label.en: 女频种田: prose and progression

label.zh: 让选择与结果在场景里发生
label.en: Develop choices and results in scenes

label.zh: 作者文风、事实与修改范围
label.en: Author style, facts and revision scope

title.zh: 科幻末世小说怎么写：资源、规则与信任同时倒计时
title.en: Writing Apocalyptic Sci-Fi: Resources, Rules and Trust Under Pressure

seo_title.zh: 科幻末世小说怎么写｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: How to Write Apocalyptic Sci-Fi | ZenStory

description.zh: 把灾变规律、资源消耗和队伍信任连成选择链，让每次生存收益都带来损耗或暴露。
description.en: Connect disaster patterns, resource use and group trust through choices. Make every survival gain bring depletion or exposure.

answer.zh: 科幻末世文可以先建立可观察的灾变规律和立即影响行动的资源缺口，让人物根据有限证据试错。水、电、时间与队伍信任怎样限制选择，需要有前后连续性；得到资源后再判断它改变了哪些机会或风险，不必每次强加新损失。科技和灾害规律服从本书设定，角色推测与已经确认的事实分开。
answer.en: Start a science-fiction survival story with an observable disaster pattern and a resource gap affecting immediate choices. Let characters test limited evidence. Water, power, time, and trust should constrain action consistently; when resources arrive, identify changed opportunities or risks without forcing a new loss every time. Technology and disaster rules follow the book’s setup, with character hypotheses kept separate from confirmed facts.

heading.zh: 先把故事的主要冲突写清
heading.en: Define the Story Engine

body.zh:
三条线同时运转：外部灾变怎样变化，资源按什么速度消耗，队伍中谁愿意承担风险。科技或能力必须说明适用条件与代价。设定解释跟随试错：人物先依据有限证据行动，结果再修正规则，避免开篇用百科全书宣布世界。

题材卡强调生存压力，本书仍可安排安全恢复、关系回收或单纯得到补给的段落。危险与消耗在需要它们的行动中保持一致，不能为了“每章都有代价”临时削掉已经确认的收益。
body.en:
Keep three strands moving together: how the external disaster changes, how quickly resources are consumed and who in the group will take risks. Establish the conditions and costs of technology or special abilities. Explain the setting through trial and error: characters act on limited evidence, then use the result to revise their understanding of the rules. Avoid opening with an encyclopaedic announcement of the world.

The genre card emphasizes survival pressure, but a book can still include safe recovery, relationship payoff, or a straightforward supply gain. Keep danger and consumption consistent where relevant rather than inventing losses to meet a per-chapter quota.

heading.zh: 怎样持续推进而不重复
heading.en: Keep Progressing Without Repetition

body.zh:
| 获得 | 可能的后果 |
|---|---|
| 新水源 | 位置暴露、净化负担 |
| 避难所名额 | 规则约束、队伍取舍 |
| 能源设备 | 噪声、维护、使用权限 |
| 新成员 | 技能增加、信任成本上升 |

这张表列出可能的后果，不要求每次获得都同时出现对应损失。检查当前循环改变了哪些规则认知、资源余量、队伍关系或退路。连续打怪却不改变这些状态，只会变成重复动作。
body.en:
| Gain | Possible effects |
|---|---|
| A new water source | An exposed location and the burden of purification |
| Places in a shelter | Rules to comply with and choices about the group |
| Energy equipment | Noise, maintenance and permission to use it |
| A new member | More skills, but a higher cost of building trust |

These are possible effects, not compulsory losses attached to every gain. Check which understanding, resources, relationships, or routes change in the current loop. Repeated monster fights that leave all these states unchanged become repetitive action.

heading.zh: 原创范例
heading.en: Original Example

body.zh:
以下为原创虚构设定与纸面案例，不是实测通讯或求生方案。

极寒后的地下交通站只剩一块有电的便携电池，够广播终端短时工作。终端标着“定位请求会自动回传站点编号”。工程师乔岚此前见过另一站发请求后有巡查机抵达，因此怀疑求救信号与巡查有关；她并不知道两者是否存在直接指令关系，也不知道断电能否停止已经发出的信息。队伍需要终端里的药库路线，尚未取得药品。

乔岚没有与所有人商量，就把终端和电池带到已撤空的站台；其他人留在不联网的维修间。屏幕先显示本站编号“已发送”，再出现药库坐标，她记下后拔电。随后巡查机进入站台，停在这条撤离近路的入口扫描，队伍暂时不能从这里隐蔽离开。

这个结果支持继续调查“定位请求与巡查的关联”，并说明至少本次断电没有阻止巡查到来。它不能证明巡查系统的全部用途、维修间已经暴露，或坐标里的药品仍在。路线到手与药品到手也属于两步。

队员指出她擅自把撤离口用作试验。乔岚承认没有预先商量，分别说明面板文字、自己见过的两次巡查和仍未知的部分，提出下次联网先由队伍一起判断地点与退路。在场队员实际同意这一约定；他们转去检查另一条已知但较长的出口，是否能通行留到下一段。

本段同时留下电池使用、目前被占的入口与新的讨论约定。风险来自具体行动和可见回应，没有把一次局部观察升级成主角知道整个系统真相。
body.en:
This is an original fictional setup and paper example, not a tested communications or survival plan.

After extreme cold, an underground station has one portable battery with enough power to run a broadcast terminal briefly. Its panel says a location request automatically sends the station identifier. Engineer Qiao Lan once saw patrol machines arrive after another station made a request, so she suspects a connection. She does not know whether the request directly commands patrols or whether disconnection can halt an already sent message. The team needs the terminal’s route to a medicine store; it has not obtained medicine.

Without consulting everyone, Qiao carries the terminal and battery to the evacuated platform; the others remain in an offline repair room. The screen first marks the station identifier “Sent,” then displays coordinates. She records them and unplugs the battery. A patrol subsequently enters the platform and scans the entrance used as a short evacuation route. The team cannot currently leave unnoticed through it.

This supports investigating the association between location requests and patrols and shows that disconnection did not prevent this arrival. It does not establish the system’s entire purpose, exposure of the repair room, or medicine still present at the coordinates. Obtaining a route and obtaining medicine are separate actions.

A teammate objects to Qiao using the exit for an experiment without consultation. She acknowledges that choice, separates the panel message and two observed patrol arrivals from what remains unknown, and proposes deciding the location and retreat together before the next connection. The teammates present actually agree. They turn to inspect another known, longer exit; whether it is passable remains for the next passage.

The scene carries forward battery use, a presently occupied entrance, and an agreed discussion rule. Risk comes from specific actions and visible responses, without making a local observation reveal the whole system.

heading.zh: 常见写偏与修正
heading.en: Common Missteps and Fixes

body.zh:
| 写偏 | 修正 |
|---|---|
| 囤货没有消耗 | 记录使用、维护与暴露代价 |
| 灾变规律随时改 | 用试错证据逐步修正规则 |
| 队友靠宣誓建立信任 | 用分配、守夜、救援与违约证明 |
| 危机像观光 | 让普通人的选择和损失持续存在 |

设计基地规则时同时写明执行者、违规后果和可被人物利用的边界。规则只用广播宣布却从不影响分配和行动，会沦为背景。让人物在遵守、质疑或绕开规则时付出不同代价，秩序线才能与生存线合流。队伍因此必须重新选择。
body.en:
| Misstep | Fix |
|---|---|
| Stockpiles that never diminish | Track use, maintenance and the cost of exposure |
| Disaster rules changing arbitrarily | Revise the rules gradually through evidence from trial and error |
| Teammates establishing trust through oaths alone | Demonstrate it through allocation, night watches, rescues and broken commitments |
| Crises feeling like sightseeing | Keep ordinary people’s choices and losses present throughout |

When designing base rules, identify who enforces them, the consequences of breaking them and the limits characters can exploit. Rules announced only over a broadcast, but never affecting allocation or action, become background decoration. Make compliance, questioning and circumvention carry different costs so the struggle over order joins the struggle for survival. The group must then choose again.

q.zh: 这种方法需要固定章节数吗？
q.en: Does this method require a fixed number of chapters?

a.zh: 不需要。章节与阶段由故事实际变化决定，表格只帮助检查因果、资源与关系是否前进。
a.en: No. Chapters and phases follow the story’s actual changes. The table only helps check whether cause and effect, resources and relationships are moving forward.

q.zh: 可以直接套用示例情节吗？
q.en: Can I reuse the example plot directly?

a.zh: 示例用于展示方法。应替换故事发动机、人物选择与后果，避免只改姓名和场景。
a.en: The example demonstrates the method. Replace the story engine, character choices and consequences rather than merely changing names and locations.

text.zh: 在 Claude Code 里说：“用 /story-long-write 按本文方法规划我的故事，先写核心承诺、人物目标和可持续推进方式，不写完整正文”（Codex 里使用 `$story-long-write`）。
text.en: In Claude Code, say: “Use /story-long-write to plan my story with this article’s method. Start with the core promise, character goals and a sustainable way to move the story forward. Do not write the full prose.” In Codex, use `$story-long-write`.

label.zh: 科幻末世正文方法
作者与本书文风

title.zh: 西幻小说怎么写：让制度和魔法代价进入行动
title.en: Writing Western Fantasy: Put Institutions and Magic Costs into Action

seo_title.zh: 西幻小说怎么写｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: How to Write Western Fantasy | ZenStory

description.zh: 用身份制度、职业权限、契约和能力代价塑造西幻冲突，避免只把东方升级换成西式名词。
description.en: Build conflicts through status, professional permissions, contracts and costs of power. Avoid reskinning cultivation progression with Western terms.

answer.zh: 西方奇幻先选一套会直接限制人物行动的制度：领地税、行会资格、神殿裁决、种族身份或契约义务。魔法能力同时写明能做什么、要付什么和由谁承认结果；专名只在本章会影响任务、交易或关系时出现。
answer.en: Start Western fantasy with an institution that directly constrains action: territorial taxes, guild qualifications, temple rulings, racial status or contractual obligations. For magic, establish what it can do, what it costs and who recognises its results. Introduce specialised names only when they affect the chapter’s task, a transaction or a relationship.

heading.zh: 先把故事的主要冲突写清
heading.en: Define the Story Engine

body.zh: 故事的主要冲突来自制度、身份与能力代价的交叉。主角想完成具体任务，制度决定他有没有资格，身份影响谁相信他，魔法代价迫使他取舍。胜利要由行会、契约、领地或同伴行动承认，避免打完怪后世界秩序毫无变化。
body.en: The story engine lies where institutions, identity and the cost of abilities intersect. The protagonist wants to complete a specific task. Institutions determine whether they qualify, identity affects who believes them, and magic’s costs force trade-offs. A victory should be recognised through a guild, a contract, a territory’s response or companions’ actions. Avoid leaving the world’s order unchanged after every monster fight.

heading.zh: 怎样持续推进而不重复
heading.en: Keep Progressing Without Repetition

body.zh:
| 世界要素 | 进入剧情的方式 |
|---|---|
| 职业 | 决定许可、报酬和责任 |
| 契约 | 给出义务、漏洞与违约代价 |
| 魔法 | 解决一类问题，同时制造损耗 |
| 种族/信仰 | 改变信任、法律位置与联盟 |
| 领地 | 把资源、税收和保护责任绑在一起 |

新地图应改变制度组合与任务难度，不能只换更强怪物。
body.en:
| World element | How it enters the plot |
|---|---|
| Occupation | Determines permissions, payment and responsibilities |
| Contract | Establishes obligations, loopholes and the cost of breach |
| Magic | Solves one kind of problem while causing depletion or harm |
| Race or faith | Changes trust, legal standing and alliances |
| Territory | Binds resources, taxation and duties of protection together |

A new location should change the combination of institutions and the difficulty of the task, not merely introduce stronger monsters.

heading.zh: 原创范例
heading.en: Original Example

body.zh:
原创港城规定，潮汐魔法只能由登记法师施展；海墙契约另有一条已建立的程序：行会书记可指定临时记录员，职责仅是记录指令和执行结果。混血抄写员伊莱能解读古契约，但不是登记法师，每读一段还会失去一段近期记忆。

以下沿用解读、指定、施法三种权限，把原来的申请到获救展开；伊莱不获得施法资格：

> 伊莱把解读交给码头工人抄下，神殿代表按住记录页：“帮忙写字不等于正式记录。请书记指定。”
>
> 他转向行会书记：“按海墙程序，指定他们记录指令与执行。解读在这里，先核对。”
>
> 书记比照契约，指向两名工人：“由你们担任临时记录员，只记这次执行。”两人报出姓名，记录在册。
>
> 登记法师看过方案，发出潮汐指令。记录员写下先后，工人照令调整缆绳；最后一艘船靠稳时，书记把结果交回伊莱。
>
> “署名只留你？”
>
> 伊莱看着两页执行记录：“解读记我，指令和记录各记实际做的人。”书记补齐姓名，让他确认。
>
> 他认得自己写出的内容，却想不起最先是谁说愿意帮忙。“第一句是谁说的？”
>
> 工人指着记录里自己完成的事项。伊莱把纸收好；它告诉他谁做了什么，并没有让那段声音重新回来。

船队已按原方案获救，正式记录员由有权书记实际指定，登记法师实际施法，参与署名按贡献保留。近期记忆的损失仍在，不用外部记录恢复，也没有临时救援豁免。
body.en:
Original port-city rules reserve tidal magic for registered mages. An established seawall procedure lets a guild clerk appoint temporary recorders to document instructions and execution. Eli, a mixed-heritage scribe, can read the ancient contract but is not a registered mage; each passage costs a recent memory.

Develop the request and rescue while preserving separate reading, appointment and casting authority:

> Eli handed his reading to the dockworkers to copy. The temple representative held the page. “Helping write is not formal recording. Ask the clerk to appoint them.”
>
> He turned to the guild clerk. “Appoint them under the seawall procedure to record instructions and execution. Check this reading first.”
>
> Comparing it with the contract, the clerk addressed two workers. “Temporary recorders for this execution only.” They gave their names, entered in the register.
>
> Registered mages checked the plan and issued tidal instructions. The recorders noted the sequence; workers adjusted lines as directed. When the last ship lay secure, the clerk handed the result to Eli.
>
> “Only your name?”
>
> Eli looked at the execution pages. “Credit me for the reading. Instructions and records belong to those who did them.” The clerk added their names for him to confirm.
>
> He recognised his written interpretation but could not remember who first offered help. “Who said the first words?”
>
> A worker pointed to the action recorded under his name. Eli kept the paper. It told him who had done what without bringing the lost voice back.

The fleet is saved under the existing plan. The authorised clerk actually appoints recorders; registered mages cast; contributions retain credit. Lost recent memory remains lost despite the external record, without a new rescue exemption.

heading.zh: 常见写偏与修正
heading.en: Common Missteps and Fixes

body.zh:
| 写偏 | 修正 |
|---|---|
| 专名堆满开头 | 只介绍当前任务会触发的制度 |
| 魔法解决一切 | 写清适用条件、代价与替代方案 |
| 西式名称配东方宗门逻辑 | 从领地、行会、契约与信仰关系重建制度 |
| 冒险任务互不影响 | 让结果改变资格、联盟或责任 |

建立新制度时先写一场普通人如何办事：谁发许可、怎样申诉、违约会失去什么。读者通过行动理解世界，比连续术语更牢。之后让主角的特殊能力穿过同一制度，差异与代价都会更清楚。制度也会因此显得可信。
body.en:
| Misstep | Fix |
|---|---|
| Filling the opening with specialised names | Introduce only the institutions the current task brings into play |
| Magic solving everything | Specify conditions, costs and alternatives |
| Western names attached to the logic of Eastern cultivation sects | Rebuild institutions around territories, guilds, contracts and faith relationships |
| Adventures having no effect on one another | Let outcomes change qualifications, alliances or responsibilities |

When introducing an institution, first write a scene showing how an ordinary person gets something done: who issues permission, how to appeal and what a breach costs. Readers understand a world more firmly through action than through a stream of terminology. Then put the protagonist’s special ability through that same institution. The differences and costs become clearer, and the institution feels more credible.

heading.zh: 用一场办事检验制度与魔法
heading.en: Test institutions and magic through a task

body.zh:
| 本例规则 | 行动条件 | 兑现后保留什么 |
|---|---|---|
| 登记法师才能施法 | 伊莱需要有资格的人执行 | 他不会突然获得法师权限 |
| 书记可指定记录员 | 正式指定后才承担见证职责 | 临时资格不等于加入行会 |
| 解读损耗近期记忆 | 读过的段落已经付出代价 | 外部记录能保存事实，不能恢复记忆 |

若要更改规则，先写清是谁有权修改、适用边界与此前依据。角色提出交换不等于机构接受，机构接受也不代表所有旁人赞成。

读者不必第一次见面就学完整历史；让他看见一次申请、拒绝与合法替代方案，再在新压力需要时补制度细节。这里的程序仅为虚构世界设计示例。
body.en:
| Rule | Condition | Limit |
|---|---|---|
| Registered mages cast | Eli needs a qualified executor | He gains no sudden casting authority |
| Clerk appoints recorders | Appointment precedes formal witness duties | Temporary status is not guild membership |
| Reading costs memory | Read passages already incurred the cost | Records preserve facts, not the lost memory |

A rule change needs an authorized actor, boundaries and prior basis. Proposing a bargain is not institutional acceptance; acceptance is not everyone’s approval.

A request, refusal and permitted alternative can teach the necessary institution before its full history. These procedures are fictional world-design examples.

q.zh: 这种方法需要固定章节数吗？
q.en: Does this method require a fixed number of chapters?

a.zh: 不需要。章节与阶段由故事实际变化决定，表格只帮助检查因果、资源与关系是否前进。
a.en: No. Chapters and phases follow the story’s actual changes. The table only helps check whether cause and effect, resources and relationships are moving forward.

q.zh: 可以直接套用示例情节吗？
q.en: Can I reuse the example plot directly?

a.zh: 示例用于展示方法。应替换故事发动机、人物选择与后果，避免只改姓名和场景。
a.en: The example demonstrates the method. Replace the story engine, character choices and consequences rather than merely changing names and locations.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 检查西幻场景。列制度权限、角色身份、魔法条件与已付代价；区分提出交换与正式接受、解读与施法。让解决方案使用已建立程序，不临时加豁免或恢复损耗。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to check institutions, identity, magic conditions and incurred costs. Separate a proposed bargain from acceptance and interpretation from casting. Resolve the scene through established procedures without new exemptions or restored losses.

label.zh: 西方奇幻正文与阶段取舍
label.en: 西方奇幻: prose and progression

label.zh: 让选择与结果在场景里发生
label.en: Develop choices and results in scenes

label.zh: 作者文风、事实与修改范围
label.en: Author style, facts and revision scope

title.zh: 职场婚恋小说怎么写：让事业与感情互相改变选择
title.en: Writing Workplace Romance: Let Work and Love Change Each Other

seo_title.zh: 职场婚恋小说怎么写｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: How to Write Workplace Romance | ZenStory

description.zh: 让工作与感情在主要选择上相遇，同时保留独立目标与日常陪伴。附展览公司全例，分清延期接受、测试完成与关系知情。
description.en: Connect work and romance at major choices while preserving independent goals. Includes an exhibition example with client replies and completed testing.

answer.zh: 职场婚恋要让事业线和关系线在同一选择上互相施压。人物各自有专业目标、组织责任和亲密需求；工作结果改变信任与公开边界，关系选择也带来项目、职位、客户或团队后果。行业细节只保留会改变判断与行动的部分。
answer.en: In workplace romance, career and relationship pressures should meet in the same choice. Each character has professional goals, organisational responsibilities and personal needs. Work outcomes change trust and the boundaries of what is public; relationship choices affect projects, positions, clients or teams. Keep only industry details that change judgments and actions.

heading.zh: 先把故事的主要冲突写清
heading.en: Define the Story Engine

body.zh: 每个主要单元写两句话：工作上谁要交付什么，关系上谁希望对方怎样表态。再看哪个主要事件能让两条线相遇。休息、约会或独立工作的段落也可成立，不要求每场同时互相付代价。办公室流言只是压力载体，真正冲突落在署名、回避、资源分配、客户承诺或是否公开关系。
body.en: For each major story unit, write two sentences: who must deliver what at work, and who wants the other person to take what stance in the relationship. Then identify a major event connecting the two. Rest, dates, and independent work may also serve the book without each scene imposing a cost across both storylines. Office gossip is only a means of exerting pressure. The real conflict concerns credit, stepping aside from decisions, resource allocation, commitments to clients or whether to make the relationship public.

heading.zh: 怎样持续推进而不重复
heading.en: Keep Progressing Without Repetition

body.zh:
| 单元检查 | 例子 |
|---|---|
| 专业分歧 | 一个方案保客户，一个方案保护团队 |
| 权力边界 | 上下级能否共同评审与回避表决 |
| 公开代价 | 承认关系会影响谁的信誉与机会 |
| 私人需求 | 支持对方是否意味着放弃自己的目标 |

感情推进通过共同解决、拒绝代替、承认错误和重新分权完成。亲密动作不能替代职业后果。
body.en:
| Unit check | Example |
|---|---|
| Professional disagreement | One proposal protects the client; another protects the team |
| Limits of authority | Whether a manager and subordinate can review together and abstain from voting |
| Cost of disclosure | Whose reputation or opportunities will be affected by acknowledging the relationship |
| Personal needs | Whether supporting the other person means giving up one’s own goal |

Develop the relationship through solving problems together, refusing to decide for the other person, admitting mistakes and redistributing authority. Intimate gestures cannot replace professional consequences.

heading.zh: 原创范例
heading.en: Original Example

body.zh:
城市展览公司里，项目经理叶知与灯光师周昱隐瞒恋爱关系。客户要删去团队原本已安排的安全测试以赶期开幕，周昱拒绝签字；叶知若坚持测试，主管将接管对客户的排期谈判，她会失去刚获得的项目主导权。

以下把原有安排展开为连续交流。验收、回避与交接均为本故事的团队规则，不是通用职场制度。

> 叶知把延期表放到会议桌上：“测试保留。我与周昱在交往，先向主管和验收组说明。我申请退出灯光验收表决，资料仍由我交。”
>
> 主管看了新日期：“内部按这版。验收换负责人，排期谈判由我接。你把资料交清。”叶知把自己那份排期权限从表上划去，没有说损失不存在。
>
> 主管拨通客户电话，开了免提：“保留测试需要改到这一天开幕，我们重新交付排期。”他只解释工作安排，没说恋爱关系。
>
> 客户核过日程：“这次接受，请发新表。”叶知发出已确认版本，把资料和待交接项交给新负责人，对方逐项接收：“这些由我验收。”
>
> 新排期内，周昱把完成的测试记录送来。独立验收人核对，确认本次结果。叶知收好交接回执，没有替他签掉这一步。
>
> 下班吃饭，周昱问：“还想着排期的事？”
>
> “嗯。那是我刚拿到的主导权。”
>
> 他把自己想说的安慰停住：“我知道。你要说，我听着。”叶知继续讲她准备怎样面对下一次机会，没有要求他立刻解决职位问题。

内部接受、客户接受、实际交接、独立测试与验收分别发生，才能写改期与测试完成。主管和验收组知道关系，客户只知道排期理由，其他同事也不会自动知情。叶知失去此次排期主导权，周昱保留并履行专业责任；一顿饭没有取消损失。下一阶段可写竞争，也可先留稳定陪伴，不为配额立即制造新危机。
body.en:
At a fictional exhibition company, project manager Ye Zhi and lighting specialist Zhou Yu keep their relationship secret. The client wants to remove an already planned safety test. Zhou refuses to sign. If Ye keeps the test, her supervisor will take over scheduling negotiations, costing her recently gained project control.

Expand the established arrangements into continuous exchanges. Review, withdrawal and handover are this fictional team’s rules, not universal workplace policy.

> Ye set the revised schedule on the meeting table. “Keep testing. Zhou and I are in a relationship; I’m telling the supervisor and review group. I request withdrawal from the lighting acceptance vote. I’ll still deliver the documents.”
>
> The supervisor checked the date. “Internally, use this. Another lead will review. I take the schedule negotiation; you complete handover.” Ye removed her scheduling authority from the sheet without treating the loss as unreal.
>
> The supervisor called the client on speaker. “Retaining testing requires this opening date. We’ll send the revised schedule.” He explained work, not the relationship.
>
> Checking the calendar, the client said, “Accepted for this opening. Send it.” Ye sent the agreed version and handed documents and outstanding items to the new lead, who checked each. “I’ll handle these reviews.”
>
> Within the revised schedule, Zhou delivered completed test records. The independent reviewer checked and confirmed this result. Ye kept the handover receipt without signing away his responsibility.
>
> Over dinner, Zhou asked, “Still thinking about scheduling?”
>
> “Yes. I had only just gained that lead.”
>
> He stopped the reassurance he was about to offer. “I know. If you want to talk, I’m listening.” Ye explained how she would approach another opportunity without asking him to solve her position immediately.

Internal acceptance, client acceptance, handover, testing and independent review happen separately before the schedule and tests can be called complete. Supervisor and reviewers know the relationship; the client knows only the scheduling reason, with no automatic disclosure to all colleagues. Ye loses this negotiation lead while Zhou fulfils his responsibility. Dinner does not cancel the loss. Competition or stable companionship can follow without a compulsory immediate crisis.

heading.zh: 常见写偏与修正
heading.en: Common Missteps and Fixes

body.zh:
| 写偏 | 修正 |
|---|---|
| 职场只是约会背景 | 给每场工作明确交付和责任 |
| 行业术语像汇报 | 只写会改变选择的流程与证据 |
| 爱情自动解决事业困难 | 保留专业判断、实际后果和独立责任，不强迫每次互相损失 |
| 靠反复误会拉扯 | 用公开边界、共同决策和后果推进 |

若主线承诺职场与婚恋相互影响，就在主要转向检查工作分工、公开评价、退出选择与信任怎样相连。普通日常、独立目标和喘息段不必每次交叉；只有一条线长期无作用或违背本书承诺时，才考虑重新组织。
body.en:
| Misstep | Fix |
|---|---|
| The workplace is only a backdrop for dates | Give each work scene a clear deliverable and responsibility |
| Industry terminology sounds like a report | Include only processes and evidence that change choices |
| Love automatically solves career problems | Keep professional judgment, actual consequences, and independent responsibilities without compulsory losses every time |
| Repeated misunderstandings provide all the tension | Progress through disclosure boundaries, joint decisions and consequences |

Where the book promises interaction between work and romance, check their connection at major turns through roles, public appraisal, exit, and trust. Everyday life, independent goals, and breathing room need not cross both lines each time. Reorganize when a line persistently has no function or breaks this book’s promise.

heading.zh: 复查同一个决定的两条后果
heading.en: Check both consequences of one decision

body.zh:
| 决定 | 记录 |
|---|---|
| 叶知坚持测试 | 工作结果：排期与负责人改变，交接仍需完成；关系结果：她支持专业判断，但不替周昱完成职责 |
| 向指定人员说明关系 | 工作结果：验收表决另作安排；关系结果：两人失去一部分隐私，知情范围仍有限 |
| 周昱继续完成测试 | 工作结果：专业责任实际落地；关系结果：支持不只是公开表态，也包含独立履职 |

若删掉恋爱设定后工作选择完全一样，就检查关系带来的风险有没有进入场景；若删掉工作目标后仍只是同样的告白，就检查职业任务是否只是背景。两者未必要每句都相交，但主要转向应能看到彼此影响。

不能把“她申请回避”写成“回避已经成立”。需要另一方接受的安排，就让接受、拒绝或替代方案实际发生。
body.en:
| Choice | Record |
|---|---|
| Ye retains testing | Work: Schedule and ownership change; handover remains; Relationship: She supports judgment without doing Zhou’s job |
| Disclosure to named people | Work: Another reviewer is appointed; Relationship: Privacy changes within a limited audience |
| Zhou performs tests | Work: Professional responsibility is fulfilled; Relationship: Support includes independent work |

If removing romance leaves every work choice unchanged, check whether relationship risks enter the scene. If removing work leaves the same confession, the task may only be scenery. Major turns should show interaction without forcing it into every line.

A requested withdrawal is not an accepted arrangement. Show acceptance, refusal or an alternative when another person’s decision is required.

q.zh: 这种方法需要固定章节数吗？
q.en: Does this method require a fixed number of chapters?

a.zh: 不需要。章节与阶段由故事实际变化决定，表格只帮助检查因果、资源与关系是否前进。
a.en: No. Chapters and phases follow the story’s actual changes. The table only helps check whether cause and effect, resources and relationships are moving forward.

q.zh: 可以直接套用示例情节吗？
q.en: Can I reuse the example plot directly?

a.zh: 示例用于展示方法。应替换故事发动机、人物选择与后果，避免只改姓名和场景。
a.en: The example demonstrates the method. Replace the story engine, character choices and consequences rather than merely changing names and locations.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 检查职场婚恋主要场景，附工作目标、人物关系与本书文风。核对决定权、实际回应、执行和知情，区分内部认可、客户接受、交接与完成。保留独立责任与稳定陪伴，不强迫每场两线互相付代价；只改请求范围。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to review major workplace-romance scenes with work goals, relationships, and the book’s voice. Check authority, replies, execution, and knowledge; separate internal approval, client acceptance, handover, and completion. Retain independent responsibilities and stable company without cross-line costs every scene. Revise only the requested scope.

label.zh: 职场与关系的共同压力
具体情绪与可信回应
作者选择与默认条款
把概括的变化展开为场景

title.zh: 小说人物设定集怎么整理：角色、时间线与知识边界模板
title.en: Organising a Story Bible: Characters, Timelines and Knowledge

seo_title.zh: 小说人物设定集怎么整理｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: How to Organise a Story Bible | ZenStory

description.zh: 把静态人设、当前状态、关系、时间线、世界规则和未结事项分开维护，减少长篇设定冲突。
description.en: Maintain stable character facts, current states, relationships, timelines, world rules and open threads separately to reduce continuity conflicts.

answer.zh: 长篇设定集要区分稳定事实和会随剧情变化的状态。角色卡保存身份、底线与长期目标；当前状态只记录位置、资源、关系、已知信息和未结事项的最新值；时间线保存客观顺序，知识边界另记角色与读者各自知道什么。发生变化时更新对应位置，避免多份真相并存。
answer.en: A long-form story bible should distinguish stable facts from states that change with the plot. Character profiles hold identity, boundaries and long-term goals. Current-state records keep only the latest location, resources, relationships, known information and unresolved matters. A timeline records the objective sequence, while separate knowledge records track what characters and readers each know. Update the appropriate place when something changes so conflicting versions of the truth do not accumulate.

heading.zh: 一套够用的设定集
heading.en: A Story Bible That Covers the Essentials

body.zh:
| 模块 | 内容与更新 |
|---|---|
| 角色卡 | **保存：**身份、经历、能力边界、长期目标；**更新：**设定被正式改变 |
| 当前状态 | **保存：**位置、资源、关系、已知、未结事项；**更新：**每次发生有效变化 |
| 关系表 | **保存：**双方承诺、债务、公开与私下位置；**更新：**关系动作落地 |
| 作者时间线 | **保存：**客观事件顺序与日期；**更新：**新事实确认 |
| 读者已知 | **保存：**正文已经揭示的内容；**更新：**章节完成 |
| 世界规则 | **保存：**适用条件、例外、代价；**更新：**规则建立或修订 |

同一事实指定一个权威位置，其余文件只引用或记录当前结果。
body.en:
| Module | Contents / update |
|---|---|
| Character profile | **Contents: **Identity, history, ability limits and long-term goals. **Update: **When an established fact is formally changed |
| Current state | **Contents: **Location, resources, relationships, knowledge and open matters. **Update: **After each meaningful change |
| Relationship record | **Contents: **Mutual promises, debts and how the relationship stands in public and in private. **Update: **When an action changes the relationship |
| Author’s timeline | **Contents: **Objective event order and dates. **Update: **When a new fact is confirmed |
| Reader knowledge | **Contents: **What the prose has already revealed. **Update: **When a chapter is finished |
| World rules | **Contents: **Conditions, exceptions and costs. **Update: **When a rule is established or revised |

Give each fact one authoritative home. Other files should refer to it or record only the resulting current state.

heading.zh: 可复制的角色状态模板
heading.en: A Character-State Template to Copy

body.zh:
> **截至章节**：
> **当前位置与正在执行的行动**：
> **当前目标**：
> **能力与可用资源**：
> **关键关系**：对每个重要对象写承诺、债务和边界
> **本人已知／误信／隐瞒**：
> **未结事项**：
> **本次变化来源**：

只为后续会复用的角色建状态页。一次性路人留在章节记录，避免设定集膨胀。修订旧章时，从改动点向后重算受影响的状态。
body.en:
> **Current as of chapter:**
> **Present location and action underway:**
> **Current goal:**
> **Abilities and available resources:**
> **Key relationships:** Record promises, debts and boundaries for each important person.
> **What the character knows / falsely believes / conceals:**
> **Unresolved matters:**
> **Source of this change:**

Create state pages only for characters who will recur. Leave one-off passers-by in chapter notes to keep the story bible manageable. When revising an earlier chapter, work forward from the change and recalculate the affected states.

heading.zh: 原创填写示例：旧水站管理员
heading.en: Original Filled-In Example: The Old Water Station’s Caretaker

body.zh:
> **截至章节**：第十二章
> **当前位置与行动**：旧水站值班室，准备关闭北线阀门
> **当前目标**：在检修队到达前证明污染来自回流管
> **资源**：值班钥匙、过去三日压力表；没有取样权限
> **关键关系**：欠居民代表一次公开说明；与站长的口头保密约定已破裂
> **已知**：北线夜间压力异常；**误信**：检修队已收到完整记录
> **未结事项**：谁删掉了凌晨数据；钥匙为何被复制

这份当前状态省去童年和外貌，专门保存下一章会约束行动的事实。
body.en:
> **Current as of chapter:** Chapter twelve
> **Location and action:** The old water station’s duty room, preparing to close the northern-line valve
> **Current goal:** Prove that contamination comes from the return pipe before the maintenance crew arrives
> **Resources:** Duty keys and pressure records from the past three days; no authority to take samples
> **Key relationships:** Owes the residents’ representative a public explanation; the verbal confidentiality agreement with the station manager has broken down
> **Knows:** Northern-line pressure is abnormal at night; **falsely believes:** the maintenance crew has received the complete records
> **Unresolved matters:** Who deleted the early-morning data, and why the key was copied

This current-state record omits childhood and appearance. It stores the facts that will constrain action in the next chapter.

heading.zh: 发现冲突时怎样分级
heading.en: Prioritise Conflicts When You Find Them

body.zh: 先找明文事实，再核规则条件、时间顺序、因果和代价。直接互斥或破坏主线的冲突优先处理；隐性因果断裂其次；外貌小差异单独记录；伏笔超期属于提醒。每条问题都引用前提、触发事件和矛盾点。设定集负责给证据，不替作者判断哪条剧情更好。
body.en: Locate explicit facts first, then check rule conditions, chronological order, cause and effect, and costs. Address direct contradictions or conflicts that break the main storyline first, followed by less obvious causal gaps. Record minor appearance discrepancies separately; overdue foreshadowing belongs among reminders. For each issue, cite the premise, the triggering event and the point of contradiction. The story bible supplies evidence. It does not decide for the author which plot is better.

heading.zh: 更新一条变化，不清空其他事实
heading.en: Update a changed dimension without losing the rest

body.zh:
沿用上面水站例子：第十三章，居民代表接过值班钥匙；主角仍在水站，与站长的保密约定仍已破裂，也仍没有取样权限。新的记录应改持物，不把其他维度一起清空。

| 状态维度 | 前后变化 |
|---|---|
| 钥匙归属 | **第十二章：**主角持有；**第十三章：**已交居民代表，注明正文交接处 |
| 位置与权限 | **第十二章：**水站，没有取样权限；**第十三章：**仍在水站，权限未变 |
| 关系与未结事 | **第十二章：**保密约定破裂，复制钥匙未查清；**第十三章：**两项均保留，不能因交钥匙自动和解 |

手工笔记可以按表更新权威条目。Oh Story 项目则由章节工作流提交实际变化，再由结构化状态生成当前视图，不逐份手改派生文件；角色设定卡仍保存稳定身份和长期目标。

“居民代表拿到钥匙”也不能自动写成“居民都知道完整调查”。只记录已发生的交接、在场者及实际透露内容，大纲中的未来安排另存。

**先有正文交接，再填写完整当前状态：**沿用已选的第十三章交钥匙结果，下面补一小段候选，而不是新增调查结论。

> 居民代表在值班室桌前伸出手。“钥匙先交我保管吧。”
>
> 主角把值班钥匙递过去，等对方接稳才松手。过去三日的压力表留在自己面前。
>
> “公开说明我还欠着，”主角说，“我继续在这里核记录。”
>
> 代表收好钥匙，没有拿走桌上的材料。

这次交接只改变钥匙持有者；没有取样、公开数据或解决复制钥匙疑点。按前章仍成立的事实，人工记录可更新为：

> **截至章节：**第十三章
> **位置与当前行动：**仍在旧水站值班室，继续核记录；北线阀门仍只是准备关闭，本段未执行关闭。
> **当前目标：**仍想在检修队到达前证明污染来自回流管；这是目标，不是已证明的来源。
> **资源与权限：**过去三日压力表仍可用；值班钥匙现由居民代表持有；仍没有取样权限。
> **关系：**仍欠居民代表公开说明；与站长的口头保密约定仍已破裂。
> **已知／误信：**仍知道北线夜间压力异常；仍误信检修队已收到完整记录，本段没有校正它。
> **未结事项：**凌晨数据谁删除、钥匙为何被复制，均未查清。
> **本次变化依据：**第十三章值班室当面交接；正式稿件补实际章段位置。

这是一张完整的人工当前卡，供作者核对该保留什么；不是要把卡片原样粘进Oh Story派生文件。项目中按章节事务提交真实变化并生成当前视图，核对工具能证明视图对应状态，不能证明小说本身没有漏写或误记。
body.en:
Continuing the water-station example: in chapter thirteen, the resident representative receives the duty key. The protagonist remains at the station, lacks sampling permission and has already broken the confidentiality agreement. Update possession without clearing other dimensions.

| Field | Change |
|---|---|
| Key | **Before: **Protagonist holds it. **After: **Representative receives it; cite the handover |
| Location and authority | **Before: **Station; no sampling permission. **After: **Both unchanged |
| Ties and open issue | **Before: **Broken agreement; copied key unexplained. **After: **Both remain; key handover does not restore trust |

Manual notes can update their designated authoritative entries. Oh Story submits changes through the chapter workflow and derives current views from structured state, rather than editing each generated file. Character cards retain stable identity and long-term goals.

Receiving a key does not make every resident informed about the investigation. Record actual transfer, witnesses and disclosed information; keep future plans separate.

**Write the transfer before filling the complete current state:** Keep the selected chapter-thirteen key handover and add a brief candidate, without a new investigation finding.

> The residents’ representative held out a hand at the duty-room table. “Let me keep the key for now.”
>
> The protagonist passed over the duty key and released it after the representative had a grip. The past three days’ pressure records remained in front of the protagonist.
>
> “I still owe the public explanation,” the protagonist said. “I’ll keep checking the records here.”
>
> The representative put away the key without taking the papers.

This changes key possession without sampling, publishing data or solving the copied-key question. Preserve the preceding facts in a manual update:

> **Current through:** Chapter thirteen.
> **Location and action:** Still in the old station’s duty room, checking records. Northern-line closure remains intended; no closing action appears here.
> **Goal:** Still wants to prove the return pipe caused contamination before the crew arrives. A goal is not a proven cause.
> **Resources and authority:** The pressure records remain available; the representative holds the duty key; sampling permission is still absent.
> **Relationships:** A public explanation is still owed; the station manager’s verbal confidentiality agreement remains broken.
> **Knowledge / false belief:** Still knows about abnormal nighttime pressure and mistakenly believes the crew has complete records. This passage does not correct that belief.
> **Open matters:** Deleted early-morning data and copied key remain unexplained.
> **Change source:** Chapter-thirteen handover in the duty room; cite the actual passage in a real manuscript.

This complete manual card helps check what must remain. Do not paste it into an Oh Story generated view. Submit actual changes through the chapter transaction to generate current views. A matching view proves correspondence with stored state, not that the novel omitted or misrecorded nothing.

q.zh: 这种方法需要固定章节数吗？
q.en: Does this method require a fixed number of chapters?

a.zh: 不需要。章节与阶段由故事实际变化决定，表格只帮助检查因果、资源与关系是否前进。
a.en: No. Let actual changes in the story determine chapters and stages. The table only helps check whether causality, resources, and relationships are moving forward.

q.zh: 可以直接套用示例情节吗？
q.en: Can I reuse the example plot directly?

a.zh: 示例用于展示方法。应替换故事发动机、人物选择与后果，避免只改姓名和场景。
a.en: The example demonstrates the method. Replace the story engine, character choices, and consequences rather than merely changing names and locations.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 根据已写正文更新设定集，分稳定设定、截至第M章的完整状态、客观事件与各方已知。每项变化引用正文；只更新改变的维度，保留其他有效事实。Oh Story追踪沿章节流程提交，不手改派生视图；本轮不写正文。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to update stable settings, complete current state through chapter M, objective events and each party’s knowledge from written prose. Cite changes and preserve unaffected dimensions. Submit Oh Story tracking through the chapter workflow, not generated views. Do not draft prose.

label.zh: 追踪权威与当前视图
改稿后的完整状态重算
把已定变化写成连贯场景
label.en: Write established changes as connected scenes

title.zh: 小说封面提示词怎么写：题材、构图和文字分层
title.en: Writing Novel-Cover Prompts: Separate Genre, Composition and Text

seo_title.zh: 小说封面提示词怎么写｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Writing Novel-Cover Prompts | ZenStory

description.zh: 从题材承诺提炼主体、背景、色彩和光线，再把书名与作者名作为独立文字层处理。
description.en: Translate a genre promise into subject, background, colour and light. Treat the title and author name as separate text layers.

answer.zh: 小说封面提示词先提炼一个最重要的阅读承诺，再选择能让人一眼识别题材的主体、场景与色彩。提示词按主体、动作或关系、前中远景、光线、版式和文字预留区分层描述。书名与作者名独立处理，并在生成后人工核对文字、辨识度和使用权限。
answer.en: Start a novel-cover prompt with the reading promise that matters most, then choose a subject, setting and palette that make the genre recognisable at a glance. Describe the subject, action or relationship, foreground/midground/background, lighting, layout and reserved text areas in separate layers. Handle the title and author name separately. After generation, manually check the lettering, legibility and usage rights.

heading.zh: 先把题材翻译成视觉证据
heading.en: Turn the Genre into Visual Evidence

body.zh:
这些是编辑依据风格库整理的候选，不是每类故事唯一的配色。先服从本书气质与作者选择，再比较哪种画面最清楚。

| 承诺 | 视觉选择 |
|---|---|
| 玄幻成长 | **主体证据：** 人物、法器、资格徽记；**背景证据：** 山门、试炼场、远层势力；**色彩与光线：** 深色环境配一处能量焦点 |
| 都市脑洞 | **主体证据：** 普通人和异常物件；**背景证据：** 办公室、街道、账单或屏幕；**色彩与光线：** 现实冷色配异常亮色 |
| 悬疑追查 | **主体证据：** 证物、背影、受限空间；**背景证据：** 雨夜、档案室、空房；**色彩与光线：** 高反差与局部照明 |
| 情感关系 | **主体证据：** 两人的距离和视线；**背景证据：** 共享空间或分隔物；**色彩与光线：** 与关系温度一致 |

题材元素只保留最能证明承诺的一两项，避免把所有梗都塞上封面。
body.en:
These are editorial options drawn from the style library, not the only palette for each genre. Follow the book’s tone and the creator’s choices, then compare which picture communicates most clearly.

| Promise | Visual choices |
|---|---|
| Fantasy progression | **Evidence in the subject: ** A character, magical artefact or mark of rank; **Evidence in the background: ** A mountain gate, trial grounds or distant faction; **Colour and lighting: ** Dark surroundings with one point of energy |
| Urban speculative fiction | **Evidence in the subject: ** An ordinary person and an anomalous object; **Evidence in the background: ** An office, street, bill, or screen; **Colour and lighting: ** Cool realistic colours with one anomalous bright accent |
| Mystery investigation | **Evidence in the subject: ** Evidence, a figure seen from behind or a confined space; **Evidence in the background: ** A rainy night, archive room or empty house; **Colour and lighting: ** High contrast and localised lighting |
| Emotional relationship | **Evidence in the subject: ** The distance and eyelines between two people; **Evidence in the background: ** A shared space or something separating them; **Colour and lighting: ** Lighting and colour temperature suited to the relationship |

Keep only the one or two elements that best prove the genre promise. Do not crowd the cover with every story idea.

heading.zh: 可复用的提示词结构
heading.en: A Reusable Prompt Structure

body.zh:
> 竖版小说封面；核心阅读承诺；主要人物或象征物及其动作；前景／中景／远景层次；主色与点缀色；光源方向和情绪；顶部保留清晰书名区，底部保留作者名区；整体插画或海报质感；排除水印与无关文字。

文字内容、字体风格、位置与颜色单列。任何生成工具对文字的表现都需要成图后核对；必要时先生成无字底图，再在排版软件中添加准确文字。页面不承诺具体模型一定正确输出中文。
body.en:
> Vertical novel cover; core reading promise; main character or symbolic object and its action; foreground / midground / background; main and accent colours; light direction and mood; clear title area at the top and author-name area at the bottom; illustrated-poster finish; no watermark or unrelated text.

List the wording, font style, placement and colour separately. Check any text produced by an image tool against the finished image; if necessary, generate a text-free background first and add accurate lettering in layout software. This page does not promise that a particular model will render Chinese text correctly.

heading.zh: 原创范例：《雾港回声簿》
heading.en: Original Example: The Ledger of Fog Harbor

body.zh:
这是一本都市悬疑：档案员能听见被涂改记录留下的声音。提示词可写：

> 竖版悬疑小说封面，一名年轻档案员侧身站在狭长档案库中央，手中摊开的登记簿浮出细弱声波纹；前景是被红笔覆盖的姓名栏，中景是人物与台灯，远景的金属档案架消失在雾中；墨蓝和灰白为主色，只用暗红标记涂改处；单一冷光从上方照亮书页；顶部留出大面积干净标题区，底部留作者名区；克制的插画海报感，无水印、无额外文字。

这个示例主动选择无字底图，书名和署名另行按准确内容排版。`story-cover` 默认直接生成包含书名与署名的封面；若采用本例替代流程，需要明确提出“无字底图、后期排版”，不能把无字图称为已经交付的完整封面。
body.en:
This is an urban mystery about an archivist who can hear the sounds left behind in altered records. A prompt might read:

> Vertical mystery-novel cover. A young archivist stands in profile in the centre of a narrow records archive. Faint sound waves rise from an open ledger in their hands. In the foreground, a name field is crossed out in red ink; in the midground are the archivist and a desk lamp; in the background, metal filing shelves fade into mist. Ink blue and grey-white dominate, with dark red only to mark the altered entry. A single cool light from above illuminates the page. Leave a large, clean title area at the top and an author-name area at the bottom. Restrained illustrated-poster style. No watermark or extra text.

This example deliberately chooses a text-free background and separate layout with exact lettering. `story-cover` normally generates a complete cover including the title and byline. Specify the text-free alternative if you want it; a bare background is not a finished cover.

heading.zh: 把《雾港回声簿》补成完整制作简报
heading.en: Complete the production brief for 雾港回声簿

body.zh:
沿用上面的无字底图方案。为本例原创增加笔名“林渡”，作者选择3:4练习画幅和保存目录`covers/雾港回声簿`；画幅不是某平台当前规范。执行者仍需确认本次实际用途和交付尺寸。准确文字、图像和排版分开交代：

> Create a text-free portrait illustration for the urban mystery '雾港回声簿', by '林渡', in the author-selected 3:4 composition. One young archivist stands in profile in a narrow archive, holding an open ledger with faint sound-wave traces. Keep a red alteration mark in the foreground, the archivist and desk lamp in the midground, and metal shelves fading into mist behind. Use ink blue and grey-white with restrained dark red, and a cool light from above. Reserve a quiet upper title area and lower byline area. Render no readable text, watermark or slogan. Save a separate background candidate in the chosen folder.

这里前景被涂改的姓名栏只表现涂改痕迹，不要求无字图出现可读姓名。底图生成后先核一个人物、登记簿、声波和层次，再在作者选择的排版工具中输入准确书名“雾港回声簿”、笔名“林渡”。这一步是另行排版，不能把原生技能描述成自动提供可编辑文字层。

完成排版再导出独立上传版，核每个字、字与人物互挡、最终比例和四边。缩到实际显示大小，确认书名与档案线索还能辨认，再看当前上传预览；底图无字不是已交付封面。以上为完整方案，没有实际生成或上传；需要直接一次生图含字时，则按技能默认给准确书名与笔名，并核成图。

遇到具体问题，可接[修封面错字](/oh-story/fix-ai-book-cover-text)、[缩略图看不清](/oh-story/make-a-book-cover-readable-as-a-thumbnail)、[题材不符](/oh-story/match-a-book-cover-to-your-story)或[参考图用途](/oh-story/use-reference-images-for-a-book-cover)。
body.en:
Retain the text-free-background route above. Add the original example pen name `林渡`, an author-selected 3:4 exercise canvas and save folder `covers/雾港回声簿`. This ratio is not a current platform rule; confirm actual use and delivery dimensions separately. Specify illustration and lettering as distinct steps:

> Create a text-free portrait illustration for the urban mystery '雾港回声簿', by '林渡', in the author-selected 3:4 composition. One young archivist stands in profile in a narrow archive, holding an open ledger with faint sound-wave traces. Keep a red alteration mark in the foreground, the archivist and desk lamp in the midground, and metal shelves fading into mist behind. Use ink blue and grey-white with restrained dark red, and a cool light from above. Reserve a quiet upper title area and lower byline area. Render no readable text, watermark or slogan. Save a separate background candidate in the chosen folder.

The crossed-out name field communicates alteration marks, not readable names in a text-free picture. Inspect the generated person count, ledger, sound traces and depth. Then enter the exact title `雾港回声簿` and byline `林渡` in the author’s chosen layout tool. This is separate typesetting, not a claim that the native skill provides editable type layers automatically.

Export a distinct upload version after lettering. Check every character, overlap with the figure, final ratio and edges. At the actual display size, verify title and archive cue, then inspect the current upload preview. A text-free background is not a delivered cover. This is a complete plan, with no generation or upload performed. For a single generated image with text, follow the skill’s default using exact title and byline and inspect the result.

Continue with [incorrect lettering](/oh-story/fix-ai-book-cover-text), [thumbnail readability](/oh-story/make-a-book-cover-readable-as-a-thumbnail), [genre mismatch](/oh-story/match-a-book-cover-to-your-story) or [reference purpose](/oh-story/use-reference-images-for-a-book-cover) as needed.

heading.zh: 生成或设计后检查什么
heading.en: What to Check After Generating or Designing

body.zh:
缩小到手机缩略图，检查主体与题材是否仍可识别；确认标题区域没有复杂高光和人物面部；核对人物数量、持物、时代服装和故事设定；确认画面没有多余字样、水印或错误符号；检查作者拥有输入素材和最终用途所需的权利。

构图失败时先减少元素、扩大主体或清理文字区。风格词堆得再多，也不能补救阅读承诺不清和信息层级混乱。

预留文字区仍须在实际上传版核对。画幅不一致时可能裁掉标题或署名，具体检查见[封面书名被裁掉怎么办](/oh-story/fix-cropped-book-cover-text)。
body.en:
Reduce the cover to a phone-sized thumbnail and check that the subject and genre are still recognisable. Make sure complex highlights and faces do not intrude on the title area. Check the number of characters, what they are holding, period clothing and consistency with the story. Look for stray lettering, watermarks or incorrect symbols. Confirm you have the rights needed for the input materials and the final use.

If the composition does not work, first remove elements, enlarge the subject or clear the text area. More style keywords will not fix an unclear reading promise or a confused information hierarchy.

Check reserved lettering areas in the actual upload version. A different aspect ratio can crop the title or byline; see [fixing cropped cover text](/oh-story/fix-cropped-book-cover-text).

q.zh: 书名和作者名应该一起生成，还是后期添加？
q.en: Should the title and author name be generated together or added later?

a.zh: 希望画面与字体统一时，可以在生成请求中明确给出准确文字；需要反复改书名、字体或版式时，可以先做无字底图，再单独排版。两种方式都要逐字核对成图，并检查缩略图下的可读性。
a.en: If you want the image and lettering to feel unified, specify the exact text in the generation prompt. If you expect to revise the title, font or layout, generate a text-free background first and add the type separately. Either way, check every character in the finished image and make sure it remains legible as a thumbnail.

q.zh: 封面元素太多，看不出重点怎么办？
q.en: What should I do if the cover has too many elements and no clear focus?

a.zh: 先留一个能代表故事承诺的主体，删除重复表达题材的装饰物。把标题区从人物脸部、复杂纹理与高光中让出来，再缩小检查主体和书名能否分别读清。
a.en: Keep one subject that represents the story’s promise and remove decorative elements that repeat the genre cues. Clear the title area of faces, complex textures and highlights, then reduce the image to check that both the subject and title remain easy to read.

text.zh: 需要实际生成封面时，在 Claude Code 中用 /story-cover（Codex 中用 $story-cover），提供准确书名、作者名、目标平台和保存目录，并附上题材简介及构图偏好。这个技能会调用图像生成工具并保存封面，不只是输出文字方案。使用你有权提供的参考素材，生成后逐字核对书名、署名和画面内容。
text.en: When you need an actual generated cover, use /story-cover in Claude Code (or $story-cover in Codex). Provide the exact title, author name, target platform and save directory, along with a genre summary and composition preferences. This skill calls an image-generation tool and saves a cover; it does not merely return a text proposal. Use reference materials you have the right to provide, then check the title, byline and image content character by character.

题材构图与文字风格

title.zh: 女频小说怎么写出代入感：主角成长与情感回报
title.en: How to Build Reader Investment in Women-Focused Fiction

seo_title.zh: 女频小说怎么写出代入感：主角成长与情感回报
seo_title.en: How to Build Reader Investment in Women-Focused Fiction

description.zh: 用承诺锚点、阶段回报和人物选择维持女频长篇安全感，避免整卷受虐与事后强行补偿。
description.en: Use promise anchors, phase payoffs and character choices to sustain emotional safety. Avoid a whole volume of suffering followed by contrived compensation.

answer.zh: 这篇面向承诺成长、翻盘或逐步取得选择权的女频长篇：让主角的选择与阶段回报回应读者已投入的事，伤害和帮助都有真实后果。重要结果要区分提出、接受与执行；积累、等待和日常也可保留，不把每段压力都配成立即反击或新收益，更不规定所有女性读者只接受同一种结局。
answer.en: For a long novel promising growth, recovery, or greater agency, connect choices and returns to what readers care about, retaining real effects of harm and help. Separate proposed, accepted, and enacted results. Accumulation, waiting, and daily life may remain without requiring immediate retaliation or reward for each pressure—or prescribing one ending for all women readers.

heading.zh: 先建立三种安全感锚点
heading.en: Establish Three Anchors of Emotional Safety

body.zh:
- **方向锚点**：开篇让读者看见主角准备离开、反击、争取或重建什么。
- **选择锚点**：关键转向由主角作出，帮助和宠爱也要经过她的接受、拒绝或交换。
- **回报锚点**：需要结算的重要阶段回应本书承诺，可以留下具体结果，如收入、住处、话语权、退出能力或新的关系边界。

安全感不等于提前宣布圆满结局。它让读者知道痛苦正在改变人物的行动，而非无限重复。
body.en:
- **Direction anchor:** At the opening, show what the protagonist is preparing to leave, fight back against, pursue or rebuild.
- **Choice anchor:** Let the protagonist make the key turns. Help and affection should still leave room for her acceptance, refusal or negotiation.
- **Payoff anchor:** When an important phase needs resolution, answer the book’s promise with a concrete result, such as income, housing, influence, the ability to walk away or a new boundary in a relationship.

Emotional safety does not mean announcing a happy ending in advance. It lets readers see that suffering is changing what the character does rather than repeating endlessly.

heading.zh: 虐点怎样写出剂量与回报
heading.en: Balance Pain with a Payoff

body.zh:
需要检查关键伤害时，可以写四行：谁利用什么关系或资源造成伤害；主角当下失去什么；她因此采取哪项新行动；本阶段归还什么控制权或认知。这些问题用于找缺口，不是每节必填事件。压力可积累，也可停下来写等待与已有生活；本书承诺的回报到需要兑现时再检查，不为逐段达标另造反击。

回报也不限于“被更爱”。主角获得收入、法律或组织支持、可靠盟友、公开署名、拒绝权和离开能力，都能证明局面已动。下一次压力应挑战新边界，避免把刚取得的成长重置。
body.en:
When checking consequential harm, you can write four lines: who uses which relationship or resource to cause it; what the protagonist loses immediately; what new action she takes as a result; and what control or understanding is restored in this phase. These questions find gaps rather than prescribe events for every section. Pressure may accumulate, and waiting or established daily life may remain. Check a promised return when it needs fulfillment instead of inventing retaliation to meet a per-passage quota.

Payoff does not have to mean “being loved more.” Income, support from a legal or organisational body, a reliable ally, public credit, the right to refuse and the ability to leave can all demonstrate a changed situation. The next pressure should test the new boundary, not reset the growth the character has just achieved.

heading.zh: 把成长写成正文：不再代签，边界由对方实际接受
heading.en: Write the growth: refuse proxy blame and obtain an actual boundary

body.zh:
沿用旧剧院的原创案例，按许言的有限视角把暂停、复核、提议与接受写成正文。她是舞台监督，长期替导演伴侣承担事故责任；本场灯架故障，工作灯本来可用。独自生活在本示范中具体选为另租小房，不改原有搬离与开销结果。

> 导演把事故单推到灯光席前。“签了，写个人操作失误。”
>
> 许言看到那一栏又是自己的名字。排练单还在她手里，上面列着本次安排；签下去，故障就先变成她一个人的事。
>
> “我负责的操作可以核。这句原因还没查，我不签。”她保存排练单，暂停自己负责的灯光席，通知演员按本场原来可用的工作灯彩排。
>
> “这一场的奖金就没了。”导演说。
>
> 她没有重新开灯光席，把设备问题交到复核。稍后拿到本场结算单，奖金确实已取消，她把单子和排练记录分别留下。
>
> 复核结果送来时，许言找到维护缺失那一条，继续翻到结论。它没有判定全部事故责任。她带报告和排练单去见剧院负责人，将没有签名的事故单也放到桌上。
>
> “报告不能替大家把责任全分完。”她说，“以后的操作记录，谁实际执行，谁确认自己的部分。我不再替别人签。”
>
> 负责人看过材料。“可以。记录分开确认，事故责任继续核。”
>
> 他改好下一次的记录表，将各项操作的确认栏分开。许言看过自己那一栏，把这版带回灯光席；报告仍留在复核材料里，没有被改成导演全责的结论。
>
> 晚上，她把从共同住处搬出的箱子放进另租的小房。房租和水电要计入自己的开销，她在本月支出旁添上两行。导演发来“什么时候回来”，她回复“我已经搬出来了，工作的记录按今天定的办”，再把下一次的表放到箱子上。

许言提出职责边界，负责人接受并改记录表，这才形成阶段回报。奖金没有恢复，维护缺失也没有自动证明全部事故原因；搬离已经发生，关系仍未修复。下一轮检验新安排能否执行，不把这次接受写成所有问题永久结束。

本页用虚构剧院流程表现选择与回应，不提供通用行业流程。成长向作品可以在这一处让读者看到控制权变化；若作品承诺的是悲剧或停滞，仍按本书方向判断，不为题材标签强加同一结局。
body.en:
Keep the original theater case and write the pause, review, proposal and acceptance through Xu Yan’s limited viewpoint. The stage manager has long taken blame for her director partner. A lighting-rig failure occurs, with work lights already available. This demonstration makes independent living concrete through a rented room, retaining the established move and expenses.

> The director pushed the incident sheet toward the console. “Sign it. Operator error.”
>
> Xu saw her name in that field again. She still held the rehearsal record listing the arrangements. Her signature would make the unexplained fault her responsibility first.
>
> “Review the operations I performed. The cause hasn’t been established; I won’t sign that.” She preserved the record, paused her console and told the actors to rehearse with the already available work lights.
>
> “Then you lose this event’s bonus,” he said.
>
> She kept the console paused and submitted the equipment issue for review. Later, the settlement sheet arrived with her bonus canceled. She retained it separately from the rehearsal record.
>
> When findings arrived, Xu located the maintenance deficiency and read through the conclusion. It assigned no complete responsibility for every accident. She took the report, rehearsal record and unsigned incident sheet to the theater manager.
>
> “This doesn’t assign everyone’s responsibility,” she said. “For future operations, each person should confirm their own part. I won’t sign for someone else.”
>
> He read the materials. “Agreed. Separate confirmations; continue the incident review.”
>
> He revised the next record form with separate operator-confirmation fields. Xu checked hers and took the version back to the console. The report stayed in the review materials without becoming a finding of total blame against the director.
>
> That evening she placed boxes from their shared home in her rented room. Rent and utilities now belonged in her own expenses; she added two entries to the month’s spending. The director messaged, “When are you coming back?” She replied, “I’ve moved out. Work records follow today’s arrangement,” then put the next form on a box.

Xu proposes the boundary; the manager accepts and revises the form. That delivers this stage’s payoff. Her bonus remains lost, deficient maintenance does not establish every cause, and moving out does not repair the relationship. Later pressure tests implementation rather than treating one agreement as permanent resolution.

These fictional theater procedures present choices and responses, not universal industry practice. A growth story can make changed control visible here. A work promising tragedy or stagnation still follows its own direction instead of taking the same ending from a genre label.

heading.zh: 主情绪怎样保持一致
heading.en: Keep the Central Emotion Consistent

body.zh:
先用一句话写全书主情绪的方向，例如“从总替别人收拾后果，到相信自己的选择值得被尊重”。重要的事业、亲情和爱情线可以推动或挑战这条方向；次要情绪和普通相处也有作用，不要求每场都结算成长。

复查时问：本单元让主角更能选择，还是又回到只能等待？伤害后的回报是否与伤害对应？简介承诺的翻盘方向是否仍在推进？这些问题比给女频贴固定题材或读者标签更能约束创作。
body.en:
Write the direction of the story’s central emotion in one sentence, such as: “From always cleaning up other people’s messes to believing her own choices deserve respect.” Important work, family, and romance strands may advance or challenge that direction. Secondary feelings and ordinary interaction also have purpose; every scene need not settle growth.

During review, ask: Can the protagonist make more choices in this unit, or has she returned to waiting helplessly? Does the payoff after harm correspond to what was lost? Is the turnaround promised in the synopsis still advancing? These questions constrain the writing better than assigning women’s fiction a fixed genre or reader label.

heading.zh: 先确认这本书承诺的情绪方向
heading.en: Check this book’s emotional promise

body.zh:
这篇方法适合承诺成长、翻盘或逐步取得选择权的长篇。Oh Story 的女频方法强调这类方向；它不证明所有女性读者都只接受同一种结局。悲剧、沉郁故事或刻意表现停滞的作品，要按自身承诺判断，不能强插胜利来迎合分类。

写一行本书承诺，再找本阶段对应结果。例如“从替别人承担责任到能自己决定”，回报应是可执行的边界与退出行动；突然收到贵重礼物未必回应旧伤害。

检查回报由谁提出、谁接受、何时完成，随后保留未解决的事实。若只能在作者解释中找到成长，补它实际发生的场景；若成长已经可见，不再重复意义总结。

文风裁决把本书明确选择放在题材默认值之前。上述成长路线不是所有女频都要用的成功公式；次要情绪、休息和陪伴可有自己的作用。表达选择不修改复核结论、已获职责或谁实际接受了什么。
body.en:
This method suits a long story promising growth, reversal or greater agency. Oh Story emphasizes that direction in its female-audience framework; it does not establish a single preference for all women. Tragedy, bleak fiction or deliberate stagnation follows its own promise rather than requiring inserted victories.

Write the book’s promise, then identify the corresponding phase result. Moving from assumed blame to independent choice needs an actionable boundary and exit. An expensive gift may answer neither.

Trace proposal, acceptance and completion while retaining unresolved facts. If growth exists only in explanation, show it happening. If already visible, avoid another summary of its meaning.

Style resolution places explicit book choices above genre defaults. This growth approach is no universal success formula; secondary feelings, rest, and companionship may have their own purpose. Expression changes neither review findings, established duties, nor who actually accepted what.

q.zh: 需要按固定阶段或章节数写吗？
q.en: Do I need to use fixed phases or a fixed number of chapters?

a.zh: 不需要。阶段由人物取得的资源、权力、关系与选择发生了什么变化来划分。
a.en: No. Divide phases according to changes in the character’s resources, power, relationships and choices.

q.zh: 示例可以直接换名字使用吗？
q.en: Can I use the example by changing only the names?

a.zh: 示例用于说明方法。新故事应重新设计冲突发动机、人物选择、代价和兑现方式。
a.en: The example illustrates the method. A new story needs its own conflict engine, character choices, costs and payoffs.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 检查这本成长向小说的主情绪承诺。把伤害、主角选择、真实代价和对应回报连起来，核对回报的提出、接受与完成；不要把方法当所有女频结局要求，也不把礼物代替选择权。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to check this growth story’s emotional promise. Connect harm, agency, cost and matching payoff; trace proposal, acceptance and completion. Do not impose one ending on all female-audience fiction or substitute gifts for choice.

label.zh: 主动性与成长回报
本书表达选择与事实边界
把细纲行动写成连续正文
label.en: Turn outline actions into continuous prose

label.zh: 关键处展开、过场疏写
label.en: Expand key moments and compress transitions

title.zh: 都市脑洞文怎么写：让一个新规则撑起整本书
title.en: Writing Urban Speculative Fiction: Build a Novel Around One New Rule

seo_title.zh: 都市脑洞文怎么写｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: How to Write Urban Speculative Fiction | ZenStory

description.zh: 把脑洞规则放进账单、合同、工作与关系等现实场面，并拆成不重复的收益、风险和公开反馈。
description.en: Put one speculative rule into bills, contracts, work and relationships. Develop distinct gains, risks and public responses instead of repeating rewards.

answer.zh: 都市脑洞先从具体的现实窘境进入，让一条新规则立刻改变人物的选择。规则必须有触发条件、限制和可见结果；长篇能否成立，看它能否持续产生性质不同的现实问题，而非反复发奖励。
answer.en: Open urban speculative fiction with a concrete real-world predicament, then introduce one new rule that immediately changes what a character chooses to do. Give the rule trigger conditions, limits and visible results. To sustain a novel, it must keep producing different kinds of real-world problems rather than repeatedly handing out rewards.

heading.zh: 先写一条可运行的新规则
heading.en: Write One New Rule That Can Operate

body.zh: 用五问定义脑洞：什么条件触发；主角能获得什么；限制或代价是什么；旁人能看见哪种结果；规则被公开、误解或利用后会发生什么。第一次展示只解决一个小问题，让读者从结果理解规则。面板如需出现，只保留当前目标、限制和结果。
body.en: Define the speculative premise by answering five questions: What triggers it? What can the protagonist gain? What are its limits or costs? What result can other people see? What happens when the rule is made public, misunderstood or exploited? The first demonstration should solve one small problem, letting readers infer the rule from the result. If an on-screen interface appears, show only the current goal, constraint and result.

heading.zh: 用不同方向测试长篇容量
heading.en: Test Capacity in Different Directions

body.zh:
可以从五个常见方向试写，选择本书真正有用的部分：**生计**涉及钱与资源，**职业**涉及资格与责任，**关系**涉及信任与相处，**公共评价**涉及旁人理解，**规则反噬**涉及旧用法的限制。它们是检查方向，不要求全写成支线，也不要求每一种都增加代价。

只能反复写“奖励越来越大”时，试着让同一规则碰到不同人物、目标或情境。一次没有新增危险的实际收益、一次更理解朋友的交谈，也可以兑现体验。新增完全无关能力则要检查是否让核心卖点失焦。
body.en:
Try useful directions for this book: **livelihood** concerns money and resources; **work**, qualifications and responsibilities; **relationships**, trust and company; **public judgment**, others’ understanding; and **backlash**, limits of an earlier use. These are optional checks, not five mandatory subplots or a requirement to add cost in every direction.

If every scene only increases rewards, let the same rule meet different people, goals, or circumstances. A realized benefit without a new danger, or a conversation that clarifies friendship, can fulfill the experience. Check whether unrelated new powers blur the central appeal.

heading.zh: 原创范例：建议会留下回声
heading.en: Original Example: Advice That Leaves an Echo

body.zh:
原创设定：失业声音剪辑师顾南发现，别人当面对他提出的建议，会在次日变成只有他能听见的回声。回声只留下建议中说话者愿意实际承担的部分，不能录下给旁人听，也不证明建议内容客观正确。

把原来的两次建议写成先听回声、再问真人的场景。文件和联系人是本例虚构材料，不代表现实授权已查证。

> 第二天，顾南打开空电脑，耳边只留下朋友昨日那句“帮你找下一单”。“先免费试做”没有回来。
>
> 他打给朋友：“你愿意帮我找的，是哪一条联系？”
>
> “李菲那边。我给你们介绍，但项目能不能成，要你们自己谈。”朋友把两人拉进介绍对话。
>
> 顾南向李菲问清需求，又回到原来的试做邀请：“免费做到什么时候、交什么，没说清。我不接这一版。”邀请方没有因此变坏，也没被回声替他拒绝；消息由他自己发出。
>
> 后来一位客户当面说：“素材来源写清，我提供授权文件。”隔天，回声留下“我提供授权文件”。顾南没有按下接单，先问：“请把这次约定的文件和对应素材一起给我看。”
>
> 两份文件到了。他逐项对照本例已定接单条件，发现另有一段素材尚无对应材料，回信让客户补齐。文件已收到，不等于内容客观真实或整个项目已可接。
>
> 留意到他总先核对承诺的对手发来新条件：“那就今晚交全套，迟了换人。”顾南将期限与未补材料放在一起看，还不知道这条要求会牵动哪些后续条件，没有让回声替自己给出答案。

第一单元兑现真实介绍与拒绝无边界试做；第二单元兑现文件送达与进一步核对，接单仍未完成。对手压力来自主角旧方法被注意后的反应，没有新增公开播放回声或鉴定真假能力。回声提供线索，选择、询问与承担仍由人完成。
body.en:
Original premise: advice spoken face to face to unemployed sound editor Gu Nan becomes an echo the following day, audible only to him. It retains the part the speaker will actually undertake. It cannot be recorded for others and does not prove objective truth.

Develop the two suggestions as hearing an echo followed by asking a real person. Contacts and documents are fictional materials, not verified real-world authorisation.

> The next morning Gu opened his empty computer. Only his friend’s “help find another job” remained in his ear. “Try it free first” did not return.
>
> He called. “Which contact are you willing to help with?”
>
> “Li Fei. I’ll introduce you; you’ll negotiate whether the project happens.” The friend added them to an introduction conversation.
>
> Gu asked Li about the need, then answered the original trial invitation. “No deadline or deliverable specified. I won’t take this version.” That did not make the inviter malicious. Nor did the echo decline for him: he sent the message himself.
>
> Later a client said in person, “Document the material sources. I’ll provide authorisation files.” Next day the echo retained the offer of files. Gu did not accept the job. “Please send the agreed documents with their corresponding material first.”
>
> Two files arrived. Comparing them against this story’s established project conditions, he found another clip lacked its corresponding material and requested it. Receipt did not establish authenticity or readiness of the entire project.
>
> An opponent who noticed his habit of checking promises sent a condition. “Then deliver everything tonight. Late, and we replace you.” Gu compared the deadline with the missing material, still unsure of downstream conditions, without asking the echo to decide for him.

The first unit delivers an actual introduction and refusal of an unbounded trial. The second delivers files and further checking while job acceptance remains pending. Pressure follows an exposed method rather than new public playback or truth-detection powers. The echo supplies a lead; people still choose, ask and undertake actions.

heading.zh: 脑洞写到中段怎样防崩
heading.en: Keep the Speculative Premise from Collapsing Midway

body.zh:
追踪使用后谁知道了什么、现实处境怎样变化。对手是否学习、机构是否调整、亲友是否重新判断，要由已建立的动机、权限与所见信息决定。旧用法可以继续有效，也可以碰到限制；不要为了中段“升级”自动让所有人反制。

连续贴面板、奖励只涨数字、现实人物只负责震惊，常使场面缺少人的选择。把本轮结果落到实际工作、到账收益、愿意继续的相处或当前目标；并非每次都要加合同、失去退路或公开责任。原规则明确禁止的用法仍不能靠文风改掉。

题材卡的每章规则结果与外部反馈是默认节奏参考。根据本书承诺，可以写一次完整使用，也可以写准备、思考或安静相处，不把默认值变成逐章配额。
body.en:
Track what each person learns and what changes in everyday circumstances. Opponents learning, institutions adapting, and friends reconsidering need established motives, authority, and observed information. An earlier use may keep working or meet a limit; mid-book escalation does not automatically make everyone counter it.

Repeated interfaces, purely numerical rewards, and spectators doing nothing but marveling can remove human choice. Ground the result in actual work, received benefits, continuing company, or a current goal. Every use need not add a contract, lost option, or public responsibility. Style choices do not alter a fixed prohibition in the ability.

The genre card’s per-chapter result and external-response rhythm is a default reference. A book can include a complete use, preparation, reflection, or quiet company according to its promise rather than a chapter quota.

heading.zh: 检查新情节是不是偷偷扩大规则
heading.en: Check whether the next plot silently expands the rule

body.zh:
| 固定项 | 核对与限制 |
|---|---|
| 当面建议触发 | 话语中确实有建议，不是随便一条短信；禁止扩为：所有文字与独白都触发 |
| 次日、仅本人听见 | 顾南先等待，再据此追问；禁止扩为：立刻播放给全场听 |
| 愿承担的部分 | 作为进一步核对的线索；禁止扩为：自动鉴定事实、权限或结果 |

写新单元前，把这张表与新场景对照。需要新能力时，先决定它的来源、边界与代价，再写前置铺垫；不能在危机结尾临时解锁。

外部反馈可以是客户补材料、朋友澄清帮助范围、对手改策略。它们由现实行动发生，不必每次都围观震惊，也不以规则播报代替收入、工作或关系变化。
body.en:
| Rule | Check and Limit |
|---|---|
| Face-to-face advice | The statement is advice, not merely a message. Not allowed: Every text or private thought triggers it |
| Next day; private hearing | Gu waits, then follows up. Not allowed: Immediate public playback |
| Willingness to undertake | A clue for verification. Not allowed: Automatic truth, authority or success |

Compare new scenes with the rule card. A new ability needs an established source, limit and cost before resolving a crisis.

External feedback can be supplied documents, clarified help or an adapted opposing strategy. Those arise through actions; they need not be collective shock, and a system notification cannot replace changed work, income or relationships.

q.zh: 需要按固定阶段或章节数写吗？
q.en: Do I need to use fixed phases or a fixed number of chapters?

a.zh: 不需要。阶段由人物取得的资源、权力、关系与选择发生了什么变化来划分。
a.en: No. Divide phases according to changes in the character’s resources, power, relationships and choices.

q.zh: 示例可以直接换名字使用吗？
q.en: Can I use the example by changing only the names?

a.zh: 示例用于说明方法。新故事应重新设计冲突发动机、人物选择、代价和兑现方式。
a.en: The example illustrates the method. A new story needs its own conflict engine, character choices, costs and payoffs.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 检查都市脑洞单元，附已定触发、时机、可见性、限制和当前事实。核对人物怎样取得信息、验证规则和作选择，区分线索与证明。按作者文风及本书承诺保留收益、思考与相处；不临时扩权，不强制五类支线或每次新增代价。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to review this urban premise with fixed triggers, timing, visibility, limits, and facts. Check acquired information, rule tests, and choices; distinguish clues from proof. Preserve benefits, reflection, and company under the author’s voice and book promise. Do not expand powers or require five subplots or a new cost per use.

label.en: 都市脑洞: prose and progression
