title.zh: 海螺H3提示词怎么写：三段结构、声音分层与参考模式
title.en: How to Write Hailuo H3 Prompts: Structure, Sound, and Reference Modes

seo_title.zh: 海螺H3提示词怎么写｜三段结构
seo_title.en: Hailuo H3 Prompts: Structure, Sound, and References

description.zh: 海螺H3提示词用画面时间线、整体声景、观众专属配乐三段写作；附原创花店单镜示例、参考模式分叉和逐项改法。
description.en: Write Hailuo H3 prompts with a visual timeline, soundscape, and audience-only score. Includes a flower-shop example, mode choices, and fixes.

answer.zh: 海螺H3提示词先用三字段分别写画面时间线、整体声景和观众专属配乐，单镜也从 `[Shot 1]` 开始。输入类型决定是否追加首帧或尾帧对齐说明，或改用 full-reference 六段；中文对白保留原句。
answer.en: Hailuo H3 prompts use three fields for the shot timeline, overall soundscape, and audience-only score; even a single shot begins with `[Shot 1]`. The actual inputs determine whether you add a frame-alignment instruction or switch to the six-section full-reference format. Keep Chinese dialogue verbatim.

heading.zh: 海螺H3三段提示词：画面时间线、声景、配乐
heading.en: The Three H3 Fields: Timeline, Soundscape, and Score

body.zh:
这三个英文段名属于 H3 的结构化提示词格式，不是所有视频模型都通用的“提示词公式”。按以下分工填写：

1. **`integrated_multimodal_description`**：从 `[Shot 1]` 开始，按播放顺序写景别与构图、可见起点、动作变化、说话人、逐字对白、同步发生的声音和可核对的终点。即使只有一个镜头，也写 `[Shot 1]`。
2. **`overall_soundscape`**：用一个连续段落概括全片环境底声、物理动作声和非语言人声，例如雨声、脚步、花盆落桌声或呼吸。不要在这里重复对白。
3. **`non_diegetic_music`**：只写角色听不见、观众能听见的配乐，描述乐器、速度、节奏和音量变化。角色能听见的店内收音机或现场演奏仍属于画面时间线。没有观众专属配乐时写 `N/A`。

声音分层的判断点是“要不要卡在某个动作或发声时刻”：需要精确同步的画内声写在主时间线的对应动作旁；`overall_soundscape` 汇总全片环境声、物理动作声和非语言人声，必要时可以概括时间线上的重要声响，但不要重复对白。

可复制骨架：

> integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] [Style and framing]. [Visible start state]. [Action and visible result; add a timed in-scene sound cue beside its triggering action, if needed]. The [speaker description] (S1) says: <d>[Chinese] 逐字台词</d>. [Visible end state].
>
> overall_soundscape: [Summarize the clip-wide ambience, physical sounds, and non-verbal human sounds; do not repeat dialogue].
>
> non_diegetic_music: N/A

若需要观众专属配乐，把上一示例块最后一行替换为：

> non_diegetic_music: [Audience-only score: instruments, tempo, rhythm, and dynamics]

本页沿用 H3 官方英文结构化指南的字段名和示例表达；这是模板格式，不代表英文提示词效果更好，也不代表每个界面都强制要求英文。给说话人一个稳定编号，例如 `(S1)`；身份、音色或动作写在 `<d>` 外，`<d>` 内保留语言标签和实际台词。中文对白写成 `<d>[Chinese] 原句</d>`，逐字保留。详见官方[基础与关键帧提示词指南](https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-H3/blob/d21241f0a4b3acbb34c97dae47fa417b7065e438/skills/h3-prompt-writing/references/base-en.txt)。

以上是提示词结构与阅读示例，不是视频任务请求 JSON。字段名、说话人编号与对白标签要原样保留；页面里的 `<d>` 是提示词文字，复制后仍要按实际接口放入文本输入。2026-09-30重新核对了上述固定版本官方指南，未在本次编辑中执行视频生成。
body.en:
These English field names belong to H3's structured prompt format; they are not a universal formula for every video model. Fill them as follows:

1. **`integrated_multimodal_description`**: Beginning with `[Shot 1]`, describe framing and composition, the visible start state, observable action, speakers, verbatim dialogue, synchronized sound, and a checkable end state in playback order. Keep `[Shot 1]` even when the video contains one shot.
2. **`overall_soundscape`**: In one continuous paragraph, summarize ambience, physical action sounds, and non-verbal human sounds across the video—rain, footsteps, a pot touching a counter, or breathing. Do not repeat dialogue here.
3. **`non_diegetic_music`**: Describe only music that the audience hears and the characters do not, using instrumentation, tempo, rhythm, and changes in volume. A radio or live performance audible inside the scene remains on the main timeline. Write `N/A` when no audience-only score is intended.

The sound-placement test is whether a cue must land on a particular action or vocal beat. Put time-critical diegetic sound beside that action on the main timeline. `overall_soundscape` summarizes ambience, physical sounds, and non-verbal human sounds across the clip; it may briefly recap an important cue, but it should not repeat dialogue.

Copyable skeleton:

> integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] [Style and framing]. [Visible start state]. [Action and visible result; add a timed in-scene sound cue beside its triggering action, if needed]. The [speaker description] (S1) says: <d>[Chinese] 逐字台词</d>. [Visible end state].
>
> overall_soundscape: [Summarize clip-wide ambience, physical sounds, and non-verbal human sounds; do not repeat dialogue].
>
> non_diegetic_music: N/A

If you want an audience-only score, replace the final line of that block with:

> non_diegetic_music: [Audience-only score: instruments, tempo, rhythm, and dynamics]

This page follows the English field names and example style of H3's official structured guide. That describes the template; it does not claim English prompts work better or that every interface requires English. Give each speaker a stable ID such as `(S1)`. Put the speaker's identity, voice, or action outside `<d>`; inside `<d>`, preserve the language tag and spoken words. Keep Chinese dialogue verbatim as `<d>[Chinese] original line</d>`. See the official [base and keyframe prompt guide](https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-H3/blob/d21241f0a4b3acbb34c97dae47fa417b7065e438/skills/h3-prompt-writing/references/base-en.txt).

These are prompt structures and reading examples, not a video-task request JSON. Preserve field names, speaker IDs, and dialogue tags. The `<d>` markers are prompt text that still belongs inside the interface’s text input. The linked official guide at its fixed version was rechecked on September 30, 2026; this edit ran no video generation.

heading.zh: 首帧、首尾帧与 full-reference 不是同一种格式
heading.en: First Frames, First-and-Last Frames, and Full Reference Use Different Shapes

body.zh:
先看你实际提交了哪些输入，再选提示词形状。不要先套模板，最后才决定要不要挂参考素材。

| 输入 | 记录 |
|---|---|
| 没有图片，明确做文生视频 | 使用的结构: 三字段; 写作重点: 从文字建立完整的可见起点、动作路径和终点 |
| 一张首帧 | 使用的结构: 首帧对齐说明 + 三字段; 写作重点: 从首帧现有姿态、构图和场景继续向前发展 |
| 一张首帧 + 一张尾帧 | 使用的结构: 首尾帧对齐说明 + 三字段; 写作重点: 写两帧之间连续、可观察的动作路径；结尾落到尾帧，不再追加新状态 |
| 只提供一张尾帧（如果所用入口支持） | 使用的结构: 尾帧对齐说明 + 三字段; 写作重点: 从合理的先前状态开始，逐步收束到给定尾帧 |
| 人物、地点、道具等普通参考图，或参考视频、音频；首帧再加其他参考素材也属于此类 | 使用的结构: full-reference 六段; 写作重点: 定义每项真实素材的标签和作用，再写保留关系与详细时间线 |

H3 官方指南也定义了仅尾帧的 L2VA：若当前入口提供这种输入，就加尾帧对齐说明并沿三字段写法，从合理前态收束到尾帧；不同界面或接口提供的模式可能不同。

full-reference 的六段依次是：

> subject_definitions: ...
>
> summary: ...
>
> retention_analysis: ...
>
> detailed_description: [Shot 1] ...
>
> overall_soundscape: ...
>
> non_diegetic_music: ...

六段是一条完整提示词，不是六次生成，也不能只交其中的 `detailed_description`。`<Picture 1>`、`<Video 1>`、`<Audio 1>` 等标签必须对应这次任务中实际附加的素材；同类素材的编号要和提交顺序一致。只在文字里写“参考人物图”或 `<Picture 1>`，不能替代上传或传入那份文件。具体六段规则见官方[full-reference 提示词指南](https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-H3/blob/d21241f0a4b3acbb34c97dae47fa417b7065e438/skills/h3-prompt-writing/references/ref-en.txt)。你实际使用的界面或接口未必展示所有模式，应以可用输入方式为准，不要把缺失的参考素材默默改成文生视频。

官方[视频生成接口](https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/video-generation-v2-create)另行区分媒体角色：出现 reference 图片、视频或音频时，不能在同一请求再混入 first_frame / last_frame 角色。如果用已有起始图加人物参考，按 reference 模式提交，在提示词里说明哪张图控制起始构图；写了对齐句也不能替代真实附件。界面未提供的模式不要由这张表臆造。
body.en:
Choose the prompt shape from the inputs you will actually submit. Do not start from a template and decide whether to attach references afterward.

| Input | Record |
|---|---|
| No image, with text-to-video intentionally selected | Structure: Three fields; Writing focus: Establish the complete visible start, action path, and end in text |
| One first frame | Structure: First-frame alignment instruction + three fields; Writing focus: Continue forward from the pose, composition, and scene already present in the first frame |
| One first frame + one last frame | Structure: First/last-frame alignment instruction + three fields; Writing focus: Describe an observable continuous path between the two frames; arrive at the last frame without adding a new state afterward |
| One last frame only (if the interface supports it) | Structure: Last-frame alignment instruction + three fields; Writing focus: Begin from a plausible earlier state and converge on the supplied last frame |
| Ordinary character, location, or prop images; reference video or audio; or a first frame plus other reference assets | Structure: Six-section full-reference format; Writing focus: Define the labels and jobs of the actual assets before describing retention and the detailed timeline |

The official guide also defines last-frame-only L2VA: if your current interface accepts that input, add its last-frame alignment instruction and use the three fields to move from a plausible earlier state toward the supplied ending. Available modes differ by interface and API.

The full-reference sections are:

> subject_definitions: ...
>
> summary: ...
>
> retention_analysis: ...
>
> detailed_description: [Shot 1] ...
>
> overall_soundscape: ...
>
> non_diegetic_music: ...

The six sections form one complete prompt. They are not six separate generations, and `detailed_description` should not be submitted alone. Labels such as `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, and `<Audio 1>` must identify assets actually attached to this generation task; numbering within each asset type must match the submission order. Merely typing “use the character reference” or `<Picture 1>` cannot replace supplying the file. See the official [full-reference prompt guide](https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-H3/blob/d21241f0a4b3acbb34c97dae47fa417b7065e438/skills/h3-prompt-writing/references/ref-en.txt) for the complete six-section rules. The UI or API you use may not expose every mode, so follow the inputs it actually accepts. Do not silently turn a missing-reference task into text-to-video.

The official [video-generation API](https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/video-generation-v2-create) distinguishes media roles separately: a request with reference images, video, or audio cannot also contain first_frame / last_frame roles. For an opening image plus a character reference, supply them in reference mode and identify which image controls the opening composition in the prompt. An alignment sentence cannot replace an attachment. This table does not create a mode absent from your interface.

heading.zh: 原创示例：雨后花店里的一片新叶
heading.en: Original Example: A New Leaf in a Flower Shop After Rain

body.zh:
下面是一个**写作示例**，不是已测试的 H3 生成结果。设定为文生视频、单镜、固定机位：社区花店的店员在雨后发现一片新叶，把花盆从潮湿窗台移到干燥柜台，并说一句中文对白。

> integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, a locked medium shot inside a small neighborhood flower shop just after a rain shower. A shop worker in a plain green apron stands beside a rain-speckled front window. A small potted pothos rests on the wet windowsill in front of her. She notices one pale new leaf beneath the larger leaves and leans closer without touching it. She then cups the pot with both hands, lifts it straight up from the wet sill, carries it one step to the dry wooden counter on the right, and sets it down with a soft ceramic tap. Keeping both hands beside the pot, the worker with a clear, gentle voice (S1) looks at the new leaf and says: <d>[Chinese] 你也撑过这场雨了。</d> She ends facing the pot on the dry counter, her gaze still on the new leaf.
>
> overall_soundscape: Rainwater drips at an uneven pace from the awning outside while distant tires pass over the wet street. As the pot is set down, its base makes one light tap on the wooden counter.
>
> non_diegetic_music: N/A

这条提示词只承担一次主要变化：花盆从湿窗台移到干柜台。起点、动作和终点都能在单镜中观察；对白只出现一次，并由 `(S1)` 绑定到店员。花盆放到柜台时的轻响先写在画面时间线的动作旁，再由 `overall_soundscape` 简要概括；雨后街声只需写在整体声景。没有观众专属配乐，所以末段明确写 `N/A`。若你改用首帧或首尾帧，应先实际附加相应图片，再加官方要求的对齐说明，并让正文从首帧出发或准确落到尾帧。
body.en:
The following is a **writing example**, not a tested H3 result. It is a text-to-video, single-shot, locked-camera setup: after a rain shower, a neighborhood flower-shop worker notices a new leaf, moves its pot from a wet windowsill to a dry counter, and speaks one Chinese line.

> integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, a locked medium shot inside a small neighborhood flower shop just after a rain shower. A shop worker in a plain green apron stands beside a rain-speckled front window. A small potted pothos rests on the wet windowsill in front of her. She notices one pale new leaf beneath the larger leaves and leans closer without touching it. She then cups the pot with both hands, lifts it straight up from the wet sill, carries it one step to the dry wooden counter on the right, and sets it down with a soft ceramic tap. Keeping both hands beside the pot, the worker with a clear, gentle voice (S1) looks at the new leaf and says: <d>[Chinese] 你也撑过这场雨了。</d> She ends facing the pot on the dry counter, her gaze still on the new leaf.
>
> overall_soundscape: Rainwater drips at an uneven pace from the awning outside while distant tires pass over the wet street. As the pot is set down, its base makes one light tap on the wooden counter.
>
> non_diegetic_music: N/A

The prompt carries one main change: the pot moves from the wet sill to the dry counter. Its start, action, and end are observable within one shot. The line appears once and is bound to the worker through `(S1)`. Place the pot's light tap beside the setting-down action on the main timeline, then briefly summarize it in `overall_soundscape`; post-rain street ambience belongs only in that overall summary. Because no audience-only score is intended, the final field explicitly says `N/A`. If you convert this to first-frame or first-and-last-frame generation, attach the required image or images first, add the guide's alignment instruction, and make the body begin from the first frame or land precisely on the last frame.

heading.zh: 看到这些提示词问题，就按对应字段修改
heading.en: Revise the Field That Contains the Problem

body.zh:
先检查文字本身，再用实际生成结果验证；以下改法不承诺模型一定执行。

| 你在草稿中看到的问题 | 具体改法 |
|---|---|
| 中文台词被翻译、润色，或 `<d>` 里混入“轻声说”等表演说明 | 恢复剧本原句与标点；把语言写成 `[Chinese]`，把语气、动作和说话人移到 `<d>` 外 |
| 台词存在，但不知道谁说 | 第一次发声时补足可识别的说话人描述并编号 `(S1)`；后续发声沿用同一编号 |
| 需要卡动作点的声音只写进整体声景，或全片声景和对白都塞进主时间线 | 需要同步的画内声写在 `integrated_multimodal_description` 的对应动作旁；`overall_soundscape` 概括全片环境/物理/非语言声，可归纳重要声响但不复述对白；观众专属配乐放进 `non_diegetic_music` |
| 首尾帧已经确定，正文结尾却让人物继续移动或让道具换到第三个位置 | 删除尾帧之后的新动作；把中间过程改成从首帧可见状态连续收束到尾帧状态 |
| 正文写了 `<Picture 2>`、角色参考图或参考音频，但任务里没有那份输入 | 实际附加素材并核对同类素材顺序；如果不再使用它，删除标签并重新选择无图、首帧、首尾帧或 full-reference 结构，不要让文字假装文件已经存在 |

一次只修正已经定位的字段。若画面问题其实来自分镜终点含糊，先回到[剧本转分镜](/drama-skills/script-to-storyboard)确定终点；若你要处理一般图生视频中的左右手、持物、遮挡和起终点差异，参考[图生视频提示词](/drama-skills/image-to-video-prompts)。本页只负责 H3 的结构、对白与声音分层，以及输入模式对应的格式。
body.en:
Inspect the text first, then validate it against an actual generation. These revisions do not guarantee that the model will follow every instruction.

| Problem | Revision |
|---|---|
| Chinese dialogue has been translated or polished, or `<d>` contains delivery notes such as “softly” | Restore the original words and punctuation, keep `[Chinese]`, and move delivery, action, and speaker identity outside `<d>` |
| A line exists, but the speaker is unclear | At the speaker's first vocal event, add an identifiable description and `(S1)`; reuse that ID for later lines from the same speaker |
| A timed cue appears only in the overall soundscape, or ambience and dialogue are all pushed into the main timeline | Put time-critical in-scene sound beside its action in `integrated_multimodal_description`; let `overall_soundscape` summarize clip-wide ambience, physical sounds, and non-verbal human sounds without repeating dialogue; reserve `non_diegetic_music` for audience-only score |
| First and last frames are fixed, but the body keeps the character moving or puts the prop in a third position after the ending | Remove every action after the last-frame state; rewrite the middle as a continuous path from the visible first-frame state to the last-frame state |
| The prompt names `<Picture 2>`, a character image, or reference audio that is absent from the task inputs | Attach the asset and verify the order within its asset type. If you no longer intend to use it, remove the label and choose the no-image, first-frame, first/last-frame, or full-reference structure again; text cannot pretend a file was supplied |

Revise only the field where you have located the problem. If the ending itself is ambiguous, define it in [script-to-storyboard](/drama-skills/script-to-storyboard) first. For general image-to-video questions involving hands, props, occlusion, and start/end differences, use [image-to-video prompts](/drama-skills/image-to-video-prompts). This page stays focused on H3's format, dialogue and sound layers, and the structure required by the actual inputs.

q.zh: 海螺H3提示词应该写中文还是英文？
q.en: Should a Hailuo H3 prompt be written in Chinese or English?

a.zh: 本页可复制模板沿用 H3 官方指南的英文字段名和英文示例格式。中文对白不要翻译，按 `<d>[Chinese] ...</d>` 保留原句。这个说明描述的是模板写法，不代表英文效果更好，也不表示每个入口都强制英文；如果你使用的入口接受其他语言，按其要求填写。
a.en: The copyable template on this page follows the English field names and example format in H3's official guide. Do not translate Chinese dialogue; preserve it verbatim inside `<d>[Chinese] ...</d>`. This describes the template, not a claim that English works better or that every interface requires it. If your interface accepts another language, follow its prompt requirements.

q.zh: 只提供首帧、尾帧或多张参考素材时用哪种结构？
q.en: Which structure should I use for first-frame, last-frame, and reference inputs?

a.zh: 仅首帧用首帧对齐说明加三字段；仅尾帧（当前入口支持时）用 L2VA 尾帧对齐说明加三字段，从合理的先前状态收束到尾帧；首尾帧成对也用对齐说明加三字段。普通参考图、视频或音频用 full-reference 六段。所有素材都要实际提交，标签按同类附件顺序对应。
a.en: For one first frame, use its alignment instruction plus the three fields. For one last frame only—if your interface supports it—use the L2VA alignment instruction and describe a plausible path toward that ending. A first/last-frame pair also uses an alignment instruction plus the three fields. Ordinary reference images, video, or audio use the six-section full-reference format. Submit every asset and match labels to the order within each asset type.

q.zh: 对白、环境音和配乐分别写在哪里？
q.en: Where do dialogue, ambience, and music go?

a.zh: 对白以及需要卡动作点的画内声写在 `integrated_multimodal_description` 或 full-reference 的 `detailed_description` 对应时刻。`overall_soundscape` 汇总全片环境声、物理动作声和非语言人声，可简要归纳重要声响，但不要重复对白。只有观众听见的配乐写入 `non_diegetic_music`；角色听得见的收音机、现场演奏或歌声留在画面时间线。
a.en: Put dialogue and any in-scene sound that must hit a specific action beat at that point in `integrated_multimodal_description`, or `detailed_description` for full reference. `overall_soundscape` summarizes clip-wide ambience, physical sounds, and non-verbal human sounds; it may briefly recap an important cue, but do not repeat dialogue. Reserve `non_diegetic_music` for music only the audience hears. Radio, live performance, or singing audible to the characters stays on the main timeline.

text.zh: 准备好已确认的单镜分镜、逐字对白，以及这次实际会提交的首帧、尾帧或参考素材，然后用 /short-drama-video-prompts（Codex 用 `$short-drama-video-prompts`）并明确写“按 MiniMax H3 格式”。它会按实际输入选择三字段或 full-reference 六段，并输出可复制的提示词；这一步不替你上传素材，也不执行视频生成。
text.en: Prepare the approved single-shot storyboard, verbatim dialogue, and the first frame, last frame, or reference assets you will actually submit. Then use /short-drama-video-prompts (or `$short-drama-video-prompts` in Codex) and explicitly request the MiniMax H3 format. It selects the three-field or six-section full-reference shape from the real inputs and produces copyable prompt text; this step does not upload assets or run video generation.

label.zh: H3格式、输入模式与声音分层
label.en: H3 format, input modes, and sound layers

title.zh: DeepSeek文游提示词怎么玩：把小说改成可玩的一幕
title.en: Turn a Novel into an AI Text Adventure: Start with One Scene

seo_title.zh: DeepSeek文游提示词：小说改编｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: DeepSeek Text Adventure Prompt: Novel to Scene

description.zh: 选一段有明确目标和阻力的小说场景，先锁定原作事实，再给玩家行动与后果。附改编简报、提示词和原创示例。
description.en: Adapt one novel scene into an AI text adventure. Preserve source facts, define the player’s goal and choices, and test one path before expanding.

answer.zh: 先不要把整本小说交给模型。选一个目标明确、存在阻力的场景，写清哪些原作事实必须保留、玩家是谁、能采取什么行动，以及行动会改变什么。先生成一场互动草案，再沿一条代表路径核对人物动机、信息边界和后果。
answer.en: Do not start by giving the model an entire novel. Choose one scene with a clear goal and obstacle. State which source facts must remain, who the player is, what actions they can take, and what those actions can change. Draft one interactive scene, then walk through a representative path to check character goals, knowledge boundaries, and consequences.

heading.zh: 先选一场能让玩家行动的戏
heading.en: Choose a Scene Where the Player Can Act

body.zh:
不要从“把全书变成游戏”开始。先挑一段有具体目标、阻力和可观察结果的场景，让玩家能做一件改变局面的事。单纯听角色讲设定、重读原文对白，通常还没有形成互动。

选场景时回答四问：

- **这段从哪里开始、到哪里结束？** 用章节、场景或事件标记边界。
- **主角此刻想做什么？** 写一个可判断是否完成的近期目标。
- **阻力是什么？** 选择一个会迫使玩家决策的限制、人物议程或时间压力。
- **玩家可以介入什么？** 至少有一项行动会改变后续可见事实；不要让玩家只替原作人物点确认。

先把这些落到一场，试玩时再判断它是否需要扩展成多场分支。
body.en:
Do not begin with “turn the whole book into a game.” Start with one scene that has a concrete goal, an obstacle, and an observable result. Listening to a character explain the setting or rereading the original dialogue usually does not create interaction by itself.

Answer four questions when choosing a scene:

- **Where does it begin and end?** Mark a chapter, scene, or event boundary.
- **What does the protagonist want now?** Write a near-term goal whose completion can be judged.
- **What creates resistance?** Choose a constraint, character agenda, or time pressure that forces a decision.
- **Where can the player intervene?** Include an action that changes a visible later fact; do not make the player merely click through the original character’s decision.

Shape one scene first. Use a playtest to decide whether it needs to grow into a larger branching sequence.

heading.zh: 把原作事实和改编选择写进简报
heading.en: Separate Source Facts from Adaptation Choices

body.zh:
改编简报先分两栏：一栏写不能静默改写的原作事实，另一栏写本次允许调整的设计选择。剧情可压缩，人物目标、关系变化或关键决定不能被无依据地抹掉；原作未说明的分支标成“新设计”，再判断它是否符合现有设定。

### 可复制的单场景简报

- **来源范围**：第___章 / 场景___；只使用我提供的材料。
- **需要保留**：人物目标、已经发生的事件、世界规则、关键关系。
- **玩家身份**：玩家控制谁？此人能知道什么？
- **本场目标**：玩家希望完成什么？
- **阻力与证据**：谁或什么造成阻力？玩家能看到哪些线索？
- **可选行动**：玩家能做什么？哪些是原作事实，哪些是新设计？
- **后续回响**：选择改变谁的关系、立场、证词、物件去向或公开信息？
- **场景出口**：本场在哪个可观察结果处结束？

这份简报让模型先区分材料与提案。人物能说、能做、能知道的内容要受当前场景和来源事实约束；把作者掌握的秘密直接写成角色台词，会破坏信息边界。

上面的简报是本文缩小到一场的作者工作卡，不是完整 `SOURCE_BIBLE.md` 或 `GAME_DESIGN.md`。实际流程还要登记来源版本、覆盖范围和事实边界；人物行动、世界事实与玩家所见分别核对。模型可以协助写提案，所给材料没有的结果仍需明确选择和设计。
body.en:
Split the adaptation brief into two lists: source facts the scene must not silently rewrite, and design choices this adaptation may change. You can compress events, but do not erase a character’s goal, relationship change, or key decision without a reason. Label a branch not defined by the source as a new design choice, then check it against the established setting.

### Copyable single-scene brief

- **Source boundary:** Chapter ___ / Scene ___; use only the material I provide.
- **Facts to preserve:** character goals, established events, world rules, and key relationships.
- **Player identity:** Who does the player control, and what can this person know?
- **Scene goal:** What does the player want to accomplish here?
- **Obstacle and evidence:** What creates resistance, and what clues can the player observe?
- **Available actions:** What can the player do? Which details are source facts and which are new design?
- **Downstream consequence:** Which relationship, stance, testimony, object, or public fact changes after a choice?
- **Scene exit:** At what observable result does this scene end?

This brief asks the model to distinguish source material from proposals. A character’s speech, actions, and knowledge must fit the scene and the source facts; putting an author-only secret directly into dialogue breaks the information boundary.

This single-scene brief is an editorial work card, not the complete SOURCE_BIBLE.md or GAME_DESIGN.md. The production workflow also records source version, coverage, and fact boundaries. Check character actions, world facts, and player-visible information separately. A model can draft proposals; outcomes absent from the supplied source still need an explicit adaptation choice.

heading.zh: 原创示例：风暴前的海岛气象站
heading.en: Original Example: An Island Weather Station Before a Storm

body.zh:
以下为本文原创虚构的纸面练习，没有真实气象或渡船建议，也不是模型输出、运行游戏或试玩结果。离港决策窗口在本例设为22:00；这是情节规则。21:54，海岛气象站值班助理收到一段断续的自动潮位警报。站外尺标往返与观察共需4分钟；一次通信及确认约需1分钟。本例尺标带一条黑色标线；一次肉眼观察只能记录该时刻水面与它的位置，不能确认警报成因、之后趋势或“风暴已登陆”。

| 简报项 | 本场设计 |
|---|---|
| 来源范围 | 本文原创气象站练习；以下两条路线是待作者选择的新设计，不是原作已发生事实。 |
| 需要保留 | 自动警报原因未明；22:00窗口固定；站外观察需时间；值班助理能观察、报告，不能替港务处决定开停航。 |
| 阻力与证据 | 断续警报可作为未确认提醒；到尺标处可取得当刻观察，回来后剩余通信时间减少。 |
| 玩家身份与目标 | 玩家控制值班助理，希望在窗口前把有用信息送达港务处；不能直接指挥渡船。 |
| 可选设计 | 先复核，再报告观察；或先报告尚未复核的警报。这一场只设计一次通信，后续复核是另一个场景的动作。 |
| 可见回响 | 下方分别给出发送内容、对方实际回复和可带到下一幕的记录，不由“拨号”直接宣布已送达。 |
| 场景出口 | 收到一次明确回执；若实际无人接听或窗口已过，保留未送达或错过状态，另写该分支，不套用成功台词。 |

### 两条路线分别走读

| 路线 | 纸面动作与结果 |
|---|---|
| A：先复核 | 21:54出发；在平台看见水面高于本例已设的黑色标线，记录观察时刻；21:58回站。她拨港务处电话并报告观察和仍不明的警报原因；21:59对方复述收到的观察，记入当班记录，并明确说会交给值班调度判断。助理获得较具体的观察回执，未因此获知调度决定。 |
| B：先提醒 | 21:54拨号，明确说自动警报断续、尚未到尺标复核；21:55对方复述并登记“未复核提醒”，回复会先联系值班调度待核。没有尺标读数，不能沿用A的观察；较早回应也不证明已停航、渡船已改变路线或风暴到达。 |

选择改变的是信息内容、到达时间和已确认的回应。A取得了一次现场观察，不能再说它“什么都没有确认”；自动警报的成因和接下来潮位仍未确认。B取得的是未复核提醒的回执，不自动拥有A的读数。后续场景按所选路线读取具体记录；真正的调度决定需要另一次实际回应，不能在旁白里凭空完成。
body.en:
This original fictional paper exercise is neither real weather or ferry advice nor a model output, running game, or playtest. Its departure-decision window ends at 22:00 as a story rule. At 21:54, an island weather-station assistant receives an intermittent automatic tide alert. Walking to the outdoor gauge, observing it, and returning takes four minutes; one call and acknowledgment take about a minute. The exercise’s gauge has a black mark; a visual observation records the water’s position against it at that moment. It does not establish the alert’s cause, the later trend, or a storm’s landfall.

| Brief item | Scene design |
|---|---|
| Source boundary | An original station exercise; both routes are proposed adaptation choices, not events already established in a source manuscript. |
| Facts to preserve | The automatic alert’s cause is unknown; the 22:00 window is fixed; outdoor observation takes time; the assistant observes and reports but cannot decide ferry operations. |
| Obstacle and evidence | The intermittent alert supports an unverified notice. The gauge supplies one current observation while leaving less time for communication afterward. |
| Player and goal | The player controls the duty assistant, aiming to deliver useful information to the harbor office before the window closes, without directly commanding the ferry. |
| Available design | Observe first, then report; or report the unverified alert first. This scene designs one communication; later verification is an action in another scene. |
| Visible consequence | Each route below specifies content, an actual reply, and the record carried forward. Dialing alone does not establish delivery. |
| Scene exit | Receive an explicit acknowledgment. An unanswered call or missed window needs its own undelivered or missed state instead of reusing successful dialogue. |

### Walk through the routes separately

| Route | Paper action and result |
|---|---|
| A: observe first | Leave at 21:54, see the water above the exercise’s established black gauge mark, and record the observation time; return at 21:58. Call and report the observation and unresolved alert cause. At 21:59 the harbor operator repeats the observation, logs it, and says it will go to the duty dispatcher for judgment. The assistant has a more specific observation receipt, without knowledge of the dispatch decision. |
| B: notify first | Call at 21:54, stating that the automatic alert is intermittent and has not been checked at the gauge. At 21:55 the operator repeats and logs it as an unverified notice, replying that the duty dispatcher will be contacted pending verification. This route has no gauge observation and cannot borrow A’s reading. Earlier acknowledgment does not establish canceled sailings, a changed ferry route, or a storm’s arrival. |

The choice changes information, arrival time, and the reply actually received. A obtains one field observation, so it is inaccurate to say that nothing was confirmed; the automatic alert’s cause and future tide remain unresolved. B obtains an acknowledgment of an unverified notice without A’s reading. Later scenes read the selected record. A dispatch decision requires its own actual response rather than a narrator declaring it complete.

heading.zh: 用一段提示词生成单场景草案
heading.en: Ask for One Scene, Not an Entire Game

body.zh:
把单场景简报和自己拥有或获准使用的原文片段一起提供，再让模型生成一场草案。下面这段是本文原创的起步提示词；按你的材料替换方括号内容：

> 请把我提供的小说片段改成一场文字冒险场景。先列出需要保留的原作事实，以及你建议的新设计；没有材料支持的内容标成提案，不要写成既定事实。
> 玩家身份：[身份]；本场目标：[目标]；阻力：[阻力]；可用线索：[线索]；场景结束点：[边界]。
> 提供两到三项符合玩家身份的可选行动。对每项说明玩家能观察到什么、哪些事实仍未知，以及它可能影响哪项后续状态；把推测标成提案。保持角色目标、关系和知情范围符合所给片段。不要替玩家选择；写到场景边界后停下，并列出仍未决定的问题。

先读草案里的事实清单和分支提案，再补充原文中真正支持它们的出处。对人物行为、原作规则或结局没有依据的新增内容，要么标成可选改编，要么删掉。
body.en:
Provide the single-scene brief with a passage you own or are authorized to use, then ask for one draft. This original starter prompt can be adapted by replacing the bracketed fields:

> Adapt the novel passage I provide into one text-adventure scene. First list the source facts to preserve and your proposed new design choices. Label unsupported additions as proposals, not established facts.
> Player identity: [identity]; scene goal: [goal]; obstacle: [obstacle]; available clues: [clues]; scene boundary: [exit].
> Offer two or three actions that fit the player’s identity. For each, state what the player can observe, what remains unknown, and which downstream state it might affect; label speculation as a proposal. Keep character goals, relationships, and knowledge within the supplied source. Do not choose for the player. Stop at the scene boundary and list unresolved design questions.

Read the source-fact list and branch proposal before accepting the draft, then add the passages that actually support them. Label or remove any new character action, world rule, or ending that the source does not justify.

heading.zh: 一场草案不等于可运行游戏
heading.en: A Scene Draft Is Not a Runnable Game

body.zh:
聊天里的分支场景可以用来讨论改编方向；纸面原型可以沿一条路径检查因果；可运行的游戏还要实现输入、人物处境变化、反馈和重新开始。不要把模型写出的“玩家成功了”当成已经实现或试玩通过。

扩展之前走一遍代表路径：玩家做了什么、这个选择改变了什么、谁因此得知新信息、下一场读到了哪些后果？沿未选路径再看一次，确认未发生的事实没有被当成已发生。遇到需要实时操作、空间判断或物理反馈的场景，文字草案无法验证这些体验，切片形式要与风险匹配。

在 DSH 的 NovelToGame 工作流中，可用 /novel-to-game quick 从自己提供的小说文件开始改编；完整构建还要进入设计和构建阶段。只想讨论一场时，也可以先拿上面的简报在普通聊天中打磨，不需要声称已经生成了成品。
body.en:
A branching scene in chat can help explore an adaptation. A paper prototype can check cause and effect along one path. A runnable game still needs input, state changes, feedback, and a way to restart. Do not treat model-written “the player succeeds” as an implemented or playtested result.

Before expanding, walk through one representative path: What did the player do? What changed? Who learned something as a result? Which consequences appear in the next scene? Then inspect an unchosen path to confirm that an event that did not happen is not treated as if it did. A text draft cannot validate real-time controls, spatial judgment, or physical feedback; match the prototype to the risk you need to test.

In DSH’s NovelToGame workflow, /novel-to-game quick starts an adaptation from a novel file you provide; a complete build continues through design and build stages. If you only want to discuss one scene, use the brief in an ordinary chat first and do not describe that draft as a finished product.

q.zh: 做AI文游一定要把整本小说发给模型吗？
q.en: Do I need to give the model my entire novel?

a.zh: 做第一场时不需要。给它足够理解目标场景的片段和简报，标明章节边界、必须保留的事实与可自由设计的部分。先完成一段可讨论的互动，再决定下一批需要哪些上下文。
a.en: Not for a first scene. Provide the passage and brief needed to understand its goal, mark the chapter boundary, and distinguish facts to preserve from open design choices. Complete one interactive scene before deciding what further context the next step needs.

q.zh: 一段DeepSeek提示词能直接生成可玩的游戏吗？
q.en: Can one DeepSeek prompt create a playable game by itself?

a.zh: 提示词可以帮助整理改编简报或写出互动场景草案；可运行游戏还需要设计、构建和实际验证。分别记录草案、纸面路径检查与已运行构建，避免把概念当成完成结果。
a.en: A prompt can help shape an adaptation brief or draft an interactive scene. A runnable game still needs design, implementation, and actual verification. Track a scene draft, a paper path check, and a running build as separate stages rather than treating a concept as a finished result.

q.zh: 增加玩家选择会不会破坏原作设定？
q.en: Will player choices break the source story?

a.zh: 可以先区分必须保留的事实和允许变化的设计区。玩家选择可以改变路线、代价或他人回应；若要改写关键决定或结局，应把它明示为新分支并核对人物目标、规则和信息边界。
a.en: First distinguish facts that must remain from design choices the adaptation may change. Player choices can alter a route, a cost, or another character’s response. If a key decision or ending changes, label it as a new branch and check it against character goals, rules, and knowledge boundaries.

text.zh: 在 DSH 中，用 /novel-to-game quick 并提供自己拥有或获准使用的小说文件，可从改编简报进入概念、世界设计、构建和 QA。若只讨论方向，可先提交一场的来源范围与改编简报，不必要求模型写完整游戏。
text.en: In DSH, /novel-to-game quick can start from a novel file you own or are authorized to use and move from an adaptation brief through concept, world design, build, and QA. To discuss direction only, start with one scene’s source boundary and brief rather than asking a model to write an entire game.

title.zh: 小说卷纲怎么写：分卷模板与完整范例
title.en: How to Outline a Novel Volume

seo_title.zh: 小说卷纲怎么写：分卷模板与完整范例
seo_title.en: How to Outline a Novel Volume

description.zh: 先确定一卷开始与结束时发生了什么变化，再用主推进线、关联支线和因果单元组织中段。附可复制卷纲表、原创示例与AI交接模板。
description.en: Plan one novel volume with a clear end-state change, connected story lines, causal plot units, an original example, and a restrained AI handoff template.

answer.zh: 写卷纲时，先从全书方向里选出这一卷要兑现的读者期待，并写清卷首状态与卷末变化。然后设一条主推进线，把支线接到它的选择、资源、关系、信息或代价上；每个情节单元都要由前一个结果触发，并给下一个单元留下新的条件。最后检查本卷兑现了什么、保留了什么，以及人物和局面是否真的发生了可见变化。
answer.en: To outline one volume, choose the reader expectation this volume will advance or pay off, then state the opening condition and the visible change at the end. Build one principal progression line, connect supporting lines through changes in choices, resources, relationships, information, or cost, and make each plot unit hand a new condition to the next. Finish by checking what the volume delivers, what it deliberately carries forward, and how the characters and situation have changed.

heading.zh: 先把全书、单卷和章节分开
heading.en: Separate the Book, the Volume, and the Chapter

body.zh:
全书大纲决定长篇最终去向、主要阶段和各卷之间的递进。卷纲接住其中一个阶段，回答这段旅程怎样形成自身的期待、压力与阶段结果。章节细纲再把已经选定的情节单元拆成场景目标、冲突和落点。

因此，卷纲需要足够清楚，让你知道本卷为什么存在、各条线怎样汇合、结尾改变了什么；同时保留调整空间，避免提前写完每一章。开始前只从全书大纲提取这些已批准事实：

- 本卷开场时，主角拥有什么、缺什么、误判什么。
- 本卷在全书中的阶段任务，以及不能提前使用的终局答案或能力。
- 本卷必须推进或兑现的读者期待。
- 已经成立的人物关系、世界规则和前卷结果。
- 卷末需要交给下一卷的新状态。

其余细节先留作待定项。卷纲负责组织因果和阶段变化，无须替每章预写对白、场景调度或完整转折。
body.en:
A book outline establishes the long story’s destination, major phases, and progression across volumes. A volume outline takes one of those phases and defines its own expectation, pressure, and stage result. A chapter outline later turns selected plot units into scene goals, conflicts, and endings.

A useful volume outline therefore explains why the volume exists, how its lines converge, and what changes at the end while leaving room to adjust during drafting. Begin by extracting only these approved facts from the book plan:

- What the protagonist has, lacks, and misunderstands at the opening.
- This volume’s stage purpose, including any endgame answer or ability that must remain reserved.
- The reader expectation this volume must advance or fulfill.
- Established relationships, world rules, and consequences from earlier volumes.
- The new state that must pass into the next volume.

Keep the remaining details open. The volume outline organizes causality and stage change; it does not need to prewrite dialogue, scene blocking, or every chapter turn.

heading.zh: 填写一张单卷工作表
heading.en: Complete a One-Volume Worksheet

body.zh:
先用短句填写下面各栏。每一项都要能在正文中被观察或核对；“人物成长”“局势升级”需要继续写成具体变化。

### 可复制的卷纲工作表

> **本卷位置：** 它承接全书哪个阶段？结束后把故事送往哪里？  
> **卷首状态：** 主角的目标、可用资源、关键关系、已知信息与当前代价分别是什么？  
> **本卷读者约定：** 这一卷会推进或兑现哪项已经建立的期待？  
> **主推进线：** 主角持续争取什么阶段结果？最稳定的阻力来自谁或什么？  
> **卷末变化：** 到结尾时，目标、位置、关系、认知或行动条件发生哪项不可忽略的改变？  
> **支撑线：** 每条支线有何当下目标？它在哪个节点改变主线的选择、资源、关系、信息或代价？  
> **保留项：** 哪个答案、能力、对手底牌或终局冲突要留到以后？本卷最多推进到哪里？  
> **单元链：** 每个情节单元的进入原因、阻碍、决定、可见结果，以及它怎样触发下一个单元。  
> **卷末交接：** 哪项结果已经结清？哪项压力、承诺或未知会以新状态进入下一卷？

一卷可以只用必要的栏位。支线少时不用制造额外线路，承诺简单时也不用维护复杂表格。工作表服务于故事，空栏本身不构成缺陷。
body.en:
Fill each field with short, testable statements. Broad labels such as “the character grows” or “the situation escalates” need to become visible changes.

### Copyable volume worksheet

> **Place in the book:** Which phase does this volume continue, and where does it send the story next?  
> **Opening state:** What are the protagonist’s current goal, resources, key relationships, known information, and cost of acting?  
> **Reader contract:** Which established expectation will this volume advance or fulfill?  
> **Principal progression line:** What stage result does the protagonist keep pursuing, and what supplies the most consistent resistance?  
> **End-state change:** By the end, which goal, position, relationship, understanding, or condition of action has changed in a way the story cannot ignore?  
> **Supporting lines:** What does each line pursue now, and where does it change a main-line choice, resource, relationship, fact, or cost?  
> **Reserved material:** Which answer, ability, opponent asset, or endgame conflict belongs later, and how far may this volume advance it?  
> **Plot-unit chain:** For each unit, record its entry cause, obstacle, decision, visible result, and causal handoff to the next unit.  
> **Volume handoff:** Which result closes here, and which pressure, promise, or unknown enters the next volume in a changed state?

Use only the fields the volume needs. A story with few supporting lines does not need invented threads, and a simple promise does not require a complex ledger. The worksheet serves the story; an empty optional field is not a defect.

heading.zh: 把事件列表改成因果单元链
heading.en: Turn an Incident List into a Causal Unit Chain

body.zh:
事件列表常写成“抵达新地点—遇见新人—发生冲突—参加决战”。这些事项可以按任意顺序替换，读者很难看出人物为何走到结尾。卷纲里的情节单元要保留前后传递的条件。

每个单元写五件事：

1. **进入原因：** 上一个结果为何迫使、允许或诱使人物来到这里？
2. **当前阻碍：** 哪项限制让原方案无法直接完成？
3. **决定与行动：** 人物作出什么会排除其他道路的选择？
4. **可见结果：** 选择改变了资源、关系、信息、位置或代价中的哪一项？
5. **因果交接：** 这个新状态怎样启动下一单元，而不是只在结尾制造悬念句？

支线进入某个单元时，也要改变后续条件。它可以带来新证据、消耗关键资源、改变合作立场或提高行动代价。若删掉整条支线后，主线仍以相同选择和代价到达同一结果，就把它缩短、合并，或重新设计汇合点。
body.en:
An incident list often reads: arrive somewhere new, meet someone, face a conflict, join a final confrontation. The items can be swapped freely, so the reader cannot see why the characters reach the ending. Plot units in a volume outline should pass changed conditions forward.

Record five things for each unit:

1. **Entry cause:** How does the previous result force, allow, or tempt the characters into this unit?
2. **Current obstacle:** Which constraint prevents the original plan from working directly?
3. **Decision and action:** What choice excludes another path?
4. **Visible result:** Which resource, relationship, fact, position, or cost changes?
5. **Causal handoff:** How does that new state start the next unit, beyond simply ending on a suspenseful sentence?

When a supporting line enters a unit, it should also change a later condition. It can supply evidence, consume a needed resource, change a person’s willingness to cooperate, or raise the cost of action. If removing the entire line lets the main plot reach the same result through the same choices and costs, shorten it, merge it, or redesign its convergence point.

heading.zh: 原创示例：一卷怎样从合排失败走到共同演出
heading.en: Original Example: From a Failed Rehearsal to a Shared Concert

body.zh:
以下是为本文编辑设计的简短练习，没有改编现有作品，也没有写成章节、交给模型执行或经过读者测试。

一部长篇已经确定全书方向：业余合唱组织者黎真想让几个彼此陌生的社区歌唱小组组成一支能够共同巡演的合唱团。当前只规划其中一卷。本卷开场，夜校合唱组和周末青年组同意筹备第一次公开演出，却从未一起唱过；两组约定本次编排需双方认可，邻区歌唱小组也已受邀来听；卷末，两组用共同编排完成演出，但谁来决定长期曲目和带领排练仍没有共识。

| 工作表项 | 本卷设计 |
|---|---|
| 读者约定 | 回答“两组习惯不同的业余歌者能否完成第一次共同演出”，同时推进“这支临时队伍能否形成共享的合作方式”。 |
| 主推进线 | 黎真要让两组从各唱各的走到能够听见并接住对方；稳定阻力来自不同的呼吸、速度和排练习惯，以及双方都把自己的版本当作标准。 |
| 支撑线 | 青年组中音柏秋想让新人承担可被听见的段落，不愿整场只在资深组后面垫声。她提出把同一首原创练习曲改成分段接唱，让两组各自带出熟悉的乐句，再在共同副段汇合。 |
| 单元链 | 黎真先要求所有人照资深组的完整编排齐唱，第一次合排因换气和进入位置不同而散掉；失败后，资深组提议把演出拆成各自的节目，或者大幅缩减新人的可听见段落，迫使柏秋公开自己的目标并提出分段接唱；这个方案引出“谁拥有最终决定权”的争执；黎真提议保留共同节目、撤掉只突出资深组的齐唱结尾；两组代表听完试唱，同意接唱方案，再按新进入点合排，修正相接处的换气；正式演出中，两组听见对方收句，完成各段进入与共同副段。 |
| 卷末变化 | 两组完成一首真正共同承担的公开作品；黎真放下了对这首曲子的单方面编排权，经两组回应与合排，采用柏秋提出的交替段落；柏秋的方案从排练争议变成观众能够听见的演出结构。 |
| 保留项 | 合唱团长期由谁选曲、怎样处理审美分歧、由谁带领排练仍未解决。本卷只证明两组能完成一次共同作品，不提前决定全书的永久领导关系。 |
| 下一卷交接 | 此前受邀的邻区小组听完共同演出后，发来下一次联合演出的邀请；现有成员愿意继续，却必须先决定新曲目由谁提出、谁有权否决，以及下一次排练由谁带领。 |

这份卷纲留出了许多可调整空间：练习曲的旋律、排练地点和演出中的小失误可以在章节规划时决定。不可随意丢失的是因果骨架：强行统一导致合排失败，拆分提议让柏秋的独立目标进入主线，她的方案又迫使黎真在本次作品中让出单方面的编排权；共同演出完成了本卷约定，也把长期领导问题交给下一卷。

卷纲可以简写动作，但关键回应要在计划里有位置：黎真提出方案，两组接受并试排，之后才完成演出。她让出的是本曲的单方面编排权，不因此自动取得或失去全团永久管理权；长期权责仍属下一卷要处理的问题。
body.en:
The following short exercise was editorially designed for this article. It does not adapt an existing work and has not been expanded into chapters, run through a model, or reader-tested.

The book direction is already set: amateur-choir organizer Li Zhen wants several unfamiliar neighborhood singing groups to become a chorus capable of touring together. This exercise plans only one volume. At the opening, an evening-school group and a weekend youth group agree to prepare their first public performance, although they have never sung together. They agree that both groups must approve this arrangement; a neighboring singing group is already invited to attend. By the end, they have completed the concert with one shared arrangement, but they still disagree over who should choose the long-term repertoire and lead rehearsals.

| Worksheet field | Volume design |
|---|---|
| Reader contract | Answer whether two amateur groups with different habits can complete their first shared performance while advancing the question of whether this temporary ensemble can develop a shared way of working. |
| Principal line | Li Zhen must move the groups from singing beside each other to listening and handing phrases across the ensemble. Their different breathing, tempo, and rehearsal habits create steady resistance, and each group treats its own version as the standard. |
| Supporting line | Bai Qiu, an alto in the youth group, wants beginners to carry an audible part instead of supporting the experienced singers throughout. She proposes reshaping an original practice song into alternating passages, allowing each group to lead familiar phrases before joining in a shared section. |
| Unit chain | Li Zhen first asks everyone to follow the experienced group’s complete arrangement, and the first joint rehearsal falls apart because breaths and entry points do not align; afterward, the experienced group proposes splitting the concert into separate numbers or sharply reducing the beginners’ audible part, forcing Bai Qiu to state her own goal and propose alternating passages; her proposal opens a dispute over final authority; Li proposes retaining the joint piece and removing the ending that features only the experienced singers; both groups’ representatives hear a trial version and accept alternating passages, then rehearse the new entrances and adjust the joining breaths; in the concert they hear each other’s closing phrases and complete the entrances and shared section. |
| End-state change | The groups complete one public piece that they genuinely carry together; Li Zhen gives up unilateral arrangement control over this piece and, after both groups respond and rehearse, adopts Bai Qiu’s alternating passages; Bai Qiu’s proposal moves from a rehearsal dispute into an audible part of the performance. |
| Reserved material | The chorus has not settled who chooses its long-term repertoire, how it will handle disagreements in taste, or who will lead rehearsals. This volume proves only that the groups can complete one shared piece; it does not decide the book’s permanent leadership structure. |
| Next-volume handoff | The previously invited neighboring group hears the shared performance and proposes another joint concert. The current members want to continue, but they must first decide who may introduce a new piece, who may reject one, and who will lead the next rehearsal. |

The outline leaves many adjustable details: the melody of the practice song, rehearsal locations, and small mistakes during the performance can wait for chapter planning. The causal frame remains stable: forced uniformity causes the joint rehearsal to fail, the proposal to split the program brings Bai Qiu’s independent goal into the main line, and her alternative requires Li Zhen to give up unilateral arrangement control for this piece. The joint concert fulfills this volume’s contract while passing the long-term leadership question into the next volume.

A volume plan can abbreviate actions but needs room for crucial responses: Li proposes, both groups accept and rehearse, then perform. Giving up unilateral control of this piece does not automatically grant or remove permanent authority over the chorus. Long-term responsibilities remain a next-volume question.

heading.zh: 把已批准事实交给AI，未知项单独返回
heading.en: Give AI Approved Facts and Keep Unknowns Separate

body.zh:
AI适合帮助检查因果缺口、整理单元顺序和提出备选连接。先提供作者已经批准的事实，再限定它只处理一卷。下面是本文原创的交接模板；将方括号替换为你的内容。

> 我正在规划长篇小说中的一卷。只使用下列作者已批准事实，不要补写新的正史设定：  
> 全书阶段与本卷位置：[内容]  
> 卷首状态：[内容]  
> 本卷读者约定：[内容]  
> 主推进线与阻力：[内容]  
> 已成立的支线、关系与世界规则：[内容]  
> 必须保留到后续的答案或能力：[内容]  
> 期望的卷末变化：[内容]
>
> 请输出：一份简洁的单卷工作表；一组因果相连的情节单元，每个单元写进入原因、阻碍、决定、可见结果和下一单元触发；各支线改变主线条件的位置；本卷兑现与保留的内容；卷末交接。  
> 将材料无法确定的内容集中列入“待作者决定”，说明缺少哪项信息，并提供至多两个不互相冒充既定事实的备选方向。不要替我选定新人物背景、世界规则、幕后真相或终局答案，也不要展开成逐章正文。

收到结果后，先审“待作者决定”，再看单元链。模型若把备选写成事实，就退回该项；若新增内容改变全书方向，也要先由作者批准，再进入卷纲。
body.en:
AI can help expose causal gaps, arrange plot units, and suggest alternative connections. Supply author-approved facts first and limit the task to one volume. The following handoff template was written for this article; replace the bracketed fields with your material.

> I am planning one volume of a long novel. Use only the author-approved facts below, and do not add new canon:  
> Book phase and this volume’s place in it: [content]  
> Opening state: [content]  
> Reader contract for the volume: [content]  
> Principal progression line and resistance: [content]  
> Established supporting lines, relationships, and world rules: [content]  
> Answers or abilities reserved for later: [content]  
> Intended end-state change: [content]
>
> Return a concise volume worksheet; a causal set of plot units, each with an entry cause, obstacle, decision, visible result, and trigger for the next unit; the points where supporting lines change main-line conditions; what the volume fulfills and preserves; and the handoff at the ending.  
> Put anything the supplied material cannot determine in a separate “Author decision needed” list. State what information is missing and offer no more than two alternatives, clearly labeled as proposals rather than canon. Do not choose new character histories, world rules, hidden truths, or endgame answers for me, and do not expand the plan into chapter prose.

Review “Author decision needed” before the unit chain. Return any proposal presented as an established fact. If a new idea would alter the book direction, approve it explicitly before adding it to the volume outline.

heading.zh: 用五个检查修理松散卷纲
heading.en: Use Five Checks to Repair a Loose Volume Outline

body.zh:
完成初稿后，按下面五种症状检查。每次只修因果和阶段功能，再决定是否增加情节。

| 问题 | 检查与修正 |
|---|---|
| 支线彼此断开 | 检查问题：这条线在哪个可见节点改变主线条件？ 修理方式：写出改变前后；找不到变化时合并、缩短或移除。 |
| 全卷都像高潮 | 检查问题：每个单元是否同时使用最大危险、最大揭示和最大代价？ 修理方式：保留卷末最需要的升级，把中段改成取得条件、承受损失或改变联盟。 |
| 回报没有铺垫 | 检查问题：兑现所需的人、物、规则或承诺此前在哪里进入故事？ 修理方式：在较早单元放入可辨认的进展标记，让兑现来自累积结果。 |
| 提前透支终局 | 检查问题：本卷是否用了后续阶段才该出现的答案、能力或对手底牌？ 修理方式：把完整答案留后，只交付本卷能承担的证据、局部胜利或新问题。 |
| 卷末什么也没变 | 检查问题：删除本卷后，下一卷的目标、关系、信息、资源和代价是否完全相同？ 修理方式：重写卷末选择，让至少一项条件被取得、失去、公开、锁定或重新解释。 |

还可以选择维护三份轻量记录：已经建立但尚未兑现的承诺、各推进线最近一次可见变化、连续承压后该轮换的压力来源。它们只在帮助你发现遗漏时使用；不要为了填表新增剧情，也不要求所有线路平均推进。
body.en:
After the first pass, check the outline against five common symptoms. Repair causality and stage function first, then decide whether the story needs more material.

| Problem | Check and repair |
|---|---|
| Disconnected lines | Question: At which visible point does this line change a main-line condition? Repair: Write the before and after states. If nothing changes, merge, shorten, or remove the line. |
| Every unit feels like a climax | Question: Does each unit spend the greatest danger, revelation, and cost at once? Repair: Reserve the escalation the ending needs. Let middle units obtain conditions, absorb losses, or change alliances. |
| Unearned payoff | Question: Where did the person, object, rule, or promise required by the payoff enter the story? Repair: Add recognizable progress earlier so the payoff grows from accumulated results. |
| Premature endgame reveal | Question: Does this volume use an answer, ability, or opponent asset assigned to a later phase? Repair: Preserve the complete answer and deliver only the evidence, partial victory, or new question this volume can support. |
| Nothing changes at the ending | Question: If the volume disappears, are the next volume’s goals, relationships, facts, resources, and costs identical? Repair: Rewrite the ending choice so at least one condition is gained, lost, revealed, locked, or reinterpreted. |

You can also keep three lightweight records when useful: promises established but not yet fulfilled, the most recent visible change on each progression line, and a pressure source that may need rotation after repeated use. Use them only to expose omissions. Do not add plot to fill a table, and do not force every line to advance equally.

q.zh: 卷纲要写到每一章吗？
q.en: Should a Volume Outline Cover Every Chapter?

a.zh: 不需要。卷纲先确定读者约定、主推进线、情节单元的因果交接和卷末变化。等某个单元准备进入正文时，再把它拆成章节目标、场景冲突和结尾落点；这样既保留方向，也能根据实际写作调整章节安排。
a.en: No. First establish the reader contract, principal progression line, causal handoffs between plot units, and end-state change. Break a selected unit into chapter goals, scene conflicts, and endings only when it is approaching draft stage. This preserves direction while leaving the chapter arrangement adjustable.

q.zh: 一卷需要几条支线和几个情节单元？
q.en: How Many Supporting Lines and Plot Units Does One Volume Need?

a.zh: 没有统一数量。保留能够独立产生选择、并会改变主线条件的支线；情节单元则以完成本卷阶段变化所需的因果步骤为准。功能重复的线路可以合并，无法把结果交给下一单元的事件需要重写或删除。
a.en: There is no universal count. Keep supporting lines that create meaningful choices and change a main-line condition. Use as many plot units as the causal path to the volume’s stage change requires. Merge duplicate functions, and revise or remove incidents that pass no changed condition forward.

q.zh: AI补出的设定很精彩，可以直接放进卷纲吗？
q.en: Can I Put an Appealing AI-Invented Detail Straight into the Outline?

a.zh: 先把它标成提案，检查它是否改写人物经历、世界规则、幕后真相或后续阶段安排。只有作者明确批准后，它才进入事实清单；未批准时放在待决定区，避免后面的单元把一个临时想法当成既定前提。
a.en: Label it as a proposal first. Check whether it changes a character history, world rule, hidden truth, or later phase. Add it to the fact list only after explicit author approval. Until then, keep it in the decision-needed section so later units do not treat a temporary idea as canon.

text.zh: story-long-write 可以在只讨论结构的阶段协助整理单卷工作表、因果单元和卷末交接。提供作者已批准事实与保留项，并要求把材料不足处单列为待决定问题；确认卷纲后，再进入章节或正文规划。
text.en: story-long-write can help organize a one-volume worksheet, causal plot units, and the ending handoff while the work remains at the structural stage. Supply author-approved facts and reserved material, ask for unsupported areas to be listed as decisions, and approve the volume plan before moving into chapter or prose planning.

label.zh: 本文方法来源
单卷工作流与规划边界

title.zh: AI写小说字数不够怎么办：先补漏掉的情节点
title.en: AI Novel Chapter Too Short? Restore the Missing Beats

seo_title.zh: AI写小说字数不够怎么办｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: AI Novel Chapter Too Short? | ZenStory

description.zh: AI生成的小说章节比目标短时，先核对已批准情节点。只补漏写的行动、阻碍、选择与结果；情节点齐全就由作者调整目标或接受当前长度。
description.en: AI chapter too short? Audit approved beats. Add only missing action, resistance, choice, and results; revise the plan or accept the current length.

answer.zh: AI写出的小说章节比目标短，先把已批准的情节点逐项对照正文，找出真正漏写的行动、阻碍、选择或结果。只扩写这些缺口，并保持既定事实、视角、关系和后续安排不变。若所有必要情节点都已落到正文中，就停止补写：作者可以接受当前长度，也可以修改字数目标或细纲后重写。字数目标是规划参照，不能成为新增剧情和重复描写的理由。
answer.en: When an AI-generated novel chapter comes in short, compare the draft against the approved beats and locate any missing action, resistance, choice, or result. Expand only those gaps while preserving established facts, point of view, relationships, and later plans. If every required beat is already on the page, stop adding prose: the author can accept the current length or revise the target or outline before rewriting. A word target is a planning constraint, not permission to invent plot or repeat description.

heading.zh: 先查缺失情节点，再处理字数差额
heading.en: Audit Approved Beats Before Addressing the Shortfall

body.zh:
先记下目标长度与当前长度，用它们确认差额；接下来的编辑判断要回到本章已经批准的内容。把细纲中的必要情节点列在左边，把正文中真正完成它的位置列在右边。

| 核对项 | 正文中要找到的证据 |
|---|---|
| 人物目标 | 人物在当前场景具体想完成什么 |
| 阻碍 | 原计划为什么无法直接完成 |
| 关键选择 | 人物选了哪条路，又放弃了什么 |
| 可见结果 | 目标、风险、信息、关系或资源发生了什么变化 |
| 章节交接 | 这个结果怎样改变下一步 |

“提过”不等于“写到了”。如果细纲要求人物在两种代价之间选择，正文却一句话跳到结果，这一拍仍然缺失。补写时让读者看见阻碍怎样出现、人物依据什么作出选择、选择造成什么后果。

同一个情节点已经用动作、对白和结果完成后，不要再换几组形容词复述。感官、反应或环境细节只在改变人物判断、行动或场面结果时加入。
body.en:
Record the target and current length to establish the size of the gap, then base the editorial decision on the chapter's approved material. List each required beat on the left and the place where the prose actually delivers it on the right.

| Check | Draft evidence |
|---|---|
| Character goal | What the character is trying to accomplish in this scene |
| Resistance | Why the original approach cannot work directly |
| Key choice | Which path the character takes and what that choice gives up |
| Visible result | What changes in the goal, risk, information, relationship, or resources |
| Chapter handoff | How that result changes the next step |

A mention does not always complete a beat. If the outline requires a choice between two costs and the draft jumps straight to the outcome, the choice is still missing. The repair should let the reader see the obstacle arrive, understand the basis of the decision, and witness its consequence.

Once action, dialogue, and result have completed a beat, do not restate it through extra sets of adjectives. Add perception, reaction, or setting detail only when it changes the character's judgment, action, or the outcome of the scene.

heading.zh: 按核对结果选择补写、改纲或收下
heading.en: Choose Expansion, Replanning, or Acceptance

body.zh:
核对后只有两种编辑结果。

1. **必要情节点有缺口。** 只补缺失的拍点。优先补能形成场景推进的行动、阻碍、选择与后果，让这一拍从规划标签变成读者看得见的过程。
2. **必要情节点全部完成。** 停止扩写。作者决定接受当前长度，或者调整细纲与字数目标后重写。新的支线、人物、秘密、世界设定和冲突都需要先由作者批准，不能作为凑字方案混进正文。

补写范围可以写成一句可核对的任务，例如：“展开门被锁住之后的应对，让林澈尝试原方案、发现失败，并在两个已批准选项中作出选择；结尾保持原定结果。”这种任务限定了缺口、过程和落点，也把其他剧情排除在外。

若你无法指出新增段落对应哪个已批准情节点，这段文字就没有进入本轮补写的依据。
body.en:
The audit leads to two editorial outcomes.

1. **A required beat is missing.** Add only that beat. Favor action, resistance, choice, and consequence that turn a planning label into a process the reader can witness.
2. **Every required beat is complete.** Stop expanding. The author decides whether to accept the current length or revise the outline and target before rewriting. A new subplot, character, secret, world fact, or conflict needs author approval before it enters the chapter; it cannot serve as word-count padding.

Define the repair as a testable sentence: “Expand what happens after Lin Che finds the door locked. Let him try the original approach, discover why it fails, and choose between the two approved options. Preserve the planned result.” This identifies the gap, process, and endpoint while excluding unrelated plot.

If you cannot map a proposed paragraph to an approved beat, it has no basis for entering this repair pass.

heading.zh: 可复制提示词：先报告缺口，再补写
heading.en: Copyable Prompt: Report the Gaps Before Expanding

body.zh:
把方括号替换成你的内容。第一次先要核对表，不要让模型立即续写。

> 我在检查一章比目标短的小说草稿。目标长度只作规划参照，请先判断已批准情节点是否漏写，不要为了接近数字新增内容。  
> **既定事实与连续性：** [人物关系、时间、地点、物件状态、视角、已公开信息]  
> **本章必须完成的情节点：** [逐项列出目标、阻碍、选择、结果和章尾交接]  
> **必须保留到后文的内容：** [秘密、能力、人物、关系变化或答案]  
> **当前草稿：** [粘贴正文]  
> 先输出一张核对表：每个情节点标为“已完成”或“缺失”，引用或概括对应正文作为证据。不要改写正文。若判断需要新增人物、支线、设定、秘密或事件才能补足，请列入“待作者决定”，不要自行采用。

确认核对表后，再发送补写要求：

> 只补写核对表中确认缺失的情节点：[列出项目]。把已批准的行动、阻碍、选择和结果演成连续场景；保持既定事实、视角、人物声音、信息揭露顺序和章尾结果。每个新增段落都应推进所列情节点。不要新增人物、支线、世界设定、秘密、回忆或后续伏笔，也不要用同义复述、形容词、无后果的感官和反应凑长度。材料不足时停下并列出需要作者决定的问题。若情节点已全部完成，请不要补写，只返回“接受当前长度”与“修改目标或细纲后重写”两个作者选项。

先分开诊断与改写，可以避免模型一看到“字数不足”就直接制造材料。作者确认缺口后，补写范围也更容易复核。
body.en:
Replace the bracketed fields with your material. Ask for an audit first instead of requesting an immediate continuation.

> I am reviewing a novel chapter that came in below its target. Treat the target as a planning reference. First determine whether any approved beats are missing; do not add material merely to approach the number.  
> **Established facts and continuity:** [relationships, time, place, object states, point of view, revealed information]  
> **Required chapter beats:** [list the goal, resistance, choice, result, and ending handoff]  
> **Material reserved for later:** [secrets, abilities, characters, relationship changes, or answers]  
> **Current draft:** [paste the prose]  
> Return an audit table first. Mark each beat “complete” or “missing” and quote or summarize the relevant evidence from the draft. Do not revise the prose yet. If completing a beat would require a new character, subplot, setting fact, secret, or event, put it under “Author decision needed” and do not adopt it.

After confirming the audit, send the scoped expansion request:

> Expand only these confirmed missing beats: [list them]. Dramatize the approved action, resistance, choice, and result as a continuous scene. Preserve established facts, point of view, character voice, reveal order, and the planned ending. Every added paragraph must advance one of the listed beats. Do not introduce characters, subplots, world facts, secrets, memories, or future setup. Do not pad with paraphrase, adjectives, or sensory and emotional reactions that have no consequence. If the supplied material is insufficient, stop and list the author decisions required. If every beat is complete, do not expand; return two author options: accept the current length, or revise the target or outline before rewriting.

Separating diagnosis from revision keeps a shortfall from turning into automatic invention. Once the author confirms the gaps, the expansion also has a clear review boundary.

heading.zh: 原创示例：补回被跳过的阻碍与选择
heading.en: Original Example: Restore the Omitted Obstacle and Choice

body.zh:
下面的片段为本文原创。已经批准的情节点是：乔岑必须在末班车前归还档案馆钥匙；侧门上锁后，她要在“把钥匙留进无人确认的投信口”与“按铃叫醒值夜的唐姨，并承认自己抄过一页登记”之间选择；她选择按铃；唐姨收回钥匙，把那页登记留到第二天一起查看；乔岑错过末班车。

### 过短草稿

> 乔岑在末班车前赶到档案馆，把钥匙还给值夜的唐姨，也承认自己抄了那页登记。唐姨让她第二天再来。

草稿写了开头与结果，却跳过门锁造成的阻碍、两个选项之间的取舍，以及承认行为怎样改变两人的下一步。这些都是已批准内容，可以补回。

### 限定范围后的补写

> 乔岑赶到档案馆时，侧门的铁链已经扣死。她把钥匙贴近投信口，试了试宽度。只要松手，她还赶得上末班车；可钥匙落进黑暗里，没人能确认它已经交还。  
> 她收回手，按响值夜铃。  
> “谁？”唐姨隔着门问。  
> “是我。”乔岑握住钥匙，“我用它抄了那页登记。”  
> 铁链响了一声。唐姨开门接过钥匙：“明早再来。那一页，我们一起看。”  
> 末班车从街口驶过。乔岑站在门外，点了点头。

补写后的第一段完成阻碍与代价，第二至四段完成选择，第五段给出关系和信息处理上的新状态，末句兑现错过末班车的代价。新增内容都能对应已批准情节点，没有另开支线，也没有引入未经批准的新剧情前提。
body.en:
The following passage was written for this article. Its approved beats are: Qiao Cen must return an archive key before the last bus; when she finds the side door locked, she must choose between dropping the key through an unattended mail slot and ringing for Aunt Tang, the night custodian, which also means admitting that she copied a registry page; she rings; Aunt Tang takes the key and postpones reviewing the page until they can do it together the next morning; Qiao Cen misses the bus.

### Short draft

> Qiao Cen reached the archive before the last bus, returned the key to Aunt Tang, and admitted that she had copied the registry page. Aunt Tang told her to come back the next day.

The draft supplies the opening and outcome, then skips the locked-door obstacle, the tradeoff between the approved options, and the way the admission changes what happens next. Those approved beats can be restored.

### Scoped expansion

> When Qiao Cen reached the archive, a chain held the side door shut. She tested the key against the mail slot. If she let it fall, she could still catch the last bus, but the key would land in darkness with no one to confirm its return.  
> She drew her hand back and pressed the night bell.  
> “Who is it?” Aunt Tang called through the door.  
> “Me.” Qiao Cen closed her fingers around the key. “I used it to copy the registry page.”  
> The chain shifted. Aunt Tang opened the door and took the key. “Come back in the morning. We will look at that page together.”  
> The last bus passed the end of the street. Qiao Cen remained outside and nodded.

The first added paragraph delivers the obstacle and cost. The next three deliver the choice. Aunt Tang's response establishes the new relationship and information state, and the final line pays the approved cost of missing the bus. Every addition maps to an approved beat; no unrelated subplot or unapproved story premise was introduced.

heading.zh: 补写后做一次状态、连续性与段落检查
heading.en: Finish With State, Continuity, and Paragraph Checks

body.zh:
补写完成后，不要只看字数。用下面的检查决定这次修订是否成立。

- [ ] **人物处境变化清楚。** 删掉补写段落后，人物目标、风险、信息、关系或资源会失去一项已批准变化。
- [ ] **每段都有归属。** 每个新增段落都能标回一个缺失情节点；无法标注的段落删除或退回作者决定。
- [ ] **连续性未改变。** 时间、地点、物件位置、人物已知信息、视角和关系与前后文一致。
- [ ] **保留项仍然保留。** 后文才揭晓的答案、人物、能力和伏笔没有提前出现。
- [ ] **场景完成了目标—阻碍—变化。** 人物做了事情，阻碍影响了行动，结尾留下可见结果。
- [ ] **没有重复功能。** 同一选择或情绪没有被动作、解释、感官和总结反复说多次。

全部通过后，作者仍然可以接受一个低于原目标的章节。章节完成度由它兑现了哪些必要变化来判断；字数只帮助发现可能的缺口。
body.en:
After the expansion, do not evaluate the revision by length alone. Use these checks to decide whether the repair holds.

- [ ] **The state change is clear.** Removing the added passage would erase an approved change in goal, risk, information, relationship, or resources.
- [ ] **Every paragraph has a beat.** Each added paragraph maps to a confirmed gap. Delete anything that cannot be mapped or return it for an author decision.
- [ ] **Continuity remains intact.** Time, place, object locations, character knowledge, point of view, and relationships agree with the surrounding chapters.
- [ ] **Reserved material stays reserved.** Answers, characters, abilities, and setups assigned to later chapters have not appeared early.
- [ ] **The scene completes goal, resistance, and change.** The character acts, the obstacle affects the action, and the ending leaves a visible result.
- [ ] **No function is repeated.** The same choice or feeling is not restated through action, explanation, sensation, and summary.

The author can still accept a chapter that remains below its original target after every check passes. Completion depends on the required changes the chapter delivers; length helps reveal possible omissions.

q.zh: AI写的章节字数不足，一定要让它续写吗？
q.en: Must I ask the AI to continue every short chapter?

a.zh: 不用。先核对必要情节点。存在漏写时，只补对应缺口；情节点齐全时，由作者接受当前长度，或修改细纲与目标后重写。
a.en: No. Audit the required beats first. Add only a confirmed omission. When every beat is complete, the author can accept the current length or revise the outline and target before rewriting.

q.zh: 怎样让AI精确写到指定字数？
q.en: How do I make AI hit an exact word count?

a.zh: 把字数当作规划参照，不承诺精确落点。先明确必须完成的情节点和禁止新增的内容，再按实际草稿检查遗漏；最终长度由作者结合章节完成度决定。
a.en: Treat the number as a planning reference rather than a guaranteed endpoint. Define required beats and prohibited additions, audit the actual draft for omissions, and let the author judge the final length alongside chapter completeness.

q.zh: 情节点都写到了，章节还是显得薄怎么办？
q.en: What if every beat is present but the chapter still feels thin?

a.zh: 回到作者层面检查这章承担的任务、细纲密度和字数目标。若需要新的冲突、关系变化或剧情结果，先修改细纲并批准这些变化，再重写；不要在现稿里临时塞入。
a.en: Revisit the chapter's assigned job, outline density, and target. If it needs a new conflict, relationship change, or plot result, revise and approve the outline before rewriting instead of inserting that material during a length repair.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 只核对这章的已批准情节点与当前正文，先报告漏写的行动、阻碍、选择和结果，不直接续写。确认缺口后只补对应拍点，保留事实、视角、人物声音与后续安排；情节点齐全就停止补写，由作者决定接受当前长度还是修改细纲与目标。
text.en: Use $story-long-write only to compare this chapter’s approved beats with the draft. First report missing actions, obstacles, choices, or results without continuing. After gaps are confirmed, develop only those beats while preserving facts, viewpoint, voice, and later plans. If all beats are complete, stop and let the author accept the length or revise the outline and target.
