For an error, choose the retained rule or changed event before editing. Recheck later consequences under established conditions and costs without imposing a new price on the exception.

heading.zh: 可复制的只读审计提示词与改后复查
heading.en: A copyable read-only audit prompt and follow-through check

body.zh:
下面的人工提示词只要求取证和报告。它不创造新的 skill 模式。

> 对〔已提供章节与参考材料〕做只读一致性检查。先搜索人物与别名、地点、物件、规则、时间、数量、限制和代价，再核对条件、行动与结果。每条候选给前提和触发两端的位置、短引文、表面冲突、读者影响、可能例外、缺失材料与待作者决定的问题。缺一端就标证据不足。只在有正文依据证明例外适用时排除候选。按必须改、建议改、可以不改说明优先级，优先级不代替证据。不评价故事精彩程度，不补设定，不改文件或运行有副作用的命令。

作者决定并授权改稿后，定向复查：

- [ ] 选定事实、规则或例外在正文中表述清楚
- [ ] 触发所需条件、权限与作品既定代价对齐
- [ ] 后文知情、物件、关系与行动后果仍有依据
- [ ] 删除或移动场景后，没有引用已不存在的线索或原因
- [ ] 关闭项可以引用改后正文，而不只是作者口头说明

复查沿实际依赖展开，不只看改动段，也不无条件重写全书。
body.en:
This manual prompt requests evidence and a report without creating a new skill mode.

> Perform a read-only continuity check on [supplied chapters and materials]. Search names and aliases, places, objects, rules, time, quantities, limits and costs; compare conditions, actions and results. For each candidate, give premise and trigger locations with short quotations, apparent conflict, reader effect, possible exceptions, missing materials and an author decision. Mark insufficient evidence if either quotation is missing. Clear a candidate only with textual evidence that an exception applies. Explain priority as necessary, suggested or optional without substituting priority for evidence. Do not evaluate excitement, invent setting, edit files or run side-effecting commands.

After an author decision and authorized revision, recheck:

- [ ] The chosen fact, rule or exception is clear in prose
- [ ] Conditions, authority and established costs fit the trigger
- [ ] Later knowledge, possession, relationships and consequences remain supported
- [ ] Deleted or moved scenes leave no references to missing clues or causes
- [ ] Closed findings cite revised prose, rather than only the author’s explanation

Follow actual dependencies beyond the edited passage without automatically rewriting the full book.

q.zh: AI说小说前后矛盾，却不给章节证据怎么办？
q.en: What if the AI claims a continuity error without chapter evidence?

a.zh: 把它退回“证据不足”，暂不改稿。要求 AI 给出冲突两端的章节、段落或行号和最短必要引文，再搜索适用范围与例外。只找到一端、引用与结论不匹配，或无法在原文复现时，这条就不能升级为证据支持的候选。
a.en: Return it to Insufficient evidence and leave the manuscript unchanged. Ask for the chapter, paragraph or line and the shortest necessary quotation on both sides, then search for scope and exceptions. A claim cannot become an evidence-supported candidate when only one side exists, the quotation does not support the conclusion, or the result cannot be reproduced in the text.

q.zh: 隐藏真相、不可靠叙述或规则例外会被误报吗？
q.en: Can a hidden truth, unreliable account, or rule exception be falsely flagged?

a.zh: 会，所以报告把每条结果当候选。若正文已经给出谎言、伪装、视角限制或例外条件的证据，引用该证据并标“已排除”或“作者已裁决：刻意”。若解释只存在于作者脑中，候选仍需作者决定是否让正文提供足够依据。裁决后继续检查后文的知情范围、适用边界和后果。
a.en: Yes, which is why every result starts as a candidate. If the prose already supports a lie, disguise, viewpoint limit, or exception, cite that support and mark the item Cleared or Author ruled: intentional. If the explanation exists only in the author's intent, the author still decides whether the manuscript needs evidence. Then check later knowledge, scope, and consequences against that ruling.

text.zh: 使用 /story-review lean（Codex 用 $story-review lean）时，它会尝试故事结构与一致性两个视角，所需助手或运行能力不足时转为 solo 基础审查。因此该入口比本页的事实检查更广；只提取有两端引文的事实项，结构意见另列。严格只读可直接用上方提示词，明确不修改文件或运行有副作用的命令；原生审查可能按流程维护审查状态或追踪记录。
text.en: /story-review lean, or $story-review lean in Codex, attempts structure and consistency review, falling back to solo basic review when required agents or runtime capability are unavailable. It is broader than this page’s fact check: extract cited factual findings and separate structural notes. For strict read-only work, use the prompt above and prohibit file edits and side-effecting commands; the native workflow may maintain review state or tracking records.

label.zh: 事实证据与面向作者的报告
作者报告中的修改优先级

title.en: How to Write a Satisfying Novel Ending
title.zh: 小说结尾怎么写才满足：兑现承诺，也留下余味

seo_title.en: Write a Satisfying Novel Ending
seo_title.zh: 小说结尾怎么写才满足

description.en: Trace the story’s promises, make the final choice cost something, and give the protagonist a concrete new state in the last scene.
description.zh: 从开篇承诺倒推结尾，让最终选择付出代价，并在末场交代主角的新处境。

answer.en: A satisfying ending pays off the story’s main promise, makes the protagonist choose under pressure, and shows what that choice changes. List the questions you opened, decide which must be answered on-page, then let the final scene demonstrate the cost and the new normal.
answer.zh: 满足感来自兑现故事的核心承诺、让主角在压力下作出选择，并展示选择改变了什么。先列出开篇留下的问题，确定哪些必须在正文回答，再用末场呈现代价和新的日常。

heading.zh: 结尾先回应开头答应读者的事
heading.en: Start with the promises made at the opening

body.zh:
读者在开篇等待什么：破案、回家、赢回尊严，还是一段关系的答案？从前三章和简介各摘一句，列出必须回应的主问题。高潮完成关键行动；结尾让读者看见行动之后的生活。胜负揭晓后立刻停笔，往往会漏掉人物承受的代价。

人物不一定如愿，但失败必须由此前的选择与条件造成。临时出现的救援、遗产或新能力，会把前面辛苦铺垫的决定变得无效。
body.en: Read the opening and blurb again. List what readers are waiting for: a solved case, a return home, restored dignity, or a relationship decision. The climax completes the decisive action; the ending shows its consequences. A sad ending can satisfy when earlier choices make it understandable. An unprepared rescue or new power weakens those choices.

heading.zh: 可复制的结尾检查表
heading.en: A worksheet for the final scenes

body.zh:
| 问题 | 记录 |
|---|---|
| 许遥能否保住修理铺 | 成立条件: 老客已说清：核对零件去向后才会付清尾款；尾款足以覆盖本次租金; 实际结果: 她出示实际记录，客户核对并付款，租金按时付清 |
| 是否继续替家人承担新债 | 成立条件: 家人要求她签下一笔借据；她已开始独立接单; 实际结果: 她拒绝新借据，姐姐撤回以后担保，关系留下裂痕 |

这两行是原创案例的前置设定，不是“有证据就能解决一切”的通用结论。若收入仍不足，保店还欠一个真实方案；拒绝新债也不会抹掉过去已经承担的债。

填写自己的主线时，先补成立条件，再安排行动、接受与实际完成。不用结尾一段解释代替付款、交接或离场。

这张两列表是作者检查本例的工作表，不是原生卷纲格式。Oh Story 的收尾方法检查主线结果、人物后续影响与余韵；卷级方法同时区分主角的关键贡献和其他人的执行。老客亲自核对付款，不会削弱许遥提供记录与拒签的选择。
body.en:
| Question | Record |
|---|---|
| Can Xu keep her repair shop? | Prior condition: Customers will pay the balance after verifying missing parts; it covers this rent payment; Result: She supplies records, customers verify and pay, and rent is paid |
| Will she assume another family debt? | Prior condition: Family requests a new signed loan; she has begun independent work; Result: She refuses; her sister withdraws future backing, leaving a relationship rupture |

These are the original example’s prerequisites, not a rule that evidence solves everything. Insufficient income still needs a real solution. Refusing new debt does not erase prior obligations.

Fill conditions before action, acceptance and completion. An explanatory closing paragraph cannot substitute for payment, transfer or departure.

This two-column table is an editorial worksheet, not the native volume outline. Oh Story’s closure methods check the central outcome, character aftermath, and afterglow; its volume method distinguishes the protagonist’s key contribution from other people’s execution. Customers checking and paying do not diminish Xu’s decision to present records or refuse the new loan.

heading.zh: 原创示例：让结果留在一个生活动作里
heading.en: Original example: leave the result in an ordinary action

body.zh:
接上表中的原创设定：许遥出示零件记录，老客核对后付清尾款，她及时付了本期租金。她拒签家人的新借据，姐姐因此撤回以后担保。结尾不再复述调查或付款过程：

> 许遥把新价目表贴在门内。第一位顾客问能不能赊账，她递过去一张收据：“零件到店那天付款。”门外，姐姐留着的一把伞还靠在墙边。她把伞搬进屋，继续核对下一张订单。

价目表呈现经营方式改变；收据呼应已经建立的交付与付款边界；伞保留关系余波。保店结果在此前真实完成，不能只靠贴价目表暗示。伞也不能临时出现承担所有情感，前文需有姐姐留下它的事实。
body.en:
Continuing the table’s original setup, Xu presents the parts records. Customers verify and pay the balance; she pays the current rent. She refuses the family’s new loan, and her sister withdraws future backing. The ending need not repeat those events:

> Xu fixed the new prices inside the door. The first customer asked for credit. She offered a receipt. “Pay when the parts arrive.” Her sister’s umbrella still leaned against the outside wall. She brought it in and checked the next order.

Prices show a changed practice, the receipt recalls payment boundaries, and the umbrella leaves relationship aftermath. Keeping the shop has already been enacted; a price list alone cannot prove it. Establish the sister’s umbrella earlier rather than introducing it to carry all the emotion.

heading.zh: 开放式结局不是把主线留空
heading.en: Open endings still answer the central question

body.zh:
开放式结局可以不说姐姐会不会回来，却应回答店铺保没保住、主角会怎样经营。悬疑可以留下关系或道德问题，不应把主要案件的必要线索藏到正文之外。系列小说在本卷给出一次完整结果，再打开下卷的新问题。

- [ ] 核心人物作出关键选择或不可替代的贡献；其他人的执行与回应有依据
- [ ] 关键解决办法此前已经出现
- [ ] 实际结果及作品已经建立的代价能从正文中确认，不为结尾另加牺牲
- [ ] 删掉总结段，读者仍知道主线答案
body.en:
An open ending may leave the sister’s return undecided while answering whether the shop survives. A series volume should settle its own central conflict before opening another.

- [ ] The central character makes a key choice or irreplaceable contribution; others’ actions and replies have support
- [ ] The solution has earlier setup
- [ ] The actual outcome and established costs are supported in the prose, without adding a sacrifice merely for the ending
- [ ] Removing the summary paragraph does not hide the main answer

heading.zh: 区分关系留白与缺失的主线答案
heading.en: Separate an open relationship from a missing answer

body.zh:
本例可以不回答姐姐何时回来，但必须回答本次租金是否付清、主角是否签了新借据。把“开放式”用在尚待发展的关系上，不用它藏起全书一直要求的行动结果。

列出必须关闭与允许开放的两栏，每项都写最后正文依据。线索留白若妨碍读者理解主要案件，就需要补必要答案；象征细节也不能替代结果。系列结尾可以在本卷兑现后再种新问题，但新问题不能宣布刚刚所有努力无效。
body.en:
The example can leave the sister’s return open while answering whether rent was paid and a new loan signed. Openness belongs to an ongoing relationship rather than hiding the central result.

List required closures and permitted open questions with final prose evidence. A withheld clue that prevents understanding the main case needs resolution. Symbols cannot replace outcomes. A series can open a new question after this volume’s payoff without voiding all prior effort.

q.en: Does every subplot need to be resolved at the ending?
q.zh: 结尾必须把每条支线都解决吗？

a.en: Resolve the subplots that carry this book’s central emotional or causal promises. A smaller thread can remain open if the reader can tell it is intentionally continuing and the main story still lands. Do not leave a core relationship or goal unresolved by accident.
a.zh: 回应承担本书核心情感或因果承诺的支线。较小的线索可以继续开放，但读者应看得出这是有意延续，而且主线已经落地。不要意外遗漏关键关系或目标。

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 审读结尾：列开篇承诺、解决条件、最后行动、实际完成和代价。分必须回答与允许留白，引用正文依据；不临时增加付款、资格或新能力，不用象征细节代替结果。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to review opening promises, established solution conditions, final action, completion and cost. Separate required answers from permitted openness with prose evidence. Add no payment, authority or power; do not replace outcomes with symbols.

label.zh: 核心结果、余波与结尾留白
label.en: Core outcome, aftermath, and ending space

label.zh: 卷收尾与主角关键贡献
label.en: Volume closure and the protagonist’s key contribution

title.en: Show vs. Tell in Fiction: When to Use Each
title.zh: 小说描写怎么写：场景展开与概述的取舍

seo_title.en: Show vs. Tell in Fiction
seo_title.zh: 小说描写怎么写：场景展开与概述的取舍

description.en: Choose scene detail for decisions and change; summarize routine, elapsed time, and information the reader needs without replaying.
description.zh: 关键决定写成场景，重复过程和时间跨度用概述带过。

answer.en: Use scene-level showing when readers need to witness a choice, conflict, or emotional turn. Tell or summarize when the event is routine, repeated, or less important than its result. The goal is not to eliminate summary; it is to spend page time where the story changes.
answer.zh: 当读者需要亲眼看见选择、冲突或情绪转折时写成场景；事件重复、例行或结果比过程更重要时，用概述带过。目标不是消灭概述，而是把篇幅留给真正改变故事的地方。

heading.zh: 重要选择展开写，重复过程概述写
heading.en: Dramatize important choices; summarize repeated process

body.zh:
展示让读者经历人物发现、犹豫和决定；概述压缩已经能推断的过程。冲突转折、关系变化和有分量的发现通常值得写成场景；赶路、例行工作与重复练习可以一句带过。篇幅有限时，先把字数留给读者需要亲自感受的时刻。

“她听烦了”可以直接写。为避开情绪词而追加攥拳、抿唇、移开目光，常会重复已经成立的信息。

例行劳动和赶路也可能正是这部作品的看点。人物关系、地方气氛或读者想体验的生活细节值得停留时，可以展开；只有上下文已经满足需要、重复过程无新增体验时才压缩，不按“日常”类别一律略写。
body.en:
Showing lets readers experience discovery, hesitation, and decision. Telling compresses what they can already infer. Dramatize turning points and meaningful relationship changes; summarize routine travel or practice. “She was tired of hearing it” may be clearer than adding a fist, a lip movement, and an averted gaze that all repeat the same emotion.

Routine work and travel can themselves be the attraction. Expand when relationships, atmosphere, or the life readers want to experience warrant attention. Compress when context already supplies what is needed and repetition adds no experience; the routine category alone does not require summary.

heading.zh: 逐段决定要展开还是压缩
heading.en: Decide paragraph by paragraph

body.zh:
| 项目 | 记录 |
|---|---|
| 首次发现对方说谎 | 合适做法: 展开证物、问答与反应; 检查问题: 读者能否自己发现矛盾 |
| 第五天继续查同一类资料 | 合适做法: 概述结果; 检查问题: 有没有新信息需要展开 |
| 角色决定结束合作 | 合适做法: 写决定与实际行动; 检查问题: 删掉情绪解释还看得懂吗 |
| 过场交代疲劳 | 合适做法: 可以直写; 检查问题: 细节是否增加感受、人物理解或下一步信息 |

先标每段在完成什么，再选择写法。展示与概述不是好坏等级。
body.en:
| Item | Record |
|---|---|
| Discover a lie | Approach: Show the object, questions, and response; Check: Can readers notice the mismatch? |
| Continue routine research | Approach: Summarize the result; Check: Is any new discovery worth a scene? |
| End a partnership | Approach: Show the decision and action; Check: Does it work without emotion labels? |
| Establish fatigue between scenes | Approach: Tell briefly; Check: Does detail add feeling, character understanding, or useful information? |

Choose by function, not by treating showing as automatically superior.

heading.zh: 原创改写：把解释换成一项真正改变局面的行动
heading.en: Original rewrite: replace explanation with a consequential action

body.zh:
以下是本文原创对照。两版共用前提：桌上是尚未签署的合作草稿，林冬不接受共同署名；合伙人已口头替他答应，但是否形成外部安排尚未在本段交代。这里比较表达方式，不是在真实书稿中自动补设定。

改写前：

> 林冬非常愤怒。他觉得合伙人背叛了自己，双手握紧，心中充满失望。

改写后：

> 林冬把“共同签字”那一栏划掉，推回合同。“你既然已经替我答应，就用你的名字签。”

动作明确了林冬拒绝共同署名，读者也知道他在追究什么。草稿上划线不自动改变已成立的协议，也不证明合伙人已经撤回对外承诺。若下一场需要合作真正结束，再写对方实际回应和作品已设的办理结果。如果上一段已经充分呈现背叛，后面无需补一句“他终于决定维护尊严”。

压缩时间则可以写：“接下来三天，他按旧收据找回了四位顾客。第五位始终不肯开门。”只有第五位的新阻力需要展开。
body.en:
This is an original comparison. Both versions share a premise: the document is an unsigned partnership draft, and Lin Dong refuses joint signing. His partner has spoken for him, but this passage does not establish any completed outside arrangement. The comparison changes expression rather than silently adding facts to a real manuscript.

Before:

> Lin Dong was furious. He felt betrayed, clenched his hands, and filled with disappointment.

After:

> Lin Dong crossed out “joint signatures” and slid the contract back. “You already agreed for me. Sign your own name.”

The action makes Lin’s refusal to sign jointly clear and identifies the grievance. Crossing out an unsigned draft does not change an established agreement or prove that the partner withdrew an outside promise. If the next scene needs the partnership to have ended, establish the other person’s reply and the process defined by the story. No concluding lesson is needed. To compress time: “Over three days he traced four customers through the receipts. The fifth would not open the door.” Expand that new obstacle.

heading.zh: 完整展开例子：划掉草稿之后，对方怎样回应
heading.en: Complete Expanded Example: What Follows Crossing Out the Draft

body.zh:
沿用林冬不接受共同署名的原例。为写后续，本扩展示例明确选择：合伙人叫赵岭，对外提交的是待确认的联合参展提案，主办方尚在等两人回复。这是新的原创教学安排；真实书稿若已有不同结果，不能由润色自动改成这个版本。

> 林冬把“共同签字”那一栏划掉，推回合同。“你既然已经替我答应，就用你的名字签。”
>
> “我只报了意向。”赵岭打开手机，把主办方的消息给他看：两位确认后，我们再排联合展位。
>
> “那现在还来得及撤。”
>
> “一起参展，比我一个人交强。”赵岭说，“我以为你也想要那个位置。”
>
> 林冬听烦了。“想参展，和让你替我答应是两回事。你先撤联合提案。我的作品，我自己报。”
>
> 赵岭收回手机，写下撤回联合提案的消息，给他看了一遍，才发出去。桌上的草稿还留着那道划痕。
>
> 主办方回复：收到，联合提案撤下。个人参展请分别提交。
>
> 林冬读完，把自己的作品目录从两人合用的文件夹里取出。“这份我带走。你准备你的。”

关键拒绝与交锋展开，让读者看见原来的代办怎样被叫停。主办方实际回复才确认本例的提案撤下；手机上写好了但没发，不足以完成。个人参展仍未提交或获选，两人的全部合作与关系也没因此自动结束。

“林冬听烦了”承担准确的当下感受，可以留，不需要夹进四个微动作。若接下来只交代两人各自整理目录，概述即可；下一次出现实质分歧或参展回应时再展开。
body.en:
Continue Lin’s refusal to sign jointly. This original extension explicitly chooses a partner named Zhao Ling and a joint exhibition proposal awaiting confirmation. The organizer still needs both replies. These are new teaching choices, not facts that polishing may impose on a manuscript with a different outcome.

> Lin Dong crossed out “joint signatures” and slid the draft back. “You already agreed for me. Sign your own name.”
>
> “I only submitted an expression of interest.” Zhao opened his phone and showed the organizer’s message: Once both of you confirm, we’ll allocate the joint space.
>
> “Then there’s time to withdraw it.”
>
> “A joint show is stronger than mine alone,” Zhao said. “I thought you wanted that space too.”
>
> Lin was tired of hearing it. “Wanting to exhibit and letting you agree for me are different things. Withdraw the joint proposal. I’ll submit my own work.”
>
> Zhao took back his phone, wrote the withdrawal, showed it to Lin, and sent it. The marked draft remained on the table.
>
> The organizer replied: Received. Joint proposal withdrawn. Please submit individual entries separately.
>
> Lin read it and removed his work list from their shared folder. “I’m taking this. Prepare yours.”

Expand the refusal and response so readers witness the change. The organizer’s actual reply confirms this proposal’s withdrawal; an unsent message would not. Individual entries remain unsubmitted and unselected. Neither all their cooperation nor the relationship automatically ends.

“Lin was tired of hearing it” precisely carries the feeling without four additional gestures. If the next passage merely covers separate list preparation, summarize it. Expand again when a substantive disagreement or exhibition response needs attention.

heading.zh: 把概述改成场景时别新增事实
heading.en: Do not invent facts while expanding a summary

body.zh:
给 AI 的输入应包含已确认的人物、地点、动作结果、视角与可揭示信息。要求它先指出哪个关键时刻值得展开，再写这一段；不要让它为了“更有画面”新增证人、伤势或秘密。改完对照原稿，核实事实相同，再判断段落是否更清楚。

数字也可以帮助展示代价：“欠了很多钱”可改成“这笔欠款够付店铺半年的房租”，但比较基准应来自故事，而非临时编一个夸张金额。
body.en: Give AI the confirmed characters, location, outcome, viewpoint, and available information. Ask it to identify the moment worth expanding before drafting. A more visual passage should not invent witnesses, injuries, or secrets. Compare facts first, then readability. Numbers can show stakes: a debt equal to six months’ rent means more than “a large debt,” provided that baseline belongs to the story.

heading.zh: 反例：不是每句都要改成展示
heading.en: Counterexample: showing can add repetition

body.zh:
假设林冬上一段已经拒绝合同，对方却继续解释同一理由。原句“他听烦了，打断对方，问谁负责撤回安排”可以保留。若改成攥拳、皱眉、深呼吸、压下愤怒，再问同一句，未必增加理解，只会推迟新行动。

| 项目 | 记录 |
|---|---|
| 直接写听烦并追问 | 留下什么: 低强度感受与新要求; 判断: 准确且不重复，可以保留 |
| 补一串身体表情 | 留下什么: 仍是相同追问; 判断: 没有新信息，不因“展示”而保留 |
| 追问使责任人改变计划 | 留下什么: 新选择与实际结果; 判断: 值得展开对方如何接收、回应 |

这就是 Oh Story 情绪方法中的选择：上下文足够就不补，直写准确就直写，需要感受变化才展开。气氛细节也可以有价值，但要改变读者理解或当下体验，不必每处都强行引发一个新事件。
body.en:
Suppose Lin has already rejected the contract and the other person repeats the explanation. “He was tired of hearing it. He interrupted and asked who would withdraw the arrangement” can stay. Fists, frowns, deep breaths and suppressed anger before the same question may only delay it.

| Item | Record |
|---|---|
| Direct irritation and question | What remains: Modest feeling plus a new demand; Judgment: Accurate and not redundant |
| A chain of bodily signals | What remains: The same question; Judgment: No added information merely from showing |
| Question changes the responsible person’s plan | What remains: A new choice and result; Judgment: Expand reception and response |

Oh Story allows omission when context suffices and direct emotion when precise. Atmospheric detail may change understanding or experience without forcing a new plot event every time.

q.en: Is showing always better than telling?
q.zh: 展示一定比概述好吗？

a.en: No. Showing uses more page time and can make a story feel slow when applied to routine events. Choose the form that gives the reader the right information at the right pace; a chapter often needs both.
a.zh: 不是。展示占用更多篇幅，用在例行事件上会拖慢节奏。根据读者需要的信息和节奏选择写法，一章通常两者都需要。

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 标出本段的关键选择、普通过场和已成立情绪，分别建议展开、概述或保留直写。先说明新增内容带来的信息，再改指定段；不把情绪词机械换成微动作，不新增事实。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to mark consequential choices, transitions and established emotion. Recommend scene, summary or direct statement with the information each adds. Revise only the chosen passage without mechanical body-language substitutions or new facts.

label.zh: 展示、概述与环境交互
直接情绪与可选反应
本书文风与不可静默改变的事实

title.en: How to Plan a Novel Series Without Losing Momentum
title.zh: 长篇系列怎么规划：每一卷有回报，也有新问题

seo_title.en: Plan a Novel Series
seo_title.zh: 小说系列怎么规划

description.en: Give each book a complete emotional payoff, a larger unresolved question, and a changing protagonist goal that earns the next installment.
description.zh: 让每卷完成一条情感线，再留下升级的问题与主角的新目标。

answer.zh: 先写全系列最终要回应的问题，再给当前卷一个能完成的目标、关键选择与结果。每卷的能力、关系、信息或责任留下变化，并成为下一卷阻力或机会的来源。第一卷不能只铺垫，换地图也不能无代价清空旧人物与旧成果；计划调整先核已写事实与读者期待。
answer.en: Define the series-level question and a completable goal, choice and outcome for the current volume. Let changes in ability, relationships, knowledge or responsibility create later resistance and opportunities. Do not make volume one only setup or erase earlier consequences when changing location.

heading.zh: 全系列方向与本卷回报都要成立
heading.en: Make series direction and current-volume payoff work

body.zh:
Oh Story 的分卷方法同时记全书阶段与每卷起始、结束状态；卷纲还记录当前承诺、可释放的信息与需要保留的后续内容。本页用于长篇的分卷或连续故事规划，不把参考比例当固定篇幅公式。

沿用原创修钟师许遥的系列计划：全系列讨论责任与信任，最终目标是让危险信息能被共同维护。下文三卷是待展开的虚构规划，不是已写正文或一次真实应急行动；资格、设备与撤离规则均属于本例。第一卷仍有独立任务——修好镇上的报警钟并取得检修资格，不能等第三卷才第一次让读者得到结果。

每卷提两问：这次读者等什么兑现？结果怎样改变下一卷的起点？只加新地图、新反派却不读取旧后果，系列会像反复重开。
body.en:
Oh Story tracks whole-story stages and each volume’s start/end states, current promise, releasable information and reserved developments. Apply this to volumes or continuing stories without treating reference proportions as fixed lengths.

The original series plan follows clock repairer Xu Yao through responsibility and trust toward shared maintenance of danger information. The three volumes below are fictional proposals awaiting prose, not completed chapters or a real emergency operation; their qualification, equipment, and evacuation rules belong to the example. Volume one still repairs the town alarm and earns a license; readers should not wait until volume three for the first payoff.

Ask what this volume delivers and how its result changes the next starting point. New locations and opponents without inherited consequences make a series feel repeatedly reset.

heading.zh: 每卷写目标、选择、结果与继承
heading.en: Map goal, choice, result and inheritance

body.zh:
| 卷 | 计划记录 |
|---|---|
| 一 | 目标与选择：修复报警钟机械部分；失误后主动请助手复核。拟写的实际结果：助手复核，站长按本例已设标准验收并发检修资格；机械故障修好。继承：承担夜间报警钟维护，另有来自独立水闸输入端的误报待查；不把新误报写成旧维修无效。 |
| 二 | 目标与选择：比对输入端测试和旧水闸记录，决定是否公开。拟写的实际结果：记录及本次测试确认输入问题；姐姐承认曾替前任站长隐瞒相关记录，许遥公开后，居民实际向现任站长要求说明危险范围。继承：汛期将至，输入维修来不及在本例窗口前完成；公开不自动等于已经得到撤离协作。 |
| 三 | 目标与选择：把已确认的问题和仍未知的范围同时交给站长，承担公开给关系带来的后果。拟写的实际结果：站长核对材料，按本例已有预案发通知并组织路线；居民回应后，许遥与助手完成分配给他们的通知和到达核对，住户实际到达约定安全地点。继承：姐姐暂不支持她，两名助手同意共管检修记录并实际接收副本，回应全系列问题。 |

表格是本例总体计划，不是原生卷纲或每卷同长的要求。验收、回应、执行需要在以后正文中成立；目前不能把计划表当已完成记录。许遥的贡献是复核、调查、公开与完成所领任务，制度决定和居民选择分别由相关人作出。

本卷失败也能推进，但需有具体结果和下一步。不能把所有失败都当“尚未真正开始”，无限延期已经建立的期待。

### 第一卷怎样真正收束：一段正文候选与写后记录

三卷表仍是未来计划。下面只把第一卷末的复核、验收和领取维护任务演成候选，不把第三卷的撤离结果提前写成当前事实。沿用失误后主动请助手复核、机械维修有效、独立输入待查这些条件，具体检验标准仍用本例事先设定的表，不编现实报警设备流程。

> 许遥把补修记录交给助手，指向先前漏检的那项：“这次别只听我说好了。按表再核一遍。”
>
> 助手把记录和机械部分逐项对过，完成本例规定的检验，在复核栏写下结果，才把表交给站长。
>
> 站长照已有标准核验，确认机械故障已修好。他在检修资格册上登记许遥的名字，将当夜维护单递给她。
>
> “夜里这座钟归你维护。输入端还有待查误报，另按记录核。”
>
> 许遥接住单子：“机械这部分验收了。输入为什么送错，还没查清。”
>
> “分开记。”站长说。
>
> 她在维护单上确认领取，助手把这次复核记录留在检修册里。许遥将来自独立水闸输入端的那份异常记录放到待查的一边，没有划掉已经通过的机械验收。

如果作者采用这段，写后可用下表核当前状态；在正文采用前，它仍是候选，不是现有书稿已经完成的事实。

| 项目 | 这段候选实际完成与仍待做 |
|---|---|
| 机械维修 | 助手复核、站长验收完成，已修好；不被独立输入误报自动撤销。 |
| 资格与责任 | 资格已登记，许遥已领维护单；当夜值守尚未在这一段发生。 |
| 输入端 | 异常记录已收到，原因待查；第二卷的测试与旧记录比对尚未做。 |
| 系列后续 | 姐姐的承认、居民回应、撤离与共同维护仍按后卷计划展开。 |

本卷兑现的是可靠维修和新增资格，下一卷继承夜间责任与独立输入问题。不是让同一机械裂口无原因重坏，也不把全系列的结算都塞在一个段落。卷末可以安静，只要本轮结果清楚并给出下一步实际起点。
body.en:
| Volume | Planned record |
|---|---|
| One | Goal and choice: repair the alarm clock’s mechanism and ask an assistant to verify after a mistake. Proposed enacted result: the assistant verifies; the supervisor accepts the work under the example’s established standard and issues maintenance qualification. Inheritance: night maintenance duty, with unexplained alerts from a separate sluice input; those alerts do not undo the mechanism repair. |
| Two | Goal and choice: compare input tests with old sluice records and decide whether to disclose them. Proposed enacted result: the records and current test establish the input problem; the sister acknowledges hiding relevant records for the previous supervisor. After Xu discloses them, residents actually ask the current supervisor to explain the risk area. Inheritance: flood season approaches, and input repair cannot finish before this story’s window. Publication does not establish evacuation cooperation. |
| Three | Goal and choice: give the supervisor both the confirmed problem and the unresolved risk boundary, accepting the relationship consequences of disclosure. Proposed enacted result: the supervisor checks the material, issues notices, and organizes routes under the example’s existing plan. After residents respond, Xu and the assistants perform their assigned notification and arrival checks; residents reach the agreed safe destination. Inheritance: the sister withholds support; two assistants agree to share record maintenance and receive copies, answering the series question. |

This is an overall editorial plan, not a native volume outline or an equal-length formula. Verification, replies, and execution still need to be established in future prose; this table is not a completed event record. Xu contributes verification, inquiry, disclosure, and assigned work. Institutional decisions and residents’ choices remain with the respective actors.

Failure can advance the story through a concrete result and next action. It cannot indefinitely postpone every established expectation by claiming the real story has not begun.

### Close volume one: a prose candidate and current-state record

The three-volume matrix remains a future plan. Dramatize only verification, acceptance and receipt of duties at volume one's end, without importing volume three's evacuation into current facts. Keep the request for verification after a mistake, an effective mechanism repair and a separate input problem. Use this fiction's established check sheet rather than inventing real alarm procedures.

> Xu gave the repair record to the assistant and indicated the previously missed item. “Don't just take my word that it's done. Check it against the sheet again.”
>
> The assistant compared record and mechanism item by item, completed this story's required check and entered its result before submitting the sheet to the supervisor.
>
> The supervisor verified it against the existing standard and accepted the mechanism repair. He entered Xu's name in the maintenance-qualification register and handed over tonight's duty sheet.
>
> “You maintain this clock tonight. The input still has unexplained false alerts; investigate those separately.”
>
> Xu took the sheet. “The mechanism is accepted. Why the input sends the wrong signal remains unresolved.”
>
> “Record them separately.”
>
> She acknowledged receiving the duty. The assistant left this verification in the maintenance record. Xu placed the separate sluice-input anomaly record among pending inquiries without striking out the accepted mechanism repair.

If the author adopts this passage, use this manual record afterward. Before adoption it remains a candidate, not an accomplished fact in an existing manuscript.

| Item | Completed and pending |
|---|---|
| Mechanism | Assistant verification and supervisor acceptance complete; repair stands despite a separate input alert. |
| Qualification | Registered; Xu receives her duty sheet. Tonight's maintenance has not occurred in this passage. |
| Input | Anomaly record received; cause unknown. Volume two's tests and comparison with old records remain undone. |
| Later series | The sister's admission, resident responses, evacuation and shared maintenance still await later volumes. |

This volume delivers a reliable repair and qualification. The next inherits night duties and the separate input problem rather than an unexplained recurrence of the same crack. Do not compress the whole series payoff into this paragraph. A quiet ending works when the result and actual next starting point are clear.

heading.zh: 暂不回答的事，也要有推进
heading.en: Advance questions that remain open

body.zh:
| 事项 | 记录 |
|---|---|
| 报警误报 | 读者目前知道: 机械维修已验收，独立输入仍可能触发误报; 本卷应给进展: 比对本次测试和旧记录，分清机械与输入; 预定回应: 第二卷确认输入问题及隐瞒记录 |
| 姐姐为何隐瞒 | 读者目前知道: 已见她保护旧记录，动机尚未写明; 本卷应给进展: 通过她的实际回应补原因，不由保护记录推定全部动机; 预定回应: 第二卷回应；第三卷保留关系后果 |
| 共同维护记录 | 读者目前知道: 助手已参与复核; 本卷应给进展: 后续真的读取与修正记录; 预定回应: 最终卷形成稳定做法 |

只跟踪读者有理由期待的事项，不把所有物件都变成秘密。延期时补取证、关系变化或阶段结果，不能只用更大的谜团替换旧问题。

本卷核心任务要收束；已完成的修钟不能在下一卷无原因失效。新的故障可以存在，但应有新来源，并保留人物此前学到的办法与关系。
body.en:
| Item | Record |
|---|---|
| False alarms | Current knowledge: Mechanism repair is accepted; a separate input may still trigger false alerts; Needed progress: Compare current tests and old records, separating mechanism from input; Planned response: Volume two establishes the input problem and concealed records |
| Sister’s concealment | Current knowledge: She protects old records; her motive remains unwritten; Needed progress: Establish reasons through her reply, without deriving a full motive from custody; Planned response: A reply in volume two; relationship consequences in three |
| Shared records | Current knowledge: Assistants help verify; Needed progress: They actually use and correct records; Planned response: Stable final practice |

Track justified expectations, not every object as a secret. Delay with evidence, relationship change or partial outcome rather than substituting a larger mystery.

Resolve the volume’s central task. The repaired clock must not fail without a cause merely to restart the old plot. New faults should preserve previous learning and relationships.

heading.zh: 改未来计划，先核已经兑现的事实
heading.en: Check delivered facts before changing future plans

body.zh:
中途缩减卷数或增加新阶段，先列已写状态、已给回报和未回应事项，再调整未来节点。角色退出、地图更换与能力变化都要说明怎样继承旧责任，不能回头撤销已经支付的代价。

给 AI 的输入包括本卷结果、人物当前目标与关系、物件去向、未回收期待。让它提出下一卷行动，并逐项说明从何继承；作者选定后再展开卷纲与细纲，不一口气重写全系列。

最后检查当前卷的开局与结尾能否独立理解，系列主问题是否仍在发展。若新阶段只是重复“又被看不起—再证明一次”，保留带来新资格、责任、关系或体验的变化；已经形成的日常与相处也可有价值，重复是否删看实际作用，不要求每卷再晋升一次。
body.en:
When reducing volumes or adding a stage, list established states, delivered payoffs and open expectations before changing future nodes. Exits, locations and abilities must inherit responsibility without canceling paid costs.

Give AI current outcomes, aims, relationships, object custody and open promises. Ask for proposed next-volume actions with their inherited causes. Select a direction before expanding volume and chapter plans rather than rewriting the entire series.

Check the current opening and ending for coherence and the series question for development. Retain developments in responsibility, qualification, relationships, or experience that follow earlier results. Established daily life and companionship can also have value; judge repetition by its function without requiring another promotion in every volume.

q.en: How much should I outline before publishing the first book?
q.zh: 第一卷发布前需要规划多少？

a.en: Plan the first book’s complete arc and the next installment’s likely pressure point. Record the series-level question and a few possible outcomes, but keep room to revise based on the story and reader response. Do not promise a specific number of books unless you can deliver the middle and ending.
a.zh: 先规划第一卷完整弧线和下一卷可能遇到的压力点，记录系列核心问题及几种可能结果，同时给创作和读者反馈留出调整空间。除非中段和结尾都有把握，否则不要先承诺固定卷数。

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 规划后续分卷，先读取本卷已写结果、人物状态与待回应事项。每卷列目标、关键选择、回报和继承关系；改未来计划前核旧事实，不按固定卷数与比例扩写。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to plan later volumes from established outcomes, character states and open expectations. Map goals, choices, payoff and inheritance; check existing facts before revising future plans without fixed volume counts or proportions.

label.zh: 分卷节点与收尾
卷承诺、状态与阶段边界
label.en: Volume promises, states and stage boundaries

label.zh: 把节点与状态变化演成场景
label.en: Dramatize beats and changes of state

label.zh: 本例选择、文风与事实边界

title.en: How to Write a Novel Synopsis That Shows the Whole Story
title.zh: 小说投稿梗概怎么写：讲清主线、转折和结局

seo_title.en: Write a Novel Synopsis
seo_title.zh: 小说投稿梗概怎么写

description.en: Summarize the protagonist’s goal, major turns, causal links, and ending in plain language; a synopsis is not a blurb.
description.zh: 用直白文字写清主角目标、主要转折、因果关系和结局；梗概不同于简介。

answer.zh: 梗概把主角目标、阻碍、关键选择、转折与结果串成可理解的主线。先梳理起点、终点和改变方向的节点，再删支线与装饰，最后压句子。用于让编辑了解全书的梗概通常交代结局；具体长度、格式和材料范围按当前投稿入口要求准备，别把读者简介原样交上去。
answer.en: A synopsis connects the protagonist’s goal, resistance, choices, turns and outcome. Establish start, end and direction-changing nodes before removing subplots and compressing sentences. A full-story synopsis generally reveals the outcome; follow the actual submission’s length, format and scope requirements.

heading.zh: 先区分故事梗概与读者简介
heading.en: Distinguish a synopsis from reader-facing copy

body.zh:
Oh Story 的定位简报用主角、目标、阻碍与反转整理核心设定，大纲节点法再连接起点、终点和关键变化。本页将这些方法用于梗概提炼；它们帮助讲清故事，不能替代具体投稿入口的要求。

读者简介突出看点并留期待；编辑需要的全书梗概通常让人看清最后怎样收束。因此“她能否揭开真相？”可以在简介中有用，却不能代替要求交代完整主线的梗概结尾。

先记本次材料范围：已完成正文、当前大纲，还是二者组合。尚未写出的计划标明为计划，不把设想的高潮写成稿件已经实现的结果。
body.en:
Oh Story’s positioning brief organizes protagonist, goal, obstacle and turn; outline methods connect starting state, ending state and key changes. This page applies those methods to synopsis extraction, while the actual submission controls requirements.

Reader-facing copy emphasizes attraction and expectation. A full-story synopsis generally explains resolution. “Can she uncover the truth?” may sell the book but cannot replace the outcome in a requested complete synopsis.

Identify the material: finished manuscript, current outline or both. Mark unwritten developments as planned instead of presenting an imagined climax as completed prose.

heading.zh: 从事件清单提炼改变方向的节点
heading.en: Extract direction-changing nodes from an event list

body.zh:
| 部分 | 记录 |
|---|---|
| 开局 | 要讲清的变化: 主角处境、目标与触发; 删掉什么不会伤主线: 无关家谱和完整世界史 |
| 尝试 | 要讲清的变化: 采取哪种办法，为何受阻; 删掉什么不会伤主线: 重复同一困难的过程 |
| 转折 | 要讲清的变化: 哪项新事实令旧计划失效; 删掉什么不会伤主线: 只说“事情反转了”的空话 |
| 高潮 | 要讲清的变化: 主角最后选择、行动与代价; 删掉什么不会伤主线: 与胜负无关的场景装饰 |
| 收束 | 要讲清的变化: 主线结果与人物的新做法; 删掉什么不会伤主线: 另起悬念代替结果 |

这不是固定五段配额，而是检查是否漏了因果。把“修钟、找记录、争吵、洪水”逐项串起来，还需说明为什么查记录、争吵怎样改变行动、洪水为何使原办法来不及。
body.en:
| Part | Record |
|---|---|
| Opening | Explain: Situation, goal and trigger; Remove without harming the spine: Unrelated genealogy or world history |
| Attempt | Explain: Strategy and resistance; Remove without harming the spine: Repeated versions of one obstacle |
| Turn | Explain: New fact invalidating the plan; Remove without harming the spine: Abstract “everything changes” |
| Climax | Explain: Final choice, action and cost; Remove without harming the spine: Decorative detail unrelated to outcome |
| Resolution | Explain: Main result and changed behavior; Remove without harming the spine: A new mystery replacing resolution |

These are coverage functions, not a five-paragraph quota. “Repair clock, find records, argue, flood” still needs reasons for inquiry, consequences of the argument and a deadline defeating the old strategy.

heading.zh: 原创范例：保留选择与可执行结果
heading.en: Original synopsis: retain choices and achievable results

body.zh:
下面是本文原创的虚构规划梗概，不是对已写小说执行提取后的结果。本例已设：许遥负责报警钟检修；机械维修已验收，另一个水闸输入端仍有问题；现任站长有本例撤离预案的组织职责。

> 修钟师许遥为查清误报，比对输入测试和旧水闸记录；姐姐承认曾替前任站长隐瞒相关记录。许遥原想先补修再解释，却发现输入维修赶不上汛期窗口。她把记录和未确定的危险范围一起公开，失去姐姐的支持；现任站长核对材料后启动已有预案，居民实际回应。许遥与两名助手完成分配到的通知和到达核对，住户到达约定安全地点。之后，两名助手接受检修记录副本，开始共同维护。

梗概保留目标、依据、旧办法失效、关键选择、组织者回应和实际结果。公开材料与住户安全之间还有核对、组织、居民回应和执行，不能用“获得帮助”替一部原稿补出不存在的解决条件。本例的资格验收、预案与回应均为明确选择的新设计；从真实正文提炼时，只能写材料支持的内容，没写出来的仍标计划。

姓名只保留辨认主要行动者所需。姐姐和前任站长按关系称呼足以理解时，不必引入更多名字与职务，免得短稿成为人名表。
body.en:
This is an original fictional planning synopsis, not an extraction from completed prose. The example establishes that Xu Yao maintains the alarm clock, its mechanism repair has been accepted, a separate sluice input remains faulty, and the current supervisor organizes the example’s existing evacuation plan.

> To trace false alerts, clock repairer Xu Yao compares input tests with old sluice records. Her sister acknowledges concealing relevant records for the former supervisor. Xu first hopes to repair the input before explaining, but the repair cannot finish before the flood-season window. She discloses the records alongside the unresolved risk boundary, losing her sister’s support. The current supervisor checks the material and activates the existing plan; residents respond. Xu and two assistants complete assigned notifications and arrival checks, and residents reach the agreed safe destination. Afterward, the assistants receive maintenance-record copies and begin shared upkeep.

The synopsis retains aim, evidence, the failed strategy, the key choice, an organizer’s response, and the enacted result. Disclosure and residents’ safety are connected through verification, organization, replies, and execution. “Secures help” cannot supply a condition missing from the manuscript. Acceptance, the plan, and replies are explicit new design choices in this example; extraction from actual prose uses only supported facts and marks unwritten events as plans.

Keep names necessary for principal action. Relationship labels can identify the sister and former supervisor without turning a short document into a cast list.

heading.zh: 先删支线，再压句子，最后对原稿
heading.en: Cut secondary material before sentence compression

body.zh:
先圈与主线结果没有因果联系的角色介绍、支线过程与重复挫折，再压说明性句子。保留每次换策略的原因，不能把一条完整行动链压成“历经困难后成长”。

每句梗概对到正文或当前大纲依据，检查人物是否亲自作出关键选择、解决条件是否已建立、结局是否与稿件一致。AI 可以标缺口与冗余，不能为凑完整暗中补新行动。

按目标入口核格式与长度后，再从未读原稿者的角度读一遍：谁在争什么、为何变难、怎么解决、代价是什么？答不出哪项，就回补那条因果，而不是加更多背景。
body.en:
Remove introductions, secondary processes and repeated setbacks without causal importance, then compress sentences. Preserve reasons for strategy changes instead of “grows through difficulties.”

Map each sentence to manuscript or outline evidence. Check who makes decisive choices, whether enabling conditions exist and whether the ending matches. AI can flag omissions and redundancy, not secretly invent actions for completeness.

Check the actual destination’s format and length, then read as someone unfamiliar with the manuscript: who seeks what, why does it become harder, how is it resolved and at what cost? Repair missing causality rather than adding background.

q.en: Should I reveal the ending in a submission synopsis?
q.zh: 投稿梗概要透露结局吗？

a.zh: 若当前入口要完整故事梗概，通常应交代解决方式和后果，不用“能否成功”代替结局。若入口明确要求部分章节、阶段梗概或另一种介绍，就按它的材料范围准备。先核实际要求，未写内容标计划；本文的方法不裁定投稿资格。
a.en: A requested full-story synopsis generally includes resolution and consequences rather than ending with a teaser. If the actual destination requests selected chapters, an interim synopsis, or a different introduction, follow that scope. Check its requirements first and label unwritten material as planned; this craft method does not determine submission eligibility.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 依据我提供的正文与大纲整理主线梗概，先列起点、终点和改变策略的节点，再压缩。每句注明依据；未写出的情节标计划，不补新解决条件。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to extract a synopsis from the provided manuscript and outline: identify start, end and strategy-changing nodes before compression. Cite sentence evidence and mark unwritten events as plans without inventing enabling conditions.

label.zh: 主角、目标与阻碍简报
起点、终点与关键节点

title.en: How to Write a Slow-Burn Romance That Keeps Moving
title.zh: 慢热恋爱怎么写不拖：让每次靠近都改变关系

seo_title.en: Write a Slow-Burn Romance
seo_title.zh: 慢热恋爱怎么写

description.en: Build attraction through repeated acts of trust, change the relationship at each milestone, and keep the external story moving.
description.zh: 用持续的信任行动建立吸引力，让每次关系节点带来变化，同时推进主线。

answer.zh: 慢热恋爱可以推迟确定关系，但一段关系的主要转向要累积信任、了解或新的分歧。区分外在关系身份与双方真实意愿，让行为跟得上较犹豫的一方；不靠重置已知事实拖延。普通相处可以停留在已经建立的亲近里，不必每次见面都升级。
answer.en: Slow-burn romance can delay commitment while major turns accumulate trust, understanding or meaningful differences. Separate public relationship status from both people’s actual willingness. Respect the more hesitant person and avoid resetting established facts. Ordinary companionship need not escalate at every meeting.

heading.zh: 慢热的关键是进展细小但持续
heading.en: Slow burn needs small, continuing changes

body.zh:
慢热不等于反复误会、原地犹豫。主要关系场景可以改变愿意透露的事、肯承担的责任、相处边界或对对方的判断；日常相处也可以让已有亲近被感受到，不要求每次遇见完成一个升级。

阻力来自真实目标、经历或新压力。临时忘记已经建立的信任，只能推迟告白，不能增加感情分量。先区分人物想不想靠近、准备接受哪种行为，与外界给两人的关系名称。
body.en:
Slow burn is not repeated misunderstanding. Major relationship scenes can change disclosure, responsibility, boundaries or judgment. Ordinary time together can let established closeness register without an upgrade at each meeting.

Obstacles come from goals, experience or new pressure. Forgetting established trust merely delays confession. Distinguish willingness and accepted behavior from the label others give the relationship.

heading.zh: 用四次关系变化安排一条慢热线
heading.en: Plan four relationship changes

body.zh:
| 时点 | 记录 |
|---|---|
| 初识 | 可见行动: 两人能完成一次合作; 留下的阻力: 仍不愿解释私人需求 |
| 信任 | 可见行动: 主角把关键工具交给对方; 留下的阻力: 对方可能因工作离开 |
| 亲近 | 可见行动: 一方主动承认自己的失误; 留下的阻力: 公开关系会影响共同项目 |
| 选择 | 可见行动: 双方说清意愿，决定是否继续靠近; 留下的阻力: 独立目标仍在；有已设冲突时回应，不强加牺牲 |

阶段是规划工具，不要求每对人物按固定章数完成。
body.en:
| Moment | Record |
|---|---|
| Meeting | Action: Complete a job together; Obstacle: Private needs remain hidden |
| Trust | Action: Lend an essential tool; Obstacle: One may leave for another job |
| Intimacy | Action: Admit a personal mistake; Obstacle: Public commitment affects the shared project |
| Choice | Action: Each states willingness and decides whether to grow closer; Obstacle: Keep independent goals; address established conflict without imposing sacrifice |

These are planning markers, not a fixed chapter formula.

heading.zh: 原创场景：亲近体现在多给一次选择
heading.en: Original scene: intimacy through an offered choice

body.zh:
下面是原创虚构场景。气象站技术员乔岚以往替搭档拟好夜班，认为这叫照顾；站长确认后才是正式排班。搭档此前拒绝她的提案，因为要留时间照顾母亲。这次她递过空白处还未填完的草案：“周四还空着，你先选。”

搭档看了表：“周四我得陪母亲，周五可以。你周五有安排吗？”乔岚说周五晚要去办调动手续。两人把周六写成共同提交给站长的候选，不把它当已批准班次。

这次小进展不只是她递了表：她记得对方的需求并交还选择，对方也实际愿意一起讨论。讨论排班不表示愿意恋爱，也不保证站长接受。乔岚已说要办调动手续，搭档知道这件事；剩下未说的是调离日期和是否愿意保持联系。下一场不再让他全然不知道调动，而可以让她说明日期，再看他怎样回应。无需立刻加拥抱或表白。

### 正文候选：多给选择，双方也把自己的安排说出来

保留乔岚、照顾母亲的搭档与周四/周五/周六的草案讨论。下面把原来的小进展演成一场交流，采用乔岚限知；承认上次填得太快、把候选留在草案夹，是本例的新增表达选择，未增加已批准夜班或恋爱承诺。

> 乔岚把排班草案放到两人中间。周四那格还空着，她没有先写他的名字。
>
> “周四还空着，你先选。”
>
> 搭档拿起表，先看日期：“周四我得陪母亲。上次跟你说过。”
>
> “记得。”她把笔搁在表旁，“上次我填得太快，没留你挑。”
>
> 他把表放平：“周五可以。你周五有安排吗？”
>
> 乔岚本想先把他的时间填完，到这句才停住。“周五晚去办调动手续。”
>
> 他看向周六：“那周六呢？一起报这个时间？”
>
> “可以，先写候选。站长确认了再算。”她说。
>
> 他把周六指给她看，乔岚才在两人的候选栏写下这一晚。笔尖经过周四时没有补上他的名字。
>
> “就交这版？”他问。
>
> “交这版让站长看。”她把表放回草案夹，调动的事已经说出口，调离哪天却还没有谈。

她没有替他决定，他也主动询问她的安排，实际回应使这次照料不再只是单方面拟好表。此刻双方共同选了待提交的周六，正式排班、周五手续、当晚值班都没有执行。

要继续感情线，可以让下一场谈日期或联系意愿，也可以先写普通共同生活；不能回头把他写成完全不知道调动，更不能从这次合作推出他愿意等待或接受亲密。具体节奏依本书文风，顺利交流也能有分量，不必每次加一场误会。
body.en:
This is an original fictional scene. Weather-station technician Qiao Lan used to propose her partner’s night shifts, considering it care; only the supervisor’s confirmation made a roster official. He previously refused her proposal because he needed time to care for his mother. This time she passes him the unfinished draft: “Thursday is still open. Choose first.”

He reads it. “I’m with my mother Thursday. Friday works. Do you have plans then?” Qiao says she has transfer paperwork on Friday evening. Together they enter Saturday as a candidate to submit to the supervisor, without treating it as approved.

The small development goes beyond offering the sheet: she remembers his needs and returns choice, and he actually agrees to discuss it. Scheduling cooperation is not romantic willingness or guaranteed approval. He now knows she has transfer paperwork; the date and whether she wants continued contact remain unspoken. The next scene can disclose the date and await his reply, rather than resetting his knowledge to no transfer at all. Neither a hug nor a confession is necessary.

### Prose candidate: offer choice and hear both schedules

Keep Qiao, her partner’s care for his mother and the Thursday/Friday/Saturday discussion. This scene uses Qiao’s limited viewpoint. Admitting she filled the previous draft too quickly and leaving the candidate in the draft folder are additional expression choices. Neither an approved night shift nor romantic commitment is added.

> Qiao set the roster draft between them. Thursday remained blank; she had not entered his name first.
>
> “Thursday is still open. Choose first.”
>
> Her partner picked it up and checked the dates. “I’m with my mother Thursday. I told you last time.”
>
> “I remember.” She laid the pen beside the sheet. “I filled it too quickly last time. Didn’t leave you a choice.”
>
> He put the sheet flat. “Friday works. Do you have plans then?”
>
> Qiao had been about to fill his availability. The question stopped her. “Transfer paperwork Friday evening.”
>
> He looked at Saturday. “What about this one? Shall we propose it together?”
>
> “Yes. As a candidate. It only counts when the supervisor confirms.”
>
> He pointed to Saturday. Only then did Qiao enter it for both of them. As the pen passed Thursday, she did not add his name there.
>
> “Submit this version?” he asked.
>
> “For the supervisor to consider.” She returned it to the draft folder. The transfer was now spoken about; the departure date was not.

She does not decide for him, and he asks about her schedule. An actual response changes care from a unilateral roster proposal. They choose Saturday for future submission. Official approval, Friday’s paperwork and the night shift have not occurred.

A later scene may address dates, contact or ordinary shared life. It cannot reset his knowledge of the transfer or infer willingness to wait or accept intimacy from this cooperation. Pacing follows book voice; a successful conversation need not acquire another misunderstanding to matter.

heading.zh: 检查每次拉扯有没有留下结果
heading.en: Check whether tension leaves a lasting result

body.zh:
把最近五场关系戏各写一句“之前怎样，之后怎样”。若五句都只是同一条“心动但没说”，且这一段需要新的关系转向，就合并重复或补实际选择。五场安静相处若让读者感受到新的生活细节与既有亲近，可以保留，不因没有升级就判无效。人物可以后退，但后退要有新原因；已经知道对方的处境，就不能重新依赖同一误会。

给 AI 两人的独立目标、已发生的关系事件和下一阶段阻力，要求先说明这场要让读者体验什么，再规划互动；有关系转向时，写实际回应与仍保留的边界，不用固定“一场一步”配额。
body.en: Summarize the before and after of five recent relationship scenes. If all merely repeat the same unspoken attraction while this stretch needs a relationship turn, combine repetition or add a practical choice. Five quiet encounters can remain when they offer fresh everyday experience and established closeness; absence of escalation alone does not make them ineffective. Retreat needs a new cause; known circumstances should not fuel the same misunderstanding again. Ask AI to identify the experience this scene should offer before proposing the interaction. For a relationship turn, specify the actual reply and retained boundary without a one-step-per-scene quota.

heading.zh: 同时记录关系名称与真实意愿
heading.en: Track status and willingness separately

body.zh:
| 时点 | 记录 |
|---|---|
| 一起值班 | 外在关系: 工作搭档; 双方此刻接受什么: 能合作，不代表愿意解释家庭情况 |
| 双方讨论候选班次 | 外在关系: 仍是搭档; 双方此刻接受什么: 对方提出周五，听见乔岚的安排后共同拟周六；尚待站长确认，未表示恋爱意愿 |
| 乔岚说要办调动手续 | 外在关系: 身份未变; 双方此刻接受什么: 搭档已知道调动，日期和继续联系尚未谈；后续不重置这项知情 |

Oh Story 的关系方法把社会关系与实际好感分开。本文将它用作行为边界检查，不用好感数值推算谁“应当”接受亲密动作。

乔岚有调离压力，可以暂缓告白，但不能把对方当已承诺等她的人。需要后退时，写新压力如何改变选择，并保留旧信任：担心远距离与不相信对方，是两个不同问题。
body.en:
| Moment | Record |
|---|---|
| Shared shifts | Status: Coworkers; Behavior: Cooperation, not automatic family disclosure |
| They discuss a candidate shift | Status: Still coworkers; Behavior: He suggests Friday, hears her conflict, and joins a Saturday proposal; supervisor approval and romantic willingness are not established |
| Qiao mentions transfer paperwork | Status: Same status; Behavior: He knows of the transfer; date and continued contact remain unspoken, without resetting that knowledge later |

Oh Story separates social status and affection. Use that distinction to check behavior boundaries rather than calculate entitlement to intimacy.

A transfer may delay confession, but Qiao cannot treat her colleague as someone who promised to wait. A setback should show new pressure while preserving established trust: concern about distance differs from distrust.

q.en: How do I keep a slow-burn romance from feeling too slow?
q.zh: 怎么避免慢热恋爱显得太慢？

a.zh: 不用让每章都升级。先检查最近一段主要关系戏是否积累了信任、了解或新选择；如果只是重复“心动但不说”，且人物无故忽略已知事实，就补实际行动或合并重复。安静相处、已经形成的玩笑与习惯可以保留，读者也需要感受到已有亲近。
a.en: Do not make every chapter an upgrade. Check whether the recent major relationship scenes build trust, understanding, or a new choice. If they only repeat unspoken attraction while ignoring known facts without cause, add action or combine repetition. Keep quiet companionship, established jokes, and habits so readers can feel the closeness already earned.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 审读慢热关系。分开外在身份、双方真实意愿、已接受行为和新压力，找主要场景的关系变化；保留正常日常，不每次见面强制升级，也不重置旧信任来拖延。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to separate status, each person’s willingness, accepted behavior and new pressure. Identify major relationship turns while retaining ordinary companionship. Do not force escalation at each meeting or reset trust to delay commitment.

label.zh: 社会关系、真实好感与独立目标
label.en: Social status, actual affection, and independent goals

label.zh: 把关系变化演成交流
具体投入与可信回应
本书节奏与事实边界

title.en: How to Write Enemies-to-Lovers Romance
title.zh: 先敌后爱怎么写：让冲突真实，也让转变有证据

seo_title.en: Write Enemies-to-Lovers Romance
seo_title.zh: 先敌后爱怎么写

description.en: Build a real conflict, preserve both characters’ agency, and show the repeated choices that make cooperation and trust believable.
description.zh: 建立真实冲突、保留双方能动性，并用持续选择支撑合作与信任。

answer.en: Enemies-to-lovers works when the conflict has a credible cause and the characters change through what they learn and choose. Give both people goals beyond winning the romance, let cooperation solve a concrete problem, and require accountability for harm before trust returns.
answer.zh: 先敌后爱要成立，冲突必须有可信原因，人物也要通过认知与选择发生变化。双方都应有恋爱以外的目标，让合作解决具体问题；造成伤害的人需承担责任，信任才有理由回来。

heading.zh: 先写值得冲突的目标，再写转变
heading.en: Start with conflicting goals worth defending

body.zh:
先敌后爱需要双方真正有分歧：竞争一个职位、不同责任或相互冲突的承诺。只用误听一句话制造敌意，澄清后就难以继续。各写一句“为什么他不能轻易让步”，再安排两人看见对方承担的代价。

吸引力可以先出现，信任要靠后续行动建立。曾经造成伤害的一方需要承认具体行为、停止重复并接受对方不原谅的选择。
body.en: Enemies-to-lovers needs a real conflict: one position, incompatible responsibilities, or competing promises. Explain why neither can simply yield. Attraction can appear early, but trust follows observable behavior. A character who caused harm must acknowledge it, stop repeating it, and accept that forgiveness is not guaranteed.

heading.zh: 敌意到信任的转折表
heading.en: A worksheet from hostility to trust

body.zh:
| 原判断 | 记录 |
|---|---|
| 对手只想挤掉我的项目 | 新行动依据：对手共同排查影响双方的设备故障；只改变哪一部分：认可对方愿意履行共同职责 |
| 合作后他会趁机抢功 | 新行动依据：对手保留我的修复署名；只改变哪一部分：愿意进行下一次有限合作 |
| 已经认可便应当恋爱 | 新行动依据：没有对应的主动亲近与接受；只改变哪一部分：不写成恋爱成立 |

新事实不抹掉档期竞争，认可也不自动授予亲密关系。若原稿存在具体伤害，另列停止、承认与补救的行动，不能用一次合作抵销。
body.en:
| Old view | Record |
|---|---|
| Rival only wants to displace my project | Evidence: They help check equipment affecting both; Change: Recognition of shared responsibility |
| Cooperation will become stolen credit | Evidence: They retain my repair attribution; Change: Willingness for another bounded collaboration |
| Respect means romance | Evidence: No reciprocal invitation or acceptance; Change: Relationship is not established |

Evidence does not erase schedule competition, and respect does not grant intimacy. Where actual harm occurred, separately establish stopping, acknowledgment and repair; one collaboration cannot cancel it.

heading.zh: 原创示例：合作保留分歧
heading.en: Original example: cooperation without erasing disagreement

body.zh:
原创场景：社区剧场只有一个周末演出档期。林溪要给青少年排练班办汇演，夏岑要完成专业剧团的售票场，两人都已准备许久，谁落选都有实际损失。

设备检查发现两项演出共用的投影机故障。林溪想独自修，避免对手得利；夏岑提供他实际掌握的旧接线记录，并坚持修复单保留林溪完成的工作署名。两人合作排查，把原来互相怀疑的判断改成有限认可。

投影机修好没有制造第二个档期。他们仍需按已定程序争取时段，下一场不自动放弃各自目标。可以先让败选者承认对方的准备，再在后续独立行动中出现自愿靠近；这次合作只建立后续关系的一个依据。

本例再落实一次回应：林溪接过记录，与夏岑一起按现有记录核对故障位置；修好后共同复测，画面在本次试演中正常播放。夏岑把修复单给她看，她确认自己的工作写在其中，不是作者在旁宣布“他尊重她”。这只支持本次合作和局部判断，不证明所有技术问题永远消失。

后续几次准备，两人会问对方近况，也保留档期分歧。林溪一次主动约他排练后喝咖啡，夏岑接受；两人实际去过，聊到各自想做的演出。后来夏岑说：“我想和你约会，不只是商量排期。”林溪答应，并说汇演方案仍会照常争取，他回答明白。恋爱靠近由双方实际提出和回答，没有以放弃项目为条件。这是本例可选的后续发展，不是投影机修好自动附送的结果。
body.en:
Original scene: a community theater has one weekend performance slot. Lin Xi wants a youth-class showcase; Xia Cen owes his company a ticketed performance. Both have prepared, and either losing has a real cost.

Their shared projector fails inspection. Lin considers repairing it alone rather than benefiting a rival. Xia contributes the wiring records he actually holds and keeps Lin’s work attributed on the repair sheet. Collaboration changes suspicion into limited respect.

Repair does not create a second slot. They still compete through the established process and retain their goals. A later loser can acknowledge the other’s preparation; voluntary closeness needs further actions. This cooperation supplies one reason for that future development.

Make reception concrete: Lin receives the records and checks the fault with Xia against the established material. After repair, they test together and the picture plays normally in this trial. Xia shows her the sheet; she sees her work credited rather than a narrator announcing respect. This supports this cooperation and local judgment, not the permanent disappearance of every technical issue.

During later preparations they ask about each other while retaining the schedule dispute. Lin invites Xia for coffee after rehearsal; he accepts and they actually go, discussing the performances they want to make. Later he explicitly asks to date rather than just discuss scheduling. Lin agrees while saying she will still pursue the showcase plan; he acknowledges that. Both initiate or answer without making project abandonment a condition. This is an optional continuation of the example, not an automatic prize for repairing a projector.

heading.zh: 别让恋爱撤销冲突造成的后果
heading.en: Love should not cancel the conflict’s consequences

body.zh:
竞争导致的工作损失、公开羞辱或背叛要留下后续处理。道歉之后可以开始重建，但不能把此前伤害改写成“其实是爱你”。双方都应有拒绝、离开和继续自己目标的机会。

给 AI 关系转折时，要求列出：误判被哪条事实改变、伤害如何补救、尚未解决的分歧、双方下一次自愿的行动。好感也可以来自谈话、审美、气质或安静相处；写清人物为何被打动，不必把所有靠近都改成办事证明。
body.en: Lost work, humiliation, or betrayal needs follow-through. Do not recast harm as proof of love. Both characters need meaningful refusal and independent goals. Ask AI to identify the evidence changing a judgment, the repair for harm, the unresolved disagreement, and each person’s next voluntary action. Attraction may also come from conversation, taste, presence, or quiet contact; do not turn every approach into task-based proof.

heading.zh: 关系转折要留下未解决的部分
heading.en: Retain what the turn has not resolved

body.zh:
把转折前后分别写成一句判断，再找改变判断的可见行动。林溪由“夏岑会抢走我的功劳”到“他这次保留署名”，不是由“竞争对手”直接变成“值得托付一切”。

各自目标、已有损失和未处理伤害保留在后续。原先只是目标冲突，不必为写成敌人临时添加羞辱；原先确有羞辱，也不能为了恋爱把它说成误会。

检查双方有没有主动选择继续互动，拒绝后能否仍推进各自事情。没有一方真正愿意靠近时，可以停在亦敌亦友，不由旁人的起哄替人物确认关系。
body.en:
Write the judgment before and after the turn, then cite the action changing it. Lin moves from fearing stolen credit to recognizing that Xia preserved it this time—not from rivalry to unlimited trust.

Retain goals, losses and unresolved harm. A goal conflict needs no invented humiliation to qualify as enmity. Real humiliation cannot be relabeled a misunderstanding for romance.

Check voluntary continued interaction and independent goals after refusal. Without reciprocal willingness, the relationship can remain respectful rivalry rather than being declared romantic by observers.

q.en: Do enemies-to-lovers characters need to be equally powerful?
q.zh: 先敌后爱的双方必须势均力敌吗？

a.en: They need meaningful agency, not identical status. Each person should be able to make choices, set boundaries, and change the outcome; account for differences in authority or resources in the story.
a.zh: 不必有相同地位，但双方都要有实质能动性：能作决定、设边界、改变结果。权力或资源差距应在故事中得到处理。

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 检查先敌后爱转折。列各自独立目标、旧判断、新行动依据、变化范围与剩余冲突；分别核对伤害补救和自愿靠近。不用一次合作消除竞争，不把认可写成恋爱同意。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to check goals, old judgments, new evidence, limited change and remaining conflict. Review harm repair and voluntary closeness separately. One collaboration does not erase competition, and recognition does not establish romance.

label.zh: 独立目标、双进度与关系类型
label.en: Independent goals, dual progress, and relationship types

label.zh: 具体投入与可信回应
作者结局与表达取舍

title.en: How to Write a YouTube Video Script Viewers Can Follow
title.zh: YouTube视频脚本怎么写：先给观众问题，再安排画面

seo_title.en: Write a YouTube Video Script
seo_title.zh: YouTube视频脚本怎么写

description.en: Define the viewer’s question, organize the answer into clear beats, and plan what the audience sees as well as hears.
description.zh: 明确观众的问题，把答案分成清晰节拍，并同时规划画面与旁白。

answer.zh: 已有素材的 YouTube 解说或分析视频，先写观众看完要理解的问题，再选实际画面与原声，按变化组织段落。旁白只补必要背景、因果或解释，不复述所有动作。标题、开头和结尾兑现同一承诺，稿件与素材缺口先查清，再配音和包装。
answer.en: For a YouTube recap or analysis built from existing footage, define the question viewers will understand, select actual picture and sound, and organize changes. Narration supplies necessary context, causality or interpretation. Keep title, opening and ending on one promise; resolve evidence gaps before voicing and packaging.

heading.zh: 先定一个素材能兑现的问题
heading.en: Choose a promise the footage can deliver

body.zh:
video-script 的创作方法先确定观众问题、跟随谁、信息何时揭示，以及结尾留下什么。本文针对已有素材的故事解说与分析，不把这套写法当成所有 YouTube 内容的统一格式。

沿用原创申请窗口素材：女主退回盖章的表格，另一位申请者站在一旁。可成立的主线是“为什么名额到手，她却退掉？”也可从结果出发，追问这次放弃让谁承担损失。

创作新稿时比较真实叙述方案；用户已定结构或只要求改稿时，沿用已采用的主线。不得为了开头刺激，把一次名额争执写成素材没有的骗局或胜利。
body.en:
video-script establishes the viewer question, viewpoint, revelation timing and ending impression. This guide addresses footage-based recaps and analysis, not a compulsory format for every YouTube genre.

Original application-window footage shows a woman returning a stamped form beside another applicant. One viable spine asks why she gives up a secured place; another starts with the consequences and traces the loss.

Compare real narrative alternatives when creating. Preserve an adopted structure during directed work or revision. Do not turn the dispute into a nonexistent scam or victory for a stronger opening.

heading.zh: 每段写变化与声音分工
heading.en: Give each segment a change and sound owner

body.zh:
| 段落任务 | 选中的画面与原声 | 旁白工作 | 观众此时得到什么 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 开头问题 | 盖章后退表，保留停顿 | 点出异常选择 | 想知道放弃原因 |
| 前提 | 上午承诺与截止说明 | 连接两处素材的时间 | 理解她原先打算转让 |
| 转折 | 主办方说名额不可转让 | 不盖住关键原声 | 原计划失效 |
| 结果 | 她带另一人离开窗口 | 补已证实的代价，不编成功 | 看见她如何处理承诺 |

每项写实际文件与原片时间。完成剪辑后，再核对应的成片位置。画面已表达退表，不必再旁白“她伸手把表格推回”；原声能完整交代条件时，让它承担这一拍。

本表是原创素材的编排示例，不是实际播放成绩。段落长短跟含义与表演走，不按固定秒数或旁白比例分配。
body.en:
| Segment | Selected picture / sound | Narration job | Viewer change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Opening | Return stamped form; retain pause | Identify the unusual choice | Wants its reason |
| Setup | Morning promise and deadline | Connect source timing | Understands intended transfer |
| Turn | Official says transfer is impossible | Leave essential original speech clear | Plan fails |
| Outcome | Both applicants leave | Explain established cost, not invented success | Sees how she addresses the promise |

Record actual files and source times, then map them to the edit. Do not narrate every visible hand movement; let a complete original statement carry its condition.

This is an original planning example, not performance evidence. Allocate duration by meaning and performance rather than fixed seconds or narration ratios.

heading.zh: 开头提出问题，正文补真实因果
heading.en: Open a question and connect actual causes

body.zh:
本例开头可写：“印章刚落下，她把申请表推了回去。名额到手以后，她才知道这份名额不能转给身旁的人。这次决定，要从上午那份承诺说起。”使用这句前，先核素材确实交代不可转让与承诺。

接着保留主办方的原话，再用旁白连接被压缩的上午事件。旁白拥有一个连续思路，不为每条字幕拆成一次朗读；字幕可按阅读宽度断句，发声内容仍自然连接。

结尾若只显示两人离开，就回答她放弃了什么、怎样处理当下关系。不能补“最终获得新名额”作为圆满答案，除非后续素材或可靠已知事实确实支持。
body.en:
An opening might say: “The stamp had barely landed before she returned the form. Only then did she learn the place could not go to the person beside her. Her decision begins with that morning’s promise.” First verify both the transfer rule and promise in the material.

Retain the official’s words, then connect the compressed earlier event. Narration should deliver a continuous thought; caption wrapping does not require separate choppy utterances.

If the footage ends with departure, resolve what she gives up and how she handles the relationship now. A newly won place cannot supply a happy ending without source evidence.

heading.zh: 三种方式检查同一稿件
heading.en: Review the script three ways

body.zh:
先静音旁白，检查画面与原声是否保住人物选择和必要反应；再只听声音，检查主线能否理解；最后按第一次观看的速度完整播放，看开头承诺是否得到回应。

把每条待删内容对应到损失：删了是否少动机、条件或情绪结果？只删等待和无新作用的重复，不把犹豫一概当拖沓。缺素材的连接先标缺口，不让 AI 代编。

进入配音前检查事实与声音分工，配音后确认时长；最终仍需看实际文件和各接点。字数、样帧和自动 QC 辅助定位，不替代对人物与故事的完整观看。
body.en:
Mute narration to check picture and original sound, listen without picture for a coherent spine, then watch at normal first-viewing speed to assess the promise.

For each deletion, identify lost motivation, conditions or emotional payoff. Remove empty waiting and redundant repetition without treating every hesitation as waste. Mark missing evidence rather than asking AI to invent a bridge.

Confirm facts and sound roles before voicing, then measure actual duration. Review the final file and joins: word counts, frames and technical QC assist judgment, not full story viewing.

q.en: Should I write every word before recording a YouTube video?
q.zh: 录YouTube视频前要把每个字都写好吗？

a.en: Write a full script when precise wording, evidence, or timing matters. For a familiar topic, a detailed beat outline may sound more natural. Test a short section on camera and choose the level of scripting that preserves clarity.
a.zh: 准确用词、证据或时间安排重要时，写完整稿。熟悉的话题可用详细节拍提纲，表达可能更自然。先试录一小段，再选既清楚又自然的稿件细度。

text.zh: 请用 $video-recap 为已有素材整理 YouTube 解说脚本：先定观众问题与视角，再列具体画面、原声、变化和旁白任务；逐条事实注明来源，缺口先保留，不写素材没有的结果。
text.en: Use $video-recap to plan a footage-based YouTube script: define question and viewpoint, then map picture, original audio, changes and narration jobs. Cite source evidence and retain gaps instead of inventing outcomes.

label.zh: 观众承诺、变化与声音分工
label.en: Viewer promises, changes and sound roles

title.en: How to Design Multiple Endings That Reflect Player Choices
title.zh: 多结局游戏怎么设计：让结局回应玩家一路作出的选择

seo_title.en: Design Multiple Game Endings
seo_title.zh: 多结局游戏怎么设计

description.en: Tie endings to a small set of tracked decisions, make each outcome resolve the central promise, and show the cost of the chosen route.
description.zh: 让结局对应少数关键选择，每种结果都回应核心承诺，并展示路线代价。

answer.zh: 先记录玩家实际做过的关键选择，再为结局定义可获得的条件与人物回应。每项条件写清在哪里产生、在哪里使用；相邻路径只改变一个决定，也应能解释结果差别。共享终局画面可以节约制作，但必须保留路线历史，不能让未发生的公开、交易或修复串入结局。
answer.en: Track consequential actions and give each ending obtainable conditions and character responses. Record where each condition is written and read. A neighboring path should explain a changed result when one decision changes. Shared ending assets can save production work, but must preserve route history.

heading.zh: 先确定结局读取哪些事实
heading.en: Choose the facts each ending reads

body.zh:
game-world-design 的互动叙事方法让终局回应具体行动，而不只结算隐藏总分。先确定核心冲突，再挑会改变结果的事实：原件是否保留、证人是否同意公开、玩家是否接受了不得公开的交易。

沿用原创水站故事，并先把修复条件交代清楚：玩家找到失踪记录的原件；已确认本次故障能由现有技术员与匹配配件处理。管理员同意维修进入，不论由自己或居民组织，但想收回记录。居民储备有配件与人手，愿意在核对记录后一起维修；管理员也有另一套可用资源，提出以交回原件、保留资料私下流转为交换。

证人在公开选择前说明：愿意让这次证词被实名使用，也准备在公开后离开管理员的工作组。这个代价来自她自己的处境与决定，不是资料一公开就自动被开除。若她没有同意，不能先替她宣布。

两路都可以修好水站，但必须分别写出核对、接受安排、领用配件与完成维修。公开本身不修管线，交回原件本身也不等于资源已交付。上述条件是这则虚构游戏的设定，不是现实维修或资料交易的通则。
body.en:
game-world-design makes endings read concrete actions instead of only hidden scores. Define the central conflict, then select facts that matter: retaining the original, obtaining the witness’s agreement, and accepting a private exchange.

Keep the original water-station story but establish repair conditions. The player finds the missing record. The fault can be handled by the available technician and suitable parts. The administrator permits repair access whether organized by residents or by the administrator, but wants the record back. Residents have parts and helpers and will repair after checking the record. The administrator has another usable supply and offers it in exchange for return of the original and keeping the material private.

Before publication, the witness agrees to named use of this testimony and says she plans to leave the administrator’s work group afterward. That cost follows her situation and decision, not automatic dismissal upon publication. Without agreement, the player cannot announce it for her.

Both routes may restore water, but each needs verification, accepted arrangements, parts delivery, and completed work. Publication does not repair pipes; surrendering a record is not already resource delivery. These are fictional game conditions, not real repair or document-exchange rules.

heading.zh: 把条件、提示和结果放在同一表里
heading.en: Connect conditions, signals and outcomes

body.zh:
| 结局 | 条件、过程与回应 |
|---|---|
| 公开档案 | 条件：保留原件、证人明确同意、玩家决定公布。依据：居民说明配件与人手，证人说明去留。过程：居民核对并接受安排，领配件与技术员完成维修。终局：记录公开，水站恢复；证人交接并离开工作组。 |
| 私下修复 | 条件：接受交易，实际将原件交给管理员。依据：交易说明资源与不公开范围。过程：管理员交付配件，技术员完成维修。终局：水站恢复，原件被收回，记录仍未公开。 |

每项状态都有产生和读取位置。“获得同意”来自证人明确答应；只看过证词不是公开许可。“完成维修”来自本路实际行动，不能只读到“已安排维修”。

这两条原型路线以原件公开核对或交回为互斥条件，本原型没有制作副本的动作。交回后玩家仍记得读过的内容，却不能继续拿原件当众展示。若允许制作副本、口头公开或撤回同意，就补这些行动与条件，不在末场临时放行。
body.en:
| Ending | Path and result |
|---|---|
| Public record | Requires retained original, explicit witness agreement, and publication choice. Residents state supplies and help; the witness states her plans. Residents check, accept the arrangement, collect parts, and repair with the technician. The record is public, water restored, and the witness completes handover and leaves the group. |
| Private repair | Requires accepted exchange and actual return of the original. Terms specify resources and private scope. The administrator delivers parts; the technician repairs. Water returns, the original is retained by the administrator, and the record remains unpublished. |

Every state needs a creation and a read location. Agreement comes from an explicit response, not merely viewing testimony. Completed repair comes from this route’s actions, not only “repair arranged.”

These prototype routes use publicly checking the original or returning it as mutually exclusive conditions, with no copying action in this prototype. After surrender, the player still remembers the content but cannot display the original. If copying, oral disclosure, or withdrawn agreement is supported, add its actions and conditions instead of granting it at the ending.

heading.zh: 共享地点，保留不同的历史
heading.en: Share the location, preserve different histories

body.zh:
两个结局都在修复后的水站结束。公开路线中，居民代表收拾本路使用的工具，证人完成工作组交接后离开；私下路线中，管理员带着已经收回的原件，向玩家出示本次维修记录。环境可共用，人物、称呼、物件和行动按实际历史变化。

私下路线不能让居民感谢玩家“公开了证据”；公开路线也不能让玩家交出另一条路线才交回的原件。展示不改变持有人，交付才改变归属。先列终局进入时的物件归属与各人知情，再写台词。

代价可以留下余味。证人离开工作组不必立刻被更好工作抵消，记录未公开也不等于所有人忘记问题。水站恢复由此前已完成的维修支撑，终局文件与感谢只是回响，不能代替过程。
body.en:
Both endings take place at the restored station. Public-route residents pack the tools used on that route; the witness completes her work-group handover and leaves. Privately, the administrator holds the original already returned and shows the player this repair’s record. Reuse the environment while changing people, address, objects, and actions according to actual history.

Private-route residents cannot thank the player for publication. The public route cannot return an original surrendered only on the other route. Display does not change possession; delivery does. Establish ending-entry ownership and knowledge before writing lines.

Costs can remain. Leaving the group need not immediately bring a better job, and private records do not mean everyone forgets the issue. Restoration rests on repair already completed; closing documents and thanks echo the process rather than replacing it.

heading.zh: 正向走到结局，再检查相邻反例
heading.en: Reach each ending and test a neighboring case

body.zh:
为每个结局走一条从初态开始的完整路径，检查条件能否获得、修复如何发生、终局是否读取了实际行动。再改一个关键决定：证人拒绝同意时，公开选项怎样回应？交出原件后，是否仍错误保留公开路线？

记录初态、输入、状态变化、预期与实际终局。若结局依赖某项条件，却没有任何场景写入它，就修条件链；若同一事实在共享场景中被覆盖，就修汇合读取。

纸面规划只能帮助检查设计，实际实现后仍要跑完整路径。只有结果能回到玩家选择与人物目标，多结局才不只是末页的几个按钮。
body.en:
Walk a complete initial-state path to each ending, checking obtainable conditions, repair events and historical reads. Change one consequential decision: what happens if consent is refused, or publication remains available after surrendering the original?

Record initial state, inputs, changes, expected and observed outcome. Repair a condition without a write scene; repair a shared scene that overwrites route history.

A paper plan supports design review, not playable verification. Implemented paths still need execution. Endings become meaningful when their results trace back to choices and character aims.

q.en: How many endings should a game have?
q.zh: 游戏应该设计几个结局？

a.en: Use the number you can make distinct, prepared, and satisfying. A few meaningful outcomes are often easier to understand and support than many nearly identical endings.
a.zh: 按你能做出差异、铺垫和满足感的数量来定。少数有意义的结果通常比大量近似结局更容易理解和实现。

text.zh: 用 $game-world-design 整理各结局的行动条件、写入与读取场景、途中提示和代价；检查共享终局是否串入未选事实，再交 $game-qa 验证完整路径与相邻反例。
text.en: Use $game-world-design to map ending conditions, write/read scenes, signals and costs. Check shared endings for unchosen facts, then use $game-qa for complete paths and neighboring counterexamples.

label.zh: 结局条件与历史回读
路径与边界测试

title.en: How to Write a Visual Novel Script with Clear Routes
title.zh: 视觉小说脚本怎么写：让角色路线各有目标和变化

seo_title.en: Write a Visual Novel Script
seo_title.zh: 视觉小说脚本怎么写

description.en: Plan the common route, define what opens each character route, and write dialogue with clear speaker, scene, and choice state.
description.zh: 规划共通线，明确角色路线开启条件，并用清楚角色、场景和选择状态写对白。

answer.zh: 先选玩家能观察、追问或行动的冲突，写共通线的进入、选择与离场状态，再确定各角色路线的独立目标。脚本把说话者、画面、声音、条件和结果对应起来；路线汇合时读取玩家真正看过或做过的事，不把小说逐屏切开就当成互动脚本。
answer.en: Choose a conflict the player can observe, question or act on. Define the common scene’s entry, choice and exit state, then give character routes independent goals. Connect dialogue, presentation, conditions and results; converging scenes must read actual player history.

heading.zh: 先写场景行动，再写逐句对白
heading.en: Plan scene action before dialogue

body.zh:
game-world-design 的场景方法先确定存在理由、人物议程、知识边界、玩家介入和离场状态。视觉小说可以阅读为主，但选定的关键互动仍要改变人物回应、信息或后续机会。

沿用原创展厅场景：一张借展照片不见了，玩家在闭馆后向保管员询问。保管员想保护借展手续的信誉，照片主人想查明物件去向；玩家只看见空相框，尚不知道谁拿走照片。

共通场景的任务是取得可追问依据。原作内心描写可以转成当前视角可感知的动作或文字，不让旁白提前宣布保管员在隐瞒，否则调查选择失去意义。

把上述开场展开为可读的原创脚本方案。玩家已在闭馆展厅，旁边是空相框。保管员说“登记说昨夜取走”，仍只是他给出的说法。作者为本例加入下列局部问答，不预设保管员就是拿走照片的人：

> 保管员正往盒里收钥匙：“登记说昨夜取走。”
>
> 玩家选择“先看登记簿”。保管员把簿推到桌边。玩家看到日期原字被划掉，旁边补了新日期；只能确定有修改，看不出谁改。
>
> 回到问话，出现“这处日期为什么改过？”
>
> 保管员停下收钥匙：“有人口头通知改。签收页还没核，我得再看。”
>
> 玩家选择“我和你一起核签收页”。保管员答应，把交接柜指给玩家。两人开始查手续，尚未确认照片去向。

另一条路径中，玩家没有选择看登记簿，就不出现已经发现涂改的质问。玩家可问“谁签收了照片？”保管员回应“我还没核签收页。你愿意一起查吗？”本例玩家选“好，一起查”，保管员指向交接柜；若玩家拒绝，就不算共同调查，也不自动把第一条观察写入历史。

这里已经发生的是各自选定的观察、问话与合作；“有人通知”仍是解释候选，两条路线都尚未找回照片。汇合到交接柜时，见过日期的人可继续追问那一处，未见过的人不能说“我刚才看到了”。这段只演示共通场景与调查入口，不声称完整角色路线或游戏已实现。
body.en:
game-world-design establishes scene purpose, agendas, knowledge, player intervention and exit state before lines. A visual novel can prioritize reading while consequential interactions still change responses, information or opportunities.

Original gallery scene: a borrowed photograph is missing after closing. The keeper protects confidence in the loan process; its owner wants the object traced. The player sees an empty frame but does not know who removed it.

The common scene obtains grounds for inquiry. Adapt interior prose through the chosen viewpoint; narration should not declare concealment before investigation establishes it.

Expand that setup into a readable original script proposal. The player is in the closed gallery beside an empty frame. The keeper’s “The register says last night” remains a claim. These new local exchanges do not predetermine who removed the photograph:

> The keeper was collecting keys into a box. “The register says last night.”
>
> The player chooses “Inspect the register first.” The keeper slides it over. The player sees a crossed-out date and a new date beside it, without knowing who made the change.
>
> On returning to questions, “Why was this date changed?” becomes available.
>
> The keeper stops collecting keys. “Someone told me to change it. I haven’t checked the receipt page. I need another look.”
>
> The player chooses “I’ll check that page with you.” The keeper agrees and indicates the handoff cabinet. They begin auditing the process without establishing the photograph’s location.

On another path the player does not inspect the register, so the alteration question is unavailable. “Who signed for the photo?” receives “I haven’t checked the receipt page. Will you look with me?” In this example the player selects “Yes, let’s check,” and the keeper indicates the cabinet. Declining would not establish cooperation, and the first path’s observation does not enter this history automatically.

Selected observation, questions and cooperation occur, while “someone told me” remains an explanation candidate. Neither path recovers the photograph yet. At convergence by the cabinet, an inspector may follow up on the date; an uninspected path cannot claim “I saw it earlier.” This passage demonstrates the common scene and investigation entry, not a completed character route or implemented game.

heading.zh: 场景表写清条件与实际结果
heading.en: Write conditions and actual results into the scene table

body.zh:
| 脚本段 | 表现、对白与状态 |
|---|---|
| 共通开场 | 空相框与门口雨声；保管员说登记为昨夜取走，只建立说法，尚未证实。 |
| 查看登记簿 | 日期局部；玩家见过涂改，记录观察，不认定修改者。 |
| 查看后返回问话 | 保管员停下收钥匙；“这处日期为什么改过？”仅查看后出现，回应为解释候选。 |
| 未查看的问话 | 同一展厅问“谁签收了照片？”，不假装已发现涂改。 |

独立记进入条件和离场状态，表情与音效只在有作用时变化。台词编号可供文本、字幕与配音共用，格式按所选制作工具调整；这张表是交接模板，不是任意引擎可直接执行的脚本语法。
body.en:
| Segment | Presentation, line and state |
|---|---|
| Common opening | Empty frame and rain. Keeper says the register gives last night; this establishes a claim, not verified truth. |
| Inspect register | Date close-up. Record that the player saw alteration, without identifying the editor. |
| Return after inspection | Keeper pauses while collecting keys. “Why was this date changed?” appears only after inspection; the reply is an explanation candidate. |
| Uninspected question | In the same gallery, “Who signed for the photo?” does not assume unseen evidence. |

Record entry and exit states; vary expression and sound when useful. Line IDs can connect text, captions and voices. Adapt the format to the production tool: this worksheet is not universal executable engine syntax.

heading.zh: 角色路线要有自己的问题
heading.en: Give each character route its own question

body.zh:
| 路线 | 目标、行动与回报 |
|---|---|
| 与保管员核手续 | 找签收流程漏洞；查交接与补签，路线需保管员承认管理疏漏；路线目标是建立可追溯借展记录。 |
| 与照片主人追去向 | 找回物件及其私人意义；沿签收线索找收件人，主人决定是否公开家事；路线目标是找回照片并明确今后保管者。 |

这只是本页新增的纸面路线设计。入口根据已发生的调查与明确合作决定，不把一个随意闲聊选项藏作唯一开启条件。

两条路线可以共用展厅，却不能只换立绘重演同一冲突。核心人物应有多阶段关系、独立筹码与结局回收；若只有一场短交谈，就先作为支持短线，不为了“角色路线”标签扩成冗长内容。
body.en:
| Route | Aim, action and payoff |
|---|---|
| Audit with keeper | Find the handoff failure; review signatures; the keeper needs to acknowledge a procedural lapse. The route aims for traceable loan records. |
| Trace with owner | Recover the object and its personal meaning; follow recipient evidence while the owner chooses whether to disclose private context. The route aims to recover the photo and agree custody. |

These are new paper-design routes for the example. Open them through established investigation and explicit cooperation, not an unrelated hidden chat choice.

Routes may share a gallery, but swapping portraits cannot replace distinct conflicts. A core route needs sustained relationship, leverage and payoff. Keep a brief encounter as a supporting line until broader depth is justified.

heading.zh: 检查汇合、阅读和资产交接
heading.en: Check convergence, reading and production handoff

body.zh:
从共通线分别走到两条路线，再反向核对入口：被问到的证据是否确实见过，合作条件是否满足，汇合对白是否误用另一条路线的事实。失败或回退也要有明确落点。

在实际字号与视口看选择页，必要依据贴近问题，长档案按需打开，不把按钮挤到当前正文之外。画面、配音和文本共用当前台词记录，修改后只同步受影响条目。

让 AI 先摘原作事实，再提新增路线决定，作者确认后展开。纸面选择成立后还要在目标环境检查输入、结果与回到互动；对白读得顺不能单独证明游戏可玩。
body.en:
Walk each route from the common scene and trace entry requirements backward. Characters must not refer to unseen evidence, unmet cooperation or another route’s facts. Give failure and return paths clear destinations.

Inspect choices at the actual font and viewport. Place necessary evidence near the decision and long records in accessible archives. Keep picture, voice and text on current line records; synchronize affected entries after edits.

Ask AI to extract source facts before proposing adaptation changes. Confirm those changes before expansion. Test input, outcome and return to interaction in the target runtime; smooth dialogue alone does not prove playability.

q.en: Should visual novel routes be equally long?
q.zh: 视觉小说各条路线必须一样长吗？

a.en: No. Give each route enough space for its conflict and payoff, and set expectations through the game’s structure. Unequal length is fine when the shorter route still feels complete.
a.zh: 不必。按各路线冲突与回报所需篇幅安排，并通过游戏结构建立预期。较短路线只要完整就可以。

text.zh: 用 $game-world-design 写本场视觉小说脚本，先定视角、议程、进入与离场状态，再填写台词和选项表；给各路线独立目标，标明原作事实与新增改编，检查汇合知识。
text.en: Use $game-world-design to define viewpoint, agendas and entry/exit states before a visual-novel line and choice table. Give routes distinct aims, label adaptation additions and check knowledge at convergence.

label.zh: 场景、知识与分支
人物议程与选择台词
路线深度与范围

title.en: How to Write a Game Quest with a Clear Goal and Payoff
title.zh: 游戏任务怎么写：目标明确，过程改变处境

seo_title.en: Write a Game Quest
seo_title.zh: 游戏任务怎么写

description.en: Give each quest a player-readable goal, a reason to act, meaningful steps, and a reward that changes future options.
description.zh: 给任务清楚目标、行动理由、有意义的步骤，以及能改变后续选项的回报。

answer.zh: 任务先让玩家理解目标、开始方法和必要风险，再用行动改变世界或人物处境。写清前置条件、可采取动作、规则结果、可读反馈与后续机会。完成图标只是显示；任务日志、场景、物件和角色回应必须读取同一结果，不能只让玩家交差后回到原点。
answer.en: A quest establishes a goal, starting action and necessary risks, then lets player actions change the situation. Connect prerequisites, actions, rules, feedback and future opportunities. A completion icon is only a display; logs, objects, scenes and characters must agree on the result.

heading.zh: 从人物需求写到玩家能做的事
heading.en: Turn a character need into player action

body.zh:
game-world-design 把关键行动写为“当前状态＋玩家选择＋世界规则→新状态＋可读反馈＋后续选择”。任务不只是一段背景和一个完成按钮，还需要开始路径与可理解的阻力。

沿用原创温室：日落前需要恢复供水，南北阀门的开启顺序影响蓄水箱。园丁有钥匙，管理员想保住温室，也怕父亲留下的修改记录公开。玩家可以调查后求助，或在已提示风险下自行试阀。

进入任务时，玩家应先知道水停了、何处可查、向谁借钥匙。阀门风险通过可见图示和园丁提醒呈现；不能等失败后才宣布一个此前无从得知的规则。
body.en:
game-world-design connects current state, player action and world rule to a new state, readable feedback and changed opportunities. A quest needs a starting path and understandable resistance, not just background plus a completion button.

Original greenhouse: restore supply before sunset; valve order affects storage. The gardener holds a key. The administrator wants repairs but fears disclosure of a parent’s modification record. Players can investigate and seek help or try valves after learning the risk.

Establish the failure, investigation point and key holder on entry. Show valve risks through readable diagrams and warnings before failure, rather than revealing an unknowable rule afterward.

heading.zh: 填写可用于制作的任务卡
heading.en: Fill a production-ready quest card

body.zh:
| 项目 | 本例填写 |
|---|---|
| 初始状态 | 供水停止，北侧蓄水箱仍有余水，钥匙由园丁保管 |
| 目标与期限 | 日落前恢复供水；到期苗圃状态变化 |
| 前置路径 | 查管线图，向园丁借钥匙，取得可操作入口 |
| 核心取舍 | 出示旧记录换准确顺序，或保密并承受试阀风险 |
| 确定结果 | 按选择更新阀门、余水与受影响苗圃 |
| 可读反馈 | 水流与苗圃显示实际变化，人物回应本次做法 |
| 后续机会 | 园丁依据损失和是否见过记录决定是否协助查旧账 |

记录只覆盖本任务有作用的规则，不为所有项目强加同样字段。出示文件让园丁知道其内容；玩家私下读过文件并不让所有 NPC 自动知道。
body.en:
| Field | Example |
|---|---|
| Initial state | No supply; north reserve remains; gardener holds key |
| Goal / deadline | Restore supply by sunset; expiry changes nursery state |
| Starting path | Read diagram, request key, gain operating access |
| Tradeoff | Show old record for a reliable sequence, or keep it private and accept trial risk |
| Rule result | Update valves, reserve and affected plants from the action |
| Feedback | Water and nursery show the change; characters respond |
| Next opportunity | Gardener’s assistance reads loss and whether the record was shown |
