Keep task-relevant rules rather than imposing identical fields on every game. Showing a document informs its recipient; private inspection does not automatically inform every NPC.

heading.zh: 让每条做法留下不同后果
heading.en: Give approaches distinct consequences

body.zh:
调查路线先找到修改记录，再出示给园丁。园丁提供可核对的顺序，玩家取得操作入口并按该顺序开阀后，供水才恢复；管理员得知记录被出示，会要求玩家解释。两路线都可以保留原件，保密路线另保留内容未向园丁披露的状态，但自行试阀可能耗掉北侧余水。

玩家按钮写“给园丁看修改记录”，不写“诚实路线”；提示必要代价，不提前宣布所有远期结局。若园丁没有看过记录，后文不能突然替玩家引用文件细节。

结果也不必都成功。苗圃受损可以让园丁拒绝下一次帮忙，并提供另一条查账路径。失败由已知风险产生且有后续行动，比弹出“任务失败”后毫无变化更完整。
body.en:
The investigation route finds and shows the modification record. The gardener supplies a verifiable sequence; water is restored only after the player gains operating access and follows it. The administrator then asks why the record was disclosed. Either route can retain the original document; the private route also keeps its contents undisclosed to the gardener while accepting the risk of draining the north reserve through trial.

Label the button “Show the gardener the modification record,” not “Honest route.” Present necessary costs without every distant ending. An uninformed gardener cannot later quote unseen details.

Not every approach must succeed. Nursery damage may cause refusal of later help while opening another investigation path. A known-risk failure with continuing actions is more complete than an isolated failure popup.

heading.zh: 把调查路线走完：知道顺序仍要实际开阀
heading.en: Complete the route: knowledge still requires action

body.zh:
以下继续温室原例，是供制作讨论的纸面路径，不是已运行原型。为把既有“顺序影响蓄水”写成可执行规则，本例选定：从两阀关闭开始，先开南阀、再开北阀恢复供水并保住北侧余水；先开北阀会耗掉这份余水。具体顺序是本例世界规则，不是现实管线操作建议，进入操作前在管线图与园丁提醒中呈现。

| 玩家行动 | 本次结果与反馈 |
|---|---|
| 日落前查图、找到修改记录 | 玩家看见顺序风险和记录内容；园丁尚不知道文件内容，钥匙仍在园丁手中。 |
| 选择“给园丁看修改记录” | 园丁实际看过后解释南先北后的顺序，玩家将它与图示核对。记录仍由玩家拿着；看到文件不等于收走文件。 |
| 向园丁借钥匙、打开阀门间 | 本例园丁同意借出，钥匙移入玩家背包。玩家实际使用钥匙打开入口，才出现开阀动作；得知顺序本身不会开门或供水。 |
| 先开南阀，再开北阀 | 依已提示规则恢复水流，北侧余水保留。本路径在期限前完成，苗圃不受此次停水到期损失。场景水流和日志读同一个结果。 |
| 归还钥匙，再询问旧账 | 本例钥匙回到园丁手中。园丁根据没发生损失、自己确已看过记录，同意协助查账；这才开放协助入口，不直接宣布旧账已经查清。 |

管理员只能在获得“玩家曾出示记录”的信息后追问；本例让园丁当面向他说明此事，不能让远处管理员自动读玩家背包。管理员知道文件曾被展示，也不自动知道其全部文字。

对照路径沿用相同初态：私下读记录、借到钥匙但不出示，先开北阀。余水按规则损失，水流、苗圃和日志随后读取这次结果；园丁可依据实际损失拒绝下一次帮忙，却不能引用未见的记录。重复结算不再改一次余水或再给一次协助奖励。

先把这两条路径的输入与结果写清，再放进原型检查。纸面叙述顺畅，不能证明实际开门、背包移交、期限和反馈已经正确运行。
body.en:
Continue the greenhouse example as a paper route for production discussion, not a running prototype. Make its established order-dependent storage rule concrete: from both valves closed, south then north restores supply and preserves the north reserve; opening north first loses that reserve. This is the example’s fictional rule, not real plumbing advice. Present it through the diagram and gardener’s warning before operation.

| Player action | Result and feedback |
|---|---|
| Before sunset, inspect the diagram and find the record | The player learns the order risk and record contents. The gardener remains uninformed and holds the key. |
| Choose “Show the gardener the modification record” | After seeing it, the gardener explains south before north; the player checks that against the diagram. The original stays with the player. Viewing does not transfer custody. |
| Borrow the key and open the valve room | In this route the gardener agrees, placing the key in inventory. The player uses it to gain access before valve actions become available. Knowing the sequence opens neither door nor supply. |
| Open south, then north | The announced rule restores flow and preserves the reserve. Completion is before the deadline, avoiding this outage’s expiry loss. Scene water and the log read the same result. |
| Return the key and ask about the old accounts | The key returns to the gardener. Reading the absence of loss and having seen the record, the gardener agrees to help. Assistance becomes available; the accounts are not already solved. |

The administrator needs access to the disclosure before asking about it. Here the gardener tells him in person; a distant administrator cannot automatically inspect inventory. Knowing a document was shown does not reveal all its contents.

For comparison, start from the same state: privately read the record and borrow the key without showing it, then open north first. The rule removes the reserve; flow, nursery and log read the resulting state. The gardener can refuse later help because of actual loss but cannot quote unseen records. Repeating resolution cannot remove the reserve again or grant assistance twice.

Specify these inputs and results before checking a prototype. A coherent paper account does not establish working access, inventory transfers, deadlines or feedback.

heading.zh: 检查日志、世界与人物是否一起变化
heading.en: Check agreement across log, world and characters

body.zh:
走完调查、借钥匙、开阀和结算，再走一条改变顺序的相邻路径。检查实际水流、背包钥匙、苗圃状态与任务日志，确认“完成”不是只改了文字。重复点击结算不能再次领取同一奖励。

下一任务由本次结果引出：园丁帮助、管理员阻挠或新增记录，各有原因。重复跑同地点取不同颜色物件却没有新取舍，可以合并为一次行动。

若改了规则，重放受影响路径，再查共享上游但走另一选择的情况。叙事修订不能只润色日志，让旧结果继续藏在状态里；对白与可用动作也要读到正确的任务历史。
body.en:
Walk investigation, key access, valve operation and resolution, then change the order on a neighboring path. Compare water flow, key inventory, nursery state and log. Completion must change more than text, and repeated resolution must not duplicate rewards.

Connect the next quest to this result: assistance, obstruction or new records each need a cause. Repeated collection errands without new tradeoffs can become one action.

After rule changes, replay the affected route and a neighboring choice sharing earlier state. Polishing the log cannot leave an obsolete result hidden in state; dialogue and actions must read the revised history.

q.en: Does every quest need combat?
q.zh: 每个游戏任务都需要战斗吗？

a.en: No. Investigation, negotiation, exploration, craft, or a relationship decision can make a complete quest when the player’s actions change the state.
a.zh: 不需要。调查、谈判、探索、制作或关系决定，只要玩家行动能改变状态，都能构成完整任务。

text.zh: 用 $game-world-design 将原作冲突改成任务卡，写明初态、开始路径、风险、行动结果与后续回响；保留人物知情边界，并安排正常路径和一个有区分力的反例。
text.en: Use $game-world-design to turn a source conflict into a quest card with initial state, access, risks, results and later responses. Preserve knowledge boundaries and define a normal path plus a meaningful counterexample.

label.zh: 行动、反馈与任务回响
人物议程与信息边界

title.en: How to Turn a Long Video into Short Clips That Stand Alone
title.zh: 长视频怎么剪成短片段：每条保留完整问题和结果

seo_title.en: Turn a Long Video into Short Clips
seo_title.zh: 长视频怎么剪短片

description.en: Choose moments with a complete point, add only the context needed to understand them, and make each clip’s title match its evidence.
description.zh: 挑选能讲完整观点的片段，补足必要背景，并让标题符合素材证据。

answer.zh: 先选能独立理解的一次决定、问答或变化，再保留必要前提与具体回报。记录必留画面、原声及顺序，入出点按完整动作和台词选择；压时长删无新作用的等待，不删除改变含义的借用条件。标题只承诺本条切片实际呈现的内容。
answer.en: Choose an independently understandable decision, exchange or change, then preserve its premise and payoff. Record required picture, sound and order. Set boundaries around complete actions and speech; shorten empty waiting without removing meaning-changing conditions. Titles must match what the clip actually presents.

heading.zh: 先判断切片是否能独立理解
heading.en: Check whether the clip stands on its own

body.zh:
video-script 的剪辑方法用可感知变化组织素材，不把固定秒数当一条片。先问观众从哪里进入、等待什么、离开时得到什么；人物动机与接受条件也是内容，不只保留刺激动作。

沿用原创乐器片段：朋友说“借给你可以，但今晚演出前还我”，对方带走乐器，朋友在演出前等待。如果只从拿走开始，观众可能误读成偷窃。

本条可以关注“借走的乐器为什么没回来”，但若原片没有原因，切片只能呈现借用与未归还的矛盾，不在标题里先宣布欺骗。不同条目用不同问题和回报，不只是同一段换五个近义标题。
body.en:
video-script organizes perceptible changes rather than fixed-duration chunks. Establish entry, question and payoff. Motivation and acceptance terms are content too, not expendable setup before an exciting action.

Original instrument scene: a friend permits borrowing on condition of return before that evening’s performance. The instrument leaves, and the lender waits. Starting at removal can falsely suggest theft.

The question may concern the missing return, but absent cause footage cannot establish deception. Different clips need distinct questions and payoffs rather than five synonymous titles for one segment.

heading.zh: 把不能删的前提写进剪辑要求
heading.en: Record indispensable premises in the cut request

body.zh:
| 项目 | 本例填写 |
|---|---|
| 本条问题 | 借用承诺与演出前等待为何冲突 |
| 必留声音 | 同意借用、今晚演出前归还的完整台词 |
| 必留画面 | 拿走乐器，以及演出前朋友等待的实际反应 |
| 顺序 | 许可与条件先于拿走；等待是后续结果 |
| 可删部分 | 无新信息的路程、重复问候与空等待 |
| 尚未证实 | 没归还的原因，是否有意违约 |

制作时为必留区间写实际文件、原片时间、音频或视频职责；关键前提写明先后关系，不只在备注里说“保留逻辑”。剪点吸附或再次压时长后，复核这些区间仍被完整采用。

时间属于哪版原片与成片要清楚。不能把旧版本时码复制到换序后的新视频上，再声称证据已对齐。

在引用版本中，必保时刻写进同一剪辑计划的 `required_evidence`：本例把完整许可与归还条件登记为音频节点，交接与演出前等待登记为画面节点。每项用唯一标识、实际源文件、原片起止时间、音画职责与内容说明；先核素材再填写，不照抄示例时码。把许可先于交接、交接先于等待登记为本条必需顺序；只锁这些具体时刻，不锁整个场次。

video-cut 会在画面与句界吸附之后检查声明区间是否至少有一处完整连续保留、来源及顺序是否对应，缺段或错序会阻断。这个检查支持“计划没丢必保区间”，仍不能证明所填区间真含完整条件、或者最终音乐没有盖住对白；这些要按当前素材与成片听审。
body.en:
| Field | Example |
|---|---|
| Question | Why do the borrowing promise and pre-show wait conflict? |
| Required sound | Permission and complete evening-return condition |
| Required picture | Removal and the lender’s actual waiting response |
| Order | Permission before removal; waiting as later result |
| Removable | Uninformative travel, repeated greetings, empty waits |
| Unproved | Cause of nonreturn and deliberate breach |

For production, record actual file, source interval and audio/video role; specify required order rather than hiding it in a general note. Recheck adoption after snapped boundaries or further shortening.

Distinguish source and output clocks and versions. Old timestamps cannot verify reordered new footage.

In the pinned version, put required moments into the same plan’s `required_evidence`: permission and the complete return condition are audio nodes; handoff and pre-show waiting are video nodes. Give each a unique ID, actual source file, source start/end, track role, and content. Inspect footage before entering times rather than copying illustrative timestamps. Declare permission before handoff and handoff before waiting where required by this clip; lock these moments rather than the whole scene.

After visual and speech-boundary snapping, video-cut checks that declared intervals are retained completely and continuously at least once, with matching source and required order. Missing intervals or wrong order block the cut. This supports retention of declared intervals, but cannot establish that they truly contain the complete condition or that final music leaves speech audible. Check those against current source and output.

heading.zh: 按完整含义选入点与出点
heading.en: Choose boundaries around complete meaning

body.zh:
入点可以晚进，但不能省掉许可条件；出点可以早离开，但要让朋友的等待或回应读得出来。必要时回源多保留一点实际表演，不默认定格或慢放凑长度。

把两个场次并置时，交代时空变化，别拼成同场反应。竖屏取景先看说话者、乐器与关键手部，不能为维持中心人物而裁掉证明借用的交接。字幕、标题和花字也要避开这些信息。

正常速度播放接点前后，核完整声音与动作。检测出的短镜只是候选；相关反应不因短就删，无关残镜则回剪辑计划修，不用转场特效掩盖。
body.en:
Enter later without losing permission and exit earlier without swallowing the lender’s response. Retain actual source performance when more time is needed rather than freezing or slowing by default.

Clarify time and location when juxtaposing scenes; do not fabricate one continuous reaction. Vertical framing must retain speakers, instrument and evidential handoff. Titles and captions should avoid those areas.

Play around joins at normal speed for complete sound and action. A short-shot detector supplies candidates: useful reactions may remain; unrelated remnants require plan corrections rather than concealing transitions.

heading.zh: 逐条核兑现与未证实部分
heading.en: Review payoff and unproved claims for each clip

body.zh:
看完每条，写两句：观众实际看到了什么；还有什么只是怀疑。标题、花字和旁白与这两句比较，删超出证据的胜负、关系或动机判断。

批量切片检查重复观看理由，也检查共享镜头是否提供不同回报。每条保留自己的必需前提，不能因为全长视频交代过，就认为陌生切片观众已经知道。

最后完整看当前文件、逐接点看，再只听声音。若压缩后没法理解借用关系，回源补最短有效条件；若叙事已完整，就不因预设时长随意增加或删除表演。
body.en:
After each clip, state what viewers actually saw and what remains a suspicion. Compare titles, annotations and narration against those statements; remove unsupported victories, relationships or motives.

For a batch, compare viewing reasons and distinct payoffs even when footage is shared. Each clip needs its own essential premise; new viewers have not necessarily seen the full video.

Watch the current file, inspect joins and listen without picture. Restore the shortest necessary borrowing condition if compression breaks comprehension. Do not add or remove performance merely to reach a preset duration.

q.en: How long should a clip from a long video be?
q.zh: 从长视频剪出的片段应该多长？

a.en: Long enough to preserve its setup and payoff, short enough to remove irrelevant pauses. Let the idea determine the cut and confirm the current platform’s limits before publishing.
a.zh: 长度要足以保留铺垫与结果，也要删掉无关停顿。按内容决定剪辑，并在发布前确认当前平台限制。

text.zh: 请用 $video-recap 从长视频提出独立切片，逐条写问题、必留声音和画面、原片区间及先后关系。压时长只删无新作用部分，标题不越过证据，剪后正常播放复查。
text.en: Use $video-recap to propose independent clips with a question, required sound/picture, source intervals and order. Shorten only unneeded material, keep titles evidence-based and review the actual cuts at normal speed.

label.zh: 独立变化、证据区间与入出点
label.en: Independent changes, evidence and edit boundaries

label.zh: 短镜候选与正常播放复核
必保源区间与顺序的执行检查
label.en: Required source intervals and order checks

title.en: How to Write Video-Game Dialogue That Fits Play
title.zh: 游戏对白怎么写贴合玩法：结合角色声音、状态和操作

seo_title.en: Write Video-Game Dialogue
seo_title.zh: 游戏对白怎么写

description.en: Keep lines tied to character goals and game state, avoid narrating visible actions, and test dialogue in the actual interaction.
description.zh: 让台词连接人物目标和游戏状态，避免复述画面，并在实际操作中测试。

answer.zh: 先写角色要达成什么、知道什么、能用什么筹码，再让关键台词执行请求、拒绝、交换或承诺。主要交锋要有回应与后续影响；寒暄、沉默和日常不用句句升级。按实际事件触发对白，并同步字幕与配音，不让 NPC 统一替设计师解释任务。
answer.en: Define goals, knowledge, and leverage, then make crucial lines request, refuse, exchange, or promise. Major exchanges need responses and later effects; greetings, silence, and daily life need no upgrade in every line. Trigger dialogue from actual events and synchronize subtitles and voices without turning every NPC into a task manual.

heading.zh: 先列议程，避免 NPC 只讲说明书
heading.en: Start with agendas rather than instructions

body.zh:
game-world-design 的对白方法先写人物要求、顾虑、筹码、初始策略与受阻后换招。台词是行动的一部分，不能每句都只补背景。

沿用本页温室场景：站长需要明确谁承担供水恢复责任，园丁想保住北侧苗圃，玩家要得到阀门钥匙。站长掌握签字权限，园丁掌握钥匙和现场经验，两人对“足够证据”的要求不同。

先写行动链：玩家请求钥匙，园丁要求说明开过哪只阀，玩家选择现场检查或出示记录，园丁据此决定是否交钥匙。对白承担这次交换，操作说明另在必要时呈现。
body.en:
game-world-design begins dialogue with demands, concerns, leverage and strategies that change under resistance. Lines act rather than merely supplying background.

In the original greenhouse, the supervisor wants responsibility established, the gardener wants the north nursery protected, and the player needs a valve key. Signing authority and practical access give the two NPCs different leverage and evidence standards.

Plan the exchange: request the key, receive a demand for valve history, inspect the site or show a record, then obtain a response. Dialogue carries this bargain; essential controls can appear separately.

heading.zh: 把台词条件写成实际事件
heading.en: Use actual events as line conditions

body.zh:
| 项目 | 记录 |
|---|---|
| G-01 | 说话者与条件：园丁；玩家请求钥匙但尚未说明阀门；台词：“先告诉我你开过哪只阀。”；状态或下一步：开放现场检查与出示记录 |
| G-02 | 说话者与条件：园丁；本场实际见过旧记录，钥匙仍在园丁、玩家尚未持有；台词：“这道线是后来加的。钥匙给你，别先开北边。”；状态或下一步：交钥匙，提供顺序依据 |
| G-03 | 说话者与条件：园丁；玩家只检查了现场；台词：“先让我看你找到的接头。”；状态或下一步：进入核验，尚未交钥匙 |

玩家自己读过文件，不等于园丁见过。G-02 的条件来自“出示记录”的实际行动；不能用无关的好感分数代替这一知识来源。

编号把文案、字幕与语音对应起来，出现条件仍由游戏规则检查。表格是本页纸面设计，不代表已经接入引擎或运行通过。

**同一初态的完整纸面交互：**供水暂停，钥匙在园丁手中，玩家尚未开阀且只检查过现场。玩家手中有旧记录，园丁本场还未见；本例页边注记明确南边那条线为后加，并注明先南后北；沿用[温室任务设计](/novel-to-game/write-a-game-quest)的规则：先开南阀再开北阀，恢复供水并保住北侧备用水。

> 玩家：“先借我阀门钥匙。”
>
> 园丁：“先告诉我你开过哪只阀。”
>
> 玩家：“还没开。我把旧记录带来了，你看看这页。”
>
> 玩家实际选择“出示旧记录”。园丁接过纸页，看了页边注记，再指向南侧箭头。
>
> 园丁：“这道线是后来加的。钥匙给你，别先开北边。”
>
> 他把钥匙递到玩家手里。状态记录归属转移，出现按既定顺序前往阀柜的行动；此刻供水仍未恢复。
>
> 玩家再次请求钥匙。园丁看着玩家手中的钥匙：“你拿着呢，按刚才说的来。”

第二次请求没有再次发物件，也不把园丁变回“未见记录”。未出示的相邻路径仍可选择带他看接头，触发原G-03：“先让我看你找到的接头。”他同意查看后进入现场核验，钥匙暂留园丁；不能先写成已经交出，或借出示分支的注记知识收尾。两路后来做完各自规则才进入相应结果。

“钥匙给你”是对白表现，真正归属由规则提交的递交记录决定。只改句子而不改触发条件，重复播放仍可能重发；规则正确之后，感谢、提醒或沉默都可以按人物选择写，不为避免一句重复无限新增台词。
body.en:
| Item | Record |
|---|---|
| G-01 | Speaker / condition: Gardener; key requested without valve history; Line: “Tell me which valve you opened.”; State or next step: Inspection and showing records become available |
| G-02 | Speaker / condition: Gardener shown the record; key still with gardener, not held by player; Line: “That line was added later. Take the key. Don’t open north first.”; State or next step: Key handed over; sequence evidence given |
| G-03 | Speaker / condition: Player inspected only the site; Line: “Show me the joint you found first.”; State or next step: Verification begins; no key yet |

Private reading does not inform the gardener. G-02 reads the showing action, not an unrelated affection score.

IDs connect copy, captions and voices; game rules still verify conditions. This is a paper example, not an implemented or tested engine script.

**Complete paper interaction from one initial state:** Supply is paused; the gardener holds the key. The player has inspected the site but opened no valve and carries an old record the gardener has not seen in this scene. Its margin identifies the south line as a later addition and specifies south before north, following the [greenhouse quest](/novel-to-game/write-a-game-quest): open south then north to restore supply while preserving the north reserve.

> Player: “Lend me the valve key.”
>
> Gardener: “Tell me which valve you opened.”
>
> Player: “None yet. I brought the old record. Look at this page.”
>
> The player actually selects showing the record. The gardener takes the page, reads its margin, and points to the south arrow.
>
> Gardener: “That line was added later. Take the key. Don’t open north first.”
>
> He puts the key in the player’s hand. The state records transfer and offers travel to the valve cabinet in the established order. Supply remains unrestored.
>
> The player asks again. The gardener looks at the held key: “You have it. Follow the order we just discussed.”

The second request grants no additional object or reset to an unseen record. On the unshown route, the player may instead offer to show the joint, triggering the original G-03: “Show me the joint you found first.” Agreement enters site verification with the key still held by the gardener. Do not report transfer early or borrow the other route’s margin knowledge. Each route reaches its own result only after its requirements are completed.

“Take the key” presents dialogue; possession follows the rule-committed handover. Wording changes alone cannot stop duplicate grants from faulty conditions. Once state is correct, reminders, thanks, or silence may fit the character without limitless new lines merely to avoid one repetition.

heading.zh: 同一风险，两个人用不同筹码说话
heading.en: Let different leverage shape speech

body.zh:
供水暂停，站长说：“恢复以前，谁都不能签供水合格。”园丁说：“北边那排还剩半桶水，别等到根全干。”前者划责任边界，后者提出眼前损失，玩家分别获得权限与期限信息。

若改成两人轮流说“情况很严重，你必须尽快完成任务”，声音会合并，现场也没有新进展。修订时保留各自关注的实物与条件，让反对者能拒绝、要求证据或换策略，不让玩家每句请求都立刻成功。

按钮写玩家真正会说的话，例如“先借我钥匙，我带你去核接头”。不能显示“协商”，执行时却变成威胁。回应先呈现对方反应，再进入确实开放的新动作。
body.en:
“Nobody signs the water certificate before restoration,” says the supervisor. “The north row has half a bucket left. Don’t wait until the roots dry,” says the gardener. One sets responsibility limits; the other presents immediate loss. Players learn authority and urgency.

Replacing both with “This is serious; finish your quest quickly” removes distinction and progress. Preserve concrete concerns and conditions. Let resistance request evidence, refuse or change strategy instead of granting every request.

Buttons should represent actual speech: “Lend me the key; I’ll show you the joint.” A “Negotiate” label must not execute a threat. Show the reaction before offering newly available actions.

heading.zh: 对白太长时，先找哪句真的改变选择
heading.en: For long dialogue, find what changes the choice

body.zh:
对白方法把台词当人物行动，游戏文案方法保留原作语域与人物不整齐的说话方式。删解释不等于把每句话都剪成标准短句。

继续温室例：园丁需要知道玩家开过哪只阀，玩家需要钥匙。若他先讲温室成立以来的全部供水史、自己为什么负责苗圃、站长为什么谨慎，关键请求会被埋住。先保留“你开过哪只阀”，让玩家回应，再把目前选择确实需要的风险放到所对应的行动旁。旧事可以在玩家主动追问时展开。

不要把园丁的急话“北边那排还剩半桶水”统一修成“请注意目前资源紧张”。前句指出他盯着哪处损失，后句成了通用提示。站长的责任边界与园丁的眼前担忧各自成立，交换说话者后不应全部照旧。

长发言若正在施压、公开证据或改变听者选择，可以保留；沉默与闲聊也能让玩家感受人物。重点是主要交锋有没有重复同一招，而非每句话是否够短、每轮是否都涨一次数值。
body.en:
The dialogue method treats lines as character actions; game-copy craft preserves source register and uneven speech. Cutting explanation does not make every sentence a standardized short line.

Continue the greenhouse example: the gardener needs to know which valve the player opened; the player needs a key. A lecture on the entire water history, the gardener’s duties, and the manager’s caution buries that request. Keep “Which valve did you open?” and let the player answer. Place the risk needed now beside its relevant action. History may open through an active follow-up question.

Do not normalize “The north row has half a bucket left” into “Please note resources are limited.” The first names the loss this person watches; the second becomes a generic prompt. The manager’s responsibility boundary and gardener’s immediate concern differ. Swapping speakers should not leave all lines unchanged.

A long speech that applies pressure, exposes evidence, or changes a listener’s choice may remain. Silence and chat can also reveal people. Check whether major exchanges repeat one strategy, not whether every line is short or every round increases a value.

heading.zh: 用状态和实际播放复查台词
heading.en: Review dialogue against state and playback

body.zh:
正向走一条出示记录路线，再走没有出示的路线。园丁是否提前知道文件内容，钥匙是否重复发放，汇合处是否误说玩家已公开记录？这些先查触发与状态，再改句子。

修语言时删重复解释与没有新作用的来回，保留人物的称呼、急话或地方表达。交换说话者后仍完全成立的关键句，检查缺了目标、知识还是筹码，不用硬塞口头禅制造区别。

在目标视口与实际配音中检查关键请求能否读完、听全，选项是否被挤走。让 AI 只改指定台词编号，冻结条件和结果；采用后同步对应字幕与声音，再看当前版本。
body.en:
Walk a showing route and an unshown-record route. Check premature knowledge, duplicate keys and shared dialogue claiming disclosure that never happened. Repair triggers and state before polishing language.

Remove explanation and repetitive exchanges without erasing characteristic address, urgency or regional speech. If exchanging speakers leaves a key line intact, inspect missing aims, knowledge or leverage rather than adding catchphrases.

Check critical requests and choices in the target viewport and actual voice playback. Limit AI edits to specified line IDs while preserving conditions and results, then synchronize affected captions and voices.

q.en: Should game dialogue explain controls?
q.zh: 游戏对白要解释操作方式吗？

a.en: It can support a tutorial, but pair the line with an action and feedback so players can try the control. Avoid repeating instructions after players have demonstrated they understand.
a.zh: 可以辅助教学，但要把台词与操作和反馈配合，让玩家实际尝试。玩家已展示理解后，就别反复重复指示。

text.zh: 用 $game-world-design 为本场列人物议程、知识与筹码，再写条件化台词和实际选项。检查未见证者泄密、重复给予物件和汇合串线；文案修订只作用于指定编号。
text.en: Use $game-world-design to establish agendas, knowledge and leverage before conditional lines and actual choices. Check leaked knowledge, duplicate object grants and route contamination; constrain copy edits to specified IDs.

游戏文本与原作声口
前置、归属与表现层读取

title.en: How to Tell a Story Through a Game Environment
title.zh: 游戏环境叙事怎么做：让地点变化透露过去和选择

seo_title.en: Tell a Story Through Game Environments
seo_title.zh: 游戏环境叙事怎么做

description.en: Use object placement, damage, access, and repeated locations to show what happened and what players can infer.
description.zh: 用物件位置、破损、权限和重复地点展示发生过什么及玩家能推断什么。

answer.zh: 先决定玩家需要观察到的事实，再选物件、布局或痕迹承载它，区分可见证据、最小结论与尚未确定的解释。让发现支持下一步行动，并在实际视角中可读。水渍或划痕可以提示继续调查，不能单独证明作案人、动机或精确发生时间。
answer.en: Choose the observable fact players need, then carry it through objects, layout or traces. Separate evidence, the smallest supported conclusion and unresolved explanations. A discovery should support an action and remain readable from the actual viewpoint; wetness or scratches alone do not identify an actor, motive or exact time.

heading.zh: 环境细节先证明它能证明的事
heading.en: Keep conclusions within the evidence

body.zh:
game-world-design 的知识方法区分载体、直接支持的最小结论与未确定解释。写环境叙事时，先定事实，再挑痕迹，不让美术细节自动承担完整推理。

沿用原创温室：北墙灌溉牌写“停用”，接头下的托盘却有水。玩家观察到矛盾，可以检查接头和管路；还不能认定有人夜间偷偷供水。旧水残留、别处漏水或标牌过期，都需要进一步排除。

只有新增证据才能缩小解释。例如玩家看到接头此刻仍滴水，就确认它现在不是完全无水；要说谁开启、何时开启，仍需相应记录、见证或其它事实。
body.en:
game-world-design separates a clue’s carrier, minimum supported conclusion and unresolved interpretation. Establish the fact before choosing the trace; art detail does not automatically supply a complete deduction.

Original greenhouse: a north irrigation sign says “Disused,” yet a tray below the joint holds water. The discrepancy invites inspection. It does not prove secret nighttime use; residual water, another leak or an obsolete sign remain possible.

New evidence narrows explanations. Seeing the joint currently drip establishes water there now. An actor or earlier time still needs records, witnesses or other relevant facts.

heading.zh: 将观察、解释与行动分开记录
heading.en: Separate observation, inference and action

body.zh:
| 载体与观察 | 直接支持什么 | 仍未知与下一步 |
|---|---|---|
| 锁扣内侧有新擦痕 | 此处近期受过擦碰 | 谁碰过、是否开门：比较使用痕迹与记录 |
| 配电箱标签与接线不一致 | 标签不能直接指导操作 | 谁改过、哪个版本有效：先核线 |
| 空架尘印旁有拖痕 | 支持物件曾被移动的判断 | 移动者与目的：查出口和交接记录 |
| 灌溉接头眼前仍滴水 | 此处当前有水 | 水源与控制者：沿可访问管路核查 |

观察可支持怀疑，不必每次都给确定答案。若游戏希望一条痕迹唯一指向某个解释，先建立排除其它原因的条件，不能在结算页替玩家补此前看不到的设定。
body.en:
| Carrier and observation | Supports | Unknown and next action |
|---|---|---|
| Fresh marks inside latch | Recent abrasion here | Actor and opening remain unknown: compare use and records |
| Fuse labels differ from wiring | Labels cannot directly guide operation | Editor and valid version: verify before acting |
| Drag marks by empty shelf outline | Suggests an object was moved | Mover and purpose: inspect exit and handoff records |
| Irrigation joint dripping now | Water currently present | Source and controller: trace accessible pipe |

Evidence may justify suspicion without certainty. A uniquely identifying clue needs established conditions excluding alternatives, not invisible rules added at resolution.

heading.zh: 让观察改变下一次行动
heading.en: Let observation change available actions

body.zh:
玩家沿可访问的管路找到另一处仍在用水的苗圃，可以询问管理者，或把“停用牌与实际滴水不符”告诉管理员。报告的是已观察事实，不是已经证实的偷水指控。

随后有签署的供水记录，才可能确定使用时间与负责人；人物承认也需与证据及其可信度一起判断。环境可以承载一部分背景，准确姓名、操作条件或人物承诺则可由文字与对白补齐。

同一地点再次出现时，展示已发生的变化：阀门关闭、积水擦去、标牌更换。变化应来自游戏行动或已接受事件，不在玩家返回时无缘无故复位。
body.en:
Following an accessible pipe reveals another nursery using water. Players can question its manager or report the discrepancy between the sign and current dripping. They report observations, not a proved theft accusation.

A signed supply record can establish time and responsibility; an admission still needs context and evidence. Environments can carry history while text or dialogue supplies exact names, operating conditions and promises.

On return, show established changes: a closed valve, cleared water or replaced sign. Tie them to game actions or accepted events instead of unexplained resets.

heading.zh: 分别修发现难、推断错与行动不明
heading.en: Repair visibility, inference and guidance separately

body.zh:
让不了解设计答案的试玩者说明看见什么、推断什么、准备做什么。看不见就检查视角、光照、尺度和路线；推断过头就检查证据与解释层级；不知道下一步就检查可用动作与就近提示。

重要线索要在实际玩家视角可读，不只在美术大图里存在。装饰照片可以补气氛，不必每个物件都附真相旁白。需要精确字符的文件再安排可读视图，不靠模糊纹理承载姓名。

改编时逐条对到原作事实；新增线索是改编决定。换场景或光线后重看可见性，改线索后重走受影响推理路径，确保玩家获得的结论仍有依据。
body.en:
Ask an uninformed tester what they observed, inferred and plan to do. Repair visibility through angle, lighting, scale and path; unsupported inference through evidence scope; missing next actions through accessible options and local guidance.

Important clues must read from the actual player view, not merely an art sheet. Decorative photographs can add atmosphere without a truth caption on every object. Provide a readable document view for exact names instead of ambiguous texture.

Match source-derived clues to the novel and label additions as adaptation choices. Recheck visibility after location or lighting changes and replay deductions after evidence changes.

q.en: Can environmental storytelling replace dialogue?
q.zh: 环境叙事能完全替代对白吗？

a.en: It can carry some history and mood, but use direct text or dialogue when players need precise instructions, names, or a choice explained clearly.
a.zh: 它可以承载部分历史和氛围；玩家需要明确指示、姓名或选择说明时，仍应使用文字或对白。

text.zh: 用 $game-world-design 为环境线索写载体、可见观察、最小结论、未知解释与下一动作。对照原作事实，删除无证据的时间、动机或身份推断，再检查实际玩家视角。
text.en: Use $game-world-design to map clue carriers, observations, minimum conclusions, open explanations and next actions. Compare source facts, remove unsupported time, motive or identity claims, and inspect the actual player view.

label.zh: 证据层级与人物知识
空间与可读反馈

title.en: How to Playtest a Novel-to-Game Adaptation
title.zh: 如何测试小说改编游戏

seo_title.en: Playtest a Novel-to-Game Adaptation
seo_title.zh: 测试小说改编游戏

description.en: Test whether players understand the game's goals, source identity, choices, and story feedback without relying on your explanation.
description.zh: 测试玩家能否理解游戏目标、原作特色、选择与剧情反馈，而不依赖作者讲解。

answer.zh: 先按设计承诺写预期，再从实际交付入口完成启动、渲染、输入、核心行动、结果与重开。每项保留最小可观察证据，并选能区分规则的失败或边界路径。截图与运行成功不能证明结局正确；修复后重放原故障及相邻分支，检查状态与画面一起恢复。
answer.en: Write expectations from design promises, then run the actual delivered build through launch, rendering, input, core action, outcome and restart. Keep minimal observable evidence and meaningful boundary cases. After a repair, replay the failing path and a neighboring branch, checking state as well as presentation.

heading.zh: 先把设计承诺变成可判断的问题
heading.en: Turn design promises into checks

body.zh:
game-qa 的方法从六项可玩结果反推证据：能打开、实际呈现、输入生效、核心行动闭合、产生设计结果、重开恢复。目标环境与本次实际运行环境分别写明，不从浏览器成功推断另一设备已经验证。

沿用原创温室：玩家查管线、借钥匙、开阀并决定是否出示旧记录。测试前写预期：顺序影响余水；文件未出示时园丁不知内容；失败重开后恢复初始钥匙归属和调查状态。

重点来自此游戏的承诺，不是把每个点击都截图。人物是否有魅力、故事是否感人可以另外记录体验意见，不能用一次运行结果自动判定。
body.en:
game-qa derives evidence from six playable results: launch, actual rendering, effective input, a closed core loop, a designed outcome and restart. Record intended and tested runtimes separately; browser success does not verify another device.

Original greenhouse: inspect pipes, obtain a key, operate valves and decide whether to show a record. Set expectations first: order affects reserve; an unshown record remains unknown to the gardener; failure and restart restore custody and investigation state.

Focus on this game’s promises instead of screenshots for every click. Character appeal or emotional impact can be experience feedback, not automatic conclusions from a successful run.

heading.zh: 一条完整路径覆盖六项结果
heading.en: Cover six results through a complete path

body.zh:
| 检查 | 本例行动 | 需要观察的结果 |
|---|---|---|
| 启动 | 从交付入口开当前候选 | 正确版本在所记环境打开 |
| 渲染 | 进入温室 | 正文、场景与必要选项可读 |
| 输入 | 点击检查管线 | 对应动作被接受，不误触另一项 |
| 核心行动 | 调查、借钥匙、开阀 | 每步状态与反馈连接 |
| 结果 | 完成或触发已设计失败 | 余水、苗圃与人物回应符合选择 |
| 重开 | 从结果重新开始 | 恢复声明的初态，可再次行动 |

预期先写，实际结果由运行填写。保存版本、环境、初态、输入与终态；有随机机制再记录种子。关键动效和接镜正常速度观察，慢放用于定位，不能证明正常体验。
body.en:
| Check | Example action | Observe |
|---|---|---|
| Launch | Open the delivered candidate | Correct version in recorded runtime |
| Render | Enter greenhouse | Scene, text and required options readable |
| Input | Select pipe inspection | Intended action accepted |
| Core loop | Investigate, obtain key, operate | State and feedback connect |
| Outcome | Reach success or designed failure | Reserve, plants and responses match choices |
| Restart | Start again from outcome | Declared initial state restored; action possible |

Record expectations before observed results. Keep version, runtime, initial state, inputs and final state, plus a seed when randomness exists. Review motion at normal speed; slow playback locates faults rather than proving ordinary experience.

heading.zh: 原创故障：画面重开，状态没重开
heading.en: Original failure: the picture resets but state does not

body.zh:
纸面故障示例：失败后回到温室入口，背包却保留钥匙，任务日志仍写“检查完成”。第二次进入可以跳过调查开阀，说明重开只恢复了画面。下面为此原创温室补一套明确的教学初态与顺序，不是skill默认数值，也不是已经跑过的游戏。

初态：水量6单位，钥匙由园丁保管，玩家未检查管线，园丁不知道旧记录内容。本例必须先检查、借钥匙再开阀；错误顺序耗掉3单位并失败，正确顺序耗2单位并完成浇水。查看旧记录不等于向园丁出示。

| 重放步骤 | 要核对的结果 |
|---|---|
| 启动，检查管线，借钥匙 | 检查完成、钥匙在玩家处，水量仍为6。 |
| 按本例错误顺序开阀 | 水量变3、进入失败，园丁仍不知旧记录。 |
| 从失败选择重开 | 回温室入口，水量6、钥匙归园丁、未检查、未出示。 |
| 不检查、不借钥匙直接尝试开阀 | 因前置未满足拒绝，不消耗水，不生成成功结果。 |
| 再检查、借钥匙，按正确顺序开阀 | 水量变4，完成浇水；不出示记录时园丁仍不能说出内容。 |

若第三步背包与检查标记仍保留，记录“失败→重开后钥匙仍在玩家背包，调查标记仍为已完成”，附实际初态、输入、终态及对应画面。修复回到完整初态：物件、资源、知情与任务阶段，不能只删日志里的“完成”。

修后重放这条故障与拒绝路径，再用不出示记录的成功路线作相邻反例。二者共享温室初态，分别检验重开后的前置与角色知识。自然对白不是权限：园丁说出未获知文件内容仍是失败。实际候选的规则、输入和数字必须来自它自己的批准设计；本文表格只能说明如何选检查，不能替它填PASS。
body.en:
Paper failure: restart returns the picture to the greenhouse entrance, but the inventory retains the key and the log says inspection is complete. The second run skips investigation and operates a valve. The following explicit teaching state and sequence belong to this original example, not skill defaults or a game already tested.

Initial state: six water units, key held by the gardener, pipes uninspected and record contents unknown to the gardener. This design requires inspection and borrowing before valve operation. The wrong valve sequence spends three units and fails; the correct sequence spends two and waters the plants. Reading the record is not showing it to the gardener.

| Replay step | Expected result |
|---|---|
| Launch, inspect pipes, borrow key | Inspection complete, key with player, six water units remain. |
| Use the example’s wrong valve sequence | Three units remain; failure occurs; record contents stay unknown to the gardener. |
| Restart from failure | Entrance restored, six units, key with gardener, uninspected and unshown. |
| Attempt operation without inspection or borrowing | Reject unmet prerequisites without water consumption or a success outcome. |
| Inspect and borrow again, then use the correct sequence | Four units remain and watering succeeds; without showing the record, the gardener still cannot reveal its contents. |

If step three retains the key and inspection flag, report the exact failure-to-restart fault with actual initial state, inputs, final state and the corresponding view. Repair object custody, resources, knowledge and quest stage rather than deleting the displayed word “complete.”

Replay the failure and rejection path after repair, then the unshown-record success route as an adjacent countercase. Both share the greenhouse initial state but check restored prerequisites and character knowledge separately. Fluent dialogue grants no permission: revealing an unseen document remains a failure. The actual candidate’s rules, inputs and quantities must come from its own approved design. This worksheet explains choosing checks and cannot fill in a PASS for it.

heading.zh: 修复后重放故障，再看相邻路径
heading.en: Replay the fault, then a neighboring path

body.zh:
保留能复现问题的版本、初态与输入顺序，修复后先重放原失败路径，再选共享上游状态但走另一选择的反例。断言玩家能观察的结果，不只检查内部函数被调用。

只换台词或资产，通常可保持状态含义；若改变变量语义、节点或行动效果，需要迁移旧存档/日志，或明确拒绝旧版本，不能假装旧状态自然兼容。具体处理随项目决定。

沿用项目已有验证入口，把回归放进同一验证流程，避免另外堆重复的通过报告。报告保留实际未运行项和必要缺口；已通过的范围要能回到当前候选与相应证据。
body.en:
Keep the reproducible version, initial state and input sequence. After repair, replay the failing route and a neighboring choice sharing earlier state. Assert observable outcomes rather than merely internal function calls.

Copy or asset replacement may preserve state meaning. Changing variable semantics, nodes or action effects requires migration or explicit rejection of incompatible old saves or logs; choose the project-appropriate handling.

Use the project’s existing verification entry and include regressions in that flow rather than producing duplicate pass reports. Record unrun items and material gaps. Every claimed result must refer to the current candidate and its evidence.

q.en: Should playtesters know the original novel?
q.zh: 测试者需要读过原著吗？

a.en: Use both familiar and unfamiliar players when the audience includes both. Ask separate questions about adaptation recognition and whether the game works on its own.
a.zh: 目标受众包含两类人时，应同时测试读过和没读过原著的玩家。分别询问他们是否认出改编内容，以及游戏本身是否成立。

text.zh: 用 $game-qa 验证当前候选，在已选运行环境中从启动走到核心行动、结果与重开。以设计承诺写预期，保留最小证据，在同一验证入口加入原故障与相邻反例；未运行项如实记录。
text.en: Use $game-qa to verify the current candidate in its selected runtime from launch through core action, outcome and restart. Derive expectations from design promises and retain minimal evidence, including the reproduced fault and neighboring counterexample in the existing verification flow.

label.zh: 最小证据与有区分力的路径
真实候选与六项结果

title.zh: 人物背景怎么写：让过去影响眼前的选择
title.en: How to Write Character Backstory Without Stopping the Story

seo_title.zh: 人物背景怎么写：让过去影响眼前的选择
seo_title.en: How to Write Character Backstory Without Stopping the Story

description.zh: 用过去、现在、未来整理人物经历，再决定哪些背景需要进入正文。附原创场景、信息投放表和过度解释的改法。
description.en: Connect a character’s past to a present choice, then decide what the reader needs now. Includes an original scene, a reveal plan and revision checks.

answer.zh: 先分清人物完整经历和正文此刻需要的背景。可以从今天的选择、习惯、关系或人物正在感受的地方生活反查过去，再决定用短说明、对白还是回忆。背景不只是让选择变难，也能解释技能、兴趣和已经建立的信任；不要把每个人都压成一段创伤履历。
answer.en: Separate the full character history from what the passage needs now. Work back from a present choice, habit, relationship or experience of a place, then choose brief explanation, dialogue or a flashback. History can explain skills, interests and established trust as well as difficulty; it need not reduce every character to a wound.

heading.zh: 人物卡记完整，正文有选择地放
heading.en: Separate your character history from its use in the story

body.zh:
Oh Story 的角色方法把经历分成过去、现在和未来。写背景时，可以把这三项连起来：过去发生了什么，留下哪种习惯；现在遇到什么事，这种习惯有什么帮助和代价；未来哪次选择会检验它。

| 项目 | 记录 |
|---|---|
| 过去 | 原创人物：社区修车师傅罗宁: 年轻时答应替朋友检修刹车，却因赶工漏查，朋友摔伤; 正文用途: 解释他为什么不肯接受“先骑走，明天再修” |
| 现在 | 原创人物：社区修车师傅罗宁: 他必须在交租前完成大客户订单，但一位学生来修失灵的刹车; 正文用途: 让责任与生计真正冲突 |
| 未来 | 原创人物：社区修车师傅罗宁: 订单来不及全部完成，他要主动告知客户并承担损失; 正文用途: 检验他能否用诚实处理责任，而非靠独自硬扛 |

朋友的姓名、当年的学校和每次争执可以记在作者笔记里。若它们不影响当前选择，不必在人物第一次出场时一起交代。

“过去—现在—未来”帮助整理成因、当下关系和后续作用，是作者规划方式，不是要求三段都进正文。学徒时练出的耐心、一起完成过的普通工作、持续的兴趣也能留下习惯；本例选事故来解释刹车检查，不因此要求其他习惯也来自同一事故。
body.en:
Oh Story’s character method connects past, present and future. Record the event, the habit it left, the help and cost of that habit today, and a later choice that tests it.

| Item | Record |
|---|---|
| Past | Original character: Luo Ning, a bicycle mechanic: He rushed a friend’s brake repair and missed a fault; the friend was injured; Story use: Explains his refusal to let someone ride an unsafe bike |
| Present | Original character: Luo Ning, a bicycle mechanic: A large order must be finished before rent is due; a student arrives with failed brakes; Story use: Puts responsibility in conflict with income |
| Future | Original character: Luo Ning, a bicycle mechanic: He must tell the customer he cannot finish every bike on time and accept the loss; Story use: Tests whether he can take responsibility honestly rather than shoulder everything alone |

The friend’s school and every old argument can stay in your notes. They need not arrive with the character’s first appearance.

Past, present and future organize causes, current relationships and later use in the writer’s plan; all three need not appear in the passage. Apprenticeship, ordinary work done together and lasting interests also shape habits. The accident explains this brake check without owning every other trait.

heading.zh: 示例：先让人物行动，再补背景
heading.en: Example: let the past affect an action before explaining it

body.zh:
下面是为本文设计的虚构片段。

**背景先行：**

> 罗宁曾经因为疏忽害朋友受伤。从那以后，他对每辆自行车都格外认真，哪怕损失收入也不愿冒险。

这段信息明确，但如果接着再讲事故经过，眼前的订单就会停下来。可以先让旧经历作用于当前行动：

> 学生把五块钱放在台上。“能骑回家就行，明天再修。”
> 罗宁转了半圈前轮，捏住刹把，轮子还在走。他把钥匙留在台上。
> “别骑这辆回去。要留店修吗？钱先拿回去。”
> 学生说自己可以走回家，把钥匙推向他：“那明天我来取。”罗宁这才把钥匙放进标着学生姓名的暂存袋。
> 手机又响起来，大客户问最后六辆车装好了没有。罗宁没接，先往学生车的刹车线上套了一枚红签。

学生抱怨他小题大做时，可以用一句具体背景补足理解：“上回有人这么说，我就让他骑走了。”事故详情留到学生追问或旧友真正出场时。并非任何背景都必须藏起来；若读者已经无法理解人物在怕什么，直接交代必要事实比持续卖关子更好。

罗宁没接客户电话只是这段的停点，不证明客户已经同意延期。若继续写表中的未来检验，可以让他回电说明剩余六辆的进度，客户实际接受四辆先交、两辆延期；本例再登记双方已约定的扣款，而不是用“他负责了”跳过对方回应。钥匙暂存和明天取车的约定也不证明修理已经完成。
body.en:
This fictional passage is original to the article.

**History first:**

> Luo Ning once injured a friend through a careless repair. Since then, he inspected every bike thoroughly, even when it cost him money.

The information is clear, but a full accident account here would stop the order in progress. Let the history work through an action first:

> The student put a small bill on the bench. “Just enough to get home. You can fix it tomorrow.”
> Luo Ning spun the front wheel and squeezed the brake. The wheel kept turning. He left the bike key on the bench.
> “Don’t ride this one home. Want to leave it for repair? Keep the money.”
> The student said he could walk home and pushed the key over. “I’ll collect it tomorrow.” Only then did Luo place the key in a custody bag marked with the student’s name.
> His phone rang again: the customer wanted the last six bikes. He let it ring and tied a red tag to the student’s brake cable.

When the student protests, one line may supply enough history: “The last time someone said that, I let him ride away.” Save the fuller account for a question or encounter that needs it. If readers cannot understand what he fears, give them the necessary fact plainly rather than prolonging a mystery.

Leaving the customer’s call unanswered is the passage’s stopping point, not agreement to a delay. To develop the planned future test, have Luo call back with the six-bike status, the customer actually accept four first and two later, and the story record any agreed deduction. “He took responsibility” cannot replace that reply. Key custody and a collection plan likewise do not establish a completed repair.

heading.zh: 把后续选择写出来：客户是否真的接受延期
heading.en: Write the later choice: does the customer accept the delay?

body.zh:
沿用罗宁留修学生车后的场景。下面把原表中的未来检验展开成一个候选续段：最后六辆客户车中四辆装好，两辆仍待完成；延期扣款在这段交流中才由双方明确约定。它不是上段“没接电话”自动产生的结果。

> 罗宁把学生车的红签挂好，拨回客户电话：“最后六辆，现在装好了四辆。另两辆今天交不了，能改到明天下午吗？”
>
> “我今天就要用。”客户说。
>
> 罗宁没有许诺“马上全交”。“四辆今天按原时间送到。剩下两辆如果你同意等，我明天下午三点交；延期的两辆，每辆从这次尾款里扣十块。”
>
> 客户停了一会儿：“四辆先送。两辆明天三点，扣二十，写到交车单上。”
>
> 罗宁在单子上写下四辆今天交、两辆明日三点交，把二十元扣款也写上，拍给客户。对方回复“按这个”，他才把这张单子夹在待交四辆车的标记旁。

旧事故影响了他不肯让学生骑走，也让他这次选择直说实际进度。过去解释选择；对方的需求、拒绝和新约定仍有自己的分量，不能只写一句“客户理解了他”。

这段完成的是双方确认交车安排和扣款，还没有完成四辆送达、另外两辆修完或交租。是否获得客户长期信任，要看后面是否履约；不靠一次坦白立即换全部认可。原场景的学生车也仍处于留修状态，不被这通电话顺便修好。
body.en:
Continue after Luo Ning accepts the student’s bike. This candidate develops the future test in the original table: four of the customer’s last six bikes are assembled and two remain unfinished. The deduction becomes an actual agreement in this conversation, not a consequence automatically produced by ignoring the earlier call.

> Luo tied the red tag to the student’s bike and called the customer back. “Four of the last six are assembled. I can’t deliver the other two today. Could they come tomorrow afternoon?”
>
> “I need them today,” the customer said.
>
> Luo did not promise immediate completion. “The four will arrive at the original time. If you can wait for the other two, I’ll deliver them at three tomorrow and deduct ten yuan per delayed bike from this payment.”
>
> After a pause: “Send the four first. Two tomorrow at three, twenty deducted. Put it on the delivery sheet.”
>
> Luo wrote today’s four, tomorrow’s two and the twenty-yuan deduction on the sheet and sent a photo. Only after the customer replied “Agreed” did he place it with the four bikes marked for delivery.

The old accident affects both his refusal to let the student ride and his refusal to hide the order’s status. History explains a choice while the customer retains a need, objection and actual agreement. “The customer understood him” would skip that exchange.

The arrangement and deduction are confirmed. The four bikes have not yet arrived, the other two are not finished and rent has not been paid. Long-term trust depends on later delivery rather than being awarded for one admission. The student’s bike remains awaiting repair.

heading.zh: 用信息投放表安排背景出现的位置
heading.en: Plan each reveal around a present need

body.zh:
| 项目 | 记录 |
|---|---|
| 学生要求先骑走 | 读者需要知道: 罗宁曾放走过一辆不安全的车; 暂不交代: 事故全过程; 揭示后会改变什么: 学生更能理解建议，是否留修仍由他回应 |
| 大客户要求按时交付 | 读者需要知道: 他错过订单会付不起租金; 暂不交代: 多年经营史; 揭示后会改变什么: 留车的选择有可见成本 |
| 旧友回来找他 | 读者需要知道: 事故后两人多年没见; 暂不交代: 与本场无关的童年; 揭示后会改变什么: 罗宁无法再用忙碌回避道歉 |

删去一条背景试读：人物的选择还讲得通，就可以稍后放；选择像无缘无故，说明需要提前补。长回忆适合过去本身包含一个必须看清的决定；如果只需要说明原因，一句叙述或对话往往够用。
body.en:
| Item | Record |
|---|---|
| The student asks to ride home | What readers need: Luo once released an unsafe bike; What can wait: The complete accident; What the reveal changes: The advice is more understandable; leaving the bike still requires his reply |
| The customer demands delivery | What readers need: Losing the order threatens his rent; What can wait: Years of business history; What the reveal changes: Keeping the bike has a visible cost |
| The old friend returns | What readers need: They have not met since the accident; What can wait: Unrelated childhood; What the reveal changes: Luo can no longer avoid apologizing by staying busy |

Remove a fact and reread the choice. If it still makes sense, that fact can wait. If the action becomes arbitrary, reveal it sooner. Use a full flashback when an earlier decision must be experienced; a brief explanation is often enough when only the cause matters.

heading.zh: 背景写得多但人物仍然薄，怎么改
heading.en: Repair a detailed history that does not shape the character

body.zh:
- **所有习惯都由同一次创伤解释**：补一项来自职业、兴趣或日常关系的选择，让人物的生活不只剩事故。
- **每次坚持都重复讲同一段往事**：第一次建立原因，后续展示这项坚持在不同情境里的成本，不重复事故介绍。
- **以悲惨经历替伤人行为开脱**：让过去解释行为，同时保留受伤者的反应和人物应负的责任。
- **背景随剧情临时增加**：在人物卡记录已经公开的事实，新增经历要能与年龄、关系和时间线对上。

写完检查：过去是否改变了至少一个具体选择？读者是否在需要时获得信息？删去履历后，人物在场景里是否仍然可辨认？

往事也可以让读者理解性格、体验地方生活或关系余味，不要求每段背景都立即改一项动作。这里的当前选择法帮助安排信息，不把一生压缩成一个创伤原因。
body.en:
- **One wound explains every trait:** add a choice shaped by work, interest or an ordinary relationship. The accident should not consume the whole life.
- **Every refusal repeats the same history:** establish the cause once, then vary the cost of the principle in later scenes.
- **A painful past excuses harmful behavior:** keep the harmed person’s response and the character’s responsibility visible.
- **New history appears whenever the plot needs help:** record established facts and check additions against age, relationships and chronology.

Does the past change a concrete choice? Does the reader receive information when it becomes necessary? After removing the résumé, can the character still be recognized through action?

History can also deepen character understanding, local life, or relational afterglow without changing an action in every paragraph. The present-choice method organizes information rather than reducing a life to one wound.

q.zh: 人物背景要在第一章写完吗？
q.en: Must all backstory appear in chapter one?

a.zh: 不用。第一章先给理解当前目标和选择所需的信息。会影响以后行动的经历先记在人物卡，等相关压力出现时再放。
a.en: No. Give enough history to understand the immediate goal and choice. Record later-relevant experiences in your notes and reveal them when the pressure makes them matter.

q.zh: 人物一定要有童年创伤吗？
q.en: Does every character need childhood trauma?

a.zh: 不一定。职业训练、反复失败、一个被兑现的承诺、长期关系，都能影响人物。选择适合故事的成因，不为了“深度”强塞悲惨经历。
a.en: No. Training, repeated failures, a kept promise or a lasting relationship can shape behavior. Choose a cause that belongs to the story rather than adding misery to suggest depth.

text.zh: 可以对 story-long-write 说：“先只整理罗宁的人物背景方案。把过去、当前习惯和未来选择连起来，标出第一场需要交代的事实，不写正文。”确定后再请求相应章节。
text.en: Ask story-long-write to plan the character’s history first: connect past experience, present habit and a future choice; identify what the first scene must reveal, and stop before prose. Request the chapter separately once the plan is settled.

label.zh: 人物经历与选择
必要背景与叙事取舍
背景表达服从本书文风

title.zh: 小说配角怎么写：有自己的目标，也能推动主线
title.en: How to Write Supporting Characters Who Have Their Own Goals

seo_title.zh: 小说配角怎么写：有自己的目标，也能推动主线
seo_title.en: How to Write Supporting Characters Who Have Their Own Goals

description.zh: 从出场作用、独立目标、标志性行为与退场安排设计配角。附原创人物卡和同一场冲突中的三种选择。
description.en: Give supporting characters a story function, a goal of their own and a planned exit. Includes character cards and three choices in one conflict.

answer.zh: 先确认配角进入故事后会改变什么，再给他一个与主角不完全相同的目标。用具体选择和少量特征让读者记住他，提前安排其承诺何时兑现、何时退场。这样配角能帮助或阻碍主线，又不会只在主角需要时出现。
answer.en: Decide what the supporting character changes in the story, then give them a goal that does not completely match the protagonist’s. Make them memorable through a choice and a few recognizable traits. Plan when their promises pay off and when they leave.

heading.zh: 配角卡先填作用与目标
heading.en: Start the character card with function and goal

body.zh:
Oh Story 的配角卡先问功能、与主角的关系、核心特质、标志性特征和退场方式。创作时再加一句“他自己想得到什么”，能避免人物只负责送线索或夸主角。

以下人物和修车店故事均为原创：主角要在房租到期前完成一笔车队订单。

| 人物或问题 | 记录 |
|---|---|
| 学徒小陶 | 改变主线的作用: 指出主角忽略的交付缺口，也能承担部分检修; 自己的目标: 想独立完成第一辆车，不总被叫去拿工具; 可记住的行为: 每次检查后在红签背面记下结果; 本段结束后的去向: 订单结束后申请单独负责学生车 |
| 邻店老板许姐 | 改变主线的作用: 提供临时工作台，同时要求公平交换; 自己的目标: 自己的忙季不能被占用; 可记住的行为: 先把约定写在收据背面; 本段结束后的去向: 收回工作台，保留以后合作的关系 |
| 车队领队阿民 | 改变主线的作用: 代表车队确定接收优先级；维修复查由罗宁负责，只接收已确认可交付的车; 自己的目标: 第二天的比赛必须安全开跑; 可记住的行为: 逐辆捏刹车，不接受口头保证; 本段结束后的去向: 验收后带队离开，留下反馈而非常驻店里 |

功能让人物有出场理由，独立目标让他有拒绝和谈判的理由。两者不能互相替代。
body.en:
Oh Story’s supporting-character card asks for function, relationship, core traits, a memorable feature and an exit. Add “What do they want for themselves?” to keep the character from becoming a source of clues or praise.

These characters belong to an original story: a mechanic needs to finish a team’s bike order before rent is due.

| Item | Record |
|---|---|
| Tao, the apprentice | Main-plot function: Spots a delivery gap and can handle repairs; Personal goal: Wants responsibility for a complete bike; Recognizable behavior: Writes each test result on the back of a red tag; Where they go next: Asks to take charge of student bikes |
| Xu, the neighboring shop owner | Main-plot function: Offers a temporary bench on negotiated terms; Personal goal: Needs room for her own busy season; Recognizable behavior: Writes agreements on the back of a receipt; Where they go next: Reclaims the bench but remains a possible partner |
| Min, the team captain | Main-plot function: Sets the team’s receiving priority; Luo performs the final repair check before bikes become available; Personal goal: Needs safe bikes for tomorrow’s race; Recognizable behavior: Tests every brake rather than accepting assurances; Where they go next: Leaves with the team and later sends feedback |

Function explains the entrance; a personal goal explains refusals and negotiations. Both are necessary.

heading.zh: 同一压力下，让配角作出不同选择
heading.en: Use one pressure to reveal different priorities

body.zh:
**虚构场景**：晚上十点，六辆车还未检修。主角打算不吃饭继续做，希望所有人都留下帮忙。

> 小陶把第三辆车推到自己台前。“这辆我做，你最后复查。”
> 许姐没有坐下。“我十一点要收店。台子给你，货架上的东西别动。”
> 阿民看了看明天的名单，划掉两辆备用车。“先保四辆上场的。缺哪一步，直接告诉我。”

三个人都与主角合作，但合作的条件不同。小陶争取能力证明，许姐维护自己的营业边界，阿民改变交付优先级。主角仍要决定检修顺序并承担结果；配角提供新条件，不替他把全部难题解决。

三个人都关心主角并不等于功能重叠。若只有同一句安慰、没有不同信息或体验，再查是否需要合并或补独立目标；也可以保留共同照料的场景，不为制造区分而强加争执。

本例由罗宁负责最终维修复查，阿民选择车队先接收哪些已通过的车，两种职责分别成立。罗宁实际回应：“四辆优先，小陶做基础项目，我逐辆复查；借台到十一点，原货架不动。”许姐答应他按时归还工作台。此时只完成分工确认，不能提前写成四辆已验收、学徒已能独立签字或工作台已归还。
body.en:
**Fictional scene:** at ten at night, six bikes remain unchecked. The protagonist plans to skip dinner and wants everyone to stay.

> Tao rolled the third bike to his bench. “I’ll do this one. You give it the final check.”
> Xu stayed standing. “I close at eleven. Use the bench. Leave the stock on the shelves.”
> Min crossed two spare bikes off tomorrow’s list. “The four race bikes first. Tell me exactly what’s missing.”

All three cooperate on different terms: Tao seeks responsibility, Xu protects her business, Min changes the delivery priority. The protagonist still chooses the repair order and bears the result.

Shared concern does not itself make functions overlap. If there is only repeated reassurance without distinct information or experience, consider combining roles or developing independent aims. Shared care can also be the scene’s purpose, without adding conflict merely to distinguish people.

In this example Luo owns the final repair check, while Min selects which cleared bikes the team receives first. Luo replies: “Four first. Tao handles the basic work; I recheck each bike. The bench until eleven, and no touching the stock.” Xu agrees to that return time. This establishes the work arrangement, not four completed inspections, independent sign-off by Tao, or a returned bench.

heading.zh: 标志特征可以重复，选择不能原地打转
heading.en: Repeat a trait while changing what it costs

body.zh:
小陶总写检修记录，是一个辨认点。第一次可以被主角嫌慢；发现漏项时成为有用证据；后来独立负责车子时，他自己要为签字负责。重复的是行为，变化的是意义和责任。

不要每次出场都复述同一句口头禅，也不用用夸张外貌代替性格。先定一两项稳定特征，再让不同压力揭出其矛盾：许姐重视明算账，但可以主动给困难学生免一笔工钱；她自己作出的例外，比作者宣布“其实她很善良”更有分量。

主要配角的关系要能承接已有经历；相处与稳定陪伴也可以保留，不要求每次出场都产生新冲突。偶尔出现的支线人物，围绕一个鲜明目标或执念写清即可。篇幅与其实际作用相称。
body.en:
Tao’s habit of recording repairs is a recognition cue. At first the mechanic thinks it slows him down; later the notes reveal an omission; finally Tao must take responsibility for his own signed checks. The behavior repeats, but its meaning and cost change.

Do not repeat a catchphrase at every entrance or substitute extravagant appearance for character. Choose one or two stable traits, then expose tension within them: Xu values clear accounts but may waive a fee for a student. Her chosen exception carries more weight than “She was kind underneath.”

Recurring characters should inherit the relationship’s history; ordinary companionship can remain without a new conflict at each entrance. A brief visitor may need only a clear goal and a memorable choice. Give them space proportionate to their function.

heading.zh: 写清去向，处理抢戏与遗忘
heading.en: Plan departures and repair attention problems

body.zh:
| 人物或问题 | 记录 |
|---|---|
| 配角突然知道所有答案 | 先查: 信息从哪里来; 改法: 给他合理来源与知识边界，不让情报凭空出现 |
| 配角比主角更能决定主线 | 先查: 谁作关键选择、承担成本; 改法: 把主线决定交回主角，保留配角自己的局部决定 |
| 新人物越来越多 | 先查: 是否承担相同作用; 改法: 合并功能相近者，保留不同目标带来的必要分歧 |
| 配角后半本消失 | 先查: 已承诺的事情是否结束; 改法: 安排交接、完成、失败或有原因的离开 |

出场前能回答“为什么是这个人”；退场时能回答“他这段要做的事怎样了”。不必给所有人一个长结局，但不要留下无意遗忘的承诺。
body.en:
| Item | Record |
|---|---|
| A supporting character suddenly knows every answer | Check: Where the information came from; Repair: Establish a source and a knowledge boundary |
| They control the main story more than the protagonist | Check: Who chooses and pays; Repair: Return the main decision to the protagonist while keeping local choices theirs |
| The cast grows without need | Check: Who performs the same function; Repair: Merge overlapping roles; preserve necessary differences in goals |
| Someone vanishes halfway through | Check: Which promises remain open; Repair: Show completion, failure, handover or a reason for leaving |

At the entrance, answer “Why this person?” At the exit, answer “What happened to their task?” Everyone need not receive a long epilogue, but accidental disappearance leaves a promise unpaid.

q.zh: 配角需要完整人物弧光吗？
q.en: Does every supporting character need a complete arc?

a.zh: 不需要。经常出现并影响主线的人，应有能持续发展的目标与关系；只承担一场作用的人，清楚的选择、特征与去向就够。
a.en: No. A recurring, consequential character needs developing goals and relationships. A one-scene character may only need a clear choice, trait and departure.

q.zh: 配角太多，优先删谁？
q.en: Which character should I cut from an overcrowded cast?

a.zh: 先看功能重叠和关系重叠。删掉后没有任何决定、信息或后果改变的角色，优先合并；不要仅凭台词少就删掉唯一能完成重要行动的人。
a.en: Check duplicated functions and relationships. Merge someone whose removal changes no decision, information or consequence; do not cut the only person able to perform an important action merely because they speak little.

text.zh: 对 story-long-write 说：“先只做配角方案。每人填主线作用、自己的目标、与主角的分歧、标志行为和退场方式；指出可合并的人物，不写章节。”
text.en: Ask story-long-write for a supporting-cast plan only: each person’s function, own goal, disagreement with the protagonist, recognizable behavior and exit. Request suggestions for overlapping roles without drafting chapters.

label.zh: 配角卡与出退场
配角功能与行为反差

title.zh: 小说对白提示语怎么写：说话标签、动作和停顿的取舍
title.en: Dialogue Tags and Action Beats: When to Use Each

seo_title.zh: 小说对白提示语怎么写：说话标签、动作和停顿的取舍
seo_title.en: Dialogue Tags and Action Beats: When to Use Each

description.zh: 什么时候保留“他说”，什么时候省略或改成动作？用原创改前改后对照，处理说话者不明、动作堆砌与节奏机械。
description.en: Use tags to identify speakers and action beats to change the scene. Original before-and-after examples address unclear attribution and repetitive gestures.

answer.zh: “他说”先负责让读者知道谁在说话，不需要每次换一个华丽动词。说话者清楚时可以省略；动作改变物件、关系或决定时才值得插入。停顿要对应人物正在考虑、等待或拒绝的事，不必给每句对白配表情。
answer.en: A dialogue tag first identifies the speaker; it need not use a different ornate verb each time. Omit it when attribution is clear. Add an action beat when it changes a possession, relationship or decision. Let pauses belong to a real hesitation, wait or refusal rather than decorating every line.

heading.zh: 先判断这句旁白需要完成什么
heading.en: Choose the form by its job

body.zh:
Oh Story 的行文方法明确保留普通“说”，需要处理的是机械重复和高频公式化标签；对话方法也指出，句句配动作会让行文机械。可以按下表判断：

| 需要 | 记录 |
|---|---|
| 不知道谁在说 | 优先选择: 简单说话标签或姓名; 示例: “钥匙留下。”许姐说。 |
| 两人交替很清楚 | 优先选择: 直接对白; 示例: “明早几点？”“七点。” |
| 控制权改变 | 优先选择: 有后果的动作; 示例: 她把钥匙收进口袋。“明早我开门。” |
| 人物暂不答应 | 优先选择: 等待、具体动作或沉默; 示例: 阿民没有伸手接单。“刹车试过了吗？” |
| 普通一问一答 | 优先选择: 不补多余表演; 示例: 不必在每句后写抬眼、皱眉或点头 |

动作可以顺带标明说话者，但角色做动作并不自动等于他在说。多人在场时，若可能误读，直接点明名字。
body.en:
Oh Story’s prose method keeps ordinary “said” and targets mechanical repetition. Its dialogue method warns that attaching a gesture to every line makes the rhythm mechanical. Choose by the missing information:

| Need | Record |
|---|---|
| Speaker identity | Use: A simple tag or name; Example: “Leave the key,” Xu said. |
| Nothing: two speakers alternate clearly | Use: Bare dialogue; Example: “What time?” “Seven.” |
| A change in control | Use: A consequential action; Example: She pocketed the key. “I’ll open tomorrow.” |
| Acceptance is uncertain | Use: A meaningful wait or refusal; Example: Min did not take the invoice. “Have you tested the brakes?” |
| An ordinary exchange | Use: No added performance; Example: Do not attach a nod or frown to every answer |

An action can help identify a speaker, but movement alone does not always make attribution clear. In a group scene, name the speaker when needed.

heading.zh: 改前改后：删表情，保留局面变化
heading.en: Before and after: keep changes, remove decorative gestures

body.zh:
以下修车店对话为原创。

**改前：**

> “四辆都能交吗？”阿民皱着眉问道。
> “还差最后一辆。”罗宁深吸一口气回答。
> “那先给我三辆。”阿民点了点头说道。
> “不行，要先试车。”罗宁抬起眼，坚定地说道。

四次动作都在强调已能从台词读出的态度，没有改变交车条件。

**改后：**

> “四辆都能交吗？”阿民问。
> “还差最后一辆。”
> 阿民把三辆车的钥匙从台上拢过来。“先给我这三辆。”
> 罗宁压住最外面那把。“试过再走。”

第一句点清说话者，第二句在双人交流中可以省标签。后两个动作改变钥匙控制权，把“着急交车”和“先保证安全”的分歧落到同一件物品上。不是因为“压住”比“说道”更高级，而是这个动作确实影响下一步。

这里的钥匙动作使交车在这场停下来，不表示车或钥匙的所有权改变，也不证明已经完成检修。对照表是作者的行文选择卡，不是 skill 原生对白格式；简单标签、无标签对白和动作按归属与场景用途取舍，不以数量决定质量。
body.en:
This bike-shop exchange is original.

**Before:**

> “Are all four ready?” Min asked with a frown.
> “One left,” Luo replied, taking a deep breath.
> “I’ll take three.” Min nodded.
> “Not before a test ride,” Luo said firmly, lifting his eyes.

Every gesture repeats an attitude already present in the words. None changes the delivery terms.

**After:**

> “Are all four ready?” Min asked.
> “One left.”
> Min gathered three keys from the bench. “I’ll take these.”
> Luo pinned the nearest key under his hand. “Test rides first.”

The first tag establishes the exchange; the next line needs none. Gathering and stopping the keys alter control and make the disagreement physical. The action earns its place because it affects what happens next.

The key action pauses the handover within this scene; it does not transfer ownership or establish a completed repair. The comparison is an editorial prose card, not a native dialogue format. Choose a simple tag, no tag, or an action by attribution and scene function rather than by a count.

heading.zh: 长对白与多人场景怎么安排停顿
heading.en: Handle long speeches and group exchanges

body.zh:
长台词里可以插入对方拒绝、物品被拿走、声音打断或人物自己改口。若动作没有改变说话条件，只是“喝了口水继续说”，不必按固定间隔塞进去。说明性内容读者已经知道时，可以用一句叙述带过；关键谈判仍应保留双方的拉扯。

多人场景每次换发言对象时重新确认归属。比如许姐从门口插话，先写“许姐在门口说”，比连写三句无标签对白后让读者倒回去猜更顺。动作和对白的相邻位置也要清楚，别把一个人的动作写在另一个人的台词后面，却没有说明是谁在动。

停顿的长短由场景决定。钥匙被压住后，阿民要衡量比赛时间；这段等待有内容。普通报时中插入反复沉默，只会延迟信息。
body.en:
Interrupt a long speech when the listener refuses, an object changes hands, a sound intervenes or the speaker revises their position. Do not insert a drink or glance at fixed intervals merely to break the paragraph. Summarize explanations the reader already knows; keep the negotiation that changes terms.

In a group scene, re-establish attribution when a new person enters the exchange. “Xu called from the doorway” is easier to follow than several untagged lines that make readers guess. Keep the ownership of nearby actions clear too.

Let the pause have content. After Luo stops the key, Min weighs the race schedule. Repeated silence during a simple request for the time only delays information.

heading.zh: 第三人插话：重新点明归属，不给每句加动作
heading.en: A third speaker enters: re-establish attribution

body.zh:
沿用修车店的阿民和罗宁，接在罗宁压住钥匙之后；原文提到的许姐这时从门口插话。七点半截止与十分钟试车是作者为这段续例选定的时间。她提供期限，罗宁负责试车，阿民等候，三人不用轮流做表情。

> 许姐在门口说：“比赛签到七点半就停了。”
>
> “试一圈要多久？”阿民问罗宁。
>
> “十分钟。你愿意等，试完能交的先交。”
>
> “我等。”阿民松开拢钥匙的手，退到一旁。
>
> 许姐问：“第四辆呢？”
>
> 罗宁把台上三把钥匙留在自己这边。“还没修完，今天不交。”

第一句姓名与位置建立第三人，阿民的问题明确交给罗宁，下一句因此可以省标签。阿民退开给试车留下空间；许姐再次插问时点名，罗宁保留钥匙对应交车条件。本段只达成等候和先试车，尚未完成试车或交车。若把所有名字都删掉，三人轮换就容易被误当成两人交替；若每句都加点头皱眉，也没有新增归属或信息。
body.en:
Continue the bike-shop exchange after Luo stops the key. Xu, already mentioned in the original discussion, now speaks from the doorway. The author selects seven-thirty closing and a ten-minute ride for this continuation. Xu supplies timing, Luo handles test rides and Min waits; they need not perform a gesture at every turn.

> “Race check-in closes at seven thirty,” Xu said from the doorway.
>
> “How long for a lap?” Min asked Luo.
>
> “Ten minutes. If you wait, you can take whichever bikes pass.”
>
> “I’ll wait.” Min released the keys he had gathered and stepped aside.
>
> “And the fourth?” Xu asked.
>
> Luo kept the three keys on his side of the bench. “Not repaired yet. That one stays today.”

The first line establishes the third speaker. Min addresses Luo, so the reply can omit a tag. Min’s movement makes room for testing. Name Xu on her next interruption; Luo’s keys maintain the handover condition. They have agreed to wait and test, without completing either testing or delivery yet. Removing every name can make three speakers look like two alternating; repeated nods and frowns add no useful attribution.

heading.zh: 一遍修改只查归属、作用与密度
heading.en: Revise attribution, purpose and repetition

body.zh:
1. 只读对白，标出不知道谁说的地方，补最短的必要标签。
2. 圈出所有动作，问它是否改变了注意、关系、物件或选择；只是翻译语气的重复动作优先删。
3. 看剩下的标签是否连续用同一种公式；保留自然的“说”，把真正重要的转折写具体。
4. 正常速度朗读整段，确认停顿没有打散一句完整意图，也没有把关键反应删掉。

“说”出现多不自动等于差，少也不自动等于好。改完应更容易知道谁在争什么，而不只是标签数量变少。
body.en:
1. Read only the dialogue and mark uncertain speakers. Add the shortest necessary attribution.
2. Circle actions. Keep those that change attention, relationships, objects or choices; remove gestures that only translate the tone.
3. Check for a repeated tagging formula. Keep natural “said” and make meaningful turns specific.
4. Read the passage aloud at normal pace. Ensure pauses do not fragment an intention or erase a necessary response.

Many instances of “said” are not automatically bad; few are not automatically good. The revision should make it easier to follow who wants what, not merely reduce a count.

q.zh: “他说”是不是都要删？
q.en: Should I delete every “said”?

a.zh: 不用。归属不清时保留最简单的标签。优先删机械重复、重复解释语气的部分，不拿动作强行替换每个“说”。
a.en: No. Keep a simple tag when attribution needs it. Remove mechanical repetition and redundant descriptions of tone without replacing every tag with a gesture.

q.zh: 每句对白都加动作会更有画面吗？
q.en: Does a gesture after every line make dialogue more visual?

a.zh: 通常会机械。动作应有场景作用，比如收回钥匙、拒绝签字、退出门口；其他地方让对白和必要的上下文自己推进。
a.en: Usually it makes the passage mechanical. Give actions a scene function—taking back a key, refusing a signature or leaving the doorway—and let dialogue carry the rest.

text.zh: 把原段交给 story-long-write，并限定：“只改这一段对白的归属提示和重复动作，不改台词事实、人物决定或场景结果；改后指出保留动作的作用。”
text.en: Give story-long-write the passage and limit the request to attribution and repetitive action beats. Preserve dialogue facts, decisions and the scene outcome; ask it to explain the purpose of retained actions.

label.zh: 说话标签与行文
动作密度与对白节奏
主语重置与动作连续性
按本书表达选择保留事实

title.zh: 不可靠叙述者怎么写：事实、误判与隐瞒要分清
title.en: How to Write an Unreliable Narrator With Fair Clues

seo_title.zh: 不可靠叙述者怎么写：事实、误判与隐瞒要分清
seo_title.en: How to Write an Unreliable Narrator With Fair Clues

description.zh: 区分真诚误判与有意隐瞒动机，给可疑叙述建立事实表。附原创两种版本、揭示步骤与公平性自查。
description.en: Separate mistaken interpretation from withheld motives. Use a fact ledger, two original versions and a reveal that survives rereading.

answer.zh: 先决定叙述者哪里不可靠：他看见了事实却解释错，还是如实叙述行动却没有说出动机。把客观事实、人物解释和最终真相分别记下，关键线索提前让读者见到。揭示后改变的是旧事实的意义，不能把此前明确写出的事实临时推翻。
answer.en: Decide whether the narrator misinterprets what they witness or truthfully reports actions while withholding a motive. Track fact, interpretation and truth separately. Show important clues before the reveal; change their meaning rather than overturning previously established facts.

heading.zh: 先选不可靠的方式，别在中途换规则
heading.en: Choose the kind of unreliability before drafting

body.zh:
Oh Story 的短篇视角反转以“叙述者真诚相信自己的判断”为方法；悬疑题材卡另允许凶手或共谋叙述者如实记录动作、暂不解释动机。这是两种不同安排，不能把第一种的误判写到结尾才改成第二种的装傻。

| 项目 | 记录 |
|---|---|
| 真诚误判 | 正文应给什么: 看到或听到的事实，以及人物当时的判断; 可以保留什么: 尚未接触的信息; 需要避免: 人物早就知道真相却装不知道 |
| 隐瞒动机 | 正文应给什么: 真实发生的动作与可回查的细节; 可以保留什么: 行动背后的目的; 需要避免: 明确否认自己确实做过的事 |

本篇采用这两种 skill 支持的方法。它们不代表所有文学作品的不可靠叙述规则；这里的目标是让反转在回看时仍成立。
body.en:
Oh Story’s viewpoint-reversal method uses a narrator who sincerely believes their interpretation. Its suspense genre card separately permits a culprit or accomplice to report actions truthfully while withholding motive. Do not draft sincere ignorance and abruptly reveal that it was a deliberate performance all along.

| Item | Record |
|---|---|
| Sincere misjudgment | Give readers: Observed facts and the narrator’s interpretation; May withhold: Information they have not encountered; Avoid: Pretending not to know an established truth |
| Withheld motive | Give readers: Real actions and details that can be rechecked; May withhold: Why those actions were taken; Avoid: Explicitly denying something they actually did |

These are the two methods supported by the cited skill, not universal rules for every literary use of unreliable narration. The aim here is a reveal that holds up on rereading.

heading.zh: 原创示例：同一组事实的两种叙述
heading.en: Original example: two narrators, one set of facts

body.zh:
虚构故事里，咖啡店收银员只看见一份投诉的开头，没有通读，认为经理正在找理由辞退自己。经理收走了排班表，又约她关店后谈话。

| 项目 | 记录 |
|---|---|
| 投诉信没有写员工姓名 | 误判版本的解释: “一定是在说我”; 最终证据: 原信投诉的是店里坏掉的报警器 |
| 经理收走排班表 | 误判版本的解释: “他在删我的班”; 最终证据: 表上标记的是谁愿意临时值守等维修工 |
| 关店后才谈 | 误判版本的解释: “不想当着同事辞退我”; 最终证据: 经理先前让她等维修预约结果 |

**真诚误判版：**“他把排班表折起来，我的名字留在折痕边上。我只盯着那一行，就认定他要删掉我的班。”这是当时看见的事实和推断；她没有看见的纸角内容不在这一刻由第一人称报出。后来经理摊开同一张表，请她通读先前原信；她这才读到‘等维修回电’和报警器故障，经理说明关店后商量的是愿意等待维修的人，回电确认预约后再定。

**隐瞒动机版**可另选一名叙述者：收银员的同事确实递交了报警器投诉，却希望迫使经理推迟开店，好让自己完成一场面试。他可以写“我把信放到办公室门缝下”，不解释动机；不能写“我没有交过投诉”。前文应出现面试预约和他打听维修时长的行为，结尾再连起目的。

两个版本不能混成一个角色忽而无知、忽而全知。选定后，把其知识边界维持到底。

同事的面试是他希望推动延期的动机，不等于经理已经接受延期或面试已经完成；报警器有故障也不自动使他的全部说法可信。两版分别选定后，都沿已写动作和实际回复展开。
body.en:
In this fictional café story, a cashier reads only the beginning of a complaint and fears it is an excuse to fire her. The manager removes the rota and asks to speak after closing.

| Item | Record |
|---|---|
| The complaint names no employee | Mistaken interpretation: “It must mean me”; Later evidence: The original concerns a broken alarm |
| The manager takes the rota | Mistaken interpretation: “He is cutting my shifts”; Later evidence: It records who can wait for the repair visit |
| The talk is after closing | Mistaken interpretation: “He wants to fire me privately”; Later evidence: He is waiting for the appointment to be confirmed |

**Sincere version:** “He folded the rota. My name stayed at the edge of the crease. I watched that line and decided he meant to remove my shifts.” This reports what she saw and inferred, without first-person knowledge of an unseen corner. Later the manager unfolds the same rota and asks her to read the earlier letter fully. She then reads “Await repair callback” and the alarm fault. He explains that the closing-time discussion concerns who is willing to wait for a repairer, with the appointment to be settled after the callback.

**Withheld-motive version:** choose a different narrator, the coworker who submitted the alarm complaint to delay opening and attend an interview. They can say “I slipped the letter under the office door” without explaining why. They cannot say “I never submitted a complaint.” An interview appointment and questions about repair times should appear before the motive is connected.

Do not combine the versions into a person who alternates between sincere ignorance and complete knowledge. Maintain the chosen knowledge boundary.

The coworker’s interview motivates the hoped-for delay; it does not establish that the manager delayed opening or that the interview occurred. An actual alarm fault also does not validate every claim. Develop either chosen version through its written actions and replies.

heading.zh: 揭示要有证据，也要迫使人物行动
heading.en: Make the reveal supply evidence and force a response

body.zh:
先让误判或隐瞒参与一次重要决定：指责、承诺、离开或错误合作。随后用已存在的人、物件或证词纠正解释。最后让人物处理自己造成的后果。

收银员看见原信后，不能只用一句“原来我误会了”收尾。本例可以继续写她在群聊撤回指责，贴出已读的故障条目；维修方回电确定时间后，经理问谁愿意留下，两名同事实际答应，经理再发等待安排。若选择信任受损线，就写经理明确告诉她：这次维修通知由经理发；她接受这个当次安排。误判的后果由已发生的行为决定，不要求每个故事都加一项惩罚，也不能把道歉写成大家已经原谅。

隐瞒动机的同事也不能凭解释获得自动原谅：报警器确实需要修，目的里却有个人算计。结尾可以保留他对自己“做了好事”的辩解，同时让读者看见别人如何评价。事实与自我解释仍分开。
body.en:
Let the misunderstanding or concealment influence an important accusation, promise, departure or alliance. Correct the interpretation with an existing person, object or testimony. Then make the narrator handle the consequences.

The cashier should do more than say “I was mistaken.” The example can continue with her retracting the accusation in the group chat and posting the fault passage she has read. After the repairer confirms a time, the manager asks for volunteers; two coworkers agree, and he issues the waiting arrangement. If choosing a damaged-trust thread, have him explicitly say that he will send this repair notice, and have her accept that immediate arrangement. Consequences follow actual behavior rather than mandatory punishment, and an apology does not establish forgiveness.

The coworker’s explanation should not produce automatic forgiveness either. The alarm needs repair, but personal calculation shaped the complaint. They may still insist they did a good thing while readers see how others judge it. Keep fact and self-justification separate.

heading.zh: 回看检查：读者有没有被作者作弊
heading.en: Check whether the reveal cheats the reader

body.zh:
- 把所有“肯定”“从来没有”“我知道”圈出来，核对是否把推测写成硬事实。
- 给每条关键消息标注亲见、转述、推断或隐瞒动机，检查叙述者能否在当时获得它。
- 用真相重读早期场景，动作和物件应能对上，不只靠结尾解释补漏洞。
- 如果真相必须新增此前完全不存在的人或记录，优先提前铺设必要证据。
- 删掉结尾说明，再看读者是否能从已出现的线索拼出核心真相；太含糊就补线索，不把谜底全部提前说破。

不可靠来自这个人的认知或议程，不来自作者随时改事实。
body.en:
- Circle absolutes such as “definitely,” “never” and “I knew.” Check that inference has not become hard fact.
- Mark each key statement as witnessed, reported, inferred or motive withheld. Could the narrator access it then?
- Reread early scenes with the truth in mind. Actions and objects should fit without a final speech repairing holes.
- If the truth needs a previously nonexistent person or record, establish the necessary evidence earlier.
- Remove the final explanation. Readers should still be able to connect the core truth from clues already present; add evidence if needed without announcing the solution.

Unreliability belongs to the person’s perception or agenda, not to facts the author changes at will.

q.zh: 不可靠叙述者一定是坏人吗？
q.en: Must an unreliable narrator be a villain?

a.zh: 不一定。恐惧、愿望、有限经验都可能造成真诚误判。要写清其盲区如何影响观察和选择，不把判断错直接等同于恶意。
a.en: No. Fear, desire and limited experience can produce sincere mistakes. Show how the blind spot shapes observation and choice without equating error with malice.

q.zh: 可以一直藏到最后才给关键线索吗？
q.en: Can I save every key clue for the final reveal?

a.zh: 若真相完全依赖最后新增的证据，回看很难成立。关键事实提前出现，先容许另一种解释，结尾再用已有证据改变意义。
a.en: A truth that depends entirely on new final evidence rarely rewards rereading. Present important facts earlier under a plausible interpretation, then change their meaning with established evidence.

text.zh: 对 story-short-write 说：“只设计叙述方案，不写正文。分别列客观事实、叙述者当时知道什么、他的解释和最终真相；选择真诚误判或隐瞒动机，给出提前出现的公平线索。”
text.en: Ask story-short-write for a narration plan only: objective fact, knowledge at the time, interpretation and eventual truth. Choose sincere misjudgment or withheld motive and identify fair clues that appear before the reveal.

label.zh: 视角反转与公平铺垫
悬疑叙述者的动机隐瞒

title.zh: AI写小说提示词怎么写：任务、细纲与知识边界
title.en: How to Prompt AI to Write a Novel Chapter

seo_title.zh: AI写小说提示词怎么写：任务、细纲与知识边界
seo_title.en: How to Prompt AI to Write a Novel Chapter

description.zh: 把任务范围、章节情节点、人物状态和禁止提前揭示的信息交清楚。附可复制提示词、填写范例和有针对性的返修写法。
description.en: Give the AI a defined task, chapter beats, current character state and limits on what may be revealed. Includes a filled prompt and focused revision requests.

answer.zh: 先说清要规划、写正文还是改一段，再给这次必须发生的情节点、人物当前状态、上一段停点和不能提前透露的信息。文风用短样本说明，缺的故事事实让 AI 列出待补项。提示词应把作者已定内容和可自由发挥的细节分开，避免一句“写得精彩”让模型自行改剧情。
answer.en: State whether you want planning, prose or a local revision. Supply required beats, current character state, the previous stopping point and information that must remain unrevealed. Use a short style sample and ask for missing facts to be identified. Separate settled story decisions from details the model may invent.

heading.zh: 先定任务，再给本次用得上的材料
heading.en: Define the task before assembling relevant material

body.zh:
Oh Story 的单章写作方法先检查细纲、读取相关人物与设定、承接上一章结尾，再明确本章意图。手动组装方法也把任务范围放在最前，而不是先堆一长串“你是一位知名作家”的角色要求。

| 材料 | 记录 |
|---|---|
| 任务 | 需要回答的问题: 规划还是正文？哪一章或哪一段？停在哪里？; 不必默认塞入: 与这次无关的全书任务 |
| 情节点 | 需要回答的问题: 哪些事必须发生？顺序和结果定了吗？; 不必默认塞入: 未批准的新支线 |
| 当前状态 | 需要回答的问题: 谁在场、知道什么、手里有什么？; 不必默认塞入: 每个人物完整生平 |
| 衔接 | 需要回答的问题: 上一段最后发生了什么？; 不必默认塞入: 整本旧稿全文 |
| 信息边界 | 需要回答的问题: 哪个真相现在不能揭示？; 不必默认塞入: 后文全部结局细节 |
| 表达 | 需要回答的问题: 视角、节奏、短样本、字数范围; 不必默认塞入: 相互矛盾的泛用风格口号 |

材料少而准确，通常比很多互相冲突的要求更可执行；如果某条旧设定会影响本章，仍必须给到，不能为了短就省略。
body.en:
Oh Story’s chapter workflow checks the outline, reads relevant characters and setting, connects to the previous ending, and defines the chapter’s purpose. Its manual assembly method puts the task and scope first rather than beginning with elaborate role praise.

| Material | Record |
|---|---|
| Task | Question to answer: Planning or prose? Which chapter or passage? Where must it stop?; Do not include by default: Unrelated whole-book tasks |
| Beats | Question to answer: What must happen, in what order, with what outcome?; Do not include by default: Unapproved subplots |
| Current state | Question to answer: Who is present, what do they know and hold?; Do not include by default: Every character’s full biography |
| Connection | Question to answer: What happened at the previous stopping point?; Do not include by default: The entire earlier manuscript |
| Knowledge limit | Question to answer: What truth must remain unrevealed?; Do not include by default: Every later ending detail |
| Expression | Question to answer: POV, rhythm, a short sample and length range; Do not include by default: Conflicting general style slogans |

Relevant, accurate material is easier to execute than a long contradictory brief. Brevity does not justify omitting an old fact that affects the scene.

heading.zh: 可复制提示词：把作者已定和可发挥分开
heading.en: A filled prompt that separates decisions from freedom

body.zh:
以下故事为原创示例；字数范围是作者的本次要求，不是通用标准。

> 本次只写第 4 章正文，中文 1800—2200 字，不接着写第 5 章。视角跟随修车师傅罗宁。
>
> 上一章停点：阿民提出先交三辆车，罗宁压住钥匙，要求试车后再走。
>
> 必须发生：阿民解释比赛开场时间；罗宁让学徒先做已安排的基础检查，发现第二辆刹车线松动，尚不安排它试骑；首辆与第三辆通过基础检查后，罗宁亲自复查并完成上一章要求的试车，确认本例已设交付条件满足；他说明延误原因，阿民实际接受先交这两辆。不要改变这个结果。
>
> 人物状态：罗宁知道修不完会失去部分工钱，但不肯放走不安全的车；小陶会做基础检查，尚不能独立签最终验收；阿民知道比赛安排，不知道罗宁旧事故。钥匙仍在柜台上，三辆车尚未交付。
>
> 暂不揭示：不要在本章说出罗宁旧事故的完整经过，也不要让阿民突然知道它。
>
> 可以补：基础检查与已允许试车中的短动作、与检修有关的一次性物件细节。新增长期人物、改事故真相或改交付结果，先列建议，不写进正文。
>
> 文风参考：附上我自己写的短段。保留对话的自然语气，不给每句配动作，也不用结尾感悟替人物收场。章尾停在阿民准备带走两辆车时，接到比赛地点临时更改的电话。
>
> 交付后对照必发生事项逐项指出落点；缺必要事实时先列待补项。

在能读取文件的工作区，提供真实文件路径并明确要读取；在普通聊天里，贴相关摘录。路径名本身不能代替内容，也不要假定模型看过未提供的文件。

本例检查顺序是作者已选情节，不是自行车维修教程。学徒发现问题不自动获得最终验收能力；阿民接收意愿也不替代罗宁实际复查与已要求的试车；第二辆未修好、未通过检查时不让它进入试骑。章尾仍停在准备带走两辆、接到地点变更电话，不提前宣布已经骑到新地点。
body.en:
This is an original story example. The length range is this author’s request, not a universal standard.

> Write chapter 4 only, in 900–1,200 English words, following bicycle mechanic Luo Ning. Do not continue into chapter 5.
>
> Previous stopping point: Min asked to take three bikes. Luo stopped the keys and required test rides first.
>
> Required events: Min explains the race start time; Luo has the apprentice perform the arranged basic checks, identifying a loose brake cable on the second bike before any ride of that bike; after the first and third pass their basic checks, Luo personally rechecks them and carries out the test rides required in the previous chapter against the example’s established delivery conditions; he explains the delay, and Min actually accepts those two first. Preserve this outcome.
>
> Current state: Luo risks losing part of his fee but will not release an unsafe bike. Tao can perform basic checks but cannot sign final acceptance alone. Min knows the race arrangements, not Luo’s old accident. The keys remain on the counter; no bike has been delivered.
>
> Do not reveal: the complete old accident or knowledge of it that Min does not have.
>
> May invent: brief actions in the basic checks or already authorized tests, plus one-use repair details. Suggest, rather than silently add, recurring characters, a changed accident truth or a different delivery outcome.
>
> Style: use my attached original sample. Keep natural dialogue; do not attach gestures to every line or end with a moral summary. Stop as Min prepares to take two bikes and receives a call changing the race venue.
>
> After the draft, identify where each required event appears. List missing necessary facts before drafting if needed.

In a workspace with file access, supply real paths and ask for them to be read. In ordinary chat, supply relevant excerpts. A path name alone does not give access to its contents.

This check order is an author’s plot choice, not a bicycle repair tutorial. Finding a fault does not give the apprentice final acceptance capability, and Min’s willingness does not replace Luo’s recheck or the required rides; the second bike does not enter a ride before its fault is repaired and checks are passed. The ending remains at preparation to take two bikes and the venue-change call, without declaring arrival at the new venue.

heading.zh: 返修提示词指出缺在哪里，不只说“再精彩些”
heading.en: Use revision requests that name the actual defect

body.zh:
| 成稿问题 | 更具体的返修要求 |
|---|---|
| 学徒突然成了检修专家 | “小陶只能基础检查。只改超出其能力的动作，把最终验收交回罗宁。” |
| 旧事故提前说破 | “删除完整事故解释，保留罗宁不放车的选择；不要新增替代秘密。” |
| 每段都在感叹压力 | “合并重复说明租金压力的段落，保留一次明确代价；不删基础检查发现。” |
| 字数不足但情节点完整 | “先指出哪处场景还没展开，不新增主线事件；我选定后再补写。” |
| 结尾接着写下一章 | “停在比赛地点变更的电话，不展开新地点。删去越过停点的部分。” |

返修时给原文和范围，说明哪些台词事实、选择与结果要保留。若缺的是细纲里的必要事件，先补遗漏；若只是想增加字数，不让模型用新剧情填满。
body.en:
| Draft problem | Focused request |
|---|---|
| The apprentice becomes an expert | “Tao only performs basic checks. Revise actions beyond that ability and return final acceptance to Luo.” |
| The accident is revealed early | “Remove the full accident account but keep Luo’s refusal. Do not invent a replacement secret.” |
| Every paragraph repeats the pressure | “Merge repeated rent explanations, keep one clear cost, and preserve the basic-check discovery.” |
| The draft is short but covers the beats | “Identify underdeveloped scene work without adding a main event. Wait for my choice before expanding.” |
| The ending continues into the next chapter | “Stop at the venue-change call. Remove the new-location sequence.” |

Supply the original passage and revision boundaries. Preserve settled facts, choices and outcomes. Restore missing required events first; do not fill a length target by inventing plot.

heading.zh: 用 skill 时说明创作意图，不手动复刻内部流程
heading.en: Use the skill through an author-facing request

body.zh:
在已经配置好的 Oh Story 工作区，可以直接说：“用已有细纲写第 4 章，只写这一章；按本书文风，停在比赛地点变更的电话。”技能会按自己的写前与检查流程处理材料。本页模板用来帮助作者交清事实和边界，不要求作者复制技能内部的字段或脚本步骤。

第一次使用时，先确认工作区里确实有本书的设定、细纲和续写状态。缺材料就先补规划，不在不知道上一章结果时强行续写。交稿后至少检查必发生事项、人物知识和停点；格式或检测结果不能替代这三项阅读判断。

本页是面向作者的简报，不是 `writer_prompt.md` 的完整原生组装格式。所引 `writer-prompt-fallback.md` 仅在组装脚本不可运行或作者明确不用脚本时使用；数据错误应先修复，不能靠复制本页绕过。普通聊天里的提示词也不能代替项目部署、实际读取或追踪提交。
