Write three planning lines: what the declaration should change, what answer the speaker fears, and what the listener needs to preserve. The speaker cannot prewrite the response; the listener is not a reward that nods on cue.

heading.zh: 直接表白之后，接住对方真正说的话
heading.en: Follow a clear declaration with a responsive exchange

body.zh:
**泛用誓言：**“你是我生命里唯一的光，我永远都会守护你。”这句话可以放进任何情侣身上，没接住他们当前的关系。

**原创改写：**

> 梁宜说：“我不是只想和你排练。我想周日也见你。”
> 贺闻看了一眼手机上的班表。“这周不行，我还没换到班。”
> “那你想不想？”
> “想。等班表定了，我来约你。但领唱那件事，你别为我放弃。”

答话先碰到现实限制，追问再把限制与心意分开。最后一句回应她已有目标。这里的迟疑不是误会工具；她确实获得了清楚回答与下一步约定。句间可按需要留动作和停顿，不必每句配表情。
body.en:
A generic vow such as “You are my only light; I will always protect you” could belong to any couple and misses their present relationship.

Original revision:

> “I don’t only want to rehearse with you,” Liang said. “I want to see you on Sunday.”
> He checked his rota. “Not this week. I haven’t changed my shift.”
> “But do you want to?”
> “Yes. I’ll ask when the rota is settled. Don’t give up the solo for me.”

The answer meets a practical limit; the question separates availability from desire. His last line responds to her established goal. Hesitation supplies a real condition, not an artificial misunderstanding. She receives an answer and a next step. Use gestures or pauses where useful, without attaching one to every line.

heading.zh: 把“等班表定了”写成能回应的下一步
heading.en: Turn “When the Rota Is Settled” into an Answerable Next Step

body.zh:
几天后，班表确定。下面接上原对白，不把同一晚的承诺剪成已经约会：

> 贺闻发来消息：“下个周日我休息。你下午还练领唱吗？五点散步，来得及就约那时。”
>
> 梁宜回：“我先按原安排练。五点可以，排练楼门口见。”
>
> “好，我来找你。”
>
> 到下个周日，梁宜先完成自己的领唱练习。贺闻五点到门口，她把谱放回包里，和他沿河走了一段。
>
> “下次轮到我来约。”她说，“先问你班表。”
>
> “行。”他没有把“想见你”说成她以后都该空出周日。

他们明确相约并实际见面，排练之外的认识开始了；领唱目标与工作仍在。一次赴约只证明这次履约，不等于永远没有时间分歧，也不替他们决定所有亲密行为。

若贺闻后来说无法赴约，就让他主动说明，再由梁宜答应另约或拒绝；不要仅用“班表还没定”无限延期。如果写拒绝路线，应改此前回答及后续距离，而非保留“想”与已答应见面，再让旁白说双方从未表态。
body.en:
Several days later the rota is settled. Continue the earlier exchange without turning that night’s promise into an already completed date:

> He messages: “I’m off next Sunday. Are you still practicing the solo that afternoon? Could we walk at five, if that works?”
>
> Liang replies: “I’ll practice as planned. Five works. Outside the rehearsal building.”
>
> “Good. I’ll meet you there.”
>
> The next Sunday Liang completes her own solo practice first. He arrives at five; she puts away the score, and they walk along the river.
>
> “My turn to ask next time,” she says. “I’ll check your rota first.”
>
> “All right.” Wanting to see her has not made every Sunday his to claim.

They have agreed and actually met, beginning to know each other outside rehearsal while work and her solo goal remain. One date proves this kept agreement, not freedom from all future scheduling differences or consent to every intimate act.

If he later cannot attend, let him say so and let Liang accept another date or refuse rather than indefinitely recycling “the rota isn’t settled.” A refusal route changes the earlier answer and later distance; it cannot retain “yes” and an accepted date while narration insists neither ever answered.

heading.zh: 让回答改变下一场的相处
heading.en: Make the answer affect the next encounter

body.zh:
接受之后可以写一次真实约会、新的联系习惯或如何处理工作冲突；不要下一场仍把彼此当无变化的搭档。暂缓则写明原因与后续条件，不无限回到同一句“以后再说”。拒绝也要影响距离与期待，同时允许双方继续有自己的生活。

若告白显得突兀，补之前的主动靠近和理解，不用临时增加救命恩情。若对白只有一方长篇独白，让听者的顾虑与选择进入。若已经说清还强制造误会，检查是不是作者在拖延应有的关系结果。

最终问：谁冒了什么风险，谁有权作出回答，回答之后什么真的变了？这些比誓言的长度更能支持一场有分量的告白。
body.en:
After acceptance, show a date, changed contact habits or a practical conflict they handle together. A delay needs a reason and a condition, rather than endlessly repeating “later.” Refusal changes distance and expectation while leaving each a life beyond the relationship.

For an abrupt confession, establish earlier initiative and understanding instead of adding a sudden rescue debt. For a long monologue, bring the listener’s concern into the exchange. If explicit understanding leads immediately to another forced misunderstanding, check whether the story is avoiding its earned consequence.

Ask who risks what, who can answer, and what changes afterward. Those questions support weight better than the length of a vow.

q.zh: 告白对白一定要含蓄吗？
q.en: Must confession dialogue be indirect?

a.zh: 不一定。告白的任务往往就是结束心意不明，直接的话也可以有张力。让语气符合人物，把犹豫放在真实成本、回应与后续选择上，不为潜台词而说不清。
a.en: No. A confession often resolves uncertainty. Direct language can carry tension when voice, cost, response and consequences are credible. Do not preserve obscurity merely to add subtext.

text.zh: 请 story-long-write 按本书文风审阅告白：分开关系名称与实际好感，核对各自目的、真实回答及后续邀请、接受和履约。对白回应可由话语、动作或停顿承接，不强制每句配反应；保留拒绝或暂缓的有效选择，不新增背景。
text.en: Ask story-long-write to review the confession in the book’s style: status versus affection, each purpose, the actual answer, then invitation, acceptance, and follow-through. Words, gestures, or pauses may carry replies without a reaction attached to every line. Retain effective refusal or delay without inventing backstory.

label.zh: 关系进度与行为边界
场合、议程与情绪回应
本书表达选择与事实边界

title.zh: 小说序章怎么写：先判断是否真的需要
title.en: How to Decide Whether Your Novel Needs a Prologue

seo_title.zh: 小说序章怎么写：先判断是否真的需要
seo_title.en: How to Decide Whether Your Novel Needs a Prologue

description.zh: 判断序章是否提供第一章需要的叙事信息。附原创渡口故事、保留与合并对照及背景说明的修订办法。
description.en: Test whether a prologue supplies necessary narrative context. Includes an original ferry story, keep-or-merge comparisons and exposition repairs.

answer.zh: 先试着从第一章开始读：理解眼前选择没有障碍，就不必强加序章。要保留时，让序章以一个短而完整的事件提供必要信息，并与第一章形成紧密因果。不要先写世界史、设定词典或空泛预言，再等待正文开始。
answer.en: Try beginning with chapter one. If the present choice is understandable, a prologue may be unnecessary. If retained, give it a brief narrative event supplying essential information and a close causal connection to chapter one. Avoid opening with a world history, glossary or vague prophecy.

heading.zh: 先做一次删除序章的试读
heading.en: Test the opening without the prologue

body.zh:
Oh Story 的开篇方法对连载开头采取克制取舍：序章要以叙事为主、足够简短，并与第一章逻辑紧密。这是网文开篇的编辑方向，不是宣布所有形式的小说都不能使用序章。

原创故事：第一章里，渡口管理员夏遥接到一艘无人船，船上有一张盖着她父亲印章的旧通行票。她父亲多年失踪。读者只需知道她认得印章以及为什么在意，就能理解她接下来的核查。

如果序章只是讲父亲以前当过船员，可以把必要事实放进认票的时刻。删去后行动仍清楚，就省掉一个入口。信息重要，不等于必须提前独立成章。
body.en:
Oh Story’s serial-opening method treats prologues cautiously: narrative, brief and closely connected to chapter one. This is an editorial direction for web-serial openings, not a ban across all fiction forms.

Original story: ferry administrator Xia Yao receives an empty boat carrying a passage ticket stamped with her missing father’s seal. Knowing that she recognizes it and cares about his disappearance is enough to understand her investigation.

If a prologue only explains that he was once a sailor, move the necessary fact into her recognition of the ticket. When removal preserves understanding, spare readers another entry point. Important information does not automatically require a separate chapter.

heading.zh: 保留时，让一个事件造成正文的难题
heading.en: Let a retained event cause the chapter-one problem

body.zh:
另一种版本里，序章写父亲失踪前最后一次当班：他发现通行票的目的地被改过，决定留下自己签过的那张，而不是按惯例销毁。故事停在他把票交给可信任的人，具体去向仍未知。

第一章再让票随无人船回来。前一事件留下了眼前证据，读者知道票为何值得核查，却仍不知道是谁送回、为什么现在送回。两个入口通过同一行为后果连接，不靠“多年后命运开启”总结意义。

这个版本只是一种原创设计。若留票的原因能在后面发现，序章仍可以删除。选择保留，要看提前知道这项行为是否改善第一章的判断或期待，不是为了多塞一段悬念。

### 把序章和第一章连着读

沿用父亲留票、可信任的人接收、多年后票随无人船回来。为让票面可比较，教学候选补选两个虚构目的地“东埠”和“西埠”；票上已签的东埠被改成西埠，改动者与送回者都未揭晓。下面是选择保留序章时的两个相接片段，不是必须放进每本书的模板。

序章候选：

> 夏遥的父亲翻到当班最后那叠通行票，停在自己签过的一张。东埠被划过，上面改成西埠，印章仍是他的。
>
> 旧友把惯例销毁用的匣子推近：“这叠也收了？”
>
> 他把那张抽出来，没有往匣子里放。“这张留着。目的地改过，我不知道谁改的。”
>
> “交回去查？”
>
> “先替我保管，别和这一叠一起毁。”他把票递给旧友，等对方接稳，才松手。
>
> 旧友把票单独收起。匣子合上时，那张不在里面。

第一章候选：

> 无人船靠到渡口，夏遥在舱内座板上看见一张旧票。她取出来，印章朝上，先认出了父亲常用的那个印。
>
> 他失踪多年。她看过家里留的旧票，认得这处印记，却不知道眼前这张怎样上了船。
>
> 东埠划过，改成西埠。她没有把认出印章当成父亲还活着的证明，先按本例渡口流程记下来船和票面，请值班人核对旧票册。
>
> 值班人看过她记的内容，答应取这份获准核对的旧册。夏遥把票留在眼前，等对方拿来；是谁送回、为何现在送回，仍没有答案。

读者提前见过“留下而不销毁”的决定，第一章接住的是这件物的回返；夏遥没有看过序章，不能自动知道父亲当时把票交给谁。认印提供她愿意查的理由，不包办票的来路、父亲生死或改票责任。

若不保留序章，第一章的认印、失踪与申请核对仍足够建立眼前行动；留票过程可以在查证时另揭示。比较两个版本时，看提前知道父亲主动留票是否让阅读更有期待，别只因为序章更神秘就采用。地点、座板、旧友和核对响应是本例展开时的教学安排，真实书稿按已有事实取舍。
body.en:
In another version, the prologue shows the father’s final shift. He finds that a ticket’s destination was altered and retains the copy he signed instead of destroying it as usual. It ends when he entrusts the ticket to someone; its route remains unknown.

Chapter one returns it on the empty boat. The earlier action creates present evidence. Readers know why checking it matters, while sender and timing remain questions. The connection comes from a consequence, not a summary announcing destiny.

This is one original option. If discovering the retention later works better, omit the prologue. Keep it when advance knowledge improves chapter-one judgment or expectation, not merely to add another mystery.

### Read the prologue directly into chapter one

Keep the father retaining the ticket, a trusted person receiving it and its return years later on an empty boat. To make the text comparable, this teaching candidate adds two fictional destinations, East Landing and West Landing. East is crossed out and changed to West on the signed ticket; changer and sender remain unknown. These are linked passages for the version retaining a prologue, not a template every book must use.

Prologue candidate:

> Xia's father reached the final stack of passage tickets from his shift and stopped at one he had signed. East Landing was crossed out and replaced with West Landing. His seal remained.
>
> An old friend pushed the box used for routine destruction closer. “This stack too?”
>
> He drew that ticket out instead of putting it in. “Keep this one. Someone changed its destination. I don't know who.”
>
> “Return it for inquiry?”
>
> “Hold it separately first. Don't destroy it with the stack.” He offered the ticket and let go only after his friend took it securely.
>
> The friend put it aside. When the box closed, that ticket was not inside.

Chapter-one candidate:

> The empty boat reached the ferry. Xia found an old ticket on a seat board in its cabin, lifted it seal-side up and recognized her father's usual mark.
>
> He had been missing for years. She had seen tickets kept at home and knew the mark, but did not know how this one had reached the boat.
>
> East Landing crossed out, West Landing written above. Recognition was no proof that her father lived. Under this fictional ferry's procedure, she recorded boat and ticket, then requested comparison with the old ticket register.
>
> The duty worker examined her entry and agreed to retrieve the register authorized for this inquiry. Xia kept the ticket before her while waiting. Sender and reason for returning it now remained unanswered.

Readers have seen the decision to retain rather than destroy; chapter one receives its consequence. Xia did not see the prologue and cannot automatically know whom her father entrusted. Recognition motivates inquiry without resolving provenance, survival or responsibility for alteration.

Without a prologue, recognition, disappearance and a request to check still orient the present action. Retention can emerge through later inquiry. Compare whether advance knowledge of that choice improves anticipation instead of keeping the prologue merely because it is mysterious. Destinations, seat board, friend and response are teaching choices for this expansion; an actual manuscript follows established facts.

heading.zh: 用信息用途决定独立、合并或后移
heading.en: Choose whether to keep, merge or delay information

body.zh:
| 序章内容 | 处理与依据 |
|---|---|
| 渡口百年沿革 | 合并必要一句，其余后移；当前认票不需要完整历史。 |
| 父亲留下票的具体决定 | 可以保留短事件，也可后揭示；看提前知道是否改变第一章期待。 |
| 和主线无关的追逐 | 删除或等到真正有用途；激烈不等于因果相关。 |
| 正文稍后完整重演同一事件 | 比较两次新增信息；无新判断时避免重复开头。 |

只保留本场会用到的人物与规则。读者需要知道谁在作决定、阻力是什么、结果留下什么，不需要记住全部组织名称。

序章结尾和第一章开头连着读。若像两本书，先补真正的因果连接，或选其中更有效的一处开始；不要只加一句过渡旁白掩盖断裂。
body.en:
| Material | Treatment and reason |
|---|---|
| A century of ferry history | Merge one useful fact and delay the rest; recognition does not need the full history. |
| The father’s decision to retain the ticket | Keep briefly or reveal later; does advance knowledge change expectation? |
| An unrelated chase | Remove until it has a function; intensity is not causality. |
| An event fully replayed later | Compare new information; avoid repeating the opening without changed judgment. |

Include people and rules needed for this event. Readers need the decision, resistance and residue, not every organization’s name.

Read the ending directly into chapter one. If they feel unrelated, repair the actual causal link or begin at the stronger point. A transitional narration cannot conceal a missing connection.

heading.zh: 修订只热闹、不带入正文的序章
heading.en: Repair a prologue that delays the real opening

body.zh:
若序章靠谜语吸引，却看不出任何人在做什么，补一个可辨认的目标与行动；秘密可以暂不揭示，场景本身不能失去方向。若第一章又花很久交代同一背景，决定信息由哪一处承担，删重复说明。

若序章人物暂不再出现，要让他的行为结果先进入主线；否则读者会在换到陌生主角时重新寻找关注点。不要为了强连接把所有人物硬说成亲属，也不必将结局高潮搬来提前剧透。

篇幅由必要事件决定，没有适用于所有小说的固定字数。本文的方法主要针对需要尽快建立人物与追读理由的连载开头；其他叙事形式可以有不同取舍，但仍应能说明序章为阅读增加了什么。
body.en:
When riddles conceal what anyone is doing, add a recognizable goal and action. A secret can remain unresolved while the scene retains direction. If chapter one repeats the background, choose where each fact belongs and remove duplication.

When a prologue character disappears, let the consequence of their act enter the main story first. Otherwise readers must rebuild investment around an unrelated protagonist. Do not force family connections or move the climax forward merely to create a link.

Length follows the necessary event, not a universal word count. This method primarily serves serial openings that need early orientation and a reason to continue. Other forms allow different choices, but should still identify what the prologue contributes.

q.zh: 序章必须用未来高潮作开头吗？
q.en: Must a prologue show a future climax?

a.zh: 不必。先判断提前看见会不会削弱后续期待。序章可以是造成第一章问题的过去事件，也可以完全省略；别把激烈场面当成使用序章的理由。
a.en: No. Test whether seeing it early weakens later expectation. A prologue can show an earlier cause of chapter one, or be omitted. Intensity alone does not justify one.

text.zh: 请用 story-long-write 比较有序章和无序章两个开头。说明每条信息的用途、与第一章的因果连接和重复处，给出保留、合并或后移方案，不追加设定。
text.en: Use story-long-write to compare openings with and without this prologue. Identify each fact’s function, its causal link to chapter one and duplication. Suggest keeping, merging or delaying without adding lore.

label.zh: 连载序章取舍与信息投放
label.en: Serial prologue choices and opening information

label.zh: 章节目标与场景结果
把节点与状态变化演成场景
label.en: Dramatize beats and changes of state

label.zh: 本例选择、文风与事实边界

title.zh: 英文视频怎么翻译配音成中文：逐句对齐原画面
title.en: How to Dub an English Video into Chinese

seo_title.zh: 英文视频怎么翻译配音成中文：逐句对齐原画面
seo_title.en: How to Dub an English Video into Chinese

description.zh: 先核对英文转写与逐句译文，再回到原时间窗配音。附原创工具演示、对照表与当前单说话者模式的限制。
description.en: Verify the English transcript and sentence translations before dubbing into the original windows. Includes an original demo and current workflow limits.

answer.zh: 先逐句核对英文原文、中文含义与原时间窗，保留信息和重复，不暗改成解说。所引单说话者整轨替换流程不分离背景音乐，超窗适配超过上限还会裁尾；生成后须对照raw与fitted回听整句，不能仅凭时长判断完整。
answer.en: Verify each source line, Chinese meaning, and original window without turning translation into commentary. The cited single-speaker full-track replacement does not separate background music, and over-cap fitting trims tails. Compare raw with fitted speech; duration alone proves no complete line.

heading.zh: 先分清翻译配音与中文解说
heading.en: Distinguish translated dubbing from commentary

body.zh:
video-recap 的英译中模式把原说话者的内容译成中文，再逐句生成语音放回原时间线。它不是压低英文原声、叠加一份重新讲故事的解说稿。要总结、评述或删掉重复，应选择解说任务，而非暗中改动翻译。

开始前检查说话者人数，以及原轨里有没有需要保留的音乐和环境声。本文引用的固定版本只有单说话者整轨替换，不提供背景音乐分离；原素材包含重要现场声音时，需要另定声音方案，不能假定换人声后这些声音仍在。

确认英文转写也很重要。人名、数量、否定和操作顺序听错，流畅译文也会变成错误内容。先回听可疑词，再进入译文，不让后面的合成掩盖上游错误。
body.en:
The English-to-Chinese mode translates the original speaker’s content and places sentence-level speech back on the source timeline. It does not lower the English track and add a rewritten commentary. Summarizing or deleting repetition belongs to a different editorial task.

Check speaker count and whether important music or ambient sound must survive. The pinned version supports one speaker and replaces the whole track; it does not separate music. Material with important location sound needs another audio plan, not an assumption that changing speech preserves everything else.

Verify transcription first. A mistaken name, quantity, negation or operating order remains wrong even in fluent Chinese. Listen to doubtful words before translating; synthesis cannot repair an upstream misunderstanding.

heading.zh: 逐句保留含义、重复和时间窗
heading.en: Preserve meaning, repetition and source windows

body.zh:
以下是为本文设计的虚构工具演示，不是已生成的配音结果。

| 原声时间窗 | 判断与处理 |
|---|---|
| 0–3 秒 | **英文内容：** Keep the lid open until the light goes out. **中文译文：** 灯熄灭前，别合上盖子。 **检查：** 保留时间条件与否定关系 |
| 3–5 秒 | **英文内容：** Not yet. **中文译文：** 还不行。 **检查：** 不能因为重复提醒而删掉 |
| 5–8 秒 | **英文内容：** Now close it, then press the blue button. **中文译文：** 现在合盖，再按蓝色按钮。 **检查：** 保留先后与颜色 |

每句沿用原时间窗，相邻句不重叠。中文可以调整语序，让意思自然，但不能把“灯灭前别合盖”缩成“合盖”，也不能把下一句的指令提前说完。

可复制记录项：原文、已核对译文、开始、结束、时长、疑点、实听结果。没有试听的格子写“待检查”，不要预填“已同步”。
body.en:
This original demonstration is a planning example, not a generated dub.

| Source window | Record |
|---|---|
| 0–3 seconds | **English:** Keep the lid open until the light goes out. **Chinese translation:** 灯熄灭前，别合上盖子。 **Check:** Preserve the condition and negation |
| 3–5 seconds | **English:** Not yet. **Chinese translation:** 还不行。 **Check:** Retain the repeated warning |
| 5–8 seconds | **English:** Now close it, then press the blue button. **Chinese translation:** 现在合盖，再按蓝色按钮。 **Check:** Preserve order and color |

Reuse the original sentence windows without overlap. Natural Chinese can reorder phrasing, but must not reverse the instruction or announce the next action early.

Record original text, approved translation, start, end, duration, doubts and listening result. Mark untested entries as pending, not synchronized.

heading.zh: 译文太长，先保含义，再检查实际发声
heading.en: Preserve meaning before judging spoken duration

body.zh:
该版本以约每秒五个中文字作为译文长度参考，但数字、英文名称、停顿和音色都会影响实际时长，不能当所有句子的硬上限。先用自然中文去掉翻译造成的冗余，不删原文必要信息，也不擅自合并句子。

例如“在指示灯仍然保持点亮状态的这段时间里面，不要将盖子进行关闭”可改成“灯亮着时，别合盖”。这是语句简洁化；把完整提醒删掉则改变内容。

实际实现逐句锚定start，空间按本句end与下一句start的较早者计算，并设0.4秒下限；不是只在越过下一句时才处理。短于空间且在容差内的WAV保持节奏，超出时局部加速。

重要边界：引用版本的压缩上限为2倍。仍超出时，会对加速后的音频裁到窗口并淡出；所以输出时长符合窗口，可能仍丢了语尾。不要把“已导出”或拟合时长当整句已保留。

纸面例：原WAV长5秒、可用空间2秒，所需压缩2.5倍超过上限；先2倍得到约2.5秒，再裁到2秒，最后0.5秒可能含必要内容。此例未合成或听审，实际丢哪些字必须回听。

保留完整含义仍说不完时，回修具体译句或重新确定时间方案，再检查raw与fitted两份声音。普通解说旁白的批准稿保护与dub不是同一路径，不能假定加一个保护要求就让dub自动阻断所有裁尾。
body.en:
The version uses roughly five Chinese characters per second as a drafting reference. Numbers, English names, pauses and voice affect actual duration, so it is not a universal ceiling. Remove translation-induced redundancy without dropping source information or merging sentences.

A verbose phrase meaning “during the period in which the indicator remains illuminated, do not perform closure” can become “while the light is on, do not close it.” That simplifies phrasing; removing the warning changes content.

The implementation anchors each line at its start and computes room using the earlier of that line’s end and the next start, with a 0.4-second minimum. It does not wait only for overlap with the next line. A WAV within room and tolerance retains its pace; an overlong one is compressed locally.

The cited version caps compression at 2×. If that remains insufficient, it trims the compressed audio to room and fades the tail. A fitted duration can therefore lose final words. Export success or matching duration is not complete-sentence proof.

Paper example: a five-second raw WAV in two seconds of room needs 2.5×. The cap first produces roughly 2.5 seconds, then trimming reduces it to two; the lost half-second may contain necessary content. No audio was generated or listened to here; actual lost words require listening.

If the complete meaning still cannot fit, revise the specific translation or timing plan and compare raw with fitted audio. Ordinary narration’s approved-text policy and dub are separate paths; a protection request does not automatically make dub block every tail trim.

heading.zh: 验收回到原句、动作和接点
heading.en: Review against source speech, actions and joins

body.zh:
逐句核对三个问题：有没有译错或漏掉条件；中文实际说完了吗；画面中的操作是否仍在正确时刻发生。随后连播相邻句，听有没有重叠、突兀空白或语气突然变样。

若英文转写有误，先修原文和译文；若只是某句超窗，定位该句，不整片统一加速；若原背景音乐消失，回查整轨替换的模式选择，不把问题误判成音量设置。

通过文件校验与完成导出不等于翻译准确或听感自然。保留已核对的逐句表和实际试听记录，方便只修问题位置。这篇处理的是跨语言忠实翻译；已有中文文案超出画面时间窗，另见配音超时指南。

dub的输入门禁能阻止空行、重叠和越界安排；它在合成前记录文字与时长风险，不能证明生成的发音或裁尾后内容完整。回听每句的条件、否定与最后音节，再核对画面。
body.en:
Check each sentence for lost conditions, complete delivery and correspondence with the action. Then play neighboring sentences together for overlap, awkward gaps or abrupt delivery changes.

For faulty transcription, repair the source text and translation first. For one overlong sentence, locate it rather than accelerating the entire video. If background music disappears, revisit whole-track replacement instead of diagnosing only a volume setting.

Successful export does not prove faithful translation or natural delivery. Keep the verified sentence table and listening notes so revisions can stay local. This guide concerns faithful cross-language dubbing; fitting an existing Chinese script to a picture edit is a separate question.

Dub’s input gate blocks empty, overlapping, and out-of-range lines and records text/timing risks before synthesis. It proves neither generated pronunciation nor content after trimming. Listen to conditions, negatives, and the final syllable, then check the picture.

q.zh: 能把多人英文访谈直接用这个模式配成中文吗？
q.en: Can this mode directly dub a multi-speaker interview?

a.zh: 本文引用版本不支持；它只有单说话者、逐句合成和整轨替换。多人身份分配、多人音色与保留现场音乐需要另选流程，不应按单人教程假设已经解决。
a.en: The cited version does not support that. It handles one speaker, sentence-level synthesis and whole-track replacement. Multiple speaker identities, voices and retained location audio need a different workflow.

text.zh: 请用 video-recap 处理单说话者英文视频的中文翻译配音。先核对原转写，逐句保留含义与原时间窗，列出超窗和疑点；开始前说明整轨替换对原音乐与环境声的影响。
text.en: Use video-recap for Chinese dubbing of this single-speaker English video. Verify transcription, preserve sentence meanings and source windows, and flag duration conflicts. First establish the effect of whole-track replacement on music and ambience.

label.zh: 英译中逐句配音与版本范围
逐句时间适配、压缩上限与裁尾
label.en: Per-line fit, compression cap, and tail trimming

label.zh: 普通旁白保护与dub的边界
label.en: Ordinary narration protection and dub boundaries

title.zh: 叙事游戏界面信息太多怎么办：先留当前选择
title.en: How to Simplify a Story Game Interface

seo_title.zh: 叙事游戏界面信息太多怎么办：先留当前选择
seo_title.en: How to Simplify a Story Game Interface

description.zh: 把常驻信息、当前证据与完整档案分开呈现。附原创港口场景、界面删减表与不靠缩字号的修订方法。
description.en: Separate persistent signals, current evidence and archives. Includes an original harbor scene and interface repairs that preserve readable text.

answer.zh: 先找出玩家此刻要回答的一个问题，只把判断它必需的证据、动作与代价放到主界面。时空与紧迫信号按需要常驻，完整历史和账目由玩家主动打开。删重复、分节拍和就地揭示优先于缩字号；必要信息不能藏到玩家无法找到的位置。
answer.en: Identify the question the player must answer now. Keep its essential evidence, actions and costs on the main screen. Retain necessary orientation and urgent signals; put full history in an accessible archive. Remove duplication, split beats or reveal details locally before reducing text size.

heading.zh: 从当前问题倒推第一屏
heading.en: Work backward from the present decision

body.zh:
game-art-direction 将叙事信息分成常驻、当前场景和按需档案三层。分类依据是用途，不是文字长短；一句无关说明也可以挪走，一段决定选择的证词则必须在需要时可见。

原创游戏：港口调度员要决定是否让一艘晚到的运输船今晚卸货。现在影响判断的是仓库剩余空间、船上有需要保冷的药品，以及工人能否加班。主画面聚焦码头、请求与可选安排；历次船运、所有人物关系和完整天气史不一起摊开。

先用一句话写玩家问题：“今晚安排卸货，还是等明早？”再把每项界面内容连到这个判断。连不上的内容可以进入按需页，不必因为它是真实状态就永久占据主屏。
body.en:
game-art-direction separates persistent, scene-specific and on-demand information. Function matters more than length. A short irrelevant note can move; evidence essential to a choice must be available when needed.

Original game: a harbor dispatcher decides whether a late cargo ship can unload tonight. Relevant facts are warehouse capacity, refrigerated medicine and worker availability. The main view focuses on the dock, request and arrangements, not every voyage, relationship and weather record.

Write the current question in one sentence: unload tonight or wait until morning? Connect each visible element to it. Information without a current role can remain accessible on demand rather than occupying the screen simply because it is a real state.

heading.zh: 给每项信息一个出现理由
heading.en: Give each information layer a reason to appear

body.zh:
| 层次 | 本例内容与出现方式 |
|---|---|
| 常驻 | **内容：** 今晚、码头位置、即将关库 **方式：** 简短时空与截止提示 |
| 当前场景 | **内容：** 药品保冷条件、仓库余量、加班请求 **方式：** 紧贴相应安排展示 |
| 按需档案 | **内容：** 旧班表、历史货运、完整关系记录 **方式：** 可识别的档案入口 |

若旧承诺会让工人拒绝加班，把相关一句回到当前请求附近，不要求玩家从长历史里自行猜到条件。完整记录仍可查看，但本次决定的依据应就地出现。

选项只写独有动作与代价，不在每张卡重复全港规则。选中安排之后再给人物回应和实际结果，避免一开始把所有远期分支结局摊开。
body.en:
| Layer | Content and presentation |
|---|---|
| Persistent | **Content:** Tonight, current dock, warehouse closing **Presentation:** Brief orientation and deadline |
| Current scene | **Content:** Cold-storage needs, capacity, overtime request **Presentation:** Beside the relevant arrangement |
| On demand | **Content:** Old rotas, voyage history, relationship records **Presentation:** A recognizable archive entry |

If an earlier promise makes workers refuse overtime, bring its relevant sentence beside the request. Do not expect players to infer the condition from a long history. Keep the full record accessible too.

Options state their distinct action and cost without repeating global rules. Show responses and actual results after selection rather than displaying every distant ending in advance.

heading.zh: 完整纸面例子：请求加班，不等于药品已入库
heading.en: Complete Paper Example: An Overtime Request Is Not Unloading

body.zh:
把上面港口场景落实到一条完整路径。以下是原创设计稿，界面文案展示安排与实际结果的区别；不是已完成的交互界面或目标视口测试。

本例20:40，冷库21:00关闭，空位恰可容纳两箱药品；船上也恰为两箱，尚未卸货。船长已提供船上冷藏可保持到明早09:00的依据，冷库明早08:00重新开放，所以等明早是可行的安排，不是把药品丢在露天。现班已结束，今晚卸货需工人自愿加班；本例查看说明与发送请求不推进时钟；工人20:40同意后，已确定的卸货任务耗时十分钟。仅有同意还不算执行。

| 节拍 | 玩家看到、输入与实际变化 |
|---|---|
| 进入 | 主屏只留“晚到货船：今晚卸还是明早？”与20:40/关库提示。必要依据紧邻选择：两箱药品、冷库两箱空位、船上保冷至09:00、明早08:00开库、现班结束 |
| 选择 | “请求今晚加班卸两箱”和“安排明早卸货，今晚留在船上冷藏”。前者先请求、需要同意；后者药品今晚仍在船上 |
| 提交请求 | 显示“请求已送给当班工人，等待回应”。箱子仍在船上、冷库仍空两位；不亮“卸货完成” |
| 正常回应 | 在没有冲突承诺的这条历史中，工人说“我们愿意做，先把两箱药品卸完。”实际记录同意，进入执行；同意不等于已移动箱子 |
| 完成执行 | 到20:50，两箱实际搬入冷库，冷库空位从2变0、船上这批从2变0；显示“药品两箱已入库”再给下一步。不是全部船货都已卸完 |
| 另一历史的拒绝 | 若玩家此前承诺“今晚不再安排加班”，已核对的那句在请求附近出现。工人拒绝，箱子仍船上、空位仍2；可改选明早，保冷依据仍可复看 |

拒绝路径上选明早，只提交明早的安排；今晚不生成“已入库”，到明早实际卸货时才再核当时空间、人员与保冷情况。正常路径已入库也不能推断工人此后愿意无限加班。

完整班表与旧承诺原文放档案，但影响当前请求的那一句必须可见。人物确实同意或拒绝时再呈现回话，不把所有历史下的答案提前列成剧透。返回选择保留已查证的容量与保冷依据；必要说明用文字和数量补足图标、颜色，不能靠一个绿色圆点表示药品已经安全入库。

真正接入游戏后，在目标视口实际阅读与点击，确认当前正文、选择和必要反馈能一起看清。纸面只说明信息应怎样组织，不能保证这些句子已经在手机上同屏。
body.en:
Make the harbor case a complete original design route. The example distinguishes requests from actual results; it is not a working interface or a completed target-viewport test.

It is 20:40; cold storage closes at 21:00 and has room for exactly two medicine crates. Both crates remain aboard. The captain supplied evidence that onboard refrigeration lasts until 09:00 tomorrow; cold storage reopens at 08:00. This makes waiting viable rather than leaving medicine outdoors. The current shift has ended, so unloading needs voluntary overtime. Reading and sending the request do not advance this example’s clock. The crew agrees at 20:40 on the normal route, after which the defined job takes ten minutes; consent alone does not perform it.

| Beat | Input and outcome |
|---|---|
| Enter | Focus on “Late cargo: unload tonight or tomorrow?” with 20:40 and closing time. Beside the choice: two crates, two cold-storage spaces, onboard refrigeration until 09:00, morning opening at 08:00, and the ended shift. |
| Choose | “Request overtime to unload both tonight” or “Schedule morning unloading; keep them refrigerated aboard tonight.” The first needs consent; the second leaves the crates aboard. |
| Send request | “Request sent to the current crew; awaiting response.” Both crates remain aboard and both warehouse spaces remain free. No completed-unloading signal. |
| Normal response | In a history without a conflicting promise, the crew says, “We agree. We’ll unload these two medicine crates first.” Record consent and begin execution; consent has not moved cargo. |
| Actual completion | At 20:50 both crates enter cold storage. Free spaces change from 2 to 0; this medicine aboard changes from 2 to 0. Show “Two medicine crates stored” and the next action, without declaring all ship cargo unloaded. |
| Refusal in another history | A verified earlier promise of no more overtime tonight appears beside the request. The crew refuses; crates remain aboard and free spaces remain 2. Morning scheduling is available, with refrigeration evidence accessible again. |

Selecting morning on the refusal route commits a schedule, not tonight’s storage. Recheck then-current space, staff, and refrigeration when morning unloading actually happens. Completed unloading on the normal route does not establish consent to unlimited future overtime.

Keep the full rota and promise in the archive, but display the sentence affecting this request where it matters. Present the actual crew reply after its response rather than listing every history’s answer beforehand. Returning to the choice retains checked capacity and refrigeration evidence. Text and quantities support icons and colors; a green dot alone cannot establish safe storage.

After implementation, read and operate the screen in its target viewport and check that current prose, choices, and essential feedback remain readable together. A paper organization does not establish that these sentences fit on a phone.

heading.zh: 先拆信息节拍，再决定是否滚动
heading.en: Split information beats before adding scrolling

body.zh:
原屏幕把船长来信、仓库解释、工人旧怨、全部资源、四个长选项和事后总结排在一起，玩家还没读到按钮就忘了眼前问题。可以先展示来船与必要条件，允许查看证词，再进入安排选择；提交后单独呈现结果与下一步。

主游玩屏需要往下滚才看见必要选项时，先检查是否混进完整档案或重复解释。不要只是隐藏滚动条，也不应把所有字缩小以维持“同屏”。玩家主动打开的历史页可以滚动，边界和返回入口要清楚。

拆屏也不能切断因果。返回选择时保留已查看的关键依据，必要处提供就近复看。需要多长、多少行，要在目标视口实际读和点，不能从排版稿推断。
body.en:
An overloaded screen includes the captain’s letter, warehouse explanation, old disputes, every resource, long options and an outcome summary. By the buttons, the present question is lost. Instead establish arrival and conditions, allow evidence inspection, then offer arrangements. Present results afterward.

If essential choices require scrolling, check for archives and repeated explanation. Hiding the scrollbar or shrinking all text does not solve overload. An explicitly opened history page can scroll with a clear boundary and return route.

Splitting screens must preserve causality. Keep relevant inspected evidence available beside the decision. Judge line length and interaction in the target viewport, not solely in a layout document.

heading.zh: 检查删减有没有损害判断
heading.en: Check what a cleaner interface removes

body.zh:
沿正常路径与一条拒绝路径各读一次：玩家是否在选择前看见成本，是否知道旧承诺影响哪一项，提交后是否能分清请求被接收与卸货已经完成。

只保留装饰地图而隐藏仓库余量，界面会漂亮但无法决策；把所有后台关系分数放上屏，又会挤掉人物真正的条件。两种情况都要回到当前问题，而不是追求某个固定信息数量。

图标与颜色也需要可理解的辅助表达。一次删减只移动或压缩已定位的信息，保留规则、选项意义和历史事实；若需要改规则才能让画面成立，那是另一个设计变更。以上为纸面案例，不是已经完成可用性测试的界面。
body.en:
Read a normal and a refusal path. Can players see costs before choosing, identify which option an earlier promise affects, and distinguish an accepted request from completed unloading?

A decorative map without capacity prevents judgment. Showing every internal relationship score crowds out actual conditions. Return to the present question instead of imposing a fixed information count.

Icons and colors need understandable supporting expression. A focused cleanup moves or compresses identified information while preserving rules, option meanings and history. If rules must change to make the screen work, that is a separate design change. This example is not a completed usability test.

q.zh: 档案藏起来，会不会让玩家漏看关键信息？
q.en: Will an archive hide essential evidence?

a.zh: 会，所以先分清完整记录与本次判断的必要依据。后者应在相关选项附近可见，完整来源可以按需打开；不要把所有信息一起藏进菜单。
a.en: It can. Keep evidence essential to the present decision near its option, while allowing the full source record to open on demand. Do not move everything into a menu.

text.zh: 请用 game-art-direction 整理这个叙事游戏界面。写出当前玩家问题，将信息分为常驻、场景与档案，保留必要依据；优先删重复或拆节拍，不改规则和选项含义。
text.en: Use game-art-direction to simplify this story-game screen. Identify the present decision, classify persistent, scene and archive information, and preserve its evidence. Remove duplication or split beats without changing rules.

label.zh: 界面信息层级
选择前的信息节拍

title.zh: 游戏画面太暗怎么办：保住夜景里的可读层
title.en: How to Fix a Game Screen That Is Too Dark

seo_title.zh: 游戏画面太暗怎么办：保住夜景里的可读层
seo_title.en: How to Fix a Game Screen That Is Too Dark

description.zh: 把气氛和玩家必须读到的信息分开检查。附原创夜间库房场景、四层可读表与目标视口验证方法。
description.en: Separate atmosphere from essential visual information. Includes an original night warehouse, four readability layers and viewport checks.

answer.zh: 先确认暗色是否服务题材或玩法，再检查人物方向、交互物、正文选项和结果信号是否仍可读。优先用局部对比与功能性色保住这些层，不把严肃或电影感自动变成整屏压暗。实际游玩界面需要能判断和操作，不能只靠海报漂亮。
answer.en: First establish whether darkness serves the genre or play. Check character orientation, interactive objects, text and result signals. Preserve these through local contrast and functional color rather than darkening everything for a serious or cinematic look. Test an actual playable screen, not only a poster.

heading.zh: 先说明黑暗让玩家做什么
heading.en: Identify what darkness contributes to play

body.zh:
game-art-direction 明确区分低照度体验与“高级、历史、严肃”等审美标签。潜行、恐怖或地下探索可能需要黑暗，但仍要说明玩家依靠什么辨认危险与行动；其他题材没有相应理由时，不默认压低全屏曝光。

原创游戏：夜班库房管理员寻找一箱错放的零件。夜色交代时间，货架阴影制造寻找压力；玩法并不是让玩家辨认近乎全黑的按钮。工作灯照到标签与取物区域，人物轮廓从背景里可分，场外黑暗仍能保留气氛。

先写暗处的职责：隐藏未探索区域、限制视线，还是单纯表现夜晚。没有职责的黑幕、暗角、烟雾和小灰字同时叠加，只会把可用信息一起吞掉。
body.en:
game-art-direction separates low-light experiences from labels such as prestigious, historical or serious. Stealth and horror may need darkness, but players still need a way to identify danger and action. Other genres should not inherit global underexposure without a reason.

Original game: a night warehouse clerk searches for misplaced parts. Darkness establishes time and puts pressure on the search; the game is not about deciphering invisible buttons. A work lamp reveals labels and the pickup area, while silhouettes separate from the background.

Define the dark region’s function: hide unexplored space, restrict sight or establish night. Stacking shadow overlays, vignettes, fog and tiny gray text without a role consumes useful information.

heading.zh: 按四层检查实际画面
heading.en: Inspect four layers of the actual screen

body.zh:
| 可读层 | 检查与修法 |
|---|---|
| 人物轮廓与朝向 | **本例要看清：** 管理员面对哪排架子；**失败时修什么：** 主体与背景分离，保留方向线索 |
| 关键器物与交互点 | **本例要看清：** 标签、手推车与可取物区域；**失败时修什么：** 局部光与形状，不只加发光框 |
| 正文与选项 | **本例要看清：** 当前请求、查看或搬走；**失败时修什么：** 文本底层、字号与对比 |
| 结果与危险 | **本例要看清：** 架子不稳、零件已转移；**失败时修什么：** 动作与文字或声音辅助 |

这些层是检查用途，不要求全画面一样亮。灯外的空库房可以继续暗，关键按钮却不能随着夜景一起失读。颜色提示旁边补形状、文字、位置或动作，避免危险只有一小片红色。
body.en:
| Layer | Check and repair |
|---|---|
| Character and orientation | **Must be visible:** Which shelves the clerk faces; **Repair focus:** Separation and direction cues |
| Objects and interaction | **Must be visible:** Labels, trolley and pickup area; **Repair focus:** Local light and shape |
| Text and choices | **Must be visible:** Current request and actions; **Repair focus:** Text backing, size and contrast |
| Results and danger | **Must be visible:** Unstable shelving or moved parts; **Repair focus:** Action plus text or sound |

These are functional checks, not a demand for uniform brightness. Empty space can remain dark while a necessary control stays readable. Add shape, wording, position or movement to color signals so danger is not conveyed by a small red patch alone.

heading.zh: 只修改失读的层，保留有用气氛
heading.en: Repair the unreadable layer while preserving atmosphere

body.zh:
若角色融进货架，先比较轮廓和背景，不立刻把正文卡片全部提亮。若标签读不出，增加局部照明或单独查看的表达；若按钮对比不足，修按钮与底层关系，不必改变整个库房。

暗调确实是核心体验时，记录哪几处允许暗、哪些信息不能失去，以及可选的亮度或高对比方案。替代方案应继续表达同一危险、行动与结果，不能“高对比”后把暗处的秘密直接全部公开。

从输入前到输入后一起看：搬走零件的动作、架子状态与新路线要被读到。单帧轮廓清晰，不证明动画过程或操作反馈可读。不要通过更强辉光掩盖错误状态。
body.en:
If a character merges into shelving, compare silhouette and background rather than brightening every text card. If labels disappear, improve local light or an inspection view. If controls lack contrast, repair their relationship to the backing instead of changing the entire warehouse.

For a deliberately dark experience, record permitted darkness, essential information and a brightness or contrast fallback. The alternative must preserve danger and outcomes without revealing secrets that should remain concealed.

Inspect before and after input. Moving parts, changed shelving and the new route must register. A readable still does not prove animation or feedback works. Stronger glow cannot conceal an incorrect state.

heading.zh: 可复制的修改说明：夜班库房保留暗处，也看得清
heading.en: A copyable revision brief for the night warehouse

body.zh:
沿用管理员找错放零件的原例，这份纸面说明只修改夜景可读性。演示选择竖屏390×844，实际项目继承自己已批准的目标视口；下面没有生成画面或运行候选。

> **本场目标**：让玩家在夜班库房中找到并辨认错放零件。夜色保留时间与探索压力，不以全黑按钮考验玩家视力。
>
> **当前修改范围**：保货架布局、工作灯、手推车、管理员身份与现有交互规则。只修失读的轮廓、标签、文字底层与结果信号，不换场景或增加物件。
>
> **第一眼的焦点**：正在检查的货架与灯照到的标签。管理员的朝向指向这排架子；轮廓与身后货架用局部明暗分开。灯外的未探索区域继续较暗，不把所有货架一起提亮。
>
> **器物与标签**：工作灯照明覆盖当前标签和取物区域，手推车轮廓可辨。标签使用本项目已定文字，文字层与背景有清楚关系，不用一圈辉光代替可读标签。尚未发现的标签不因这次调亮全部公开。
>
> **正文与操作**：当前请求、查看与搬走选项放在稳定的文字底层上，按实际尺寸读和点；不再用小灰字贴深色纹理。压缩重复背景，不缩字来硬塞完整历史。账册仍由玩家主动打开。
>
> **结果与危险**：只表现游戏实际提交的状态。若本次已转移零件，更新原位置与实际落点，并给简短文字；若还没搬，保原位置，不先播“完成”。架子不稳的已定提示有形状、动作或文字辅助，不只靠红色。
>
> **高对比选择**：强化当前人物、器物、正文与结果层的分离，保相同位置、行动与知情边界；不把未探索暗处变成所有线索都已发现。
>
> **验收方式**：在项目目标视口、正常显示亮度实际查看标签、选择和结果；再用静音或低动效表达走同一动作，确认必要信息仍有可读渠道。纸面文字不是已完成验证。

交给构建者时，将这段作为 ART_DIRECTION 中本场的修改说明，补上真实目标平台、已接受资产与本轮命中的问题。若问题实际来自错误结果，先交规则负责人处理；加灯和亮框不能使未执行的搬运成为已完成。
body.en:
This paper brief retains the clerk’s search for misplaced parts and revises night-scene readability only. It chooses a portrait 390×844 viewport for illustration; real projects inherit their approved target. No picture or candidate has been produced.

> **Scene goal:** Let players find and recognize misplaced parts during a warehouse night shift. Preserve night and exploration pressure without making controls nearly invisible.
>
> **Scope:** Retain shelf layout, work lamp, trolley, clerk identity and interaction rules. Repair unreadable silhouettes, labels, text backing and result signals rather than changing the scene or adding objects.
>
> **First focus:** The inspected shelves and illuminated label. The clerk faces that row, with local value separation from shelving behind. Unexplored areas outside the lamp remain darker; do not brighten every shelf.
>
> **Objects and labels:** Light the current label and pickup region; retain a readable trolley silhouette. Use approved label wording and a clear text/background relationship rather than a glow ring. Increased readability does not reveal every undiscovered label.
>
> **Reading and controls:** Place the current request and inspect/move choices on stable backing, readable and usable at actual size. Remove small gray text over dark texture. Compress repeated context rather than shrinking the complete history. Players open the ledger on demand.
>
> **Results and danger:** Show committed state only. If parts were transferred, update old position and actual destination with concise text. If no move occurred, retain the original position rather than showing completion. Supplement an established unstable-shelf warning with shape, movement or text, not red alone.
>
> **High-contrast option:** Strengthen separation of characters, objects, reading and results while preserving location, actions and knowledge limits. Do not turn unexplored darkness into discovered clues.
>
> **Review:** At the target viewport and normal display brightness, actually inspect a label, choose an action and read its result. Check the same action muted or with reduced motion, retaining readable essential information. This text is not verification evidence.

Place the passage in ART_DIRECTION as this scene’s revision, adding the real platform, accepted assets and diagnosed fault. Incorrect results belong with rule owners first; light and highlighting cannot complete an unperformed move.

heading.zh: 用真实游玩画面验收，不用调亮显示器补救
heading.en: Validate through play at the target viewport

body.zh:
在目标画幅和正常显示条件下，实际完成查看、选取、提交与读取结果。问试玩者先看到了什么、以为哪里能点、失败后知道哪项需要改变；不要只问“美不美”。

缩略图能帮助看首要焦点，最终文字仍要按实际尺寸检查。静音或低动效时保留关键信息的另一条路径。没有完成这些观察，就把可读性标为待验证，不能靠美术方向文件宣称已经通过。

若非低照度题材只有把显示器调得很亮才能操作，回到画面方案修订。不要给所有游戏套固定曝光值；素材、显示层、题材和视口不同，需要按当前失读位置判断。
body.en:
At the target viewport under normal viewing conditions, inspect, select, submit and read the result. Ask testers what they noticed first, where they expected interaction and what a failure told them to change, not merely whether the image is attractive.

Thumbnails can reveal focus; final text needs actual-size inspection. Preserve essential information when muted or with reduced motion. Until observed, mark readability as unverified rather than treating the direction document as proof.

If a game without a low-light premise requires an unusually bright monitor to operate, revise the screen. There is no exposure value for every game; locate the unreadable layer in this setting.

q.zh: 夜景是不是应该把所有东西都调暗？
q.en: Should every part of a night scene be dark?

a.zh: 不必。夜色可以由局部明暗、光源与空间建立，关键文字、器物和结果仍需可读。保留黑暗的用途，而不是让所有图层一同失去对比。
a.en: No. Local light, contrast and space can establish night while essential text, objects and results remain readable. Preserve darkness’s function without reducing every layer together.

text.zh: 请用 game-art-direction 检查这个暗色游玩界面。说明暗处的题材或玩法用途，逐项检查人物、器物、文本与结果信号，给出只修失读层的方案和实际视口检查项。
text.en: Use game-art-direction to inspect this dark playable screen. Identify darkness’s purpose, check characters, objects, text and results, and propose focused repairs with target-viewport checks.

label.zh: 明度取舍与可读层
目标视口、明度继承与运行验证
label.en: Target viewport, inherited brightness and runtime review

title.zh: 古风游戏美术怎么定：时代、画法与人物分开选
title.en: How to Define an Ancient-Fantasy Game Art Style

seo_title.zh: 古风游戏美术怎么定：时代、画法与人物分开选
seo_title.en: How to Define an Ancient-Fantasy Game Art Style

description.zh: 把时代真实性、表现媒介与人物理想化程度分开校准。附原创水城游戏、反馈修订表与实际界面目标图方法。
description.en: Calibrate period, visual medium and character treatment separately. Includes an original canal-city game, feedback repairs and an in-game target frame.

answer.zh: 先锁世界里的服饰、器物和空间，再选择二维插画、动画化角色等表现方式，最后确定人物比例与材质。“太旧”“太现代”“太真实”可能指不同层；只修被反馈命中的层，用实际游玩目标图验证后再扩展资产。
answer.en: Lock clothing, objects and space in the world, choose a visual medium, then define character proportions and materials. Feedback about age, modernity or realism may address different layers. Revise the identified layer and test a playable target frame before producing more assets.

heading.zh: 把“古风”拆成能决定取舍的三项
heading.en: Separate three decisions hidden inside an aesthetic label

body.zh:
game-art-direction 不把古风到现代审美当作一条滑杆。世界属于什么时代、画面用什么媒介、人物理想化到什么程度，是三项可以分别调整的选择。

原创游戏：虚构水城里，玩家管理河运文书。世界使用木桥、纸卷、船票与既定礼制；媒介选择明亮的二维叙事插画；人物是成熟的理想化轮廓，不追求真人皮肤，也不幼态化。三项写清后，就能拒绝现代摄影棚背景，而无需退回泛黄古画。

若采用真实历史时代，器物与礼法另做考据。虚构示例不是史料，也不宣称某种画法最受所有玩家欢迎。方向的价值是让本项目能排除不合适的方案。
body.en:
game-art-direction treats period, medium and character idealization as separate choices rather than one slider between old and modern.

Original game: in a fictional canal city, players manage shipping documents. The world uses wooden bridges, paper rolls, tickets and established etiquette. Its medium is bright two-dimensional narrative illustration. Characters have mature idealized silhouettes, without photographic skin or childlike proportions. These decisions can reject a modern studio background without retreating to a yellowed antique-painting look.

A real period needs research into objects and etiquette. The example is neither historical evidence nor a claim about universal popularity. Direction helps this project reject unsuitable options.

heading.zh: 先判断反馈指的是哪一层
heading.en: Locate the layer a piece of feedback addresses

body.zh:
| 反馈 | 定位与本例改法 |
|---|---|
| 太旧 | **先看哪里：** 泛黄、静态陈列、古画媒介；**本例可改：** 换更清晰的二维笔触与构图；**不自动改变：** 时代器物与空间 |
| 太现代 | **先看哪里：** 服装、广告式背景、摄影语法；**本例可改：** 恢复世界中的衣装与河岸环境；**不自动改变：** 整屏明度 |
| 太真实 | **先看哪里：** 毛孔、摄影质感、三维材质；**本例可改：** 调整笔触与轮廓理想化；**不自动改变：** 人物年龄 |
| 太幼态 | **先看哪里：** 比例、面部与行为气质；**本例可改：** 调整成熟度；**不自动改变：** 整个世界时代 |

“现代人喜欢”不是一项可直接执行的材质指令。补问具体不满意的画面层，再比较修订。避免一次反馈同时换服装、人物年龄、背景和调色，导致无法判断什么改善。
body.en:
| Feedback | Diagnosis and revision |
|---|---|
| Too old | **Inspect first:** Yellowing, display-like composition, medium; **Possible revision:** Clearer illustration and staging; **Do not automatically change:** Period objects and space |
| Too modern | **Inspect first:** Clothing, advertising backgrounds, photography; **Possible revision:** Restore world-specific dress and riverbank; **Do not automatically change:** Global brightness |
| Too realistic | **Inspect first:** Pores, photographic or 3D materials; **Possible revision:** Revise brushwork and silhouette; **Do not automatically change:** Character age |
| Too childlike | **Inspect first:** Proportions, face and behavior; **Possible revision:** Increase maturity; **Do not automatically change:** The whole setting’s period |

Appealing to modern players is not an executable material instruction. Locate the disliked layer, then compare a focused revision. Changing clothing, age, background and color at once obscures what helped.

heading.zh: 目标图放进真正会用的界面
heading.en: Put the target image in its intended interface

body.zh:
先做一张会进入实际游玩的目标图：河运柜台前有人提交船票，玩家需要读票、看见角色朝向，并找到核验动作。留出正文与选项的空间，目标图就同时检验世界、画法和信息层级。

写少量可观察条件：木桥与纸卷符合已定世界；人物朝向来人；票据位置可辨；二维笔触一致；文字区域不被装饰挤占。再写明确反例，例如摄影棚几何背景、真人毛孔或错误时代服装。

不是每个界面都需要另外做一张海报。高风险方向先通过一个代表性游玩时刻，再把已接受的识别锚点与表现方式传给角色、场景和道具资产。
body.en:
Create a target frame for actual play: someone presents a shipping ticket at a counter, and the player must inspect it, read character orientation and find the verification action. Reserve room for text and choices so the frame tests setting, medium and hierarchy together.

Use a few observable conditions: established bridge and paper objects, clear orientation, visible ticket placement, consistent illustration and unobstructed text. Record concrete counterexamples such as a geometric studio backdrop, photographic pores or incorrect dress.

Every screen does not need another poster. Resolve the risky direction in one representative playable moment, then propagate accepted identity anchors and visual treatment to assets.

heading.zh: 可复制的美术方向：明亮的水城河运柜台
heading.en: A copyable direction for the river-city counter

body.zh:
沿用虚构水城的原例，这份候选说明采用明亮二维插画和成熟理想化人物。它是一个代表性游玩画面的方向，不是整部游戏已经完成的 ART_DIRECTION，也没有生成或批准目标图。

> **世界**：保木桥、纸卷、船票和本作既定礼制。柜台与河岸来自这个世界，不换现代广告背景或摄影棚；虚构世界不借此宣称符合某个真实朝代。
>
> **媒介**：明亮二维叙事插画，笔触与物件边缘清楚。水城的历史感通过空间、器物和人物关系表现，不通过整屏泛黄、旧纸污渍或暗角表现。
>
> **人物**：成年角色保持本作已定身份、服饰与发式，以成熟理想化轮廓和二维笔触呈现，不用真人毛孔与摄影皮肤，不因“太真实”反馈把年龄改小。
>
> **代表画面**：河运柜台前有人提交船票。演示选用竖屏390×844；柜台和递票关系占主图，票据位置是当前焦点，木桥或河岸背景从属于这项动作，不抢阅读区。人物朝向彼此，票据由同一已定对象持有，不为画面漂亮改归属。
>
> **文本与操作空间**：为本轮读票说明与核验动作留稳定区域。目标图清楚给出票据载体，真实票文由界面按已定内容显示；原例没有给逐字票号，不凭空编造。完整河运历史放按需页，不塞进每个选项。
>
> **输入前后**：提交票据只呈现游戏已确认的提交状态，核验结果另读取规则实际结果；不能靠角色点头、绿色印章或“通过”装饰替规则提前批准。后续资产保持同一身份、柜台布局和画法，让玩家辨认发生了哪项变化。
>
> **本方向的反例**：现代摄影棚几何背景；错误世界服装；真人毛孔；幼态比例；泛黄暗调吞掉票据与正文。每项拒绝对应一个已选方向，不同时推翻另外两轴。
>
> **进入制作前**：先把一张真实目标图放到本场会用的界面，在项目目标视口检查递票关系、文字留白与操作焦点，交作者判断方向。图未出现或尚被否决，就保文字方案与未验证项，停同方向扩批。

这份说明把三项选择接到同一实际用途，便于比较“太旧”或“太真实”到底指哪一层。若真实反馈只命中笔触，先改媒介表现，保服装、人物年龄与游戏规则；本例的画法是作者选择，不是市场热门程度的结论。
body.en:
This candidate direction retains the fictional river city and chooses bright 2D illustration with mature idealized characters. It specifies one representative playing frame, not a completed whole-game ART_DIRECTION. No target picture has been generated or approved.

> **World:** Preserve wooden bridges, paper scrolls, tickets and established customs. Counter and riverbank belong to this setting rather than a modern advertising stage. The fictional world makes no claim about a particular historical dynasty.
>
> **Medium:** Bright 2D narrative illustration with clear brushwork and object edges. Period character comes from space, objects and relationships rather than uniform yellowing, paper stains or vignetting.
>
> **People:** Retain accepted adult identities, clothing and hair, using mature idealized silhouettes and 2D treatment. Avoid photographic pores and skin; “too realistic” does not authorize younger ages.
>
> **Representative frame:** A ticket is submitted at the river-shipping counter. The illustrative viewport is portrait 390×844. Counter and handoff dominate the picture, with the ticket as the current focus. Bridge or riverbank stays secondary to reading. People face each other, and the ticket remains with its established holder.
>
> **Reading and controls:** Reserve stable space for current ticket information and the checking action. The target picture establishes its carrier; the interface displays approved text. The original example provides no exact ticket number, so invent none. Full shipping history belongs on demand.
>
> **Before and after input:** Show the submitted-ticket state only when confirmed by the game, then read validation results from rules. A nod, green stamp or decorative pass label must not approve it early. Later assets retain identity, counter layout and medium so the change is recognizable.
>
> **Counterexamples:** Modern studio geometry, wrong-world clothing, photographic pores, childlike proportions, and yellow/dark treatment obscuring ticket and prose. Reject each against its selected axis without simultaneously abandoning the others.
>
> **Before production expands:** Place a real target picture in its intended interface and inspect handoff, reading space and control focus at the project viewport. The creator judges the direction. If the picture is absent or rejected, retain the text and unresolved risk while stopping expansion of that direction.

The three choices serve one concrete use, making “too old” or “too realistic” feedback easier to locate. Revise brushwork first when that alone is criticized, preserving clothing, age and rules. This medium is a creator choice rather than a market-popularity finding.

heading.zh: 方向没通过，先停住同类扩批
heading.en: Do not multiply an unresolved style error

body.zh:
如果第一张角色图被否决，不因为已生成很多而继续沿同一路线生产。隔离错误样张，保留被接受的世界事实，在命中的轴上修订，然后用同一界面位置比较。

后续资产检查共享画法、人物成熟度、器物时代与色光；同一对象的不同状态保留必要构图和身份，让玩家读出变化。风格参考只借已声明的构图、材质或信息原则，不复制别人的角色与界面。

目标图通过代表方向较明确，不等于成品资产全部正确，更不证明游戏有趣。缺少图像工具时可先写清文字方向与未验证风险，但不要把未出现的目标图记成完成。
body.en:
When the first character frame is rejected, prior production volume is not a reason to continue. Isolate rejected samples, preserve accepted world facts and revise the identified axis. Compare in the same interface position.

Later assets should share medium, maturity, period objects and lighting. States of one object need enough common framing and identity to reveal change. Borrow declared composition or material principles from references without copying characters or interfaces.

An accepted target frame clarifies direction; it does not prove every final asset or the game’s appeal. Without image tools, keep a textual direction and explicit unresolved risks rather than inventing completed frames.

q.zh: 想让古风更现代，要换成现代衣服吗？
q.en: Does a more contemporary aesthetic require modern clothing?

a.zh: 通常先看表现媒介、构图和旧化处理是否造成距离感。它们可以调整，时代服饰与器物仍跟随已定世界；确实要改变时代，需作为新的世界方向决定。
a.en: First inspect medium, composition and aging treatment. These can change while clothing and objects follow the established world. Changing the period is a separate world-direction decision.

text.zh: 请用 game-art-direction 校准古风美术。分别列世界时代、表现媒介与人物理想化程度，将反馈定位到一项；保留未受影响事实，用实际界面目标图和反例确定方向。
text.en: Use game-art-direction to calibrate this period-inspired art. Separate world period, medium and idealization, locate feedback to one layer, preserve unaffected facts and define a playable target frame with counterexamples.

label.zh: 时代题材审美校准
批准方向到实际界面的保真
label.en: Preserving approved direction in the actual interface

title.zh: 游戏过场动画怎么设计：跳过后也能接着玩
title.en: How to Design Skippable Game Cutscenes

seo_title.zh: 游戏过场动画怎么设计：跳过后也能接着玩
seo_title.en: How to Design Skippable Game Cutscenes

description.zh: 让过场读取已确认状态，明确开始、结束与降级表达。附原创灯塔演出、跳过对照和丢失输入后的检查方法。
description.en: Make cutscenes read confirmed state and define boundaries and fallbacks. Includes an original lighthouse sequence and skip-path checks.

answer.zh: 先判断这一段是否适合固定演出，再定义触发状态、必须交代的事实与结束后的可玩位置。播放、跳过和静帧降级应进入同一合法结果，保留必要信息和输入机会。玩家需要改变位置、视角或战术时，优先使用实时场景。
answer.en: First decide whether a fixed performance fits the moment. Define its trigger, essential facts and return to play. Watching, skipping or using a still fallback should reach the same legal result while preserving information and input opportunities. Use real-time scenes for player-controlled space, perspective or tactics.

heading.zh: 区分固定演出与玩家仍在操作的部分
heading.en: Separate a fixed performance from active play

body.zh:
game-build 的动态媒体合同把预渲染视频用于无需玩家改变视角或空间关系的短演出。漂亮视频不能替代玩家应有的控制，也不能临时决定玩法结果。

原创游戏：玩家已按正确顺序修好灯塔电路，规则确认灯亮。短过场可以表现光束扫过海面、远船回应。若玩家此时还需要调整光束方向寻找船，方向选择仍是玩法，不能用固定动画自动做完。

先写本段要表现的已发生结果，再写播放结束后在哪里接着操作。状态触发来自实际规则；按下修理按钮但材料不足，不能先播放灯塔成功亮起的动画。
body.en:
game-build uses pre-rendered media for short fixed performances without player-controlled perspective or space. A beautiful video cannot replace required control or invent a gameplay result.

Original game: the player repairs a lighthouse circuit in the correct order, and rules confirm the light is on. A cutscene can show the beam crossing the sea and a ship responding. If the player still needs to aim the beam to locate the ship, that remains play rather than an automatic film.

Identify the confirmed result and where control resumes. A repair input rejected for missing materials must not trigger a successful illumination animation.

heading.zh: 把播放前后与跳过结果写在一起
heading.en: Plan boundaries and skip results together

body.zh:
| 项目 | 原创灯塔演出 |
|---|---|
| 触发 | 电路修复结果已经提交 |
| 开始 | 灯塔亮起，玩家仍在控制室 |
| 必须信息 | 远船已回应，下一步可以发送引导信号 |
| 结束 | 控制室开放发送信号的动作 |
| 跳过 | 直接给远船回应摘要并进入同一可玩状态 |
| 降级 | 静帧加必要声音或文字，保留回应与下一步 |

开始和结束保留正确身份、持物、空间与剧情状态。影像中突然出现已损坏的旧灯、未到场的人或提前公开的秘密，即使画面好看也要修。

跳过按钮跳的是演出，不是规则结果。不能让观看者收到回应、跳过者却少一项必要条件；也不应在播放和跳过回调中各发一次奖励。

### 完整纸面路径：灯亮之后，不把船已回应当成船已安全抵达

沿用控制室与灯塔，本例补充选择：修复只提交一次，触发随后到来的回应事件；船的确认在这段演出期间由同一剧情规则提交，播放器不替船作决定。观看、跳过、素材失败都要经过这个回应节点。没有奖励物件，也没有自动发送引导信号。以下是设计候选，尚未构建或测试。

> **观看：** 玩家完成修复，控制室显示“电路已修，灯已亮；等候远船回应”。灯束扫过海面。回应事件实际到来后，远船灯光闪回，短文字显示“远船已回应；可以发送引导信号”。过场结束，玩家仍在控制室；“发送引导信号”可操作，但还没有发送。
>
> **跳过：** 从同一修复后状态按跳过，演出停止。若回应事件尚未到来，显示“灯已亮；等候远船回应”，不提前开通信号动作。同一回应节点提交后给出“远船已回应”的摘要，开放发送动作，玩家仍在控制室。摘要交付必要信息，不把船长的秘密补进来。
>
> **素材失败：** 这段演出在本候选中选择为可降级。视频不能播放时显示灯已亮的静帧与文字；回应未到仍等候，回应到来后更新为相同确认文字并开放发送动作。播放器失败不表示修复失败，也不表示已经收到回应。

三条路径都停在“修复已完成、船已回应、发送仍待玩家操作”的同一边界。若故事另选船不回应的结果，就按该规则显示等待或失败，不能让本例的成功摘要覆盖它。素材不是必需玩家效果是本例的设计选择，其他项目按自己的必需条件处理。
body.en:
| Item | Lighthouse sequence |
|---|---|
| Trigger | Repair result already committed |
| Start | Light on; player remains in the control room |
| Required fact | Ship responded; guidance is available |
| End | Signal action becomes available in the control room |
| Skip | Response summary and the same playable state |
| Fallback | Still plus sound or text preserving response and next action |

Boundaries preserve identity, objects, space and story state. A broken old lamp, absent character or premature secret needs repair despite attractive imagery.

Skipping bypasses presentation, not the rule result. Watchers and skippers must retain necessary conditions. Playback and skip callbacks must not each award the same reward.

### Complete paper paths: a response is not a safe arrival

Keep the control room and lighthouse. This candidate adds an explicit design: repair commits once and triggers a subsequent response event. During the sequence, the same story rule commits the ship’s acknowledgement; the player does not decide it. Watch, skip and media failure all pass through that response node. No item reward or automatic guidance signal is added. These are unbuilt, untested design paths.

> **Watch:** After repair the control room reads, “Circuit repaired; light on; awaiting the ship’s response.” The beam sweeps across the sea. When the response event actually arrives, the ship flashes back and text reads, “Ship acknowledged; guidance signal available.” Playback ends in the control room. Sending is available but has not happened.
>
> **Skip:** From the same repaired state, skipping stops the presentation. If the response event has not arrived, show “Light on; awaiting the ship’s response” without unlocking guidance early. Once the same response node commits, summarize acknowledgement and enable sending in the control room. Preserve necessary information without adding a captain’s secret.
>
> **Media failure:** This candidate classifies the sequence as degradable. A failed video uses a still of the lit tower and text. Wait while acknowledgement is pending; when it arrives, display the same confirmation and enable sending. Media failure means neither repair failure nor an already received response.

All three paths end with repair complete, acknowledgement received and sending awaiting player input. A design selecting no response must show its actual waiting or failure outcome rather than apply this success summary. Classifying media as degradable is this example’s choice; other projects follow their own required effects.

heading.zh: 素材失败与失焦也要有可继续的处理
heading.en: Handle failed media and interrupted playback

body.zh:
制作前就决定素材是必需效果还是可以降级。可降级视频无法播放时，采用已定静帧或低动效表达；必需效果缺失则明确报告，不能把黑屏当作完成。备用表达仍需交代相同结果，不应变成泛用“任务成功”。

实际接入检查预载、开始、跳过、切出窗口、静音和播放结束后的控制恢复。静音时必要信息不能只留在对白里；低动效时仍应看懂灯已修好、船已回应。

生成素材先用草稿核对首中尾事实和动作，成立后再提高尺寸。模型、格式和供应商随环境选择，具体能力另查官方文档；本文不许诺任一生成模型能稳定完成所有过场。
body.en:
Decide whether the media is essential or degradable before production. A failed degradable video uses its approved still or reduced-motion expression. Missing essential media needs an explicit failure rather than treating a black screen as completion. A fallback preserves the same fact, not a generic success message.

Check loading, start, skip, focus loss, mute and return of control. Essential information cannot exist only in speech; reduced motion must still show the repaired light and ship response.

Use drafts to check boundary facts before increasing dimensions. Provider and format depend on the environment and need official capability checks. No single generation model is promised to solve every cutscene.

heading.zh: 把观看、跳过与降级三条路并排检查
heading.en: Compare watching, skipping and fallback paths

body.zh:
从同一初始状态分别走完三条路径，比较位置、物件、知识、奖励和下一步动作。都应回到已声明的合法状态，演出长度和表现可以不同。

再检查播放结束与快速连按跳过是否重复提交；载入存档后是否把已看完的事件再结算；缺素材时是否仍保留必要输入。测试只证明这些运行关系，不能代替玩家对演出节奏和趣味的评价。

若一条路径泄露更多秘密，核对该信息是否本就应在这一刻公开；若需要保留差异，将它明确设计为玩法，而不是让播放器偶然决定剧情。过场的职责是传达已定变化，并把控制可靠地交回。
body.en:
From the same initial state, follow watch, skip and fallback paths. Compare location, objects, knowledge, rewards and next actions. Presentation can differ, but each reaches its declared legal state.

Check repeated skip input, completion callbacks, loading after viewing and necessary input when media is missing. These tests establish runtime relationships, not pacing or enjoyment.

If one path reveals more, check whether that knowledge should become public now. An intended difference belongs in gameplay design rather than accidental player behavior. The cutscene communicates a confirmed change and returns control reliably.

q.zh: 跳过过场可以不给剧情信息吗？
q.en: Can skipping omit essential story information?

a.zh: 若信息是下一步选择的必要依据，就应通过简短摘要、静帧或可访问记录保留。跳过可以减少演出时间，不能使玩家失去理解当前状态所需的事实。
a.en: If the fact is needed for the next choice, preserve it through a brief summary, still or accessible record. Skipping shortens presentation without removing understanding of the current state.

text.zh: 请用 game-build 检查这条已定过场。列触发、起终状态、必要信息和跳过或降级结果；比较三条路径的状态与输入机会，别让表现回调重复发奖励。
text.en: Use game-build to review this approved cutscene. List trigger, boundaries, required information and skip or fallback results. Compare state and input opportunities across paths; prevent duplicate presentation rewards.

label.zh: 动态媒体与跳过降级
表现读取已提交状态

title.zh: 互动游戏选项怎么写：动作明确，后果留有悬念
title.en: How to Write Clear Interactive Story Choices

seo_title.zh: 互动游戏选项怎么写：动作明确，后果留有悬念
seo_title.en: How to Write Clear Interactive Story Choices

description.zh: 让按钮写真实动作，代价提示与人物回应各有用途。附原创证词场景、选项改写表与隐藏后果的边界。
description.en: Make options state real actions, with distinct cost cues and responses. Includes an original testimony scene and boundaries for hidden consequences.

answer.zh: 选项先说明玩家真正会说或做什么，已知成本在选择前可见，未知结果保留悬念。不要把“信任”“善良”等作者判断写成按钮，也不要让点下的行动变成相反意思。选择之后由人物回应和后续机会体现结果。
answer.en: State what the protagonist will actually say or do. Show known costs before selection while preserving uncertainty about unknown outcomes. Avoid author judgments such as trust or kindness, and never turn the selected action into its opposite. Let responses and later opportunities show consequences.

heading.zh: 按钮写行动，不写作者替玩家下的结论
heading.en: Write an action rather than an author’s judgment

body.zh:
game-world-design 的对白与交互文本方法要求选项呈现角色真实说法或行动，按钮、代价与回应各承担不同信息。选项不是策划对路线的道德评级。

原创游戏：修复档案的玩家发现一份证词，管理员要求先保密。当事人却希望公开。写“信任管理员”“伸张正义”会提前评价两条路，也没说明玩家究竟做什么。

可以改为“把证词交给管理员核对”和“请当事人在现场说明证词”。这两种行动可观察、有接收者，也留下对方接受或拒绝的空间。若按钮代表对白，点下之后说出的核心意图应一致；不因戏剧效果把请求改成威胁。
body.en:
game-world-design asks options to present real speech or action, with separate jobs for buttons, costs and responses. A choice is not a designer’s moral rating.

Original game: an archive restorer discovers testimony. The administrator requests confidentiality; the person involved wants it public. Labels such as trust the administrator or uphold justice prejudge the routes without stating an action.

Use submit the testimony for review or ask the witness to explain it on site. Both actions have a recipient and room for a response. If a button represents dialogue, the resulting line must retain its central intent rather than turning a request into a threat for drama.

heading.zh: 保留未知结果，不隐瞒已知代价
heading.en: Separate uncertainty from withheld known costs

body.zh:
| 选择前可见 | 本例表达 | 可以保持未知 |
|---|---|---|
| 谁有权看证词 | 交给管理员会扩大其知情范围 | 他随后是否会主动公开 |
| 当前时间成本 | 核对需要等到下午 | 期间谁会提出新要求 |
| 公开场合条件 | 当事人愿意出席，另有人反对 | 现场回应与最终立场 |

玩家可以承担未知，但应知道自己选择的行动。若公开会立刻消耗一个已经可见的权限，先说明；若某人尚未显露私心，不必把完整结局提前写在按钮上。

无法确定的推断就标为推断，别用确定口吻承诺结果。信息可以由证物、台词或界面短提示给出，不必每个选项附同样长的说明。
body.en:
| Visible before selection | Example | Still uncertain |
|---|---|---|
| Who receives the testimony | Submission gives the administrator access | Whether he later publishes it |
| Current time cost | Review lasts until afternoon | Who makes a new request meanwhile |
| Public meeting conditions | Witness agrees; another person objects | Responses and final positions |

Players can accept uncertainty while understanding their action. Disclose an established immediate cost, but do not put every undisclosed motive or ending in the label.

Express inference as inference rather than promising an unverified result. Objects, speech or a brief cue can supply evidence; every option does not need an equally long explanation.

heading.zh: 人物先回应，再让后续读取选择
heading.en: Show a response and a later consequence

body.zh:
提交核对后，管理员可以收下证词、提出缺少签名，或拒绝承担责任。界面先呈现真实反应，再开放补签、追问或撤回等符合规则的动作。选“提交”不保证“核对完成”，更不能自动写成所有人已经相信。

把证词去向、谁知道以及承诺了什么记录为具体事实。后续公开场景可以读取这些事实：管理员是否见过原件，当事人是否授权公开，玩家是否已答应等待。

分支可以汇合，但同一场景里的人物说法与可用行动要跟历史一致。未选的公开不能悄悄当作已经发生。选项少而有回响，比很多无人读取的路线标签更有用。
body.en:
After submission, the administrator may accept the document, request a signature or refuse responsibility. Show that response, then allow legal follow-up actions. Submit does not mean review completed or universal belief.

Record concrete facts: who holds the testimony, who knows it and what was promised. A later meeting can read whether the original was inspected, publication authorized or a waiting promise made.

Routes can converge while speech and available action honor history. An unchosen disclosure must not become a fact. A few consequential choices are more useful than many unread route labels.

heading.zh: 用实际点击路径检查选项是否诚实
heading.en: Read the actual selection path for fidelity

body.zh:
从按钮读到说出的台词、人物反应和下一场，检查四处是否在做同一件事。若按钮写“询问”却执行强行取走证词，先修动作映射，不用补一句心理旁白替玩家解释。

若所有选项只是同一结论的不同语气，承认这是表达选择，或让真实状态和机会出现差异；不能宣称剧情分支却只换一行文案。若代价提示泄露完整结局，退回玩家当前能知道的条件。

不要固定要求三项或更多选项。局面只有两种有意义行动，就写两种；没有取舍的地方可以继续叙事。文案检查能发现误导和重复，选择是否有吸引力仍需实际玩家反馈。
body.en:
Read button, performed line, response and next scene as one path. They should express the same action. If ask instead forcibly takes the testimony, repair the mapping instead of inventing internal narration to justify it.

If every option only changes tone, name it an expressive choice or provide genuine state differences. Do not advertise plot branches for one changed sentence. If a cost cue reveals the full ending, return to currently knowable conditions.

Do not impose three or more options. Two meaningful actions can be enough, and a passage without a decision can continue narratively. Text review finds misleading mappings; actual player response determines appeal.

q.zh: 隐藏后果是不是对玩家不公平？
q.en: Are hidden consequences inherently unfair?

a.zh: 不一定。玩家需要看清所选行动与已有依据，未知动机和远期结果可以保留。问题是隐藏角色已经知道的成本，或让按钮执行与字面相反的行动。
a.en: Not necessarily. Players need a clear action and available evidence; motives and distant outcomes can remain unknown. Problems arise when known costs are withheld or a label executes its opposite.

text.zh: 请用 game-world-design 审阅这组互动选项。对齐按钮与实际行动，分开已知成本和未知结果，列即时回应及后续读取；不要用道德标签替角色作决定。
text.en: Use game-world-design to review these choices. Align labels and actions, separate known costs from unknown outcomes, and identify immediate responses and later reads. Avoid moral labels that predecide the character’s choice.

label.zh: 互动选项与回应
按钮与提示的分工
隐藏因果与信息节拍

title.zh: 叙事游戏时间限制怎么设计：到期真的改变选择
title.en: How to Design Deadlines in a Story Game

seo_title.zh: 叙事游戏时间限制怎么设计：到期真的改变选择
seo_title.en: How to Design Deadlines in a Story Game

description.zh: 定义时间推进、承诺期限与到期后的可见结果。附原创渡船任务、延期事项表及提前或重复触发的检查。
description.en: Define time advancement, commitments and visible deadline consequences. Includes an original ferry task and checks for early or repeated triggers.

answer.zh: 先说明哪些行动推进时间、什么条件算到期，再把到期结果接回玩家当前可做的事。期限要有来源、接收者与结清方式，不能只在界面倒数。玩家应能预判已知成本；载入、回放和表现动画不能把同一后果重复触发。
answer.en: Define which actions advance time and what makes a deadline due. Make its consequence change present opportunities. A deadline needs an origin, recipient and settlement, not just a countdown. Players need knowable costs, and loading, replay or animation must not trigger the same consequence twice.

heading.zh: 先定游戏里的时间怎样前进
heading.en: Define how the game clock advances

body.zh:
game-world-design 要求延期事项重新进入决策面，game-build 再约束到期、结清与载入。时间可以按回合、事件或实时推进，先选与当前玩法相符的一种，不默认所有菜单和阅读都消耗时间。

原创游戏：岛上邮递员答应在第三次渡船离港前送回一份签收单。每完成一次跨区行动推进一个时段，查看已取得的记录不推进。出发前能看见当前时段、船期和送单路线。

这些是本例规则，不是通用数值。先把推进与不推进的动作写清，玩家才知道看证据是否会浪费期限。若确实采用实时等待，需要另外建立暂停、失焦和阅读时的行为。
body.en:
game-world-design requires delayed matters to return to the decision surface; game-build constrains due events and settlement. Time may advance by turns, events or real time. Choose what fits the game rather than charging every menu and reading action.

Original game: an island courier promises to return a signed receipt before the third ferry departure. Each cross-area action advances a period; inspecting acquired records does not. Players can see the current period, schedule and delivery route before leaving.

These are example rules, not universal values. Clear advancement rules let players know whether reviewing evidence spends the deadline. Real-time waiting needs separate pause, focus-loss and reading behavior.

heading.zh: 把期限记成有来源的事项
heading.en: Give the deadline an origin and a settlement

body.zh:
| 记录项 | 原创送单任务 |
|---|---|
| 来源 | 玩家向船员承诺归还签收单 |
| 携带事实 | 谁答应、单据在哪里、谁见证 |
| 到期条件 | 第三次离港事件开始前检查 |
| 当前状态 | 待送、已送或已错过 |
| 重新出现 | 相关路线提示与船员主动催问 |
| 结清 | 单据送达，或错过后双方改约 |

期限从承诺产生，不要每次进入港口就新建一个相同任务。完成之后停止催问，错过之后也不要无条件复活成未完成。

检查时点要准确：若设计允许最后一刻交单，就在离港事件前裁决；如果程序先开船再处理提交，同一规则会在表现层被悄悄改掉。
body.en:
| Record | Ferry task |
|---|---|
| Origin | Player promises the crew to return a receipt |
| Carried facts | Who promised, location of the document, witnesses |
| Due condition | Check before the third departure begins |
| Status | Pending, delivered or missed |
| Return to attention | Route cue and an active crew reminder |
| Settlement | Delivery or a revised arrangement after failure |

The promise creates the matter. Entering the harbor must not create another copy. Stop reminders after settlement and do not revive failure as a fresh pending task.

Timing matters. If last-minute delivery is allowed, resolve it before departure. A program that departs first and handles submission later silently changes that rule.

heading.zh: 让错过改变机会，而非只减一个分数
heading.en: Make missing it change an opportunity

body.zh:
送达后，船员把文件带走，后续收件人可以核实一项安排。错过后，船员已经离港，邮递员需要决定等下班船、找已经建立的另一接收人，还是承认无法按约完成。

不能让意外出现的路人自动替玩家送完核心任务。也不一定永久关闭整条剧情：时间成本可以让今天少做一件事、改变见面顺序或要求再次承诺。失败幅度取决于本游戏已声明的体验。

当前选择附近给出已知期限和成本，不提前公布所有结局。人物的催问、船位变化或短提示可以表达压力；倒计时只是其中一种表现，不必所有叙事游戏都挂精确秒数。
body.en:
Delivery lets the crew carry the document, enabling a later recipient to verify an arrangement. After a missed departure, the courier must wait for another ferry, use an established alternative recipient or acknowledge the broken promise.

An unexpected passerby should not automatically solve the core task. Missing a deadline also need not permanently close the whole story. It may reduce today’s opportunities, change meeting order or require another commitment, according to the declared experience.

Put knowable deadlines and costs beside affected choices without exposing every ending. A reminder, changed ship position or brief cue can convey pressure. An exact seconds counter is optional.

heading.zh: 检查临界时刻、结清与载入
heading.en: Check boundary timing, settlement and loading

body.zh:
从同一任务状态比较提前送达、临界送达和错过三条路线。记录推进时间的行动与实际检查时点，确认结果能回到玩家选择，而不是被动画播放长度改变。

再从到期前存档载入，核对不会提前开船；从已结清状态载入，核对不再次催问或再次奖励；连续提交同一单据，不能重复结算。这里处理的是期限运行关系，玩家感到紧张还是烦躁仍需实际观察。

若改船期或路线成本，重走受影响路径并同步设计与实现。只改界面倒数不改规则，会让承诺失去可信度；反过来也不能在没有告知的情况下缩短已建立的期限。
body.en:
Compare early, boundary-time and missed delivery from the same task state. Record advancing actions and the actual due check, ensuring outcomes follow choices rather than animation length.

Load before the deadline and ensure no early departure. Load after settlement and ensure no repeated reminder or reward. Repeated submission must not resolve twice. These checks establish deadline behavior; observing players determines whether the pressure feels compelling or irritating.

After changing schedules or route costs, replay affected paths and align design with implementation. A countdown changed without its rule undermines trust, as does an unannounced reduction of an established deadline.

q.zh: 时间限制一定要永久锁掉失败路线吗？
q.en: Must a missed deadline permanently close a route?

a.zh: 不一定。可以改变当天机会、见面顺序、后续代价或重新协商条件。先决定本项目需要的失败后果，再确保期限真实读取行动和时间，不用倒计时假装有压力。
a.en: No. It can change daily opportunities, meeting order, later cost or renegotiation. Choose the intended consequence, then make the deadline read actions and time rather than using a decorative countdown.

text.zh: 请用 game-world-design 设计这项有期限的承诺。说明时间推进、到期检查与结清，列送达、临界送达和错过后的当前选择；再给 game-build 明确载入和重复提交不得重复触发。
text.en: Use game-world-design to define this timed commitment. Specify advancement, due checks and settlement, and current choices after early, boundary or missed delivery. Give game-build explicit loading and duplicate-submission behavior.

label.zh: 延期回响与世界回应
到期与重复触发边界

title.zh: AI视频镜头忽明忽暗怎么办：按同一光态接镜
title.en: How to Match Color Between AI Video Shots

seo_title.zh: AI视频镜头忽明忽暗怎么办：按同一光态接镜
seo_title.en: How to Match Color Between AI Video Shots

description.zh: 先区分生成偏差与有意光线变化，再比较脸、衣物和中性表面。附原创柜台场景、接镜记录与局部修正方法。
description.en: Distinguish generated drift from intended light changes, then compare matching regions. Includes an original counter scene and focused correction checks.

answer.zh: 先确认相邻镜头处于同一场景、同一光线状态，再比较可比区域。轻微曝光或白平衡差异可以后期修正；有意关灯、换场或回忆不能被强行拉平。人物身份、错误光源和缺失动作需要回到制作，调色不能替它们补事实。
answer.en: Confirm the shots share a scene and light state, then compare matching regions. Modest exposure or white-balance differences may suit correction. Preserve intentional switches, scene changes and flashbacks. Identity drift, wrong light sources and missing actions need upstream repair, not color grading.

heading.zh: 先判断亮度变化有没有剧情理由
heading.en: Check whether the light change is intentional

body.zh:
short-drama-edit 先标实际素材的可用区间，再处理同场景接镜。不要看见剪点闪了一下，就把所有镜头平均亮度设为相同；服装面积、景别和背景也会改变全画面统计。

原创素材设定：夜间服务台里，值班员递出钥匙；下一镜近拍来人的手。两镜属于同一灯光状态，却一个偏黄、一个发白。这里可比较桌面和衣袖。随后有人关掉台灯，亮度下降有明确事件，应保留。

这些是诊断用的虚构素材描述，不是实测结果。实际处理先完整播放，再记录问题首次出现的时间和可见位置。段内慢慢变亮与剪点突然变亮不同，不能只看两个截帧就下结论。
body.en:
short-drama-edit identifies usable footage before matching a scene. Do not equalize every full-frame average after noticing a jump. Framing, clothing area and background change those statistics.

Original material setup: at a night service counter, a clerk hands over a key, followed by a close view of the visitor’s hand. The light state is unchanged, but one shot is yellow and the other washed out. Compare the desktop and sleeve. A later lamp switch intentionally darkens the space and should remain.

These are fictional diagnostic descriptions, not measurements. Play actual footage and record the first defect’s time and region. Gradual brightening within a shot differs from a jump at a cut; two stills alone are insufficient.

heading.zh: 用可比区域判断，不只看全画面均值
heading.en: Compare equivalent regions rather than whole-frame averages

body.zh:
| 检查项 | 本例做法 | 避免误判 |
|---|---|---|
| 场景与光态 | 两镜都在服务台、台灯仍开 | 换场或关灯不列同组 |
| 桌面 | 找同一材质且未被遮住的区域 | 不把反光钥匙当中性色 |
| 衣袖 | 比同一件衣服的未过曝部分 | 景别变近不等于衣服变色 |
| 人物 | 检查肤色和身份是否都正确 | 调色不能修脸或造型漂移 |

内置接镜按同场景素材统计做近似修正，能辅助发现和减少跳动，但不能自动判断剧情光态。明确有意变化的段需排除；自动处理后仍要看相同区域和实际切点。方法没有跨模型通用的正确亮度数值。
body.en:
| Check | Example | Avoid |
|---|---|---|
| Scene and light | Same counter, lamp still on | Grouping a new scene or lamp-off moment |
| Desktop | Same visible material | Using a reflective key as neutral reference |
| Sleeve | Same garment, unclipped area | Mistaking tighter framing for changed color |
| Character | Skin and identity both correct | Expecting grading to repair a face change |

Built-in matching uses scene-level statistics for approximate correction. It cannot infer intentional lighting. Exclude deliberately changed segments and inspect equivalent regions and actual cuts afterward. There is no universal correct brightness for every model.

heading.zh: 小幅修正后，回看信息有没有损失
heading.en: Correct modestly and recheck the story information

body.zh:
先比较未处理与小幅修正的版本。若桌面接上了，脸却发灰或钥匙纹理被压没，继续调整对应段，而不是整集统一套一个强滤镜。工具中的色温量是工具自己的冷暖校正，不等于开尔文，参数范围也不等于画面质量标准。

记录本段校正或排除自动处理的选择，避免两层效果叠加。超出内置能力时用调色工具，并把真实处理留在剪辑记录里；只写“色彩保持一致”不会改变文件。

若生成片尾高光逐渐过曝，可以只采用信息已完成、缺陷尚未发生的区间。若必要动作已经落在过曝处，列缺口回制作，不能为躲瑕疵删掉关键交接。
body.en:
Compare untreated footage with a modest correction. If the table matches but the face turns gray or key detail disappears, revise the affected segment rather than adding a strong filter to the episode. Tool temperature values are not kelvin, and supported ranges are not quality standards.

Record correction or exclusion decisions so effects do not stack unintentionally. Use a grading tool where needed and document actual treatment. Writing consistent color does not modify footage.

For an overexposed tail, use a complete information interval before the defect if available. If an essential action occurs in the defective region, request repair rather than deleting the handoff to avoid the flaw.

heading.zh: 逐接点和整段各看一次
heading.en: Inspect both joins and the complete scene

body.zh:
局部往返看桌面、衣物和脸，再按正常速度连播，看变化是否抢走原本的注意。必要时抽帧或测量帮助定位，实际可读性仍由画面与播放决定。

分别记录三种结果：已通过后期修正；有意变化保留；身份、光源或动作缺陷需回上游。不要把所有差异归成同一种调色问题，也不要把自动接镜成功当成整片验收。

重出素材以后重新检查该段和两侧接点，旧参数未必仍然合适。修订保留已正确的镜序、台词和结果，只针对已经观察到的差异。生成前的光线设计另见灯光提示词指南。
body.en:
Scrub the desktop, garment and face around each join, then play the scene normally to see whether the change distracts from its purpose. Frames or measurements help locate it; they do not establish final readability alone.

Record corrected differences, retained intentional changes and upstream defects separately. Automatic matching success is not acceptance of the whole film.

After regenerating a segment, recheck it and both neighboring joins; old values may no longer fit. Preserve correct order, dialogue and results while repairing observed differences. Planning light before generation is a separate task.

q.zh: 把每个镜头调成一样亮就能接上吗？
q.en: Will equal brightness make every cut match?

a.zh: 不能。景别、材质、衣服占比和有意光线变化都会影响均值。比较同场景同光态的可比区域，保留剧情变化，再实际播放判断。
a.en: No. Framing, materials, clothing area and intentional light changes affect averages. Compare equivalent regions under the same light state, preserve story changes and judge actual playback.

text.zh: 请用 short-drama-edit 检查相邻素材的亮度和色调。先确认同场景同光态，列可比区域与实际差异，排除有意变化；小幅处理后回看切点，不用调色掩盖身份或动作错误。
text.en: Use short-drama-edit to inspect brightness and color across these shots. Confirm scene and light state, compare regions, preserve intentional changes, and review modest corrections without masking identity or action defects.

label.zh: 可用区间与接镜校正

title.zh: 短剧对白中途怎么切画面：保留一句完整声音
title.en: How to Cut Away During Continuous Dialogue

seo_title.zh: 短剧对白中途怎么切画面：保留一句完整声音
seo_title.en: How to Cut Away During Continuous Dialogue

description.zh: 先定位台词发声，再把画面切到有作用的反应或物件。附原创钥匙归还场景、声画区间表与工具范围说明。
description.en: Locate the spoken line before cutting to a useful reaction or object. Includes an original key-return scene, interval table and workflow limits.

answer.zh: 先保住一句台词完整的声音区间，再决定观众此刻需要看说话者、听者还是证物。画面切点可以与声音切点不同，但说话人、空间和因果必须清楚。不要为换画面把原句改成两句，也不要拿无关反应冒充人物已经接受。
answer.en: Preserve the complete spoken interval first, then decide whether the speaker, listener or object deserves attention. Picture and sound cuts can differ, but speaker, space and causality must remain clear. Do not split the written line merely to change picture or use an unrelated reaction as acceptance.

heading.zh: 切到谁，先看这句改变了什么
heading.en: Choose the image by what the line changes

body.zh:
short-drama-edit 的入出点方法允许一句台词中途换画面，条件是音轨连续、说话人和叙事关系清楚。画面不是每个字的插图；它可以让观众看见这句话正在造成的反应。

原创场景：管理员归还钥匙，说：“我把备用的也放进去了，明天你不用等我开门。”承包人原本伸手拿钥匙，听到后却停住，问是否连检查责任也交给自己。

切到手停下，可以让“交接”显出新的压力；切到无关窗景只会离开行动。先确定这一次注意转移的作用，再选真实存在的素材。不要从另一场剪一个点头，写成此刻的同意。
body.en:
short-drama-edit permits a picture change within a line when speech stays continuous and the speaker and narrative relationship are clear. The image can reveal the line’s effect rather than illustrate each word.

Original scene: an administrator returns keys: “I included the spare. Tomorrow you won’t need me to open up.” The contractor pauses before taking them and asks whether inspection responsibility is included.

Cutting to the stopped hand reveals pressure within the handoff. An unrelated window view abandons the action. Define the attention shift, then select existing material. Do not borrow a nod from another scene to fabricate agreement.

heading.zh: 声音与画面分开记录区间
heading.en: Record speech and picture intervals separately

body.zh:
| 区间 | 画面、声音与作用 |
|---|---|
| 台词开始 | 采用画面：管理员与钥匙；采用声音：管理员完整原句开始；叙事作用：建立说话人与交接 |
| “明天”之后 | 采用画面：承包人的手停下；采用声音：同一句继续，不重启；叙事作用：读到条件引起的迟疑 |
| 原句结束 | 采用画面：承包人看向管理员；采用声音：保留原句语尾与必要停顿；叙事作用：为追问留空间 |
| 追问开始 | 采用画面：有依据的回应镜；采用声音：承包人自己的原句；叙事作用：明确责任仍需协商 |

这张表是原创设计，没有实测秒数。实际剪辑先定位真实发声，再标画面时刻；源素材时间与成片时间分别记，截取或换镜后重新核对。

同一句只能开始一次、结束一次。切到听者时可以是画外延续，不能让两段各自重复整句，也不能把画内对白暗中改成内心旁白。
body.en:
| Interval | Picture and sound |
|---|---|
| Line begins | Picture: Administrator and keys; Sound: Original line starts; Purpose: Establish speaker and handoff |
| After tomorrow | Picture: Contractor’s hand stops; Sound: Same line continues; Purpose: Show hesitation caused by the condition |
| Line ends | Picture: Contractor looks up; Sound: Complete ending and needed pause; Purpose: Prepare a question |
| Question begins | Picture: Relevant response view; Sound: Contractor’s own line; Purpose: Responsibility remains negotiable |
