完成记录写具体结果：“SC004–SC005 已换成无伤版本，SC006 建立受伤后态，SC007 引用一致”。它比“全部已更新”更能支持下一轮工作。最后正常速度看受影响段落，确认文档一致也落实到了画面。
body.en:
Review the last pre-injury shot, the fall and the first post-injury shot. Check clothing, injury, gait and possession for continuity, premature injury or unexplained recovery.

An episode’s silence about injury does not establish treatment. Find an accepted recovery or elapsed-time basis; otherwise leave a creator decision rather than inventing one downstream. Flashbacks use historical states without overwriting the present.

Close with a concrete result: “SC004–SC005 use uninjured versions; SC006 establishes the injury; SC007 agrees.” Play the affected sequence at normal speed to confirm that consistent documents also produced consistent footage.

q.zh: 只改角色名字也要重出素材吗？
q.en: Does renaming a character require new footage?

a.zh: 如果只是显示名称改变，身份与视觉事实没变，通常只需更新对应文本和引用。画面含必须改的可读姓名时，再定位那处素材；不自动重做无关分镜。
a.en: Usually not when only a display name changes and identity and visual facts remain intact. Update text and references; locate any visible name that must change without remaking unrelated shots.

text.zh: 用 $short-drama-assets 记录这次剧本修订的前态、后态、来源与有效范围，搜索现有资产、分镜及提示词的实际使用方，列出需要同步的事实并复查边界。
text.en: Use $short-drama-assets to record before/after facts, source and effective range. Find actual existing asset, storyboard and prompt dependencies, then check affected boundaries.

label.zh: 变化记录与修订影响

title.zh: 视频边框和Logo怎么加：先锁音画，再检查遮挡
title.en: How to Add a Video Frame and Logo Without Obstruction

seo_title.zh: 视频边框和Logo怎么加：先锁音画，再检查遮挡
seo_title.en: How to Add a Video Frame and Logo Without Obstruction

description.zh: 将静态边框、标题条与Logo作为独立图层，按实际画布定位。附原创包装布局、遮挡检查与声音保留方法。
description.en: Place static frames, title bars and logos as separate layers on the actual canvas. Includes an original layout and obstruction and audio checks.

answer.zh: 先确认无包装母版的画面、旁白和混音，再叠静态透明图层。布局画布与输出画幅一致，位置避开脸、动作、证据与字幕；动效另用完整动画素材。合成后查看亮暗场景和最终文件，确认包装可读、内容不被挡、声音没有意外变化。
answer.en: Lock picture, narration and mix before adding static transparent layers. Match the output canvas and avoid faces, actions, evidence and captions. Supply actual animation when needed. Inspect bright and dark scenes and the final file for readability, obstruction and unintended audio changes.

heading.zh: 先定内容，再投入包装
heading.en: Lock content before packaging

body.zh:
video-assemble 的包装方法先锁音画，再做边框、字幕与图层。剪点和声音仍在反复变化时，先不要精修动画，否则一轮改稿就可能让文字时段和画面位置失效。

原创视频展示修复一只旧收音机，采用竖屏。创作者想保留上方栏目名、角落 Logo 和轻薄边框。首先确认旁白与操作画面：拆盖、查看故障、换件、试听结果。包装的任务是稳定识别，不是每个空位都加效果。

记录输出宽高和已经接受的栏目文案。边框是整片不动的透明图片，可以单独叠加；标题动画若需渐显，就准备动画输出，而不是把静态图片声明成动效。
body.en:
video-assemble recommends locking picture and sound before packaging. If cuts and audio are still changing, detailed animation can become stale after the next edit.

Original vertical video shows an old radio repair: opening, diagnosis, replacement and a listening result. The creator wants a program title, corner logo and light frame. Their purpose is consistent recognition, not filling every empty area with effects.

Record the actual output dimensions and accepted title. A stationary transparent frame can be a separate image layer. A fading title requires rendered animation rather than an animated label attached to a still image.

heading.zh: 为内容留位置，别只看空白处
heading.en: Reserve space for content

body.zh:
| 图层 | 位置、作用与避让 |
|---|---|
| 轻薄边框 | 本例的位置与作用：沿画布边缘建立栏目识别；需要避开的内容：不能盖住手部移到边缘的操作 |
| 栏目名 | 本例的位置与作用：上方已留的标题区；需要避开的内容：不覆盖收音机盖上的关键标记 |
| Logo | 本例的位置与作用：创作者确认的角落位置；需要避开的内容：与解说字幕、指示箭头错开 |
| 解说字幕 | 本例的位置与作用：按实际台词与阅读宽度排；需要避开的内容：留出拆件近景的关键区域 |

这些位置是本项目布局选择，不是所有平台的固定安全区。用实际画幅看开头、近景、亮背景、暗背景和长字幕，必要时缩减边框或移动 Logo。

不要只拿一张空背景试排版。收音机在后半段移动到右下，原本看似空的角落会变成关键动作区；这时改包装位置，比遮住操作更合适。
body.en:
| Layer | Role and limits |
|---|---|
| Light frame | Role in this example: Identity around the canvas edge; Avoid: Hands moving toward the edge |
| Program title | Role in this example: Reserved upper title region; Avoid: Important marks on the radio cover |
| Logo | Role in this example: Creator-approved corner; Avoid: Captions and instruction arrows |
| Narration captions | Role in this example: Actual speech and reading width; Avoid: Important areas in repair close-ups |

These positions belong to the example, not a universal platform safe area. Inspect opening, close-up, bright, dark and long-caption frames in the actual aspect ratio.

Do not design against an empty background alone. The radio moves into the lower-right corner later, making a previously empty logo position important action space. Move or reduce packaging to retain the instruction.

heading.zh: 保持图层与画布关系明确
heading.en: Keep layers and canvas geometry explicit

body.zh:
静态图片保留透明背景，写清每层的本地路径与画布内矩形位置。画布尺寸必须等于成片尺寸，矩形不能越界；不靠合成后整体拉伸来掩盖比例错误。图层顺序也要明确，避免 Logo、画面说明与字幕互相盖住。

本版本 video-assemble 支持 packaging_layers.json 记录整片静态图片与位置，合成时叠加，剪映草稿里可保留独立图片轨。需要修改品牌图时替换对应素材和记录，不把整个包装烙在一张不可分的背景图上。

渐显、移动或其它逐帧变化使用项目渲染器输出，再经 foreground-compose 合成。该合成器接收已经画好的图层，不负责设计字体、生成文案或把任意模板变成动画。
body.en:
Use transparent images and explicit local paths and rectangles inside the actual canvas. The canvas must match the final dimensions and placements must remain in bounds. Final stretching cannot repair an incorrect aspect ratio. Make layer order explicit to avoid collisions with annotations and captions.

This version of video-assemble supports whole-video static image placement through packaging_layers.json, with independent image tracks in an exported Jianying draft. Replace the relevant asset when changing a brand element rather than flattening every element into one background.

For fades or movement, render the animation at project level and compose the resulting frames. foreground-compose overlays already rendered pixels; it does not design fonts, generate copy or animate arbitrary templates.

heading.zh: 在最终文件中检查包装
heading.en: Review packaging in the final file

body.zh:
先抽检代表帧，再完整播放实际最终视频。静态图在第一帧正确，不代表后面的手部、证据特写和字幕都未被挡。对比无包装母版，确认添加的是识别层，没有意外裁掉画面或引入不需要的声音处理。

如果标题在暗背景清楚、亮背景消失，可以调整描边、阴影或底板；如果这些都压住画面内容，就减少装饰或改位置。包装价值来自稳定可读，效果多不等于完成度高。

需要保留已定音轨时在任务里明确提出，并使用适合该锁定母版的合成路径；工具记录和正常回听各核对自己的问题。最终还要看第一帧、最后一帧和片尾是否残留 Logo 或字幕。
body.en:
Inspect representative frames, then play the actual final video. Correct first-frame placement does not prove later hands, evidence close-ups or captions remain unobstructed. Compare the unwrapped master for accidental cropping or unwanted sound processing.

If a title disappears on bright backgrounds, try an outline, shadow or backing. If those obscure content, reduce decoration or reposition it. Stable readability matters more than effect count.

Explicitly request preservation of adopted audio and use a compatible composition path. Technical records and normal listening address different checks. Review the first and last frames for unintended lingering logos or captions.

q.zh: 每个静态Logo都要做成逐帧动画吗？
q.en: Must every static logo become a frame sequence?

a.zh: 不必。整片固定的透明图片可以走静态包装图层；确实需要渐显或运动时，才准备完整动画序列，并按目标画布与时间线合成。
a.en: No. A fixed transparent image can use the static packaging path. Supply a complete animation sequence when a fade or movement is actually required.

text.zh: 请用 $video-recap 在已锁定母版上加静态栏目边框和 Logo。先确认画布、独立图层位置与遮挡检查，保留已采用声音，输出后看亮暗场景及首尾帧。
text.en: Use $video-recap to add a static program frame and logo to a locked master. Confirm canvas and independent layer placement, preserve adopted audio, then inspect bright/dark scenes and boundary frames.

label.zh: 包装顺序与静态图层
动画图层合成范围

title.zh: 视频片尾黑屏怎么处理：最后一镜与片尾卡分开检查
title.en: How to Replace an Unintended Black Video Tail

seo_title.zh: 视频片尾黑屏怎么处理：最后一镜与片尾卡分开检查
seo_title.en: How to Replace an Unintended Black Video Tail

description.zh: 判断黑尾是有意停顿还是未完成片尾，再提供真实静态或动画素材。附原创片尾区间表与首尾、音轨检查。
description.en: Distinguish an intentional pause from an unfinished tail, then supply the intended still or animated endcard. Includes an original timing plan and checks.

answer.zh: 先定位实际视频的最后内容帧、声音结束与黑尾范围，确认黑场是否有意。需要片尾卡时，提供覆盖目标区间的实际素材；静态卡用静图，渐显或动画用完整序列。不要默认复制最后一帧，也不要为消黑尾截掉仍需听完的词或音乐。
answer.en: Locate the final content frame, audio ending and black-tail interval, then establish whether the black is intentional. Supply an actual endcard covering the intended range: a still for a static card, a full sequence for a fade or animation. Do not freeze a frame or cut required audio by default.

heading.zh: 先确认黑尾来自哪个决定
heading.en: Identify the intended ending

body.zh:
video-assemble 的配对与前景合成方法会保留已有画面区间；成功合成不代表自动生成了品牌片尾。黑尾如果原本就在锁定母版中，它可以被忠实保留到输出。

原创教程母版的主要内容在第九秒结束，最后一秒保留给栏目片尾。旁白在九点四秒结束，成片却只有黑画面。先确认这段是待补的片尾区间，而不是创作者希望保留的黑场停顿。

如果黑尾来自上游剪辑遗漏，先修时间线；若它是已留出的片尾区间，就准备片尾素材。文件总时长与音轨时长相近只能说明兼容，不能证明结尾感受合适。
body.en:
video-assemble’s pairing and foreground paths preserve an existing picture interval; successful composition does not automatically create a branded ending. A black tail in the locked master can survive faithfully into the result.

Original tutorial: content ends at nine seconds, with one second reserved for a program card. Narration ends at 9.4 seconds, but the output shows only black. First establish that this is an unfinished card interval rather than an intentional pause.

Repair an upstream omission in the timeline, or provide media for the accepted reserved range. Compatible picture and audio durations do not prove the ending works editorially.

heading.zh: 把片尾卡放进明确区间
heading.en: Place the card in an explicit interval

body.zh:
| 本例区间 | 内容与保持项 |
|---|---|
| 零至九秒 | 内容：已锁定的教程画面与包装；必须保住：不重排操作、不改旁白 |
| 九至十秒 | 内容：栏目片尾卡；必须保住：旁白末句与已定混音继续完整播放 |
| 十秒以后 | 内容：本例没有交付内容；必须保住：不凭空增加黑帧或静音尾巴 |

这是本文虚构十秒母版的安排，不是建议所有片尾都做一秒。片尾时长应跟可读文案、声音和已接受的交付要求一起决定；需要延长母版时先重定时间线，而非让合成器暗中补时长。

用帧区间交接时，明确起点包含、终点不包含。三十帧每秒的本例中，片尾覆盖输出帧 270 到 300 之前，避免前景层与片尾层重叠一帧或漏一帧。
body.en:
| Example interval | Content and limits |
|---|---|
| 0–9 seconds | Content: Locked tutorial and packaging; Preserve: Action order and narration |
| 9–10 seconds | Content: Program endcard; Preserve: Complete final words and adopted mix |
| After 10 seconds | Content: No accepted content; Preserve: No invented black or silent extension |

This is a fictional ten-second master, not a one-second recommendation for all cards. Set duration with reading needs, audio and delivery requirements. If extension is necessary, revise the timeline instead of expecting hidden padding.

For frame handoff, include the start and exclude the end. At 30 fps, this card occupies output frames 270 through 299. Explicit bounds prevent a missing or duplicated boundary frame.

heading.zh: 静图和动画不能互相冒充
heading.en: Use actual still or animated assets

body.zh:
整段确实静止时，可以使用完整画布的片尾 PNG。若交付设计包含淡入、文字运动或其它变化，需要渲染全部片尾帧；冻结最后一张不能还原渐显过程。

本版本 foreground-compose 接收调用方已经渲染好的全画布 RGBA 序列，或明确的静态片尾素材。它不生成文案、字体或品牌动画，也不会在素材缺失时自动重复最后一帧填空。前景结束应接片尾开始，片尾结束应到达已确认的母版结束。

没有片尾需求时，前景可以覆盖完整母版，并明确没有片尾区间。不要保留一段空白范围，再把“无片尾”当成自动填充黑场的指令。
body.en:
Use a full-canvas PNG when the intended card is genuinely static. For a fade, moving text or other change, render every endcard frame; freezing the last image cannot reproduce the animation.

This version of foreground-compose accepts caller-rendered full-canvas RGBA sequences or an explicit still card. It does not generate copy, fonts or branding animation, and does not fill missing media by repeating a frame. Foreground and card ranges must meet, with the card ending at the verified master endpoint.

When no card is wanted, the foreground can cover the full master. Do not reserve an uncovered tail and expect “no endcard” to create an implicit filler.

heading.zh: 检查最后一秒，也回听最后一句
heading.en: Inspect the tail and listen to the last line

body.zh:
看片尾切入前后帧，确认没有未覆盖黑帧、上一镜残影或字幕突然跳回；再正常速度播放，判断片尾卡是否有足够阅读时间，以及淡入是否实际发生。

回听末句和音乐收尾。不能用“以最短音画结束”为快捷修法截掉必要尾音；若片尾需要改长度，要重新确认声音与画面区间，保留创作者已接受的内容。

输出文件存在只说明渲染得到一个结果。若工具帧数检查通过却仍见黑尾，回查素材是否本身带黑、透明层是否未覆盖、图卡是否放错范围。明确是哪项内容需修，再输出新的候选版本供检查。
body.en:
Inspect frames around the card entry for uncovered black, leftover image or captions that jump back. Play at normal speed to assess reading time and whether the intended fade actually occurs.

Listen to the final words and musical ending. Cutting to the shorter stream can remove required sounds. If duration changes, confirm both intervals again while preserving accepted content.

A rendered file is a result, not proof of a finished ending. If frame counts pass but black remains, inspect black pixels in the asset, uncovered transparent regions or misplaced ranges. Locate the failed content and produce a revised candidate.

q.zh: 有黑场就一定是导出错误吗？
q.en: Is every black ending an export error?

a.zh: 不是。黑场可以是有意停顿、留白或声音继续的选择。先核对创作意图和实际区间；只有缺少已要求的内容或出现意外帧时，才按问题修。
a.en: No. Black may be an intentional pause or space for continuing sound. Check the intended range; repair missing required content or unintended frames.

text.zh: 请用 $video-recap 检查最终视频黑尾，确认内容结束、声音结束与预留片尾区间。需要图卡时使用实际静图或完整动画，保留已采用音轨并复查边界帧。
text.en: Use $video-recap to inspect a black tail against content, audio and reserved card ranges. Supply an actual still or full animation when needed, preserve adopted audio and check boundary frames.

label.zh: 片尾素材与帧区间
包装与最终播放检查

title.zh: AI生成的图片和视频怎么放进游戏：保存、接入与失败处理
title.en: How to Integrate AI Media into a Story Game

seo_title.zh: AI生成的图片和视频怎么放进游戏：保存、接入与失败处理
seo_title.en: How to Integrate AI Media into a Story Game

description.zh: 将生成素材保存为稳定游戏资源，按状态触发并保留备用表达。附原创渡船场景资产表与加载失败检查。
description.en: Save generated media as stable game assets, connect it to state triggers and retain a fallback. Includes an original ferry scene and failure checks.

answer.zh: 生成完成后，把已确认素材保存到项目可用的稳定位置，再按游戏状态触发。记录角色、场景和剧情事实，检查首中尾帧与前后边界；为可选媒体准备静帧或低动效备用。临时任务页和下载地址不能代替正式资产，播放成功也不能代替玩法结果。
answer.en: Save accepted media in stable project locations and trigger it from game state. Track character, location and story facts, checking representative frames and boundaries. Provide a still or low-motion fallback for optional media. Temporary task pages are not production assets, and playback does not establish a gameplay outcome.

heading.zh: 先判断这段体验是否适合预渲染
heading.en: Decide what prerecorded media can carry

body.zh:
game-build 的动态媒体方法适用于美术方向已选择的视频过场、环境循环或关键帧演出。固定构图的短表现可以用预渲染；玩家输入会改变视角、位置、碰撞或战术信息时，需要对应的实时场景，不能用视频假装交互。

原创游戏中，玩家决定是否点亮渡口的信号灯。点亮结果已经由规则确认后，一段短视频表现对岸船只回应，随后继续交互。船只是否来接人由游戏状态决定，视频负责呈现它，不在生成时临时改结果。

如果玩家需要随时转头查两侧水道，这就超出固定视频承担的范围。先明确体验，再选择素材，不能因为生成了一段好看的视频就让玩法迁就它。
body.en:
game-build’s media method applies when art direction has chosen cutscenes, environment loops or keyframe performance. A fixed-view short presentation can be prerecorded. Player-controlled perspective, movement, collision or tactical information requires appropriate real-time behavior.

Original game: the player chooses to light a ferry signal. Rules confirm the result before a short clip shows a boat responding; interaction then resumes. Game state decides whether the boat comes. Generated media presents that result rather than inventing it.

If the player must freely turn to inspect both channels, a fixed clip cannot carry that interaction. Choose the experience first instead of reshaping gameplay around an attractive generated asset.

heading.zh: 保存实际文件与接入条件
heading.en: Keep the actual file and its trigger

body.zh:
| 记录项 | 本例填写 |
|---|---|
| 稳定资源名 | ferry-response，保存到项目媒体目录 |
| 触发条件 | 信号已点亮、渡船仍可响应、此前未播放 |
| 已锁事实 | 同一渡口、船在对岸、信号灯已亮 |
| 允许变化 | 船灯回应，短距离驶近 |
| 起止边界 | 开始在对岸；结束仍未靠岸，进入等待选择 |
| 备用表达 | 同状态静帧与一句船只回应的事件文本 |

记录还包括时长、所用参考、输出路径、来源和当前状态。输出立即保存，不把供应商任务页、缓存或可能失效的下载链接当成项目资源。

资源名稳定便于接入，但替换文件后仍要确认它符合已定事实。不能只凭相同文件名把另一处渡口或提前靠岸的素材当同一个结果。
body.en:
| Record | Example |
|---|---|
| Stable resource | ferry-response in the project media directory |
| Trigger | Signal lit, boat able to respond, not previously played |
| Locked facts | Same landing; boat across the water; signal on |
| Allowed motion | Boat answers with a light and approaches briefly |
| Boundaries | Starts across the water; ends before docking, returning to a waiting choice |
| Fallback | Same-state still and a short response event |

Also record duration, references, output path, provenance and status. Save actual files promptly; supplier task pages, caches and temporary download links do not serve as project assets.

Stable naming supports integration, but replacement media must still match accepted facts. A clip from another landing or showing premature docking is not equivalent merely because its filename matches.

heading.zh: 先低成本检查事实，再产最终素材
heading.en: Review facts before final production

body.zh:
先锁角色、场景、道具与本次临时状态，再用草稿检查身份、构图、动作和边界。已有参考时描述本镜的变化，不重新设计外观；分辨率更高也不会自动修复船位或人物身份漂移。

抽看首、中、尾代表帧，再正常播放。船应从已定位置开始，不凭空多一艘；结尾不能已靠岸却让后续文字仍说在等待。上一段结束与下一段开始也要能衔接。

失败定位到具体事实后再补素材或改受控变化。主观喜欢另一种画风可以成为美术取舍，但不能用“画面更好看”掩盖对游戏结果的改写。
body.en:
Lock identity, location, props and temporary state, then test framing, motion and boundaries with a low-cost draft. Existing references support controlled changes; higher resolution does not repair boat-position or identity drift.

Inspect first, middle and last frames, then play normally. The boat starts where established, no extra vessel appears, and the ending cannot show docking while subsequent text still asks the player to wait. Connect adjacent media boundaries too.

Locate the failed fact before regenerating. A preferred visual style is an art decision, but visual appeal does not justify changing a gameplay result.

heading.zh: 素材加载失败后仍有明确下一步
heading.en: Define behavior when media fails

body.zh:
接入时明确预载、播放、跳过、失焦、静音与资源释放。目标环境不能解码素材时，在构建阶段转换到支持格式，不等玩家运行后临时请求供应商。

本例的视频是表现层，可降级为已登记的静帧与事件文本。模拟加载失败，确认信号结果、玩家可见信息和下一步等待选项仍保留，返回交互时不再发一次奖励。备用不是只显示“加载失败”后永远卡住。

若 brief 已把某条媒体列为不可缺少的玩家效果，就不能静默换成静帧并声称完成。显示明确错误，回到相应构建环节解决。正常路径与失败路径各走一遍，看资产是否真的服务可玩流程。
body.en:
Specify preloading, playback, skip, focus loss, mute and resource release. Convert unsupported media during the build rather than requesting a supplier while the player is running the game.

Here video is optional presentation, with an accepted still and event-text fallback. Simulate a load failure and confirm the signal result, necessary information and waiting choice remain available, without issuing a second reward on return. A permanent loading error is not a usable fallback.

If the brief makes a media effect indispensable, do not silently replace it and claim completion. Show a clear error and resolve the relevant build issue. Walk both normal and failed-media paths to verify that the asset supports play.

q.zh: 生成视频能直接替代玩家操作吗？
q.en: Can a generated clip replace player interaction?

a.zh: 固定镜头的表现段可以使用视频；玩家会改变视角、位置或规则结果时，需要真实交互。先由游戏规则确认结果，再用素材表现，不能让视频内容替规则裁决。
a.en: A clip can carry a fixed presentation. Player-controlled perspective, position or rule outcomes need real interaction. Commit results through game rules, then present them in media.

text.zh: 用 $game-build 接入已确认的动态媒体，记录稳定路径、触发条件、事实锁与起止边界；为可降级素材准备备用表达，并验证播放、跳过与加载失败后的合法状态。
text.en: Use $game-build to integrate accepted media with stable paths, triggers, locked facts and boundaries. Register fallbacks and verify legal states after playback, skipping and load failure.

label.zh: 动态媒体保存、连续性与失败处理
label.en: Media storage, continuity and failure handling

title.zh: 小说多方势力怎么写：目标、筹码与联盟变化
title.en: How to Write Multiple Factions in a Novel

seo_title.zh: 小说多方势力怎么写：目标、筹码与联盟变化
seo_title.en: How to Write Multiple Factions in a Novel

description.zh: 让多方势力围绕同一事件行动，按各自利益回应。附原创联盟变化表，避免第三方只负责围观或突然帮助主角。
description.en: Give factions independent reasons to act on one event. Includes an original alliance map and repairs for passive observers or unexplained support.

answer.zh: 先选一件所有势力都必须回应的事，再分别写他们想保住什么、掌握什么、能采取什么行动。下一方的回应要继承上一方造成的条件。盟友可以有分歧，第三方也有自己的利益；立场改变必须来自新信息、交换或代价，而非只因主角需要援手。
answer.en: Choose one event all factions must respond to. Give each a goal, information and leverage. Each response inherits conditions created by the previous action. Allies can disagree, and third parties have their own interests. New information, a bargain or a cost must explain a changed position.

heading.zh: 先围绕一件事分清各方
heading.en: Organize factions around one event

body.zh:
Oh Story 的阵营方法让不同立场对同一事件行动，并检查第三方是否补足动机与逻辑。它有偏爽文的实力排序版本；这里采用利益与回应的方法，不把“主角最后碾压”当所有小说的要求。

原创故事：河港暴雨将至，旧仓库既存着船工粮食，也是航运会担保的货物。港务署准备按既有防汛计划关仓，船工要求先取粮，航运会怕担保货物混乱后无人负责。主角是一名负责清点的仓管，想让粮食能被取出，也保住交接记录。

先写各方此刻能做的事。港务署掌握封仓安排；船工知道哪些粮袋属于自家；航运会能派人核对担保货。背景和势力名称只补到读者理解这些选择为止。
body.en:
Oh Story has factions respond differently to a shared event and uses third parties to test motives and logic. Some variants favor a power-ranking payoff. This example applies goals and responses without requiring the protagonist to overpower everyone.

Original story: heavy rain approaches a river port. A warehouse holds workers’ food alongside cargo guaranteed by the shipping guild. The port office plans to close it under an established flood procedure. Workers want their food; the guild wants accountable handling. The protagonist, a warehouse clerk, wants access to the food and reliable handover records.

The office controls closure, workers identify their sacks, and the guild can supply cargo witnesses. Introduce history and names only as needed to understand these actions.

heading.zh: 原创示例：援手也提出条件
heading.en: Example: help comes with conditions

body.zh:
| 一方行动 | 下一方为什么回应 | 局面改变 |
|---|---|---|
| 船工要求立即取粮 | 港务署担心人群堵住清点通道 | 要求指定代表，不允许全部入仓 |
| 仓管提出分区交接 | 航运会要保留担保货的责任链 | 愿派见证人，但要求每批货有签收 |
| 船工推举代表并核对粮袋 | 港务署得到可管理的人流安排 | 同意在原定封仓前办理有限交接 |

航运会帮助不是“突然发现主角优秀”，而是新方案保护了它关心的记录。船工也不是听完演讲全部站队：代表必须向其他人说明哪些粮袋已取走，剩余如何登记。

这个例子不宣称粮食全部获救。若时间不足，主角还要决定先交哪些、向谁解释，不能让一份新表格消除已经建立的雨势与工期。
body.en:
| Action | Motive | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Workers demand access now | The office fears a blocked counting passage | It requests delegates rather than a crowd |
| Clerk proposes separate handovers | The guild wants a chain of responsibility | It offers witnesses if each batch is signed for |
| Workers nominate delegates and identify sacks | The office now has manageable access | It permits limited handovers before the existing closure time |

The guild helps because the proposal protects its records. Representatives still owe other workers an account of what was retrieved and what remains.

The plan does not prove every sack is saved. An approaching deadline still requires priorities and explanations; paperwork cannot erase established constraints.

heading.zh: 记录换边的依据与剩余分歧
heading.en: Record why an alliance changes

body.zh:
> **共同事件：**谁的资源或行动受到影响？
>
> **各方目标与筹码：**谁能阻止、允许、提供或证明什么？
>
> **立场变化的触发：**新事实、可信交换，还是已付代价？
>
> **变化范围：**同意本次合作，还是接受长期联盟？
>
> **仍未解决：**谁的利益没被满足，下一步会做什么？

本例航运会同意派见证人，不等于支持仓管以后所有决定；船工接受代表交接，也不等于放弃剩余粮食。这种有限合作能保留后续冲突。

主角替友军出头，也要连回自己的目标、责任或既有关系；敌方背后的新势力出场时，要解释它与本次利益如何相连，不能只因需要更大对手。
body.en:
Use a planning card: shared event; each faction’s goal and leverage; trigger for a changed position; scope of cooperation; unresolved interests and next action.

Providing witnesses does not mean the guild supports every future decision. Accepting representative access does not mean workers abandon the remaining food. Limited cooperation preserves future differences.

If the protagonist intervenes for an ally, connect that choice to an established goal, responsibility or relationship. A larger opposing faction needs a connection to the current interests, rather than arriving merely to escalate the cast.

heading.zh: 检查是否只换人名，没换行动逻辑
heading.en: Check whether factions actually differ

body.zh:
把各方名字暂时遮住，比较行动理由。每方都只想羞辱主角、每方都同时震惊，说明利益没有进入场景。给承担决定的势力一项不可替代的筹码，背景群众不必都建成长线。

再按事件顺序读：谁知道新方案？谁确实收到条件？谁已采取行动？私下谈妥的事不能自动让公开人群知道。一个人承担某项承诺，也不能自动代表整个组织同意。

最后检查删掉第三方后的损失。若仅少了鼓掌，可以降为旁观；若失去责任见证、资源或一项反制，就把它的行动理由写实。势力图帮助作者检查逻辑，正文仍通过行动和对白推进。
body.en:
Hide the faction names and compare reasons. If everyone only humiliates the protagonist or expresses surprise, interests have not entered the scene. Give decision-making factions distinct leverage; background crowds need not become long-running subplots.

Trace who heard the proposal, received conditions and acted. A private agreement is not public knowledge. One person’s commitment does not automatically bind an organization.

Removing a third party should reveal its function. If only applause disappears, reduce it to background. If evidence, resources or opposition disappear, establish why it provides them. The planning map supports scenes rather than replacing them.

q.zh: 第三方必须支持主角吗？
q.en: Must a third party support the protagonist?

a.zh: 不必。它要按自身利益行动；援助、拒绝或有限合作都需要具体理由。
a.en: No. Help, refusal or limited cooperation follows its own interests and needs an established reason.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 检查我的多方势力场景。先列共同事件、各方目标、筹码与知情范围，再按行动顺序检查回应和换边依据。区分本次合作与长期联盟；不临时增加援手、权限或更大反派。材料：〔场景和有关设定〕。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to review a multi-faction scene. Map the shared event, goals, leverage and knowledge, then trace responses and alliance triggers. Separate temporary cooperation from lasting allegiance. Do not invent allies, authority or a larger villain. Material: [scene and settings].

label.zh: 阵营动机与回合回应

title.zh: 小说修改前文后怎么检查后文：线索、知情与持物
title.en: How to Check Later Chapters After Revising a Novel

seo_title.zh: 小说修改前文后怎么检查后文：线索、知情与持物
seo_title.en: How to Check Later Chapters After Revising a Novel

description.zh: 从改动事实追到最后已写章，检查线索、人物知情与物件去向。附原创删线索案例和后续影响表，避免只更新设定集。
description.en: Trace a revised fact through written chapters. Check clues, knowledge and object ownership with an original example and a downstream-impact worksheet.

answer.zh: 先写清前文哪项事实变了，再找后文所有依赖它的行动、对白与揭示。删掉取得线索的一幕，就检查后面谁还引用它；改变交接，就检查物件后来在谁手里。先列正文冲突，再决定保留、重写或删除，最后按最后已写章更新当前记录。
answer.en: Name the fact changed by the revision, then find later actions, dialogue and reveals that depend on it. Removing a clue requires checking later references; changing a handover requires checking ownership. Identify manuscript conflicts before choosing a repair, then update current records through the last written chapter.

heading.zh: 把改稿变成可追踪的事实差异
heading.en: Describe the factual difference

body.zh:
Oh Story 的章节修订方法要求从改动章检查到最后已写章，分别重算伏笔、时间、读者认知与人物状态。这里把它转成作者可用的改稿表；文字润色未改变事实时，不必把全书重新写一遍。

原创稿件原来在第六章让池遥独自查看值班本，发现周姨曾代领工具；第九章池遥据此当面追问。修改后，第六章只保留值班本被锁进柜中的情节，池遥没有看过内页。第九章那句“你上周代领了工具”于是失去知识来源。

这不是把“看到”改成“想到”就能修好。先确认作者希望删掉的是查看过程、获得信息这件事，还是提前揭示的时机。三种选择影响不同。
body.en:
Oh Story’s chapter-revision method checks affected clues, time, reader knowledge and characters through the last written chapter. This worksheet adapts that process for authors. Wording changes that preserve facts need not trigger a whole-book rewrite.

Original manuscript: Chi Yao reads a duty register alone in chapter six and learns Mrs. Zhou collected tools. She questions Zhou about it in chapter nine. The revision instead locks the register in a cabinet before Chi can read it. Her later accusation now lacks a source.

Replacing “saw” with “realized” does not repair access. Determine whether the author removed the viewing process, the acquisition of information, or only its reveal timing. Those decisions have different consequences.

heading.zh: 示例：沿依赖关系逐章查
heading.en: Example: follow dependencies

body.zh:
| 后文位置 | 原来依赖什么 | 改后需要裁定 |
|---|---|---|
| 第九章追问 | 池遥看过代领记录 | 删除确定说法，或在此前建立真实获知机会 |
| 第十章怀疑改变 | 周姨回应了有依据的追问 | 检查追问变化后，这次回应是否仍会发生 |
| 第十二章公开说明 | 其他人听过周姨解释 | 若解释未发生，他们不能默认已经知情 |

表格只记录当前稿件中的实际依赖，不把可能的新剧情当已经发生。修法若增加一场查看，就要重新决定查看条件、在场者、读者得到的内容和后文代价。

若作者只是想让读者晚知道，可以保留池遥早先已看过的事实，但需要正文允许这种信息分配；不能修后再把作者知道的内容随便交给角色。
body.en:
| Passage | Depends on | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| Chapter nine question | Chi read the collection entry | Remove certainty or establish a real earlier opportunity to learn |
| Chapter ten suspicion | Zhou answered an informed question | Check whether the revised interaction still causes this response |
| Chapter twelve public account | Others heard Zhou’s explanation | If the explanation no longer happens, they cannot already know it |

Record actual dependencies, not possible replacement plots. Adding a viewing scene requires decisions about access, witnesses, reader information and consequences.

If only reader timing changes, Chi may still know earlier, provided the chosen narrative supports that distribution. The author’s private knowledge cannot be freely assigned to a character.

heading.zh: 当前记录不能停在被改那一章
heading.en: Update records through the written endpoint

body.zh:
第六章池遥没看过值班本，不等于第十二章也一定不知道：她可能在第十一章通过已经存在的正式交接得知。检查要追到最后已写章，再分别记“何时获得、当时谁在场、目前知道什么”。

物件同样分开：谁拿过、何时交出、目前谁持有。删掉一次借钥匙，不要顺手清空角色后来真实取得的其他资源。关系变化也只改受影响部分，保留仍然成立的承诺与边界。

在 Oh Story 项目里由修订流程重建追踪记录；手工写作可按同样原则更新笔记。两种方法都要以修后正文为证据。大纲里的未来揭示仍是计划，不写成读者已经知道。
body.en:
Not reading the register in chapter six does not prove Chi remains ignorant in chapter twelve. An existing chapter-eleven handover may give her the information. Check through the written endpoint and record acquisition, witnesses and current knowledge separately.

For objects, distinguish past possession, transfer and current owner. Removing a key loan must not erase unrelated resources later acquired. Preserve unaffected relationship promises and boundaries.

Oh Story rebuilds tracking through its revision workflow; manual notes can follow the same principle. Both require evidence in revised prose. Future reveals in an outline remain plans rather than reader knowledge.

heading.zh: 一次只处理明确批准的依赖
heading.en: Bound the repair pass

body.zh:
> **改动章与事实：**原来如何，现在哪里不同？
>
> **影响表：**每处后文依赖、位置与原句依据。
>
> **作者裁定：**保留哪个事实；哪些章这轮获准修改？
>
> **复读范围：**改动章衔接、受影响后文和最后已写章状态。

先留原稿。局部改稿检查前章末段与后章开头；整章重写需要更完整的相邻上下文。修后重走影响表，确认每个关闭项能找到新的正文依据。

若后文已经因另一事件获得同一信息，就注明来源，不扩大修订。若一个依赖尚未处理，明确留在清单上。更新设定集可以帮助续写，但不能让现存错误对白自动消失。
body.en:
A repair brief names the original and revised fact, each dependent passage and its evidence, the author’s chosen authority, approved chapters, and the reread range.

Keep the original. Local changes need neighboring transitions; whole-chapter rewrites require fuller adjacent context. Revisit the impact table and close items only with evidence in revised prose.

If another existing event supplies the same knowledge, record it rather than enlarging the edit. Leave unresolved dependencies visible. Updating notes supports continuation but cannot repair an incorrect line already in the manuscript.

heading.zh: 完整修法：先问，再看见，再限制后文结论
heading.en: A Complete Repair: Ask, See, Then Bound Later Claims

body.zh:
接着上例，假设作者选定：第六章仍不让池遥读到内页，第九章才获得代领信息。这次批准修改第九、十、十二章相关段落，并明确周姨原有职责允许她当面核对自己经手的一条；池遥没有自由翻阅整本的权限。她要追的是这批工具的去向，不能预先知道谁代领。下面是本页原创改稿示范，不是已执行的项目修订。

**第九章候选：**

> “你们收发工具都记在那本里吗？”池遥指了指柜门，“能帮我查一下上周这批工具的收发吗？我没看过内页。”
>
> “哪些工具？”周姨问。
>
> 池遥指明自己要找的工具。周姨打开柜门，把本子翻到相应的一行，指给她看：“这一次是我领的。”
>
> 池遥看清工具名称、日期和签名。“领走以后交给谁了？”
>
> “值班长。”周姨合上本子，放回柜中。

这里周姨实际回应、出示，池遥才有已见记录；她没有看全本，也没有据此知道工具最终去了哪里。问题按已有的查找目标提出，不先把谁代领塞进问题；工具名称对上之后，记录才与这批工具有关。周姨的“值班长”是她当面作出的说法，还不是已独立核验的交接。

**第十章承接：**

> 池遥在笔记上写下：“见到周姨代领记录；她说后来交给值班长，未核。”她把下一次询问留给值班长，没有再把代领等同于拿走不还。

**第十二章当面说明：**

> 周姨和器材负责人都在场。池遥把笔记摊在桌上：“我看见的只有周姨代领那条。后面的去向还没核到，不能说东西现在就在她手里。”器材负责人复述了要核对的交接，表示先问值班长并核对记录。

负责人接受的是下一步核对，不是已经查明去向。这三人听到了说明，未在场的人仍不能默认知情。

| 位置 | 改后正文与当前边界 |
|---|---|
| 第六章 | 值班本被锁起；池遥未见内页，读者也未从这场得到代领内容 |
| 第九章 | 实际看见一条签名并听到回应；没有得到全本或完整去向 |
| 第十章 | 怀疑改为待核交接；下一次询问仍是计划 |
| 第十二章 | 当场说明已见与未核；现持工具者仍未知，本子由周姨收回 |

这样改，删掉旧获知机会并没有让后文凭空消失，而是把后文改成新的获知、反应和说明。真实稿件要逐项引用修改后的章段，扫描至最后已写章；更新笔记不能代替修掉旧对白。若原稿已有别的独立获知机会，保留那条有效来源，不再套用本例新增一次查问。
body.en:
Continue the register example. Suppose the author chooses to keep Chi ignorant of its contents in chapter six and let her learn the collection entry in chapter nine. This pass permits the dependent passages in chapters nine, ten and twelve to change. It also establishes that Zhou's existing duties let her show her own entry; Chi cannot browse the whole book. She is tracing these tools, without knowing in advance who collected them. This is an original editorial demonstration, not an executed project revision.

**Chapter-nine candidate:**

> “Do you record tool handoffs in that book?” Chi pointed to the cabinet. “Could you check last week's receipt and return of these tools? I haven't seen the pages.”
>
> “Which tools?” Zhou asked.
>
> Chi identified the tools she was tracing. Zhou opened the cabinet, found the matching line and pointed to it. “I collected this one.”
>
> Chi read the tool names, date and signature. “Who got the tools afterward?”
>
> “The duty supervisor.” Zhou closed the book and returned it to the cabinet.

An actual response and showing now precede Chi's knowledge. One entry establishes neither the whole register nor the tools' final destination. The question follows an established search goal without presuming who collected the tools. Matching tool names connect this entry to the objects being traced. Zhou's statement about the supervisor remains a reported handoff, not independent verification.

**Chapter-ten continuation:**

> Chi wrote: “Saw Zhou's collection entry. She says she passed the tools to the duty supervisor; unchecked.” She left a question for the supervisor rather than treating collection as proof that Zhou had kept them.

**Chapter-twelve conversation:**

> Zhou and the equipment officer were present. Chi opened her notes. “All I saw was Zhou's collection entry. I haven't traced what happened afterward. I can't say she has the tools now.” The equipment officer repeated the handoff to investigate and agreed to ask the duty supervisor and check the records first.

Agreement to check does not establish the destination. These three heard the explanation; absent people do not acquire it automatically.

| Passage | Revised evidence and limits |
|---|---|
| Chapter six | Locked register; Chi has not read it, and this scene gives readers no collection details. |
| Chapter nine | One signed entry is seen and a reply heard; the whole book and complete destination remain unknown. |
| Chapter ten | Suspicion becomes an unchecked handoff; the next question is still planned. |
| Chapter twelve | Seen and unchecked facts are stated to those present; current tool possession is unknown, and Zhou has taken the register back. |

Removing the old opportunity now changes later acquisition, response and explanation rather than erasing their dependencies. In a real manuscript, cite the revised passages and trace through the written endpoint. Notes cannot fix an old line left in the prose. Retain a different valid acquisition already in the manuscript instead of automatically adding this inquiry.

q.zh: 只是换措辞也要查到最后一章吗？
q.en: Does every wording edit need a full downstream scan?

a.zh: 没有改变事实或信息顺序时，核对局部衔接即可。改变知情、持物、事件或关系后，再追实际依赖。
a.en: If facts and information order are unchanged, check local transitions. Trace actual dependencies after changes to knowledge, possession, events or relationships.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 检查〔第X章〕改稿对后文的影响。先比较原稿和新稿，逐项列改变的事件、线索、知情者、持物和关系；从X查到最后已写章M，引用实际依赖。先出影响表，不自动修后文；经我指定范围后再修订，并保留未处理项。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to compare the original and revised chapter [X]. Trace changed events, clues, knowledge, ownership and relationships through the last written chapter [M], citing actual dependencies. Report impacts before editing later prose. After I specify scope, revise and retain unresolved items.

label.zh: 章节范围与后续同步

title.zh: 多人对峙分镜怎么做：站位、视线与阵营变化
title.en: How to Storyboard a Group Confrontation

seo_title.zh: 多人对峙分镜怎么做：站位、视线与阵营变化
seo_title.en: How to Storyboard a Group Confrontation

description.zh: 先分清谁保护、施压、作证与决定，再把关系变成站位。附原创群戏表，修复角色换边、重复惊讶与一人两处的问题。
description.en: Map who protects, pressures, witnesses and decides before placing the cast. Includes an original scene and repairs for conflicting positions and reactions.

answer.zh: 先按本场作用分组，再画主要对抗关系、见证区域和进出口。每个人的朝向、距离与行动线都要对应当前剧本。新事实使谁能够行动，就重点表现谁；切镜继承上一镜的站位与持物，换边需要真实行动或可读的转向，不能靠新构图偷偷完成。
answer.en: Group characters by their current function. Establish the main confrontation, witnesses and entrances. Orientation, distance and movement must match the script. Prioritize people whose available actions change. Cuts inherit position and ownership; a changed allegiance needs a readable action or turn.

heading.zh: 分组看行动能力，不轮流拍表情
heading.en: Group by agency rather than reaction shots

body.zh:
Drama Skills 的群体调度方法分清知情者、决定者、利益相关者和普通旁观者，再把“谁保护、协作、施压、观察谁”变成空间安排。不是每个人都需要一条独立对话轴线。

原创场景：活动室里，组织者季琳要求志愿者签下设备损坏说明。设备负责人陈澄要核对交接单，管理员握有原始登记，其他志愿者在门侧等待布置。已定剧本要求：陈澄站到签字者旁边请求暂停；管理员拿出登记；季琳随后允许先核对。

主对抗是季琳与签字者，陈澄此刻协助签字者，管理员控制证据。门侧人群只在暂停布置影响自己工作时回应，不需要挨个震惊特写。
body.en:
Drama Skills separates informed people, decision-makers, stakeholders and observers. It then translates directed relationships—protection, cooperation, pressure and observation—into space. Every participant need not have a separate dialogue axis.

Original scene: organizer Ji Lin asks a volunteer to sign a damage statement. Equipment lead Chen Cheng wants the handover checked. The administrator holds the original register; others wait near the entrance. The accepted script has Chen move beside the signer and request a pause, the administrator produce the register, and Ji permit verification.

The main confrontation is Ji versus the signer. Chen supports the signer; the administrator controls evidence. Waiting volunteers react when the pause affects their work, without a sequence of identical shocked faces.

heading.zh: 原创站位表：关系只对当前一拍成立
heading.en: Example: map relationships for this moment

body.zh:
| 当前关系 | 空间落实 | 转向后要更新 |
|---|---|---|
| 陈澄协助签字者 | 陈澄站在签字者身旁，朝向季琳；不遮住签字者的手 | 陈澄转去核对登记时，记录实际移动 |
| 季琳向签字者施压 | 两人隔桌相对，说明书在桌面上 | 同意暂停后，压力动作结束，不继续把笔逼近 |
| 管理员提供记录 | 留在登记柜旁，持本走到桌侧 | 后镜继承新位置与持本状态 |

这张表不替剧本新增联盟。陈澄提出核对，不等于指认季琳说谎；管理员提供资料，也不等于支持某人的全部立场。

一帧内不能把陈澄同时写成“与签字者并肩向季琳施压”和“站在季琳一侧拦住签字者”，除非本镜确实表现她换位的过程。先解决关系和行动矛盾，再写构图。
body.en:
| Relation | Position | Update |
|---|---|---|
| Chen supports the signer | Beside the signer, facing Ji, without hiding the signing hand | Record her movement when she goes to inspect the register |
| Ji pressures the signer | Across the table with the statement visible | Stop advancing the pen once a pause is accepted |
| Administrator supplies records | Starts by the cabinet, then carries the book to the table | Subsequent shots inherit the new position and possession |

The map adds no alliance to the script. Requesting verification is not an accusation of lying; supplying records does not imply complete allegiance.

Chen cannot simultaneously stand beside the signer in support and beside Ji blocking the signer unless the shot shows a real transition. Resolve that conflict before composing the frame.

heading.zh: 按新行动切镜，并保留地理
heading.en: Cut on changing action and preserve geography

body.zh:
先用能读清桌、门、登记柜及主要人物关系的画面建立方位。登记拿出后，注意可以转到它；若观众需要同时看见季琳是否阻拦，就保留相关人物的关系画面，别只拍书页。

只有新事实改变人群下一步时，才表现他们让路、继续等待、作证或离开。背景人物不必为“群戏丰富”轮流走动。

摄影机换到主要人物连线另一侧时，可用同镜可见移动、中性过渡或新全景帮助理解；创作者也能有意选择错乱，但要有明确目的。新观察侧建立后，后续方向随之更新，不让每镜各自猜左右。
body.en:
Establish the table, entrance, cabinet and major relationships. When the register appears, attention may move to it. If viewers must also see whether Ji blocks access, retain that relationship rather than cutting only to pages.

Show a crowd yielding, waiting, testifying or leaving when new information changes its next action. Background movement is not a requirement for visual richness.

A camera-side change can use visible movement, a neutral transition or a new wide view. Deliberate disorientation is a creative choice with a purpose. Once a new side is established, later shots inherit it rather than guessing directions independently.

heading.zh: 逐镜核对同一个人是否被写了两次
heading.en: Repair duplicate positions and unexplained changes

body.zh:
顺读镜序，逐镜问：谁在什么位置、面向谁、拿什么、此刻支持或阻止哪项行动？把每次变化连回剧本动作。

- 人物无原因换边：回查前镜结束位置，补实际移动或恢复原位置。
- 反应全是同一种惊讶：选择会改变风险或行动的代表回应，其余保留同框状态。
- 陈澄前后同时占两个区域：合并提示词重复描述，只保留本镜有效关系。
- 新近景让证据持有人消失：决定他的在场是否影响读法，必要时保留或重新建立关系。

纸面检查只能证明分镜没有明显矛盾。生成后仍需正常速度看站位、视线和交接是否可读；角色一致不代表群体关系已拍清。
body.en:
Read the sequence and record position, orientation, possession and current support or opposition. Tie each change to a scripted action.

Repair unexplained side changes from the previous end state. Replace identical reactions with one that changes risk or action. Remove contradictory duplicate descriptions of a person. Check whether an absent evidence-holder changes what a close-up means.

The worksheet identifies design contradictions. Actual output still needs normal-speed inspection for readable positions, gaze and transfers. Consistent faces do not establish a clear group relationship.

q.zh: 多人场面要给每个人特写吗？
q.en: Does everyone in a group scene need a close-up?

a.zh: 不必。优先让会改变行动的回应可读；旁观者可留在关系画面里。
a.en: No. Prioritize responses that change action; observers can remain in a shared relationship view.

text.zh: 用 $short-drama-storyboard 审读这场多人对峙。按当前剧本列谁保护、协作、施压、观察谁，再落实主轴线、见证区域、进出口、站位和持物。只给改变行动的群体安排回应；引用每次换位依据，修复一人两处，不新增阵营或证据。
text.en: Use $short-drama-storyboard to map the current confrontation: who protects, cooperates, pressures or observes whom. Establish the main axis, witness area, entrances, positions and objects. Give groups responses when their actions change. Cite movements and repair duplicate positions without adding alliances or evidence.

label.zh: 群体关系与轴线

title.zh: AI球赛视频怎么做：持球、传球与切镜连续性
title.en: How to Storyboard Ball Sports for AI Video

seo_title.zh: AI球赛视频怎么做：持球、传球与切镜连续性
seo_title.en: How to Storyboard Ball Sports for AI Video

description.zh: 让观众看清球从哪里来、由谁控制、传给谁。附原创传球分镜与前后状态表，修复球瞬移、方向反转和欢呼掩盖动作。
description.en: Keep the ball’s origin, controller and transfer readable. Includes an original pass sequence and repairs for teleporting objects or reversed movement.

answer.zh: 先画球、持球者、接球者与防守者的相对位置，再写一次行动的起点、控制权转移和终点。切镜接住上一镜的球位与方向，战术变化要有看得见的原因。慢动作、解说和观众欢呼都不能代替丢失的传球过程；镜头数量跟着必要空间变化走。
answer.en: Map the ball, controller, receiver and defenders. Define the action’s start, control transfer and finish. Cuts continue the previous position and direction, while tactical changes need visible causes. Slow motion, commentary and cheers cannot replace missing spatial stages. Use the shots the action actually needs.

heading.zh: 先设计一段能读懂的比赛行动
heading.en: Design one readable play

body.zh:
Drama Skills 的竞赛分镜方法把动态物体的控制者、方向、目标路线和反制带过切镜。本文用原创篮球传球示例说明方法，不提供比赛规则教学，也不保证某个生成模型能一次完成动作。

已定场面：林澄持球站在半场右侧，队友许舟靠近篮下，防守者挡住直传路线。林澄先观察，再向另一侧空位队友乔音传球；乔音接稳后传给许舟。重点是借一次中转绕开阻挡。

在俯视草图上标实际站位和传球路线。写“精彩配合”不足以告诉下游第一球交给谁；写“球飞向篮筐”则把传球变成投篮。
body.en:
Drama Skills carries a moving object’s controller, direction, route and opposition across cuts. This original basketball example explains that method rather than teaching competition rules or guaranteeing a model’s output.

Accepted action: Lin Cheng holds the ball on one side of half court. Xu Zhou waits nearer the basket; a defender blocks the direct pass. Lin passes to Qiao Yin in an open position on the other side. After securing it, Qiao passes to Xu. The scene’s point is a relay around a blocked route.

Mark actual positions and paths on a sketch. “Brilliant teamwork” omits the first recipient; “the ball flies at the basket” changes a pass into a shot.

heading.zh: 示例：每次转手都交代新控制者
heading.en: Example: show each new controller

body.zh:
| 镜头职责 | 起点到终点 | 必须读到 |
|---|---|---|
| 建立阻挡 | 林澄持球，直传线被防守者挡住 | 为什么改用中转 |
| 第一段传球 | 林澄出球，乔音接住并控制球 | 球的路线与第一次归属变化 |
| 第二段传球 | 从乔音已经持球开始，到许舟接球 | 中转完成，不能又从林澄手里出球 |

这三项是信息职责，不规定三镜或时长。完整空间足够清楚时，可以同镜完成两段传球；需要切镜时，在草图上确认下一机位怎样看同一条路线。

若故事还需要投篮得分，另设计出手、到达和确认结果。许舟接球不等于已经得分，欢呼也不能替它补上未经拍出的结果。
body.en:
| Purpose | Start–end | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Establish obstruction | Lin holds the ball; defender blocks the direct route | Why the relay is chosen |
| First pass | Lin releases; Qiao receives and controls | Path and first ownership change |
| Second pass | Begins with Qiao holding; ends with Xu receiving | The relay, without another release from Lin |

These are information responsibilities, not a three-shot or duration rule. A readable continuous view may carry both passes. If cutting, check how the next camera sees the same route.

Scoring requires a separately designed release, arrival and confirmed outcome. Receiving a pass is not scoring, and cheers cannot supply an unshown result.

heading.zh: 切镜检查位置、方向与跳时
heading.en: Check position, direction and time across cuts

body.zh:
> **上一镜结束：**球在哪、谁控制、正在往哪里运动？
>
> **下一镜开始：**是否接住同一状态；若跳时，观众靠什么理解？
>
> **战术变化：**谁看见了什么，才调整路线？
>
> **画面文字：**比分或计时是否影响这次选择，如何准确呈现？

屏幕方向变化先回查摄影机是否换侧。人物路线没变却突然反向，可能是观察关系失去连续性，不是再加“流畅运动”就能解决。

计时、比分只在影响选择时出现。准确数字若不能由本次生成可靠完成，按已接受的方案用后期图形或声音表达，不让模型自行创造一场比分。
body.en:
For each cut, record the ball’s previous end position, controller and movement; the next start; any explicit time jump; the information causing tactical change; and whether score or time matters.

A reversed screen direction may come from an unexplained camera-side change. “Smooth movement” cannot repair an inconsistent observation relationship.

Include score and timing when they affect a decision. If exact digits cannot be reliably generated, use agreed graphics or sound rather than letting the model invent a score.

heading.zh: 先修缺失阶段，再加表现强度
heading.en: Repair missing stages before adding emphasis

body.zh:
球凭空到了接球者手里，先定位丢失的是出手、轨迹还是接住；只要求更刺激的慢动作不会补回控制权。前一镜已经接稳，后一镜就从持球开始，避免完整接球重复两遍。

若一镜内既要抢断、转身、横穿全场、传球和投篮，先按已定故事选择不可删的过程，调整分镜边界与时长；不能让这些互为条件的动作全部“同时”发生。

反应镜可以表现防守者意识到路线被绕开，并改变下一步防守；普通欢呼可在行动结果之后使用。正常速度连看生成片段，再检查球和人物是否连续。设计表不能证明真实视频的运动已经成立。
body.en:
If the ball appears in a receiver’s hands, locate the missing release, path or reception. More dramatic slow motion cannot restore control. A shot after a completed catch starts with possession rather than repeating the catch.

If one shot demands a steal, turn, full-court run, pass and score, identify necessary stages and adjust boundaries or duration. Dependent actions cannot all occur simultaneously.

A reaction can show a defender recognizing the relay and adapting. Ordinary cheers can follow the result. Review actual clips at normal speed; a coherent design table does not prove generated motion works.

q.zh: 能用欢呼跳过传球吗？
q.en: Can cheers replace a pass?

a.zh: 如果传球路线和控制权是本场必要信息，就不能。先让动作可读，再安排反应。
a.en: Not when the path and transfer are necessary information. Make the action readable before adding reactions.

text.zh: 用 $short-drama-storyboard 为这段球赛动作设计分镜。先画球、持球者、接球者和防守者的相对位置，列每次出手、转移、接住及终点。逐切点核对位置、方向、控制者与跳时依据；不新增得分，不用欢呼替代传球过程。〔已定动作〕。
text.en: Use $short-drama-storyboard to map the ball, controller, receiver and defenders. Define each release, transfer, catch and finish. Check position, direction, control and time across cuts. Do not invent scoring or use cheers to replace a pass. [Accepted action].

label.zh: 动态对象与竞赛

title.zh: AI视频递东西穿模怎么办：接触、松手与接住
title.en: How to Fix Object Handoffs in AI Video

seo_title.zh: AI视频递东西穿模怎么办：接触、松手与接住
seo_title.en: How to Fix Object Handoffs in AI Video

description.zh: 把递物拆成接近、接触、释放与新持有状态。附原创文件交接提示词，修复双手冲突、物品复制与切镜重复。
description.en: Specify approach, contact, release and new possession. Includes an original handover prompt and repairs for conflicting hands or duplicated objects.

answer.zh: 先核对谁用哪只手拿什么，再明确接收者怎样靠近、何时接住、递出者何时松手。相邻镜头从上一镜的结束状态继续。若过程承载证据或关系变化，就保留必要接触；若一镜动作过多，回到分镜调整范围与时长，不能全靠“自然流畅”几个字解决。
answer.en: Identify the object and each occupied hand. Specify approach, reception and release, then carry the ending possession into the next shot. Keep contact when it carries evidence or a relationship change. If the shot is overloaded, revise its scope or duration rather than relying on “natural, smooth movement.”

heading.zh: 先写起点，不急着加动作词
heading.en: Establish the starting state

body.zh:
Drama Skills 的动作时序方法要求接触动作有条件与结果：靠近、触碰、施力，再到物件变化；转手要说明哪只手、何时释放与接住。这用于定位提示词中的含混，不保证所有模型都会正确完成。

原创镜头：档案员叶棠把一只封好的文件袋交给取件人。起点是叶棠右手持袋，取件人双手空着，两人隔着柜台。终点是取件人拿稳袋，叶棠的手已离开；封口不被打开。

若起始参考图已经是取件人持袋，就不能再要求叶棠从相同位置递出同一袋。先选与本镜起点相符的参考，再描述过程。
body.en:
Drama Skills gives contact actions prerequisites and results: approach, touch, apply force and object change. Transfers specify hands, reception and release. This diagnoses ambiguity without guaranteeing every model can execute it.

Original shot: archivist Ye Tang gives a sealed envelope to a collector. Ye holds it in her right hand; the collector’s hands are empty across the counter. The ending has the collector holding it securely and Ye’s hand withdrawn. The seal stays closed.

A reference already showing the collector holding it is not the starting state for this transfer. Match the reference to the shot boundary before describing movement.

heading.zh: 示例：让交接顺序可核对
heading.en: Example: make the transfer order explicit

body.zh:
**含混版：**“她自然地把文件袋递给他，两人同时转身离开，电影感，流畅动作。”

它没说谁接哪一端，也把互为条件的接住、松手和转身压成同时发生。

**明确版：**

> 起点：叶棠右手持封好的文件袋，袋在柜台上方；取件人双手空着，面对她。
>
> 叶棠将袋送到取件人可接的位置。取件人用双手托住袋的两侧，拿稳后叶棠松开右手，并把手收回柜台内侧。
>
> 终点：袋只在取件人手中，封口仍完整。两人仍面对柜台，没有转身或拆袋。

这是动作说明示例。镜头景别要能看清接触与最终归属，实际时长需要容纳这个过程；不能把全文塞进任何长度的镜头。取件人离开可以放在后镜，前提是已接受分镜允许这样拆。
body.en:
**Ambiguous draft:** “She naturally hands him the envelope; both turn away simultaneously, cinematic and fluid.” It omits reception and compresses dependent stages.

**Explicit example:**

> Start: Ye holds the sealed envelope above the counter in her right hand. The collector faces her with empty hands.
>
> Ye moves it within reach. The collector supports both sides with both hands. Once it is secure, Ye releases her right hand and withdraws it behind the counter.
>
> End: only the collector holds the envelope; the seal remains intact. Both still face the counter, without turning or opening it.

The framing must show contact and ownership; duration must accommodate the process. A departure can belong to a later shot if the accepted storyboard permits that division.

heading.zh: 按输出里丢掉的事实修
heading.en: Repair the fact missing from the output

body.zh:
| 实际问题 | 先查什么 | 改法 |
|---|---|---|
| 两人各有一只相同袋 | 起点数量与终点归属是否矛盾 | 写明同一只袋的转移，后镜继承接收者持有 |
| 接触后袋穿过手 | 接触区域、先后与景别是否含混 | 明确支持位置、接稳再松手，并检查实际结果 |
| 一只手同时持笔与接袋 | 已占用的手是否忘记 | 按剧本先放笔，或采用确实空着的手 |
| 后镜又递一次 | 上一镜是否已经完成交接 | 从已经持有继续，不重复完整动作 |

这张表帮助修改要求，不能把输出瑕疵的原因一律归为提示词。要求已经清楚仍失败时，比较重新生成、拆镜或其他制作方式。要更换交接方法，先核对是否改变剧情。
body.en:
| Problem | Check | Repair |
|---|---|---|
| Both hold identical copies | Conflicting quantity or ownership | Specify one object’s transfer and inherit possession |
| Envelope passes through hands | Ambiguous contact, order or framing | Specify support, secure reception, then release; inspect output |
| One hand holds a pen and receives | Forgotten occupied hand | Use an empty hand or a scripted prior placement |
| Next shot repeats the transfer | Previous transfer already completed | Continue from possession |

The table repairs requirements rather than proving every defect comes from prompting. Clear instructions can still fail. Compare regeneration, shot division or another production method, checking story meaning before changing the handover.

heading.zh: 哪些交接不能只拍结果
heading.en: When the process must remain visible

body.zh:
普通交付有时可以从递出前切到拿稳后，但若剧情要证明谁碰过文件袋、封口有没有被换、谁迟疑后才接，就不能只靠结果镜头。省掉过程可能改变证据或选择。

只为减少复杂度而把主动交付改成袋子自己滑落，也会改变人物责任。需要改实现时，保持谁决定、物品数量、封口状态、获知范围和最终归属。

正常速度看完前后镜，再暂停检查关键接触。正常播放看得懂，比单张漂亮关键帧更能检验这次交接；不能靠已定终点宣称输出已经到达。
body.en:
A routine delivery may cut from before transfer to secure possession. A scene proving contact, a changed seal or a hesitant acceptance needs its consequential process.

Replacing voluntary delivery with an accidental slide changes responsibility. Preserve agency, quantity, seal state, knowledge and final ownership when adjusting realization.

Watch neighboring shots normally, then inspect contact frames. A beautiful still cannot establish a successful transfer, and a planned ending is not evidence that the generated clip reached it.

q.zh: 写清松手接住后还失败怎么办？
q.en: What if a clear handoff prompt still fails?

a.zh: 看实际输出定位失败，比较重生成、调整分镜与其他制作方式；不能把已定终点当作成功证据。
a.en: Inspect the output and compare regeneration, storyboard adjustment or another production method. A planned ending is not success evidence.

text.zh: 用 $short-drama-video-prompts 修订这次递物要求。以已接受分镜为准，写明起点数量、持物手、接触、接稳、松手与终点。核对同一只手的任务和相邻镜头，不新增拆袋、复制物件或交接结果；超载时列分镜调整建议。〔分镜与实际失败〕。
text.en: Use $short-drama-video-prompts to clarify this accepted handoff: quantity, occupied hands, contact, secure reception, release and ending. Check hand conflicts and neighboring shots. Add no opening, duplicate object or new outcome. If overloaded, report storyboard adjustments. [Shot and observed failure].

label.zh: 接触与转手时序
保留动作含义的实现调整

title.zh: 短剧悬念怎么拍：谁先知道，什么时候揭示
title.en: How to Control Suspense with Audience Information

seo_title.zh: 短剧悬念怎么拍：谁先知道，什么时候揭示
seo_title.en: How to Control Suspense with Audience Information

description.zh: 把身份、声音和证据拆成独立揭示，明确观众此刻知道什么。附原创门外来客分镜，避免遮住必要信息或提前泄密。
description.en: Separate identity, sound and evidence reveals. Plan what viewers know now with an original visitor scene, avoiding hidden essentials or premature disclosure.

answer.zh: 先把需要控制的事实逐条列出，再决定本镜展示还是暂时扣住；扣住的内容要有明确释放事件。用构图、画外声或遮挡实现已定的信息顺序，同时保证本镜必须理解的动作仍可读。角色知道、观众知道和作者知道分开，不能用“神秘感”一句话替代设计。
answer.en: List each fact separately. Decide whether to show or withhold it in the current shot, with a concrete release event for withheld information. Use framing, offscreen sound or occlusion to realize that order while keeping necessary actions readable. Distinguish character, audience and author knowledge.

heading.zh: 同一个来客，也可能有几项秘密
heading.en: One visitor can carry several facts

body.zh:
Drama Skills 的观众揭示方法把事实来源、当前权限、可见或可听载体、释放时机与保护方法分开。本文讨论如何落实已接受的剧本，不在镜头层新增秘密。

原创已定场景：许宁听见门外有人叫她旧昵称。观众此刻可以知道来客认识她，但要等许宁打开门，才看见来客是她离开多年的姐姐。观众此前未听过姐姐的声音。许宁听出姐姐声音，所以她此刻的犹豫来自是否开门，不是猜来人是谁。

“认识许宁”和“来客身份”是两条信息。画外旧称呼可以先出现；姐姐的脸在开门前不展示。不能在脚本没允许时，让反射镜或宣传关键帧先泄露身份。
body.en:
Drama Skills separates source, current permission, sensory carrier, release event and protection method. This article realizes an accepted script without adding secrets at the camera stage.

Original accepted scene: Xu Ning hears an old nickname outside the door. Viewers may know the visitor knows her, but see that it is her long-absent sister only when Xu opens the door. Viewers have not previously heard the sister’s voice. Xu recognizes it; her hesitation concerns opening, not guessing identity.

Familiarity and identity are separate facts. The nickname can arrive offscreen before the face. A reflection or reference frame must not reveal the sister earlier than the script permits.

heading.zh: 示例：每条事实都有载体与释放事件
heading.en: Example: give each fact a carrier and release

body.zh:
| 事实 | 当前可见／可听；揭示边界 |
|---|---|
| 来客认识许宁 | 画外叫旧昵称，许宁听见后停下收拾；当前允许；声音不能被配乐完全盖住 |
| 来客是姐姐 | 门外人物不露脸；许宁打开门后，按已定剧本展示姐姐 |
| 许宁决定让她进来 | 开门后许宁移开挡在门口的椅子；椅子让出通路后才表示允许进入 |

开门不自动等于接受和解，移开椅子也不等于过去已被原谅。镜头只落实当前决定，后续关系仍按剧本发展。

若本镜必须让观众理解“许宁听见了”，别只拍空门与声音，遗漏她接收后的动作。保留身份悬念不能连带遮住当前行动理由。

**把这张表写成可拍的顺序**

本例局部写法已经选定如下；不是让分镜执行者给现有剧本自行新增对白。观众此前没听过姐姐声音，开门前也没有能辨认她的照片或字幕。

1. **屋内，门仍关着。**许宁叠衣服，门外传来旧昵称：“宁宁。”她停下，把衣服放回椅背。画外声与她接收后的动作同在这一段，观众知道她听见了。
2. **许宁走到门边。**手握门把，但没有立即转。她问：“你怎么来了？”门外答：“想跟你说句话。”此时没有“姐姐”称呼，镜面、门缝和人物标注也不提前展示身份。许宁认出声音是作者事实，她的迟疑来自是否开门。
3. **许宁实际开门后。**姐姐的脸首次进入画面，许宁看着她，说：“姐。”脸与称呼共同落实观众身份揭示；不靠一张陌生脸要求观众猜对亲属关系。姐姐停在门外，暂未进来。
4. **许宁移开挡路的椅子。**她说：“进来吧，先把话说完。”姐姐低头看让出的通路，再抬眼点头。到这里许宁允许进入、姐姐收到邀请；不提前记录姐姐已经进屋，也不把邀请写成原谅。

这四段说明信息与动作顺序，不规定四个镜头或固定秒数。同一镜头能看清接收和决定，就不必拆切；实际镜头还要保持门、椅子和人物所在一侧连续。检查候选画面时尤其看预览图、字幕说话者名和反射：把第二段标成“姐姐来访”，仍可能在脸出现前泄底。
body.en:
| Fact | Carrier; Release |
|---|---|
| Visitor knows Xu | Old nickname offscreen; Xu stops tidying after hearing it; Allowed now; music must not obscure the cue |
| Visitor is the sister | No face shown outside; Show the sister after Xu opens the door |
| Xu permits entry | After opening, Xu moves the chair blocking the doorway; Permission becomes visible when the passage is cleared |

Opening the door is not reconciliation; moving the chair does not establish forgiveness. The shot realizes the present decision.

If viewers must understand that Xu heard the voice, retain her reception. Protecting identity must not hide the reason for the action they need to follow.

**Turn the table into a filmable sequence**

The article chooses the following local realization; it does not authorize a storyboard executor to add dialogue to an existing script. Viewers have not heard the sister’s voice or seen a photo or caption identifying her before the door opens.

1. **Inside, with the door shut.** Xu folds clothes. “Ningning,” an old nickname, comes from outside. She stops and returns the clothes to the chair back. Sound and her reception occur in this passage, so viewers know she heard it.
2. **Xu reaches the door.** Her hand holds the handle without turning it immediately. “Why are you here?” she asks. “I wanted to talk,” comes the reply. Nobody says “sister” yet; mirrors, gaps and speaker labels also withhold identity. Xu’s recognition is an author fact. Her hesitation concerns opening.
3. **After Xu actually opens.** The sister’s face first enters view. Xu looks at her and says, “Sis.” Face and address jointly establish identity for viewers; an unfamiliar face alone need not communicate kinship. The sister stays outside.
4. **Xu moves the blocking chair.** “Come in. Let’s finish what you came to say.” The sister looks down at the cleared passage, then up and nods. Xu has permitted entry and the sister has received the invitation. Do not record completed entry or forgiveness yet.

These passages establish information and action order, not four required shots or fixed durations. A single shot that clearly carries reception and decision need not be split. Actual coverage must preserve the door, chair and each person’s side. Check previews, caption speaker names and reflections: labeling the second passage “sister’s visit” may reveal identity before the face appears.

heading.zh: 选择遮挡方法时检查副作用
heading.en: Check the cost of withholding

body.zh:
背影、门缝、画外声、浅景深或遮挡都可以改变观众所知。选择时先问两件事：藏住了什么，误挡了什么？例如门缝可以保住面部身份，但若还挡住开门人的手，就可能让观众不理解是谁主动开门。

为每条暂扣事实写一句“在〔可见事件〕之后揭示”。“稍后再说”没有明确边界，下游难以判断哪一帧开始可以出现。

如果剧情要求姐姐此刻已被观众认出，就不能再为制造悬念藏脸；如果许宁原本没听出身份，也不能在提示词里擅自改成认识。这些是剧本的信息决定，需要回到上游修订。
body.en:
A back view, door gap, offscreen voice, shallow focus or occlusion can control knowledge. Ask both what it hides and what else it blocks. A gap may protect a face while hiding whose hand opens the door.

Write a visible release event for each withheld fact. “Reveal later” supplies no usable boundary.

If the script already lets viewers identify the sister, hiding her face changes the design. If Xu does not recognize her in the accepted script, prompting cannot silently grant recognition. Those changes belong upstream.

heading.zh: 连看镜序，核对泄露和断供
heading.en: Review the sequence for leaks and missing essentials

body.zh:
逐镜列观众此刻能直接看到、听到或合理推断什么，并与剧本权限比较。重点查脸部、可识别服饰、反射、字幕、画外称呼和能揭底的道具；“不露脸”并不保证身份不会由别处提前出现。

再检查暂扣信息是否按计划释放，释放后有没有改变判断或行动。若只把揭示一拖再拖，人物也没有据此决定，先回剧本明确这项秘密的作用。

最后从观众视角正常速度看成片。设计表能检查计划，实际画面与声音才决定观众是否看清、听见，或被一个未计划的细节泄露。
body.en:
For each shot, list what viewers see, hear or reasonably infer and compare it with script permission. Check faces, recognizable clothing, reflections, subtitles, names and revealing props. Hiding a face alone may not protect identity.

Check that withheld facts release at the planned event and change understanding or action. Indefinite delay without a consequence calls for a clearer story purpose.

Watch the finished sequence normally. The plan checks intention; actual image and sound determine what is understood or inadvertently disclosed.

q.zh: 不露脸就能保住身份悬念吗？
q.en: Does hiding a face protect identity?

a.zh: 不一定。称呼、声音、服饰、反射与字幕都可能泄露，要按当前剧本的揭示权限逐项检查。
a.en: Not necessarily. Names, voices, clothing, reflections and captions may disclose it; check each against the script’s permission.

text.zh: 用 $short-drama-storyboard 检查悬念信息顺序。逐条列事实来源、人物已知、观众当前可知、载体和释放事件；区分声音里的熟悉关系与面部身份。检查遮挡是否误挡必需动作，以及反射、字幕或服饰是否提前泄露。只落实已定剧本，不增秘密。
text.en: Use $short-drama-storyboard to check each fact’s source, character knowledge, current audience permission, carrier and release event. Separate audible familiarity from facial identity. Check hidden essentials and leaks through reflections, subtitles or clothing. Realize the accepted script without new secrets.

label.zh: 观众事实权限与释放时机
证据接收与场面调度

title.zh: AI短剧太像模板怎么改：因果、策略、台词与镜头
title.en: How to Revise a Formulaic AI Drama

seo_title.zh: AI短剧太像模板怎么改：因果、策略、台词与镜头
seo_title.en: How to Revise a Formulaic AI Drama

description.zh: 用具体重复位置判断模板感，分别修因果、策略、表达和镜头。附原创诊断表，保留有意的仪式、喜剧与固定构图。
description.en: Locate repetition in causality, strategy, expression and shots. Includes an original diagnostic table and exceptions for deliberate recurring forms.

answer.zh: 先找两处以上可比较的重复，再说明它损失了什么：主角没参与揭示、对手始终同一策略，还是动作与台词已表达后又解释。按问题所在层修，不能只换词或随机换景别。有意的仪式、人物口癖与喜剧重复要看第二次新增的意义，不凭表面相同判错。
answer.en: Locate comparable repetitions and identify the loss: absent protagonist agency, unchanged opposing strategies or redundant explanation. Repair the relevant layer rather than replacing synonyms or randomizing shots. Deliberate rituals, verbal habits and comedy depend on their added meaning, not surface variety.

heading.zh: 把“像AI写的”改成具体问题
heading.en: Replace a vague label with evidence

body.zh:
Drama Skills 的去模板方法区分因果、策略、表达与镜头四层，要求可引用的位置与损失。这里用它审读原创草稿，不把某个词、动作或类型惯例当禁用项。

假设第二集与第三集都由对手主动说出关键秘密，主角只问“为什么”，旁人依次震惊，结尾补一句“她终于夺回尊严”。如果两次揭示都不需要主角的选择，问题在因果；若还有逐句重复的表情，另记表达问题，分别修。

位置要落到场景与句子。单次攥拳、一次推镜不证明模板；修订要说明保留后怎样伤害这部戏。
body.en:
Drama Skills distinguishes causality, strategy, expression and shot repetition and asks for locations plus a concrete loss. This original draft review does not turn words or genre conventions into banned items.

Suppose episodes two and three both have an opponent announce a secret. The protagonist only asks why, observers react in turn, and a concluding line explains restored dignity. If neither reveal depends on her choice, diagnose causality. Repeated expression beats are a separate issue.

Locate scenes and lines. One clenched fist or camera push does not establish a formula; explain the harm to this story.

heading.zh: 按层修，不把所有问题都交给润色
heading.en: Repair the layer that causes the problem

body.zh:
| 重复层 | 要比较什么 | 修订方向 |
|---|---|---|
| 因果与策略 | 答案如何出现，谁换过办法 | 保留事实，让至少一项揭示由已有筹码与有代价选择触发 |
| 表达 | 已演出的选择是否又被解释；每轮是否同构收口 | 删重复意义说明，保留未处理后果与人物自己的节奏 |
| 镜头 | 每次切镜服务哪项新注意 | 随证物、关系与接收变化选画面，不机械给每句推近 |

表中第一项包含两个相关但不同的检查：谁造成事件，是因果；人物用什么办法争取，是策略。可以分别记录，修订时不要把它们混成“节奏不好”。

信息密度也要比较整场。每拍都有同样大小的新信息，会把重点抹平；允许已经成立的信息留出接收与行动时间，不要求每句都是爆点。
body.en:
| Layer | Compare | Repair |
|---|---|---|
| Causality and strategy | How answers appear; who changes approach | Retain facts, but connect a reveal to established leverage and a consequential choice |
| Expression | Explained choices and identical closures | Remove redundant interpretation; retain unresolved effects and individual rhythm |
| Shots | New attention served by each cut | Follow evidence, relationships and reception rather than pushing in on every line |

Causality asks who causes events; strategy asks how someone pursues a result. Record them separately instead of calling both poor pacing.

Compare information across the scene. Equally sized revelations can flatten emphasis. Allow time for reception and action without demanding an explosive fact in every line.

heading.zh: 原创修法：保留秘密，改变它如何出现
heading.en: Example: retain the secret, change its delivery

body.zh:
原设计中，对手又一次主动承认改过登记。可改为：主角已有原始交接单，她可以立即公开，却会同时暴露曾帮自己保管副本的同事。她先请同事决定是否共同提交，再在双方同意后出示材料；对手面对真实记录改变说法。

修法把“免费得到答案”变成选择，也留下同事被卷入的后果。前提是副本、同事参与和提交机会已经由作者接受；若原稿没有，就先在剧情方案层决定，不让审稿提示词擅自加证据。

去掉结尾的尊严总结后，再看观众能否从公开提交、拒绝旧安排或新的责任看出结果。看不出就补必要行动，不能只删总结而让回报空着。
body.en:
Instead of another unsolicited admission about an altered register, the protagonist can face a choice involving her existing original handover record. Immediate disclosure would expose the coworker who kept its copy. She asks whether they will submit it together; after agreement, she presents it and the opponent changes their account.

This converts a free answer into a decision with consequences. The copy, coworker and submission opportunity must be accepted story facts. If absent, decide them at the planning stage rather than letting review invent evidence.

After removing the dignity summary, check whether submission, a refused arrangement or a changed responsibility still conveys the result. Restore necessary action if it does not; deleting explanation alone is insufficient.

heading.zh: 别误删有作用的重复
heading.en: Protect repetition with a purpose

body.zh:
同一句祝词第二次由不同人说，可能体现权力易手；同一笑料让不同人付出新代价，也可能有新的效果。固定双人镜可以故意保持压力，不必为了“镜头多样”切开。

对每个重复项写：第二次新增什么、是否有意、保留会损失什么。理由不足时，列问题而非直接重写。

修后回到原来两处比较：主角选择是否参与结果，对手是否回应新条件，表达是否只说必要内容，镜头是否完成当前职责？不要修一次又统一给每集追加相同的“留白”，形成新模板。成片还需看实际节奏与可读性。
body.en:
A repeated greeting from a new speaker may mark transferred authority. A running joke may impose a different cost. A locked two-shot may deliberately sustain pressure and need no variety cut.

Ask what the recurrence adds, whether it is intentional and what retaining it loses. Insufficient evidence calls for a question rather than an automatic rewrite.

Compare the original locations after revision: does a choice affect the result, does opposition adapt, is expression necessary, and does each shot serve its purpose? Adding identical pauses to every episode would create another formula. Actual pacing still needs viewing.

q.zh: 固定双人镜头也是模板吗？
q.en: Is a locked two-shot automatically formulaic?

a.zh: 不是。有意保持压迫或表现关系时可以成立。先说明重复损失什么，再决定是否修。
a.en: No. It may deliberately sustain pressure or a relationship. Identify a concrete loss before deciding to revise.

text.zh: 用 $short-drama-review 诊断模板感，先引用至少两处可比位置，区分因果、策略、表达和镜头重复，并说明具体损失。检查有意仪式、喜剧与固定镜头的误报。只输出问题和保真修订目标，不擅自增加秘密或证据；我确定后再指定范围改写。
text.en: Use $short-drama-review to cite comparable locations and diagnose causality, strategy, expression or shot repetition with its concrete loss. Check deliberate rituals, comedy and locked-shot exceptions. Report problems and repair goals without adding secrets or evidence; I will choose the rewrite scope.

label.zh: 去模板诊断、修订与误报
label.en: Formula diagnosis, repair and false positives

title.zh: 体育竞技小说怎么写：比赛、训练与队伍变化
title.en: How to Write Sports Fiction

seo_title.zh: 体育竞技小说怎么写：比赛、训练与队伍变化
seo_title.en: How to Write Sports Fiction

description.zh: 把比赛写成目标、限制、临场选择与反馈，让训练成果和队伍关系进入胜负。附原创比赛与训练对照，不靠解说宣布翻盘。
description.en: Connect match goals, limits, decisions and feedback. Includes an original match and training worksheet, with team changes that affect play.

answer.zh: 先让读者知道本场要争取什么、为什么旧办法不够，再写人物根据场上信息调整。训练建立可复用能力，比赛检验它在压力下是否成立；结果改变排名、合作或下一轮要求。写清“怎么做到”，比分和观众反应辅助理解，不能替代操作与选择。
answer.en: Establish the match goal and why the old approach fails. Let participants adapt to visible information. Training builds an ability; competition tests it under pressure. Results change standing, cooperation or future requirements. Scores and reactions support the action rather than replacing how it happens.

heading.zh: 赛制只交代当前选择需要的部分
heading.en: Explain the rules needed for this choice

body.zh:
Oh Story 的游戏体育方法把胜负目标、限制、操作与公开反馈连起来。本文用于竞技故事结构；具体项目的真实规则和技术细节，应在写作时查证，不把方法卡里的数值比例当通用标准。

原创球队故事：本场前已经交代，这支队伍要赢下比赛才有晋级机会。比赛临近结束，主角林峤所在队落后一球，对手开始封堵他们惯用的传球路线。队友周越认为应继续找林峤，另一名队员提出利用对手挤向同一侧后留下的空间。

先让读者看见位置、谁控球、哪些通路被挡，再进入选择。只说“他读懂了局势，完成绝杀”，缺的是行动过程，不是更多激情形容词。

### 先演出训练约定，再写比赛兑现

沿用林峤、周越和远侧队友。本教学候选明确选择一场虚构校园足球赛，周越控球，林峤近侧接应，另一队友在远侧；从0:1落后扳到1:1后，终场仍未取胜。赢才有晋级机会是本例已定条件，扳平不自动晋级。下面先补一段此前的训练，再接比赛，不把“他们早就练过”当作无来源的临场本事。

> 训练里，周越又把球送到林峤脚前，守这一路的队友先碰到了球。
>
> “你看我一眼就传。”林峤说，“我往近侧带人，你再看远侧。”
>
> 周越问：“你要是还在原地呢？”
>
> “那就按当时的路线来。不是听见一句就固定往那边踢。”
>
> 下一轮林峤往近侧移动。周越等防守跟过去，才把球送到远侧队友脚下。对方接到球，继续向前；教练叫停，问周越这次看到什么。
>
> “他跟着林峤走，另一边空了。”周越说。

到正式比赛，已定能力仍需在压力下执行；训练只建立识别和配合，不保证每次传球或射门成功：

> 周越脚下有球，林峤那条常用路线被堵住。他抬头时仍先看林峤，喊了一声名字。
>
> 林峤没有停在原地要球，往近侧挪开。跟他的防守人随之移动，远侧队友往空处接应。
>
> 周越这回看见了，把球传向远侧。队友接到球后继续推进，林峤跟上另一路；直到远侧队友实际射门得分，记分牌才从0:1改成1:1。
>
> 场边有人喊起来。周越没再找那一条旧路线，下一次控球先看两边。对手也指向刚才的接应点，让人贴住远侧。
>
> 再传过去时，防守人已经在那条线上，球被挡回。周越收住脚，回身接球，没能照搬刚才的一次得分。
>
> 终场哨响，比分还是1:1。林峤走过来，周越说：“那次看到了。后一次又等他空出来，晚了。”
>
> “扳平了，没赢。”林峤看着记分牌，“下一次得看对方也在动。”
>
> 周越把下一次复盘记为“远侧被补上之后怎么接”，不再只写“给林峤传准一点”。

本场得到一次有效配合和扳平，未达到必须取胜的条件。对手从亲眼看见的进攻补防，队伍从实际失误确定下一项训练；没有临时觉醒或只靠观众一句“天才”宣布晋级。作者也可以选择第二次配合取胜，但要把相应攻防和结果写出来。

场上位置、训练交流与赛终结果是本例的新增教学选择，不是现实比赛记录或训练处方；真实项目的具体规则、计时和技术细节另按来源核实，不用这个片段代替。
body.en:
Oh Story’s sports-and-game method connects victory goals, constraints, action and public feedback. This is a story-structure guide; verify a real sport’s rules and technical details for your manuscript rather than adopting sample ratios as standards.

Original team story: the established competition requires a win for a chance to advance. Near the finish, Lin Qiao’s team trails by one goal. Opponents block its usual passing route. Zhou Yue wants to keep feeding Lin; another teammate proposes using space left as defenders crowd one side.

Show positions, possession and blocked routes before the choice. “He read the game and won it” lacks a process, not passionate adjectives.

### Establish coordination in practice, then test it in the match

Keep Lin, Zhou and the far-side teammate. This teaching candidate selects a fictional campus football match: Zhou has the ball, Lin offers nearby support and another teammate waits on the far side. They equalize from 0:1 to 1:1 but finish without a win. The established condition requires victory for a chance to advance; an equalizer does not grant advancement. First show an earlier practice rather than granting unexplained preparation during the match.

> In practice Zhou again sent the ball toward Lin. The teammate guarding that route touched it first.
>
> “You look at me and pass,” Lin said. “When I draw someone toward the near side, look across.”
>
> “And if you stay where you are?”
>
> “Read the route then. Don't kick over there just because you heard a phrase.”
>
> In the next attempt Lin moved toward the near side. Zhou waited for the defender to follow before sending the ball to the far-side teammate, who received and advanced. The coach stopped them and asked what Zhou had seen.
>
> “He followed Lin. The other side opened.”

Competition tests that preparation under pressure. Practice establishes recognition and coordination without guaranteeing every pass or shot:

> Zhou had the ball; the usual route to Lin was blocked. He still looked at Lin first and called his name.
>
> Lin did not remain demanding a pass. He moved toward the near side, drawing his marker. The far-side teammate offered support in the open space.
>
> Zhou saw it and passed across. The receiver advanced while Lin followed another route. Only when the far-side teammate actually shot and scored did the board change from 0:1 to 1:1.
>
> Someone cheered from the touchline. Zhou looked both ways on his next possession instead of seeking only the old route. Opponents pointed toward the receiver and assigned closer coverage there.
>
> The next pass met a defender already on that line and came back. Zhou turned to recover it, unable to repeat the scoring move unchanged.
>
> The final whistle sounded at 1:1. Lin approached. “I saw it that time,” Zhou said. “Later I waited for him to open up again. Too late.”
>
> “We equalized. We didn't win.” Lin looked at the board. “Next time, see that they're moving too.”
>
> Zhou recorded the next review as what to do once the far side is covered, rather than only passing more accurately to Lin.

The scene delivers coordination and an equalizer without satisfying the win condition. Opponents cover an attack they actually saw; the team identifies its next practice from an actual failed exchange. Neither sudden awakening nor praise grants advancement. An author may select a later winning exchange, provided its action and result are shown.

Positions, practice dialogue and the final result are additional teaching choices, not a real match record or training prescription. Verify a real project's specific rules, timing and techniques from appropriate sources rather than treating this passage as those facts.

heading.zh: 原创示例：一次判断改变下一步
heading.en: Example: a decision changes the next move

body.zh:
| 这一拍 | 依据与变化 |
|---|---|
| 对手封住旧路线 | 林峤无法按前场办法接球；队友必须换传递目标或承担失误风险。 |
| 林峤带动防守注意 | 另一侧队友得到可用空间；配合依据来自移动，不是全员突然变笨。 |
| 球转到新接应点 | 队友能继续推进；接应成功仍不等于已经得分。 |

后续得分或失误必须实际写出。可以让方案奏效，也可以让对手识别并反制；无论哪种，结果要回到已经展示的动作、规则和限制。

周越的反应关注以后能否继续这样配合，对手关注暴露的路线，解说说明关键变化。观众可以欢呼，但不能让所有人都用同一句“天才”完成反馈。
body.en:
| Beat | Basis and change |
|---|---|
| Opponents block the old route | Lin cannot receive as before; teammates need another target or accept a turnover risk. |
| Lin draws defensive attention | Space becomes available elsewhere; movement explains the opportunity. |
| Ball reaches the new receiver | The team can advance; reception is not already a goal. |

Enact the score or failure afterward. The plan can work or invite an informed counter; either result follows shown actions, rules and limits.

Zhou considers future coordination; opponents notice the exposed route; commentary clarifies the change. Cheers can follow, but everyone need not call Lin a genius.

heading.zh: 训练章先建立比赛会用的能力
heading.en: Build an ability before testing it

body.zh:
| 训练内容 | 变化与检验 |
|---|---|
| 判断传递时机 | 从只盯林峤到能识别另一接应点；检验旧路线被堵时是否会换目标。 |
| 配合约定 | 周越知道队友移动的含义；检验压力下是否仍能按约行动。 |
| 失败复盘 | 指出信息或执行在哪一步丢失；下次修同一问题，对手也会调整。 |

这是原创剧情准备表，不是现实训练处方。进步可以是失误减少，也可以是敢于询问、愿意信任或学会承认判断不准；没有实际训练证据，不在比赛前临时宣布“他早就会”。

训练章也有具体目标与反馈，但不必每章打破纪录。普通练习可概述，关键分歧、第一次完成配合和失败后的选择值得展开。
body.en:
| Drill | Change and test |
|---|---|
| Passing decisions | Look beyond Lin to another receiver; change targets when the old route closes. |
| Coordination | Zhou understands a teammate’s movement; act on it under pressure. |
| Failure review | Locate missing information or execution; address it next time while opponents also adapt. |

This fictional planning worksheet is not a real training prescription. Improvement may mean fewer errors, asking questions or trusting a teammate. Establish it before the match rather than granting unseen preparation.

Practice needs a goal and feedback without a record every chapter. Summarize routine drills; expand consequential disagreements, new coordination and responses to failure.

heading.zh: 结算比赛，也结算关系与责任
heading.en: Settle the match and its consequences

body.zh:
比赛结束后，分别写事实结果与人物回应：晋级条件是否真的满足，谁承担失误，队友对配合有什么新判断，下一场暴露了哪项限制。一次赢球不保证全部矛盾消失，一次失误也不等于人物没有成长。

复读时暂时删掉解说与弹幕：读者还能理解谁依据什么改变了行动吗？再遮住队友姓名：他们关注的是同一件事吗？若全是赞叹，补不同职责与目标；若动作只是技能名称，补起点、选择和结果。

保留原先已付的体力、机会或关系代价，不让结算奖励重置所有限制。下一轮从本场造成的新条件开始，避免每场都靠同一种临时觉醒。
body.en:
Separate the factual result from responses: were advancement conditions met, who bears an error, what did teammates learn and what remains limited? A win resolves neither every conflict nor all responsibility; failure need not erase growth.

Remove commentary temporarily. Can readers still follow the decisions? Hide teammate names and compare concerns. Replace identical praise with distinct duties; replace skill labels with starts, choices and results.

Carry physical, opportunity or relationship costs forward. Rewards should not reset every limit. Begin the next contest from this one’s conditions rather than another identical awakening.

q.zh: 训练章一定要写数字进步吗？
q.en: Must a training chapter show numerical improvement?

a.zh: 不必。可观察的配合、判断或关系变化也能推进；数字只在它确实影响比赛选择时使用。
a.en: No. Observable coordination, judgment or relationship changes can advance the story. Use numbers when they affect match decisions.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 规划竞技小说本场比赛。列已定目标、赛制限制、场上信息、主角和队友的选择、真实结果与下一场条件；核对能力是否由训练建立。先出行动与反馈表，不靠解说宣布胜负，不临时发新能力。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to plan the contest: established goal, rules, visible information, decisions, enacted result and carryover. Check preparation. Produce an action-and-feedback worksheet without commentary-only wins or sudden powers.

label.zh: 竞技目标、操作与反馈
把节点与状态变化演成场景
label.en: Dramatize beats and changes of state

label.zh: 本例选择、文风与事实边界

title.zh: 文字游戏该用按钮还是自由输入：从玩家动作决定
title.en: Buttons or Free Text: Choose a Story Game Input

seo_title.zh: 文字游戏该用按钮还是自由输入：从玩家动作决定
seo_title.en: Buttons or Free Text: Choose a Story Game Input

description.zh: 先看玩家要执行什么，再判断自由表达是否增加有意义的组合。用原创信使任务比较按钮与命令，避免给每个角色都加聊天框。
description.en: Choose input from player actions. Compare buttons and free text in an original courier task, with finite intent, clear costs and readable outcomes.

answer.zh: 按钮能完整表达核心动作时，优先让玩家直接选择。自由输入适合角色需要组合对象、执行人、条件、期限或知情范围，且不同安排真会改变局面的时候。先决定这种表达带来什么玩法，再设计有限候选与世界回应；不以“能聊天”代替互动。
answer.en: Use buttons when they fully express the core action. Free text is useful when a role combines objects, actors, conditions, deadlines or disclosure, and different arrangements matter. Define that play value first, then bound candidate actions and world responses.

heading.zh: 先问动作是否需要自由组织
heading.en: Start with the action

body.zh:
novel-to-game 的概念方法先确定玩家身份与反复做的工作，再选择输入方式。自然语言不是所有故事游戏的默认功能；已有按钮能完整表达的动作，不必绕到聊天框。

原创信使故事有两种设计。第一种只让玩家对手中一封信选择“送到南门”“暂存”“退回”。如果对象、路线和后果都已确定，按钮足以表达。第二种让玩家担任驿站调度员，需要安排哪位信使、何时交给谁、遇到什么情况暂停，以及谁可知道内容。它才可能需要组合表达。

两种都可以有好故事。判断依据是玩家的工作，不是小说对白多不多，也不是项目用了大模型就必须打字。
body.en:
The concept method starts with the player’s role and recurring job. Natural language is not a default feature; a chat box need not replace a complete set of actions.

An original courier story offers two designs. In one, the player holds a letter and chooses “Deliver to South Gate,” “Hold” or “Return.” With object, route and effects fixed, buttons are sufficient. In the other, a depot dispatcher assigns a courier, recipient, time, stop condition and disclosure. Combining those choices may justify free expression.

Either can support a strong story. Choose from the job, not the amount of dialogue or the presence of a language model.

heading.zh: 用同一个任务比较两种输入
heading.en: Compare one task

body.zh:
| 玩家安排 | 按钮版本 | 自由表达的价值 |
|---|---|---|
| 把此信送到已指定南门 | 点击明确动作即可 | 换说法并未增加玩法 |
| 让阿岚在换岗后送给守门人 | 可用人物与时间选项 | 只有组合真正重要时才保留表达 |
| 若城门封闭就退回，不向助手转交 | 条件菜单也可能足够 | 复杂安排需让玩家看懂采用了什么 |

自由输入并不天然优于菜单。条件组合很少、玩家主要比较明确代价时，结构化选项可能更清楚。若角色身份的乐趣就在安排和交涉，才保留有价值的措辞差异。

不要把“尽快办妥”直接解释为任意付钱或向所有人透露秘密。缺少执行条件时，先询问；对照已有动作后仍无新增价值，就把 `signature_command` 记为 `N/A`。
body.en:
| Plan | Buttons | Text |
|---|---|---|
| Deliver this letter to the set gate | One clear action | Rewording adds no play |
| Assign Alan after the guard change | Actor and time choices | Keep expression only if combining them matters |
| Return if the gate closes; do not pass it to the aide | A condition menu may suffice | Complex plans need a readable adopted meaning |

Menus may be clearer when combinations are few and costs explicit. Keep wording differences when arranging or negotiating is part of the role’s appeal.

“Handle it soon” cannot authorize arbitrary spending or disclosure. Ask about missing terms. If expression adds no value beyond existing actions, record `signature_command` as `N/A`.

heading.zh: 输入有效，也不等于安排必定成功
heading.en: Valid input still meets resistance

body.zh:
在纸面设计中，调度员提出：“换岗后由阿岚把这封信交给守门人；城门关闭就带回，内容只给收件人看。”先展示被采用的安排，再让世界按规则回应。

阿岚可能不在站内，守门人可能拒收，时间也可能被前一任务占用。这些是有依据的阻力，不能由模型随意换成“任务已完成”。部分执行时，写清已经做了哪一步、信仍在谁手里、谁实际得知了内容。

可支持的安排、费用、权限与保密后果都要在世界设计中确定。概念阶段只提出候选和风险，不冒充已经有可运行解析器。实现时的验证与状态提交另见[自由输入不乱改结果](/novel-to-game/llm-text-games)。
body.en:
In the paper design, the dispatcher says: “After the guard change, have Alan deliver this letter to the gatekeeper. Return if the gate is closed; show the contents only to the recipient.” Display the adopted plan before the world responds.

Alan may be absent, the recipient may refuse or an earlier job may occupy the time. Grounded resistance cannot become a model’s invented success. Partial execution must say what happened, who holds the letter and who learned its contents.

World design determines supported plans, costs, rights and disclosure effects. A concept proposes candidates and risks; it is not a working parser. See the separate free-input guide for validation and state commits.

heading.zh: 原型只检验最重要的表达差别
heading.en: Test the important difference

body.zh:
为同一小任务准备按钮版和自由表达版，使用相同世界条件。让参与者做一项确实需要取舍的安排，观察：能否理解动作，能否预判代价，能否看出结果对应自己哪项决定。

这是一份待执行的比较方案，不是测试成绩。若输入自由了，结果仍全部相同，先修玩法；若表达有价值但常被误读，缩小候选范围、增加采用前确认，或改用组合菜单。不要靠新增无限 NPC 对话掩盖问题。

保留能够重复使用、产生不同后果的核心动作。输入方式应帮助玩家做决定，而不是增加打字工作。
body.en:
Prepare button and free-text versions of the same small task under the same world conditions. Ask participants to make a consequential plan. Observe whether they understand actions, anticipate costs and identify which decision caused the result.

This is an unrun comparison plan. If every input produces the same result, repair the gameplay. If valuable expression is often misread, bound intents, confirm the adopted plan or use a menu that combines choices. More NPC chat will not fix the decision.

Keep repeatable actions with distinct consequences. Input should help the player decide rather than merely type.

q.zh: 按钮会不会让文字游戏显得不够智能？
q.en: Do buttons make a text game less intelligent?

a.zh: 不会。可理解的选择、真实的代价和世界对过去行为的回应更重要；打字后只得到同一结果，互动并未增加。
