| Join | **Sound**: First audible problem; **Reason**: Intended change or a material seam |

Do not review only individual files. Each can sound plausible while the join jumps in noise or reverberation. Mark the time and audible change before choosing a layer to repair; “unnatural” is too vague for replacement work.

heading.zh: 原创例子：图书馆回收口
heading.en: Original example: a library return slot

body.zh:
以下为声音设计例子，未生成或试听。阅读室通风设备持续运转，窗外有远雨；走廊已有正在交谈的人，关门时只隐约听见。

| 镜头 | 画面与声音 |
|---|---|
| A01 | **画面**：管理员拿书走到回收口；**底声与事件**：通风与远雨持续，走廊人声被门隔远 |
| A02 | **画面**：书滑入箱内的近景；**底声与事件**：同一房间底声延续；落书声跟动作出现 |
| A03 | **画面**：管理员开门，视角转向走廊；**底声与事件**：人声随门打开更清楚，阅读室底声退远 |

A02 不因换了生成文件就换设备声；落书声也不循环成新的底噪。A03 的变化有开门与视角的依据，不必与 A01 同响度。

如果 A01→A02 突然像换了大厅，先比较实际素材：是底声换了、混响变了，还是一段多带音乐？按已确认的声音方案修正。需要补底声时，从项目真实可用的声音素材选择，不发明广播或新人物来填空。
body.en:
This sound design has not been generated or auditioned. Ventilation runs in the reading room, rain is distant, and established corridor conversation is faint through the closed door.

| Shot | Image and sound |
|---|---|
| A01 | **Image**: Librarian brings a book to the return slot; **Sound**: Fan and rain continue; door distances voices |
| A02 | **Image**: Book slides into the box; **Sound**: Same room ambience; landing sound follows action |
| A03 | **Image**: Door opens, view turns to corridor; **Sound**: Voices become clearer; reading-room sound recedes |

A02 does not acquire a new machine sound because it is a different file. The book impact does not loop into new room tone. A03 has a door and view change, so it need not match A01’s level.

If A01→A02 suddenly sounds like a hall, inspect the actual clips: changed ambience, reverberation or added music? Repair according to the accepted plan. Choose additional ambience from available project sounds rather than inventing a broadcast or new person.

heading.zh: 给三个相邻镜头写完整声音说明
heading.en: Write connected sound briefs for all three shots

body.zh:
沿用上面的图书馆案例。以下是供分镜和视频提示词使用的声音说明，不是混音命令；三镜的画面动作仍各自由已确认分镜决定。没有实际生成、素材试听或接点验收。

> A01：管理员手持同一本书走到阅读室回收口，结束时仍握书，尚未投下。通风与窗外远雨从镜头开始持续到结束；走廊已有的人声被关着的门隔得很远。保留本镜的必要脚步，不添广播、对白或配乐。镜尾的房间距离感交给 A02。
>
> A02：从同一本书仍在管理员手中的状态开始。书被送进回收口，管理员松手后书落入箱内，落书声跟随实际接触，不在松手前预响，也不循环。通风、远雨和隔门人声延续 A01 的空间与相对层级，不能因换近景变成另一间大厅。结束时书已入箱，不在下一镜再次投书。
>
> A03：书已留在箱内，管理员从门关闭的状态开门。门打开时，已有走廊人声逐渐更清楚；按本镜已确认的视角转向走廊，阅读室通风与远雨退远。变化由开门和视角产生，不在切点先把阅读室底声全部删掉。不新增说话人、可辨新台词或配乐。

回听时把 A01 的尾部和 A02 的头部连起来，再把 A02 的尾部接 A03。第一处切点应保住同一房间的听感；第二处先听门仍关时是否延续，再听开门后的合理变化。落书只发生一次，不能靠重复音效掩盖接缝。

若实际 A02 自带更大的大厅混响，先判断是整段同期声的问题，还是另加的独立底轨。独立轨可按方案另做接续；混在原声里的问题不能仅凭剪辑单一句话移除。也不要把一条新底轨叠到原底声上就宣称空间统一。选择替换、补素材或外部处理后，回听真正的输出；上面的三段文字只证明声音意图能相接。
body.en:
Keep the library example above. These are connected sound briefs for storyboard and video prompts, not mixing commands. Each shot’s accepted storyboard still owns its visible action. No footage has been generated, auditioned or accepted at the joins.

> A01: The librarian carries the same book to the reading-room return slot and still holds it at the end. Ventilation and distant outdoor rain continue throughout. Established corridor voices sound far away behind the closed door. Retain necessary footsteps without adding a broadcast, dialogue or score. Carry this room perspective into A02.
>
> A02: Start with that book still held. The librarian feeds it into the slot, releases it and it lands in the box. Its impact follows actual contact, not the moment before release, and does not loop. Fan, rain and muffled corridor voices continue with A01’s spatial character and relative levels. A close-up does not become a different hall. End with the book inside, so the next shot does not return it again.
>
> A03: The book remains inside the box. The librarian opens the previously closed door. Existing corridor voices become clearer as it opens; as the accepted view turns toward the corridor, reading-room ventilation and rain recede. Let door and view cause the change rather than deleting room tone at the cut. Add no new speakers, intelligible new lines or score.

Listen across A01’s end and A02’s start, then A02’s end and A03’s start. The first cut should retain the room. At the second, check continuity while the door is closed before evaluating the change as it opens. The book lands once; repeated impacts are not a repair for a seam.

If A02 actually carries larger hall reverberation, identify whether it is embedded in the source or comes from a separate ambience track. A separate track can be treated according to the plan. Embedded sound cannot be removed by a note in the edit list. Adding a new bed over the old one does not establish a unified space either. After replacement, new material or external processing, listen to the real output. These briefs establish connected intent only.

heading.zh: 修接点，再回听整段
heading.en: Treat the join, then listen to the sequence

body.zh:
可比较连续环境底、交叉淡入或保留声音另配画面的方案，按本场需要选择。已经与对白混在一起的底噪不能假定可独立替换；必要信息无法保住时，应补素材。

本版本内置 render 保留原声，不因剪辑单写了“环境声延续”就自动做交叉淡入或静音。外部处理完成后记录区间、所用文件和实际输出，回听接点两侧与整段，确认台词和有意义的静默都保住。整片响度统一不能替代这个检查。

主篇说明[声音与留白的剧情职责](/drama-skills/scene-sound-and-silence)；配乐突然起奏另见[跨镜配乐接续](/drama-skills/music-continuity-across-shots)。
body.en:
Compare a continuous ambience bed, crossfade or retained audio over a different image according to scene needs. Noise mixed with speech is not automatically separable; request material when necessary information cannot be preserved.

This version’s render retains source audio. Writing “ambience continues” does not execute a crossfade or mute. After external treatment, record spans, files and actual output. Listen across both sides and the sequence, preserving speech and meaningful silence. Overall level normalization does not replace this review.

The main guide covers [sound and silence as story choices](/drama-skills/scene-sound-and-silence). See [score continuity](/drama-skills/music-continuity-across-shots) for music restarts.

q.zh: 同场景的底声必须完全相同吗？
q.en: Must same-scene ambience be identical?

a.zh: 不必。声源距离、门窗、视角或主动留白可以改变声音。检查变化是否有依据、是否保住剧情信息，别机械拉成同一响度。
a.en: No. Distance, doors, view or intended silence can change sound. Check the reason and story information rather than forcing equal levels.

text.zh: 用 $short-drama-edit 回听已有相邻素材，记录持续底声、地点/视角、变化事件和第一处异常。区分底声、事件音效与配乐，比较修接点或补素材；需要外部处理时记录实际输出，再回听成片。
text.en: Use $short-drama-edit to audition existing adjacent clips. Record recurring ambience, location/view, triggering changes and first audible problem. Separate ambience, event effects and score. Compare seam treatment and replacement footage, recording actual external output before reviewing the sequence.

label.zh: 配乐与环境声的跨镜边界
声音接缝、字幕与实际混音
label.en: Audio seams, captions and enacted mixing

label.zh: 按信息和表演选入出点
label.en: Choose cuts by information and performance

title.zh: 短剧字幕怎么加：台词、时间与画面避让
title.en: Short-Drama Subtitles: Text, Timing and Placement

seo_title.zh: 短剧字幕怎么加：台词、时间与画面避让
seo_title.en: Short-Drama Subtitles: Text, Timing and Placement

description.zh: 字幕错字、慢半拍或挡住证据？按剧本确认文字，区分素材时间与剪辑时间，重测发声并检查成片阅读和画面遮挡。
description.en: Fix wrong, late or obstructive captions: verify script text, locate speech, convert clip timing and review readability in the finished cut.

answer.zh: 短剧字幕先按剧本确认文字，再从实际声音定位，最后对齐剪辑后的时间和画面。转写帮助找位置，不自动改剧本；重出素材或调整入点后要重新对齐。烧录成功不等于可读，还要检查折行、遮挡与逐句完整性。
answer.en: Start subtitles with approved script text, locate the actual speech, then align it with the edited time and frame. Transcription helps locate lines; it does not rewrite the script. Regeneration or new cut points require realignment. Successful burning is not proof of readable, complete captions.

heading.zh: 先确认文字来自哪里
heading.en: Establish the text source

body.zh:
Drama Skills 的字幕文字以《剧本.md》为准。转写可辅助定位，但同音字、名字和低声台词要回听核对；不能悄悄把识别结果当作新版本台词。

若实际录音说错或漏字，先判断要重出素材，还是由作者修改剧本并同步。字幕写正确却声音仍错，观众会接收到两套信息。允许有意的声画差异时，应由创作者明确设计。

[AI画面文字乱码](/drama-skills/text-in-ai-frames)解决生成画面里的字；本篇处理后期字幕的文字、时间与阅读。
body.en:
Drama Skills uses the screenplay as the caption text source. Transcription can locate speech, but replay names, homophones and quiet lines. Do not silently treat recognition output as revised dialogue.

When audio says a wrong word or omits one, choose replacement media or an author-approved script revision with synchronization. Correct captions over wrong speech present two versions. A deliberate discrepancy needs an explicit creative design.

[Generated text errors](/drama-skills/text-in-ai-frames) concern lettering inside generated images. This guide concerns captions added during editing.

heading.zh: 分清素材、剪辑段与成片时间
heading.en: Separate source, cut and sequence time

body.zh:
先记发声在源文件中的区间，再减去本段入点。字幕相对本 CUT 入点；拼到成片后，还要加上前面实际渲染段落的时长。

假设回听某素材得到：入点 3.00 秒，完整台词从 3.40 到 6.60 秒，出点 7.80 秒。下表只是时间换算示例，不是实测报告。

| 项目 | 时间 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| 源素材 | 3.40—6.60 秒 | 这句话在原文件里的位置 |
| 当前段 | 0.40—3.60 秒 | 减去入点 3.00 秒后的字幕位置 |
| 成片预计 | 2.40—5.60 秒 | 假设前面实际使用段为 2.00 秒 |

最终累计用渲染后各段的实际时长，避免帧边界取整造成偏移。重出视频后，哪怕台词没改，发声位置也可能变；重新回听相关句子。
body.en:
Locate speech in the source file, then subtract the cut’s in-point. Caption time is relative to this CUT. For the sequence, add preceding rendered durations.

Suppose the in-point is 3.00s, a complete line occupies 3.40–6.60s, and the out-point is 7.80s. This illustrates conversion, not an actual measurement report.

| Space | Time | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Source | 3.40–6.60s | Speech in the original file |
| Cut | 0.40–3.60s | After subtracting the 3.00s in-point |
| Sequence | 2.40–5.60s | If preceding used material actually lasts 2.00s |

Use final rendered segment durations for accumulation to avoid frame-rounding drift. A regenerated clip can change speech position even with unchanged words; replay affected lines.

heading.zh: 原创例子：字幕别挡住交接
heading.en: Original example: leave the handoff visible

body.zh:
示例剧本中，阿岚把蓝色钥匙圈放进邻居掌心，说：“这把开侧门，关门后放回蓝盒。”邻居收起钥匙并点头。钥匙交接和蓝盒都是已经建立的剧情信息。

坏字幕把整句一次塞在画面中央，既挡住交接又挤掉蓝盒。可先从实际发声和停顿定位，分成先后可读的字幕，再检查人物手、盒子和平台界面附近是否有空间。不要为了排版把“侧门”改成“正门”，也不凭空加“千万别告诉别人”。

若字放到下方仍遮住手，比较上移、调整画面或用其他已批准镜头的方案。该版本内置字幕样式统一，不支持 CUT 内逐镜位置指令；复杂避让要在外部字幕编辑器或字幕层完成，检查实际输出。
body.en:
In the sample script, Alan places a blue key ring in a neighbor’s palm: “This opens the side door. Put it back in the blue box after closing.” The neighbor pockets it and nods. The handoff and box are established story information.

A single central caption covers both hand and box. Locate real speech and pauses, display readable successive captions, then check hands, box and interface space. Do not change “side door” to “front door” for layout or invent “tell nobody.”

If lower placement still masks the hand, compare moving text, adjusting framing or using another approved shot. This version’s built-in captions use a uniform style without per-CUT placement instructions. Use an external editor or subtitle layer for complex avoidance and inspect the output.

heading.zh: 按成片核对，不只看字幕文件
heading.en: Review the finished picture and sound

body.zh:
逐句回听文字与声音，抽帧查字号、先后显示、关键字被拆开与画面遮挡，再正常速度完整播放。长句拆分方式和字幕样式是项目工具选择，不是所有短剧的统一规范。

把错误分开处理：文字错回剧本与录音核对；时间错重测发声并检查入点；挡画面改排版或镜头；漏一句检查是否被剪掉。重剪或重出后，不沿用旧对齐结论。

字幕可按作品需要选择硬字幕、独立字幕或无字幕；用户已接受的交付要求仍要落实。剪辑单填写见[素材与剪点模板](/drama-skills/ai-short-drama-edit-list-template)。
body.en:
Replay each line against text, inspect frames for size, order, split key words and occlusion, then watch at normal speed. Long-line splitting and caption styling are project/tool choices, not universal short-drama rules.

Treat errors by cause: check words against script and audio; remeasure timing and in-points; change layout or picture for occlusion; inspect a cut for a missing line. Do not carry old alignment findings onto new edits or regenerated footage.

Hard captions, separate subtitles or none can follow the work’s needs while honoring agreed delivery requirements. See the [edit-list template](/drama-skills/ai-short-drama-edit-list-template).

q.zh: 转写正确就能直接当字幕吗？
q.en: Can a correct transcript serve directly as captions?

a.zh: 仍需按剧本核对文字、定位实际发声，并换算剪辑时间。识别正确不代表字幕时间、阅读速度和遮挡都合适。
a.en: Still verify script text, actual speech and edited timing. Accurate recognition does not establish readable timing or unobstructed placement.

text.zh: 用 $short-drama-edit 检查已存在素材与剧本字幕。逐句保留原文，定位发声，换算本CUT时间；重出和改入点后重新对齐。复杂避让交外部字幕处理，输出后回听并抽帧检查，不把转写正确当交付完成。
text.en: Use $short-drama-edit with existing footage and screenplay. Preserve line text, locate speech and convert to CUT-relative times; realign after regeneration or changed in-points. Handle complex placement externally and review actual output audio and frames.

label.zh: 声音接缝、字幕与实际混音
label.en: Audio seams, captions and enacted mixing

label.zh: 按信息和表演选入出点
label.en: Choose cuts by information and performance

title.zh: AI视频开头结尾怎么剪：保留动作完成与反应
title.en: Where to Trim an AI Video: Actions and Reactions

seo_title.zh: AI视频开头结尾怎么剪：保留动作完成与反应
seo_title.en: Where to Trim an AI Video: Actions and Reactions

description.zh: 素材开头等太久、结尾漂移或重复动作？先标可用区间，再按台词、动作结果和反应选入出点，避免剪掉剧情信息。
description.en: Trim waiting, drift and repeated motion by marking usable spans, then choosing cuts that preserve complete speech, action results and reactions.

answer.zh: 先看完整素材、标可用区间，再按故事信息选入出点。起始静止可能是无用等待，也可能是必要反应；结尾应让观众读到动作结果，并避开无意回弹或漂移。缺失的关键动作要补素材，不能靠剪短假装完成。
answer.en: Watch the complete source and mark usable spans before choosing story cuts. Initial stillness may be dead waiting or a needed reaction. End after the action result reads, before unwanted rebound or drift. Missing essential action needs material, not a shorter cut that pretends it happened.

heading.zh: 可用区间与选中的剪辑段分开
heading.en: Separate usable spans from chosen cuts

body.zh:
第一次完整播放，记录缺陷在哪里：身份或道具变化、动作回弹、无意重复、画面发白、台词错位。静止、暗部、停顿不自动算废片，先看它们是否符合本镜职责。

可用区间是观察，入出点是选择。一个文件前八秒都可用，也可能只取其中四秒；一句话需要呼吸和回应时，也可以保留比动作更长的尾部。

生成不符合意图时，是否重抽、改提示词或补拍见[生成修订分流](/drama-skills/reroll-or-rewrite)。本篇讨论已经有素材后，具体保留哪里。
body.en:
On the first full playback, locate identity/prop changes, rebound, accidental repetition, bleaching and speech errors. Stillness, darkness and pauses are not automatically unusable; compare their shot purpose.

A usable span is an observation; in/out points are a choice. Eight usable seconds may yield a four-second cut. A line needing breath and response may retain a longer tail.

See [generation revision choices](/drama-skills/reroll-or-rewrite) for rerolling, rewriting or pickups. This guide chooses the retained interval once material exists.

heading.zh: 原创剪点例子：接过再松手
heading.en: Original cut example: receive, then release

body.zh:
下面是假设素材供作者比较的剪点设计，不是实际生成结果。分镜要求：小乔把修好的木偶交给阿梅，阿梅接稳后小乔松手，阿梅点头。分镜没有台词。

| 素材段 | 假设可见内容 | 取舍 |
|---|---|---|
| 0.00—0.80 秒 | 尚未开始交接 | 看本场是否需要等待，不自动保留 |
| 0.80—4.00 秒 | 小乔递出，阿梅接稳，小乔松手 | 保留完整因果 |
| 4.00—5.20 秒 | 阿梅看木偶并点头 | 留出观众读到接收结果的时间 |
| 5.20—6.40 秒 | 持物稳定 | 只保留需要的余味 |
| 6.40 秒后 | 木偶漂移，交接动作重复 | 不用这一缺陷段 |

可比较入点 0.60、出点 5.40 秒的方案：动作前有一点准备，接稳和点头完整。它是示例候选，不是统一秒数。若从 3.50 秒开始，观众可能只见手已松开；若 3.80 秒结束，则接收尚未读清。

下一镜阿梅应继续持木偶。删掉漂移并没有自动证明接镜连续，还要把下一镜起点并排核对。
body.en:
This hypothetical material supports a cut-design comparison, not an actual generated result. The storyboard requires Xiao Qiao to hand repaired puppet to Amei, release after Amei supports it, then Amei nods. There is no dialogue.

| Span | Content | Choice |
|---|---|---|
| 0.00–0.80s | Transfer has not started | Keep waiting only if the scene needs it |
| 0.80–4.00s | Offer, secure grip, release | Preserve the causal chain |
| 4.00–5.20s | Amei looks and nods | Let the receipt register |
| 5.20–6.40s | Stable hold | Retain the needed aftereffect |
| After 6.40s | Puppet drifts; handoff repeats | Exclude this defect span |

Compare an in-point of 0.60s and out-point of 5.40s: brief preparation plus complete receipt and nod. These are candidate values, not universal seconds. Starting at 3.50s may show only a released hand; ending at 3.80s may lose clear receipt.

Amei should still hold the puppet in the next shot. Removing drift does not prove continuity; compare the next accepted start.

heading.zh: 有台词时先保完整发声
heading.en: Protect complete speech first

body.zh:
先定位属于本句的实际发声，不被前后杂音拖长。留多少开口准备、呼吸和句后反应，按本场表演决定；skill 的大约留量是工作默认，不是全片配额。

一句话中可以切画面，但音轨要连续，说话人和叙事关系清楚。该版本内置 render 同步裁声音与画面；保留完整声音另配画面时，需要外部剪辑处理并记录区间。不要为方便剪镜把原台词擅自拆改。

调整入点后重新核对字幕相对时间，具体见[短剧字幕对齐](/drama-skills/add-and-time-short-drama-subtitles)。
body.en:
Locate the actual speech of this line rather than extending it for unrelated noise. Choose lead-in, breath and reaction by performance. The skill’s approximate padding is a working default, not a whole-film quota.

Picture may cut during a line if audio remains continuous and speaker/story relations stay clear. This version’s render trims sound and image together; retained audio over different picture requires external editing and recorded spans. Do not rewrite the line just to simplify cutting.

Recheck caption-relative times after changing the in-point; see [subtitle alignment](/drama-skills/add-and-time-short-drama-subtitles).

heading.zh: 缺关键过程时，剪辑能做什么
heading.en: When necessary material is missing

body.zh:
可用段已经完整承载信息，可以缩短；其他已拍镜头能交代缺口，可以比较换镜或改镜序。必需的接触、选择、台词或反应没有出现，则列缺口补素材。

叠化不能补出从未发生的交接，冻结最后一帧也不能自动成为接稳。必要过程可以换实现方式，但要回到分镜确认，而不是剪辑偷偷改事实。

整段正常速度回看，再检查相邻镜头、声音和字幕。目标时长若只是参考，报告实际差异；若作者明确要求固定交付时长，就继续调整或说明缺什么，不自行降为参考。
body.en:
Shorten when the usable span fully carries the information. Compare another existing shot or a reordered sequence when it can supply the gap. If necessary contact, choice, speech or reaction never appears, list the gap and request material.

A dissolve cannot create a missing handoff, and a frozen frame does not establish secure receipt. An alternative realization needs storyboard approval rather than a silent change of story facts.

Watch the sequence at normal speed, then check joins, sound and captions. Report differences from a reference duration; honor a fixed delivery duration or identify missing material rather than downgrading it to a reference.

q.zh: 必须把开头静止和句后停顿都剪掉吗？
q.en: Must all initial stillness and trailing pauses be cut?

a.zh: 不必。等待、反应和留白可能正是本镜的作用。只有没有新作用的等待或无意重复才考虑删，按正常速度的实际观看判断。
a.en: No. Waiting, response and silence may be the shot’s purpose. Consider removing waiting or accidental repetition only when it adds no intended function, judged at normal playback speed.

text.zh: 用 $short-drama-edit 看完整现有素材，分别记录可用区间和选中的入出点。保留本镜信息、完整发声与结果，核对下一镜起点；列需要补拍的缺口，重剪后复查字幕和声音。
text.en: Use $short-drama-edit to watch existing sources fully and record usable spans separately from chosen cuts. Preserve shot information, complete speech and outcomes, compare the next start, list pickups and recheck captions/audio after trimming.

label.zh: 生成素材的可用区间
按信息和表演选入出点
label.en: Choose cuts by information and performance

label.zh: 声音接缝、字幕与实际混音
label.en: Audio seams, captions and enacted mixing

title.zh: AI视频镜头乱动怎么办：固定机位与运镜区间
title.en: AI Video Camera Drift: Lock or Time the Move

seo_title.zh: AI视频镜头乱动怎么办：固定机位与运镜区间
seo_title.en: AI Video Camera Drift: Lock or Time the Move

description.zh: 本想固定，成片却推近或环绕？先查已定运镜与提示词冲突，再写机位、允许动作和保持区间，逐帧核对实际结果。
description.en: Wanted a still camera but got a push or orbit? Check accepted motion, resolve prompt conflicts and specify framing, allowed action and hold intervals.

answer.zh: 先确认分镜本来要固定还是移动，再改视频提示词。本来固定，就写清构图、保持区间及画内允许动作；本来移动，就写触发、路径和落点。固定机位不等于人物冻结，写得明确也不保证生成正确，仍要检查实际镜头。
answer.en: First confirm whether the storyboard wants a static or moving camera. For static framing, state its interval and permitted action; for movement, state trigger, path and landing. A fixed camera does not freeze the actor, and precise wording still needs actual-output review.

heading.zh: 先查意图，别直接锁死
heading.en: Check intent before locking

body.zh:
如果分镜已安排人物跟拍、揭示或关系变化，不要为了消除漂移自行改成固定。先判断成片是在执行已定运镜，还是多了不需要的运动。

同一区间同时写“完全固定”和“缓慢环绕”有明确冲突；人物走动而机位不动却不一定矛盾，只要固定构图能承载动作与终点。没有写运镜也不等于自动固定：补选择时回分镜确认。

运镜的叙事选择见[推拉摇移主篇](/drama-skills/motivated-camera-movement)；这里处理已选行为怎样落实进提示词。
body.en:
Do not replace accepted tracking, reveals or relationship moves with a lock just to eliminate drift. Determine whether the output follows the plan or adds unwanted motion.

“Fully locked” and “slow orbit” conflict over the same interval. An actor moving under a static camera may be fine if framing carries action and endpoint. A blank camera field is not automatically static; confirm a supplied choice with the storyboard.

See [motivated movement](/drama-skills/motivated-camera-movement) for the creative choice. This guide implements the selected behavior in a video prompt.

heading.zh: 原创提示：机位不动，人物仍表演
heading.en: Original prompt: still camera, active performance

body.zh:
示例分镜已确定：阿蕊坐窗边等待，听到门铃后看向画外门口，最终仍坐着。固定中近景、平视、桌边与窗框作为空间参照；窗帘原本轻摆。下面是手写提示，未生成结果。

**含糊版**：“电影感固定镜头，轻轻漂浮环绕，人物听见门铃，整个画面保持静止。”机位同时固定和环绕，还把表演与窗帘一并冻住。

**修订候选**：

> 固定中近景，平视，桌边与窗框持续留在已定构图中；全镜保持此机位。阿蕊起初等待并自然呼吸，既定门铃响起后，她抬眼看向画外门口，最终仍坐在原位。画内保留她的呼吸、转头与窗帘轻摆；摄影机不跟随转头，结束构图沿用起点。

这里把“机位保持”与“画内运动”分开。门铃是示例剧本已有声音，不为让她转头新增第二个人或另一次事件。真实参考帧若已承载外貌与室内细节，就不用重复写满装修。
body.en:
The sample storyboard fixes this plan: Arui sits by a window, hears a doorbell and looks toward an off-screen doorway, remaining seated. Eye-level medium close framing keeps table edge and window as spatial anchors; the curtain already moves gently. This manual prompt has not been generated.

**Vague:** “Cinematic locked camera, gently floating orbit, she hears the bell, keep the entire picture still.” It demands both lock and orbit while freezing performance and curtain.

**Revision candidate:**

> Hold the accepted eye-level medium close framing throughout, keeping table edge and window in place. Arui waits and breathes naturally. At the established doorbell, she looks toward the off-screen doorway and remains seated. Her breathing, head turn and gentle curtain movement continue inside the frame. The camera does not follow her turn; end framing matches the start.

Separate camera hold from action within the image. The bell exists in this sample script; add no extra person or event to cause the turn. When a real reference already supplies looks and interior detail, do not restate all the decoration.

heading.zh: 需要移动时，把区间写清
heading.en: If movement is wanted, mark its interval

body.zh:
镜头可以先固定、再移动、最后停住，前提是分镜已接受这些阶段。用“门铃响起后开始”“她停在门边时结束”等触发与地标，比只写“适当推进”清楚。

如果制作需要秒段，使用已确认时长并说明顺序或重叠；只加一两个保持锚点时，不必把整镜变成秒表。相机与人物速度可以不同，写清谁跟谁、最终构图是什么，不为了速度一致改掉原设计。

具体术语按目标模型已确认的写法，不把另一个模型上用过的词当通用保证。
body.en:
A shot can hold, move, then land if those phases are accepted upstream. Triggers and landmarks such as “after the bell” or “when she reaches the door” are clearer than “push suitably.”

For explicit timed phases, use the accepted duration and state order or overlap. One or two hold anchors need not turn the whole shot into a stopwatch. Actor and camera speeds may differ; state who follows whom and the final frame rather than revising the design to equalize speed.

Use wording supported by the chosen target rather than treating another model’s term as a universal guarantee.

heading.zh: 用实际画面确认问题在哪
heading.en: Find the issue in actual frames

body.zh:
比较开头、变化处与结尾：桌边、窗框等空间参照是否整体改变位置，景别是否意外变紧，人物是否完成约定动作。身体转头、衣服变化或背景变形不一定都是运镜，先定位具体异常。

| 异常 | 下一步 |
|---|---|
| 固定与移动同时出现 | 先消除同一区间冲突 |
| 文本只写“固定”但构图含糊 | 补机位、保持区间与允许动作 |
| 运动正确但错过关键反应 | 调触发或落点，必要时回分镜改构图 |
| 机位稳定，人物或背景仍变形 | 分开处理身份、资产或动作问题 |
| 提示已清楚，结果仍漂移 | 比较重出、可用片段或补素材，不假称已经修好 |

这是一张诊断表，不是成功率测试。记录哪段出现什么变化，再按[重抽或修订分流](/drama-skills/reroll-or-rewrite)选择下一步。
body.en:
Compare start, change point and end: do table/window anchors shift together, does framing tighten unexpectedly, and does the actor perform the agreed action? A head turn, clothing change or warped background is not necessarily camera movement; locate the actual issue.

| Issue | Next step |
|---|---|
| Lock and move coexist | Resolve their same-interval conflict |
| “Fixed” leaves framing vague | Add viewpoint, interval and allowed action |
| Correct move misses a reaction | Adjust trigger/landing; revise framing if needed |
| Stable camera, warped actor or background | Treat identity, assets or action separately |
| Clear wording still drifts | Compare replacement, usable spans or pickups |

This diagnostic table is not a success-rate test. Record the span and change, then use [reroll or revision choices](/drama-skills/reroll-or-rewrite).

q.zh: 固定镜头是不是要求人物完全不动？
q.en: Does a fixed camera require a motionless actor?

a.zh: 不是。固定的是摄影机机位与构图关系，人物表演和已确定的环境运动仍可发生。把允许动作与保持项分别写清。
a.en: No. Camera position and framing remain fixed; performance and accepted environmental movement can continue. Specify permitted action separately from what stays fixed.

text.zh: 用 $short-drama-video-prompts 检查已接受分镜的摄影机行为。分清固定区间与移动区间，写机位、触发、路径、落点和画内允许动作；不改既定事实，实际生成后核对空间参照与表演。
text.en: Use $short-drama-video-prompts with the accepted storyboard. Separate hold/move intervals and state framing, trigger, path, endpoint and permitted in-frame action. Preserve story facts and review spatial anchors and performance in actual output.

label.zh: 固定与移动摄影机的区间
起点、动作和摄影机落点

title.zh: AI润色小说乱改剧情怎么办：先定修改范围
title.en: Stop AI Polishing From Changing Your Plot

seo_title.zh: AI润色小说乱改剧情怎么办：先定修改范围
seo_title.en: Stop AI Polishing From Changing Your Plot

description.zh: 把文字润色、局部修订和整章重写分开；用原文事实、信息来源与前后衔接限制改动，附钥匙交接案例。
description.en: Separate prose polishing from plot revision. Protect facts, knowledge sources and scene joins with a worked key-handoff example.

answer.zh: 先明确这次只改表达，还是允许改变事件。润色可以调整句子、重复和停顿，但不能改变物件交接、人物决定、知识来源或揭示时机。保留原稿，先改一个片段，再逐项核对事实；发现剧情问题时另列建议，不借润色顺手修掉。
answer.en: Specify whether the task may change events or only their expression. Polishing can alter phrasing, repetition and pauses, while preserving possession, decisions, knowledge sources and reveal timing. Keep the original, revise a small passage first and compare its facts. Report plot problems separately.

heading.zh: “润色一下”需要先补哪句话？
heading.en: Define What Polishing May Change

body.zh:
“更好看”“更自然”说明期望，没说明改动权限。Oh Story 的去AI味方法只改怎么说；章节修订则区分局部修改、按原细纲整章重写、先改细纲再重写。本页把这些边界整理成作者可用的任务说明。

| 任务 | 写清权限 |
|---|---|
| 文字润色 | 只改指定片段的表达，事件和信息分配不变 |
| 局部修订 | 点明可变的事件或对白，其他段落保持原样 |
| 整章重写 | 指定采用的细纲与相邻章材料，说明是否允许改剧情 |

有时一句“这段只改表达，人物仍拒绝接钥匙”就够了。别为了润色先造一整本设定集；只补本段所依赖的事实和作者已经选定的文风。
body.en:
“Make it better” states an ambition without defining editing authority. Oh Story’s deslop method changes expression. Its chapter revision workflow distinguishes a local edit, a chapter rewrite under the existing outline, and revising the outline before rewriting. The table translates those boundaries into an author’s brief.

| Task | Permission to specify |
|---|---|
| Prose polish | Change expression in the named passage; preserve events and information distribution |
| Local revision | Name the event or dialogue that may change; preserve the other paragraphs |
| Chapter rewrite | Supply the chosen outline and neighboring context; state whether plot changes are allowed |

Sometimes “Polish only; she still refuses the key” is enough. Use the facts the passage depends on and the author’s chosen style, rather than inventing a book-wide specification for a small edit.

heading.zh: 核对动作结果，也核对人物怎么知道
heading.en: Check Results and How Characters Know

body.zh:
先从原文摘出必须保留的事实：谁在场、物件在哪里、谁做了什么、决定是否兑现、人物通过什么途径得到信息、读者此刻能知道多少。原文没有交代的动机也属于边界：润色不能替作者补成一个确定原因。

写法变化可能掩盖事件变化。“把钥匙放在她面前”改成“把钥匙塞进她手里”，改变了交接；“拨号后听到停机提示”改成“她知道号码已经停机”，丢掉了获知过程。逐项比较动作、结果与来源，比只看新稿是否流畅更可靠。

本书选定的长句、直接情绪或叙述者评论可以保留。文风允许一种表达，不代表允许提前揭示秘密或替角色增加经历。
body.en:
Extract the facts that must survive: who is present, where objects are, what people do, whether a decision is carried out, how information is learned and what the reader currently knows. An unspecified motive is also a boundary; polishing cannot replace it with a definite explanation.

A stylistic change can conceal an event change. “He put the key in front of her” becoming “He pressed it into her hand” changes possession. Replacing a disconnected-line message heard after dialing with “she knew the number was disconnected” removes the knowledge-gathering action. Compare actions, results and sources as well as fluency.

Preserve the author’s chosen long sentences, direct emotion or narrator commentary when they work. A style preference does not authorize revealing secrets early or adding experiences to a character’s history.

heading.zh: 原创对照：钥匙没有交出去
heading.en: Original Comparison: The Key Was Never Accepted

body.zh:
**原文**

> 谢宁把钥匙放在桌上。陶禾看了一眼，没有拿。她说等房东把漏水修好再决定。谢宁把钥匙收回外套口袋，二人都没再提搬家的事。

**越界改稿**

> 陶禾接过钥匙，终于决定给这个家一次机会。

这不是压缩表达：钥匙到了另一人手里，条件等待变成接受，还新增了“家”的关系解释。

**保留事实的润色**

> 谢宁把钥匙放到桌上，陶禾看过后没有伸手：“等房东修好漏水，再决定。”谢宁收回钥匙，放进外套口袋。搬家的话题就停在那里。

新版调整转述与停顿，仍保留放下、未拿、提出条件、收回、结束话题这五项。陶禾没有答应搬家，也没有新获知房东已安排维修。例子为本页原创，展示的是可核对的修改边界，不是一次实际模型运行结果。
body.en:
**Original**

> Xie Ning put the key on the table. Tao He looked at it without taking it. She said she would decide after the landlord fixed the leak. Xie Ning returned the key to his coat pocket. Neither mentioned the move again.

**Revision beyond the brief**

> Tao He accepted the key, finally deciding to give this home a chance.

The key changes hands, a conditional wait becomes acceptance, and “home” adds a relationship interpretation.

**A fact-preserving polish**

> Xie Ning set the key on the table. Tao He looked at it but did not reach. “I’ll decide after the landlord fixes the leak.” He put the key back in his coat pocket. The subject of moving ended there.

The phrasing changes, while setting down, not taking, stating a condition, taking back and ending the topic remain. Tao He has neither agreed to move nor learned that repairs are scheduled. This original editorial example demonstrates a checkable boundary; it is not a reported model run.

heading.zh: 怎样要求改稿与报告？
heading.en: Request a Revision You Can Compare

body.zh:
给出范围、文风和不可改事实后，要求返回改稿与简短变更说明。先看这一段是否符合要求，再扩大范围。下面是人工任务模板，不是 skill 新增的运行模式。

> 只润色〔片段〕。保留〔动作、结果、信息来源、未揭示内容〕，采用〔本书文风〕。不新增经历、物件、解释或人物决定。发现剧情问题另列，暂不修。返回改稿和主要表达改动；若某处无法在保留事实的前提下改好，标明位置供我决定。

接受改稿前，把事实表逐项对照；再读前段末尾和后段开头，检查指代、时间和物件归属。未获准的整章改写退回原稿，保留有用建议即可。若你确实决定改变事件，转到[章节修订](/oh-story/review-and-revise)，并检查[后文依赖](/oh-story/sync-later-chapters-after-a-revision)。
body.en:
Supply scope, style and protected facts, then request the revised passage and a short change note. Check a small result before expanding the assignment. This is a manual brief, not a new skill mode.

> Polish only [passage]. Preserve [actions, results, knowledge sources and unrevealed information]. Use [book style]. Add no experiences, objects, explanations or decisions. List plot problems separately without fixing them. Return the revision and main expression changes. Identify any passage you cannot improve within these boundaries for my decision.

Compare each protected fact, then read the preceding ending and following opening for references, time and possession. Revert an unauthorized chapter rewrite while retaining useful suggestions. If you choose to change an event, use [chapter revision](/oh-story/review-and-revise) and check [later dependencies](/oh-story/sync-later-chapters-after-a-revision).

q.zh: AI发现了原文逻辑问题，润色时能顺手改吗？
q.en: Can polishing also fix a plot problem the AI discovers?

a.zh: 先列出问题、位置和影响，由作者决定是否扩大范围。原文确实有问题，也不能用未获准的新剧情来替换；改事件后还要核对后文依赖。
a.en: List the problem, location and effect for the author’s decision. A real defect does not authorize an unrequested plot replacement. Event changes also require checking later dependencies.

text.zh: 在 Claude Code 用 /story-deslop（Codex 用 $story-deslop），附上上方的范围、文风与事实说明。它用于表达修订；允许改变事件时，应另走 story-long-write 的章节修订流程。
text.en: Use /story-deslop in Claude Code or $story-deslop in Codex with the scope, style and fact brief above. It handles expression; authorized event changes belong in story-long-write’s chapter revision workflow.

label.zh: 保留创作意图与最少改动
作者文风优先级
章节修订的范围与衔接
文风与事实分别裁决

title.zh: AI审稿意见太空泛怎么办：原句、影响与改法
title.en: Get Specific AI Feedback on Your Manuscript

seo_title.zh: AI审稿意见太空泛怎么办：原句、影响与改法
seo_title.en: Get Specific AI Feedback on Your Manuscript

description.zh: 把“节奏不好、人物不立体”转成有原文位置、读者影响和有限改法的审稿意见；区分必须改、建议改与作者选择。
description.en: Turn vague criticism into located quotations, reader effects and bounded next steps. Separate necessary fixes, suggestions and author choices.

answer.zh: 要求每条意见引用原文，说明读者在哪里误解、等待或失去依据，并指出要修改的范围。事实矛盾需要两端证据；风格判断要结合作者目标。把意见分成必须改、建议改、可以不改，材料不够就说明缺什么，先报告再决定改稿。
answer.en: Require a quotation and location, the specific reader effect and a bounded next step. Factual contradictions need evidence on both sides; style judgments need the author’s goal. Separate necessary fixes, suggestions and optional changes. Identify missing evidence before deciding on revision.

heading.zh: 先给审稿一个可回答的问题
heading.en: Give the Review an Answerable Question

body.zh:
“评价我的小说”容易得到一串抽象褒贬。先说明审查哪一章或哪场戏，以及你最担心什么：读者是否理解拒绝的原因？悬念是不是拖到失去兴趣？角色转变有没有依据？一轮集中处理一个主问题，其他明显错误可以另列。

同时提供相关前提和文风。你希望对白克制，就不能让“台词没有说透情绪”自动成为缺陷；但若读者连谁说话都无法辨认，仍要指出具体位置。Oh Story 的审稿报告要求说明范围、原文证据、读者后果与作者待定事项；本页把它转成可用的提问方法。
body.en:
“Evaluate my novel” invites abstract praise and criticism. Specify the chapter or scene and your main concern: Can readers understand the refusal? Does suspense outlast their interest? Is the change of mind supported? Focus one pass on one main question while listing other clear errors separately.

Supply relevant premises and style. A preference for restrained dialogue means unspoken emotion is not automatically a defect. If readers cannot identify the speaker, the reviewer should still locate the problem. Oh Story’s report method calls for scope, quotations, reader consequences and author decisions; this guide translates that into useful review questions.

heading.zh: 一条意见要能回到哪句话？
heading.en: Make Each Note Traceable to the Passage

body.zh:
| 项目 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| 位置 | 章节与段落；文件审查可用真实行号 |
| 引文 | 足以支持判断的短原句，不改写成所谓原文 |
| 影响 | 读者会误认什么，哪条期待或因果失效 |
| 下一步 | 修改哪一处、保留哪些事实；无需直接代写 |
| 边界 | 哪些是判断，哪些缺材料或由作者选择 |

“人物不立体”不能直接变成“加一段悲惨童年”。先指出这个人物哪次选择缺少已建立的动机。事实问题要求前提与触发事件两端引文，方法见[小说一致性检查](/oh-story/ai-fiction-consistency-check)；本页也处理节奏、表达与读者体验，不把这些主观判断伪装成事实错误。
body.en:
| Item | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Location | Chapter and paragraph; real line numbers for file reviews |
| Quotation | A short original excerpt supporting the judgment |
| Effect | What readers misread, or which expectation or causal link fails |
| Next step | What to revise and preserve; drafting is not required |
| Limits | Distinguish judgment, missing materials and author choices |

“A flat character” does not justify adding a traumatic childhood. Locate the choice lacking an established motive first. Factual findings need quotations for both premise and triggering event; see [continuity checking](/oh-story/ai-fiction-consistency-check). This guide also covers pacing, expression and reader experience, whose judgments should not be presented as factual contradictions.

heading.zh: 原创示例：把“节奏拖沓”改成具体意见
heading.en: Original Example: Make a Pacing Note Specific

body.zh:
假设作者要让读者跟着岑雨等待包裹，却不提前透露寄件人。稿件片段如下：

> 门铃响了，岑雨从桌边起身，往玄关走。她经过餐桌，穿过客厅，绕过沙发，走到玄关，伸手打开门。快递员把盒子递给她，她只看见上面写着自己的名字。

空泛意见是“节奏拖沓，建议增强悬念”。更可用的意见：

> **建议改：本场开头“起身……往玄关走……经过餐桌……走到玄关”。**连续句子重复从桌边到门口的位移，读者等待包裹内容，途中没有新阻碍或新线索。可压缩这次走动，保留门铃、开门、交接和只看到收件人名字。不要为了增强悬念添加敲门暗号、陌生监视者或寄件人信息。

这是基于给定目标的局部节奏判断。若作者要表现行动艰难，就需要读到稿件中实际存在的阻碍，再判断哪些步伐应保留；不能凭空设定岑雨受伤来证明原段合理。示例为编辑原创。
body.en:
Suppose the author wants readers to wait with Cen Yu for a parcel without revealing its sender. The draft reads:

> The doorbell rang. Cen Yu rose from the table and headed toward the entrance. She passed the dining table, crossed the living room, went around the sofa, reached the entrance and opened the door. The courier handed her a box. All she saw on it was her own name.

A vague note says, “Slow pacing; increase suspense.” A useful note says:

> **Suggested revision: the opening movement from “rose” through “reached the entrance.”** Several clauses repeat the journey from table to door. Readers are waiting for the parcel; the route adds no obstacle or clue. Compress the journey while preserving the bell, opening, handoff and recipient-only information. Do not add a coded knock, watcher or sender details to manufacture suspense.

This is a local pacing judgment against a stated goal. If difficult movement is the intended effect, assess obstacles actually present in the manuscript. Do not invent an injury to justify the passage. This example was written for the guide.

heading.zh: 排序，不让“建议”变成全部重写
heading.en: Prioritize Without Turning Every Suggestion Into a Rewrite

body.zh:
Oh Story 给作者的报告用“必须改、建议改、可以不改”，内部严重度代号不必成为作者的任务清单。明显的事实断裂或读不通之处优先；节奏和风格意见结合本场目标再决定。

审稿意见互相冲突时，先看它们引用的是不是同一处、针对的是不是同一个目标。“压缩进门”与“给交接留停顿”可以同时成立，因为处理的过程不同。若一条要隐藏寄件人，另一条要立即揭示，就交给作者选择揭示时机，不能两边都执行。

下面是人工追加要求，可附在实际审稿请求后：

> 每条意见给出位置、短引文、读者影响、有限改法与保留事实。按必须改、建议改、可以不改排序。证据不足说清缺什么，风格取舍由我决定。只审〔范围〕，不修改正文；我选定意见后再另开改稿任务。

改完对照原来的问题读一遍：重复位移是否减少，包裹交接和信息边界是否仍在。评价词变好听不能代替这些结果。
body.en:
Oh Story’s author report uses necessary fixes, suggested revisions and optional changes. Internal severity codes need not become the author’s checklist. Prioritize clear factual breaks and unreadable passages; judge pacing and style against the scene’s goal.

For conflicting notes, compare locations and goals. Compressing the walk and allowing a pause at the handoff can coexist because they concern different processes. Hiding and immediately revealing the sender require an author decision, rather than executing both.

This manual requirement can accompany a review request:

> For each finding, provide location, a short quotation, reader effect, bounded next step and protected facts. Separate necessary fixes, suggestions and optional changes. State missing evidence and leave style choices to me. Review only [scope] without editing the prose. I will select findings for a separate revision task.

After editing, test the original concern: Has repeated movement decreased, with handoff and information boundaries intact? More flattering evaluation language cannot substitute for those results.

q.zh: AI说“不错”，却没有问题清单，能当作审稿通过吗？
q.en: Does praise without findings mean the manuscript passed review?

a.zh: 不能据此判断。先确认它读了哪些材料、按什么目标检查；要求指出可核对的结果和没法判断之处。没有发现问题与没有实际核查，是不同情况。
a.en: It is insufficient evidence. Confirm the materials and goals checked, and request verifiable results and unresolved limits. Finding no problem differs from performing no meaningful review.

text.zh: 在 Claude Code 用 /story-review solo（Codex 用 $story-review solo），指定范围、作者目标与文风，附上上方报告要求。solo 是已有基础审查模式，不代表能从未提供的全书材料中推断结论；报告后另行授权改稿。
text.en: Use /story-review solo in Claude Code or $story-review solo in Codex with scope, goals, style and the report requirements above. This existing basic-review mode cannot infer a full manuscript it has not read. Choose findings before assigning revision.

title.zh: 小说修稿先改什么：剧情、场景与文字的顺序
title.en: What to Revise First in a Novel

seo_title.zh: 小说修稿先改什么：剧情、场景与文字的顺序
seo_title.en: What to Revise First in a Novel

description.zh: 用具体读者问题判断先改故事方向、情节因果还是句子；附人物改变主意的修订顺序与停手条件。
description.en: Diagnose story direction, causal design or prose before editing. Includes a change-of-mind example and clear stopping criteria.

answer.zh: 先找最影响当前阅读目标的问题。若人物行动没有原因或结果缺少条件，先解决事件设计；若事件成立但读者看不懂，先修交付过程与表达；方向和目标读者需要调整时，再回到定位与大纲。先定事实和范围，再润色，不把所有问题都当成词句问题。
answer.en: Start with the defect that most affects the intended reading experience. Repair missing motives or conditions before polishing; clarify delivery when events already work. Revisit positioning and outlines only when the story’s direction needs changing. Set facts and scope before sentence editing.

heading.zh: 同一句“读着没劲”，可能要改三种东西
heading.en: One Complaint Can Point to Different Layers

body.zh:
Oh Story 的写作参考将输出检查分为选材、剧情设计与文笔。它不是要求每轮都推翻定位，而是提醒作者：句子改顺，未必解决读者不想继续看的原因。

| 观察 | 先查哪里 |
|---|---|
| 卖点与目标读者一直不清楚 | 定位和核心承诺是否成立 |
| 知道人物在做什么，却不信他会这样做 | 动机、条件、选择与结果 |
| 因果已成立，却读不出发生过程 | 场景交付、信息顺序与句子 |

把“没劲”换成一次具体阅读失败：不知道主人公想要什么？理解目标却看不到阻碍？还是同一动作读了三遍？先定位症状，不凭单个读者的一句话重定整本书的方向。
body.en:
Oh Story’s writing references separate material and audience, plot design, and prose delivery. This does not require overturning a book’s positioning on every pass. It reminds the author that smoother sentences may leave the reason readers disengage untouched.

| Observation | First place to investigate |
|---|---|
| The core promise and intended reader remain unclear | Positioning and the central premise |
| Actions are clear but unconvincing | Motive, conditions, choice and result |
| Cause and effect work but the process is hard to follow | Scene delivery, information order and sentences |

Replace “boring” with a specific reading failure: an unknown goal, no meaningful obstacle, or the same action repeated three times. Locate the symptom before changing an entire book’s direction in response to one comment.

heading.zh: 原创案例：拒绝之后为什么答应？
heading.en: Original Case: Why Agree After Refusing?

body.zh:
已有前提：许韵要借学校礼堂演出，馆务员担心她们排练后留下垃圾。双方先前没有私人交情。

**问题稿**

> “不能借，明早有人用。”馆务员说。许韵笑了笑：“我们真的很需要。”馆务员被她的真诚打动，答应了。

句子并不难懂。问题是馆务员此前担心清理，明早又要有人使用；“真诚”没有解决任何条件。仅把“真诚”换成一个表情，拒绝到同意的台阶仍然缺失。

作者若决定让借用成立，可以先在细纲批准一个方案：许韵提出负责清理、当晚交还，馆务员根据既有权限决定是否接受。若馆务员本来无权批准，就不能仅加保证让他放行。也可以保留拒绝，让许韵另找场地。两条是剧情选择，由作者决定，不是润色的自动结果。
body.en:
Established premise: Xu Yun wants to borrow a school hall for a performance. Its caretaker worries about rubbish after rehearsals. They have no prior personal relationship.

**Problem draft**

> “No. Someone needs it tomorrow morning,” the caretaker said. Xu Yun smiled. “We really need it.” Moved by her sincerity, he agreed.

The sentences are understandable. The missing step concerns cleanup and next-morning availability. Replacing “sincerity” with a facial expression resolves neither condition.

If the author wants permission granted, first approve an outline change: Xu Yun offers cleanup and same-night return, and the caretaker decides within his established authority. A promise cannot grant authority he lacks. Alternatively, retain the refusal and send Xu Yun elsewhere. These are author-selected plot changes, not automatic consequences of polishing.

heading.zh: 选定事实之后，再把场景写清楚
heading.en: Set the Events Before Polishing Their Delivery

body.zh:
假设作者选择“提出清理与交还方案”，并已确认馆务员有权同意，可以这样安排这一轮：

1. **细纲先定条件。** 写明许韵提出什么、馆务员为什么认为条件可接受，以及答应的边界。
2. **场景兑现决定。** 让读者看到提议与回应，不用“被感动”跳过协商；答应借用也不等于演出已成功。
3. **文字再去重复。** 清理反复请求和重复解释，保留实际促成改变的条件。
4. **检查相邻段落。** 后文准备演出可以继续依赖借用，但不能写成获得了整周使用权。

若事实不需要变，只是“我们真的很需要”被重复多次，就可以直接做局部表达修订。层级判断的目的，是找到必要改动，并非强制先改一遍大纲再碰句子。
body.en:
Suppose the author chooses a cleanup-and-return proposal and confirms that the caretaker can approve it. Order this revision as follows:

1. **Set the conditions in the outline.** Specify the offer, why it is acceptable and the limits of permission.
2. **Deliver the decision in the scene.** Show proposal and response rather than skipping negotiation with “moved.” Permission does not mean the performance has succeeded.
3. **Polish repetition afterward.** Cut repeated pleas and explanations while preserving the conditions that change the answer.
4. **Check neighboring passages.** Later preparations can depend on the booking, but cannot treat it as a week’s unrestricted use.

If the events already work and only the plea repeats, a local expression edit is enough. Diagnosis identifies necessary changes; it does not mandate rewriting an outline before touching any sentence.

heading.zh: 用一张修订清单控制这轮工作
heading.en: Keep One Bounded Revision List

body.zh:
下面是人工修订清单，可由作者或审稿结果填写，不是新的 skill 数据格式。

| 项目 | 记录 |
|---|---|
| 首要问题 | 位置、原句和读者影响 |
| 原因 | 定位、事件设计或表达；仍不确定的注明缺证 |
| 本轮决定 | 选定改法、获准范围和不可改事实 |
| 验收 | 改后哪项条件成立，哪些后文仍要检查 |

先处理妨碍理解或破坏主要因果的问题；可选文风意见放后面。文字漂亮不代表剧情成立，剧情成立也不代表每个作者都必须采用同一种文风。

当选定问题解决、事件边界保持、衔接复读没有发现新断裂时，结束这轮。暂未处理的建议留在清单上，别为了“再好一点”循环重写。需要多章事实同步时，再使用[后文修订检查](/oh-story/sync-later-chapters-after-a-revision)。
body.en:
This manual revision list can be filled from author notes or review findings. It is not a new skill data format.

| Item | Record |
|---|---|
| Main problem | Location, quotation and reader effect |
| Cause | Direction, event design or expression; note missing evidence |
| Decision | Chosen repair, authorized scope and protected facts |
| Acceptance | Which condition now works and what later passages need checking |

Address problems blocking understanding or major causality before optional style changes. Attractive prose does not prove sound plot, and sound plot does not require every author to share a style.

End the pass when the selected problem is resolved, event boundaries remain intact and neighboring passages introduce no new break. Keep deferred suggestions on the list rather than rewriting indefinitely. Use [later revision checks](/oh-story/sync-later-chapters-after-a-revision) when changed facts affect multiple chapters.

heading.zh: 把借场地改法写成真正发生的场面
heading.en: Write the Chosen Hall Repair as a Complete Scene

body.zh:
接上文，假设作者选定借用成立，已确认馆务员有权批准今晚的使用，并批准新增以下时间条件：六点进场、七点四十五散场、八点前清理和交还；明早已有另一组使用。下面是原创改后片段，展示先改事件再改表达，不是一次模型运行报告。

> “明早有人用，不能把清理留给他们。”馆务员说。
>
> “我们只借今晚六点到八点，”许韵说，“七点四十五散场。台上和椅子下面都由我们清理，椅子放回标线内。八点前请你检查，再收钥匙。”
>
> 馆务员看过今晚的空档。“只批这一晚。八点要交回来，明天不能再用。”
>
> “好。”许韵记下时间，接过钥匙。
>
> 晚上七点五十五，椅子已摆回标线内。馆务员沿最后一排检查，指出椅脚旁还有一个纸杯。许韵捡起来，放进垃圾袋，连同其他垃圾带到门外的分类桶。馆务员再看了那处，伸手接回钥匙，锁上门。

提议解决的是原来拒绝的条件，馆务员实际同意才取得钥匙。晚上的检查、处理漏杯、交还说明本轮兑现了什么；“演出成功”“以后随时可用”“双方产生私人交情”都不是这个结果。时间表可按真实稿件改，不能靠精确分钟掩盖根本没有清场能力。

| 修订层级 | 这次实际改什么 |
|---|---|
| 事件设计 | 作者选择可借用，明确原有批准权、清理及交还条件；也可另选拒绝路线 |
| 场景交付 | 写出提议、限定同意、取得钥匙与晚上的复查交还 |
| 文字表达 | 合并反复恳求，保留影响答复的条件；不另加感动或私交解释 |
| 后文依赖 | 今晚使用已结束、钥匙已交回；下一次仍需重新申请，不拥有整周场地 |

如果问题稿的后文只写“她终于有场地了”，可保留并明确今晚；若写“周末每晚都能排练”，必须修掉或另建立新的许可。不要先把那句润色得更激动，再忘了它仍依赖一个不存在的使用权。

实际修稿时，先固定作者选定的事实，把候选场面放回前后段落，再按问题复读。案例只证明这次条件与交还，不要求每个借物、求助场景都逐步展开：无关的熟悉流程仍可概述。
body.en:
Continue the refusal example. Suppose the author chooses permission, confirms the caretaker's existing authority, and approves these conditions: enter at six, audience leaves at 7:45, cleanup and return by eight, with another group already booked for the following morning. This original revised passage shows event repair followed by expression work; it is not a model-run report.

> “Someone needs it tomorrow morning. We can't leave the cleanup to them,” the caretaker said.
>
> “Only six to eight tonight,” Xu Yun said. “Everyone leaves by 7:45. We'll clear the stage and beneath the chairs, then put the chairs inside the marked lines. You can inspect before eight and take the key back.”
>
> He checked the free slot. “Tonight only. Return it by eight. This doesn't include tomorrow.”
>
> “Agreed.” Xu noted the times and accepted the key.
>
> At 7:55 the chairs were back inside the lines. Checking the final row, the caretaker pointed to a paper cup by a chair leg. Xu picked it up and took it with the other rubbish to the sorting bins outside. He checked the spot again, took back the key and locked the door.

The offer addresses the reasons for refusal. Actual permission precedes receiving the key. Inspection, removing the missed cup and returning the key establish this limited result, without proving a successful show, unrestricted future access or a personal bond. Adapt times to the manuscript; precise minutes cannot replace a feasible cleanup plan.

| Layer | What this pass changes |
|---|---|
| Event design | The author chooses permission with existing authority, cleanup and return conditions; refusal remains a separate possible route. |
| Scene delivery | Show proposal, limited approval, key receipt, later inspection and return. |
| Expression | Combine repeated pleas while preserving conditions; invent no private friendship or emotional explanation. |
| Later dependencies | Tonight's use has ended and the key is back; another booking needs permission, rather than treating this as a week's access. |

A later “She finally had a venue” can remain when it means tonight. “They could rehearse every night that weekend” needs correction or a genuinely new permission. Polishing its excitement first would leave the nonexistent entitlement intact.

Fix the author's chosen events, place the candidate in neighboring prose and reread against the initial problem. This example checks particular conditions and return; it does not require every borrowing or request scene to dramatize a familiar process in full. Irrelevant steps can still be summarized.

q.zh: 小说修稿一定要先整本审查吗？
q.en: Must every revision begin with a full-book review?

a.zh: 不必。局部问题先读对应片段和必要上下文；只有证据指向更广的结构或连续性问题时才扩大范围。未读到的章节不能算已经审过。
a.en: No. Start with the affected passage and necessary context. Expand when evidence points to broader structural or continuity problems. Unread chapters have not been reviewed.

text.zh: 用 /story-review solo（Codex 用 $story-review solo）先审指定范围，要求定位问题层级并给出原文依据。选定事实修订后走 story-long-write 的章节修订；仅表达问题可用 story-deslop。这个顺序是作者工作安排，不是一个全书自动重写模式。
text.en: Use /story-review solo, or $story-review solo in Codex, to review the specified scope and locate the problem with quotations. Use story-long-write chapter revision for approved event changes and story-deslop for expression. This is an author’s work plan, not an automatic full-book rewrite mode.

title.zh: 小说对白太多怎么办：删重复，保留交流的作用
title.en: Too Much Dialogue in Your Novel? What to Keep

seo_title.zh: 小说对白太多怎么办：删重复，保留交流的作用
seo_title.en: Too Much Dialogue in Your Novel? What to Keep

description.zh: 对白多不等于有问题。检查重复信息、角色目标和交流结果，压缩可略过程，保留关键回应，附乐器借还案例。
description.en: Diagnose repeated information and conversational results rather than counting lines. Preserve key responses with a worked instrument-loan example.

answer.zh: 先看对白是否重复已知信息，是否让读者理解人物目标、回应与关系。压缩无变化的重复确认和流程，把关键提议、拒绝、条件与承诺留下；需要概述的过程可以用叙述带过。别设全书对白比例，也别给每句台词强加动作或冲突。
answer.en: Look for repeated information and whether the exchange conveys goals, responses and relationships. Compress unchanged confirmations and routine process; preserve offers, refusals, conditions and commitments. Use narration for a process that can be summarized, without imposing dialogue percentages or adding action to every line.

heading.zh: 是对白太多，还是交流没有变化？
heading.en: Diagnose the Exchange Before Counting Lines

body.zh:
两个人谈满一页，仍可以有丰富的试探与变化；对白只有几句，也可能一直重复读者知道的事实。先标出每段交流的任务：争取什么、确认什么、隐瞒什么，或如何表现亲近、尴尬与告别。

Oh Story 的写作参考关注对白对剧情、人物与张力的作用，也允许氛围与人物互动。结合文风裁决，这些是修改时的观察方向，不能推成“每句话都必须翻转局面”。日常应答、仪式性重复和喜剧回环可能就是效果。

本页解决的是**交流内容的密度**。谁在说话以及标签怎么写，见[对白提示语](/oh-story/write-natural-dialogue-tags)；没说透的意思如何让对方接住，见[潜台词](/oh-story/write-subtext-in-dialogue)。
body.en:
A page-long conversation can contain rich testing and change. A few lines can still repeat facts readers know. Mark the purpose of each exchange: seeking something, confirming something, withholding something, or expressing closeness, discomfort or farewell.

Oh Story’s references consider dialogue’s contribution to plot, character and tension, while allowing atmosphere and interaction. With author style priorities applied, these are diagnostic directions, not a requirement that every line reverse the situation. Routine answers, ritual repetition and comic returns may be the intended effect.

This guide addresses the density of conversational content. For attribution, see [dialogue tags](/oh-story/write-natural-dialogue-tags); for communicating unstated intentions, see [subtext](/oh-story/write-subtext-in-dialogue).

heading.zh: 把重复确认与关键回应分开
heading.en: Separate Repeated Confirmation From Key Responses

body.zh:
| 看见的情况 | 修改方向 |
|---|---|
| 两人把双方已知的来历重新讲完 | 留触发当前选择的部分，其余删或概述 |
| 同一要求反复出现，回答没有变化 | 压缩重复；有意施压或回环则保留效果 |
| 决定被概述成“谈好了” | 补回已有的关键提议与回应，勿编新条件 |
| 台词很多，却不知道物件交到谁手里 | 保留实际交接动作，区分承诺与完成 |
| 每句话后都新增一个小动作 | 删无功能填充，用必要叙述维持交流 |

压缩对白时，最容易把“我愿意借”写成“已经借到”，或者把“我会还”写成“已归还”。决定和行动要分别核对。概述不等于省掉因果。
body.en:
| Observation | Revision direction |
|---|---|
| Both speakers recap history they both know | Keep what changes the current choice; cut or summarize the rest |
| The same request repeats without a changing answer | Compress, unless pressure or a deliberate refrain is the effect |
| The decision becomes “they sorted it out” | Restore the existing key offer and response without inventing conditions |
| Many lines leave possession unclear | Keep the actual handoff; distinguish promise from completion |
| Every line gains a tiny physical action | Cut filler and use necessary narration to sustain the exchange |

Compression can turn “I’m willing to lend it” into “the loan is complete,” or “I’ll return it” into “it was returned.” Check decisions and actions separately. Summary should preserve cause and effect.

heading.zh: 原创对照：借一把排练用的吉他
heading.en: Original Comparison: Borrowing a Guitar for Rehearsal

body.zh:
前提是杜琳需要吉他排练，许杭还没答应借。原段如下：

> “明天排练，我想借你的吉他。”杜琳说。

> “你明天要排练？”

> “对，明天要用吉他。”

> “所以你想借我的？”

> “是。周五之前还给你。”

> “周五我也要用。”

> “周四晚上还行吗？”

> “行。”许杭从柜子里拿出琴包，递给她。杜琳接过，背在肩上。

中间两轮只复述请求；周五的使用需要、改为周四归还以及实际交接改变了安排。

**压缩版**

> 杜琳说了明天排练借吉他的事，答应周五前归还。许杭摇头：“周五我也要用。”

> “那周四晚上还。”

> “行。”他从柜子里拿出琴包递来，杜琳接过，背在肩上。

这里概述第一项请求，保留改期与接受，最后明确琴包已到杜琳手里。周四归还是承诺，当前片段没有证明它已经兑现。两版为本页原创；若重复问话原本表现听力困难或故意刁难，就应按那个目标重新判断，不能照抄删法。
body.en:
Du Lin needs a guitar for rehearsal; Xu Hang has not yet agreed to lend his. The original passage reads:

> “I’m rehearsing tomorrow. Could I borrow your guitar?” Du Lin asked.

> “You have rehearsal tomorrow?”

> “Yes. I need a guitar tomorrow.”

> “So you want mine?”

> “Yes. I’ll return it before Friday.”

> “I need it on Friday.”

> “Would Thursday evening work?”

> “Yes.” Xu Hang took the guitar case from the cupboard and handed it over. Du Lin accepted it and slung it over her shoulder.

Two exchanges only restate the request. Friday’s need, changing the return to Thursday and the handoff affect the arrangement.

**Compressed version**

> Du Lin asked to borrow the guitar for tomorrow’s rehearsal and promised it back before Friday. Xu Hang shook his head. “I need it on Friday.”

> “Thursday evening, then.”

> “Yes.” He brought the case from the cupboard and handed it over. She accepted it and slung it over her shoulder.

The request is summarized, while renegotiation, acceptance and actual possession remain. Thursday’s return is a promise, not a completed event. These examples are original. Repeated questions serving hearing difficulties or deliberate obstruction would require a different judgment.

heading.zh: 一遍检查：删完交流还成立吗？
heading.en: One Pass: Does the Exchange Still Work?

body.zh:
先留原稿，圈出有意重复，再标请求、回应、变化与交接。只修改这场交流，连读前后段，核对说话人、时间和物件；多人场景不要为了少写标签让读者失去归属。

> 修改〔对白片段〕的交流密度。先说明哪些台词重复了什么；只压缩无功能重复与可略过程，保留〔关键回应、条件、承诺、交接〕。采用〔本书文风〕，不新增冲突、动作或知识来源。返回改稿与保留事实；无法判断的重复列给我决定。

这是人工改稿要求。若需要取消借琴或改成另一天归还，属于事实修订，先决定范围再检查后文。仅减少对白行数不是验收标准。
body.en:
Keep the original, mark intentional repetition, then identify request, response, change and handoff. Revise this exchange only and reread its joins for speakers, time and possession. In a group scene, fewer tags should not make attribution uncertain.

> Revise conversational density in [passage]. Identify repeated content first. Compress only functionless repetition and summarizable process. Preserve [responses, conditions, promises and handoffs]. Use [book style] without adding conflict, actions or knowledge sources. Return the revision and protected facts; flag uncertain repetition for my decision.

This is a manual revision brief. Canceling the loan or changing its return date is a factual revision requiring scope and downstream checks. Fewer dialogue lines alone do not establish success.

q.zh: 对白占多少比例才合适？
q.en: What percentage of a novel should be dialogue?

a.zh: 本页方法不设统一比例。按作品文风、场景任务和读者能否跟上判断；关键交流可以长，重复已知信息的短对白也可删。
a.en: This method sets no universal percentage. Judge by style, scene purpose and readability. A pivotal conversation may be long; a short one repeating known facts may still need cutting.

text.zh: 用 /story-long-write（Codex 用 $story-long-write）做指定场面的局部修订，附上交流目标和不可改事实。明确其他段落不动，参考默认对白规则需服从本书文风；先报告内容问题，再采用你选定的压缩方向。
text.en: Use /story-long-write, or $story-long-write in Codex, for local revision of the named exchange. Supply its purpose and protected facts; preserve other paragraphs and apply dialogue defaults under the book’s style. Choose the compression direction after diagnosis.

label.zh: 对白、节奏与氛围的取舍
作者文风与事实边界
局部修订与衔接检查

title.zh: 小说写得像剧本怎么办：把指令改成叙述
title.en: Fix a Novel That Reads Like a Screenplay

seo_title.zh: 小说写得像剧本怎么办：把指令改成叙述
seo_title.en: Fix a Novel That Reads Like a Screenplay

description.zh: 区分有意的对白风格与漏进正文的镜头、场次指令；按视角、选择和真实动作改写，保留必要概述。
description.en: Distinguish intentional dialogue-heavy style from leaked camera and scene instructions. Restore viewpoint, choices and actual actions.

answer.zh: 先判断剧本感来自作者选定的形式，还是正文只剩场次标签、镜头命令与动作清单。后者应回到本书视角，把已有事件写成人物能感知的选择和结果；规划字段不必逐格成段。关键变化写清过程，可略过场仍可概述，不为补小说感新增内心、细节或剧情。
answer.en: Distinguish chosen form from leaked scene labels, camera commands and action lists. Return to the book’s viewpoint and render existing events as perceivable choices and results. Planning fields need not become matching paragraphs. Show key changes, summarize routine transitions and avoid invented psychology or plot.

heading.zh: 先分清形式选择与未成文的指令
heading.en: Separate Chosen Form From Undrafted Instructions

body.zh:
对白多、动作清楚，不代表小说有问题。有些作者有意使用剧本体或克制叙述；应按作品目标评价。这里处理的是作者要写普通小说，却留下“场景一”“特写”“镜头拉远”“此处制造悬念”等制作指令。

Oh Story 的场景方法指出：细纲规定发生什么，不规定正文的形状。目标、情节点与结尾状态不能原样搬进叙述。“镜头思维”可以帮助选择注意重点，但不要求在小说里给一个不存在的摄影机下命令。

[细纲写成章节](/oh-story/outline-to-chapter)处理从规划到初稿的完整过程；本页用于诊断已经写出的正文里，哪些句子仍是指令或清单。
body.en:
Abundant dialogue and clear action do not prove a defect. Some writers deliberately choose a script form or restrained narration; evaluate that choice against their goals. This guide concerns an intended prose novel retaining “Scene One,” “close-up,” “camera pulls back” or “create suspense here.”

Oh Story’s scene method treats the outline as requirements for events, not the shape of the prose. Goals, plot points and ending states should not be copied as narration. Camera thinking can guide attention without issuing commands to an imaginary camera inside the novel.

[Outline to chapter](/oh-story/outline-to-chapter) covers the full planning-to-draft process. This guide diagnoses sentences in an existing draft that remain instructions or lists.

heading.zh: 改写时补什么，不补什么？
heading.en: What to Restore During Revision

body.zh:
| 原稿表现 | 修订方向 |
|---|---|
| “特写破掉的扣子” | 当前视角如何注意到扣子，已有发现影响什么 |
| “人物A愤怒，人物B心虚” | 按本书视角写可知感受；不替限知人物读心 |
| “发现问题 → 改变主意 → 离开” | 让已确定的发现、选择与离开接上因果 |
| 每个情节点一段，长短完全一致 | 按重要变化安排详略，勿机械逐格填空 |
| “本场结束，两人关系恶化” | 兑现已写的具体变化，不新增吵架或断交 |

缺少事实时，不能靠添一个秘密、一段回忆或新道具填满小说感。先请作者决定缺失过程，再修正文。风格可以允许直接写情绪或叙述者评论；它们不必全部改成身体动作。
body.en:
| Draft pattern | Revision direction |
|---|---|
| “Close-up: broken clasp” | Show how the viewpoint notices it and what the existing discovery changes |
| “A is angry; B feels guilty” | Use accessible feelings under the chosen viewpoint, without unauthorized mind-reading |
| “Find problem → change mind → leave” | Connect established discovery, decision and departure causally |
| One identical paragraph per plot point | Allocate detail by importance rather than filling planning boxes |
| “Scene ends; relationship worsens” | Deliver the established change without inventing a fight or breakup |

A secret, memory or new object cannot fill missing facts merely to make prose feel novelistic. Ask the author to decide missing processes first. Direct emotion and narrator commentary may fit the chosen style; they need not all become physical reactions.

heading.zh: 原创对照：演员试戴旧项链
heading.en: Original Comparison: Trying on an Old Necklace

body.zh:
已定事实：宋芮在排练前试戴旧项链，扣子接不上；阿哲提出用胶带，她拒绝，取下项链放回盒里。采用宋芮限知视角。

**未成文版本**

> 场景：后台。特写项链扣。宋芮试戴，扣不上。阿哲：用胶带？宋芮拒绝。镜头拉远，她摘下项链。结尾状态：放回盒里。

**小说段落**

> 宋芮把项链绕到颈后，扣子却接不上。

> “用胶带？”阿哲问。

> “不用了。”她取下项链，放回盒里。

新版把试戴与扣不上接成一个动作过程，保留建议、拒绝、取下与放回盒里；没有靠新增一次尝试或新道具制造过程。

没有写阿哲心里失望，没有解释项链属于谁，也没有说宋芮因此退出演出。盒中物件的状态清楚，结尾不用再报一次“放回盒里”。这个场景为本页原创，可替换为你已经确定的动作细节。
body.en:
Established facts: before rehearsal, Song Rui tries an old necklace whose clasp will not close. A Zhe suggests tape; she refuses, removes the necklace and returns it to its box. The chosen viewpoint is limited to Song Rui.

**Undrafted version**

> Location: backstage. Close-up on clasp. Song Rui tries it; it will not close. A Zhe: tape? Song Rui refuses. Camera pulls back as she removes it. Ending state: returned to box.

**Prose passage**

> Song Rui brought the necklace ends together behind her neck, but the clasp would not close.

> “Tape?” A Zhe asked.

> “No.” She removed the necklace and put it back in its box.

The revision connects trying on and the failed clasp, preserving the suggestion, refusal, removal and return to the box. It adds neither a second attempt nor a new object to manufacture a process.

The passage supplies no thoughts for A Zhe, ownership history or withdrawal from the performance. Possession is clear, and the ending does not restate its planning label. This original scene can be adapted using actions already established in your manuscript.

heading.zh: 不要把所有过场也扩成一场戏
heading.en: Routine Transitions Can Remain Summary

body.zh:
重点是发现和拒绝的过程，走到后台、整理普通衣物等过场可以简写。把每项概述展开，会换来另一种冗长。小说需要叙述和场景配合，不需要每句都可拍成分镜。

> 诊断〔片段〕的剧本感。区分有意形式与漏入的场次、镜头或规划标签。按〔本书视角与文风〕改写，保留〔既定事件与信息边界〕；关键变化写清，过场可概述。列出需要作者批准的新增动作，未批准的不要加。返回改稿和删除的指令类型。

这是人工局部修订任务。改后连读，检查是否仍能辨认谁发现问题、凭什么知道、怎样选择、结果如何；同时确认没有新增外部视角、动作权限或秘密解释。
body.en:
The discovery and refusal deserve attention. Arrival backstage and routine preparation can remain concise. Expanding every summary produces a different form of excess. A novel combines narration and scenes; every sentence need not become a storyboard shot.

> Diagnose script-like passages in [excerpt]. Distinguish intentional form from leaked scene, camera or planning labels. Revise under [viewpoint and style], preserving [events and information boundaries]. Clarify key changes and summarize routine transitions. List proposed new actions for author approval; do not add unapproved ones. Return the prose and instruction types removed.

This is a manual local revision brief. Reread for who discovers the problem, how they know, what they choose and what results. Check that no unauthorized viewpoint, action or secret explanation has appeared.

q.zh: 小说是不是不能出现“镜头”这个词？
q.en: Must the word “camera” be removed from a novel?

a.zh: 不必。角色在拍摄、叙述者有意采用影像比喻时都可使用。需要修的是作者不想要的制作指令泄漏，以及只报状态却缺少过程的正文。
a.en: No. Characters may be filming, and a narrator may intentionally use visual metaphors. Repair unwanted production instructions and missing processes, rather than banning a word.

text.zh: 用 /story-long-write（Codex 用 $story-long-write）修指定片段，说明本次是局部修订、采用的视角和是否允许展开已有事件。writing-craft 的“把规格演成场景”提供方法，本书文风优先；它不是剧本自动转小说的专用模式。
text.en: Use /story-long-write, or $story-long-write in Codex, for local revision with viewpoint and explicit permission to develop events. The writing-craft scene method supplies the approach under the book’s style. This is not a dedicated screenplay-to-novel mode.

label.zh: 细纲规格如何写成场景
对白、节奏与氛围的取舍
作者文风与事实边界
局部修订与衔接检查

title.zh: 小说时间线怎么整理：事件先后与揭示顺序
title.en: Organize Your Novel’s Timeline and Reveals

seo_title.zh: 小说时间线怎么整理：事件先后与揭示顺序
seo_title.en: Organize Your Novel’s Timeline and Reveals

description.zh: 把故事实际先后、正文呈现和读者已知分开记录；用相对时间避免乱补日期，附错放包裹的倒叙案例。
description.en: Separate event chronology, manuscript order and reader knowledge. Use relative time and a worked flashback example without inventing dates.

answer.zh: 先按故事内的实际顺序记录事件，再注明它在哪章出现、当时读者知道什么。倒叙与延迟揭示不改变事件发生时间；未来揭示计划留在大纲。原稿只有“前两天”就用相对时间，未知处标待定。修订后检查依赖时间、知情与物件状态的后文。
answer.en: Record events in story order, then note their chapter appearances and what readers know. Flashbacks and delayed revelations do not change when events occurred. Keep future reveal plans in the outline; use relative time when dates are unspecified. After revision, check later timing, knowledge and possession dependencies.

heading.zh: 先分开三种“先后”
heading.en: Separate Three Kinds of Order

body.zh:
| 顺序 | 回答什么 |
|---|---|
| 故事发生 | 哪件事先发生，间隔多久 |
| 正文呈现 | 作者先写哪场戏，哪里倒叙或概述 |
| 读者获知 | 哪章知道哪部分事实，哪些仍未知 |

第八章回忆上周的交接，交接不会因此发生在第八章的“现在”；第二章只看到空架，也不代表读者已经知道谁移动了包裹。

Oh Story 的追踪方法区分客观事件、读者认知与实际揭示章节，并要求未来计划留在大纲。下面的表是作者的人工工作表，不是直接提交给工具的字段格式。[设定集整理](/oh-story/story-bible-template)用于整本资料管理，本页专门处理时间与揭示顺序。
body.en:
| Order | Question |
|---|---|
| Story chronology | What happened first, and how much time passed? |
| Manuscript presentation | Which scene appears first, including flashbacks and summaries? |
| Reader knowledge | Which facts are known in which chapter, and what remains unknown? |

A handoff recalled in Chapter Eight still happened last week. An empty shelf shown in Chapter Two does not identify who moved the parcel.

Oh Story’s tracking method separates objective events, reader knowledge and actual revelation chapters, keeping future plans in the outline. The table below is a manual worksheet, not a tool input schema. [Story-bible organization](/oh-story/story-bible-template) covers book-wide materials; this page focuses on chronology and reveals.

heading.zh: 时间不够精确时，别补一个日期
heading.en: Do Not Invent Dates to Complete the Table

body.zh:
先收集原文明确时间词、事件条件和顺序。例如“停雨后”“交接两天前”“当晚”可以保持相对形式。未说明年月日就不猜一个日期；矛盾的时间写成待裁决，不偷偷选一个。

每件重要事件记录实际发生、依据位置、呈现位置和当前读者认知。需要跨度时，再检查最少必须经过多久与稿件实际给出多久；旅行、治疗等外部事实需另行查证，不能用作者时间表证明现实可行。

未发生的计划不要混入已完成事件。角色也有自己的知情范围：作者和读者知道包裹被移动，不代表收件人已得到这个消息。
body.en:
Collect explicit time phrases, prerequisites and ordering. “After the rain,” “two days before the handoff” and “that evening” can remain relative. Do not invent a calendar date where none is specified. Record conflicting times for a decision instead of silently choosing one.

For important events, note occurrence, evidence location, presentation location and current reader knowledge. When duration matters, compare the required interval with the time the draft actually supplies. External facts such as travel or recovery require separate verification; an author’s timetable cannot prove real-world feasibility.

Keep unperformed plans separate from completed events. Characters also have their own knowledge boundaries: the author and reader knowing a parcel moved does not mean its recipient knows.

heading.zh: 原创案例：先见空架，后见搬走过程
heading.en: Original Case: The Empty Shelf Before the Move Is Revealed

body.zh:
假设稿件已经写到第八章：周五傍晚，秦泊将许简的包裹从门外架子移到室内储物柜，以避雨；许简不在。周六早上许简看到空架，以为包裹没送到。第八章倒叙周五，读者才看到秦泊移动它。柜门随后仍关着，秦泊尚未告诉许简。

这套完整前提为本页原创，表格只记录已经写出的版本：

| 事件 | 时间与读者获知 |
|---|---|
| 秦泊搬走包裹 | 周五傍晚；第八章倒叙才展示搬入室内柜的过程 |
| 许简看到空架 | 周六早上；第二章展示，她判断“没送到”，读者尚不知原因 |
| 许简得知真实去向 | 截至第八章未发生；不填写一个未来章节当实际揭示 |

**当前状态**：读者知道包裹在室内柜里，许简仍以为没送到。秦泊知道自己的搬移动作。第二章的判断是人物误认，不是“作者写错投递结果”。

第十章让秦泊解释去向可以是大纲计划；只有实际写出告知，才能更新许简已知与读者新增信息。这个示例不保证倒叙有效，效果还需从悬念与阅读目标判断。
body.en:
Suppose the manuscript reaches Chapter Eight. On Friday evening, Qin Bo moves Xu Jian’s parcel from an outdoor shelf into an indoor cupboard to protect it from rain; Xu Jian is absent. Saturday morning, Xu Jian sees the empty shelf and assumes no delivery. Chapter Eight flashes back to Friday, showing the move for the first time. The cupboard remains shut, and Qin Bo has not told Xu Jian.

This complete premise is original to the guide. The worksheet records the written version:

| Event | Time and revelation |
|---|---|
| Qin Bo moves the parcel | Friday evening; Chapter Eight’s flashback first shows the move indoors |
| Xu Jian sees the empty shelf | Saturday morning; Chapter Two shows her mistaken conclusion before readers know the cause |
| Xu Jian learns its location | Not yet written by Chapter Eight; no planned future chapter counts as an actual reveal |

**Current state:** readers know the parcel is in the cupboard; Xu Jian still assumes it was not delivered. Qin Bo knows his own action. Chapter Two contains a character’s mistaken belief, not an erroneous authorial delivery record.

Qin Bo explaining in Chapter Ten can remain an outline plan. Update Xu Jian’s knowledge only when the explanation is written. This example does not prove the flashback is effective; judge it against suspense and reading goals.

heading.zh: 移动一场戏后，按实际版本更新
heading.en: Update the Written Version After Moving a Scene

body.zh:
把第八章倒叙提前到第三章，会改变读者获知时间，但不会自动改变周五的搬移动作或许简的知情。若删除搬移动作，则室内柜里的包裹和后续解释都失去依据。先判断改变的是事件还是呈现，再查后文。

> 整理〔已写章节范围〕的时间线。给出事件实际先后、原文位置、正文呈现章节、读者已知与角色知情。保持原文时间精度，缺失标待定；把误认与客观事实分开，未来揭示计划另列。只整理与指出候选冲突，不改写正文或文件。

这个提示词适合人工整理。使用 Oh Story 正式项目时，时间线视图由结构化状态生成，不直接手改作者真相或读者已知文件；已批准修订通过章节修订流程更新截至最后已写章的当前状态。表格写好了，不代表现存正文的时间矛盾已经修复。
body.en:
Moving Chapter Eight’s flashback to Chapter Three changes when readers learn the move. It does not automatically change Friday’s event or Xu Jian’s knowledge. Deleting the move removes support for the cupboard’s parcel and later explanations. Distinguish event changes from presentation changes before checking later dependencies.

> Organize the timeline for [written scope]. Give event chronology, quotation locations, presentation chapters, reader knowledge and character knowledge. Preserve the source’s time precision; mark unknowns. Separate mistaken beliefs from objective facts and future reveal plans. Report candidate conflicts without editing prose or files.

This prompt supports manual organization. In a formal Oh Story project, timeline views are generated from structured state; do not directly edit the author-truth or reader-knowledge views. Approved chapter revision updates current state through the last written chapter. A completed table does not itself repair contradictory prose.

q.zh: 时间线整理后，还能倒叙或隐藏真相吗？
q.en: Can I still use flashbacks and hidden truths after organizing a timeline?

a.zh: 可以。整理用于区分实际发生、呈现顺序与知情范围，不强迫顺叙。检查读者能否理解已给出的线索，以及角色的判断是否符合当时所知。
a.en: Yes. Organization separates occurrence, presentation and knowledge without enforcing chronological narration. Check that clues are understandable and character judgments fit what they know at the time.

text.zh: 人工只读整理可用上方提示词。若用 /story-long-write（Codex 用 $story-long-write）修订章节，按 workflow-revision 与 tracking-transaction 更新事件、实际揭示和当前知情；不要把本页工作表当作正式事务输入，也不要为整理时间线自动重写小说。
text.en: Use the prompt above for a manual read-only worksheet. For chapter revision with /story-long-write or $story-long-write in Codex, workflow-revision and tracking-transaction update events, actual reveals and current knowledge. This worksheet is not formal transaction input, and organization does not authorize rewriting.

title.zh: 游戏数值怎么平衡：比较策略，不先套比例
title.en: Balance Game Numbers by Comparing Strategies

seo_title.zh: 游戏数值怎么平衡：比较策略，不先套比例
seo_title.en: Balance Game Numbers by Comparing Strategies

description.zh: 先写清什么现象表示取舍失效，再用同一初态比较策略，并换局面复查。附维修行动的完整成本与期限演算。
description.en: Define what breaks a tradeoff, compare strategies from the same start, then change the situation. Includes repair costs and deadline calculations.

answer.zh: 先定义数值对应的行动、目标和可见反馈，再声明哪种现象会推翻设计：一个策略通吃、路线不可达或不同选择始终同结果。用一致初态比较策略，并在另一真实局面重算；数字调整后核对实现规则。演算能发现漏洞，玩家是否觉得公平仍需试玩。
answer.en: Define actions, goals and visible feedback, then state what would invalidate the design: a dominant strategy, unreachable route or identical outcomes. Compare from consistent starts and recalculate in another relevant situation. Check implementation after changes. Calculations expose defects; fairness still needs playtesting.

heading.zh: 先说清“平衡”在本项目指什么
heading.en: Define Balance for This Project

body.zh:
“两个技能差不多强”无法验收。先写你希望玩家作什么判断，以及什么现象表示判断消失。例如，紧急场面应考虑时间，长期行动应考虑资源；若同一动作在所有已列局面中既省时又省资源，取舍可能没有成立。

NovelToGame 的数值方法要求项目自己声明有效差距与失败现象，不提供通用倍率、胜率或回合数。本页讨论**策略在不同局面中的作用**；单条路线能否支付返程和最终成本，先看[资源消耗](/novel-to-game/resource-cost-design)。

| 要定的事 | 记录 |
|---|---|
| 玩家目标 | 要完成什么，哪项结果算有效 |
| 行动规则 | 前置、成本、时点与实际效果 |
| 可见依据 | 玩家选择前能知道什么 |
| 否决现象 | 哪种结果会证明设计承诺没兑现 |
body.en:
“Both abilities should be equally strong” is not a testable goal. State the judgment players should make and the observation that would remove it. Urgency may prioritize time; sustained activity may prioritize resources. If the same action saves both in every listed situation, the intended tradeoff may be absent.

NovelToGame asks each project to define meaningful differences and failure observations, without universal multipliers, win rates or turn counts. This page compares strategies across situations. For paying return and final costs on one route, see [resource costs](/novel-to-game/resource-cost-design).

| Decision | Record |
|---|---|
| Goal | What must be completed and what counts as a result |
| Action rule | Preconditions, costs, timing and committed effects |
| Visible basis | What players know before acting |
| Falsifier | What would show the promise has failed |

heading.zh: 原创规则：同样修一处，花时间还是电量
heading.en: Original Rules: Spend Time or Energy on a Repair

body.zh:
下面是纸面游戏设计，不是实测平衡结论。维修员每次修好一处故障，所有故障相同且不需赶路；没有充电、随机失误或额外奖励。

- 快修：消耗3电量与1回合，修好一处。
- 细修：消耗1电量与2回合，修好一处。
- 每次行动开始前，检查电量足够且完成时不超过期限；不满足就拒绝，不扣资源、不推进回合。
- 当前故障全部修好即完成；界面提前显示剩余电量、剩余回合与两种成本。

**局面A**：2处故障、6电量、2回合期限。两次快修共耗6电量和2回合，可以完成；两次细修需要4回合，不能在期限内完成。混用也需要3回合。

**局面B**：3处故障、6电量、5回合期限。三次快修要9电量；三次细修要6回合。一次快修加两次细修共耗5电量与5回合，可以完成。次序可换，没有额外次序奖励。

两局面目标都是完成维修，判断却不同：A要求节省回合；B需要组合行动。数字为这个虚构小关卡定义，不能照抄成其他游戏的比例。
body.en:
This is a paper design, not a measured balance result. Each repair fixes one identical fault; there is no travel, charging, random failure or extra reward.

- Quick repair costs 3 energy and 1 turn, fixing one fault.
- Careful repair costs 1 energy and 2 turns, fixing one fault.
- Before acting, require sufficient energy and completion within the deadline. Reject invalid actions without spending energy or advancing time.
- Fixing every fault completes the task. Remaining energy, turns and both costs are visible before choice.

**Situation A:** 2 faults, 6 energy and a 2-turn deadline. Two quick repairs cost 6 energy and 2 turns, completing the task. Two careful repairs need 4 turns; a mixed pair needs 3. Neither fits.

**Situation B:** 3 faults, 6 energy and a 5-turn deadline. Three quick repairs need 9 energy; three careful repairs need 6 turns. One quick plus two careful repairs costs 5 energy and 5 turns, completing the task. Order is interchangeable with no bonus.

Both situations require completed repairs, while A rewards turn economy and B requires combining actions. These values belong to this fictional level, not a universal ratio.

heading.zh: 沿同一初态记余额与拒绝原因
heading.en: Track Balances and Rejections From the Same Start

body.zh:
在局面B试走：细修后剩5电量、已用2回合；再细修后剩4电量、已用4回合，已修2处。此时再细修会到第6回合，规则拒绝；换快修则剩1电量、已用5回合，完成第三处。

如果界面只灰掉细修，却不说明期限，玩家无法知道为何不能行动；如果点击后先扣电再拒绝，实际规则已经不同。比较时记录的必须是最终提交结果，不只是AI说“你修好了”。

调数后重新走原路径。若快修降为1电量，且仍只占1回合，在这些局面中它比细修更省时、同样省电，细修不再有对应优势。可以恢复差异、改变体验承诺或删去多余动作；不要为了保住按钮临时加一个无关系统。
body.en:
Walk Situation B: a careful repair leaves 5 energy after 2 turns. Another leaves 4 energy after 4 turns, with 2 faults fixed. A third careful repair would finish on turn 6 and is rejected. A quick repair instead leaves 1 energy after 5 turns and fixes the final fault.

A disabled button without the deadline reason conceals the basis for choice. Spending energy before rejecting would implement a different rule. Compare committed results rather than an AI’s statement that the repair succeeded.

After changing values, replay the same path. If quick repair costs 1 energy and still 1 turn, it becomes faster at equal cost in these situations; careful repair loses its advantage. Restore the difference, revise the promise or remove the redundant action without adding an unrelated system merely to preserve a button.

heading.zh: 给AI比较条件，给玩家验证体验
heading.en: Separate Rule Comparison From Player Experience

body.zh:
下面是人工设计任务模板：

> 按〔规则版本、初态与目标〕比较〔策略〕，逐步记录资源、时间、已完成事项、行动资格与反馈。先检验〔设计声明的否决现象〕，再换到〔另一局面〕重算。只改定位到的数值或规则；注明改变哪些路径，不引入新系统，不把演算当作试玩结论。

实现后重放原问题路径和一条相邻路径，核对按钮、结算、失败提示是否消费同一组规则。随机机制会影响结果时才控制随机条件；确定设计不必硬加随机种子。

真实玩家是否读懂成本、是否觉得选择有重量、长期资源流是否合理，需要构建后的观察。有限局面没有出现通吃策略，只能支持这些局面中的结论。
body.en:
Use this manual design brief:

> Compare [strategies] under [rule version, starting state and goal]. Track resources, time, completed work, eligibility and feedback at every step. Test [declared failure observation], then recalculate in [another situation]. Change only located values or rules, identify affected paths and add no new system. Do not present calculations as playtest conclusions.

After implementation, replay the faulty path and an adjacent path, checking buttons, settlement and failure feedback against the same rules. Control randomness when it affects results; a deterministic design need not acquire a random seed.

Player comprehension, choice weight and long-term resource flow require observation in a build. Finding no dominant strategy in limited situations supports only those situations.

q.zh: 是不是把所有选项收益调成一样就平衡了？
q.en: Does equalizing all rewards create balance?

a.zh: 未必。选择可能比较时间、资源、信息或机会，收益不同也能有取舍；收益一样却行动与后果完全一致，就可能只剩重复按钮。按项目目标比较实际路径。
a.en: Not necessarily. Choices can trade time, resources, knowledge or opportunity. Unequal rewards can support decisions, while equal outcomes may leave duplicate buttons. Compare actual paths against project goals.

text.zh: 在已有 SOURCE_BIBLE.md、选定 CONCEPT.md 与 PRODUCT_BRIEF.md 的项目里，用 /game-world-design（Codex 用 $game-world-design），附规则与比较局面。numeric-design-method 提供预算和证伪方法；先交付设计，实际构建与试玩另行验证。
text.en: In a project with SOURCE_BIBLE.md, a chosen CONCEPT.md and PRODUCT_BRIEF.md, use /game-world-design or $game-world-design in Codex with the rules and situations. numeric-design-method supplies budget and falsification methods. Deliver design before separately validating the build and player experience.
