title.en: How to Write Mutual Pining Without Stalling the Romance
title.zh: 如何写出不断推进的双向暗恋

seo_title.en: Write a Mutual-Pining Romance
seo_title.zh: 写好双向暗恋

description.zh: 让读者看见双方好感，同时写清两人各自知道什么、为何还没说。附原创双视角、约会回应、实际相处与拖延修订。
description.en: Show attraction on both sides while tracking what each person knows. Includes original viewpoints, a date invitation, actual contact, and pacing repairs.

answer.zh: 双向暗恋的关键是两人都喜欢，却还没有把心意说清；读者可以知道双方心意，人物未必知道。写清各自不说的原因，以及相处怎样增加理解。张力可以来自一个邀请被误读，而不是反复电话打断；安静陪伴也有价值，真正承诺推进的节点要给出行动和回答。
answer.en: Mutual pining means both people are attracted before their wishes are clear to each other. Readers may know both feelings while the characters do not. Establish each reason for hesitation and how company builds understanding. A misread invitation can create tension without repeated interrupting calls. Quiet companionship has value; promised turning points need actions and replies.

heading.zh: 先分清读者知道和人物知道
heading.en: Separate Reader Knowledge from Character Knowledge

body.zh:
人物关系方法里的双进度适合这里：两人表面仍是普通熟人，实际已有好感。再分别记录双方知道多少。作者说“两人都爱”，不足以替代人物自己经历的吸引；一个笑容也不足以证明对方愿意恋爱。

采用分节双视角时，每节只写当前视角能知道的内容。采用单视角时，可以先保留另一人的未知，后面再由其表达或实际行为揭示；不为方便安排“她早就看懂了”而补不存在的经历。

| 记录 | 本例填写 |
|---|---|
| 陆原的私心 | 想单独听许棠聊旧戏，也想邀请她看戏 |
| 许棠的私心 | 活动之外仍想见陆原，不想只有组织者身份 |
| 两人互知 | 都愿参加读书活动；尚未说明约会意愿 |
| 犹豫原因 | 他怕把活动感谢误读成好感，她怕被当成统一招呼 |

这是关系、情绪与信息边界方法的编辑组合，不设每章必须误会、吃醋或提高风险的配额。各自的工作与兴趣仍可以正常发展。
body.en:
Dual relationship progress fits this situation: outwardly ordinary acquaintances, inwardly attracted. Also record how much each knows. “They both love each other” cannot replace experienced attraction; one smile cannot establish willingness to date.

With alternating viewpoint sections, each reports only that person’s knowledge. In a single viewpoint, keep the other’s feelings uncertain until expression or actions reveal them. Do not invent an earlier observation merely to claim the protagonist already understood.

| Record | This example |
|---|---|
| Lu Yuan’s private wish | Hear Xu Tang discuss old theater and invite her to a performance |
| Xu Tang’s private wish | See him outside activities rather than only as an organizer |
| Mutual knowledge | Both enjoy the reading group; romantic wishes remain unstated |
| Hesitation | He may misread gratitude; she may be offering only a group invitation |

This is an editorial combination of relationship, emotion, and information-boundary methods. It imposes no quota of misunderstanding, jealousy, or increasing risk per chapter. Their work and interests can continue normally.

heading.zh: 原创例子：同一份节目单，两种理解
heading.en: Original Example: One Program, Two Readings

body.zh:
许棠与陆原都是成年社区读书组成员；她轮值组织，他负责本月借还书箱。两人分别有陶艺工作与公交驾驶工作，已经连续三次活动聊过旧戏，也都愿意继续交谈。

**前一节，陆原视角。**他喜欢许棠讲戏时不急着下结论的样子，想约她看周日的演出。上次她发来活动后喝茶的邀请，他接到临时换夜班通知，回复“周六得上夜班，去不了”。他想再问周日，却怕她原先只是邀请所有组员，最后只发了工作排班解释。读者看见他的私心；许棠只收到取消与原因，没有收到新的邀请。

**下一节，许棠视角。**演出节目单从书箱里滑出来，陆原伸手扶住。她记得他的取消，知道是工作安排，却仍拿不准他会不会愿意单独见自己。

> “你也看这个？”她问。
>
> “想去。周日不用值班。”
>
> 许棠把节目单翻正。“我也想去。上次喝茶，是想单独请你。没有给全组发。”
>
> 陆原没立刻接纸。“我以为是活动后的招呼。换班是真的，不是不想去。”
>
> “那这次我说清。”她停了一下，“我喜欢跟你相处，想约你看戏。你愿意吗？”
>
> “愿意。我也喜欢你，想约你很久了。”
>
> “很久是多久？”
>
> “第二次你跟我争那个人物为什么回来以后。”
>
> 她笑了。“那次我可没让着你。”
>
> “知道。周日还可以接着争。”

两人随后各买自己的票，约好在剧场门口见；周日实际赴约。演出结束后，他们聊那场争执，也聊陆原的轮班与许棠周末教课，两人都表示愿意开始交往。对话回答了邀请，实际相处兑现了期待；排班仍是下一次约会要讨论的事，没有因为确认关系就自动消失。
body.en:
Xu Tang and Lu Yuan are adult community reading-group members. She takes a turn organizing; he handles this month’s borrowed book box. She works in ceramics and he drives buses. They have discussed old theater at three meetings and both want more conversation.

**Earlier section, Lu’s viewpoint.** He likes how she discusses theater without rushing to conclusions and wants to ask her to Sunday’s performance. When she invited him for tea after a meeting, an unexpected night-shift change made him reply, “I have a night shift Saturday; I can’t come.” He considered suggesting Sunday, but worried she had invited every member. He sent only the schedule explanation. Readers see his wish; Xu receives the cancellation and reason, without a new invitation.

**Next section, Xu’s viewpoint.** A performance program slips from the book box and Lu catches it. She remembers the cancellation and knows it was work, yet still does not know whether he wants to meet her alone.

> “You watch this too?” she asked.
>
> “I’d like to. I’m off Sunday.”
>
> Xu turned the program upright. “So would I. Last time, I wanted tea with you alone. I didn’t invite the whole group.”
>
> Lu did not immediately take the paper. “I thought it was a post-meeting invitation. The shift change was real. I wasn’t avoiding you.”
>
> “Then I’ll be clear this time.” She paused. “I like spending time with you. I’d like a date at the performance. Would you?”
>
> “Yes. I like you too. I’ve wanted to ask for a while.”
>
> “How long?”
>
> “Since you argued with me about why that character returned.”
>
> She laughed. “I didn’t go easy on you.”
>
> “I know. We can keep arguing Sunday.”

They buy their own tickets, arrange to meet outside the theater, and actually attend on Sunday. Afterward they discuss the old argument, his shifts, and her weekend classes. Both say they want to begin dating. The reply answers the invitation and actual company fulfills it. Scheduling remains something to discuss for the next date rather than disappearing with relationship confirmation.

heading.zh: 为何这次说清，之前却没有
heading.en: Why They Speak Now

body.zh:
取消邀请不自动等于拒绝，也不自动保证有好感。旧回复已经说明排班，许棠的不确定在于“我只是组织者，还是他愿意见的人”。她有新机会说明当时邀请的范围，陆原也给出自己的私人意愿，因此这次信息真的增加了。

不要让主角明知对方已经明确示爱，还为了凑章节反复误读。同样，不需要把每次未告白都升级成更大的代价。本例之前的三次讨论可以写默契、不同意见与快乐；关键转折才需要检查这次说了什么、另一人怎样理解和回答。

对白方法里的情绪承接用于这里：他回应她担心“只是统一招呼”，她承接他的工作理由，再共同说明心意。直说与潜台词都可用，按人物习惯选，不必强行让每句有暗号。
body.en:
A canceled invitation is neither automatic rejection nor guaranteed attraction. The earlier reply already explains work. Xu’s uncertainty concerns whether she is merely an organizer or someone he wants to see. She can now clarify the original invitation’s scope; he states his private wish. Information actually changes.

Do not repeatedly misread explicit declarations simply to fill chapters. Every delayed confession need not acquire a larger cost. Earlier discussions can contain rapport, disagreement, and enjoyment. At the turning point, check what was said, understood, and answered.

Dialogue’s emotional response applies here: he addresses the group-invitation uncertainty, she acknowledges the work reason, and both clarify feelings. Direct statements and subtext are available according to character voice; every line needs no secret code.

heading.zh: 双向暗恋拖沓时怎样改
heading.en: Repair Stalled Mutual Pining

body.zh:
先找重复：是不是连续几场都“想说、被打断、又当没发生”？可以合并一次偶然打断，把余下场景用于实际相处，或让人物决定主动询问。若需要继续犹豫，理由要是本书仍然存在的问题，不是同一个误读已经解释却重新出现。

再查好感证据：读者有没有看见双方各自喜欢什么、为什么愿意靠近，而不只有旁人起哄。最后查确认状态：买票只是约定，赴约才是实际见面；一次见面未必自动成为情侣，本例由双方明确选择交往。作者也可以选开放结局，只需兑现所承诺的理解与关系状态。

双向暗恋与慢热可以重合，但重点不同：这里双方好感已经存在，难点是心意尚未互相知道；慢热还可写好感如何逐渐形成。单恋则不能预填另一方也喜欢。
body.en:
Find repetition first: several scenes of almost speaking, interruption, and pretending nothing happened can be merged. Use remaining scenes for actual company or a decision to ask. Continued hesitation needs a problem still present in this book, rather than a misunderstanding already resolved and artificially revived.

Then check attraction: readers should see what each likes and why each approaches, not only bystander teasing. Finally check relationship status. Tickets establish an arrangement; attendance establishes meeting. One meeting need not create a couple. This example makes dating a mutual choice. An open ending can also fulfill the promised understanding and relationship state.

Mutual pining and slow burn can overlap. Here attraction already exists but remains unshared; slow burn can also describe attraction gradually forming. Unrequited love cannot assume the other person reciprocates.

q.zh: 双向暗恋必须交替两人视角吗？
q.en: Does mutual pining require alternating viewpoints?

a.zh: 不必。单视角可以保留另一方未知，后来通过表达揭示；双视角则要分节标清，并保留人物互相不知道的内容。读者知情不等于角色知情。
a.en: No. A single viewpoint can retain uncertainty until later expression. With two viewpoints, mark the sections and preserve what the characters do not know about each other. Reader knowledge is not character knowledge.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 审阅双向暗恋，附各自好感、表面关系、当前知情、犹豫理由与选定结局。区分读者知道和人物知道，查取消、解释、邀请、回应及实际相处。保留安静陪伴与作者文风，不给每章追加风险或升级配额；只改指定范围。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to review mutual pining with each person’s attraction, public relationship, knowledge, hesitation, and chosen ending. Separate reader and character knowledge; check cancellation, explanation, invitation, reply, and actual company. Preserve quiet companionship and voice without per-chapter risk or escalation quotas. Revise only the named scope.

title.zh: 时间循环小说怎么写不重复：让重来改变选择与理解
title.en: How to Write a Time-Loop Novel Without Repeating the Same Scene

seo_title.en: Write a Time-Loop Novel
seo_title.zh: 时间循环小说怎么写

description.zh: 先定重置时刻、记忆和物件能否保留，再让每轮行动产生不同理解。附原创钟塔四轮对照、完整片段与退出条件检查。
description.en: Define reset timing, retained memory, and object states. Includes four original clock-tower loops, a complete scene, and checks for an earned ending.

answer.zh: 时间循环的新鲜感来自人物带着上轮所知，重新选择这一轮怎样做，而非每天再念一次同样对白。先固定什么重置、什么保留、谁知道循环，再设计每轮要查清或完成的事。重复动作可以概述，改变判断与关系的场面展开；退出条件要提前建立，并由实际结果验证，不靠结尾临时增加能力。
answer.en: A time loop stays fresh when a character uses knowledge from earlier rounds to choose differently now, rather than replaying identical dialogue. Fix what resets, what persists, and who knows; then design what each round investigates or accomplishes. Summarize repeated actions and expand changed judgment or relationships. Establish an exit condition beforehand and verify it through results rather than a last-minute power.

heading.zh: 先固定重置规则，分开记忆与当前事实
heading.en: Fix the Reset Rules: Memory Is Not Current State

body.zh:
都市脑洞方法要求新规则进入可验证的现实场面；连续性方法追踪线索的实际推进与结果；悬念方法按提出问题、提示和答案安排信息。本篇把它们用于循环故事，以下重置表是作者编辑表，不是来源里已有的时间循环专用公式。

| 规则 | 原创钟塔例 |
|---|---|
| 重置时刻与范围 | 午夜条件失败，小镇回到同一天06:00 |
| 保留项 | 新任调钟员顾遥保留记忆；身体回到早晨状态 |
| 重置项 | 工具、纸张、钟的故障、他人记忆都回到早晨 |
| 退出条件 | 午夜钟声完整响满十二声，才进入次日 |
| 信息来源 | 钟塔旧值班日志写明现象；首轮十一声后重置，证实其中一部分 |

日志是提前出现的设定线索，不等于顾遥从开头就验证了一切。他记得上轮照片，不能把那张照片当本轮已经拍好的物件；他记得同伴答应，也不能让重置后的同伴直接承认那个约定。
body.en:
Urban-premise craft puts a new rule into testable situations; continuity craft tracks actual progress and results; suspense craft arranges questions, hints, and answers. This article applies them to looping. The following is an editorial worksheet rather than a time-loop formula already present in the sources.

| Rule | Original clock-tower example |
|---|---|
| Reset time and scope | If the midnight condition fails, the town returns to 06:00 on the same day |
| Retained state | New clock attendant Gu Yao retains memory; his body returns to morning state |
| Reset state | Tools, papers, clock faults, and everyone else’s memories return to morning |
| Exit condition | A complete twelve-stroke midnight chime permits the next day |
| Source | An old duty log states the phenomenon; the first eleven-stroke reset verifies part of it |

The early log is a setting clue, not proof that Gu has verified everything. Remembering a photograph does not produce that photograph in this round. Remembering a colleague’s agreement does not make the reset colleague remember it.

heading.zh: 四轮对照：改变策略，不只增加灾难
heading.en: Four Rounds: Different Strategies, Not Just More Disasters

body.zh:
原设定：旧戏院当晚封闭搬迁，钟塔检修只开放到17:00。日志在早晨值班室可读。顾遥会调钟，卡杆检查则需要另一位熟悉这套装置的当日值班员何雪配合；她下午14:00要离镇。故障不因他记住位置就自动消失。

| 轮次 | 已知、行动与实际结果 |
|---|---|
| 第一轮 | 16:00才检查钟，发现末击卡住；何雪已离开。午夜响十一声后回到06:00。 |
| 第二轮 | 上午提前准备，却想独自完成，发现自己无法同时调钟与检查卡杆；没有修成，再重置。 |
| 第三轮 | 中午请求何雪相信“昨天已经查过”，却没有本轮检查材料；她不愿照未知判断操作。等他补查后，她已到离镇时间。 |
| 第四轮 | 09:00重新拍当前故障，让何雪现场核对；两人按已有办法处理，午间试鸣完整，午夜再实际听到十二声。 |

每轮都有同一故障与时刻限制，变化在顾遥怎样使用记忆、取得当下证据和请求合作。何雪拒绝未知操作有自己的理由，并非为了逼主角再失败。第四轮不需要突然找到新高手或让工具穿越。

四轮只是本例的分量。其他故事可以两轮完成一个单元，也可以让一轮主要用于休息、熟悉环境或情感体验；不强制每次重来新增死亡、损失或更强对手。
body.en:
Established setup: the old cinema closes for relocation that evening; tower maintenance is accessible until 17:00. The log is available in the morning duty room. Gu can adjust the clock, but checking the catch needs the other on-duty attendant familiar with this mechanism, He Xue, who leaves town at 14:00. Remembering the fault does not repair it.

| Round | Record |
|---|---|
| One | Inspection starts at 16:00; the final stroke catches, and Xue has left. Eleven midnight strokes precede a reset to 06:00. |
| Two | Gu prepares earlier but tries alone; he cannot adjust and check the catch simultaneously. It remains unfixed and resets. |
| Three | At noon he asks Xue to trust a check from “yesterday,” without current inspection material. She refuses to operate on unknown findings. By his new check, it is time for her to leave. |
| Four | At 09:00 he photographs the current fault and obtains her on-site check. They use the established method, complete a noon test, and hear twelve actual strokes at midnight. |

The fault and time limits remain constant. Gu changes how he uses memory, obtains present evidence, and requests cooperation. Xue’s refusal has a reason rather than existing only to force failure. Round four needs neither a sudden expert nor a tool carried through resets.

Four rounds are this example’s scale. Another unit may need two, or devote a round to rest, orientation, or emotional experience. Each return needs no new death, loss, or stronger opponent.

heading.zh: 原创片段：别要求她记得另一个昨天
heading.en: Original Scene: Do Not Ask Her to Remember Another Yesterday

body.zh:
第四轮，顾遥没有再从“我昨夜见过”讲起。他带何雪到当前检修台，让她看得到实际问题。这里用的是本故事已有维护方法，重点是协作与知情，不提供现实设备维修步骤。

> “今天先查末击。”顾遥把刚拍的照片递过去。
>
> 何雪看了一眼，又去看台上的卡杆。“这里确实卡住了。你昨天没发现？”
>
> 他几乎要说，发现过三次。那三个下午她都不记得。
>
> “这次发现了。”他说，“我调钟，你按值班办法查这一处，来得及吗？”
>
> “午饭前可以。别再一边调一边伸手查。”
>
> “好。你说停，我就停。”
>
> 这句话没有让她知道循环，却让两人知道今天各做什么。

两人完成处理，午间试鸣十二声。何雪记下本次检修后按原计划离镇；顾遥在塔外等午夜钟声，这次实际响满十二声。次晨他的手机显示次日日期，时间走过06:01，没有回到同一个06:00。本轮退出由这些结果兑现，午间成功只是中间验证。

何雪记得第四轮的共同工作，没有凭空获得前三轮经历。顾遥可以在后续讲述，她是否相信仍有自己的回答；脱离循环也不要求把她的出行或独立目标取消。
body.en:
In round four Gu does not begin with “I saw this last night.” He brings Xue to the current maintenance station where she can check the problem. The fictional method is already established; the scene concerns cooperation and knowledge rather than real equipment instructions.

> “Let’s check the last stroke today.” Gu offered the photograph just taken.
>
> Xue looked at it, then at the catch. “It really is stuck. Didn’t you notice yesterday?”
>
> He nearly said he had noticed three times. She remembered none of those afternoons.
>
> “I’ve noticed this time,” he said. “I adjust; you check this part by the duty method. Is there time?”
>
> “Before lunch. Stop trying to adjust and reach in at once.”
>
> “Okay. When you say stop, I stop.”
>
> That did not tell her about the loop. It told them what each would do today.

They complete the work and a twelve-stroke noon test. Xue records this maintenance and leaves as planned. Gu waits outside the tower at midnight and actually hears twelve strokes. Next morning his phone shows the next date and time passes 06:01 rather than returning to the same 06:00. Those results fulfill this round’s exit; noon was an intermediate test.

Xue remembers round four’s shared work without acquiring earlier rounds. Gu may later tell her, and she still has her own reply. Escape need not cancel her travel or independent goals.

heading.zh: 重复部分概述，新的理解展开
heading.en: Summarize Repetition and Expand Changed Understanding

body.zh:
早晨刷牙、走同一段路、听同一句广播，可以在规则建立后概述：“他又在六点醒来，广播还是昨天那一句。”不必把每轮开场逐字复制。要展开的是旧动作里的新选择：第二轮想靠自己抢时间，第三轮向没有同样记忆的人求助，第四轮先提供当下材料。

同一句对白也可重现，但让主角的理解有区别。“你昨天没发现？”第一次只是责问，后来成为他意识到双方记忆不同的提醒。不要只把对白换词当作剧情变化；反过来，重复原句也不自动等于水文。

悬念可以从“为何重复”转向“怎样合作、午夜是否真正成功”。解答到位时可以收束，不要求退出以后马上接更危险的新循环。
body.en:
Once the rule is established, summarize brushing teeth, the same walk, or an identical broadcast: “He woke at six again. The broadcast used yesterday’s words.” Expand new choices within familiar actions: acting alone in round two, asking someone without the same memory in three, and supplying current material in four.

A repeated line can gain meaning. “Didn’t you notice yesterday?” first sounds like criticism, later reminding him that their memories differ. Rewording dialogue alone does not create progress; repeating a line does not automatically create filler.

Suspense may move from why repetition happens to cooperation and whether midnight actually succeeds. When the answer is fulfilled, the story can close without immediately creating a more dangerous loop.

heading.zh: 时间循环写崩时，先查跨轮状态
heading.en: Repair a Loop by Checking State Across Rounds

body.zh:
逐轮列出主角知道什么、本轮已经做什么、别人现在知道什么。若只有主角记忆保留，手机截图、伤口、别人答应过的安排都不能无说明地跨轮保留。若本书选择保留某类物件或伤势，提前写进规则，再检查所有后续场景。

退出条件可以是修复、选择或找到真相，但要可被本书条件支持。若是人物选择，写清谁怎样判断条件达成，不用“他终于成长”代替规则解释。若此前不知道退出条件，后面要有来源、推断和检验，不在最后一句直接宣告“其实只要相爱”。

最后查每轮的价值：新信息、成功尝试、失败理解、情感体验都可以成立。没有新作用的重复可以缩短；稳定陪伴和休息仍按本书体验保留，不为让表格看起来不断升级硬加灾难。
body.en:
For each round record what the lead knows, what has happened now, and what others currently know. If only the lead’s memory persists, screenshots, wounds, and other people’s agreements cannot cross rounds without explanation. If this book retains a category of objects or injuries, establish that rule first and apply it consistently.

An exit can depend on repair, choice, or truth, but must follow the book’s conditions. For a choice-based exit, establish who or what determines completion rather than using “he finally grew” as the rule. An initially unknown condition needs a source, inference, and test later, not a final assertion that love was enough all along.

Check each round’s value: information, a successful attempt, understanding failure, or emotional experience can work. Shorten useless repetition; retain rest and stable company when they serve the book instead of adding disaster to make a table escalate.

q.zh: 每轮都必须失败或付更大代价吗？
q.en: Must every loop fail or cost more?

a.zh: 不必。可以得到局部成功、理解他人或完成当前目标。变化在人物怎样理解与选择，不必用更多惨事证明循环有进展。
a.en: No. A round can achieve partial success, understanding, or the present goal. Changed judgment and choices can matter without escalating calamity.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 审阅时间循环，附重置时刻、保留/重置项、当前知情、退出条件及已写轮次。逐轮区分旧记忆、本轮物件、他人回答与实际结果，检查规则来源和验证。按作者文风展开关键场面、概述重复，不强制每轮失败或新增代价；只改指定范围。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to review this time loop with reset timing, retained states, current knowledge, exit conditions, and written rounds. Separate old memory, current objects, replies, and results; check rule sources and verification. Expand key scenes and summarize repetition under the author’s voice, without mandatory failure or added cost. Revise only the named scope.

label.zh: 新规则进入现实场面
label.en: A new rule in concrete situations

title.en: How to Write a Secret-Identity Romance with Fair Clues
title.zh: 身份隐瞒爱情故事怎么写：线索公平，揭晓有后果

seo_title.en: Write a Secret-Identity Romance
seo_title.zh: 身份隐瞒爱情故事

description.zh: 分清双方怎样知道真实身份、隐瞒了多久，以及揭晓改变什么。附原创网络笔名案例、可回看线索与揭晓后的实际回应。
description.en: Track who knows the identity, when they learn it, and what disclosure changes. Includes an original pen-name romance, fair clues, and replies after revelation.

answer.zh: 身份隐瞒爱情先写清两个身份分别怎样与对方相处，再让线索提示它们可能属于同一个人。隐瞒者知道多少、为何不说、怎样利用信息，决定揭晓后的问题。真相可以由本人坦白，不必强迫撞破；恋爱继续、暂停或结束，都需要另一人的真实回应，不能用隐藏身份更优秀抵消曾经的隐瞒。
answer.en: Establish how each identity relates to the other person, then clues that they may belong to one person. What the concealer knows, why they withhold it, and how they use that knowledge shape the disclosure. They can confess directly rather than be caught. Continuing, pausing, or ending romance needs the other’s actual reply; a more impressive hidden identity cannot erase concealment.

heading.zh: 两个身份，四种知情不要混在一起
heading.en: Two Identities: Keep Knowledge Separate

body.zh:
关系方法用网上与现实的双重身份制造期待，反转方法要求先定表面身份、隐藏身份和可回看行为；情绪方法再问这份相处为何珍贵、揭晓改变什么。本篇将它们组合为爱情例，不规定隐瞒者一定是富豪、高手或仇人。

| 要记录的事 | 本例填写 |
|---|---|
| 表面与隐藏身份 | 邻居叶斐，也是线上合作朗读者“北桥” |
| 双方何时知道 | 叶斐三周前听程意公开读出笔名“纸舟”，才认出她；程意尚不知道北桥是叶斐 |
| 已透露的内容 | 两人线上讨论短篇与个人心情，现实已单独见面两次，尚未确认交往 |
| 隐瞒如何影响行为 | 他借线上得知的旧唱片喜好送礼，却说只是碰巧 |

若采用程意限知视角，只叙述她的观察、想法和他实际说的话。不能写“他完全不认识纸舟”作为事实，后来又改成早知道；可以让她相信他不知道，再由证据纠正。作者知道不等于她已经知道。
body.en:
Relationship craft uses online and offline identities to create expectation; reversal craft establishes public and hidden identities with revisitable behavior; emotional craft asks why the connection matters and what revelation changes. This article combines them for romance without requiring a concealed billionaire, master, or enemy.

| Record | This example |
|---|---|
| Public and hidden identities | Neighbor Ye Fei is online reading collaborator “Beiqiao” |
| When each knows | Three weeks ago Ye heard Cheng Yi publicly read her pen name “Paperboat” and recognized her; Cheng does not know Beiqiao is Ye |
| Shared information | Online they discuss short fiction and personal feelings; offline they have met alone twice without agreeing to date |
| Effect of concealment | He uses an online record preference to choose a gift, then calls it coincidence |

In Cheng’s limited viewpoint, report her observations, thoughts, and his actual words. Do not state as fact that he does not know Paperboat, then later declare he always did. She can believe he does not know and later revise that belief. Author knowledge is not her knowledge.

heading.zh: 线索提示身份，不能独自证明一切
heading.en: Clues Suggest Identity Without Proving Everything

body.zh:
叶斐与程意在线上、现实相处已有两个月，三周前他才把两个身份接上。前文可以展示以下细节：

| 细节 | 能说明与不能说明 |
|---|---|
| 北桥与叶斐都说“这里先留一个空行” | 用语相似可引起注意；不是唯一身份证明 |
| 北桥常说18:40赶末班车，叶斐也有这个下班安排 | 时间有重合；不能单凭排班断言是同一人 |
| 她只在线上提过的旧唱片，叶斐送给她 | 他取得信息的来源需解释；不自动证明全程监视或所有交流都虚假 |

让这些细节先在正常相处里成立。程意起初把唱片理解为巧合，后来听到相同用语才问来源。若书中一直用双视角，也可早让读者知道他的身份，把期待转到“何时坦白、她会怎样回应”；不必为了惊讶硬藏他视角里正在想着的事实。

线索数量、揭晓位置和是否自我坦白按作者选择。来源的三处暗示与禁止自报身份是默认技法，不能压过本书明确采用的直接告白；仍要保持已知事实一致。
body.en:
Ye and Cheng have interacted online and offline for two months; he connected the identities three weeks ago. Earlier scenes can show:

| Detail | Scope |
|---|---|
| Both use “Leave a blank line here first” | Similar wording draws attention without unique identification |
| Beiqiao catches the last bus at 18:40; Ye has the same work schedule | Overlapping times alone do not establish identity |
| Ye gives the record she mentioned only online | His information source needs explanation; it does not prove total surveillance or make all exchanges false |

Let details first work in ordinary company. Cheng initially reads the record as coincidence and later asks after hearing familiar wording. With two viewpoints, readers may know his identity early and wait for disclosure and her response rather than surprise. Do not suppress facts he is actively considering solely to hide them.

Clue count, reveal timing, and direct disclosure follow author choice. The source’s three-hint and no-self-identification techniques are defaults, not overrides of this book’s chosen direct conversation. Established facts still need consistency.

heading.zh: 原创片段：先回答信息从哪里来
heading.en: Original Scene: Answer Where the Information Came From

body.zh:
第三次单独见面，程意听叶斐对她刚写的句子说“这里先留一个空行”。她想起唱片，直接问起。

> “那张唱片，你怎么知道我想找？”
>
> 叶斐没有再说碰巧。“你告诉过北桥。”
>
> “我没告诉过你。”
>
> “北桥就是我。三周前你在读书组说自己叫纸舟，我才知道。”
>
> 他从现有账号发来一条消息。程意打开原先两人的对话，看到消息进到同一串记录里；他在她面前输入，又停下来等她看完。
>
> “你知道以后，还问我喜不喜欢你。那时我不知道你们是一个人。”
>
> “是。我怕你不再跟北桥说话，拖着没讲。唱片也不是巧合。”
>
> “我喜欢跟你相处。现在我要先弄明白，是怎样的相处。”
>
> “你想先停吗？”
>
> “线上合作先停，周末那顿饭也先不约。等我想好再联系。”
>
> “好。我不换别的账号来找你。”

账号中的当前消息支持两种身份的对应；他的说明交代获知时点与隐瞒理由，不证明每句过去的话都真实。她已有好感，也确实需要暂停，两者可以同时成立。

两周里叶斐没有另换账号催促。程意后来主动提出散步，他接受，双方实际见面。她问清几次线下话题的信息来源，他逐项回答；她说仍想继续约会，他同意按彼此现在知道的身份相处。两人再约好下一次见面，后来共同表示愿意交往。这里有重新接触与选择，不宣布一次谈话治好全部信任，也不把等待两周当保证复合的配额。
body.en:
At their third private meeting, Cheng hears Ye suggest leaving a blank line in her new sentence. Remembering the record, she asks directly.

> “How did you know I wanted that record?”
>
> Ye did not call it coincidence again. “You told Beiqiao.”
>
> “I didn’t tell you.”
>
> “I am Beiqiao. Three weeks ago, when you said you were Paperboat at the group, I realized.”
>
> He sent a message from the existing account. Cheng opened their earlier conversation and saw it arrive in the same thread. He typed in front of her, then waited for her to finish reading.
>
> “After you knew, you still asked whether I liked you. I didn’t know you were one person.”
>
> “Yes. I feared you’d stop talking to Beiqiao and put it off. The record wasn’t coincidence either.”
>
> “I like being with you. Now I need to understand what that company was.”
>
> “Do you want to stop for now?”
>
> “Pause the online work, and don’t arrange the weekend dinner. I’ll contact you when I’ve thought.”
>
> “Okay. I won’t use another account to find you.”

The current account message supports the identity connection. His explanation supplies when he learned it and his reason for concealment, without proving every past statement true. Her attraction and need to pause can coexist.

For two weeks Ye uses no other account to press her. Cheng later proposes a walk, he accepts, and they actually meet. She asks where several offline topics came from; he answers each. She says she still wants to date, and he accepts company under their now-shared knowledge. They arrange another meeting and later mutually choose a relationship. Renewed contact and choice do not mean one conversation restores all trust. Two weeks is this example’s timing, not a reconciliation quota.

heading.zh: 身份揭晓后，保留双方各自的选择
heading.en: After Disclosure, Keep Each Person’s Choices

body.zh:
先核对隐瞒范围：只是没有说笔名，还是主动编过假信息、利用对方私事或替对方做决定？后果对应本书确实发生的行为，不把所有隐瞒都写成同一种罪，也不因“他为她好”把行为删掉。

再核对回应：惊讶、快乐、失落、愤怒都可能，取决于原相处与人物价值。身份本人解释不等于对方已经接受，旁人起哄也不能替代关系确认。让角色问、回答、暂停或继续，把这一轮选择写到实际往来。

故事可选继续相爱、开放等待或分开。若继续，补对应的新行为；若分开，不必突然把曾经所有温暖都写成骗局。隐藏身份更有地位或能力，可以改变处境，却不能自动换取恋爱与原谅。
body.en:
Check the scope of concealment: an unmentioned pen name, invented information, use of private details, or decisions made for someone else have different effects. Address the behavior that actually occurred rather than assigning every concealment the same judgment or erasing it because he meant well.

Check the reply: surprise, pleasure, disappointment, or anger can fit the earlier relationship and values. An explanation is not acceptance, and bystander teasing cannot confirm romance. Let questions, replies, pauses, and continuation affect actual contact.

The ending can continue love, remain open, or separate. For continuation, show corresponding new conduct. Separation need not turn every earlier warm encounter into fraud. A prestigious or powerful hidden identity may alter circumstances without automatically purchasing romance or forgiveness.

q.zh: 一定要让身份被别人撞破吗？
q.en: Must someone else expose the identity?

a.zh: 不必。本人主动坦白同样能形成场景，重要的是信息从何而来、先前线索能否回看，以及对方听见后怎样回答。
a.en: No. Voluntary disclosure can form a scene. Establish the information source, revisitable clues, and the other person’s reply.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 审阅身份隐瞒爱情，附双方身份、获知时点、已透露范围、叙述视角和选定结局。分开线索、推测、身份核验、自认与对方接受；补实际往来。保留作者文风与双方选择，不强制三条暗示、撞破、惩罚或复合，只改指定范围。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to review this secret-identity romance with identities, discovery times, shared information, viewpoint, and ending. Separate clues, inference, verification, admission, and acceptance; check actual contact. Preserve voice and both choices without mandatory three-hint counts, exposure, punishment, or reconciliation. Revise only the named scope.

title.zh: 剪视频把对白剪断了怎么修：回原片找完整句子
title.en: How to Fix Dialogue Cut Off by a Video Edit

seo_title.zh: 剪视频把对白剪断了怎么修：回原片找完整句子
seo_title.en: How to Fix Dialogue Cut Off by a Video Edit

description.zh: 区分剪点截断、混音盖声与原素材缺字，回原片恢复完整对白。附原创借书片段的源时间、输出时间与字幕重排示例。
description.en: Distinguish clipped speech, masking, and missing source audio. Restore complete source dialogue with an original borrowing example and updated output timing.

answer.zh: 先只听接点附近，再回原片确认缺字是否存在。剪点落在讲话中时，把入出点移到完整句子外的可靠停顿；修画面闪帧后再核对白。保留的句子变长会移动后续声音和字幕，要按新输出时间重排。原片本就缺字时，不能靠淡入淡出或字幕补出不存在的声音。
answer.en: Listen around the join, then check whether the missing words exist in the source. Move cuts inside speech to reliable pauses around the complete line, and check speech again after visual cleanup. Longer retained dialogue moves later audio and captions, which need new output times. Fades or captions cannot restore words absent from the source.

heading.zh: 先听原片，别把所有缺字都当剪点问题
heading.en: Check Source Audio Before Moving a Cut

body.zh:
先暂停配乐和旁白，只听原声接点，再比较原片同一句。不同原因需要不同修法：

| 现象 | 判断与处理 |
|---|---|
| 原片有完整尾字，成片在句中切走 | 回剪辑计划移动出点，保留完整发声和必要停顿 |
| 成片有尾字，但被音乐或旁白盖住 | 调对应音轨或旁白位置；移动画面剪点不解决遮盖 |
| 原片本身也听不见尾字 | 查实际选择的音轨、其他完整素材；没有完整声音就需补录或重写，不能声称已恢复 |
| 只有自动字幕漏字 | 回听确认声音完整后改文字与时间，不为识别错误重剪正确音轨 |

不要靠一个波形低谷就认定句子说完。爆破音、轻声字和短暂停顿都可能很轻；转写用于定位，是否完整要听实际声音。本篇主要处理第一种：完整原声被本次剪点截断。
body.en:
Mute music and narration temporarily, listen to source-audio joins, and compare the same line in the source.

| Symptom | Decision and repair |
|---|---|
| Source contains the ending; the edit leaves mid-line | Move the planned out point to retain the full utterance and needed pause |
| Ending is present but masked by music or narration | Adjust that track or narration placement; a picture cut cannot fix masking |
| Ending is missing in the source too | Check the selected audio stream or another complete take; otherwise record or rewrite rather than claim restoration |
| Only automatic captions omit a word | Confirm complete sound, then correct text/timing without recutting a good audio track |

A waveform dip does not establish a finished sentence: a quiet syllable or brief pause may be part of speech. Transcription helps locate the line; actual listening decides completeness. This article addresses the first case: a new cut truncating intact source dialogue.

heading.zh: 原创时码例：一个尾字会改变许可条件
heading.en: Original Timing Example: The Missing Word Changes Permission

body.zh:
以下是纸面剪辑例，时码用于演算，没有声称实际分析或播放了视频。一本书的借用场面中，原片10.20—12.60秒说“借你可以，周五前还”，句前停顿为10.00—10.20，句后停顿为12.60—12.90。现计划截取10.40—12.30，开头和归还条件都不完整。

可以把该段改为10.10—12.75：两边在已知停顿内，完整保留句子。它不是固定多留0.5秒的公式；真实素材须按实际发声、停顿与后续动作选择，若句后紧接别人的话，还要避免切入下一句。

| 计划 | 时间核对 |
|---|---|
| 旧段 | 源10.40—12.30，长1.90秒；前面已有5.00秒，输出5.00—6.90 |
| 修后段 | 源10.10—12.75，长2.65秒；输出5.00—7.65 |
| 完整台词 | 源10.20—12.60；本例无变速，修后输出5.10—7.50 |
| 后续段 | 原本输出6.90起，现在7.65起，顺延0.75秒 |

表里时间是本例假设。真实成片应使用渲染后的实际时长与帧边界，不能以演算表代替输出测量。修后再听完整许可与归还条件，不能仅凭字幕写全就说声音完整。
body.en:
This is a paper edit with illustrative times, not analyzed or played footage. In a book-borrowing scene, source 10.20–12.60 contains “You can borrow it, but return it before Friday.” Known pauses are 10.00–10.20 before and 12.60–12.90 after. The current 10.40–12.30 selection loses the beginning and part of the return condition.

A proposed 10.10–12.75 selection puts both edges inside known pauses and retains the line. This is no fixed “add half a second” rule: choose from actual speech, pauses, and actions, without cutting into the next speaker.

| Plan | Timing record |
|---|---|
| Old segment | Source 10.40–12.30, duration 1.90; with 5.00 seconds preceding it, output 5.00–6.90 |
| Repaired segment | Source 10.10–12.75, duration 2.65; output 5.00–7.65 |
| Complete line | Source 10.20–12.60; at unchanged speed, new output 5.10–7.50 |
| Following segment | Previously started at output 6.90; now 7.65, moving 0.75 seconds later |

These are assumed times. Use actual rendered duration and frame boundaries for real footage rather than treating worksheet arithmetic as measured output. Listen for the whole permission and return condition; complete caption text alone does not prove complete sound.

heading.zh: 画面修整之后，句界还要再检查
heading.en: Recheck Speech After Visual Boundary Cleanup

body.zh:
video-cut 先避开画面硬切附近的残帧，再用可靠句末或静音窗修正边界，声音完整性最后检查。句末锚点只采用中、高可信记录；已有讲话时段却仍在讲话中截断时，写阻断问题，不把无法吸附算通过。

没有可用讲话时码时，实现会把相应检查记为未检查，而非自动保证对白安全。别只看没有错误：先回听并补可靠定位，再决定剪点。停顿窗也不能替代内容判断，保住字词之后，还要确认没有删掉前一句中的“可以”或“不能”。

同一原片的相邻区间若源时间和输出时间真正连续，并未丢声音，不必为了片段标签强制再造句界；仍须回听接缝。两个不同文件各有自己的讲话区间，不能把甲片的停顿时码套给乙片。画面干净却声音少了半句时，继续回源修选择；不把闪帧检测为零当声音验收。
body.en:
video-cut cleans edges near visual hard cuts first, then adjusts to reliable sentence or quiet windows, with speech completeness checked last. Sentence anchors use medium/high confidence records. An edge still inside known speech becomes a blocking issue rather than a successful unsnapped cut.

Without usable speech timing, the implementation marks the relevant check unchecked; it cannot automatically promise safe dialogue. Listen and obtain reliable timing before choosing boundaries. Pause windows also cannot establish meaning: keeping words still requires retaining an earlier “may” or “must not” where relevant.

Truly adjacent intervals from the same source, continuous in both source and output time, have not removed speech merely because they have separate clip labels. Listen to that join too. Different source files need their own speech intervals, not copied pause times. If visual cleanup leaves half a spoken line, repair selection again; zero flash-frame candidates is no audio approval.

heading.zh: 句子补长后，重排后面的声音与字幕
heading.en: Update Later Sound and Captions After Extending a Line

body.zh:
本例后续段顺延0.75秒，原先按6.90起写的旁白、字幕和音效不能照抄。原片区间仍用源时间；剪后旁白用新的输出时间。字幕再绑定当前视频和实际采用的声音，逐句核对开始、尾字和阅读停留。

不要简单给全片字幕统一加0.75秒：本例前面5秒没有变化，修补段内部的台词还因入点提前而改变相对位置。只修受影响区间及后续累计位置，最后检查全段。若还有变速、重排或帧取整，按实际输出重测，不能只加一个偏移量。

导出候选后，正常速度连听接点前后，再只听声音，确认完整句子、没有重复尾字或突兀淡出；连画面检查动作与反应仍属于这句话。原素材不足时，保留待补录或待选素材状态，不用字幕、定格或转场宣称声音恢复。
body.en:
In the example, later material moves 0.75 seconds. Narration, captions, and effects written for 6.90 cannot be copied unchanged. Source selections retain source times; edited narration uses new output times. Bind captions to the current video and chosen sound, then check starts, final words, and reading time.

Do not shift all captions by 0.75: the preceding five seconds stay unchanged, and the repaired line’s relative position changes with the earlier in point. Correct affected intervals and later cumulative times, then review the passage. Speed changes, reordering, or frame rounding require actual output measurements rather than one offset.

Play the exported join normally and listen without picture for complete speech, duplicated words, or an abrupt fade. With picture, confirm actions and responses belong to that line. If source material is inadequate, leave recording or selection unresolved instead of claiming that a caption, freeze, or transition restored audio.

q.zh: 加淡入淡出能把缺的字补回来吗？
q.en: Can a fade restore missing words?

a.zh: 不能。淡入淡出可以处理安全停顿内的接缝，但不生成被删的音节。先恢复完整源声音，再按需要处理接缝；不要在完整句中用淡出遮掩剪断。
a.en: No. A fade can smooth a join within a safe pause, but cannot generate a removed syllable. Restore complete source sound first, then treat the join if needed without fading away speech.

q.zh: 画面必须切走，还能保留整句对白吗？
q.en: Can picture cut away while dialogue continues?

a.zh: 可以在保留完整音轨时独立调整画面，先确认反打或补画面真实属于该事件。本文的同段音画截取修法不能直接当作独立声音剪辑；需要分离轨道的方案再核对实际音画对应。
a.en: You can edit picture independently while retaining complete sound, using a reaction or insert that belongs to the event. Moving coupled audio/video boundaries is not the same operation; check actual correspondence in a separate-track edit.

text.zh: 请通过 video-recap 检查我指出的断句，先回原片区分剪点截断、盖声或原音缺失。对完整句子提出新入出点，核对句末与讲话区间，并按实际剪后时间更新后续旁白和字幕；给正常速度试听候选。
text.en: Use video-recap to diagnose the specified clipped line against source audio. Distinguish a bad cut, masking, and source loss; propose boundaries around the complete line, check pauses and speech spans, and update later narration/captions to actual edited times. Provide a normal-speed listening candidate.

label.zh: 剪点、句界与声音优先级
句末停顿、讲话区间与连续连接检查
label.en: Pause windows, speech spans, and continuous joins

label.zh: 源素材与成片逐句回听
label.en: Line review in source and finished audio

title.zh: AI配音音量忽大忽小怎么办：先检查每段，再检查混音
title.en: How to Fix Uneven Volume Between AI Voiceover Segments

seo_title.zh: AI配音音量忽大忽小怎么办：先检查每段，再检查混音
seo_title.en: How to Fix Uneven Volume Between AI Voiceover Segments

description.zh: 区分分段配音电平、峰值限制和整片混音，避免把RMS目标当成LUFS实测。附原创增益演算与逐段回听方法。
description.en: Separate segment levels, peak guards, and final mixing. Includes gain examples and listening checks without confusing RMS targets with measured LUFS.

answer.zh: 先把各段配音单独连听，确认差异来自语音本身还是音乐和原声。逐段统一电平时同时留意峰值，峰值受限的段落可能达不到RMS目标；声音太冲或停顿过长时再按表演修订。完成混音后测量当前编码成片的响度和真峰，再回听各句，不把整片达标当作每段都均衡。
answer.en: Listen to voiceover segments alone to distinguish voice-level differences from music or source masking. Level segments with a peak guard: a peak-limited segment may miss its RMS target, and harsh delivery or long pauses may need performance revision. After mixing, measure loudness and true peak in the current encoded export and listen to individual lines; whole-film compliance does not establish even segments.

heading.zh: 先单独连听配音，找音量差来自哪里
heading.en: Listen to Voice Segments Alone First

body.zh:
把相邻几段WAV按实际顺序连听，再比较加音乐后的成片。同一声线也会因为语气、参考音频、停顿长度或生成结果而有电平差，不能只看音色名称相同。

| 差异出现在哪里 | 先检查 |
|---|---|
| 独立配音已一段响一段轻 | 当前WAV的电平、峰值、生成设置与有意表演 |
| 独立配音顺，混完却听不清 | 音乐、原声与旁白的位置和局部比例 |
| 只有一个字特别刺耳 | 瞬态或表演，不把整段无限调低就算解决 |
| 轻声段是人物有意压低声音 | 是否仍可辨、有上下文；不把所有语气拉成一样响 |

先保存当前候选，再改最明显的几段。改完独立声音也要重新放回混音里听；耳机、手机扬声器上的可辨性都来自实际输出，不由一行目标值保证。
body.en:
Listen to neighboring WAVs in actual order before comparing the mix with music. The same voice can produce different levels with delivery, references, pause length, or synthesis results; a matching voice name is insufficient.

| Difference | First check |
|---|---|
| Voice files already alternate loud/quiet | Current WAV levels, peaks, settings, and intentional delivery |
| Voice alone is consistent, mixed speech is unclear | Music, source sound, and local timing/balance |
| One word is unusually harsh | Transient or performance, rather than indefinitely lowering the entire segment |
| Soft speech is intentional | Intelligibility and context; do not flatten every delivery |

Save the current candidate and begin with the most noticeable segments. Repaired standalone sound must be heard in the mix too. Headphones and phone speakers test actual intelligibility; a target field cannot guarantee it.

heading.zh: 逐段归一会受峰值约束
heading.en: Segment Normalization Has a Peak Constraint

body.zh:
引用版本的 video-voiceover 默认对每段16-bit PCM WAV做RMS归一：目标为−20 dBFS，线性峰值上限为0.98。这是该版本的默认设置，可以改变，不是所有平台的交付标准。

实现先按整段采样计算RMS并求所需增益，再用峰值约束增益，最后记录实际输出。它是在整段上乘同一个系数，不是把一个过高瞬态单独压平的压缩器。目标增益碰到峰值上限，就可能无法达到目标。

分段元数据里的 `rms_dbfs_before`、`rms_dbfs_after` 与 `peak_after` 是归一阶段的记录；没有归一记录的空值不能读成“已达标”。声音后续经过适速、叠轨或编码，这些值也不自动代表最终文件。检查你这次实际采用的WAV与设置，而非拿旧缓存或旧报告说明新声音。

RMS包含整段采样，长静音会拉低均值；两段RMS一样，也可能因停顿、声线和频率分布而听起来不同。先听，确认停顿是否有创作作用，再决定修表演或时间安排，不为数字接近就删掉必要呼吸。
body.en:
The pinned video-voiceover defaults normalize each 16-bit PCM WAV to −20 dBFS RMS with a linear peak ceiling of 0.98. These configurable version defaults are not universal platform delivery requirements.

The implementation computes whole-block RMS and desired gain, caps that gain by the peak constraint, then records the output. It multiplies the whole segment by one factor, rather than compressing a single excessive transient. A peak-constrained gain may not reach the RMS target.

Segment fields `rms_dbfs_before`, `rms_dbfs_after`, and `peak_after` record this normalization stage. Null normalization records are no proof of compliance. Later tempo processing, mixing, or encoding means these values do not automatically describe the final file. Inspect adopted WAVs and settings from this run rather than an old cache/report.

Whole-block RMS includes pauses; long silence lowers the average. Equal RMS can still sound different with pauses, voices, and frequency content. Listen and judge a pause’s purpose before changing delivery or timing rather than deleting needed breaths to align numbers.

heading.zh: 原创演算：不是每段都能加到同一目标
heading.en: Original Calculation: Not Every Segment Can Reach the Target

body.zh:
以下是为了说明增益约束的假设数值，没有生成或试听过这些音频。暂不考虑采样取整，统一以−20 dBFS RMS为演算目标。

| 段落 | 输入与预期结果 |
|---|---|
| A，较轻、峰值低 | 输入RMS −26 dBFS、峰值0.20；约加6 dB，幅度约乘2，可到−20，峰值约0.40 |
| B，较轻但有高峰 | 输入RMS −26、峰值0.75；约乘2会使峰值到1.50，超过0.98。增益最多约1.31，即+2.32 dB，输出RMS约−23.68，峰值约0.98 |
| C，整体较响 | 输入RMS −18、峰值0.50；约减2 dB，幅度乘0.79，输出RMS −20，峰值约0.40 |

A和C可以靠整段增益缩小差异，B仍偏轻的原因却是高峰值，不是参数没写对。继续把B整体推到−20会违反本例峰值约束。回听究竟是必要强调、异常尖声还是素材问题；需要处理瞬态时另用音频工具，或修正表演重生成，再检查当前声音。不把代码的增益限制称为已经做了压缩器或真峰测量。

B与其他段还有数字差也不一定必须重做：实际连听可懂且强调符合表达时，可以保留。修订的目的在可辨与自然，不在让每行报告完全相等。
body.en:
These assumed values illustrate gain limits; none were synthesized or auditioned. Ignoring sample rounding, use −20 dBFS RMS as the worksheet target.

| Segment | Input and expected result |
|---|---|
| A: quiet, low peak | RMS −26 dBFS, peak 0.20; about +6 dB multiplies amplitude by 2, reaching −20 and peak about 0.40 |
| B: quiet, high peak | RMS −26, peak 0.75; multiplying by 2 would reach peak 1.50, over 0.98. Maximum gain is about 1.31, or +2.32 dB: RMS about −23.68, peak about 0.98 |
| C: louder overall | RMS −18, peak 0.50; about −2 dB multiplies amplitude by 0.79, reaching RMS −20 and peak about 0.40 |

Gain can bring A and C closer. B remains quieter because of its high peak, not a missing setting. Raising B to −20 would violate this example’s peak constraint. Listen for intended emphasis, a harsh transient, or a source problem. Use a separate audio tool if transient treatment is needed, or revise delivery and regenerate, then inspect the current sound. The gain guard is neither a compressor nor a true-peak measurement.

A remaining numerical difference need not force regeneration if connected listening is intelligible and the emphasis suits the line. The aim is natural clarity rather than identical report rows.

heading.zh: 混音完成后，再测成片与回听
heading.en: Measure and Listen Again After Mixing

body.zh:
逐段归一不负责混音乐、压低原声或渲染字幕。独立声音合适后，按各段用途安排音乐、原对白和旁白，再检查整片。

短剧声音方法要求混音后测量编码输出的实际LUFS与真峰，并指出两遍 loudnorm 不保证恰好达到目标；峰值或动态范围不允许线性增益时，可能转为动态处理。−20 dBFS RMS、目标LUFS和编码后实测LUFS是不同量，不要把它们互相替换。WAV的样本峰值0.98，也不证明编码成片的真峰已经通过。

整片测量通过后，仍逐句连听：有没有只有某一段轻到漏词、音乐在一句中途突然冒起、接缝切断呼吸、轻声被拉成喊叫。若问题来自音乐遮盖，回混音改局部比例；若来自语音表演，回该段修，不反复标准化全片碰运气。

保存修前与修后候选、实际设置和本次测量。没有测过或听过的输出写为待测/待试听，不把预设目标当成完成结果。
body.en:
Segment normalization does not mix music, duck source sound, or render captions. Once voice files suit their roles, arrange music, original dialogue, and narration, then inspect the finished mix.

Short-drama audio craft calls for measuring actual LUFS and true peak in the encoded output. Two-pass loudnorm does not guarantee hitting a target exactly: peak or dynamic-range constraints can cause dynamic processing instead of linear gain. −20 dBFS RMS, target LUFS, and measured encoded LUFS are different quantities. A WAV sample peak of 0.98 also does not prove compliant true peak in the encoded film.

Even after whole-film measurement passes, listen to connected lines: a single segment may lose words, music may rise mid-line, a join may cut breathing, or a whisper may become a shout. Repair local masking in the mix and performance problems in the relevant voice segment rather than repeatedly normalizing the entire film.

Retain before/after candidates, actual settings, and this run’s measurements. Mark unmeasured or unheard outputs awaiting measurement/listening instead of reporting a preset as a result.

q.zh: 把所有段音量都设成100%就一样响吗？
q.en: Will setting every segment to 100% make them equally loud?

a.zh: 不会。相同播放增益不代表输入音频的电平一样。先比较实际WAV与表演，再用峰值约束下的增益调整，最后连听。
a.en: No. Equal playback gain does not mean equal input levels. Compare actual WAVs and delivery, adjust gain within peak constraints, and listen in sequence.

q.zh: 全片LUFS达标，为什么还是有一段太轻？
q.en: Why can one line be quiet when whole-film LUFS meets the target?

a.zh: 整片响度汇总不能证明每段相对平衡。该段可能有意轻声、原始电平较低、受高峰值约束或被音乐遮盖；单独与混音分别回听，再修对应原因。
a.en: Whole-film loudness cannot establish local balance. A line may be intentionally soft, lower-level, peak-constrained, or masked. Listen to it alone and in the mix, then repair the actual cause.

text.zh: 请通过 video-recap 对比音量不一致的配音段，先单独试听并检查当前WAV的RMS与峰值及归一设置。解释不能达到目标的段落，不反复加增益冲破峰值。保留有意的轻声与强调，修后重新混音，再测量成片LUFS与真峰并试听。
text.en: Use video-recap to compare uneven voiceover segments in isolation. Inspect current WAV RMS/peak and normalization settings, explain peak-constrained segments without repeatedly raising gain, and preserve intentional soft speech/emphasis. Remix repaired segments, measure encoded-export LUFS and true peak, and listen.

label.zh: 逐段配音与输出证据
RMS归一与峰值增益约束
label.en: RMS normalization and peak gain guard

label.zh: 当前默认归一设置
混音后测量实际响度和真峰

title.zh: 反派洗白怎么写可信：改变行为，不强迫别人原谅
title.en: How to Write a Believable Villain Redemption

seo_title.zh: 反派洗白怎么写可信：改变行为，不强迫别人原谅
seo_title.en: How to Write a Believable Villain Redemption

description.zh: 分开动机解释、停止伤害、实际修复与受伤者回应。附原创灯会反派转变片段和后续选择，不靠苦衷或救场抹掉旧事。
description.en: Write redemption through changed choices, real repair, and the injured person’s reply. Includes a lantern-fair scene without forced forgiveness.

answer.zh: 先保留反派已经做过的事，再写他为何不再用原来的办法争取目标。苦衷解释动机，不能改写伤害；一次帮忙只证明这次选择。让停止、修复和受伤者回应分别落地，后续在类似机会前继续呈现做法。合作、信任和原谅可以有不同进度，不用全员称赞或牺牲一次宣布洗白。
answer.en: Retain what the antagonist actually did, then show why they stop pursuing a goal through the old method. Hardship explains motives without erasing harm; one helpful act proves one choice. Show stopped harm, repair, and the injured person’s reply separately, then later behavior under similar opportunity. Cooperation, trust, and forgiveness can progress differently rather than being settled by praise or one sacrifice.

heading.zh: 先分清：解释过去，还是改变现在
heading.en: Explaining the Past and Changing the Present Are Different

body.zh:
Oh Story 的反派方法要求行为有内在逻辑，人物成长落在心智和选择；关系方法从既定经历、目标与处境推导行为，情感方法再检查读者投入怎样改变意义。本篇把这些组合到反派转变，不声称来源已有一套“洗白专用公式”。

先写清本书要做哪件事：补出值得理解的一面、让他停止旧行为、转为有限盟友，还是长期修复。揭露“从前其实没做过”属于事实反转；已经确定他做过的事，不能临时用苦衷改成从未发生。

| 层次 | 需要看见什么 |
|---|---|
| 动机解释 | 他当时想保住什么，为什么选了伤害别人的办法 |
| 行为改变 | 同类机会出现时，他现在实际怎么选 |
| 修复 | 可恢复的东西是否真的恢复，尚不能恢复的后果是否保留 |
| 关系回应 | 被伤害者愿意接受哪些改变，仍拒绝哪些接近 |

这些层次可以错开。读者开始理解，不等于剧中受伤者已经知情；愿意继续竞争，不等于重新信任或原谅。
body.en:
Oh Story’s antagonist method asks for internal logic and growth through choices; its relationship method derives behavior from established experience, goals, and circumstances; emotional craft checks how reader investment changes meaning. This article combines them for an antagonist’s turn rather than claiming a native redemption formula.

Decide whether the book adds an understandable side, stops harmful behavior, creates a limited alliance, or follows long-term repair. Revealing that someone never committed an act is a factual twist. A hardship cannot retroactively make an established act disappear.

| Layer | What should become visible |
|---|---|
| Motive | What they protected and why they chose harm |
| Changed behavior | Their actual choice when a similar opportunity appears |
| Repair | What is actually restored and what remains unresolved |
| Reply | What the injured person accepts and what closeness they still refuse |

These layers may progress separately. Reader understanding is not the injured character’s knowledge. Continued competition is not renewed trust or forgiveness.

heading.zh: 原创灯会例：他想赢，错在怎样赢
heading.en: Original Lantern-Fair Example: The Wrong Is How He Tries to Win

body.zh:
杜闻是老街灯会筹办者之一，也经营彩灯摊；他想保住自己的订单，怕新人沈烛的纸灯抢走客人。前文已写他耐心教老匠的孙子装灯，也写他故意把分给沈烛的工作台搬进自己的储间，并把她原本可用的公共工具也留在储间，让她两天不能制作，丢了一笔已经承诺的订单。

他能安排公共工具的位置，不能取消已经分给别人的工作台。沈烛因停工要求核对，杜闻先把“空间紧张”当借口；大家对照原分配发现台子被他占着。他曾有善意，也确实排挤过人，这两件事都保留。

现在他有两条路：继续把责任推给场地，或承认挪台、归还并协助恢复制作条件。转变不靠突然补出一个更坏幕后人，而来自他面对自己做法与原本珍惜的共同灯会之间的冲突。

以下台子、订单和分配均为原创故事设定，不是实际活动规则。沈烛的目标是完成自己的灯与生意，不是负责教杜闻成为好人。
body.en:
Du Wen helps organize an old-street lantern fair and runs a light stall. He wants to protect orders and fears newcomer Shen Zhu will attract customers. Earlier scenes show him patiently teaching an old craftsman’s grandson—and deliberately moving Shen’s assigned workbench into his own storage room. He also kept the shared tools she could use in storage. Two lost production days cost her an already-promised order.

Du may arrange shared tools, but cannot revoke another person’s assigned bench. When Shen asks for a check, he blames cramped space. Comparing the existing allocation reveals he has kept the bench. Earlier kindness and actual exclusion both remain true.

He can keep blaming the venue or admit moving it, return it, and help restore production conditions. The turn comes from conflict between his method and the shared fair he values rather than a suddenly invented worse mastermind.

Bench, order, and allocation are original story premises, not real event rules. Shen wants to finish her own work and business, not teach Du to become good.

heading.zh: 原创片段：她接回台子，没有接下原谅的义务
heading.en: Original Scene: Accepting the Bench Does Not Require Forgiveness

body.zh:
沈烛站在储间门外，看着自己的工作台。

杜闻拿着钥匙，先说：“我只是想把场地理顺。”

“那为什么没问我？”她说，“顾客已经把那笔灯退了。”

他没有再把钥匙收回口袋。过了一会儿，他开门，把自己堆在台上的灯架搬开，和筹办同伴一起将台子送回原定位置。

“是我挪的。”他说，“我怕你把单接走。空间不是理由。”

沈烛摸了摸台沿，确认可以重新铺纸。同伴把原分配恢复，留她按自己的时间使用。杜闻提出替她赶剩下的灯。

“不用进我的制作间。”她说，“你把占着的工具也还回来。我自己做。”

他将她原本可用的公共工具放回架上，没有拿修复当理由接管她的工作。

“那笔订单我补不回去。”他说。

“我知道。它没回来，别说这件事已经过去了。”

“好。”

当天傍晚，沈烛重新铺开纸灯。杜闻留在自己的摊前，把一盏做好的灯放到窗边。他仍希望客人买他的灯；只是这次没有把旁边的桌子再推走。

本场实际恢复台子与工具，承认了谁挪走它们；丢失订单没有自动回来，沈烛也没有答应进入亲密合作。杜闻还可以竞争、有不甘，变化在他开始承认竞争不应靠剥夺对方位置。
body.en:
Shen stands outside storage, looking at her bench.

Du holds the key. “I was only trying to organize the space.”

“Then why didn’t you ask? The customer cancelled that order.”

He does not pocket the key. After a pause, he opens the room, removes his light frames, and carries the bench back to its assigned place with another organizer.

“I moved it,” he says. “I was afraid you’d take the orders. Space wasn’t the reason.”

Shen checks the bench edge and prepares to lay out paper. The other organizer restores the allocation so she can use it on her own schedule. Du offers to help finish the remaining lanterns.

“Stay out of my work area. Return the shared tools you’re keeping. I’ll make them myself.”

He puts her available shared tools back on the rack rather than using repair as a reason to take over.

“I can’t bring that order back,” he says.

“I know. It hasn’t returned. Don’t say this is all behind us.”

“All right.”

That evening Shen lays out paper again. At his own stall, Du places a finished light by the window. He still wants customers to buy it; this time he does not push the neighboring bench away.

Bench and tools are actually restored, and responsibility for moving them is admitted. The lost order has not returned; Shen has not accepted close cooperation. Du can remain competitive and resentful. The change begins with recognizing that competition cannot justify taking the other person’s place.

heading.zh: 后续选择要继承旧事，不急着宣布他已变好
heading.en: Later Choices Retain Earlier Acts

body.zh:
一周后，另一名筹办者提议把沈烛的摊位临时移到后巷，把空出来的位置给杜闻。原位置已答应沈烛，提议者不能替她同意。杜闻这次拒绝占位，要求先问本人；实际摊位仍留在原处，沈烛来布置时看见自己的位置没有被换掉。

沈烛听见他拒绝后，只答应灯会结束时一起清点公共工具，仍不共享订单和制作间。共同清点那天，两人各把使用过的工具放回，核对缺件，再分开收摊。一次有限合作已经发生，全部信任并未恢复。

这段后续用于观察相似机会下的选择，不是所有作品必加的尾声。若前面的关键行动已足以兑现本书转变，可以在那里收；若要写长期修复，就让后续行动继续保留旧后果。后果越重，越不能用一个送礼、救场或牺牲镜头替代所有受伤者的回应。
body.en:
A week later another organizer proposes moving Shen’s stall to the rear lane and giving Du the space. The existing place was promised to Shen; the proposer cannot accept for her. Du refuses it and asks that she be consulted. Her stall actually remains where assigned, which she sees on arriving.

After hearing his refusal, Shen agrees only to count shared tools together after the fair, still keeping orders and workspaces separate. That day they return their tools, check missing items, and close their own stalls. A limited cooperation has happened; full trust has not returned.

This later passage observes a similar opportunity rather than prescribing an epilogue for every book. A decisive earlier action may complete the chosen turn. Long-term repair carries earlier consequences forward. Greater harm cannot be settled on every injured person’s behalf by one gift, rescue, or sacrifice.

heading.zh: 洗白显得强行时，修哪一层
heading.en: Repairing Forced Redemption

body.zh:
| 问题 | 修法 |
|---|---|
| 一讲苦衷，旧行为都不算数 | 保留已经发生的伤害，动机只解释为何选择 |
| 帮过一次，就让大家交回全部权力 | 按实际帮助调整有限合作，剩余决定仍由各人作出 |
| 受伤者拒绝就被骂不宽容 | 给她自己的目标、判断和边界，别让她为反派弧线服务 |
| 悔改后能力、脾气和欲望全消失 | 保留人物原有本事与声音，改变争取目标的办法 |
| 临时加更坏的人转移责任 | 先用原来的选择完成修复，不抹掉他做过的事 |
| 所有代价自动清零 | 分清已经恢复、可以再修与仍不能恢复的后果 |

“洗白”可以写成重新理解，也可以写成真正改过或有限合作。先确定本书承诺，再选择分量；无需把所有复杂反派写成圣人，也无需为了证明悔改固定安排死亡。
body.en:
| Problem | Repair |
|---|---|
| A hardship makes earlier acts stop counting | Retain harm; motive explains the choice |
| One helpful act restores all authority | Adjust limited cooperation while each person keeps remaining decisions |
| The injured person is blamed for refusing | Give them their own goals, judgment, and boundaries |
| Change erases skill, temperament, and wants | Keep ability and voice; change the way goals are pursued |
| A new worse villain absorbs all responsibility | Repair through the original choices without erasing acts |
| All consequences vanish | Separate restored, repairable, and unresolved effects |

Redemption can involve new understanding, changed conduct, or limited alliance. Choose the book’s promise and scale. Complex antagonists need neither sainthood nor a compulsory death to prove remorse.

q.zh: 反派有悲惨过去，就足够洗白吗？
q.en: Is a tragic past enough to redeem a villain?

a.zh: 只解释了一部分动机，还需看他现在怎样选择以及旧行为留下什么。过去可以早已建立，不必临时新增；读者理解与其他人物原谅也不是同一结果。
a.en: It may explain motives; present choices and earlier consequences still matter. An established past need not be newly invented. Reader understanding and other characters’ forgiveness are different results.

q.zh: 洗白之后一定要成为主角朋友吗？
q.en: Must a redeemed antagonist become the protagonist’s friend?

a.zh: 不必。停止作恶、有限合作、继续公平竞争或分道扬镳都可成立。关系变化按真实回应与本书方向安排，不用友谊作唯一证明。
a.en: No. Stopping harm, limited cooperation, fair competition, or separation can work. Actual replies and the book’s direction determine the relationship rather than friendship being the only proof.

text.zh: 请 story-long-write 只审阅这条反派转变线：保留旧行为，按既定动机推导停止伤害与修复的选择，分清实际结果、受伤者回应和仍未解决的后果。不要新增万能苦衷、强制原谅或把一次帮助当永久变化。
text.en: Use story-long-write to review this antagonist’s change: retain earlier acts, derive stopping/repair choices from established motives, and separate completed results, the injured person’s reply, and unresolved consequences. Do not invent an all-explaining hardship, force forgiveness, or treat one helpful act as permanent change.

label.zh: 反派内在逻辑与选择中的成长
label.en: Antagonist logic and growth through choices

label.zh: 行为从经历、目标与当前状态推导
label.en: Behavior from experience, goals, and current state

label.zh: 具体投入、意义变化与可信反应
label.en: Concrete investment, changed meaning, and credible replies

label.zh: 本书选择与事实边界

title.zh: 言情吃醋场景怎么写：在意什么，就回应什么
title.en: How to Write Jealousy in a Romance

seo_title.zh: 言情吃醋场景怎么写：在意什么，就回应什么
seo_title.en: How to Write Jealousy in a Romance

description.zh: 先分清人物看到的事、猜测和真正想要的回应。附原创吃醋片段，保留恋人的工作、第三人的目标与已经答应的约会。
description.en: Separate observed facts, guesses, and the reply a character wants. Includes a jealousy scene that retains work, a third person’s goals, and an agreed date.

answer.zh: 先确定两人的关系已确认到哪一步，再写人物看见了什么、害怕失去哪种相处。吃醋可以让心意变清楚，也可能暴露想控制别人；让对方按实际请求回应。一次关注不证明出轨，一句喜欢不取消工作或社交。保留真实不安与有限改变，不让第三人受罚替代两人交流。
answer.en: Establish the confirmed relationship, what the character observes, and what closeness they fear losing. Jealousy can clarify affection or expose a wish to control; let the other person answer the actual request. Attention alone proves no affair, and affection cancels neither work nor friendships. Retain unease and limited change rather than punishing a third person instead of communicating.

heading.zh: 他在意的究竟是哪件事
heading.en: What Does the Character Actually Care About?

body.zh:
Oh Story 的题材卡把吃醋放在亲密需求与关系分寸中，人物关系方法再区分已确认的社会关系与心里的好感，并从经历、目标和处境推导行为。对白方法检查场合与回应。本篇组合这些方法设计一场吃醋戏，不声称来源提供了专门公式。

先选本场真正被触动的东西：被记得、已有约定、能分享某种生活，还是自尊与控制欲。人物可以不安、嘴硬、直接承认或一时失言；写法按本书选择，不要求所有人攥拳、抢人或当众宣布占有。

| 要分开的事 | 写作时检查 |
|---|---|
| 所见事实 | 看见一起工作、听见邀约，还是对方真的取消约定 |
| 人物猜测 | 他怎样解释事实，哪些尚没有证据 |
| 关系阶段 | 是已确认恋人、朋友，还是单方面喜欢；不能凭好感代对方答应排他关系 |
| 实际请求 | 想确认约会、听到心意或说明边界，还是要求对方放弃自己的生活 |
| 对方回应 | 接受、拒绝、解释或提出另一安排，回应没有自动扩大权限 |

吃醋与误判可能同场出现，也可以没有误判：人物明知只是正常合作，仍在意那份熟悉。关心这个人的理由越具体，越不用借一个突然出现的坏情敌抬高情绪。
body.en:
Oh Story’s genre card places jealousy among intimate needs and boundaries. Its relationship method separates confirmed social status from affection and derives behavior from experience, goals, and circumstances; dialogue craft checks setting and response. This article combines those methods rather than claiming a dedicated formula.

Choose what is touched here: being remembered, an existing promise, sharing a part of life, pride, or control. Unease, defensiveness, admission, or a careless remark can fit different people and book styles. Clenched fists and public possessive declarations are not requirements.

| Distinction | Check |
|---|---|
| Observation | Working together, an invitation, or an actually cancelled plan? |
| Guess | How is the fact interpreted, and what lacks evidence? |
| Relationship | Confirmed partners, friends, or one-sided affection? Feelings do not establish exclusivity for both people. |
| Request | Confirm a date, hear affection, state a boundary, or demand the other person abandon a life? |
| Reply | Acceptance, refusal, explanation, or another plan; a reply grants no broader authority automatically. |

Jealousy can accompany a mistake or exist without one: a person knows the collaboration is ordinary but envies its familiarity. Specific attachment needs no suddenly malicious rival.

heading.zh: 原创前提：已答应的约会与各自的工作
heading.en: Original Premise: An Agreed Date and Separate Work

body.zh:
宋禾与字体设计师梁青已交往两个月，约好周六下午两点一起看展。木作师陆辛与梁青合作修展摊的旧架子，需要周六上午十点到十一点核尺寸；这项工作早已安排，不是为触发吃醋临时出现的约会。

宋禾来找梁青时，只听见陆辛说“周六见”，看见两人很熟地讨论尺寸。她不知道上午的工作时段，也发现自己很少听梁青讲那份字稿。她真正怕的，是自己的约定被当作可以随手挪开的空档，也在意自己进不了那种熟悉的交流。

她没有亲见改约或出轨。陆辛的目标是按时修好架子，不是替恋人制造试探；梁青也不能替陆辛取消工作。以下人物、工作与时间均为原创故事安排。
body.en:
Song He and lettering designer Liang Qing have dated for two months and agreed to visit an exhibition at two on Saturday. Woodworker Lu Xin collaborates with Liang on an old stall frame; their previously arranged measurement check runs from ten to eleven that morning. It is work, not a newly invented date to trigger jealousy.

Song arrives hearing only “See you Saturday” and sees an easy discussion of dimensions. She knows neither the morning slot nor much about Liang’s lettering draft. She fears their own promise has become a gap he can casually move, and envies a shared language she rarely enters.

She has observed neither a changed date nor an affair. Lu wants to finish the frame on time rather than test the couple; Liang cannot cancel Lu’s work for him. People, work, and times are original story premises.

heading.zh: 原创片段：问清约定，再说出在意
heading.en: Original Scene: Checking the Promise and Naming the Feeling

body.zh:
陆辛转身去取尺寸纸，宋禾才问梁青：“周六还去看展吗？”

“去，两点。”

“你们也约了周六。”她想把话说得轻一点，出口却有些硬。

梁青翻开自己的日历：“上午十点到十一点，核这个架子。我们下午那段没有改。如果工作拖了，我先告诉你，不让你站在门口等。”

“我不是要你把工作推掉。”宋禾看了一眼他桌上的字稿，“刚才你们说得很熟。我有点吃醋。那份稿你也说过想给我看，后来一直没讲完。”

他没有拿手机交给她检查，也没有当众叫陆辛离开。梁青把自己的字稿从尺子下面抽出来：“这个没有客户保密内容，可以给你看。现在要先把尺寸交出去。晚上你有空听我讲吗？”

“八点，我有空。”她说，“但周六那段，我想是我们两个人的。”

“本来就是。”

陆辛拿着尺寸纸回来，问架子的内宽。梁青回答了原定数据，陆辛记下，带走自己的材料去准备。宋禾等他们说完，才继续问字稿上那个弯角。

晚上八点，梁青实际讲完这份自己的字稿，宋禾问了她一直没看懂的部分。周六上午，两位合作者按约核完尺寸；梁青收起工具，发消息确认下午仍是两点，宋禾回复在展馆门口见。两人两点实际会合，看完展再去吃饭。

这几场兑现了分享字稿和原有约会，未把正常合作当成背叛，也未用陆辛的损失证明宋禾被珍视。宋禾可以仍羡慕那份工作熟悉；本次改变是她说清了想分享什么、梁青接住并履约，不是以后不再有不安或所有时间都归她。
body.en:
Lu turns to fetch the measurement sheet before Song asks Liang, “Are we still going to the exhibition Saturday?”

“Yes. Two.”

“You’ve also made plans for Saturday.” She means to sound casual but hears the edge in her voice.

Liang opens his own calendar. “Ten to eleven, checking this frame. Our afternoon hasn’t changed. If work runs late, I’ll tell you before you’re left waiting outside.”

“I’m not asking you to cancel work.” Song looks at his lettering draft. “You two sounded so familiar. I’m a little jealous. You said you wanted to show me that draft too, but never finished explaining it.”

He offers no phone inspection and does not order Lu away. He pulls his own draft from under a ruler. “This one has no client-confidential material. I can show you. First I need to hand over the measurements. Could I talk you through it tonight?”

“Eight works. And on Saturday, I want that part to be just us.”

“It already is.”

Lu returns asking for the frame’s inside width. Liang supplies the agreed dimensions; Lu records them and takes his materials away to prepare. Song waits for them to finish before asking about the curve in the draft.

At eight Liang actually finishes explaining his own draft, and Song asks about the part she never understood. On Saturday morning the collaborators complete their check; Liang packs his tools and confirms two by message. Song replies that she will meet him at the exhibition entrance. They actually meet at two, see the exhibition, and go for a meal.

Sharing the draft and keeping the date are fulfilled. Ordinary collaboration is not treated as betrayal, nor Lu’s loss as proof that Song matters. She may still envy their work familiarity. The change is naming the closeness she wants and receiving a kept response, not permanent freedom from unease or ownership of all his time.

heading.zh: 换一个关系阶段，就要换请求与回应
heading.en: A Different Relationship Stage Changes the Request

body.zh:
| 关系与场景 | 可以怎样写 |
|---|---|
| 尚未确认关系 | 人物可承认在意或试着邀约，对方也能拒绝；别把吃醋直接写成已获排他承诺 |
| 已有明确约定 | 核对是否改约，说明自己的需要；是否继续相处由双方回应 |
| 对方真的违约 | 不靠“其实没有情敌”免掉失约，单独处理实际发生的事 |
| 人物要求控制 | 让要求与对方反应成立；作者若写危险或失败关系，也要保留此类行为的实际作用 |
| 喜剧或稳定情侣 | 玩笑、撒娇和日常都可写；确认一次不会强制每章换一人吃醋 |

这些不是恋爱指导，也不是所有作品只能写理想人物。反应可以错误或难堪；要避免的是叙述跳过对方选择，直接把控制宣布成双方甜蜜。
body.en:
| Relationship and scene | Possible handling |
|---|---|
| Unconfirmed feelings | Admit care or invite; the other person may refuse. Jealousy establishes no exclusive promise. |
| An explicit agreement | Check whether it changed and state a need; both people answer whether to continue. |
| A real broken promise | No rival does not erase a missed agreement; address what actually happened. |
| A controlling demand | Show the demand and reply. A dangerous or failing relationship retains the behavior’s actual effect. |
| Comedy or steady partners | Jokes, playfulness, and daily life work without assigning someone jealousy every chapter. |

This is fiction craft rather than relationship advice or a demand for ideal characters. Replies may be wrong or awkward. Do not skip the other person’s choice and declare control mutual sweetness.

heading.zh: 吃醋戏显得油腻或重复时怎么改
heading.en: Repairing Contrived or Repeated Jealousy

body.zh:
| 问题 | 优先改法 |
|---|---|
| 一见异性就断定背叛 | 分开亲见事实与人物猜测；有误判就允许正常询问 |
| 第三人只能冒犯或受罚 | 保留其已定目标与行动，不让他替两人承担交流成本 |
| 抢手机、改工作被直接夸成甜 | 写请求、对方真实回应与后果，不用旁白代同意 |
| 解释完就回到同一种误会 | 继承已经确认的信息与约定，再看是否还有不同的需求 |
| 台词只有“你是我的” | 回到人物真正在意的相处与声音；作者选择占有宣言时也写清其作用 |
| 每次吃醋都立刻告白或升级 | 允许确认旧约、理解一点或仍不安，不为配额增加关系变化 |

最后连读吃醋前后的两场：那个约定是否还有效、人物是否知道了刚听过的事实、回应是否真正发生？可以直接写心理，也可以借对白和动作，让本书的表达选择先于题材默认口吻。
body.en:
| Problem | First repair |
|---|---|
| Any other person proves betrayal | Separate observation from guess; let a mistaken character ask normally. |
| A third person exists only to offend or be punished | Retain their goals and actions rather than charging them for the couple’s communication. |
| Phone seizure or changed work is simply praised | Show requests, actual replies, and consequences; narration cannot consent for someone. |
| The same mistake returns after explanation | Carry confirmed information and promises forward, then check for a different need. |
| Only “you are mine” appears | Recover specific attachment and voice; a chosen possessive declaration still needs its effect. |
| Each episode demands confession or escalation | Confirming a promise, partial understanding, or remaining unease can suffice. |

Read the scenes before and after: does the promise stand, is newly heard information retained, and has the reply happened? Interior thought, dialogue, or action can follow the book’s expression choices above genre-default tone.

q.zh: 吃醋一定要安排情敌吗？
q.en: Does jealousy require a romantic rival?

a.zh: 不必。已有约定、他人熟悉的相处或某种没被分享的生活都能触发在意。先让人物说清失落在哪里；第三人若出现，也有自己的目标，不必为了两人恋爱被写坏。
a.en: No. A promise, another person’s familiarity, or an unshared part of life can trigger care. Establish the specific loss. A third person retains a goal rather than becoming bad for the couple’s benefit.

q.zh: 写吃醋可以直接写心理吗？
q.en: Can I state jealous thoughts directly?

a.zh: 可以。人物怎样解释亲见事实很重要，直写可以帮助分清猜测与真相。按本书文风选表达，再检查请求、回应和行动是否成立，不把所有反应压成同一种动作。
a.en: Yes. Interpretation matters; direct thought can distinguish a guess from truth. Choose expression by book style, then check requests, replies, and acts rather than reducing every reaction to one gesture.

text.zh: 请 story-long-write 审阅这场吃醋戏，按本书文风列已确认关系、人物亲见事实、猜测、在意的相处与实际请求。让双方与第三人保留已有目标，检查回应和后续是否对应；不临时加出轨、不强制占有宣言或丑化第三人。
text.en: Ask story-long-write to review this jealousy scene in the book’s style: confirmed relationship, observations, guesses, desired closeness, and actual requests. Retain all three people’s goals and check matching replies and follow-through without inventing an affair, requiring a possessive declaration, or degrading the third person.

label.en: Jealousy, boundaries, and intimate needs in a genre card

label.zh: 关系阶段、独立目标与行为推导
label.en: Relationship stage, independent goals, and behavior

label.zh: 场合、目的与情绪回应
本书表达选择与事实边界

title.zh: AI配音漏读怎么办：对照定稿、分段声音与成片
title.en: How to Fix Missing Words in AI Voiceover

seo_title.zh: AI配音漏读怎么办：对照定稿、分段声音与成片
seo_title.en: How to Fix Missing Words in AI Voiceover

description.zh: 分开自动缩稿、TTS漏读和合成漏段。用原定文案、分段WAV与当前成片逐层定位，不拿完整字幕或spoken_text当已听清。
description.en: Find whether words were shortened, omitted by TTS, or lost in assembly. Compare approved text, segment audio, and the current video.

answer.zh: 先确认哪句话在当前成片里缺了，再对照送给TTS的文字和分段音频。文字已经变短，回查缩稿；文字完整而WAV漏读，修该段合成；WAV完整而成片缺失，查落点与混音。批准稿保护能阻止自动删字，不能保证供应商实际读全；字幕与元数据也不能代替回听。
answer.en: Locate the missing phrase in the current video, then compare the text sent to TTS and its segment audio. Shortened text points upstream; complete text with missing speech points to synthesis; a complete WAV missing from the video points to placement or mix. Approved-text protection blocks automatic shortening, not provider omissions. Captions and metadata do not replace listening.

heading.zh: 先确认漏在哪一层
heading.en: Locate the Layer Where Speech Is Lost

body.zh:
听当前采用成片，写下缺的是哪个字、哪句以及时间；再单听对应分段。不要先重生成整片，否则未点名的配音、音色和节奏也可能一起改变。

| 对照结果 | 下一步 |
|---|---|
| 定稿完整，送给TTS的文字变短 | 检查实际文案、清理与自动缩稿；不要用旧定稿解释当前合成 |
| 请求文字完整，分段WAV漏字 | 问题已进入合成音频；只重做或替换已点名段，再回听 |
| WAV读全，成片缺这一段或语尾 | 核对当前用到的文件、放置起止、混音与安全适配结果 |
| 字幕完整，声音漏读 | 字幕展示文字，不证明这几个字已经说出 |

Video Recap 的分段记录保留原稿、请求文字与WAV路径。这里的 `spoken_text` 是送入TTS的文字证据，并非从WAV重新听写得出的证明。即使字符串与定稿一致，仍须听音频。
body.en:
Listen to the adopted video and identify the word, phrase, and time, then listen to its segment separately. Do not regenerate everything before locating the fault.

| Comparison | Next step |
|---|---|
| Approved text is complete; the TTS request is shorter | Check current text, cleanup, and shortening instead of using an old draft to describe this synthesis. |
| Request is complete; the WAV omits words | Repair the specified synthesis and listen again. |
| WAV is complete; the video omits it or its tail | Check consumed files, actual placement, mix, and fit results. |
| Caption is complete; speech is not | Displayed text proves no utterance. |

Video Recap records authored text, the TTS request, and the WAV path. `spoken_text` is requested-text evidence, not a transcription recovered from the WAV. Even a matching string still needs listening.

heading.zh: 保护定稿能防什么
heading.en: What Approved-Text Protection Actually Prevents

body.zh:
所引版本的普通旁白路径可能在超窗时按句界缩稿，记录 `truncated`。已经采用且不允许改字的文案，要明确使用批准稿保护；仅在请求里说“不要漏字”不能当作已经启用。

`--preserve-approved-text` 保留作者原文与清理后的请求文字。整句超出可用窗口及语速预算时阻断，必需段失败不能被部分成功策略降级交付；只有舞台提示、清理后没有实读文字的段也会报错。失败后不要拿归档的旧成功元数据冒充本轮完成。

这保护的是输入文字与处理策略，未保证模型发音正确、每个字都可听见或混音没有遮盖。格式清理、自动缩稿、供应商音频和下游放置分别核对。授权改稿时也只改具体句，保留否定、数量和条件。
body.en:
The cited ordinary narration path may shorten an overlong segment at a sentence boundary and mark `truncated`. Adopted text that must remain exact needs the explicit approved-text policy; asking “do not omit words” is not proof it was enabled.

`--preserve-approved-text` retains authored text and the cleaned request. A complete line exceeding its window and tempo budget blocks the run; required failure cannot become a deliverable partial result. A segment containing only removed stage cues also fails. An archived earlier success does not represent this failed run.

The policy protects input text and processing, not correct pronunciation, audible words, or an unobscured mix. Check cleanup, shortening, provider audio, and placement separately. Authorized rewriting remains local and preserves negation, quantities, and conditions.

heading.zh: 纸面例：漏掉一个否定，意思就反了
heading.en: Paper Example: One Missing Negative Reverses Meaning

body.zh:
以下是排查练习，没有生成或试听音频。定稿是“灯还亮着，先不要合盖”，字幕也显示这句。

| 假设观察 | 判断与处理 |
|---|---|
| 请求文字只有“先合盖” | 文案已改变；恢复必要条件与否定，解决窗口冲突后再合成 |
| 请求文字完整，假设WAV只读“先合盖” | 字符串通过仍不能交付；重做该段并听“不要”是否清楚 |
| 假设WAV读全，成片缺了开头 | 查当前音频落点与可用空间，不重写全文掩盖合成错误 |
| 文件缺失或无安全放置 | 未放置就是未完成；补有效段或修时间方案，再查当前结果 |

最后把原句、实际请求、实际听到的内容和处理状态分别记下。未听过就写待听，不能照着定稿预填实听栏。否定词、数字、人名和先后条件优先核对；不要为了保住秒数截掉关键词。
body.en:
This diagnostic exercise contains no generated or listened-to media. The approved line is “The light is still on; do not close the lid yet,” also shown in the caption.

| Assumed result | Check and repair |
|---|---|
| The request says only “Close the lid” | Text changed; restore the condition and negative, resolve the window, then synthesize. |
| Request is complete; assume the WAV says only “Close it” | Matching text is insufficient; remake the segment and listen for the negative. |
| Assume WAV is complete; the video loses its opening | Check placement and available room instead of rewriting everything. |
| File is missing or no safe placement exists | Unplaced is incomplete; supply valid audio or repair timing and inspect the new result. |

Record approved wording, actual request, audible speech, and status separately. An unheard result stays unchecked rather than being copied from the script into a listening field. Prioritize negatives, numbers, names, and ordering conditions.

heading.zh: 修复示例：灯亮时等待，灯灭后才合盖
heading.en: Repair example: wait for the light, then close the lid

body.zh:
沿用“灯还亮着，先不要合盖”的原句，选择一个八秒微缩模型演示作为原创制作练习：0—4秒画面显示指示灯亮着，手停在未合的盖旁；4—6秒灯熄灭，老师原声说“灯灭了，可以合了”；6—8秒实际合盖。旁白只用原句，占0—4秒，后面保留原声。没有真实源文件或试听结论。

假设定稿与`spoken_text`都是完整原句，但问题WAV听起来是“灯还亮着，先合盖”。字幕写对也不能修声音的反义。先单听该WAV确认，再看成片是否确实用到了它，记录缺的是“不要”，不把未知问题先归到压稿或混音。

**重合成之前看缓存**：所引实现按文字、设置和WAV身份复用分段。同一文字与设置直接重跑，可能再次采用这份漏读WAV。执行者先保存问题音频和对应sidecar证据，再只让问题段退出缓存并重新合成；检查本轮确实生成了新候选，不清空所有正确段，也不拿旧成功元数据当新完成。

给问题段启用批准稿保护，文字仍是原句。新候选必须实际听清“不要”和句尾“合盖”；若仍漏读，继续保留未通过状态。若完整声音放不进0—4秒，先回报窗口冲突，按作者决定修安排，不裁掉否定或覆盖4—6秒的老师原声。

候选读全且可放后，再让合成阶段消费当前有效音频与元数据，核实际落点与字幕。正常速度从灯亮、手等待播到灯灭、老师许可和实际合盖，确认旁白没有把许可提前，老师句尾没有被切掉。记录实际听过的版本、缺字是否消失，以及完整演示中的观察。
body.en:
Keep the original line, “灯还亮着，先不要合盖” (“The light is still on; don’t close the lid yet”). Select an original eight-second miniature-model demonstration: at 0–4 seconds the indicator is on and a hand waits beside the open lid; at 4–6 it goes out and the teacher’s original audio says closing is now allowed; at 6–8 the lid actually closes. Narration uses only the original line at 0–4, leaving the later original speech. No source file or listening result exists here.

Assume approved copy and `spoken_text` contain the whole line, but the faulty WAV omits “不要,” reversing its instruction. Correct captions cannot repair that sound. Listen to the WAV, check that the finished candidate uses it and record the missing negation rather than assuming truncation or mixing before diagnosis.

**Inspect caching before regeneration:** This implementation reuses segments by text, settings and WAV identity. Rerunning unchanged input may reuse the faulty WAV. Preserve the affected audio and sidecar evidence, then invalidate only that segment and synthesize again. Confirm a new candidate was generated without clearing correct segments or treating old success metadata as current completion.

Enable approved-text protection and retain the original sentence. Actually hear the negation and final word in the new candidate. Continued omission remains a failure. If the complete voice will not fit 0–4, report the window conflict and revise the arrangement by author decision; do not cut the negation or cover the teacher at 4–6.

Once complete and placeable, let assembly consume the valid current audio and metadata, checking placement and captions. Play normally from lit indicator and waiting hand through extinguished light, permission and actual closing. Narration must not move permission earlier or cut the teacher’s ending. Record the version actually heard, whether the missing word returned and observations from the full demonstration.

heading.zh: 只修问题段，再听接点与整片
heading.en: Repair the Segment, Then Check Joins and the Full Video

body.zh:
保留未受影响的文案与声音，重新生成或采用问题段后，核对该WAV是否成为当前合成输入。音频时长变了，就检查下一句、动作和字幕的位置；缓存存在不等于本轮已使用，生成成功也不等于已经放入成片。

先单听问题句，再连播前后句，最后正常速度听成片。记录实际缺词是否修复，新的句尾是否被裁、音色和音量是否接得上。ASR可帮定位可疑词，仍要回听；有争议的读音不要让识别文本替你定稿。

这篇处理语音内容缺失。原声对白被剪点截断、字幕转写错误、声音被音乐盖住分别回对应教程，不把所有“听不见”都当同一种漏读。
body.en:
Retain unaffected wording and audio, then confirm the repaired WAV is consumed by the current assembly. A changed duration needs checks of the next line, action, and captions. A cache is not proof of current use; synthesis is not placement.

Listen to the segment, its joins, and the full video at normal speed. Record whether the missing words returned and whether the tail, voice, or level now breaks. ASR can locate suspect wording but still requires listening, especially for disputed pronunciation.

This page addresses missing speech content. Source dialogue cut at an edit, incorrect captions, and music masking speech have separate diagnoses.

q.zh: 字幕有这句话，就能证明配音没漏读吗？
q.en: Does a complete caption prove the voiceover is complete?

a.zh: 不能。字幕可以来自定稿，而不是音频。对照当前分段与成片实听，分别记录文字一致和声音完整。
a.en: No. Captions may come from the draft rather than audio. Check the current segment and video, recording text matching separately from audible completeness.

q.zh: 开启批准稿保护后，还需要听吗？
q.en: Do I still listen after protecting the approved text?

a.zh: 需要。保护阻止处理流程自动删改，供应商漏读、错误文件、放置和混音问题仍需核对。
a.en: Yes. Protection blocks processing changes; provider omissions, wrong files, placement, and mixing still need checks.

text.zh: 请 video-recap 只排查下述配音或合成问题。先确认当前采用文件与具体时间，列出能观察的事实、缺失证据和最小修订；保留定稿、未受影响声音与画面。未生成或未听审的部分标待检查，不把元数据当实听通过。
text.en: Ask video-recap to diagnose this specified voiceover or assembly problem. Identify current media and time, observations, missing evidence, and a limited repair. Preserve approved text and unaffected sound and picture; mark ungenerated or unheard parts unchecked rather than treating metadata as listening approval.

label.zh: 批准稿保护与部分成功边界
保护策略与超窗阻断
请求文字与分段音频记录
缺文件、放置与安全适配
原声与旁白的合成分工
label.en: Assembly roles for original speech and narration

title.zh: AI配音句间停顿太长怎么办：先查音频，再查时间线
title.en: How to Fix Long Pauses Between AI Voiceover Lines

seo_title.zh: AI配音句间停顿太长怎么办：先查音频，再查时间线
seo_title.en: How to Fix Long Pauses Between AI Voiceover Lines

description.zh: 区分WAV自带静音、文案窗口、呼吸设置和合成落点。用一段时间演算排查空白，不把所有停顿删光或让旁白提前泄露画面。
description.en: Separate silence inside a WAV, authored windows, pause settings, and actual placement. Includes a timing example that preserves intentional sound.

answer.zh: 先单听分段WAV，再看这句实际结束与下句实际开始。WAV尾部静音、未用完的窗口和作者特意留白可以叠加；只减pause_after_ms未必让下一句提前。判断停顿是否承担原声、动作或情绪，再只修无作用的部分。收紧旁白不能越过画面信息和已采用声音的时间。
answer.en: Listen to the segment, then compare its actual end with the next line’s actual start. WAV silence, unused window time, and intentional gaps can add up; reducing pause_after_ms need not move the next line. Retain pauses serving dialogue, action, or feeling, and repair only idle space without advancing narration beyond picture information or adopted sound.

heading.zh: 先问：是旁白停了，还是整片真的无声
heading.en: Is Narration Paused, or Is the Whole Mix Silent?

body.zh:
原对白、操作声、环境声和沉默可以承担一段内容。听见旁白停下来，不代表应该补满；画面上一个决定尚未完成，提前讲下一步也会破坏理解。

| 空白来自哪里 | 怎样定位 |
|---|---|
| 分段WAV内部 | 单听开头、句中与尾部；文件时长不等于最后一个音节的位置 |
| 输入的时间窗口 | 看上一段end与下一段start，确认作者是否有意留出原声 |
| 合成设置与实际落点 | 看实际place起止；入场延迟、上一句停顿和收紧策略可能参与 |
| 无旁白但仍有场内声音 | 连同画面判断其职责，不按旁白密度一律删除 |

先找哪一种问题，再选合成、时间线或剪辑修订。别为了“流畅”整片加速或把所有停顿归零。
body.en:
Dialogue, operation sounds, ambience, and silence may carry a passage. Narration stopping does not mean it needs filling. Explaining the next step before a visible decision finishes can harm understanding.

| Gap source | How to locate it |
|---|---|
| Inside the WAV | Listen to its opening, interior, and tail; duration is not the last syllable’s position. |
| Authored window | Compare the previous end and next start; check whether source sound was deliberately left room. |
| Assembly and placement | Inspect actual starts and ends; delay, prior pause, and tightening may participate. |
| No narration, other sound present | Judge its job with the picture rather than deleting it for narration density. |

Choose synthesis, timeline, or edit repair after locating the cause. Neither global speed-up nor zero pauses is a universal solution.

heading.zh: 为什么改段尾停顿可能没有用
heading.en: Why Changing the Pause Field May Not Solve It

body.zh:
所引旁白合成先用段长减去 `pause_after_ms` 来估计语音空间，并有最小空间限制；这不是已经听到的停顿测量。下游另按实际音频、入场延迟和前段结束放置。

关闭段内收紧或进入新段落时，下一句仍尊重作者起点与入场条件；段内收紧则比较前句实际收尾、短间隔与允许提前的下限，不单靠上一句的pause字段。作者留出较长间隙时会视为新段，不自动把所有话挤到前面。

因此，要核对当前实际使用的策略与放置结果，不只修改一个数字。若声音已经采用为完整混音，重新收紧会改变它；按本轮授权选择修订，不在“保留已定声音”的任务里偷偷重放置。
body.en:
The cited synthesis estimates room from segment length minus `pause_after_ms`, with a minimum-room floor. That is a budget, not a measurement of audible silence. Assembly separately places audio using its duration, entry delay, and the prior segment’s end.

With tightening disabled or a new run starting, the next line still honors its authored start and entry conditions. Within a tightened run, placement compares the previous actual end, a short gap, and the earliest permitted start; the prior pause field alone does not control it. A sufficiently large authored gap starts a new run rather than pulling every sentence forward.

Inspect the actual policy and placement instead of changing one number. Re-tightening changes an adopted complete mix; follow the authorized repair scope rather than silently re-placing retained sound.

heading.zh: 纸面演算：四点二秒空白从哪里来
heading.en: Paper Timing Example: Where 4.2 Seconds Come From

body.zh:
以下假设关闭收紧、没有入场延迟且不变速，没有生成或听审媒体。A窗口10–13秒，WAV放在10–12.4秒；假设最后音节在11.8秒，后面0.6秒为WAV尾部静音。B窗口16–19秒，放置与开口都从16秒开始。A的段尾pause为0.3秒。

| 区间 | 意义 |
|---|---|
| 11.8–12.4 | A的WAV尾部静音，0.6秒 |
| 12.4–13 | A窗口尚未用完，0.6秒 |
| 13–16 | 两个作者窗口之间的留白，3秒 |
| 11.8–16 | 旁白听觉间隙合计4.2秒；是否整片静音另听其他轨 |

前段文件结束12.4秒，加0.3秒仍只到12.7，早于B原定16秒。将pause减到0并不能单独把B移到13秒；假定的三秒作者留白仍在。

若13–16秒保留必要原对白，就保持它。若实际素材只是重复工具展示、确实没有需要等待的信息，可以提出删这三秒画面，同时重算B及后续落点与字幕；不是只让B提前说、画面却仍在旧时刻。先确认源素材与表达要求，再制作候选。
body.en:
Assume tightening is off, with no entry delay or speed change. No media was generated or listened to. A’s window is 10–13, its WAV placed at 10–12.4. Assume the final syllable is at 11.8, followed by 0.6 seconds of WAV silence. B’s window is 16–19, with placement and speech beginning at 16. A has a 0.3-second pause field.

| Interval | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 11.8–12.4 | A’s WAV tail silence: 0.6 seconds |
| 12.4–13 | Unused A window: 0.6 seconds |
| 13–16 | Authored gap: 3 seconds |
| 11.8–16 | Narration gap totals 4.2; other tracks determine whether the whole mix is silent. |

The preceding file ends at 12.4; adding 0.3 reaches only 12.7, before B’s authored 16. Zeroing the pause alone does not move B to 13; the three-second authored gap remains.

Retain necessary source dialogue at 13–16. If actual footage only repeats a tool display and no information needs waiting, propose removing those three picture seconds and recalculating B, later placements, and captions. Do not merely advance speech while the picture stays on its old clock. Confirm source footage and expression before producing a candidate.

heading.zh: 修后听三处，再连画面看
heading.en: Listen at Three Places, Then Watch
