heading.en: Return Without Repeating or Resetting History

body.zh:
再次经过花园时，可以突出还要带回的篮，而不完整重播园丁首次介绍。画册已经在手，画室旧领取按钮不能再生成一本；未经许可先试私门时，则保持原位置并让庄婶说明需要先问。

如果玩家走公共主路，庄婶不能说“你答应的篮呢”，因为这条代表路径没有这个承诺。返回反馈读取实际路径，可以给相同院口不同的回应，但不必为每条路复制一整张地图。

重开、回滚或载入是否恢复路线与物件，另按本作[存档约定](/novel-to-game/design-story-game-saves)处理，不由返回场景自行清空。
body.en:
On a return to the garden, emphasize the outstanding basket rather than repeating the entire introduction. An already-held sketchbook cannot be duplicated by an old collection action. Trying the private gate before permission retains position and prompts asking Zhuang.

The representative public path has no basket promise, so Zhuang cannot demand it as promised. Read actual history for different courtyard replies without copying a complete map per route.

Restart, rollback, and loading follow [save rules](/novel-to-game/design-story-game-saves); returning does not itself reset objects or routes.

heading.zh: 先走通，再验证玩家怎样看懂路线
heading.en: Check Causality, Then Observe Navigation

body.zh:
纸面先走主路、捷径和一次缺条件路径，记录位置、持物、地图连接、知情与承诺；重点找未抵达就交物、未许可就穿门、返回后复制物件或串入另一支义务。

若风险只是这些因果，文本沙箱可以先查。若承诺玩家真实走位、视线、相机或地形操作，就要合适引擎原型；能读懂文字不证明转角看得见地标。实际候选里观察玩家最先看哪处、走错后能否找回、拿到目标后是否知道返回，而不由设计表宣称导航完成。

路线太长时，先删没有新作用的停留或重复，不靠自动传送跳过本作本来要玩家判断的部分。
body.en:
On paper, walk main, shortcut, and a missing-condition path, recording position, possession, links, knowledge, and promises. Look for transfers before arrival, gates crossed without permission, duplicated objects, or another branch’s obligations.

A text sandbox can check causal risk. Movement, sightlines, camera, or terrain need an appropriate engine prototype; readable prose does not prove a landmark is visible around a corner. Observe attention, recovery from wrong turns, and return direction in the candidate rather than declaring navigation complete from a table.

For excessive length, remove purposeless stops or repeats instead of teleporting over the promised judgments.

q.zh: 探索地图越大越好吗？
q.en: Is a larger exploration map better?

a.zh: 不一定。先看地点是否提供判断、行动、体验或必要连接。没有作用的距离和房间会增加制作与记忆成本。
a.en: Not necessarily. Check decisions, actions, experience, or necessary links. Unused distance and rooms add production and memory cost.

q.zh: 返回同一个地点，要写完全不同的新场景吗？
q.en: Does returning require a completely new scene?

a.zh: 不用。保留空间，读取这次实际持物、知情和承诺，突出变化即可。无关首次介绍可缩短，未发生的分支不能带进来。
a.en: No. Retain space, read actual possession, knowledge, and promises, and emphasize changes. Compress irrelevant introductions without importing an unchosen branch.

text.zh: 用 $game-world-design 检查这段探索路线。附地图连接、当前目标、已见地标、主路和可选路的条件；从初态走到取物与返回，核实际位置、持物、已知信息和承诺。只补会影响判断的地点，不加空房间凑规模，也不把文字走读当导航体验验证。
text.en: Use $game-world-design to review exploration with map links, goal, seen landmarks, and route conditions. Walk from the initial state through retrieval and return, checking position, possession, knowledge, and promises. Add only decision-relevant places and do not equate text walkthroughs with navigation validation.

label.zh: 空间路线、地标与局面变化
知识、物件与返回回响
位置前置与实际归属

title.zh: 小说友情线怎么写：共同经历，也有各自生活
title.en: How to Write a Friendship Arc

seo_title.zh: 小说友情线怎么写
seo_title.en: Write a Friendship Arc

description.zh: 让友情有具体相处、独立目标和可信变化。附摄影展与陶艺课的原创片段，友情不用靠背叛或恋爱证明分量。
description.en: Give friends shared habits, independent goals, and credible change. Includes an original photography-show scene without compulsory betrayal or romance.

answer.zh: 先写两人怎样相处，让读者认识这段友情值得保留什么，再让各自生活带来新的需要。朋友可以支持、争执、拒绝，也可以只是一起开心；写清对方怎样回应以及后来怎样相处，不把随叫随到当友情的唯一证明。关系变化不一定变坏，也不必最终变成恋爱。
answer.en: Establish how these people enjoy being together and what makes the friendship worth keeping. Independent lives bring new needs. Friends can help, argue, decline, or simply have fun; show the reply and later contact without treating constant availability as the only proof. Change need not mean deterioration or romance.

heading.zh: 从两个人相处的趣味开始
heading.en: Begin With the Pleasure of Their Company

body.zh:
“多年好友”能交代时间，却不能独自给出关系质感。可以写他们怎样开玩笑、分享喜欢的东西、记得彼此的小偏好，或者能在对方面前说出平时难说的话。帮助与牺牲都能成立，轻松相处本身也有价值。

Oh Story 的关系方法把联盟、亲密与冲突分开，要求人物有自身动机；情感方法用具体经历建立羁绊。本文组合这些方法处理友情，不把恋爱好感度或“每段关系必须背叛一次”移作友情验收线。

重要的关系可以在改变生活安排时显出分量，也可以通过稳定陪伴深化。不是只有翻脸才算有戏。
body.en:
“Friends for years” gives duration but not texture. Show their jokes, shared interests, remembered preferences, or the things they can say in each other’s company. Help and sacrifice can matter; easy enjoyment also has value.

Oh Story distinguishes alliance, intimacy, and conflict while deriving conduct from personal motives. Its emotional methods build bonds through specifics. This page combines those methods for friendship rather than importing romance affinity levels or a compulsory betrayal test.

A bond can reveal its weight as routines change or deepen through steady company. A falling-out is not the only possible drama.

heading.zh: 别让一个朋友只负责成全另一个
heading.en: Let Both Friends Have a Life

body.zh:
给两个人都写想完成的事，也写对这段友情的不同需要。一个盼人陪自己撑场，另一个愿意来看，却不能取消已报名的课；差异就能产生交流，不必把其中一个改成坏人。

| 要看什么 | 场景里的依据 |
|---|---|
| 原有相处 | 哪种习惯让两人觉得自在 |
| 各自目标 | 即使本场不帮忙，仍在做什么 |
| 当前需要 | 请求的是全程陪伴、片刻见面，还是只想被听见 |
| 后来相处 | 接受、拒绝或另约之后，实际发生什么 |

这是编辑用表，不是 skill 的原生友情公式。朋友也可以为对方自愿改变安排；重点是选择有来处，而不是友情禁止让步。
body.en:
Give each person something to pursue and a distinct need from the friendship. One wants company throughout an event; the other wants to visit but keep an enrolled class. That difference supports an exchange without turning either person into a villain.

| Check | Scene evidence |
|---|---|
| Earlier contact | A habit that feels easy together. |
| Individual goal | What each pursues without this favor. |
| Present need | Full company, a brief meeting, or being heard. |
| Later contact | What follows acceptance, refusal, or a new arrangement. |

This is an editorial table, not a native friendship formula. A friend may freely change plans; the point is a motivated choice, not a ban on compromise.

heading.zh: 原创片段：不陪全程，也认真来看你的作品
heading.en: Original Passage: A Short Visit That Still Matters

body.zh:
唐禾和祝乔是多年好友，常在周末看完展去喝茶。祝乔总先看照片边缘，唐禾则爱给她的陶杯挑名字。唐禾周六办第一次社区摄影展，九点到十七点开放；祝乔已报陶艺课，当天十六点下课，之前也告诉过她。唐禾仍想让好友整天在场。以下为原创示范。

> “你坐入口那张椅子吧，我每次一回头都能看见你。”唐禾说。
>
> 祝乔把展览小卡放在桌上。“我上午和下午都上课。能四点半到，赶你收展前看。”
>
> “我知道。只是第一回办，怕冷场。”
>
> “椅子坐满不等于展办好了。”祝乔把卡翻过来，“你给我留一点时间，讲讲那只猫为什么只露半张脸。”
>
> 唐禾看着那张照片。猫真正在看的是框外的水碗，她自己倒老想着入口那把椅子。
>
> “好。你来我再讲，别为了赶路没做完杯子。”

周六唐禾照常布展、接待来客。祝乔十六点半实际到场，唐禾带她从第一张看到最后一张；祝乔问到猫照片的边缘，她把水碗在框外的取舍讲完。收展后，两人照常喝茶，祝乔拿出当天做杯子的照片，唐禾给歪了一点的杯耳起名“侧着听”。她们笑了好一会儿。

展览是唐禾自己办成的，祝乔没有放弃课。一次短相聚仍有认真关注，也保留两人的趣味。唐禾以后是否不再要求全程陪伴，要由后文支持；本场只完成了这次安排与实际见面。视角里的判断属于唐禾，不替祝乔宣布内心。
body.en:
Tang He and Zhu Qiao have been friends for years and often have tea after visiting shows. Zhu checks a photograph’s edges first; Tang likes naming her pottery cups. Tang’s first community photography show opens Saturday from nine to five. Zhu’s enrolled class ends at four, as she already told Tang. Tang still wants her there all day. Original demonstration:

> “Sit in the chair by the entrance. I could look back and see you,” Tang said.
>
> Zhu laid down the exhibition card. “I have class morning and afternoon. I can come at four-thirty, before you close.”
>
> “I know. It’s my first show. I’m afraid nobody will come.”
>
> “A full chair won’t make the show work.” Zhu turned the card over. “Save time to tell me why that cat shows only half its face.”
>
> Tang looked at the photograph. The cat had been watching a water bowl outside the frame, while she kept thinking about the entrance chair.
>
> “All right. I’ll tell you when you come. Don’t leave your cup unfinished to rush.”

Tang sets up and receives visitors. Zhu actually arrives at four-thirty; Tang takes her through the photographs. Asked about the cat’s edge, she explains the decision to leave its water bowl outside the frame. After closing, they have tea. Zhu shows a photo of the cup made that day. Tang names its slightly crooked handle “Listening Sideways.” They laugh for a while.

Tang runs her show; Zhu keeps her class. The brief visit contains attention and their shared pleasure. Later text would need to support any lasting change in Tang’s wish for full-time company. This scene establishes this arrangement and meeting. Interior judgment belongs to Tang, without assigning Zhu an unspoken feeling.

heading.zh: 友情可以换一种相处，不必先失去它
heading.en: Let the Friendship Find a New Form

body.zh:
住得远、工作变忙、兴趣不同，都可以让相处改变。写具体：以前随时碰面，后来另约时间；以前一个人总听，后来两个人都讲自己的事。温暖可以继续，偶尔失落也可以保留。

如果作者选择疏远或决裂，再找真正的原因和行动后果，别靠“长大了就必定散”替代过程。若写一场争执，见[争吵场景](/oh-story/write-an-argument-scene)；若写友情转恋爱，另外核新的心意与双方回答，不把普通关心一律当恋爱证据。
body.en:
Distance, work, and differing interests may change contact. Specify it: spontaneous meetings become arrangements; one usual listener also gets to talk. Warmth can continue alongside occasional disappointment.

For a chosen estrangement or rupture, show its causes and consequences instead of invoking inevitable adulthood. Use the [argument scene](/oh-story/write-an-argument-scene) for a confrontation. A romantic turn requires new feelings and replies; ordinary care need not be evidence of attraction.

heading.zh: 改稿时，先找朋友自己的行动
heading.en: Review Each Friend’s Own Actions

body.zh:
| 问题 | 先修什么 |
|---|---|
| 朋友只负责夸主角 | 给他自己的审美、趣味、目标与回应 |
| 没有牺牲就被称不够真 | 看具体关注与自愿选择，不按付出大小评级 |
| 一次拒绝就突然翻脸 | 核原有约定、人物经历与本次需要 |
| 友情最后必变恋爱 | 按作者选定关系收束，友情本身可以是终点 |

**改稿提示：**列出两人各自目标、旧相处和本次请求，指出哪些回应在原文已经发生。只修没有依据的关系跳跃，保留作者选定文风与结局。别为了制造考验添加事故、背叛或秘密爱情。
body.en:
| Problem | First repair |
|---|---|
| A friend only praises the protagonist | Restore taste, humor, goals, and replies. |
| No sacrifice means no friendship | Examine specific attention and free choices rather than ranking costs. |
| One refusal instantly ends the bond | Check old arrangements, experience, and current needs. |
| Friendship must end in romance | Follow the chosen relationship; friendship can be the destination. |

**Revision prompt:** list both goals, earlier contact, and the current request. Identify replies already present. Repair unsupported relationship leaps while preserving the chosen voice and ending. Add no accident, betrayal, or secret attraction merely to test the bond.

q.zh: 友情线一定要安排背叛或牺牲吗？
q.en: Must friendship include betrayal or sacrifice?

a.zh: 不必。分歧、生活安排改变、认真听对方或共同享受一件事，都能显示关系。需要重大考验时按已有情节来写，不把考验类型当配额。
a.en: No. Differences, changed routines, attention, and shared enjoyment can reveal a bond. Use a major test when the chosen story supports it, without a quota of test types.

q.zh: 两个人目标不同，还能写成很好的朋友吗？
q.en: Can friends have different goals?

a.zh: 可以。不同目标让他们有各自生活，也能学会理解和安排相处。不必一人完全围着另一个转；主动帮忙也不因此失去自身目标。
a.en: Yes. Different goals support independent lives and changed contact. Neither needs to orbit the other, and freely offered help need not erase a personal goal.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 检查友情线。附两人的旧相处、各自目标、当下约定和片段；指出关系变化由哪次交流与行动支持。保留已有温暖与独立生活，只修点名范围，不添加背叛、事故或爱情来强造分量。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to review a friendship with earlier habits, independent goals, present arrangements, and the passage. Identify the exchanges and actions supporting change. Preserve warmth and independent lives, revising only the named scope without invented betrayal, accidents, or romance.

label.en: Relationship types, independent goals, and conduct

label.zh: 具体羁绊与意义变化
交流目标与回应
文风与故事事实分开裁决

title.zh: 小说道歉场景怎么写：承认什么，对方怎样回应
title.en: How to Write an Apology Scene

seo_title.zh: 小说道歉场景怎么写
seo_title.en: Write an Apology Scene

description.zh: 从具体错误、交流目标和对方回应写道歉。附封面署名被抢的原创场景，分清说出歉意、实际修复和恢复信任。
description.en: Build an apology from a specific wrong, conversational purpose, and reply. Includes an original cover-credit scene separating admission, repair, and trust.

answer.zh: 写清人物为哪件事道歉，而不是只让他说“我错了”。承认与解释可以同时存在，解释却不能把已经造成的后果取消；对方可以接受修复、暂缓亲近或不原谅。道歉如何影响关系，要由实际回应和后续行为支持，不由旁白替双方宣布。
answer.en: Name the specific wrong rather than stopping at “I was wrong.” An explanation can accompany admission without undoing consequences. The other person may accept a repair, delay closeness, or decline forgiveness. Replies and later conduct establish the relationship change, not a narrator’s declaration for both.

heading.zh: 先确定他承认的是哪件事
heading.en: Name the Wrong Being Admitted

body.zh:
“让你不开心”有时绕开了实际行为：抢走署名、失约、泄露别人不愿公开的话。把原因落到本场已经发生的事，读者才知道这份歉意回应什么。

Oh Story 的对白方法先找双方议程，让回应接住上一句情绪；关系方法从人物已有目标与状态推导行为。本文据此组织道歉场景，不宣称 skill 内置一种道歉话术，也不把长短台词当责任大小的刻度。人物可以直说，潜台词不是必须遮住认错。
body.en:
“Making you unhappy” may avoid the actual act: taking credit, missing an arrangement, or revealing something another person did not want shared. Name what happened so readers understand what the apology answers.

Oh Story’s dialogue methods identify both agendas and emotionally responsive replies; its relationship methods derive conduct from established goals and state. This page applies them to an apology without claiming a native apology script or measuring responsibility by line length. Direct admission can fit; subtext need not conceal it.

heading.zh: 给对方一个与自身需要有关的回答
heading.en: Give the Other Person a Reply of Their Own

body.zh:
道歉者可能想弥补，也可能急于结束尴尬。受影响的人可能要公开更正、归还物品、重新安排合作，或者今天不想继续谈。两人的需要未必一致。

| 层面 | 要区分的事 |
|---|---|
| 承认 | 是否说清自己做了什么 |
| 解释 | 是否解释原因，还是借原因否认后果 |
| 修复 | 做了什么，哪些仍无法撤回 |
| 回应 | 对方接受了哪一项，拒绝或暂缓哪一项 |

这张表是编辑组合工具，不是必须四段念完的台词模板。一声简短“对不起”也能有力，只要前后文已让责任与回应可读。
body.en:
The apologizer may want repair or a quick end to embarrassment. The affected person may want a public correction, a returned object, changed cooperation, or no more conversation today. Their needs can differ.

| Layer | Distinction |
|---|---|
| Admission | Naming one’s actual act. |
| Explanation | Explaining a cause versus denying its consequence. |
| Repair | What happens and what cannot be withdrawn. |
| Reply | What is accepted, refused, or deferred. |

This editorial combination is not a four-paragraph speech template. A brief “sorry” can work when context makes responsibility and response readable.

heading.zh: 原创片段：先更正那句“我做的”
heading.en: Original Passage: Correct “I Made It” First

body.zh:
社区小册子的封面由葛简独立画成，江澄做文字排版；印在册子上的署名本来正确。六人的展示筹备会上，主持问“封面也是你做的？”，江澄急着接过夸奖，回答“是”，主持随即把展示记录中的封面作者填成江澄。葛简在场，听到后没有再参与闲聊。散会江澄追上她，以下为原创片段。

> “刚才那句是我说错了。封面是你画的，我只排版。”
>
> “你不是不知道。”葛简说。
>
> “知道。我想顺着夸奖接下去。这是原因，不是你的封面就成了我的。”
>
> 葛简把自己的画稿收进包里。“先把会上说法改过来。晚饭今天不一起了。”
>
> 江澄拿出手机，向包含原来六人的筹备群发出更正：“刚才我回答错了。封面作者是葛简，排版是我，请展示介绍按原署名说。”他把已发送的消息给她看，没有再问她是不是消气了。

主持随后回复已看到，并实际把展示记录里的封面作者改为葛简；葛简核对后说“更正看到了”。她仍按自己的安排离开，没有接受晚饭。江澄把自己负责的排版继续完成。

本例已经完成具体承认、消息更正和展示记录修复；葛简确认更正，不等于确认恢复亲近。消息发到原群，也不能证明每名成员都已读或所有印象已消除。江澄以后怎样面对夸奖，需另有行为支持，不靠一句道歉宣布长期成长。
body.en:
Ge Jian drew a community booklet’s cover alone; Jiang Cheng laid out its text. The printed credit is correct. In a six-person exhibition-planning meeting, the host asks whether Jiang also made the cover. Eager to accept praise, he answers yes; the host enters Jiang as cover artist in the exhibition record. Ge hears and stops joining the casual talk. Jiang catches up after the meeting. Original passage:

> “That answer was wrong. You drew the cover. I did the layout.”
>
> “You knew that,” Ge said.
>
> “I did. I wanted to keep accepting the praise. That explains my answer; it doesn’t make your cover mine.”
>
> Ge put her drawing into her bag. “Correct what you said at the meeting first. I’m not having dinner together today.”
>
> Jiang sent a message to the planning group containing the same six people: “My answer was wrong. Ge Jian is the cover artist; I did layout. Please use the original credit in the display introduction.” He showed the sent message without asking whether she had stopped being angry.

The host replies and actually corrects the exhibition record’s cover credit. Ge checks and says, “I’ve seen the correction.” She still leaves on her own plans without accepting dinner. Jiang finishes his assigned layout.

The specific admission, sent correction, and record repair happen. Ge’s acknowledgment does not establish restored closeness. Posting to the original group does not prove every member read it or every impression vanished. Later conduct would need to support any lasting change in Jiang’s response to praise.

heading.zh: 真诚、笨拙与操纵，要由内容和后果区分
heading.en: Distinguish Sincerity, Awkwardness, and Manipulation

body.zh:
台词流利不等于真诚，说得笨拙也不等于敷衍。看他有没有承认事实、接住对方要求、实际做所说的修复，还是把“我已经道歉了”用来要求立刻恢复原状。

作者也可以写失败或不真诚的道歉。让读者看出它怎样转移责任，人物又怎样回应，不把一段漂亮话自动当成有效改变。对方本来愿意原谅，也可写温暖接受；不要求每场都拒绝才显得高级。
body.en:
Fluent words do not prove sincerity, and awkward speech does not prove indifference. Examine admission, attention to the reply, and actual repair, or whether “I apologized” demands immediate restoration.

A failed or insincere apology can be intentional. Make its responsibility shift and the response readable rather than treating polished speech as change. Warm acceptance is also possible when supported; refusal is not a mandatory mark of sophistication.

heading.zh: 改稿时，不用苦衷抹掉原来的错
heading.en: Keep the Original Wrong Visible in Revision

body.zh:
| 问题 | 修改方向 |
|---|---|
| 只说“对不起”，读者不知道为哪件事 | 借已有前文或一句具体承认交代 |
| 临时添加巨大苦衷 | 核是否已有依据；原因不自动取消责任 |
| 把接受修复写成全原谅 | 收到对方实际说出、做出的变化 |
| 宣布永久改好 | 看后文相似情境中的行为 |

**改稿提示：**列出原错、已发生后果、双方目标、道歉与回应，指出跳过了哪一步因果。只修指定片段，保留文风与选定结局；不代造苦衷、替对方原谅或抹掉已发生损失。跨全书改变见[人物弧光](/oh-story/character-arc)，关系恢复见[亲情和解](/oh-story/write-a-family-reconciliation-scene)。
body.en:
| Problem | Revision direction |
|---|---|
| “Sorry” without a readable object | Use existing context or a specific admission. |
| A sudden enormous excuse | Check its established basis; a cause does not erase responsibility. |
| Accepting repair becomes total forgiveness | Limit the conclusion to actual replies and conduct. |
| Permanent reform is declared | Examine later behavior under similar pressure. |

**Revision prompt:** list the wrong, consequences, goals, apology, and reply. Identify missing causality, then revise only the named passage with voice and ending preserved. Invent no excuse, forgiveness, or erased loss. Use the [character arc](/oh-story/character-arc) for book-length change and [family reconciliation](/oh-story/write-a-family-reconciliation-scene) for restored contact.

q.zh: 道歉之后一定要和好吗？
q.en: Must an apology lead to reconciliation?

a.zh: 不必。可以只承认并修复一件事，也可以暂时不恢复亲近。作者要写和好时，用对方真实回答和后续相处支持它。
a.en: No. An admission and one repair can happen without restored closeness. For reconciliation, support it through the other person’s reply and later contact.

q.zh: 道歉场景能不能直接写“对不起”？
q.en: Can the character simply say “sorry”?

a.zh: 可以。具体错误已经清楚时，简短台词可能更符合人物。不要把长篇解释当真诚的固定证明，也不要机械禁止直说。
a.en: Yes. A brief line can fit when the wrong is already clear. Lengthy explanation is not a fixed proof of sincerity, and direct speech need not be banned.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 检查道歉片段。附原错、已经造成的后果、双方目标和后文；区分承认、解释、修复行动与对方回答。保留已知事实和作者结局，只修指定句段，不替受影响者原谅，也不补新苦衷免除责任。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to review an apology with the wrong, consequences, both goals, and later text. Separate admission, explanation, repair, and reply. Preserve facts and the chosen ending, revising only the named passage without granting forgiveness for another person or inventing excuses.

label.zh: 对话议程、情绪承接与因果
label.en: Dialogue agendas, emotional replies, and causality

label.zh: 从既有目标与行为推导回应
label.en: Deriving replies from established goals and conduct

label.zh: 事件触发的变化与可见兑现
作者选择与既有事实

title.zh: 小说追逐戏怎么写：路线、距离与改变策略
title.en: How to Write a Chase Scene

seo_title.zh: 小说追逐戏怎么写
seo_title.en: Write a Chase Scene

description.zh: 先定追赶目标和完整路线，再写双方选择如何改变距离。附仓区追逐原创片段，不靠临时出口或对手突然停下解围。
description.en: Establish the objective and route, then show choices changing pursuit. Includes an original warehouse chase without a last-minute exit or frozen pursuer.

answer.zh: 先说清谁追谁、为何追、追到或跑到哪里才算本场结果。读者要跟得上关键路线和双方回应，不必记住整张地图；障碍应改变走法或距离，不能只增加动作词。到达一个地点、交出物件和彻底脱险分别判断，后面的追赶与消耗照前文继续。
answer.en: Establish who pursues whom, why, and what counts as this scene’s outcome. Readers need the key route and both responses rather than a complete map. Obstacles should affect routes or distance beyond extra verbs. Arrival, handoff, and escape are distinct; ongoing pursuit and established costs continue afterward.

heading.zh: 先定本场追逐要交付什么
heading.en: Choose the Outcome Before the Sprint

body.zh:
追逐可以为了抓住一个人、抢回物件、摆脱跟随，或把重要东西先送出去。对手也有目的：要人、要物，还是只想阻止到达？目标不同，会改变拦截和转向的选择。

Oh Story 把追逐列为叙事元素，战斗方法则先定结果与条件、再安排动作。本文把这些方法用于移动中的追赶，未把它称为独立追逐 skill。跑得更快不自动解决所有问题，逃跑者也未必需要战胜追赶者。
body.en:
A chase may aim to catch someone, recover an object, lose a follower, or send something ahead. The pursuer may want the person, the object, or simply prevent arrival. These goals shape interception and turns.

Oh Story lists pursuit as a narrative element; its combat methods choose outcomes and conditions before actions. This page applies those methods to a moving chase without claiming a separate native chase skill. Greater speed need not solve everything, and the runner may not need to defeat the pursuer.

heading.zh: 让读者认出关键路线，不列整张街区图
heading.en: Make the Relevant Route Readable

body.zh:
写清起点、一次关键岔路、障碍与终点之间的连接。必要地标可以先进入人物观察，也可以随行动第一次出现；影响破局的捷径、门和工具要有可用依据，不能在结果需要时才凭空补出。

| 记录 | 要检查什么 |
|---|---|
| 位置 | 过门、拐弯、进入通道前后各在哪里 |
| 距离 | 哪次阻挡、选择或能力让人追近/拉开 |
| 持物 | 是否一直携带，什么时候实际递出 |
| 对方回应 | 有没有跟随、换路、拦截或被真实挡住 |

不要求每步报米数。一个拐角隔断视线、门口足以伸手的距离，都可以够用；“差点抓到”要与实际位置相容。
body.en:
Connect the start, a meaningful fork, an obstacle, and the destination. Landmarks can appear in prior observation or as the route unfolds; an escape-enabling shortcut, door, or tool needs a usable basis rather than appearing for convenience.

| Record | Check |
|---|---|
| Position | Where each person is before and after a turn or doorway. |
| Distance | What choice, obstacle, or ability closes or opens the gap. |
| Possession | What remains carried and when it is actually handed over. |
| Response | Following, changing route, intercepting, or being genuinely blocked. |

Exact meters are optional. A corner interrupting sight or reaching distance at a door may suffice, provided “almost caught” matches positions.

heading.zh: 原创片段：先把纸包递进去，人还没进去
heading.en: Original Passage: The Packet Gets Inside First

body.zh:
原创仓区故事：周宁手里拿着自己拍下并打印的登记页，已发现仓管殷衡擅改数量，想交给值守员复核。殷衡要抢回纸包，已在北库门口试过夺取。周宁先前来过这里，知道北门外晒架区有两路通向东门：左路较宽但绕，右路窄且短；东门外的直通道尽头是值守室，室外投递窗可交东西，不能从窗钻人。值守员今天在室内，前文已看见。

> 周宁攥住纸包，出北门往左绕。他怕在窄路被追上时无处侧让，宁愿绕远。回头看见殷衡进了右侧窄路，他知道那条路短，没有把拐弯当成甩脱。
>
> 晒架挡着内侧，他沿外缘过。到东门时，殷衡从右路口追上来，伸手碰到了包角。周宁把纸包收向胸前，包没脱手；他转出东门，继续往通道尽头跑。
>
> “把东西留下！”
>
> 值守室就在前面，门关着，投递窗开着。周宁没有停在门外找钥匙，把纸包伸向窗里：“请先收着，看登记数量。”
>
> 值守员在室内接稳，他才松手。再回身时，殷衡已到两步外。周宁背后是墙，值守室的门仍没开。

纸包经过实际接收留在室内，周宁仍在通道，不是整个人已经安全。殷衡走较短路使距离缩小，没为主角递东西而突然停机；后文怎样处理两步距离，要继续依靠已建立条件。若作者要本场写到完全脱险，就须另写有依据的过程，不能用“到了值守室”代替。

这份原创文本按周宁所知、所见与所闻写，不跳进殷衡内心。
body.en:
Original warehouse story: Zhou Ning carries copies of register pages he photographed and printed. He has discovered manager Yin Heng changed quantities and wants the duty attendant to check them. Yin tried to take the packet at the north warehouse door. Zhou has visited before: the drying-rack area outside the north door has a wider, longer left route and a narrow, shorter right route to the east gate. Outside that gate, a straight passage ends at the duty room. Its delivery window passes objects, not people. The attendant was shown inside earlier today.

> Zhou gripped the packet and went left outside the north door. He wanted room to dodge a reaching hand if caught, preferring the longer path to the cramped one. Looking back, he saw Yin take the narrow right route. He knew it was shorter; the turn had not ended pursuit.
>
> Racks blocked the inner edge. He followed the outside. At the east gate, Yin emerged from the right route and reached the packet’s corner. Zhou drew it against his chest without losing it, turned outside, and ran down the passage.
>
> “Leave it!”
>
> The duty room was ahead, its door closed and delivery window open. Zhou did not stop to search for a key. He extended the packet through the window. “Please hold this. Check the quantities.”
>
> The attendant secured it before Zhou let go. When he turned, Yin was two steps away. The wall was behind Zhou, and the room’s door had not opened.

The packet is actually received inside; Zhou remains outside. Yin’s shorter path closes the gap rather than freezing him for the handoff. Resolving the remaining two steps requires further established conditions. A chosen complete escape would need that process, not merely “reached the duty room.”

This original passage follows Zhou’s knowledge and perceptions without entering Yin’s mind.

heading.zh: 快不等于每个动作都写短句
heading.en: Let Speed Follow Attention and Change

body.zh:
关键碰到包角、收回、接稳再松手，要留足过程。连续绕路可以概述，前提是读者仍能跟上它怎样改变距离。心理只留影响这次行动的判断，如知道右路更短，不停下来回忆整段旧史。

写作方法允许追逐连续处在动作中，不要求每节塞一个停顿或受伤。长短句按本书文风与注意点安排；真实疲劳、伤势或丢失的东西继续有效，不为“节奏更快”直接消除。
body.en:
Leave enough process for the packet corner, withdrawal, secure receipt, and release. Summarize routine movement when its effect on pursuit stays clear. Keep thoughts relevant to a decision, such as knowing the right route is shorter, without stopping for an entire history.

The writing methods allow sustained action in a chase without a pause or injury quota. Sentence length follows the book’s voice and attention. Established fatigue, wounds, or lost objects remain effective rather than disappearing to accelerate pacing.

heading.zh: 查对手有没有消失，出口有没有临时长出来
heading.en: Check the Pursuer and the Available Exits

body.zh:
| 问题 | 优先修改 |
|---|---|
| 一转弯就直接甩脱 | 补真实遮挡、距离或换路依据 |
| 追赶者一直只喊不动 | 写符合目标的行动与可见回应 |
| 屋里屋外突然切换 | 核跨门、位置与实际进入 |
| 找到接应处就宣布全安全 | 分清到达、交接与本人脱险 |
| 招式、路名太多却没有变化 | 留影响追赶的节点，压缩纯重复 |

**改稿提示：**逐段列关键位置、持物、路线和对方回应，指出哪次动作造成距离变化。保留既有条件与选定终点，只改空间和因果断点，不造新出口、救兵、消耗恢复或对手停机。
body.en:
| Problem | First repair |
|---|---|
| A turn automatically loses pursuit | Supply actual cover, separation, or route logic. |
| The pursuer only shouts | Restore goal-driven action and visible response. |
| Outside becomes inside without passage | Check the doorway and actual entry. |
| Reaching support means total safety | Separate arrival, handoff, and personal escape. |
| Many moves and street names without change | Retain consequential points and compress repetition. |

**Revision prompt:** trace positions, possession, routes, and replies; identify actions changing distance. Preserve established conditions and the chosen endpoint, repairing spatial and causal gaps without invented exits, rescuers, restored stamina, or a frozen opponent.

q.zh: 追逐场景必须写很多地形和米数吗？
q.en: Does a chase need many landmarks and exact distances?

a.zh: 不必。读者需要关键连接与有作用的距离变化。地形影响选择时写清，重复跑过的路可压缩，别让地图信息淹没当前目标。
a.en: No. Readers need relevant connections and consequential changes in distance. Explain terrain affecting a choice, summarize repeated movement, and keep the goal readable.

q.zh: 追逐一定要在章尾彻底脱险吗？
q.en: Must a chase end with complete escape?

a.zh: 不一定。本场可选交出物件、暂时挡住或仍被追赶。把已经完成和尚未完成的结果分清，下一场继承当前位置与持物。
a.en: No. The chosen outcome may be a handoff, temporary obstruction, or continuing pursuit. Separate completed from unresolved results and carry position and possession forward.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 检查追逐场景。附起点、路线、双方目标、已有能力/消耗和选定结果；逐段列出关键位置、持物与对方回应。只修空间或因果断点，保留文风，不新增出口、工具、救兵或瞬移来替主角解围。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to review a chase with starting positions, route, goals, abilities, costs, and chosen result. Trace key positions, possession, and pursuit responses. Repair only spatial or causal gaps while preserving voice, without invented exits, tools, rescuers, or teleportation.

label.zh: 追逐作为叙事元素
预定结果、环境与双方回应
label.en: Chosen outcomes, environment, and opposing responses

label.zh: 连续动作与场景节奏
视角、感知与动作信息
文风选择不改故事事实

title.zh: 小说倒计时情节怎么写：期限逼近，选择也要变
title.en: How to Write a Countdown Plot

seo_title.zh: 小说倒计时情节怎么写
seo_title.en: Write a Countdown Plot

description.zh: 让截止条件、耗时和实际后果共同制造紧迫感。附摄影投稿的原创时间线，不靠反复报数字或临时延期维持悬念。
description.en: Build urgency from a clear cutoff, task duration, and consequences. Includes an original submission timeline without convenient extensions.

answer.zh: 先让读者知道期限到来时会发生什么、人物为什么在乎，再把剩余时间与仍要做的事连起来。报时有用，是因为它改变了可选办法；不是每段倒数一次就会紧张。结果可以成功、失败或部分完成，截止之后的后果仍按已经建立的规则发生。
answer.en: Tell readers what happens at the deadline and why it matters, then connect remaining time to unfinished work. A time check matters when it changes options, not merely because numbers decrease. Success, failure, or partial completion can work; consequences after the cutoff follow the established rules.

heading.zh: 先说明到点发生什么
heading.en: Establish What the Deadline Does

body.zh:
截止不是一串数字，而是选择即将失效：报名停止、船已开走、约定的人离开，或者某项威胁开始生效。人物要争取的东西和失去它的意义也要可读。

Oh Story 的倒计时卡要求结束时有事发生，悬念方法用时间锁和提前告知大事件制造期待。本文把它们与数字意义、场景节奏合用，不把固定隔一两章报时当普遍要求。期限可以很日常，不用每次升级成生死。
body.en:
A cutoff means an option expires: submissions close, a boat leaves, someone departs, or a threat takes effect. Make the desired result and meaning of losing it readable.

Oh Story’s countdown card requires an event at its end; suspense methods use time locks and advance disclosure. This page combines those ideas with meaningful numbers and scene rhythm without a universal report-every-two-chapters rule. Ordinary stakes can support a deadline without becoming life or death.

heading.zh: 让时间改变能选的办法
heading.en: Let Time Change Available Tactics

body.zh:
列出剩余任务、时间依据和可能放弃的部分。精确数字适合算可行性；耗时尚未知时，写不确定范围或先核条件，别假装所有步骤保证准点。

| 检查 | 对应问题 |
|---|---|
| 截止条件 | 以开始、到达还是完整交付为准 |
| 任务 | 哪步没做，哪些已经完成 |
| 耗时 | 已测、规则规定、人物估计，还是未知 |
| 选择 | 赶最佳版本、交已有版本或接受错过 |

这是编辑检查表，不是 skill 原生时间账协议。结果要与条件相符；也可通过交谈改变期限，但谁有权改变、何时确实同意，需要在故事里成立。
body.en:
List unfinished tasks, duration evidence, and possible tradeoffs. Exact figures help feasibility; unknown durations need uncertainty or a check rather than guaranteed punctuality.

| Check | Question |
|---|---|
| Cutoff condition | Starting, arriving, or delivering everything? |
| Tasks | What remains and what is already done? |
| Duration | Measured, prescribed, estimated, or unknown? |
| Choice | Pursue the best version, use an existing one, or miss the chance? |

This is an editorial table, not a native timing-ledger protocol. An agreed extension can work, but authority and actual agreement need support in the story.

heading.zh: 原创时间线：保住投稿机会，放弃最想换的新照片
heading.en: Original Timeline: Submit the Existing Set

body.zh:
原创社区摄影征集在今晚二十点停止收件，以截止前收到完整封装为准：三张纸质照片加报名表。这是本故事规则。秦遥想交一组“回家的路”，表与两张照片已经装好，第三张想换成今晚新拍的门灯；旧候选“院口”已经印好放在同一袋中，可以组成完整三张，但她更喜欢新图的收束。

十九点四十二分，打印店说新图预计十九点五十六分可取；她按熟悉路程估计，从店到收件处约六分钟。十九点五十六分再走，预计二十点零二分到，已晚于截止；这些是当时估计，不能当已完成的测量。

| 时刻 | 本例实际发生的事 |
|---|---|
| 19:42 | 秦遥听到打印估计，比较等新图与交旧组的选择 |
| 19:48 | 她已选旧“院口”，核三张与报名表，完整封好后离店 |
| 19:54 | 实际到达收件处，工作人员核收完整封装并记下收到时间 |
| 20:00 | 工作人员结束收件，收起提交箱；没有为她临时延时 |

> 秦遥把门灯的预览收回手机里，将旧照片翻到最上面。院口那盏灯还没亮，路却已经走到这里了。
>
> “交这一组。”她说。

她保住了这次投稿机会，实际放弃的是新照片替换；不是拿到奖，也不是新图必然比旧图好。十九点五十六分能否真的取到新图没有在本路径发生，后文不要改写成实测。若选择等新图，作者就要另写真实取件和到达，让迟到后果按截止条件结算。
body.en:
Original community photography call closes at eight tonight. A complete sealed submission must arrive before then: three paper photographs and a form. This is the fictional story’s rule. Qin Yao’s “Way Home” has its form and two prints ready. She wants a new doorway-light picture as the third; an already printed courtyard candidate in the same bag can complete the set, but she prefers the new ending.

At 19:42, the print shop estimates the new picture ready at 19:56. Qin estimates about six minutes from shop to collection point on a familiar route. Leaving then suggests arrival at 20:02, after closure. These are present estimates rather than completed measurements.

| Time | What happens in this path |
|---|---|
| 19:42 | Qin hears the estimate and compares waiting with submitting the existing set. |
| 19:48 | She chooses the courtyard print, checks three photographs and the form, seals everything, and leaves. |
| 19:54 | She actually arrives; staff receive the complete packet and record its arrival. |
| 20:00 | Staff close collection and put away the box without extending it for her. |

> Qin put the doorway-light preview back on her phone and moved the old photograph to the top. The courtyard lamp was unlit, but the route had reached home.
>
> “I’ll submit this set,” she said.

She preserves the submission opportunity while giving up the replacement, without winning a prize or proving one photograph better. The estimated 19:56 pickup never occurs in this path and must not become a measured fact later. A chosen waiting branch needs its own actual pickup and arrival, with lateness handled under the cutoff condition.

heading.zh: 报时之间，要有新的选择或进展
heading.en: Give the Time Checks Something to Measure

body.zh:
时钟可以不反复出现。检查任务推进、人物改变办法、一个原本可行的选择失效，读者就能感到时间压缩。等待本身也能产生压力，前提是知道等什么及错过会怎样，不为每次报时硬塞新事故。

秦遥的两张照片和表早已完成，紧张点是第三张取舍与完整交付。补拍、交通堵塞、工作人员刁难都不是本例需要的额外障碍。大段谈话或回忆若发生在实时倒数中，时间仍要计入；概述和跳时可以用，但前后时刻不能矛盾。
body.en:
The clock need not appear repeatedly. Task progress, changed tactics, or an option expiring can compress time. Waiting itself can create pressure when its object and consequence are known, without an accident for every check.

Qin’s two prints and form are ready; the tension concerns the third image and complete delivery. Extra reshoots, traffic, or obstructive staff are unnecessary here. Conversation and memories consume time within a continuous countdown. Summary and time jumps can work with consistent anchors.

heading.zh: 结束时别让规则忘了自己说过什么
heading.en: Make the Ending Respect the Established Cutoff

body.zh:
| 问题 | 修改方向 |
|---|---|
| 只报数字，任务一直没变 | 核报时是否影响选择、进展或等待压力 |
| 以提交为准，却到门口就算完成 | 补真实交付或改准确结果 |
| 预估全写成保证 | 区分预期和实际时刻 |
| 到点突然无条件延期 | 给已有条件与真实同意，或按原规则结算 |
| 成功投递就宣布胜出 | 限于实际获得的结果，后续评选另写 |

**改稿提示：**列截止条件、关键时刻、未完成任务与每次选择。对照实际发生的路径核时间；只修矛盾，不添事故或延期，不把作者计划、人物估计写成已发生。
body.en:
| Problem | Revision direction |
|---|---|
| Numbers change while nothing else does | Check choices, progress, or meaningful waiting pressure. |
| Arrival counts despite a delivery condition | Show actual delivery or limit the result. |
| Estimates become guarantees | Separate expectation from actual timing. |
| A free extension appears at closure | Establish conditions and agreement or honor the original rule. |
| Submission becomes victory | Keep the actual outcome; selection remains separate. |

**Revision prompt:** list the cutoff, time anchors, unfinished tasks, and choices. Check the actual branch for timing consistency. Repair contradictions without new accidents or extensions, and keep plans and estimates distinct from events.

q.zh: 倒计时一定要秒表、爆炸或生死危险吗？
q.en: Does a countdown need a stopwatch or mortal danger?

a.zh: 不需要。投稿、赴约、赶车或一个机会结束，都可以有分量。让读者明白人物为何在乎与到点后果，不靠危险级别替代投入。
a.en: No. Submission, an appointment, transport, or an expiring opportunity can matter. Establish investment and consequences rather than substituting danger level for stakes.

q.zh: 截止前成功是不是最好的结局？
q.en: Is success before the deadline always the best ending?

a.zh: 不一定。错过、部分完成或付出取舍都可以成立，按作者的故事承诺选择。重要的是条件、过程与结果相符，不为制造反转临时改截止规则。
a.en: No. Missing it, partial completion, or a tradeoff can fit the chosen story. Conditions, process, and result need to agree without a last-minute rule change for a twist.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 检查倒计时情节。附起始时刻、截止条件、任务耗时依据、双方所知和原稿；逐项核选择与实际到达/提交时间。保留既定结果，只修时间或因果矛盾，不凭空延期、瞬间完成步骤或把计划当已发生。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to review a countdown with its start, cutoff condition, duration basis, knowledge, and passage. Check choices against actual arrival or submission. Preserve the result while repairing timing or causality, without convenient extensions, instantaneous work, or completed plans that never happened.

label.zh: 倒计时结束要有事件
label.en: An event at the end of a countdown

label.zh: 时间锁与提前告知的悬念
数字含义与场景节奏
作者节奏与已定时间事实

title.zh: AI配音重复一句怎么办：文稿、音频和放置分别查
title.en: How to Fix Repeated Lines in AI Voiceover

seo_title.zh: AI配音重复一句怎么办
seo_title.en: Fix Repeated AI Voiceover Lines

description.zh: 分清文案重复、分段音频错用和成片重复放置。附两段旁白的完整排查方案，删重之后也要补回本来该说的内容。
description.en: Separate repeated text, reused segment audio, and duplicate placement. Includes a repair plan that restores the intended second line.

answer.zh: 先听出重复发生在哪里，再比对当前请求文字、单段声音和成片放置。文字重复，先修稿；单段内部多念一次，修该段合成；两个窗口用了同一个旧音频，换回各自选定文件；成片多放一次，修时间线。别只删掉多出来的声音，却把本来要说的下一句也留成空缺。
answer.en: Locate the repetition, then compare current request text, individual audio, and final placement. Repair duplicated writing, repetition inside one recording, a reused old file, or an extra timeline instance at its own layer. Removing the extra sound must not leave the intended next line missing.

heading.zh: 重复是先后多说一次，还是同时有两路人声
heading.en: Locate the Repetition Before Deleting It

body.zh:
先正常速度听当前成片，记下重复的时间和字词，再单听相应分段。先后出现同一句，可能是文稿、文件或放置重复；同时两路声音叠着说，则还要核原声与旁白是否都在说同一内容。

字幕出现两次不等于声音也出现两次；反过来，字幕只一条也不能证明混音只放了一段。作者有意让人物复述、回放或回声，可以保留，先明确这是不是本次选定效果。
body.en:
Listen at normal speed and note the repeated words and times, then hear the individual segment. Sequential repetition may come from text, files, or placement. Simultaneous voices also require checking original sound and narration carrying the same content.

Two subtitle cues do not prove two spoken instances; one cue does not prove one mixed segment. Chosen repetition, replay, or echo can remain. Establish whether it is intentional before removal.

heading.zh: 在哪一层出现，就修哪一层
heading.en: Repair the Layer Where It Appears

body.zh:
| 对照结果 | 优先处理 |
|---|---|
| 送入TTS的文字已经重复 | 修当前文稿，保留必要前提与回应 |
| 请求一次，单段音频念了两次 | 只重做或替换这段，再实际听 |
| 第二段误用了第一段文件 | 核来源，采用第二段应有音频 |
| 两个分段都正常，成片多放一次 | 查当前轨道与放置实例 |
| 原声和旁白同时复述 | 回声音分工，不靠删关键词掩盖冲突 |

所引分段缓存核文字、设置与WAV的大小/修改时间，不从声音听写。采用记录核选定顺序和文字；如果错误文字恰好也被“选定”，或正确记录指向读错的文件，字符串检查不能替你发现语义重复。
body.en:
| Comparison | First repair |
|---|---|
| Submitted text repeats | Revise the current script, retaining necessary premise and reply. |
| One request, two spoken instances inside one file | Redo or replace that segment and listen. |
| The second segment uses the first file | Trace provenance and select the intended second audio. |
| Both segments are right, the export adds an instance | Check current tracks and placements. |
| Original sound and narration restate together | Revisit sound ownership rather than dropping keywords. |

The cited cache compares text, settings, and WAV size/mtime; it does not transcribe sound. Adoption checks selected order and words. Wrong words selected consistently, or correct records pointing to wrong speech, cannot be diagnosed by string checks alone.

heading.zh: 纸面排查：第二窗不能只是删空
heading.en: Paper Repair: Restore the Second Window’s Words

body.zh:
原创解说方案有两段中文：0–4秒“她把名单折了回去。”，4–8秒“门外有人敲了两下。”。这是示意窗口，尚无实际语音，能否放下待核。假设成片第二窗又念第一句，排查计划如下。

| 要比对的层 | 本例假设与处理 |
|---|---|
| 定稿与请求 | 两句本来不同，先保留原文字与窗口 |
| 单段音频 | 假设第一段正确，第二段手动导入了旧第一句文件 |
| 修问题段 | 换成选定第二句的音频；缺候选就生成这一句并试听，不重做第一段 |
| 放入成片 | 核实际采用两份不同用途文件，再连听折名单与敲门句 |

若只删除4–8秒重复放置，第二句仍然没说出，不能宣布已完成。换好后还要查第二句尾字、句间接续、音色与字幕；新声音时长变化时，邻接位置也要核。

本例没有音频、合成或试听结果。使用仓库采用路径时，让选定文本/顺序匹配当前元数据，并核实际混音输入；这种匹配表示选择被消费，不表示音频已经按文字念对。
body.en:
Original plan: two Chinese segments, 0–4 seconds “她把名单折了回去。” (she folds the list back), and 4–8 seconds “门外有人敲了两下。” (someone knocks twice outside). These are illustrative windows without actual audio or proven fit. Suppose the second window repeats the first sentence.

| Layer | Hypothesis and repair |
|---|---|
| Chosen/requested text | The lines differ; preserve both and their windows. |
| Individual audio | Assume the first is correct, while an old first-line file was manually imported for the second. |
| Problem segment | Select the intended second audio; if absent, generate and hear only that line. |
| Export | Check the actual files serving both purposes, then listen through the two lines. |

Deleting the repeated 4–8-second placement alone leaves the second sentence missing. After replacement, check its ending, joins, voice, and subtitles. Changed duration requires checking adjacent positions too.

No audio, synthesis, or listening exists in this example. On the repository adoption path, match chosen text/order to current metadata and inspect consumed inputs. Matching establishes consumption, not that the recording spoke those words correctly.

heading.zh: 保留该保留的复述与原声
heading.en: Keep Repetition That Has a Purpose

body.zh:
人物重复一遍才改变回应、回放让观众比对线索，或作者选了回声，都不该机械删掉。若原对白完整呈现决定，就让它有空间，旁白只补必要连接；同一句内容被两路声音无意争抢时，再改声音安排。

局部修订保护未受影响文件。不要删全缓存试运气，也不要为删重改掉数量、否定或先后条件。定稿里真有重复而作者允许改，就明确改哪句，再同步请求、字幕与采用选择。
body.en:
A repeated line may change a reply; replay may enable comparison; echo may be chosen. Do not remove these mechanically. Give an original decision-making line room, with narration providing necessary connections. Revise ownership when two tracks unintentionally compete.

Protect unaffected files in a local repair. Avoid wiping caches or losing numbers, negation, or conditions. When a script repetition is authorized for removal, name the changed line and synchronize requests, subtitles, and chosen inputs.

heading.zh: 最后核内容完整，再听整片
heading.en: Check Completeness Before the Final Listen

body.zh:
**复查顺序：**单听问题段，连听前后段，正常速度看听当前成片。确认该重复已处理、下一句没有缺失、原声重要回应仍在；未听的项目留待听，不从字幕预填通过。

可把定稿、实际请求、采用文件、成片时间和实听内容并排记录。这是编辑排查表，不是新的自动语音验真工具。原声被剪断或输入漏字，各回相应教程，不把所有声音错误都用“删一句”处理。
body.en:
**Review:** hear the problem segment, its neighbors, then the current export at normal speed. Confirm repetition is resolved, the next line remains, and important original replies survive. Leave unlistened checks unresolved rather than inferring a pass from subtitles.

Record chosen text, request, selected file, output time, and heard content side by side. This editorial aid is not a new automatic speech-verification tool. Original dialogue cuts and missing input words need their own repairs rather than deleting one line for every fault.

q.zh: 文字没重复，为什么声音还会重复？
q.en: Why can audio repeat when text does not?

a.zh: 单段合成可能多念，手动导入可能用了旧文件，时间线也可能多放一次。对照实际声音与当前输入逐层查，文字相同或不同都不能代替试听。
a.en: A recording may repeat, an import may reuse an old file, or a timeline may add an instance. Compare actual sound with current inputs; text alone cannot replace listening.

q.zh: 直接删掉第二次播放可以吗？
q.en: Can I simply delete the second playback?

a.zh: 它本来就是多余实例时可以；若那里原本有另一句，就要恢复正确内容。有意回放或人物复述则按本次创作选择保留。
a.en: Yes if it is an extra instance. If another line belongs there, restore it. Preserve intended replay or character repetition according to the chosen edit.

text.zh: 在现有 Video Recap 流程里提供重复位置、当前定稿与分段文件，要求按 video-voiceover 和下游采用记录排查。先给原因与最小修法，只重做点名段；保留其他文字、声音与画面，最后核实际输入并回听，不用字幕或请求文字代替实听。
text.en: In the existing Video Recap flow, provide the repeated location, chosen text, and segment files. Ask for a minimal diagnosis using video-voiceover and downstream input records. Redo only named segments, retain unaffected text, audio, and picture, then check actual consumption and listen.

label.zh: 分段请求文字、缓存与文件记录
label.en: Segment text, cache, and file records

label.zh: 选定顺序、文字与实际混音输入
label.en: Chosen order, text, and consumed mix inputs

label.zh: 分段放置与声音分工

title.zh: 视频变速后声音变调怎么办：分清速度和音高
title.en: How to Fix Pitch Changes After Speeding Audio

seo_title.zh: 视频变速后声音变调怎么办
seo_title.en: Fix Pitch Changes After Speeding Audio

description.zh: 先定位变调发生在原声、配音还是整体播放。附十秒到八秒的速度方案，核实际滤镜、累计速度与最终试听。
description.en: Locate pitch changes in source audio, narration, or playback. Includes a ten-to-eight-second plan checking filters, cumulative speed, and listening.

answer.zh: 先回到正常播放速度，比较变速前后的单独音轨，确认是哪路声音变尖或变低。画面速度、语音节奏和音高是不同选择：只加速画面不能假定旁白也要加速。需要语音提速时，核实际处理方式与累计倍率，保全字词，再听最终声音；时长合格不自动等于自然。
answer.en: Return playback to normal speed and compare each track before and after processing. Picture speed, speech tempo, and pitch are distinct choices; faster picture need not require faster narration. Check actual processing and cumulative factors, preserve complete words, and listen. Fitting duration does not establish natural delivery.

heading.zh: 先查播放速度，再查哪条音轨变了
heading.en: Check Playback, Then Isolate the Track

body.zh:
播放器本身以倍速播放、原声整体被加速、配音被单独提速、TTS请求已经带不同语气或音高，听起来可能相似，修法却不同。先恢复播放器常速，单听原声与配音，再与处理前版本比较。

“声音变尖”不一定是同一技术原因。别立刻换声线或重写文稿；原稿和原声音还在时，先定位是哪一步改变。视频画面只做快进，声音可按创作安排独立铺设，也可选择同速变化。
body.en:
A fast player, sped-up source sound, separately accelerated narration, or different TTS delivery can sound similar but need different repairs. Restore normal playback, isolate source and narration, and compare with prior versions.

A higher-sounding voice need not have one technical cause. Do not immediately change narrator or rewrite the script. Find the operation first. Picture can accelerate while sound is placed separately, or both can intentionally change together.

heading.zh: 不要把改采样率和改节奏混成一件事
heading.en: Distinguish Rate Reinterpretation From Tempo Processing

body.zh:
[FFmpeg官方滤镜文档](https://ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg-filters.html#asetrate)说明，`asetrate`不改PCM数据而改变采样率解释，会同时影响速度和音高；[atempo](https://ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg-filters.html#atempo)用于处理音频节奏。它们不是同一个操作，也不要把正常格式重采样都叫变调。

所引 Video Recap 的普通旁白提速使用`atempo`，以避免把音高跟着播放速率一起搬动。选了节奏处理仍须听重音、字尾和音色，不能保证任何倍率都自然。

TTS阶段的语速、全段提速与段内适配分别核。若已有两次节奏处理，倍率要相乘看实际路径；别只看最后一个设置。
body.en:
The [official FFmpeg documentation](https://ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg-filters.html#asetrate) describes `asetrate` as reinterpreting sample rate without changing PCM data, affecting speed and pitch. [atempo](https://ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg-filters.html#atempo) processes audio tempo. These are different operations; ordinary format resampling should not all be called pitch shifting.

The cited Video Recap narration path uses `atempo` to avoid moving pitch with playback rate. Tempo processing still needs listening for emphasis, endings, and voice texture; no arbitrary factor is guaranteed natural.

Check TTS speed, global acceleration, and segment fitting separately. Successive tempo factors multiply; the final setting alone does not describe the actual path.

heading.zh: 纸面方案：十秒旁白放入八秒画面
heading.en: Paper Plan: Ten Seconds of Narration in Eight Seconds

body.zh:
本例作者已选八秒画面，原中文旁白是“她把名单折了回去，门外响起两下敲门声。”。假设未加速候选长十秒，需完整保留文字；这里没有生成或试听声音。

1. 保留原候选和八秒画面，不再把画面额外加速。
2. 作者选择只试旁白1.25倍节奏处理，理论`10 / 1.25 = 8`秒；这是计算，不是实际输出时长。
3. 本例没有额外TTS提速或段内适配。若通过所引采用路径，独立速度策略选`global_atempo=1.25`、`bounded_segment_fit=false`、`segment_tempo_max=1.0`，累计软/硬上限均1.25；实际消费者接受合法独立策略，不是让环境默认覆盖已选方案。
4. 处理后测实际时长、核完整句尾和选定文件进入混音，再正常速度听成片。输出若仍超窗，不裁尾，也不偷偷再加速。

若1.25的候选读起来不合适，作者可以扩大画面窗口，或明确允许改这句旁白；原画面不能改、文字也不能改且速度不可接受时，当前安排就尚未解决。参数通过不等于这一句已经自然或已经可放。
body.en:
The author chooses eight seconds of picture and the exact Chinese line “她把名单折了回去，门外响起两下敲门声。” (she folds the list back; two knocks sound outside). Assume an unaccelerated candidate lasts ten seconds and all words must remain. No audio is generated or heard here.

1. Preserve the original candidate and eight-second picture, without another picture speed pass.
2. Try narration tempo alone at 1.25: theoretical `10 / 1.25 = 8` seconds, not a measured output duration.
3. This plan has no added TTS acceleration or segment fit. On the cited adoption path, independently select `global_atempo=1.25`, `bounded_segment_fit=false`, `segment_tempo_max=1.0`, and cumulative soft/hard limits of 1.25. The actual consumer accepts valid independently declared policies; ambient defaults do not choose one for you.
4. Measure the result, check the full ending and consumed candidate, then listen to the export at normal speed. An overlong output cannot be trimmed or secretly sped up again.

If this delivery is unsuitable, the author can enlarge the picture window or authorize a line edit. Fixed picture, fixed words, and unacceptable speed leave the arrangement unresolved. Valid parameters do not establish natural delivery or actual fit.

heading.zh: 先认出当前分支，不把所有声音都套同一开关
heading.en: Identify the Actual Audio Path

body.zh:
普通旁白路径会处理速度与适配；已采用的独立策略按所引reference和消费者代码执行，保守默认是原速且不段内适配。默认不等于只有这一种合法选择。

显式完整声音混音分支跳过旧的速度/适配步骤。若走的是这个分支，修改旧`narration_speed`不会兑现旁白加速；要回已选输入与放置安排。冻结音频的画面修订也不应暗中改变声音。先核实际分支，再核操作记录与成片。
body.en:
The ordinary narration path processes speed and fitting. Independently adopted policies follow the cited reference and consumer code, with conservative defaults of original speed and no segment fit. A default is not the only valid selection.

The explicit full-sound branch bypasses legacy speed/fitting. Changing the old `narration_speed` there will not accelerate narration; revisit selected inputs and placements. A frozen-audio picture revision should not secretly alter sound. Identify the branch before checking operation records and the export.

heading.zh: 时长、字词和听感分别复查
heading.en: Review Duration, Words, and Sound Separately

body.zh:
| 问题 | 先查什么 |
|---|---|
| 播放器倍速造成误判 | 回常速与同一设备比较 |
| 只想快一点却改变音高 | 核实际变速方法与滤镜 |
| 总倍率比想象高 | 查TTS、全段和段内实际处理 |
| 为了适配截掉字尾 | 回完整输入，解决窗口与速度选择 |
| 记录显示采用就认定听感好 | 单听候选、连听接点、听当前成片 |

记录保留文字、速度决定、实际处理文件与听到的问题。没有试听就留待听，不把理论八秒或合格参数填成听感通过。
body.en:
| Problem | First check |
|---|---|
| Player speed misleads comparison | Restore normal playback on the same device. |
| Faster tempo changes pitch unexpectedly | Inspect the actual method and filters. |
| More acceleration than expected | Check TTS, global, and segment operations. |
| Fitting drops the ending | Restore complete input and revisit window/speed. |
| Adoption is treated as good sound | Hear the candidate, joins, and current export. |

Retain text, the speed decision, actual processed file, and heard problems. Leave listening unresolved when absent; theoretical eight seconds and valid settings are not a listening pass.

q.zh: 用不变调提速就一定自然吗？
q.en: Does pitch-preserving acceleration guarantee natural speech?

a.zh: 不一定。重音、停顿、字尾和整体语气仍可能不合适。只把速度与音高分开还不够，实际候选和成片都要听。
a.en: No. Emphasis, pauses, endings, and delivery may still be unsuitable. Separating tempo and pitch is useful, but the actual candidate and export still need listening.

q.zh: 画面加速，配音必须跟着加速吗？
q.en: Must narration speed up with the picture?

a.zh: 不必。按声音安排选择。若配音单独铺设，可保原速并调整窗口；若确要同速，核完整文字、累计倍率和实际音画关系。
a.en: No. Follow the sound plan. Separately placed narration can retain speed with a revised window. A chosen shared speed still needs complete words, cumulative factors, and actual alignment checks.

text.zh: 在 Video Recap 流程里提供原音轨、目标窗口、已选速度与问题成片，要求按 video-assemble 的实际声音分支排查。保留未点名轨道和画面，不暗加二次提速、不裁尾；先说明处理方案，再核实际消费文件、时长与试听。
text.en: In the Video Recap flow, provide original audio, target window, selected speed, and the faulty export. Ask for diagnosis against the actual video-assemble audio path. Preserve other tracks and picture, add no hidden second speed pass or tail cut, then check consumed files, duration, and sound.

label.zh: 实际atempo处理与不裁尾适配
label.en: Actual atempo processing and no-trim fitting

label.zh: 独立选定速度策略与消费记录
label.en: Independently selected tempo policy and consumption

label.zh: 完整声音分支跳过旧变速
label.en: Explicit full-sound bypasses legacy speed changes

label.zh: 独立速度策略的实际校验

title.zh: 叙事游戏卡关怎么办：分清缺提示和无路可走
title.en: How to Fix a Story Game That Cannot Progress

seo_title.zh: 叙事游戏卡关怎么办
seo_title.en: Fix a Story Game That Cannot Progress

description.zh: 从玩家当前状态检查可达行动，分清没看懂、明确失败与意外死路。附修复重复借钥匙条件的完整纸面路径。
description.en: Check reachable actions from the current state, distinguishing unclear guidance, declared failure, and an unintended dead end. Includes a key-loan repair.

answer.zh: 先从玩家当前持物、位置、已完成行动和可用选项出发，看是否还存在合法推进路径。有路径但看不懂，修提示和反馈；规则明确本轮已结束，给约定的恢复；状态显示可继续却没有路，修造成死路的条件。多塞提示不能替代恢复一条真正可执行的路。
answer.en: Check possession, position, completed actions, and available options for a legal path forward. If it exists but is unclear, improve guidance. A declared ended run needs its specified recovery. A supposedly continuing state without a path needs repaired conditions; more hints cannot create an executable route.

heading.zh: 先看有路，只是没看出来，还是根本没路
heading.en: Distinguish Hidden Guidance From No Legal Route

body.zh:
玩家不知道下一步，不一定是规则断了。先用当前可见信息和合法行动走读，不看作者藏着的答案：目标是否可读、必要物件在哪里、前置条件是否能满足、反馈是否指出还缺什么。

三种情况不要混修：有路但提示不足；本轮按设计已经失败；本轮仍显示进行中却再也满足不了主任务。第三种常被称为软锁，但本页用具体状态说明，不靠术语代替诊断。
body.en:
Not knowing the next step does not necessarily mean broken rules. Walk from visible information and legal actions without relying on the author’s hidden answer: readable goal, necessary objects, satisfiable conditions, and useful feedback.

Separate an existing route with poor guidance, a deliberately failed run, and a supposedly active run unable to reach its main task. The last is often called a softlock; identify its specific state rather than stopping at the term.

heading.zh: 用刚才的操作追到第一个断点
heading.en: Trace the First Broken Condition

body.zh:
| 记录 | 要找的断点 |
|---|---|
| 初态与操作 | 哪一步之后可用路消失 |
| 当前持物 | 拿着、放回与曾经拿过是否混用 |
| 前置条件 | 缺的资源/许可能否再获得 |
| 当前结果 | 已结束、仍进行还是只损失可选内容 |
| 恢复 | 从当前状态怎样真的再推进 |

NovelToGame 的模型方法分开“发生过什么”和“现在是什么”，规则对实际位置、归属与权限结算。这里的表是编辑排查工具，不要求项目再造一套存档文件。只改提示文案，不会自动改变错误的行动条件。
body.en:
| Record | Break to locate |
|---|---|
| Initial state and actions | The step after which all routes vanish. |
| Possession | Held, returned, and previously acquired conflated. |
| Preconditions | Whether a missing resource/access can still be obtained. |
| Outcome | Ended, continuing, or merely missing an optional result. |
| Recovery | An actual next path from this state. |

NovelToGame separates past events from current state and commits position, ownership, and access through rules. This editorial aid does not require a new save format. Changing a hint does not repair an action condition.

heading.zh: 原创路径：钥匙已还，可以在本次许可内再借
heading.en: Original Repair Path: Borrow Again Within the Same Visit

body.zh:
纸面档案室游戏的目标是进入展柜区看一张公开展签。开放来访期间，柜台员允许玩家借一把展柜区入口门钥匙，用完需还；本次许可持续到玩家离场，柜台员始终在场。钥匙初在柜台，展柜区入口门锁着，展签尚未看。玩家先借到钥匙，却在开门前选择归还。

旧候选条件把“曾借过一次”当成不能再借。当前钥匙已回柜、玩家没持钥匙、许可仍在，界面却只显示继续找，没有开门或借钥匙的路；本轮又未结束。错误在行动条件，不是玩家没发现一条秘密捷径。

**纸面修法与完整路径：**

1. 不清除第一次借还历史。再借读取当前许可有效、柜台员在场、钥匙在柜台且玩家未持有；这些都成立才可选。
2. 玩家再次请求，柜台员实际把同一把钥匙交到手上；钥匙离柜，不复制新钥匙。
3. 玩家到入口门，用持有钥匙开门，实际进入展柜区查看展签，主任务记录完成。
4. 玩家回柜台归还钥匙，钥匙回柜、持物清空。离开档案室，本次许可结束。

**相邻反例：**尚持钥匙再点“借”，不再给一把；已离场的旧借用入口不能恢复本次权限。若设计以后可再来访，按新来访重新处理，而不是把已结束许可暗中复活。

这条修订保留先前归还事实、主任务和同次许可，没有免费送物或全局重开。它是未实现纸面规则走读；构建后还须重放卡住序列与反例，再观察玩家能否看懂新的反馈。
body.en:
Paper archive game: visit the display area to read one public label. During an open visit, the attendant permits borrowing one exhibit-area door key until departure and stays present. Initially the key is at the counter, the area door is locked, and the label unread. The player borrows but returns the key before opening that door.

A candidate wrongly treats “borrowed once” as permanently disabling borrowing. The key is back, the player holds none, and permission remains, but the interface only says keep looking. No opening or borrowing route exists, and the run is not ended. The fault is a condition, not a missed secret shortcut.

**Paper repair and complete path:**

1. Preserve the first loan/return history. Borrowing reads current permission, attendant presence, key at counter, and no key held; all must hold.
2. Ask again; the attendant actually hands over the same key, removing it from the counter without duplication.
3. Use the held key at the area door, actually enter the exhibit area and read the label, and complete the main task.
4. Return the key at the counter, clearing possession; leave and end this visit’s permission.

**Adjacent counterexamples:** another borrow while holding the key grants nothing; an old borrowing entry after departure cannot restore ended permission. Any later visit follows a newly defined visit rather than secretly reviving the old one.

The repair preserves the earlier return, objective, and visit limit without free items or a global reset. It is unimplemented paper reasoning. After building, replay the stuck sequence and counterexamples, then assess whether players understand the feedback.

heading.zh: 恢复路径不能抹掉已经成立的后果
heading.en: Preserve Established Consequences in Recovery

body.zh:
意外死路可以修条件、补原设计漏掉的可达入口，或明确调整恢复规则。选择哪种取决于原作与玩家承诺；不要每次直接回填所有资源、恢复被拒绝的机会或抹去旧选择。

明确的失败也不是都要取消。若本轮按设计已结束，显示原因与约定恢复，见[失败与重开](/novel-to-game/game-failure-and-restart)。如果主任务能继续而可选访谈没了，也不应为了“不能拿满”把它误判成卡死。
body.en:
Repair unintended dead ends through conditions, an omitted reachable entry, or an explicitly revised recovery rule according to the source and player promise. Do not refill every resource, reopen refusals, or erase choices by default.

Deliberate failure can remain with cause and declared recovery; see [failure and restart](/novel-to-game/game-failure-and-restart). Losing an optional interview while the main task continues is not an automatic dead end merely because everything cannot be collected.

heading.zh: 修后走原失败序列，再走会揭错的另一条
heading.en: Replay the Failure and a Distinguishing Neighbor

body.zh:
重放提前还钥匙的原序列，再走持钥匙重复借、离场再借等相邻路径。核结果、持物、权限与可用行动，不能只看新按钮出现。若修改了变量语义或行动效果，存档/日志兼容也需按实际版本处理。

提示问题则找真实玩家观察：是否认出目标、注意到反馈、知道下一步。规则可达和提示好懂各自验证，不把纸面能走通当作试玩通过。
body.en:
Replay the early-return sequence, then neighboring cases such as another loan while holding the key or after departure. Check outcome, possession, permission, and actions beyond a visible new button. Changed variable meanings or action effects need explicit save/log compatibility handling.

For guidance, observe actual players noticing the goal, feedback, and next step. Reachability and understandable guidance need distinct evidence; a coherent paper route is not a successful playtest.

q.zh: 玩家说卡住了，就该多给提示吗？
q.en: Should every report of being stuck get more hints?

a.zh: 先查有没有合法推进路。有路但没看懂才修提示；如果条件已把所有路径封死，需要修规则或明示恢复，多写一句提示不能让动作变得可执行。
a.en: Check whether a legal route exists. Improve guidance when it does; broken conditions need repaired rules or declared recovery, not another hint for an unavailable action.

q.zh: 不能拿到所有可选内容算卡死吗？
q.en: Is losing optional content a dead end?

a.zh: 不一定。主任务继续、弱结果或软失败可能是选定设计。分清失去什么与本轮是否还能到达一个允许的结果，不默认全收集是唯一有效结局。
a.en: Not necessarily. Continued main progress, a weaker outcome, or soft failure may be intentional. Check what is lost and whether a permitted outcome remains, without requiring total collection.

text.zh: 把选定概念、当前关卡规则、卡住前的操作和状态交给 game-world-design。先区分认知、失败与意外不可达，给最小修法及原路径/相邻反例；保留既有持物、权限和已发生历史，不凭空送钥匙或清空全部进度。
text.en: Give game-world-design the selected concept, level rules, action sequence, and stuck state. Distinguish guidance, failure, and unintended unreachability; propose a minimal repair with the failing path and adjacent counterexample. Preserve possession, access, and history without free keys or a full reset.

label.zh: 当前状态、可用行动与局部修订
label.en: Current state, available actions, and local repair

label.zh: 当前状态与历史分开、真实前置
label.en: Separate current state/history and actual preconditions

label.zh: 原失败路径及相邻反例

title.zh: 游戏战斗结果怎么接剧情：胜负、奖励与人物回应
title.en: How to Connect Combat Results to a Game Story

seo_title.zh: 游戏战斗结果怎么接剧情
seo_title.en: Connect Combat Results to a Game Story

description.zh: 让战后剧情读取实际胜负、玩家选择和已经交付的奖励。附两条比试后续路径，打赢不自动改写成输，也不保证所有问题都解决。
description.en: Make aftermath read actual results, choices, and delivered rewards. Includes two tournament paths without rewriting victory or making it solve every problem.

answer.zh: 先说明这一战的是什么、玩家能改变什么，再让战后场景读取已经结算的胜负与选择。胜利可以拿到席位但仍有别的困难，败战也可以保留实际完成的事；它们都不能被过场一句话改写。奖励、持物和人物反应分别落地，不让旁白替规则补结算。
answer.en: Establish what the fight contests and what the player can change, then make aftermath read committed results and choices. Victory may win a place without solving unrelated difficulties; defeat may retain completed acts. A cutscene cannot rewrite either. Deliver rewards, possession, and reactions rather than settling them by narration.

heading.zh: 先把这一战的承诺说清
heading.en: State What This Fight Can Decide

body.zh:
胜负决定什么：得到名额、守住物件、撑到同伴离开，还是只争一口气？不要按钮写“击败对手”，规则算玩家获胜，过场却无依据地说“你从没赢过”。另一项困难可以继续，但本战结果应被承认。

NovelToGame 的世界方法要求动作改变状态与后续选择，叙事方法让人物具体回应玩家做过的事。本文处理战后读取，不提供适用于所有题材的战斗数值模板，也不要求没有战斗的原作加一套战斗。
body.en:
What does this fight decide: a place, an object, time for a companion, or pride? Do not promise defeating an opponent, commit victory, then claim the player never won. Another problem can continue while this result is acknowledged.

NovelToGame connects actions to state and subsequent choices, with characters responding to actual conduct. This page concerns aftermath reads, not a universal combat balance template or compulsory combat in adaptations without it.

heading.zh: 战后要读哪些已发生事实
heading.en: Read Committed Facts in the Aftermath

body.zh:
| 事实 | 后续怎样使用 |
|---|---|
| 胜负与目标 | 席位、路线或资格是否按实际结果开放 |
| 玩家行动 | 有无保住同伴、承诺、物件或披露信息 |
| 资源与持物 | 奖励是否实际交到手，消耗是否保留 |
| 在场人物 | 谁看见结果，谁需要后来才获知 |

可以汇流到同一场景，但换对白、持物和可用行动时按所选路径读。看见“胜利”字样不是所有奖励已到账，人物称赞也不是所有关系已经修复。
body.en:
| Fact | Later use |
|---|---|
| Outcome and objective | Places, routes, or eligibility opened by the actual result. |
| Player conduct | Protected people, commitments, objects, or revealed information. |
| Resources and possession | Actual reward delivery and retained costs. |
| Witnesses | Who saw it and who must learn afterward. |

Branches can meet in one scene with history-specific dialogue, objects, and actions. A victory label is not all rewards delivered; praise is not every relationship repaired.

heading.zh: 原创战后路径：赢了有席位，输了仍有自己的事做
heading.en: Original Aftermath Paths: A Place Won or a Different Role

body.zh:
原创武艺社游戏里，玩家与顾平争一个公开演示席位。规则先明示：每个有效得分一分，先到两分结束；最多三回合，届时高分胜，平分则无人取得本轮席位。本例成功应对攻势使玩家得一分，失误使顾平得一分，未判有效得分的回合双方不加分。这是本例约定，不是通用比武规则。玩家与顾平原本约好，不论谁演示，另一人负责已分好的展架准备。

下表是从同一初态分别安排的纸面路径：A选择两次有效应对，规则结算2比0；B两次应对失误，规则结算0比2。这里不模拟动作、碰撞或真实操作手感，重点是已经选定的结果怎样进入剧情。

| 路径 | 战后实际安排 |
|---|---|
| A：玩家获胜 | 裁判确认玩家拿席位，把唯一的演示牌递给玩家，玩家接稳持有。顾平没有拿同一牌，按原约去摆自己负责的展架；他祝贺但表示今天仍要独自练习，不自动成为全程追随者 |
| B：顾平获胜 | 裁判把演示牌交给顾平，玩家无牌；玩家去摆自己负责的展架，顾平仍按原约完成他的准备部分。对话承认玩家输了本轮，不说玩家以后都没机会 |

两条后文都可进入社团准备室：A读取玩家持牌及席位，开放“准备演示”；B读取顾平持牌，玩家只能继续当前展架任务，不能点出并未得到的演示资格。各人实际完成哪项准备，再写入后续活动，不由一句“都准备好了”包办。

A保住比试胜利，也保留顾平的独立安排；B失去席位，但不是全部生活被取消。重复点击领奖不得复制唯一演示牌；汇流不借另一条路径的奖牌或胜利。全部是未构建纸面方案，尚未验证战斗乐趣或运行时状态。
body.en:
Original martial-arts club game: the player and Gu Ping contest one public demonstration place. Visible rules give one point per valid score, end at two points, or compare scores after at most three rounds; a tie awards neither person the place this time. In this example, a successful response to an attack scores for the player; an error scores for Gu; a round without a valid score adds nothing. This is the example’s rule, not a universal contest rule. Both previously agreed to do their assigned display-stand preparation regardless of who demonstrates.

These paper paths start independently from the same state. A chooses two valid responses and commits 2–0; B makes two response errors and commits 0–2. Movement, collision, and real controls are not simulated here; the focus is aftermath use of the chosen outcomes.

| Path | Aftermath arrangement |
|---|---|
| A: Player wins | The referee confirms the place and actually hands over the unique demonstration token; the player holds it. Gu holds no duplicate. He undertakes his assigned stand work, congratulates the player, but keeps his independent practice today. |
| B: Gu wins | The referee gives Gu the token; the player has none. The player does their assigned stand work, and Gu keeps his preparation commitment too. Dialogue acknowledges this loss without declaring every future chance closed. |

Both can reach the preparation room. A reads the player’s token/place and offers preparation for demonstration. B reads Gu’s token; the player continues stand work without an unearned demonstration action. Record actual completion of each assigned task rather than asserting everything ready.

A preserves victory and Gu’s own plans; B loses the place without cancelling the rest of life. Repeated reward collection cannot duplicate the unique token, and convergence cannot borrow another branch’s outcome. This unbuilt paper plan verifies no combat enjoyment or runtime state.

heading.zh: 原作已定结果，也要明确玩家的可玩目标
heading.en: Clarify Agency When the Source Fixes an Outcome

body.zh:
原作若选定这场守不住，可把本场玩家目标写成带出证据、保护同伴或决定撤离办法；这些结果必须真的有差异，并在后文读取。不能继续承诺“打赢可守住”，又把所有打法都改成同一败局。

如果改编概念允许胜负改写，再给真正对应的后续，不让原小说结果无条件覆盖玩家。是否保留原结果，是上游选择；战后对白不能暗中替作者改变这个边界。
body.en:
If the source fixes loss of a position, a playable objective may concern evidence, a companion, or withdrawal. Those results need genuine differences and later reads. Do not still promise winning the position while rewriting every strategy as the same defeat.

If the chosen adaptation permits changed outcomes, provide corresponding consequences rather than unconditionally restoring the novel. Keeping the source result is an upstream choice; aftermath dialogue cannot silently alter that boundary.

heading.zh: 分开核胜负、奖励、人物与下一步
heading.en: Check Outcome, Reward, Character, and Next Action

body.zh:
从本轮初态走到结算，再进共享战后场景，核真实胜负、持物、资源、见证与可用动作。至少用一条相邻结果揭露串线；有平局、撤退或不同目标完成状态时，也按本作规则检查。

奖励只发一次，事件历史保留发生过什么。文本叫法改了不等于状态改了；构建后看实际提交与反馈，角色是否动人、战斗是否好玩另看试玩，不拿结果对齐代替全部质量。
body.en:
Trace initial state through resolution into the shared aftermath, checking actual outcome, objects, resources, witnesses, and actions. Use a neighboring result to expose contamination; ties, retreats, or distinct objective states follow this game’s rules too.

Deliver rewards once and retain event history. A changed label is not changed state. After building, inspect actual commits and feedback; character appeal and combat enjoyment need playtest evidence beyond aligned results.

q.zh: 玩家打赢后，剧情还能安排困难吗？
q.en: Can difficulties continue after victory?

a.zh: 可以。承认本战实际赢了、发放应得结果，再让已有其他问题继续。别把新困难写成这次胜利从未发生，也别让胜利自动解决无关冲突。
a.en: Yes. Acknowledge the victory and its earned result while other established problems continue. Do not erase this win or make it solve unrelated conflicts.

q.zh: 小说原作必败，还能改成有选择的游戏吗？
q.en: Can a fixed defeat still support choices?

a.zh: 可以，但需在概念里明确玩家能改变的目标，让保人、保物或撤离选择有真实后果。不能宣传玩家能改胜负，却在过场无条件抹掉结果。
a.en: Yes, with a clear playable objective and real consequences for people, objects, or withdrawal. Do not promise outcome agency and erase it unconditionally in a cutscene.

text.zh: 把原作边界、选定战斗目标、胜负规则与战后场景交给 game-world-design。核各结果怎样改变后续动作、人物回应和物件，保留玩家已提交行为；只修断开的读取点，不替实现重造战斗系统，也不把纸面分支称为试玩结论。
text.en: Give game-world-design the source limits, chosen objective, outcome rules, and aftermath. Check actions, replies, and objects for each result, preserving committed player conduct. Repair disconnected reads without redesigning the combat system or claiming a paper branch is playtested.

label.zh: 类型规则、世界响应与后续决策
label.en: Genre rules, world responses, and later decisions

label.zh: 因果权、结算权与人物回响
label.en: Causal agency, outcome agency, and character callbacks

label.zh: 胜负、持物与事件由规则提交
label.en: Rules commit outcomes, possession, and events

title.zh: 小说人物死亡怎么写：生前选择、死因与留下的空缺
title.en: How to Write a Character Death That Matters

seo_title.zh: 小说人物死亡怎么写
seo_title.en: How to Write a Character Death

description.zh: 先让读者认识活着的人，再核死亡如何发生、谁知道什么，以及关系和日常怎样改变。附完整原创片段与常见失败修法。
description.en: Establish the living character, the cause of death, who knows what, and the changed relationships. Includes original prose and revision checks.

answer.zh: 先写这个人活着时想要什么、如何与别人相处，再检查死亡的原因、时机和已建立的故事规则。确认死亡与失踪、传闻分开；消息怎样被人物获知，要在文中成立。后续写具体的人与生活如何回应空缺，不把死亡只当主角升级按钮，也不要求所有人哭、复仇或马上释怀。
answer.en: Show what the character wanted while alive and how they lived with others. Check the death’s cause, timing, and established rules. Separate a confirmed death from disappearance or rumor, and establish how people learn about it. Let particular relationships and routines respond to the absence without making death an upgrade button or requiring tears, revenge, or immediate acceptance.

heading.zh: 先写活着的人，别只铺“他快死了”
heading.en: Establish a Person Who Is Alive

body.zh:
问三个具体问题：他自己还想做什么？别人和他有过怎样的相处？他在压力下会怎样选择？人物可以不讨喜，也不必临终才变得完美。写一个真实相处比连加几段赞美更有用。

本页组合人物目标、退场规划、具体情感投入和可信反应，整理成死亡桥段检查；不是 skill 的专用死亡公式。普通悲伤场景未必有人死亡，本题另外要核“死亡事件本身是否成立”。
body.en:
Ask what the character still wanted, what contact others had with them, and how they chose under pressure. They need not be likable or become perfect at the end. An actual shared experience does more than several added tributes.

This page combines character goals, planned exits, emotional investment, and credible response into an editorial check, not a native death formula. A sad scene need not involve death; this task also checks whether the event itself holds.

heading.zh: 核死因、可用办法与消息来源
heading.en: Check Cause, Available Options, and Knowledge

body.zh:
| 要核什么 | 具体问法 |
|---|---|
| 原因与时机 | 既有局势为何在这里造成死亡？不要到事后才添关键规则 |
| 人物选择 | 他为何在场、用了什么已知办法？突然变蠢不是唯一解法 |
| 已有救助 | 本书若已有可用救助或复活手段，此刻为何不能直接解决？ |
| 确认消息 | 视角人物看见了什么、从谁处获知？失联和传闻仍可未确认 |
| 后续影响 | 哪段关系、习惯或未完目标发生变化？不必全转成新任务 |

死亡可以突然发生，不要求本人主动选择牺牲。若作品允许复活，就遵守已建立规则；若要改规则，先改相应设定和前文，不让下一章一句“其实没事”抹掉此前的失去。
body.en:
| Check | Question |
|---|---|
| Cause and timing | Why does the established situation produce death here? Avoid a crucial rule added afterward. |
| Conduct | Why was the person there, and which known options did they use? Sudden foolishness is not the only route. |
| Available help | If rescue or resurrection already exists, why can it not resolve this case? |
| Confirmation | What does the viewpoint witness or learn from whom? Lost contact or rumor may remain unconfirmed. |
| Aftermath | Which relationship, routine, or unfinished aim changes? It need not all become another task. |

Death may be sudden without voluntary sacrifice. Follow established resurrection rules if the book has them. A rule change needs corresponding setup rather than an effortless next-chapter reversal erasing the loss.

heading.zh: 完整原创例：小椅子没有替他完成一生
heading.en: Complete Original Example: An Unfinished Chair

body.zh:
虚构故事里，木匠陈伯打算春天回乡种杏树，也在给孙女做小椅。他教徒弟陆禾手艺，却常和陆禾争执该不该接便宜急单。生前一次相处是：

> “椅腿又长了。”陆禾把刨子递过去。
>
> 陈伯把他刚刨的那根放回一旁。“留着，下回用。她长得快，你别一回全刨短。”
>
> “你回乡后，谁给她改？”
>
> “她要是还肯坐，我回来一趟。她要是嫌小，就让她选新的。”

后来的城门失守已有战事铺垫。故事明确写出陈伯在带街坊撤离时遇害，同行的赵婶亲见，陆禾随后看见运回的遗体并听她说明经过；这里是已确认死亡，不是仅凭失联推定。他没能回乡，陆禾也没有凭悲痛突然得到新能力。数日后：

> 陆禾拿起留在桌边的椅腿，想把剩下的都刨成一样长。刨子碰到木头，他停住了。
>
> 小满站在门口。“那是我的？”
>
> “是。你爷爷还没做完。我可以接着做。”
>
> 她看了会儿。“先别。我想把画放在这里。”
>
> 陆禾把刨子收进抽屉，腾出桌面。小满摊开自己的画，陈伯的椅腿被挪到一旁。
>
> “画的是老家？”
>
> “他总说杏树。我没见过。”
>
> 陆禾看着纸上的树，没有替她纠正。他也没见过陈伯说的那片院子。

孙女把画放上桌，徒弟实际让出位置，椅子仍未完工。熟悉的指导和回乡愿望都留下了空缺；这次相处没有证明悲伤结束，也没有让小满承担传承手艺的义务。若作者要写战事责任、继续做椅或另一种回应，另按已发生事实展开，不能把本片段当作那些结果已完成。
body.en:
In this fictional story, carpenter Chen plans to return home in spring to plant apricot trees and is making a small chair for his granddaughter. He teaches apprentice Lu He, but they often disagree over cheap rush orders. Earlier contact:

> “This leg is too long again.” Lu handed him the plane.
>
> Chen set the newly trimmed leg aside. “Keep it for next time. She grows fast. Don’t shorten every one at once.”
>
> “Who’ll adjust it after you move home?”
>
> “If she still wants the chair, I’ll come back. If it’s too small, let her choose a new one.”

The later fall of the city gate follows established fighting. The story states that Chen is killed while helping neighbors leave: Mrs. Zhao witnesses it, and Lu subsequently sees the returned body and hears her account. Death is confirmed rather than inferred from lost contact. Chen never returns home; grief gives Lu no sudden new ability. Several days later:

> Lu picked up the leg left by the table, intending to trim the others to match. The plane touched wood. He stopped.
>
> Xiaoman stood in the doorway. “Is that mine?”
>
> “Yes. Your grandfather didn’t finish. I can carry on.”
>
> She watched it. “Not yet. I want to put my drawing here.”
>
> Lu put the plane in the drawer and cleared the table. She spread her drawing out; Chen’s chair leg moved aside.
>
> “Is that his hometown?”
>
> “He always talked about apricot trees. I’ve never seen it.”
>
> Lu looked at the trees on the paper without correcting them. He had never seen the courtyard Chen described either.

The child places the picture and the apprentice actually makes room. The chair remains unfinished. Familiar guidance and the homecoming wish leave an absence. This contact proves neither completed grief nor a duty for Xiaoman to inherit the craft. Accountability for the fighting, completing the chair, or another response needs its own later development rather than being reported as already delivered here.

heading.zh: 让反应贴合这个人、这段关系
heading.en: Fit the Response to the Person and Relationship

body.zh:
有人当场哭，有人先处理眼前事，有人拒绝继续谈；同一个人也可能先后有不同反应。写清触发与相处，不把反应排成所有人通用的阶段表。必要的直接情绪或内心可以保留，不为“克制”堆满拿杯子、攥手指。

预先告知坏结果再写生前日常，是来源中的一种悲壮写法；突然失去也可成立。选哪一种取决于视角和作者想让读者经历什么，不要求每次都先告别、说遗言或埋一个信物。
body.en:
Someone may cry immediately, handle an immediate need, or refuse further talk; one person may respond differently over time. Establish triggers and contact without imposing a universal sequence. Direct feeling or thought can remain; restraint does not require piles of cup-holding and clenched fingers.

The source offers showing a known bad outcome before warm earlier contact as one tragic technique. Unexpected loss can also work. Choose around viewpoint and desired experience without requiring farewells, last words, or a keepsake every time.

heading.zh: 没有分量时，先修缺的那一环
heading.en: Repair the Missing Basis for Impact

body.zh:
| 问题 | 优先修法 |
|---|---|
| 只临死前突然补“大家都爱他” | 找生前真实目标与相处，少加赞美说明 |
| 既有办法明明可救，却无人想到 | 回查规则、时间与人物所知，不能只说“为了悲剧” |
| 所有人立即同样哭、同样复仇 | 按不同关系与当前能力写回应 |
| 下一章忘记这个人 | 在需要时表现已改变的日常或目标，不规定每章提名字 |
| 复活随口发生，损失全消失 | 核已定规则和实际后果，明确作者是否改了结局 |

先修影响相信的地方，再调表达强度。能否打动读者仍要看整段文本与阅读反馈，死亡人数、哭喊长度和作者自评都不能代替。
body.en:
| Problem | First repair |
|---|---|
| Everyone suddenly loves the person only at the end | Establish earlier aims and contact rather than add praise. |
| Available help is inexplicably ignored | Recheck rules, time, and knowledge; “for tragedy” is not a cause. |
| Everyone instantly cries or seeks revenge alike | Write responses from different ties and present capacities. |
| The person disappears from the next chapter’s world | Show changed routines or goals when relevant, without a name quota. |
| Casual resurrection erases all loss | Check established rules and actual consequences, including a changed authorial outcome. |

Repair belief first, then tune expression. Impact still depends on the whole passage and reader response rather than a death count, length of crying, or the author’s own rating.

q.zh: 重要人物死亡一定要有最后一句话吗？
q.en: Does a major death require last words?

a.zh: 不必。遗言适合部分场景，突然死亡、消息传来或事后空缺也能承载情绪。看既定死因、视角和节奏，不让所有人临终都解释一生。
a.en: No. Last words suit some scenes; sudden death, news, or later absence can also carry feeling. Follow cause, viewpoint, and pacing without making everyone explain a lifetime at the end.

q.zh: 人物死亡后，主角必须改变或复仇吗？
q.en: Must the protagonist transform or seek revenge afterward?

a.zh: 不必立刻成长或接复仇任务。相处、生活或认知可以有具体变化，也可以暂时停住；死亡不能自动证明新能力、成熟或释怀已经完成。
a.en: Immediate growth or revenge is unnecessary. Contact, routine, or understanding may change, or the person may pause. Death does not prove that ability, maturity, or acceptance has been gained.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 审读点名的死亡桥段，附生前片段、已定死因、当前视角知情与后续安排。先核人物是否只为死亡存在、原因是否成立、谁已确认消息和反应是否贴合关系。保留作者选定结果和文风，不加新死亡、复活或自动复仇；先给具体改法，采用后再改点名段。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to review the named death passage with earlier scenes, chosen cause, current knowledge, and aftermath. Check whether the character exists only to die, whether the cause holds, who has confirmation, and how responses fit the relationships. Retain the chosen outcome and voice; add no death, resurrection, or automatic revenge. Propose specific repairs before revising the named passage.

label.zh: 人物目标、动机与退场规划
label.en: Character aims, motives, and planned exits

label.zh: 具体投入、意义变化与可信反应
label.en: Specific investment, changed meaning, and credible response

label.zh: 预知失去与场景后反应
本书表达与事实边界

title.zh: AI写小说提前揭底怎么办：本章停点与后续安排
title.en: How to Stop AI Fiction from Revealing Future Plot Too Soon

seo_title.zh: AI写小说提前揭底怎么办
seo_title.en: Stop AI Fiction from Revealing Future Plot Too Soon

description.zh: 明确本章必须完成、不能提前揭示和停笔的位置，保留眼前回报。附相册故事的越界对照、完整改写片段和返修简报。
description.en: Specify the current payoff, protected later revelations, and stopping point. Includes an album-story repair and a focused revision brief.

answer.zh: 把本章要完成的事、后续才揭示的信息和本次停笔点并列给出，写完逐项对照正文。提前揭底时，只返修越界段和依赖它的当前反应，保留本章应有的进展；不能用删除所有发现来拖慢故事。作者明确决定提前揭示，则同步后续安排，不把新的决定仍标成“按原纲”。
answer.en: Give the current chapter’s required payoff, protected later information, and stopping point together, then compare them with the draft. Repair the premature revelation and current reactions depending on it while retaining earned progress. Removing every discovery only stalls the story. If the author chooses an earlier reveal, update the later plan rather than still calling the draft faithful to the old outline.

heading.zh: 先分清提前揭底、局部完成和作者改纲
heading.en: Separate Early Revelation From a Present Payoff

body.zh:
本章找到一条线索、完成一次合作或拿到奖励，并不等于提前大结局。真正要核的是：用了后续才有的证据吗？确认了本轮不能确认的身份或真相吗？越过停笔事件，把下一章也写了吗？

作者主动调整揭示顺序也可以。要改就明确采用新安排；若当前任务只是按原细纲续写，不能因“这样更精彩”自行提前。文风允许旁白评论或切视角，也不等于可以突破已定信息边界。
body.en:
Finding a clue, completing cooperation, or earning a reward need not be a premature ending. Check whether the draft uses later evidence, confirms an identity or truth reserved for another stage, or continues into another chapter beyond the stopping event.

An author may change reveal order. Adopt that plan explicitly. A request to follow the current outline does not authorize acceleration simply because it seems more exciting. Narrator commentary or a viewpoint change does not override established information bounds.

heading.zh: 把“本章要给什么”和“不能给什么”一起写
heading.en: State the Payoff and the Protected Information Together

body.zh:
| 本轮简报 | 第8章相册例 |
|---|---|
| 本章完成 | 许桐找到缺失照片、放回相册，并与母亲约定一起查看 |
| 当前证据 | 原相册空位、照片缺角、背面日期；无人物姓名 |
| 后续安排 | 第14章取得另一张合影与父亲旧友说明，才确认照片人物 |
| 本章禁止 | 不提前使用那份说明，不确认身份，不写后续调查结果 |
| 停笔事件 | 母亲在电话中答应周末一起看之后停止 |

这是作者整理的返修简报，不是新增的原生表单。给AI当前细纲和相关阶段边界即可，不用把整本设定全塞进同一提示。前文已改变时先同步事实；缺失安排留待作者定，不临时猜一个终局。
body.en:
| Brief | Album example, chapter 8 |
|---|---|
| Present delivery | Xu Tong finds the missing photo, restores it, and arranges to view it with his mother. |
| Current evidence | Album gap, torn corner, and date; no name. |
| Later plan | Another group photo and the father’s old friend’s account in chapter 14 establish identity. |
| Exclusions | No early use of that account, identity confirmation, or later investigation result. |
| Stop | End after the mother agrees by phone to look together at the weekend. |

This is an editorial repair brief rather than a new native form. Supply the current outline and relevant stage boundaries without stuffing every setting into one prompt. Synchronize changed earlier facts first; missing decisions remain for the author rather than an invented ending.

heading.zh: 完整改写：找到照片，仍不知道照片里是谁
heading.en: Complete Repair: Find the Photo Without Identifying Its Subject

body.zh:
原创故事中，许桐整理父亲旧相册，上一章已看见一处空位，边角残留半片照片纸。第8章只完成找回和约定。原稿却写“他立刻认出，那就是父亲一直寻找的人”，接着写两人相见；当前材料没有识别依据，且会提前消费后续安排。

按上表返修，保留已经选定的寻照结果，片段可以是：

> 抽屉拉开时，那张照片贴着柜底落了出来。许桐把它捡起，先看背面：日期还在，下面空着。
>
> 他翻回正面。父亲站在树边，旁边的人看着镜头。缺掉的角刚好能接上相册里留下的半片纸。
>
> 许桐把照片放回空位，压平卷起的边，又拨通母亲的电话。
>
> “缺的那张找到了。”
>
> “夹好了吗？别再掉了。”
>
> “夹好了。爸旁边那个人，你认得吗？”
>
> “发我看一眼。”
>
> 许桐拍下照片，发了过去。母亲在电话里说收到了，过了一会儿才答：“我不认得。周末你带来，我们一起看。”
>
> “好，周末。”
>
> 他合上相册，放进准备带走的帆布袋。

照片找到了、放回了，母亲收到照片、听见请求并实际答应一起看；身份仍未确认。本章有明确回报，结尾还有共同查看的期待，不靠把找回也删掉维持悬念。这里不再接“几天后他终于查出”，也不预告人物后来是谁。

若越界稿已经被后文当成事实，返修还要检查相关知情、对白与行动；不能只删一个名字，保留人物已经依此作出的决定。反过来，作者若真想第8章揭晓，需补识别依据并调整第14章功能，而非仍称遵守原安排。
body.en:
In this original story, Xu sorts his father’s old album. The previous chapter shows a gap with part of a torn photo corner. Chapter 8 delivers retrieval and an arrangement only. The faulty draft says he immediately recognizes the person his father has been seeking and proceeds to their meeting. Current materials provide no basis for recognition, and the passage consumes later plans.

Retain the chosen retrieval result while repairing the reveal:

> When the drawer opened, the photo slipped down against the cabinet’s base. Xu picked it up and checked the back first: the date remained, with nothing below it.
>
> He turned it over. His father stood by a tree; the other person faced the camera. The missing corner fitted the paper left in the album.
>
> Xu put the photo back, flattened its curled edge, and called his mother.
>
> “I found the missing one.”
>
> “Is it secured? Don’t let it fall out again.”
>
> “It is. Do you recognize the person beside Dad?”
>
> “Send me a picture.”
>
> Xu photographed it and sent it. She said she had received it, then answered after a pause: “I don’t recognize them. Bring it at the weekend and we’ll look together.”
>
> “All right. This weekend.”
>
> He closed the album and put it in the canvas bag he would take.
