title.zh: 小说救援场景怎么写：抵达、配合与真正脱困
title.en: How to Write a Rescue Scene

seo_title.zh: 小说救援场景怎么写
seo_title.en: Write a Rescue Scene

description.zh: 先定要救谁、困在哪里和怎样才算脱困。附完整幻想场景，检查已知能力、被救者行动、撤离路线与救出后的关系。
description.en: Define the person, obstacle, and escape result. Includes a complete fantasy rescue with established abilities, cooperation, and an actual exit.

answer.zh: 先定救援结果，再核谁知道被困位置、怎样抵达、什么阻止带人离开，以及双方能做什么。把接近、接触与撤离写成因果相接的行动，被救者按实际状态参与；不能用打赢一场架、开了门或一句感谢代替真正脱困。救人可以出于关心，不必须换成恋爱、忠诚或额外奖励。
answer.en: Choose the rescue outcome, then establish who knows the location, how to reach it, what prevents departure, and what each person can do. Connect approach, contact, and withdrawal causally, with participation suited to the trapped person’s state. Winning a fight, opening a door, or receiving thanks does not itself establish escape. Care may motivate rescue without a mandatory reward of romance or loyalty.

heading.zh: 先定救出结果，不把赢了等同于安全离开
heading.en: Define Escape Before Writing a Victory

body.zh:
救援的核心结果是某个人脱离当前困境。击退对手、赶到门口或获得钥匙，可能只是中间步骤。先写本场终点在哪里、谁必须到达、还保留哪些危险；部分救出或失败也可以，但别把没完成写成完成。

本页用真实方法中写前确定结果、能力与环境约束、动作后果、人物独立目标和情绪因果来安排救援，原创封印室不是 skill 的原生案例。打斗篇处理攻防和胜负，本页重点是找到人之后怎样一起离开；救援不一定需要战斗。
body.en:
The central result is a person leaving a specific predicament. Repelling an opponent, reaching the door, or obtaining a key may be intermediate steps. Define the endpoint, who must reach it, and remaining danger. Partial rescue or failure may be chosen, but incomplete action cannot be reported as complete.

This page combines the sources’ chosen outcomes, abilities and environmental limits, action consequences, independent aims, and emotional causality. The seal room is original, not a native skill case. Combat concerns exchanges and victory; rescue concerns getting people out together and need not include combat.

heading.zh: 把地点、信息和可用手段接起来
heading.en: Connect Location, Knowledge, and Available Means

body.zh:
| 需要明确 | 本例事实 |
|---|---|
| 谁被困 | 档案员何初，误封在塔东室；能走动、能说话，手里一筒自己的笔记 |
| 如何知道 | 陶森在本场之前已收到何初从门缝递出的求助纸条，位置写明 |
| 已有手段 | 塔管已借给陶森一把东室钥匙；她另有一枚已说明作用的鸣石 |
| 进入路线 | 从庭院经外廊到东室门前，门外可用钥匙解封 |
| 退出阻力 | 解封声引外廊影兽靠近；原路现在不宜通过 |
| 内侧知识 | 何初当天走过右侧杂物廊到庭院的通道，可指路；当前出口仍须核 |
| 本场终点 | 两人实际进入有闭合结界的庭院，影兽留在外侧；笔记仍在何初 |

路线不必画成复杂地图，读者需要知道关键选择为什么可行。提前建立救援依赖的钥匙、能力和信息；不能最后一刻突然增加传送、万能药或未说过的后门。被困原因也要与这些路线相容：右侧通道在室外，何初被封在室内时到不了它。
body.en:
| Establish | This example |
|---|---|
| Trapped person | Archivist He Chu was accidentally sealed in the east room; can walk and speak and holds one tube of personal notes. |
| Location knowledge | Before the scene, Tao received He’s plea through the door gap, specifying the location. |
| Means | The tower keeper lent Tao the east-room key; she has one sound stone whose function is established. |
| Entry | From the courtyard through the outer hall to unlock the room externally. |
| Withdrawal obstacle | Unsealing draws a hall shadow beast toward them; the return route is obstructed. |
| Inside knowledge | He used the right-hand service passage to the courtyard earlier today and can guide; the current exit still needs checking. |
| Endpoint | Both enter the warded courtyard, with the beast outside and the notes still with He. |

Readers need the basis for critical route choices, not an elaborate map. Establish key means and information before reliance rather than inventing teleportation, cures, or exits at the climax. The service passage lies outside the sealed room, so it was unavailable to He while trapped.

heading.zh: 完整原创片段：开门之后，还得一起走出去
heading.en: Complete Original Scene: Getting Out After Opening the Door

body.zh:
幻想小说已有规则：东室只能从外解封；鸣石掷出后会持续发声，不能命令影兽离开；庭院结界让影兽无法穿过，入口处可由人直接跨入。陶森与何初是共同整理旧档案的朋友。陶森先救人、资料另办，何初想带走自己手中的笔记。以下写到两人脱困，不结算塔内所有问题：

> 钥匙转到底，门上的蓝线消退。陶森推开门，何初已经走到门后，怀里抱着笔记筒。
>
> “出来。”她让出门口。
>
> 外廊传来刮墙声。来时还贴在远处壁上的影子向门前拉长，拦住了她准备返回的方向。陶森取出仅剩的鸣石，望向左边的廊弯。
>
> 何初跟着她跨出房门。“右边。杂物廊通庭院，我上午走过。”
>
> “出口开着？”
>
> “上午开着，现在得看。”
>
> 陶森把鸣石掷到左侧廊弯。响声连成一串，影兽转向了那边；她没等它消失，跟何初一起转进右廊。何初把筒夹在臂弯，空出的手推开尽头虚掩的木门。庭院结界的亮边还在。
>
> “通了，跟我来。”
>
> 他先跨入庭院，陶森紧随其后。刮墙声追到门边，被亮边挡在外侧。何初停在院中的石桌旁，放下笔记筒，再回头看她。
>
> “你真来了。”
>
> “先到这儿。东室的资料还没拿。”陶森看着空下来的石袋，“鸣石还在外廊，今天不回去拿了。”
>
> 何初确认筒里的纸还在，把它留在自己身边。“明天我去找塔管，把误封的记录补上。今天不再进去了。”
>
> 她点头，同他在石桌边坐下。影子仍刮着院外的墙，两个人已经不在它能碰到的地方。

钥匙解除室内困境，鸣石争取转向，何初提供通道知识并实际核出口，两人跨过已有结界才完成本场救出。影兽没有被杀，其他档案仍未取回，何初关于明天的安排只是计划。感谢表达他的感受，不自动成立恋爱或终身追随。

本例从受困到安全位置全写清；若人物无法行走或说话，改相应配合方式与运送条件，不能照抄“跟我来”就完成移动。需要改变既有设定时先由作者决定，不用补一句隐藏能力遮过缺口。
body.en:
Established fantasy rules: the east room unseals only from outside. A thrown sound stone keeps making noise without commanding beasts away. People can cross the courtyard ward, but shadow beasts cannot. Tao and He are friends cataloging old records. Tao prioritizes rescue; He wants to retain his notes. The scene ends with their escape, not resolution of every tower problem.

> The key reached its stop and the blue seal faded. Tao pushed the door open. He was already behind it, holding his note tube.
>
> “Come out.” She cleared the doorway.
>
> Scraping came from the outer hall. The shadow that had clung to a distant wall lengthened toward them, obstructing her return. She took out her last sound stone and looked toward the left-hand bend.
>
> He stepped out beside her. “Right. The service passage reaches the courtyard. I used it this morning.”
>
> “Is the exit open?”
>
> “It was. We have to check now.”
>
> She threw the stone toward the left bend. As it rang, the beast turned that way. Without waiting for it to disappear, she followed He into the right passage. He tucked the tube under his arm and used his free hand to push the partly open end door. The bright edge of the courtyard ward remained.
>
> “Clear. Come with me.”
>
> He crossed first, Tao immediately behind. Scraping reached the door and stopped at the ward. He put the tube on the courtyard’s stone table and turned back.
>
> “You came.”
>
> “We’re here. The east-room records are still inside.” She looked at the empty stone pouch. “The stone is still in the hall. We’re not going back for it today.”
>
> He checked that his papers remained and kept the tube beside him. “Tomorrow I’ll ask the keeper to record the mistaken sealing. I’m not going back today.”
>
> She nodded and sat beside him. The shadow still scraped the outer wall. Neither person remained within its reach.

The key releases confinement; the stone gains a turn; He supplies and checks a route; both cross an established ward before rescue is complete. The beast survives, other records remain inside, and tomorrow’s report is only a plan. Thanks expresses feeling without automatically establishing romance or lifelong service.

If the person cannot walk or speak, change participation and transport accordingly. “Follow me” cannot perform unavailable movement. An author must choose any change to established rules rather than conceal a gap with a hidden power.

heading.zh: 被救者能配合，也可以确实需要帮助
heading.en: Participation Follows the Person’s Actual State

body.zh:
被救者有行动，不等于每个人都必须同样强。何初熟悉通道、能推门，所以他提供实用帮助；如果他被捆住，先解除限制；如果他失去意识，不能让他突然开口指路。

人物被救后仍有自己的愿望和判断。可以感谢、害怕、愤怒或不愿再进去，按经历写；别把一次救援自动变成全部服从。救援者也可以只是想让朋友活着，不必为“有自己的目标”强加财产、名望或感情回报。
body.en:
Participation does not require equal strength. He knows a route and can open a door, so he helps. Bound hands require release first; unconsciousness cannot conveniently become a spoken direction.

The rescued person retains wishes and judgment: gratitude, fear, anger, or refusal to reenter may fit. Rescue does not imply total obedience. Wanting a friend alive can motivate the rescuer without an added demand for wealth, fame, or affection.

heading.zh: 救援显得轻巧时，查哪一步没写到
heading.en: Find the Missing Step in an Unconvincing Rescue

body.zh:
| 问题 | 修法 |
|---|---|
| 无依据就找到人 | 补已有线索怎样被收到与理解，不替人物使用读者信息 |
| 门开了便宣布救出 | 接实际移动、出口与剩余危险 |
| 危险靠新能力消失 | 回到已定手段、空间和结果，缺口交作者决定 |
| 被救者只等别人安排 | 按可做的事与自身目标补回应，不能强迫重伤者完成动作 |
| 救出马上强制恋爱或归顺 | 分开本场感谢、以后接触与关系确认 |
| 为紧张每次都加死亡或牺牲 | 先写清已有障碍怎样限制选择，不要求救援必受罚 |

连读位置来源、抵达、接触和退出，核能力、持物、人物可行动程度及结尾。快慢放在关键判断和配合上，重复赶路可概述；平静救出也可以让读者放心，不强制再出一次险情。
body.en:
| Problem | Repair |
|---|---|
| Finding the person without evidence | Show receipt and interpretation of available clues, not access to reader-only information. |
| Opening means automatic rescue | Continue through actual movement, exit, and remaining danger. |
| A new power erases the obstacle | Return to established means, space, and outcome; let the author decide gaps. |
| The trapped person has no response | Use available actions and personal aims without demanding feats from someone unable to perform them. |
| Rescue forces romance or service | Distinguish thanks, later contact, and relationship agreement. |
| Every rescue adds death or sacrifice | Clarify existing limits without requiring punishment. |

Read discovery, arrival, contact, and exit together. Check powers, possession, capacity, and ending. Expand consequential decisions and cooperation while summarizing repetitive travel. A calm escape can reassure without one more obligatory emergency.

q.zh: 救援必须写成打斗吗？
q.en: Does a rescue need a fight?

a.zh: 不必。找到人、协商放行、解开既有限制和一起退出都能承担场景。若有打斗，胜负仍要接上被救者的实际去向。
a.en: No. Finding someone, negotiating release, lifting an established restriction, and leaving together can carry it. Combat still needs the person’s actual exit.

q.zh: 被救的人一定要对救援者产生好感吗？
q.en: Must rescue create affection for the rescuer?

a.zh: 不必统一。感谢、信任变化和恋爱是不同结果，按人物经历、当前关系与实际回应分别写。
a.en: No. Gratitude, changing trust, and romance are separate outcomes grounded in history, present ties, and actual response.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 检查点名救援场景，附已定结果、位置来源、人物可行动程度、能力和路线。核抵达、接触与实际撤离，保被救者回应、持物和剩余问题。只修本段，不新增隐藏能力或改成恋爱奖励，按本书文风交完整片段。
text.en: Use $story-long-write on the named rescue with outcome, location evidence, capacity, powers, and route. Check arrival, contact, withdrawal, responses, possession, and remaining problems. Preserve voice and scope without hidden powers or assumed romantic rewards.

label.zh: 结果、能力、环境与动作后果
旧关系、独立目标与真实回应
label.en: Established relationships, independent goals, and responses

label.zh: 具体投入、触发与意义变化
label.en: Specific investment, triggers, and changing meaning

label.zh: 连续场景、感知与详略
作者文风与事实边界

title.zh: 视频声音只有一边怎么办：先查声道，再改混音
title.en: How to Fix Video Audio Playing on One Side

seo_title.zh: 视频声音只有一边怎么办
seo_title.en: Fix One-Sided Video Audio

description.zh: 区分播放设备、空声道和有意的立体声。附旁白左右声道的完整纸面修订例子，说明响度归一化与复制音轨的边界。
description.en: Separate playback faults, an empty channel, and intentional stereo. Includes a narration repair example and the limits of normalization and stream copy.

answer.zh: 先比较当前成片、所选旁白文件与播放设备，确认声音偏一边发生在哪一层。若本意是居中的单人旁白，却把它存成左边有声、右边为空的立体声，选好有效通道后另存新的正确输入，再按实际路径重新混音。整体加音量不会填补空声道；有意的空间声与左右不同内容不要一起强制合成单声道。
answer.en: Compare the current export, selected voice file, and playback device to locate the imbalance. If a centered voice was stored as stereo with only its left channel active, select the valid channel and save a corrected input before remixing. Global gain cannot fill an empty channel. Preserve intentional spatial sound and genuinely different left and right content.

heading.zh: 先确认是一边没声，还是两边内容不同
heading.en: Locate the Imbalance Before Changing Channels

body.zh:
耳机只响一边，不足以证明视频坏了。先用熟悉的正常音频检查同一设备，再比较当前成片在另一副耳机或播放设备上的表现。若别的音频也偏一边，先处理播放端；若只有当前文件异常，继续查素材与混音。设备问题和文件问题也可能同时存在。

在音频编辑器中分开看、听左右通道，比较所选旁白输入与成片中的同一完整句。是所有声音都偏一边，还是只有旁白？一边完全为空、一边明显更轻、或者左右说了不同内容，需要不同处理。轨道名写着“stereo”只说明容器有两个通道，不证明两边都有人声。

本页依据真实混音的声道转换、输入采用与响度处理方法整理排查，不是 skill 自动诊断设备或自动补右声道的功能。导出完全无声与所有分段响度不一致已有独立教程，不重复展开。
body.en:
One silent earcup alone does not establish a damaged video. Test familiar working audio on the same device, then compare the current export on another headset or playback device. If other audio also leans to one side, investigate playback first. If this file alone differs, inspect its inputs and mix. Both faults can coexist.

In an audio editor, inspect and listen to left and right separately. Compare the selected narration input with the same complete sentence in the export. Does every sound lean, or just the voice? Silence, a quieter channel, and different content call for different decisions. A stereo label establishes two channels, not speech in both.

This editorial diagnostic draws on actual channel conversion, input selection, and loudness methods. The skill does not automatically diagnose hardware or fill the right channel. Separate guides cover an entirely silent export and uneven segment loudness.

heading.zh: 决定保留立体声，还是修正单人旁白输入
heading.en: Choose Between Preserving Stereo and Correcting a Voice Input

body.zh:
| 实际输入 | 对应决定 |
|---|---|
| 真正单声道的人声 | 在引用的完整声音混音路径中，左右各按 `1/sqrt(2)` 放置；这是该路径的规则，不是全平台标准 |
| 左右都有效的立体声 | 该路径分别保留两个通道；有意的人物方位、音乐和环境声可继续不同 |
| 左有完整旁白，右为空，本意是居中 | 先确认左边确为全部所需台词；用音频编辑器另存由左通道得到的新单声道人声，再采用新输入 |
| 两边是不同说话者或不同有效内容 | 先决定叙事职责，不能选一边就把另一人删掉 |
| 超过两个通道 | 引用的完整声音 v1 路径会拒绝，不支持随意提交自定义映射；先另行完成明确转换 |

不要只把文件标记改成“mono”，也别把空右通道复制回左边。新文件应有实际正确的样本与完整台词。若左右都有人声但相互抵消，简单相加还可能让内容变弱；先比较通道，不把所有立体声一键合并。

声音本来有空间位置时，居中不一定更好。修正的是本例意外偏置的旁白，不是把整片音乐、环境和人物方位全部抹平。
body.en:
| Actual input | Decision |
|---|---|
| Genuine mono voice | The cited full-sound path places it left and right at `1/sqrt(2)` each. This is a path rule, not a universal standard. |
| Valid stereo | That path preserves both channels independently, including intentional spatial voices, music, and ambience. |
| Complete voice on the left, empty right; centered delivery intended | Confirm all required speech is on the left, save a new mono voice from that channel in an audio editor, and select the new input. |
| Different speakers or useful content on each side | Assign their story roles before choosing a channel; do not discard another speaker. |
| More than two channels | The cited full-sound v1 path rejects this input and offers no arbitrary mapping. Complete an explicit conversion separately first. |

Changing a label to mono does not create correct samples. Copying the empty channel cannot recover speech. A new file must retain complete required words. If two voice channels cancel each other when combined, a simple sum can weaken the result; inspect them before combining.

Spatial placement can be intentional. The repair addresses an accidentally displaced narrator, without flattening every musical, environmental, and character position in the film.

heading.zh: 完整纸面例子：左边有旁白，右边只有音乐
heading.en: Complete Paper Example: Voice on the Left, Music on Both Sides

body.zh:
原创八秒解说，旁白是“她推开空柜，才发现昨晚的记录不在这里。”创作决定是让这个讲述者居中；音乐左右都有效。为说明运算，只取一句中同一瞬间的示意样本，下面不是录音测量：

| 步骤 | 输入、处理与结果 |
|---|---|
| 原始旁白 | 立体声示意 `(左0.20，右0.00)`；右边为空，不是故意把讲述者放左边 |
| 直接走完整声音路径 | 立体声分别保留。若底轨该瞬间为 `(0.02，0.02)`、段增益和主增益均为1，示意混音为 `(0.22，0.02)`；右边的音乐不等于右边有旁白 |
| 给原旁白整体加倍 | 得到 `(0.40，0.00)`，右边仍为空。RMS归一化也是整体乘增益，不会复制有效通道 |
| 修正输入 | 音频编辑器读取完整有效左通道，另存新的单声道文件，完整句长与台词保留；不覆盖原文件 |
| 重新采用并混音 | 新单声道示意0.20，经该路径分给两边各约0.1414；加上原底轨，示意两边各约0.1614 |
| 实际验收 | 重新生成候选，分别听左、右及合起来的完整句，再看正常速度的八秒；这些示意值不能证明输出无失真或可辨 |

仅改文件不够：把新的实际旁白路径交给当前分段元数据，并重新核对采用的文字、顺序和速度策略。确认当前混音真正消费新文件；旧快照、旧路径和旧成片不能冒充修订结果。完整声音路径不会自动裁尾或把放不下的句子缩短。

本例纸面上证明的是空声道不会由整体增益填补，以及选定单声道如何按该路径分到两边。我们没有生成或听过本例声音，因此不声称已经修好耳机表现、音色或最终响度。
body.en:
An original eight-second recap says, “She opened the empty cabinet and found last night’s records missing.” The author wants a centered narrator and valid stereo music. The values below represent one illustrative instant, not measured recording samples.

| Step | Input, operation, and result |
|---|---|
| Original voice | Illustrative stereo `(left 0.20, right 0.00)`: an empty right channel, not intentional placement. |
| Direct full-sound mix | Stereo remains independent. With a bed of `(0.02, 0.02)` and segment and master gains of 1, the illustrative sum is `(0.22, 0.02)`. Music on the right does not establish voice there. |
| Double the voice globally | `(0.40, 0.00)` still has an empty right channel. RMS normalization also applies a global gain rather than copying a valid channel. |
| Correct the input | Save the complete useful left channel as a new mono file in an audio editor. Preserve the sentence and duration; keep the original. |
| Select it and remix | Mono 0.20 becomes about 0.1414 on each side through this path. Adding the unchanged bed gives about 0.1614 per side. |
| Actual review | Render a new candidate; listen to each side and both together through the complete sentence, then watch the eight seconds at normal speed. Illustrative values establish neither intelligibility nor freedom from distortion. |

Update the actual voice path in the segment metadata and recheck selected words, order, and tempo policy. Confirm that the current mix consumed the new file. Old snapshots, paths, and exports are not a repaired result. The full-sound path will not cut a sentence ending or automatically shrink a placement that does not fit.

The paper example establishes only that gain cannot fill silence and how selected mono is distributed on this path. No example audio was produced or heard; headset behavior, voice quality, and final loudness remain unverified.

heading.zh: 按实际路径复核，不把复制当修复
heading.en: Review the Actual Path and Output

body.zh:
引用的显式完整声音路径将配音直接解码为48 kHz双声道浮点，单声道按等功率放置，立体声保留左右。它不走旧入口的44.1 kHz单声道转换，也不自动归一化或做声道补救。旧旁白入口有不同转换行为，不能拿旧入口听感或记录解释新路径。

`adopted-packet-copy` 保留已选AAC包，不改声道、不调增益。输入已经偏一边，复制后仍可能偏一边；要改声音就应另做明确的新声音版本，不能同时声称音轨原样冻结。复制检查通过也不是人声居中或已听审。

最终检查当前实际文件：完整旁白在两边是否如计划可听，必需对白与空间声是否保留，声音是否新增削波、相位问题或句尾缺失。看绑定记录可核输入与转换，看波形可查信号，听完整句才能评价听感；一个层面的通过不能替另一个层面下结论。
body.en:
The cited explicit full-sound path decodes voice directly to 48 kHz stereo float. It distributes mono at equal power and preserves stereo channels. It bypasses the older 44.1 kHz mono conversion and provides no automatic normalization or channel repair. The legacy narration entry behaves differently; its records or listening results do not describe the explicit path.

`adopted-packet-copy` preserves selected AAC packets without channel changes or gain. A one-sided input can remain one-sided. Repair requires an explicitly changed sound version, rather than a simultaneous claim of frozen audio. A successful copy check does not establish centered speech or listening review.

Review the current actual output: the whole voice sentence on both sides as intended, preserved dialogue and spatial cues, and no added clipping, cancellation, or missing ending. Binding records establish consumed inputs and conversion; waveforms reveal signal; complete listening evaluates the experience. These evidence layers do not substitute for each other.

q.zh: 响度归一化可以把右声道补回来吗？
q.en: Can loudness normalization restore the right channel?

a.zh: 不能。引用的TTS方法整体乘同一个增益，右边为零仍是零。先修订实际输入通道，再检查重新混音后的结果。
a.en: No. The cited TTS method multiplies samples by one gain; zero remains zero. Correct the actual input channels, then review the new mix.

q.zh: 立体声都应该改成单声道吗？
q.en: Should every stereo file become mono?

a.zh: 不用。有意的空间位置与左右不同的有效内容应按创作决定保留。本例只修正本应居中的单人旁白，不删除其他说话者、音乐或环境信息。
a.en: No. Preserve intentional positioning and distinct useful content. This example corrects a narrator intended at center without discarding other speakers, music, or ambience.

text.zh: 请用 video-assemble 排查这段旁白偏一边的问题。先核当前输入和实际声道，区分设备与文件；保留原文件，给出新输入的修订决定，再按实际混音路径生成短候选并回听两边。
text.en: Use video-assemble to investigate this one-sided narration. Check the selected input and actual channels, distinguish the device from the file, preserve the original, and select a corrected input before rendering and listening to a short candidate.

label.zh: 完整声音混音的真实声道矩阵
采用输入、实际快照与路径区别
label.en: Selected inputs, snapshots, and path differences

label.zh: TTS整体RMS增益不补空声道
label.en: Global TTS RMS gain does not fill silence

label.zh: 处理混音与原样复制的边界

title.zh: 叙事游戏合成制作怎么设计：材料、工具与成品
title.en: How to Design Crafting in a Story Game

seo_title.zh: 叙事游戏合成制作怎么设计
seo_title.en: Design Crafting in a Story Game

description.zh: 把制作写成条件、材料消耗、工具保留与成品归属。附完整道具间路线和失败演算，不用一句成功对白代替真实结算。
description.en: Define crafting conditions, consumed materials, retained tools, and output ownership. Includes a complete prop-room route and failure cases.

answer.zh: 先确定制作如何支持玩家当前目标，再写一条完整规则：需要哪些材料和工具，确认后扣什么、得到什么、失败或取消时保留什么。用有限库存从初态演算到成品，让界面说明缺项与实际结果。预览不扣料，已提交的一次制作不重复发货，制作完成也不自动等于成品已经交付或任务完成。
answer.en: Choose how crafting serves the player’s current goal. Specify required materials and tools, the cost and output on confirmation, and what stays unchanged on failure or cancellation. Trace finite stocks from the initial state to the owned product. Preview costs nothing; one committed craft grants once. Crafting does not automatically deliver the item or complete its quest.

heading.zh: 先问制作改变了什么选择
heading.en: Start With the Choice Crafting Changes

body.zh:
小说改编的游戏不必默认加入采矿、配方树或装备升级。只有玩家需要通过制作改变当前可做的事，这个系统才有理由占用内容与操作。若点“制作”只是让既定剧情继续，删掉它也没有损失，直接给道具可能更合适。

原创叙事游戏《小剧场开演前》中，玩家是道具管理员。演出负责人先明确需要两块舞台指示牌，玩家要从道具间现有物料做出来，再亲手交给负责人。这个小例子只讲已经选定的制作动作，不证明整个游戏的玩法深度。

本页组合真实方法中的动作前置、资源预算、状态变化、反馈与重开；配方和剧场是原创教学例子，不是仓库内置的制作模板。不要为了“有系统”再补天气、技能树或自动刷新商店。
body.en:
A novel adaptation needs no default mining loop, recipe tree, or equipment upgrade. Crafting earns its scope when it changes what the player can do. If pressing Craft merely continues predetermined prose and removing it changes nothing, directly supplying the item may work better.

In the original story game Before the Little Theater Opens, the player manages props. The production lead has requested two stage signs. The player must make them from available supplies, then hand them over. This small example explains an already selected crafting action, not the depth of the whole game.

The editorial method combines action preconditions, resource budgets, state changes, feedback, and restart. The theater and recipe are teaching inventions, not a built-in crafting template. Do not add weather, skill trees, or automatically restocked shops just to make more systems.

heading.zh: 把材料、工具和产物分开写
heading.en: Separate Materials, Tools, and the Product

body.zh:
| 规则项 | 本例确定的含义 |
|---|---|
| 当前目标 | 做出两块舞台指示牌；制作与交付是两个动作 |
| 玩家初态 | 木板2块、颜料1份、刷子1把、成品0块；人在可用道具台旁 |
| 有限来源 | 货架另有备用颜料1份；拿取后转入玩家库存，货架不自动补货 |
| 单次配方 | 木板1块＋颜料1份，产出指示牌1块 |
| 工具条件 | 必须持有刷子；本例刷子可重复用，制作不扣刷子 |
| 预览与取消 | 显示当前持有、所需数量与产物；未确认时不改库存 |
| 确认制作 | 重新核材料、刷子与地点；全部满足才一起扣料、加成品，并显示实际余量 |
| 失败 | 指出实际缺项，库存不变；不能先扣木板，再发现没颜料 |
| 成品归属 | 先由玩家持有；负责人尚未收到，舞台也尚未安装 |

“颜料一份”是本例为一块指示牌选定的消耗单位，不能拿来当现实涂料用量或通用平衡比。实现若换数量，设计也要同步裁决。工具会磨损、制作会失败或耗时，只有项目已经决定时才补对应规则，不凭常见游戏印象偷偷加上。
body.en:
| Rule | This example |
|---|---|
| Current goal | Make two stage signs. Crafting and delivery are separate actions. |
| Player start | Two boards, one paint portion, one brush, no signs; at an available prop bench. |
| Finite source | One spare paint portion on a shelf. Taking it transfers ownership; the shelf does not refill automatically. |
| One recipe | One board plus one paint portion produces one sign. |
| Tool | The player must hold the brush. This example keeps it reusable and does not consume it. |
| Preview and cancel | Show holdings, requirements, and output without changing inventory before confirmation. |
| Confirm | Recheck materials, brush, and location. Only when all qualify, debit materials and grant the product together; show actual remaining stock. |
| Failure | Explain the missing requirement with unchanged inventory. Never debit a board before discovering missing paint. |
| Ownership | The player holds the product; the lead has not received it, and it has not been installed. |

One paint portion is the selected game unit for this recipe, not a real painting estimate or universal balance ratio. If implemented quantities change, resolve the design too. Durability, chance, and crafting time need explicit project decisions rather than assumptions borrowed from other games.

heading.zh: 完整纸面路线：第一块成功，第二块缺料
heading.en: Complete Paper Route: One Success, Then a Shortage

body.zh:
以下只按上述原创规则走读，不是已经运行的游戏。每个状态写“木板／颜料／刷子／成品”，货架颜料单列，避免把世界里的物料同时算到玩家手里。

| 玩家行动 | 实际状态与可见反馈 |
|---|---|
| 查看配方 | 玩家 `2／1／1／0`，货架1。界面显示本次需木板1、颜料1，刷子保留；尚未扣料 |
| 取消预览 | 仍为 `2／1／1／0`，货架1；不是先制作再把数量退回 |
| 再开配方并确认第一次 | 条件满足，玩家变 `1／0／1／1`，货架1。显示“做好一块指示牌；还差一块。缺颜料1份” |
| 尝试再做一块 | 缺颜料，拒绝制作；仍 `1／0／1／1`，货架1。没有第二块成品，也没有扣最后木板 |
| 去货架拿备用颜料 | 玩家变 `1／1／1／1`，货架0。反馈说明这份已被取走，再点同一空架不发第二份 |
| 回道具台确认第二次 | 条件满足，玩家变 `0／0／1／2`，货架0；现在两块都在玩家手中 |
| 再尝试制作 | 缺木板与颜料，保持 `0／0／1／2`。这不是可无限刷牌的来源 |
| 查看交付入口 | 可以把两块交给负责人；截至此处只是选项可用，还没有交付、安装或宣布开演 |

这条路线让玩家看到“缺料—找已存在的来源—再制作”的连续操作。短缺提示可以指出已知货架；不能替玩家自动拿走颜料，也不能声称未查看的隐藏地点一定有库存。

若玩家输入“我已经做了十块”，它只是叙述候选，不能覆盖库存与实际已提交结果。按钮重复回传同一次完成结果也不再发一块；玩家主动发起下一次制作则重新查条件。本例的制作即时完成，因此不需要另造长任务队列。
body.en:
This is a paper walkthrough of the original rules, not a running game. Player stock uses `boards / paint / brush / signs`; shelf paint stays separate so world supplies are not simultaneously counted as owned.

| Action | State and feedback |
|---|---|
| Preview | Player `2 / 1 / 1 / 0`, shelf 1. Show one board and one paint required, with the brush retained; no debit. |
| Cancel | Still `2 / 1 / 1 / 0`, shelf 1. No craft and refund transaction is needed. |
| Reopen and confirm the first craft | Requirements hold. Player becomes `1 / 0 / 1 / 1`, shelf 1. “One sign made; one more needed. Missing one paint portion.” |
| Attempt another | Missing paint: reject with `1 / 0 / 1 / 1`, shelf 1 unchanged. No second sign or board debit. |
| Take the spare paint | Player `1 / 1 / 1 / 1`, shelf 0. The portion was transferred; clicking the empty shelf grants no second portion. |
| Return and confirm the second craft | Requirements hold. Player `0 / 0 / 1 / 2`, shelf 0. Both signs are now held. |
| Try again | Missing boards and paint; remain `0 / 0 / 1 / 2`. No infinite source of signs. |
| Inspect delivery | Handing both to the lead is available. It has not yet happened; neither installation nor opening the show is complete. |

The route shows shortage, an existing source, and another craft. Feedback can point to the known shelf without taking paint for the player or declaring stock at an unseen hidden location.

Typing “I made ten signs” proposes narration; it cannot override stock and committed results. Replaying the same completion response grants nothing again. A genuinely new craft action rechecks requirements. This example completes crafting immediately and needs no added long-task queue.

heading.zh: 用有区别的失败和重开检查规则
heading.en: Check Distinct Failures and Restart

body.zh:
除了上面的缺颜料，再从另一个明确初态查工具：玩家有木板2、颜料1、没有刷子、成品0，货架1。预览应说明“缺刷子”，确认不得扣料或发牌；若项目提供借工具路线，要写已有来源与借还规则，不让NPC突然送刷子补洞。

在本例，重开这一段回到玩家 `2／1／1／0`、货架1和负责人尚未收到指示牌的状态。制作历史与领料结果同时复位，不能玩家材料回初态而空货架保留，或成品保留再多领材料。真实项目若承诺保留进度，应另选一致的重开位置。

接入原型后，走一次成功、缺料、取消与重开，比较界面提示和实际库存。看到“成功”文字不能证明扣料与归属正确；库存演算正确也不能证明按钮好用、节奏有趣或经济平衡。若制作没有给当前选择增添价值，就回到范围判断，不靠加更多配方掩盖。
body.en:
Beyond missing paint, check a distinct tool state: two boards, one paint, no brush, no signs, shelf 1. Preview says the brush is missing; confirmation grants nothing and consumes nothing. A borrowing route needs an established source and return rules, rather than an NPC spontaneously supplying the missing tool.

This example restarts the segment at player `2 / 1 / 1 / 0`, shelf 1, and no delivered signs. Crafting history and material pickup reset consistently. Do not restore player materials while leaving the shelf empty, or retain products while restoring all supplies. A project promising retained progress needs a different coherent restart point.

In a prototype, exercise success, shortage, cancellation, and restart, comparing visible feedback with actual inventory. Success prose does not establish correct debits or ownership. Correct arithmetic does not establish usable controls, pacing, fun, or balance. If crafting adds no value to the current choice, reconsider scope instead of hiding the problem under more recipes.

q.zh: 工具一定要和材料一起消耗吗？
q.en: Must crafting consume its tools?

a.zh: 不一定。本例刷子是可重复使用的前置条件，木板与颜料才扣除。是否损耗服从已选规则，界面要在确认前说明。
a.en: No. This example retains a reusable brush while consuming boards and paint. Any wear follows explicit rules and must be clear before confirmation.

q.zh: 点取消需要把扣掉的材料加回去吗？
q.en: Must cancellation refund materials?

a.zh: 本例预览不扣料，取消只关闭预览，因此无需退款。确认后的已提交制作是另一个状态；若允许撤销，需明确成品和材料怎样一起恢复，不能只退料又留成品。
a.en: Preview in this example changes no stock, so closing it needs no refund. A committed craft is different. If undo is supported, define how materials and products revert together rather than refunding inputs while keeping outputs.

text.zh: 请用 game-world-design 设计本场制作动作。说明它为何服务已选核心玩法，写材料来源、工具条件、消耗、成品归属和下一步；演算一次成功、缺料、取消与重开，不另造无用制作系统。
text.en: Use game-world-design to define this crafting action within the chosen core experience. Specify material sources, required tools, consumption, output ownership, and the next action. Trace success, shortage, cancellation, and restart without adding an unnecessary system.

label.zh: 动作条件、消耗、状态与系统范围
label.en: Action conditions, consumption, states, and system scope

label.zh: 有限来源与可达资源预算
label.en: Finite sources and reachable resource budgets

label.zh: 成功、反例与重开路径检查

title.zh: 小说动作衔接写不清怎么办：位置、持物与先后
title.en: How to Write Clear Action Sequences in Fiction

seo_title.zh: 小说动作衔接怎么写
seo_title.en: Write Clear Action Sequences in Fiction

description.zh: 先核人物位置、手中物件和动作先后，再补读者需要的连接。附完整取信离场片段，不把场景写成动词清单。
description.en: Check positions, held objects, and action order, then supply necessary connections. Includes a complete scene without an inventory of every movement.

answer.zh: 先找读者在哪一步无法继续想象：谁在动、从哪里到哪里、手中物件去了哪儿，或前一个动作是否已经结束。只核这些必要事实，再用先后、受阻与结果连成正文。重要交接可以写清，读者已经能推断的抬手、转腕不必逐项记录；若事实本身冲突，先改选定动作，不靠“然后”掩盖。
answer.en: Locate the point readers cannot follow: who acts, where they move, where a held object goes, or whether the previous action has ended. Check those facts and connect sequence, resistance, and results. Clarify important handoffs without recording every wrist movement. If the facts conflict, revise the selected action rather than hiding it under “then.”

heading.zh: 分清动作重复、衔接缺口和事实冲突
heading.en: Separate Repetition, Missing Connections, and Contradiction

body.zh:
“推门、坐下、取信、转身”动词都具体，读者仍可能看不清发生了什么。先读动作前后：门是开着还是锁着，信从哪里来，动作中途有没有换人，物件是否已经递出。问题不一定是词不够漂亮。

本页处理一段连续动作的可理解性，区别于同一反应写三遍的重复、跨章节设定矛盾，以及追逐或打斗的策略设计。它组合真实写作方法中的动作依赖、状态中间过程、主语重置与事实保留，不是原生“动作审计协议”。

缺必要连接就补连接；动作真正不可能，就让作者选择怎样改。人物已经把手电放下，后来再拿起是不同动作，不能为去重复删掉；人物仍在门外却直接拿到室内物件，单加“随即”也不会让空间关系成立。
body.en:
“Opened, sat, took the letter, turned” uses concrete verbs but can still leave a scene unclear. Read the surrounding facts: an open or locked door, the letter’s source, a change of actor, and whether an object was already handed over. Better vocabulary may not address the problem.

This guide concerns one continuous sequence, distinct from repeating a reaction, contradictions across chapters, and chase or combat strategy. It combines action dependencies, intermediate states, subject resets, and factual preservation; it is not a native action-audit protocol.

Add a missing connection when that is the issue. An impossible action needs an author’s revision. Putting down a flashlight and picking it up later are different actions, not repetition to cut. Adding “immediately” cannot place an outside character next to an object inside.

heading.zh: 只记影响阅读的动作事实
heading.en: Record Only the Facts Readers Need

body.zh:
| 写前检查 | 本例决定 |
|---|---|
| 要做什么 | 沈禾从自家书房取封口信，带到前厅给正在等的陆景；不在书房拆信 |
| 空间 | 书桌在房内，未锁的抽屉朝她；门已打开，桌到门的过道可走，前厅在走廊另一端，厅内有桌 |
| 起始持物 | 左手拿折好的路线图，右手拿手电；信仍在抽屉 |
| 必要腾手 | 先把手电搁桌沿照着抽屉，再用右手拉开、取信；信放在左手的折图上 |
| 离开结果 | 抽屉合上，右手重新拿灯；到前厅实际递信，图仍自己持有 |

这是本页原创片段的已选事实，不是要求每本小说按表写动作。真实改稿只用原稿与作者已经确定的动作；不能为了顺口自动添一张桌子、让锁着的门变开，或把递出改成对方已经收下。

有两个人同场，交接处点名比省主语更重要。连续跟着同一个人时可以用代词或承接，不必句句报名字。具体写哪只手，只在腾手、受伤、交接等位置影响理解时需要。
body.en:
| Check | Selected facts for this example |
|---|---|
| Goal | Shen retrieves a sealed letter from her study and brings it to Lu in the front room. She does not open it in the study. |
| Space | The unlocked drawer faces her. The room door is open, the aisle is clear, and the front room, with a table, is at the other end of the hall. |
| Initial holdings | A folded route map in her left hand, a flashlight in her right; the letter remains in the drawer. |
| Freeing a hand | Set the light on the desk edge toward the drawer, use the right hand to open and retrieve, and place the letter on the map in the left. |
| Exit and outcome | Close the drawer, pick up the light, reach the front room, and actually hand over the letter. Shen keeps the map. |

These are selected facts for an original teaching scene, not mandatory choreography for every novel. In manuscript repair, use established actions. Do not invent a table, unlock a door, or turn an offered object into an accepted one for smoother prose.

With two people present, name the actor at a handoff rather than forcing omitted subjects. Within one person’s sequence, pronouns or continuity can replace repeated names. Specify a hand only when availability, injury, or transfer matters.

heading.zh: 完整原创片段：腾出右手，信才取出来
heading.en: Complete Original Scene: Free a Hand Before Taking the Letter

body.zh:
先看省略过头的版本：

> 沈禾拿着图和手电，拉开抽屉取出信，又合上抽屉，带着东西到了前厅，把信递给陆景。

它说了结果，却没交代关键腾手，结尾也没写陆景接没接。下面按表中同一组已选动作展开，没有追加新事故：

> 沈禾走到书桌前，左手还拿着折好的路线图。抽屉把手就在灯下，她把手电搁到桌沿，光照着抽屉，右手这才空出来。
>
> 信压在抽屉最上层。她拉开抽屉，用右手拿起信封，放在左手的折图上，指头一并扣住。封口还好好的。她推回抽屉，拿起手电，沿桌旁的空过道走到敞开的门口。
>
> “找到了？”陆景在前厅问。
>
> 她走过走廊，右手拿着灯，左手把图和信送到他面前。“信在上面，拿那封。”
>
> 陆景抽走信封，才问：“现在开？”
>
> “就在这里。”
>
> 他把信放在前厅桌上。沈禾留着路线图，把手电照过去，等他拆封。

腾手、取信、承托、重拿灯、穿过走廊和实际接收有前后依赖；连词标出关系，不替代动作本身。陆景抽走信后，信不再由沈禾持有；但截至本段他尚未拆开，内容还没被读到。

前厅桌子属于这段原创例子的场景安排，不能由此给真实改稿临时添家具。若本书原稿没有可放灯的位置，先采用已有放置处或由作者另定动作；例如改成另一人帮忙，会改变参与者与持物，不能叫只改表达。
body.en:
First, an overcompressed version:

> Holding the map and flashlight, Shen opened the drawer, took the letter, closed it, and went to the front room to offer the letter to Lu.

It gives outcomes without the crucial free hand or Lu’s acceptance. The expanded version follows the same selected sequence without an added accident:

> Shen reached the desk, the folded route map still in her left hand. The drawer handle lay in the light. She set the flashlight on the desk edge toward the drawer, freeing her right hand.
>
> The letter lay on top inside. She opened the drawer, picked up the envelope with her right hand, and laid it on the folded map in her left, holding both together. Its seal was intact. She closed the drawer, picked up the light, and followed the clear aisle to the open door.
>
> “Found it?” Lu called from the front room.
>
> She crossed the hall with the light in her right hand and offered the map and letter in her left. “The letter’s on top. Take that one.”
>
> Lu drew out the envelope. “Open it now?”
>
> “Here.”
>
> He laid it on the front-room table. Shen kept the map and aimed the light there, waiting for him to break the seal.

Freeing the hand, taking and supporting the letter, retrieving the light, crossing the hall, and acceptance have dependencies. Connectives reveal those relations rather than replacing actions. Lu accepts the letter from Shen, then places it on the front-room table. It has not yet been opened or read.

The front-room table belongs to this original scene. It is not permission to add furniture to an existing manuscript. Without a usable place for the light, use an established surface or let the author choose another action. Another person helping changes participation and holdings, rather than expression alone.

heading.zh: 写清不等于把每一步写满
heading.en: Clarity Does Not Require Every Movement

body.zh:
| 读不清的原因 | 有用修法 |
|---|---|
| 多个动作挤成无关系的逗号串 | 先核真实顺序，再用“先、才、又”或相应句法表达；不把所有动作改成同时发生 |
| 交接省了主语 | 在换人处点名，写递出与实际接受；不按名字出现次数删 |
| 物件忽然不见或多了一份 | 查放置、转交与实际持有，不凭空复制信或灯 |
| 把握拳、抬眼重复写成新进展 | 只在有新信息或功能时保留，不靠轮换身体部位改善衔接 |
| 为清楚加满转腕、迈腿、扭头 | 删读者已能推断且无作用的细节，保关键状态与因果 |

本例若取信只是普通过场，可以压成“她取出信，带到前厅交给陆景”，上下文已经确定地图与灯如何处理时更不必重演。若读者正要看谁拿到了尚未拆开的信，交接值得留下。

改后连读动作前、动作中和落点：是否仍是同一事实，是否能自然想象，句长和分段是否适合本书。短句、长句、概述都能清楚，不把某种句型或每个动作单独成段当成通用标准。
body.en:
| Cause of confusion | Useful repair |
|---|---|
| Actions form an unrelated comma list | Check their real order, then express it through syntax or sequence words; do not make everything simultaneous. |
| An unnamed handoff changes actors | Name the new actor and show offer and acceptance. Do not cut names by a quota. |
| An object disappears or duplicates | Check placement, transfer, and actual holdings rather than creating another letter or light. |
| Repeated fists or glances masquerade as progress | Retain new information or useful function, rather than rotating body parts. |
| Every wrist, footstep, and turn is recorded | Cut inferable details without purpose while preserving essential states and causality. |

If retrieving the letter is routine transit, summarize: “She took the letter to the front room and handed it to Lu.” With the map and light already settled by context, they need no replay. If the important question is who receives the unopened letter, retain that handoff.

Read into the action, through it, and out. Check preserved facts, natural imaginability, and the book’s sentence and paragraph rhythm. Short sentences, long sentences, and summary can all be clear; no sentence form or one-paragraph-per-movement rule is universal.

q.zh: 需要把左右手和每一步都写出来吗？
q.en: Must I specify every hand and step?

a.zh: 不需要。只有它影响动作可行性、交接或读者理解时才写。位置和持物已明确，普通迈步不必逐项记录；必要的一次腾手或转交则不能省到看不懂。
a.en: No. Specify them when availability, a handoff, or understanding depends on them. Do not itemize ordinary steps after positions and holdings are clear; retain a necessary free hand or transfer.

q.zh: 只加“然后”“接着”能修动作跳跃吗？
q.en: Can adding “then” fix an action gap?

a.zh: 先核事实。缺顺序提示可以改连接；缺实际移动、腾手或接收，就补作者选定的必要动作。已有动作冲突时，需要先改动作，连词不会让不可能的动作变可行。
a.en: Check facts first. A missing order cue needs a connection; a missing move, free hand, or acceptance needs the selected necessary action. A connective cannot make contradictory actions possible.

text.zh: 请用 story-long-write 修订这段动作衔接。先标读者在哪一步看不清，核已有位置、持物、人物和结果；只补必要连接，不添新事故或家具，不把正文写成每一步清单。
text.en: Use story-long-write to clarify this sequence. Locate the reading gap and check established positions, holdings, actors, and outcomes. Add only necessary connections without new incidents, furniture, or an inventory of every movement.

label.zh: 动作关系、状态过程与详略
label.en: Action relations, intermediate changes, and detail

label.zh: 连续场景与按信息分段
本书文风与不可静默改变的事实

title.zh: AI视频人物转身后变脸怎么办：参考角度与身份连续性
title.en: AI Video Character Changes Face After Turning: How to Fix It

seo_title.zh: AI视频人物转身后变脸怎么办：参考角度与身份连续性
seo_title.en: AI Video Character Changes Face After Turning: How to Fix It

description.zh: 检查正侧背识别、真实参考和转身动作，保住同一人物与剧情结果。附完整提示词示例及候选片复核，不靠重复“保持一致”。
description.en: Check identity across front, side and back views, real references and the turn itself. Includes a complete prompt and review without consistency guarantees.

answer.zh: 先比较转身前后是不是同一人物的既定脸型、头部轮廓与稳定特征，再检查参考是否覆盖当前角度、是否实际传入及转身有没有混进换装、运镜或多人动作。保留已接受的转身与剧情结果，按可用参考写起点、动作和终点；候选片需要逐段实际观看，提示词写了“同一个人”还不是验证。
answer.en: Compare established facial structure, head silhouette and stable features before and after the turn. Check whether usable references cover the relevant views and were actually supplied, and whether wardrobe changes, camera motion or multiple actors complicate the action. Preserve the accepted turn and story result through a clear start, action and end, then inspect the actual candidate.

heading.zh: 先区分变脸、换角度与光线变化
heading.en: Distinguish identity drift from a changed view

body.zh:
转到侧脸时鼻梁轮廓变得明显，背光时皮肤变暗，都不自动表示换人。要比较的是已接受的结构：下颌形状、头部与颈肩关系、发际和永久特征是否仍能对应。表情也会改变外观，不能把每一帧都要求成正脸证件照。

资产方法要求正面之外仍有可观察的识别通道。若唯一识别点是正面眉眼，背影段便很难认人；可从本来就确定的头发剪影、肩背轮廓等取用，不能为方便生成新增疤痕和配饰。

先定位第一次漂移：参考图本身已经不像，起始帧挂错，转到侧面时改变结构，还是回到正面才变成另一张脸。不同位置需要不同修法，不能全部写成“模型不稳定”。

本页处理一镜运动中的身份；换装前后怎样选择造型，见[人物换装](/drama-skills/character-look-variants)。
body.en:
A profile reveals the nose differently; backlight darkens skin. Neither alone proves a new identity. Compare accepted structure: jaw shape, head-to-neck/shoulder relationships, hairline and permanent features. Expression also changes appearance; every frame need not resemble a frontal ID photo.

The asset method calls for observable recognition beyond the front. If eyebrows and eyes are the only identifiers, the back view has little support. Use already-established hair silhouette or shoulder shape without inventing scars and accessories.

Locate the first drift: inconsistent references, a wrong start frame, structural change in profile, or a different face on returning front. These need different repairs rather than one diagnosis of instability.

This page addresses identity during motion. For selecting looks across wardrobe changes, see [look continuity](/drama-skills/character-look-variants).

heading.zh: 参考图要真能承担当前角度
heading.en: Give each actual reference a clear role

body.zh:
| 检查项 | 怎样判断 |
|---|---|
| 人物是否同一 | 正侧背图对应同一已接受身份与本镜造型，不混青年版、伤后版或另一人物。 |
| 图是否真实存在 | 打开实际文件检查；写过图片提示词不代表已经出图。 |
| 本镜如何用图 | 起始帧管开场状态，身份图管认人；按目标模型实际支持的方式绑定。 |
| 哪些事实不能跟着变 | 当前衣服、发型、年龄与持物来自已定设定，不由示例图顺手替换。 |
| 是否已经传入 | 检查本次任务实际素材，不以文档列了文件名证明服务收到了图。 |

不是每个工具都支持同时输入正侧背图，也不是图越多越好。先按当前模型的真实参考方式准备；本文不提供通用的多图槽位参数。只有正脸参考而运动需要背侧识别时，把缺口说明白，再补本镜所需角度。

侧身、背影和转头都还是同一人物，不必为每个姿势另建角色。长期造型变化与镜头瞬时朝向分别记录，避免身份描述被重复改写。
body.en:
| Check | What to establish |
|---|---|
| Same identity | Front, side and back references match the accepted person and current look, without mixing age stages or injuries. |
| Actual image | Open the file; an image prompt does not establish a generated picture. |
| Role | The start frame owns the opening state; identity reference owns recognition. Bind through the target’s supported method. |
| Retained facts | Clothing, hair, age and held objects follow the accepted setup rather than accidental reference differences. |
| Actual input | Check submitted media, not merely filenames listed in a document. |

Not every tool accepts front, side and back inputs together; more images are not automatically better. Use the target’s actual reference method. This article supplies no universal multi-image parameter. If a frontal reference cannot support needed side/back recognition, state the gap and prepare the relevant view.

Profile, back view and turning remain one person. Record lasting look changes separately from momentary orientation rather than repeatedly rewriting identity.

heading.zh: 原创示例：转回来认人，不能删掉这个动作
heading.en: Original example: the turn delivers recognition

body.zh:
原创阅览室场景：纪舟背对摄影机整理书车，听见入口值班员叫“纪舟”，转身看向门口，在终点露出正脸，观众认出他。摄影机位于入口一侧，看向书车，固定中景，不绕人走；没有换衣或新伤。已接受外观是窄长脸、左眉尾短缺口、自然卷黑发、肩背略前倾，头发低束。书车停在原处，双手离开车把后才转身。

这镜需要真实起始帧与可用身份参考。本页只有纸面示例，没有图片文件或生成结果，下面的正文不能当作已绑定素材的生产任务。

容易含混的写法：

> 人物华丽转身，镜头旋转，保持漂亮的脸，背影变正面，服装飘动，氛围越来越震撼。

它把机位运动与人物转身混在一起，“漂亮”也没有回答是哪一个人。不能靠删除转身来修，因为正脸揭示正是本镜结果。先回到已接受的动作与机位。
body.en:
Original reading-room scene: Ji Zhou faces away, arranging a book cart. The entrance attendant calls “Ji Zhou.” He turns toward the entrance, ending with his face visible so viewers recognize him. The camera holds a fixed medium shot from the entrance side, looking toward the cart rather than orbiting. Clothing and injury state do not change. Accepted appearance: narrow long face, a short notch at the left eyebrow tip, naturally curly black hair tied low, and slightly forward shoulders. The cart stays put; both hands leave its handle before the turn.

Production needs an actual start frame and usable identity reference. This page provides only a paper example, with no image files or generated result. Its text is not an already-bound production task.

Ambiguous draft:

> The person turns beautifully as the camera rotates. Keep a beautiful face, back to front, flowing clothes and increasingly dramatic atmosphere.

It mixes camera motion with the body’s turn and does not identify the person. Removing the turn would remove the required recognition. Return to the accepted action and camera.

heading.zh: 可读的核心提示词：谁转，怎样停下
heading.en: A complete core prompt: who turns and where it ends

body.zh:
先补真实参考与目标方言，再使用以下不绑定模型的核心说明：

> 从已确认的阅览室背面起始帧开始。纪舟正在书车旁，双手放在车把上；摄影机固定中景，入口方向来自本镜分镜。画外值班员叫“纪舟”。纪舟听见后先放开车把，身体转向入口，头部随身体转过来，最后面向入口停住，让正脸进入当前机位的可见范围。转身过程保持同一人物的头部轮廓、肩背关系与当前低束卷发；正脸出现后对应已接受身份参考的脸型和左眉尾短缺口。书车保持原位，当前服装不变。摄影机保持固定，转身完成后留出认人的停留；声音中的名字由值班员说，纪舟不跟着开口。

核心说明保留触发、手离把、身体与头部转向、终点正脸和识别时间。没有再加递书、奔跑、脱外套和绕拍。停留多长要按已定镜头时长与实际动作判断，不套所有转身都三秒。

若真实首帧不是双手扶车，就先修本例起点，不能命令人物保持图中不存在的手位。若当前机位看不到入口方向的正脸，需要回分镜调整机位或终点；运动提示词不能偷偷移动摄影机。

若仍失败，先检查漂移角度和实际参考，再决定补图、局部重生成或提出分镜修订。允许拆镜的项目可比较连续转身与在真实动作边界切镜的方案；需要连续揭示时仍保留完整转身，不把背影替换成无因果的正脸照。
body.en:
Prepare actual references and the target dialect before using this model-independent core:

> Begin from the accepted rear-view reading-room start frame. Ji Zhou is beside the cart with both hands on its handle. Hold the established medium shot; the storyboard defines the entrance direction. The offscreen attendant calls “Ji Zhou.” He releases the handle, turns his body toward the entrance and brings his head around with it. He stops facing the entrance with his face visible from the current camera. Retain the same head silhouette, shoulder relationship and current low-tied curls through the turn. When the face becomes visible, match the accepted facial structure and left eyebrow notch. Keep the cart in place and clothing unchanged. The camera remains fixed, with time after the turn for recognition. The attendant speaks the name; Ji Zhou does not mouth it.

This retains trigger, release, body/head movement, face visibility and recognition. It adds no handoff, running, wardrobe change or orbit. Duration follows the accepted shot and actual action, not a universal three-second turn.

If the actual start frame does not show both hands on the cart, correct the starting description. If this camera cannot see his face toward the entrance, revise the storyboard’s camera or endpoint rather than quietly moving the camera in the motion prompt.

If drift persists, inspect the angle and submitted references before preparing a view, regenerating locally or proposing a storyboard revision. Projects permitting cuts can compare a continuous turn with cuts at actual action boundaries. A required continuous reveal retains the full turn rather than replacing it with an unrelated frontal portrait.

heading.zh: 验收看实际候选片，不只看首尾截图
heading.en: Review the candidate through the turn

body.zh:
正常速度看完整动作，再定位背侧过渡与正脸出现的片段：

- 人物是否真放开车把、转向入口并停住，而不是头转了、身体仍反向。
- 正侧背特征能否对应同一人物；固定痣疤或眉缺口是否被删、移位或新增。
- 姿势与光线造成的正常变化，是否被误判为必须重新生成。
- 摄影机是否仍固定，书车与服装是否保留，名字有没有被纪舟自己念出来。
- 认人的终点有没有真正出现，后续镜能否从这个状态接上。

首尾都像同一个人，中间仍可能漂移；截图能找位置，不能证明运动自然。记录本次在哪个角度失败、改了哪些参考或动作说明，再比较新候选，不把“已写保持一致”作为通过依据。
body.en:
Watch the complete action at normal speed, then locate the side/back transition and return to a visible face:

- Are hands released, body turned toward the entrance and movement stopped, rather than head and body facing opposite ways?
- Do front, side and back cues belong to the same person? Are established marks retained rather than moved or invented?
- Are normal pose/light differences mistaken for identity failure?
- Do camera, cart and clothing remain consistent, and does the attendant speak the name?
- Is the recognition endpoint actually delivered, with a usable state for the next shot?

Matching endpoints can conceal drift between them. Stills locate issues without proving natural movement. Record the failed view and changed references or instructions before comparing the candidate. A consistency instruction is not a passing result.

q.zh: 只加一句“保持人物一致”够吗？
q.en: Is “keep the same character” enough?

a.zh: 它可以概括目标，不能补缺少的识别依据、真实参考或清楚动作。先查哪里开始不像、参考是否实际传入，再检查候选片。
a.en: It states a goal without supplying identity evidence, real references or clear action. Locate the first drift, check submitted inputs and inspect the candidate.

q.zh: 能把转身改成正脸静止镜头吗？
q.en: Can I replace the turn with a static frontal shot?

a.zh: 要看本镜要交付什么。若转身承担认人、发现或回应，替换会改剧情与镜头边界，应当作为分镜选择提出，不能在提示词返修里悄悄删掉。
a.en: Only if it preserves the accepted purpose. A turn delivering recognition, discovery or response cannot be silently removed during prompt revision; propose a storyboard choice.

text.zh: 用 $short-drama-video-prompts 检查这一镜转身后变脸的问题。附当前分镜、起止状态、已接受人物造型、真实参考和目标模型的参考方式。先定位身份还是角度/绑定/动作错误，再局部改提示词；保留转身终点、剧情信息和已定机位，不擅自删掉转身。缺必要参考先列缺口，不把图片提示词当真实图。
text.en: Use $short-drama-video-prompts to diagnose this face change. Supply storyboard boundaries, accepted identity/look, actual references and the target reference method. Distinguish identity, view, binding and action errors before a local prompt revision. Retain the turn, story information and camera; list missing references instead of treating image prompts as files.

label.zh: 正侧背识别与人物造型分工
label.en: Identity across views and look separation

label.zh: 视角变化不新建人物
label.en: View changes do not create new identities

label.zh: 动作条件、方向与完成状态
参考起点与前后状态比较

title.zh: 游戏读档后剧情错乱怎么办：保存状态与版本兼容
title.en: Game Story Changes After Loading a Save: How to Fix It

seo_title.zh: 游戏读档后剧情错乱怎么办：保存状态与版本兼容
seo_title.en: Game Story Changes After Loading a Save: How to Fix It

description.zh: 排查读档后丢失选择、重复奖励与角色乱知情。附保存、加载、继续游玩的完整纸面路径，分清存档快照、事件记录和旧版本兼容。
description.en: Diagnose lost choices, duplicate rewards and leaked knowledge after loading. Includes a complete save/load path and version-compatibility checks.

answer.zh: 先固定出错的存档和游戏版本，对比保存前与加载后的当前状态、已经发生的选择和角色知情，再继续走同一条动作路径。载入恢复状态，不能把渲染、提示或旧事件重新当玩家动作结算。规则和节点语义变了时，明确迁移或拒绝旧档，不静默把旧选择解释成另一条历史。
answer.en: Fix the failing save and game version, then compare current state, committed choices and character knowledge before saving and after loading. Continue the same action path. Loading restores state; rendering, prompts and old events must not settle again as new actions. When rule or node meaning changes, migrate explicitly or reject incompatible saves without rewriting history.

heading.zh: 先保住出错存档，复现哪一步变了
heading.en: Keep the failing save and locate the first difference

body.zh:
不要先用“重新开局就好了”结束排查。保留原存档副本，记下对应内容、规则与存档格式版本；记录玩家怎样走到保存点、存在哪里、加载后先看哪一处偏差。

| 现象 | 先对比什么 |
|---|---|
| 道具又回背包 | 保存前实际归属、加载后归属，以及载入是否再次发道具。 |
| NPC说出没见过的秘密 | 谁已看过证据、哪次事件让他知道，是否把玩家所知复制给所有人。 |
| 已领奖励再领一次 | 完成与领取状态，以及场景进入/渲染回调是否重复提交。 |
| 期限忽然归零或已结事项复活 | 保存的时间与到期状态，加载是否重新创建或提前触发事件。 |
| 老存档进入错路线 | 节点与变量含义是否在新版改变，而旧值仍按新语义读取。 |

这个问题发生在“保存后恢复并继续”。[失败与重开](/novel-to-game/game-failure-and-restart)主要决定重开回到哪里、保留什么；两者都要明确，但不是同一种操作。
body.en:
Do not finish diagnosis with “start again.” Retain a copy of the failing save and its content, rule and save-format versions. Record the path to saving, the save location and the first mismatch after load.

| Symptom | Compare first |
|---|---|
| Returned item reappears | Ownership before/after load and whether loading grants it again. |
| NPC quotes an unseen secret | Evidence access and the event informing them; check copying player knowledge to everyone. |
| Reward claimed twice | Completion/claim state and repeated settlement during scene entry or rendering. |
| Deadline resets or a settled matter returns | Saved time/status and recreated or prematurely triggered events. |
| Old save enters the wrong route | Changed node/variable meaning interpreted through new rules. |

This concerns restoring and continuing. [Failure and restart](/novel-to-game/game-failure-and-restart) decides the restart point and retained progress. Both need definition, but they are different operations.

heading.zh: 当前是什么，与发生过什么要相互对应
heading.en: Connect current state with committed history

body.zh:
game-build 把快照用于快速载入，事件记录用于定位与重演。当前状态告诉游戏“钥匙现在在谁那里”，历史告诉它“谁借过、何时归还、谁见过那次展示”。只存当前钥匙数量，无法还原人物记忆；只存一串事件，载入时又无条件重新发钥匙，也会改变结果。

按本项目实际需要保存会被后续读取的事实，例如位置、物件归属、已接受承诺、证据知情、任务完成、奖励领取与到期事项。不需要把每个无作用的闲聊词语都变成持久状态。

界面与对白读取恢复后的事实。生成模型可以根据已确认结果组织表达，不能把“他已经原谅你”的新句子直接写成信任状态。在线解析参与动作时，回放使用已保存的规范化候选，不重新问一次模型来决定旧动作究竟是什么。
body.en:
game-build uses snapshots for quick loading and events for diagnosis and replay. State answers who currently holds the key; history answers who borrowed it, returned it or witnessed evidence. A key count alone cannot recover memory; replaying events as unconditional new grants changes the result.

Persist facts actually read later: location, ownership, accepted promises, evidence access, completion, claimed rewards or pending consequences. Every inconsequential chat word need not become a state variable.

UI and dialogue read restored facts. Generated expression cannot turn a new “he forgives you” line into committed trust. When online parsing participates in actions, replay consumes recorded normalized candidates rather than asking the model to reinterpret an old move.

heading.zh: 原创完整路径：钥匙归还后再读档
heading.en: Original path: loading after the key is returned

body.zh:
原创旧馆调查例，以下是纸面验证设计，尚未实现或运行。馆员保管阅览柜钥匙；玩家可借钥匙看柜内修订目录，也可暂不查看。目录的内容只向实际打开阅读的人揭示。到期事项与随机性在此例都未采用，避免为模板凑字段。

| 步骤 | 应保存或读取的结果 |
|---|---|
| 新开局 | 钥匙在馆员手中；玩家未读目录；馆员知道钥匙可借，但不知道玩家之后会选哪条路。 |
| 借钥匙、开柜、读目录 | 馆员同意后钥匙归玩家；玩家实际开柜阅读，玩家知情更新，馆员没有在柜前看见内容。 |
| 归还钥匙 | 玩家把钥匙交回，馆员实际接收；钥匙归馆员，借阅与归还历史保留，玩家仍记得读过目录。 |
| 此时保存，再加载 | 仍是馆员持钥匙、玩家已读、馆员未见内容；加载本身不再次借出或归还。 |
| 继续询问馆员 | 他可以记得已归还，不能引用没看过的目录文字。玩家选择出示内容后，才更新馆员知情。 |

这条路径已经有当前物件、历史和两人知识的区别。如果加载后钥匙出现在玩家背包，问题不是换一句对白就能修好；如果钥匙正确但馆员忽然知道内容，要查知识恢复与分支历史。

再走相邻路线：借到钥匙但未读目录就归还，保存并加载。此时玩家和馆员都不能引用内容，钥匙同样在馆员手中。两条路线共享持物终态，却有不同阅读历史，能揭露“只按当前物件推剧情”的错误。

本例借阅没有额外金币奖励，不需要虚构一项领奖测试。项目确有奖励时，再检查读取已领取状态，重复进场、加载或按完成按钮不能再次发放。
body.en:
Original archive investigation, as a paper validation design rather than an implemented test. The keeper holds the reading-cabinet key. The player may borrow it and read a revised catalog or leave it unread. Contents are revealed only through actual inspection. This example has no timers or randomness.

| Step | Expected saved/read result |
|---|---|
| Fresh start | Keeper holds key; player has not read; keeper knows lending is possible without knowing the future route. |
| Borrow, open, read | Keeper agrees and transfers the key. Actual reading informs the player; keeper did not witness the contents. |
| Return | Player hands back the key and keeper receives it. Current ownership returns while borrowing/return history and player knowledge remain. |
| Save here, then load | Keeper still holds the key, player has read and keeper has not seen contents. Load does not lend or return again. |
| Continue questioning | Keeper may remember the return but cannot quote unseen contents. Choosing to show them later updates knowledge then. |

Current ownership, history and each person’s knowledge differ. A key reappearing in inventory needs a state fix, not new dialogue. Correct ownership alongside leaked contents points to knowledge restoration or branch history.

Compare a neighboring route: borrow, return without reading, save and load. Neither person can quote contents, and the keeper still holds the key. Shared ownership with different reading history exposes deriving story solely from current items.

This loan has no coin reward, so it needs no invented claim test. Where a project has rewards, inspect claimed state and prevent repeated scene entry, load or completion clicks from granting it again.

heading.zh: 更新后出错，别静默改写旧历史
heading.en: Do not silently reinterpret old saves after an update

body.zh:
只改一段文案，可能不影响存档；改节点编号、变量含义、行动效果或知识权限，则需要检查旧档怎样被新版读取。先声明本次改变了什么与影响哪条路径，再选择迁移或明确拒绝不兼容旧档。

例如旧版用一个“目录已查看”状态表示玩家读过，新版却把同一状态解释成馆员也读过。直接沿用旧值，会制造从未发生的展示。可把旧状态迁移为“玩家已读”；馆员是否见过要从已有可证明的历史恢复，缺少依据不能填成已见。

拒绝不兼容存档时，应保留旧档副本并说明支持的继续方式，不能先覆盖成新初态再弹一句提示。迁移方案也需要实际加载与后续操作验证；写了版本号不会自动修复语义。
body.en:
Copy edits may preserve save compatibility. Changed node identifiers, variable meaning, effects or knowledge permissions require checking how the new build reads old saves. Declare affected paths before choosing migration or explicit incompatibility.

Suppose “catalog inspected” formerly meant the player read it, but now also means the keeper did. Reusing that value invents a disclosure. Migrate the old fact to player knowledge; recover keeper access only from supported history, not a guessed value.

On incompatibility, retain the original save and explain supported continuation rather than overwriting it with a fresh state before a warning. Validate a migration through actual loading and subsequent input. A version number alone does not repair meaning.

heading.zh: 修后跑原路径，再跑能区别历史的相邻路径
heading.en: Replay the failure and a distinguishing neighboring route

body.zh:
固定实际内容、规则和存档版本，重放原来出错的保存、加载、继续操作；对比持物、知识、承诺和已经结算的结果。项目采用随机时也固定 seed，纯确定性项目不为表格新增随机系统。

再走共用前段但选择不同的路线，观察未选事件有没有混入、NPC是否只使用自己所知。修复应针对定位的状态或读取点，不把原设计的选择删掉来取得“正常显示”。

记录这次实际运行的版本、输入、预期与观察结果。截图可证明某个界面显示过，不能独自证明状态恢复和后续操作都正确。
body.en:
Fix the actual content, rule and save versions, replay the failing save/load/continue sequence and compare ownership, knowledge, commitments and settled results. Fix the seed where randomness exists; deterministic projects need no added random system.

Run a neighboring choice sharing the earlier path. Check unchosen events and each NPC’s knowledge. Repair the located state or reader rather than deleting the designed choice to obtain a normal display.

Record tested versions, input, expected and observed results. A screenshot establishes one visible screen, not correct restoration and subsequent operation.

q.zh: 读档是不是把此前事件全部再执行一遍？
q.en: Does loading execute every previous event again?

a.zh: 看实现的恢复方式，但不能把恢复变成重复玩家结算。快照与事件记录各有用途；重演应重建同一历史，不重新发奖励、改变归属或触发已结事项。
a.en: Restoration methods vary, but load must not duplicate settlement. Snapshots and events serve different roles; reconstruction retains history without repeated grants, ownership changes or settled consequences.

q.zh: 所有更新都要让旧存档失效吗？
q.en: Must every update invalidate old saves?

a.zh: 不用。按实际节点、规则和格式变化判断兼容性。可兼容的局部文字修改不必强迫重开；改变语义时再迁移或明确拒绝，并验证受影响路径。
a.en: No. Assess actual node, rule and format changes. Compatible copy edits need no forced restart; semantic changes need migration or explicit rejection and affected-path validation.

text.zh: 用 $game-build 局部修复这个读档问题。附已批准设计、当前运行版本、出错存档、保存前状态和加载后的实际偏差。定位持物、知识、承诺、期限或奖励的写入/读取点，声明兼容性与受影响路径；保留旧存档副本，修后重放失败路径及一条相邻未选路线，不改玩法和结局来绕过错误。
text.en: Use $game-build to repair this load bug locally. Provide approved design, runtime version, failing save, pre-save state and observed load differences. Locate ownership, knowledge, commitments, deadlines or reward readers/writers, declare compatibility and affected paths, and retain the old save copy. Replay the failing route plus a neighboring unchosen route without changing gameplay or endings to bypass the bug.

label.zh: 快照、事件、回放与存档兼容
版本与固定验证路径

title.zh: 视频转场怎么选：硬切、叠化与时空变化
title.en: How to Choose Video Transitions: Cuts, Dissolves and Scene Changes

seo_title.zh: 视频转场怎么选：硬切、叠化与时空变化
seo_title.en: How to Choose Video Transitions: Cuts and Dissolves

description.zh: 先判断观众需要接上动作、识别时空变化还是感受停顿，再选转场。附完整原创剪辑方案与真实工具边界。
description.en: Choose transitions by the action, scene change or pause viewers need to understand. Includes a complete original edit plan and actual tool limits.

answer.zh: 先说明相邻两镜是什么关系，再选择转场：同一动作要保住完成过程，换时空要让新地点与时间可理解，叠化或黑场按作品需要使用。先试清楚的剪点，不用效果遮住缺失动作；选定后回听声音并检查字幕。short-drama-edit 的内置渲染只做硬切，声音桥和画面转场需外部工具实际完成。
answer.en: First identify the relationship between adjacent shots. Preserve completion of continuous action, establish a new time or place, and use a dissolve or black interval when it serves the piece. Try a clear cut before covering missing action with an effect. Review sound and subtitles afterward. The pinned short-drama-edit renderer makes hard cuts; sound bridges and picture transitions require external editing.

heading.zh: 先问两镜之间发生了什么
heading.en: Start with the relationship between shots

body.zh:
转场是把观众从当前画面送到下一画面。下一镜可能接着同一个动作，也可能已经是第二天、另一个地点，或作者有意把两个画面放在一起比较。先用一句话写清这层关系，再看效果库。

| 两镜关系 | 先保住什么 |
|---|---|
| 同一时刻的连续行动 | 动作是否接得上、人物朝向与持物是否能理解；切后不要让同一交接再做一次。 |
| 时间或地点改变 | 新镜头是否提供足够的环境、光线或已定信息，让观众知道现在在哪里、何时。 |
| 有意比较或情绪停顿 | 两画面怎样互相解释，停顿是否承载作品需要的感受；不要求每次都有新剧情事实。 |
| 剧本明确指定效果 | 读清它要求的是时空变化，还是必须执行的画面、声音效果，再落实。 |

剧本写“转场到次日”不自动等于要加叠化。若剧本明确写“画面渐黑，留下雨声”，则不能用默认硬切冒充已完成这个效果。优先遵守已接受的表达。
body.en:
A transition takes viewers from the current picture to the next. The next shot may continue the same action, move to another day or place, or deliberately compare two images. Describe that relationship in one sentence before browsing effects.

| Relationship | What to preserve first |
|---|---|
| Continuous action | A readable action, orientation and object ownership; do not repeat a completed handoff after the cut. |
| A different time or place | Enough environment, light or accepted information to establish where and when the next shot happens. |
| Comparison or an emotional pause | How the pictures inform each other and what feeling the pause serves. Each transition need not reveal a new plot fact. |
| A specified effect | Determine whether the script requests a scene change or a particular picture or sound effect, then implement it. |

“Transition to the following day” does not automatically require a dissolve. An explicit instruction to fade the picture to black while rain continues cannot be fulfilled by a default hard cut. Follow the accepted expression.

heading.zh: 硬切、叠化和黑场各解决什么
heading.en: Choose a cut, dissolve or black interval for a reason

body.zh:
硬切直接换画面。动作衔接、注意转向听者、新地点已经清楚时，都可以从硬切试起；它并不天然粗糙。若切后突然看不懂谁拿着物件，先检查剪点和动作覆盖，而不是立刻加转场。

叠化让前后画面短暂重叠，可以参与时间流逝、回忆或柔和段落交接的表达。它也会让脸、手和可读文字重叠，因此要看真正承载信息的区域有没有被遮住。持续多久由实际画面与作品节奏决定，本文不给所有视频共用的秒数。

黑场可以形成停顿、段落边界或明确结束；也可能只是意外空帧。根据剧本与前后镜判断，不把所有黑色画面当故障，也不要求每次换场都先黑一下。

声音桥是另一项决定：上场声音延续到新画面，或下场声音先进入，都需要明确来源与时间关系。它不能使第二天的对白看似仍发生在昨晚，也不能截断原句。具体的一句对白中途切反应镜，见[连续对白切画面](/drama-skills/cut-away-during-continuous-dialogue)。
body.en:
A hard cut changes picture directly. It can work for connected action, attention moving to a listener, or an already-readable new location. If viewers cannot tell who now holds an object, check the cut and action coverage first.

A dissolve briefly overlaps the pictures. It can contribute to elapsed time, memory or a gentle passage between scenes. Faces, hands and text also overlap, so inspect whether essential information remains readable. Choose duration from actual pictures and pacing rather than a universal number of seconds.

A black interval may create a pause, a section boundary or an ending. It may also be an accidental gap. Judge it against the script and adjoining shots; neither reject every black frame nor insert one for every location change.

A sound bridge is a separate decision. Carrying earlier sound into a new picture, or introducing the next scene’s sound early, requires a clear source and time relationship. Do not make tomorrow’s dialogue seem to occur last night or truncate the original line. For cutting to a reaction during one complete line, see [continuous dialogue cuts](/drama-skills/cut-away-during-continuous-dialogue).

heading.zh: 原创完整方案：昨晚交苗，次日种下
heading.en: Original complete plan: an evening handoff and morning planting

body.zh:
下面是为比较剪法设计的虚构场景，没有实际视频或播放结论。已定故事是：傍晚温室里，叶澄把一盆幼苗交给杜宁，提醒“明早把它种在校门旁，那里有光”；杜宁接稳花盆，答“我来种”。第二天早上，杜宁在校门旁完成种植。作品选择朴素、连续的叙事，剧本没有指定叠化或新增旁白。

**为本例设想的镜头覆盖**：温室双人镜完整拍到叶澄持盆、杜宁双手接稳、叶澄松手及两句对白；另一镜从杜宁仍在温室里持盆开始，拍他转向出口。次日校门全景中可见早晨光线与门牌，杜宁已在花坛边，花盆放在身旁；随后他把幼苗从盆里取出放入备好的穴中、填土、浇水。种植镜完整承载这些动作。门牌是否可读，实际制作按已定画内文字方案处理。

**本版选定的剪法**：

1. 温室交接镜保留完整提醒、接稳后松手和“我来种”。在杜宁已经持稳花盆、回应已经完成处切出。
2. 硬切到温室出口镜；从杜宁已经持盆的状态接起，不再次演一遍接盆。保留转向出口与离开的必要过程，压缩不承担信息的等待。
3. 再硬切到次日校门全景。保留新环境和早晨光线可辨认的区间；不把温室里的“我来种”移到这里，冒充杜宁此刻的新对白。次日镜采用本场已有环境声。
4. 接种植动作，保留幼苗实际进入穴中、填土和浇水完成。离开时只说明这一株已经种下，不写成整座花坛都已完成。

这版用环境和实际动作建立时空变化，没有依赖特效。若作者希望更柔和地表现一夜过去，可以另比较出口镜到校门镜的叠化：交接仍先完成，门牌与种植也要在重叠结束后清楚可见。它是可选表达，不是修正交接缺帧的方法；效果需要外部剪辑实际完成。

若真实素材中杜宁从未接到花盆，不能照本方案声称交接成立。先恢复原片已有的接稳与松手，或回制作补这项必要动作，再决定转场。
body.en:
This fictional scene compares editorial choices. There are no actual clips or playback findings. The accepted story: in an evening greenhouse, Ye Cheng hands Du Ning a seedling pot and says, “Plant it beside the school gate tomorrow morning. It gets light there.” Du receives the pot securely and answers, “I’ll plant it.” The next morning he completes the planting. The piece uses plain, continuous storytelling; its script specifies neither a dissolve nor new narration.

**Imagined coverage:** A greenhouse two-shot includes Ye holding the pot, Du securing it with both hands, Ye releasing it and both complete lines. A second shot starts with Du still holding the pot in the greenhouse and follows his turn toward the exit. The next morning’s school-gate wide shot shows morning light and a gate sign; Du is beside the bed with the pot next to him. Planting coverage then shows him removing the seedling, placing it in a prepared hole, filling soil and finishing watering. Any readable gate lettering follows the project’s accepted text treatment.

**The selected edit:**

1. Keep the full instruction, secure grip before release, and “I’ll plant it.” Leave once Du holds the pot and his answer finishes.
2. Hard cut to the greenhouse exit shot with Du already holding the pot. Do not repeat the handoff. Keep the turn and necessary departure, shortening idle waiting.
3. Hard cut to the morning school-gate wide shot. Retain enough of the shot to recognize the environment and morning light. Do not move the greenhouse answer here as new present-tense dialogue. Use the morning scene’s existing ambience.
4. Continue through the seedling entering the hole, filling soil and completed watering. This ending establishes one planted seedling, not completion of the entire bed.

Environment and action establish the scene change. For a gentler overnight passage, the creator could compare a dissolve from departure to the gate: finish the handoff first and keep the sign and planting readable after the overlap. That is an expressive option requiring actual external editing, not a repair for missing handoff frames.

If real footage never shows Du receiving the pot, this plan cannot establish a completed handoff. Restore an existing secure grip and release or request that necessary coverage before choosing the transition.

heading.zh: 把转场决定写成实际可做的修改
heading.en: Record a transition that can actually be executed

body.zh:
记录前后来源、真实入出点、两镜关系、选定画面效果、声音处理和需要保留的动作。实际用了外部剪辑，再补工程、效果区间与参数；效果占用的画面、声音及字幕时间以最终时间线为准。改后不能照抄旧版累计时刻。

固定版本的 short-drama-edit 内置 render 先编码各段，再直接拼接，画面只做硬切。CUT 的“声音”行是说明，不会自动完成交叉淡入、静音或声音桥；也没有在这行写“叠化”就生成画面转场的能力。需要效果时在外部工具完成并记录，再验收实际交付文件。

若你只想讨论剪法，向 AI 提供相邻镜头的事实与剧本要求，明确这一轮只给方案。若调用技能处理媒体，素材须真实存在且可读。提示词写完和工程保存成功都不等于效果已经正确出现在成片。
body.en:
Record the preceding and following sources, actual in/out points, their relationship, chosen picture effect, sound treatment and actions to retain. After external editing, record the project, effect interval and parameters. Read picture, sound and subtitle times from the final timeline rather than carrying old cumulative positions forward.

The pinned short-drama-edit renderer encodes segments and concatenates them with hard cuts. A CUT’s sound line describes intent; it does not execute crossfades, muting or sound bridges. Writing “dissolve” there does not create a picture transition. Implement effects externally, document them and inspect the delivered file.

For discussion only, give the AI adjoining shot facts and script requirements and request a plan without running production. To process media through the skill, provide actual readable files. A written prompt or saved project does not establish a correctly rendered effect.

heading.zh: 看接点，也看前后整段
heading.en: Inspect the join and the full passage

body.zh:
先在接点前后逐帧看，找是否重复动作、人物突然换持物、文字被两画面重叠遮住或出现意外黑白帧。再正常速度播放前后整段，判断时空变化是否清楚、情绪停顿是否合适、对白和环境声是否突兀。

最后在实际成片上核字幕：台词仍完整，时间随新剪法更新，关键画面没有被字幕挡住。若问题是缺动作，回覆盖；若是换场不明，补回已有的环境或时间依据；若效果太抢眼，比较硬切或调整它的持续区间。以这次作品的观看需要作决定。
body.en:
Step through the join to find repeated actions, changed object ownership, essential text obscured by overlap or unintended black/white frames. Then play the surrounding passage at normal speed to judge time and place, the emotional pause and sound continuity.

Check subtitles on the actual output: complete speech, updated timing and unobstructed essential pictures. Missing action calls for coverage; an unclear scene change calls for available location or time evidence; an intrusive effect calls for comparison with a cut or adjusted duration. Decide from the needs of this piece.

q.zh: 每次换场都要加转场特效吗？
q.en: Does every scene change need an effect?

a.zh: 不必。新镜头已经让时空清楚时，硬切可以成立；剧本明确指定的效果仍要落实。
a.en: No. A cut can work when the new shot establishes time and place. Implement effects the script explicitly requires.

q.zh: 两段AI视频接不上，叠化能修好吗？
q.en: Can a dissolve fix two AI shots that do not connect?

a.zh: 只能改变接点表现，不能补出未发生的接物、转身或关键台词。先核对必要动作是否存在与完成，再决定效果。
a.en: It changes the presentation of a join, not the existence of a handoff, turn or essential line. Establish necessary action and completion before choosing the effect.

text.zh: 使用 $short-drama-edit 处理我提供的真实镜头、剧本和分镜，逐剪点说明连续动作与时空变化，保留完整台词和必要结果。先报告素材缺口；内置硬切能实现的方案与需要外部工程的效果分别写清。若本轮只审方案，明确不运行渲染。
text.en: Use $short-drama-edit with actual footage, script and storyboard. Explain continuous action and scene changes at each cut, preserving complete speech and necessary results. Identify coverage gaps and distinguish native hard cuts from effects requiring an external project. For planning only, explicitly request no rendering.

label.zh: 切点、转场与时空关系
声音桥与字幕的实际边界
实际成片接点与交付验收

title.zh: 视频导出后变模糊怎么办：先查原片、缩放和压制
title.en: How to Fix a Blurry Video Export

seo_title.zh: 视频导出后变模糊怎么办：先查原片、缩放和压制
seo_title.en: How to Fix a Blurry Video Export

description.zh: 逐级比较原片、剪后母版与导出文件，定位缩放或压制造成的损失。附原创排查方案及当前skill的真实输出设置。
description.en: Compare source, edited master and export to locate scaling or encoding loss. Includes an original diagnostic plan and real settings from the skill.

answer.zh: 先用同一播放器、相同显示大小比较原片、剪后母版和本地导出，找画质从哪一步开始变差；再检查真实输出尺寸、画面缩放和编码设置。恢复到合适的源文件与输出规格后重新出候选，不把低清成片放大当恢复细节。上传后才模糊，则单独检查平台处理与播放清晰度。
answer.en: Compare the source, edited master and local export in the same player at the same display size to locate the first loss. Check actual dimensions, scaling and encoding settings, then render a candidate from suitable source material. Enlarging a low-resolution export does not restore detail. If only uploaded playback looks blurry, check platform processing and playback quality separately.

heading.zh: 先找哪一步开始模糊
heading.en: Find the first stage that loses detail

body.zh:
不要只看编辑器里的预览，也不要只凭文件名写着1080p判断清晰。把同一时刻分别定位到原片、剪后画面母版和本地导出，用同一播放器、相同窗口大小与播放条件比较。先看细字、边缘和纹理，再正常速度看运动；截图只能看单帧，不能判断整段运动画质。

| 首次变差的位置 | 接下来查什么 |
|---|---|
| 原片已经不清楚 | 换可用的原始文件或补拍必要画面；提高导出尺寸无法补回原来没有记录的细节。 |
| 原片清楚，剪后母版变差 | 是否用了低清下载或预览副本，是否放大了局部，拼多来源时哪个画面被放大。 |
| 母版清楚，本地导出变差 | 实际输出宽高、缩放上限、编码设置以及是否重复压制已有成片。 |
| 本地导出清楚，上传播放才变差 | 平台处理是否结束、实际播放清晰度与观看条件；先别因此重做本地剪辑。 |

同一文件在不同播放器中差别明显时，把播放器和显示缩放也记录下来，不能直接把差异归到导出参数。
body.en:
Do not judge only an editor preview or a filename containing “1080p.” Locate the same moment in the source, edited picture master and local export. Compare in one player with the same window size and playback conditions. Inspect small text, edges and texture, then watch motion at normal speed. A still does not establish motion quality.

| First loss | What to check next |
|---|---|
| Source is already unclear | Find a usable original or obtain necessary coverage. Larger export dimensions cannot recover unrecorded detail. |
| Source is clear; edited master worsens | A low-resolution download or preview copy, enlarged crop, or upscaled source in a multi-video assembly. |
| Master is clear; local export worsens | Actual dimensions, scaling cap, encoding settings and repeated encoding of an earlier export. |
| Local export is clear; uploaded playback worsens | Processing status, selected playback quality and viewing conditions before remaking the local edit. |

If one file looks different between players, record player and display scaling too rather than immediately blaming export settings.

heading.zh: 输出尺寸与画面里的细节分开查
heading.en: Separate output dimensions from picture detail

body.zh:
画幅是宽高关系，分辨率是实际宽高像素，两者不是同一件事。横竖素材怎样并排进入一个画幅，见[横竖屏拼接](/video-recap/combine-landscape-and-portrait-videos)；本页检查的是已经选定的画面在制作途中哪里丢了细节。

大画布里放着一个小视频，再加留边，文件尺寸可以很大，主体占用的像素仍有限。裁出原片很小的区域放满画面，也会放大已有像素。检查实际可见区域，不能只记录容器宽高。

所引 video-cut 多来源路径把片段等比例放进统一画布并留边；画布选择考虑实际采用来源的方向、面积与时长。低清来源可能在较大画布里被放大。这个流程解决拼接规格，不保证每段达到同等细节，也不会自动做超分辨率修复。

源几何探测还考虑旋转和像素宽高比。对竖屏或带旋转信息的素材，按实际显示画面核对，不只抄存储宽高。
body.en:
Aspect ratio describes proportions; resolution describes actual pixel dimensions. For fitting landscape and portrait material, see [mixed orientations](/video-recap/combine-landscape-and-portrait-videos). This page traces detail loss after the picture has been chosen.

A small video surrounded by padding can live in a large frame while its subject still occupies few pixels. Enlarging a small crop likewise enlarges existing pixels. Inspect the visible region as well as frame dimensions.

The cited multi-source video-cut path fits segments proportionally into a shared canvas with padding. Canvas selection considers adopted sources’ orientation, area and duration. A low-resolution source can be enlarged within that canvas. This enables assembly; it neither promises equal detail nor performs automatic super-resolution.

Geometry probing also accounts for rotation and pixel aspect ratio. Check the displayed picture rather than copying stored dimensions alone.

heading.zh: 核对当前skill真正使用的设置
heading.en: Check the settings the current skill actually consumes

body.zh:
下面只说明所引固定版本的 video-assemble 合成路径，其他编辑器和包装路径须另查。它有三项输出设置：

- **OUTPUT_MAX_HEIGHT**：大于0时限制输出高度并保持宽高比；0表示本阶段不加这个缩放。实现只缩小，不把低清画面升成高清。
- **OUTPUT_CRF**：此路径的x264编码质量设置，默认18。调大通常减少体积并加重损失；调小不能恢复源画面已经丢掉的细节。不要把18称为所有素材都无损的保证。
- **OUTPUT_PRESET**：默认veryfast。它参与编码速度与压缩取舍，不能当成分辨率选项。

这些编码设置仅在本阶段重新编码视频时生效。烧录字幕、遮罩、视觉叠加、包装、缩放或强制重编码会进入编码路径；没有这些处理时，视频流走复制路径，改CRF不会凭空重新压制它。音频另按已有声音方案处理。

video-cut 产生剪后母版时已使用自己的编码设置；合成阶段再设置更低CRF不会恢复上一步的损失。可回到尚清楚的源文件重建受影响画面，避免反复把已压制成片当原片。若另走前景包装或剪映导出，也按那条路径的实际实现与输出复核，不把这里三个变量当通用开关。
body.en:
These settings describe only the pinned video-assemble composition path. Check other editors and packaging paths separately.

- **OUTPUT_MAX_HEIGHT:** A positive value caps output height while retaining proportions. Zero adds no downscale at this stage. The implementation shrinks; it does not upgrade low-resolution pictures.
- **OUTPUT_CRF:** This path’s x264 quality setting, default 18. A larger value generally reduces size with more loss. A lower value cannot restore detail already absent from the input. Eighteen is not a losslessness guarantee.
- **OUTPUT_PRESET:** Default veryfast. It participates in encoding speed and compression tradeoffs, not resolution selection.

Encoding settings apply when this stage re-encodes video. Burned subtitles, masking, visual overlays, packaging, scaling or forced re-encoding enter that path. Without these operations the video stream is copied, so changing CRF alone does not re-encode it. Sound follows the existing audio plan separately.

video-cut already applies its own encoding when building the edited master. A lower composition CRF cannot undo that loss. Rebuild affected pictures from a still-clear source instead of repeatedly treating an encoded export as the original. Foreground packaging and JianYing export require their own implementation and output checks; these three variables are not universal switches.

heading.zh: 原创排查方案：装订教程里的细线看不清
heading.en: Original diagnostic plan: a fine thread in a binding tutorial

body.zh:
这是虚构的纸面案例，没有真实文件、探测或观看结论。创作者把一段手工装订教程剪成短视频，关键内容是针从纸孔穿出，细线收紧，随后打结。假设原片和已剪画面母版都是1920×1080，源文件能看清孔位与线条；旧导出使用OUTPUT_MAX_HEIGHT=480，作者觉得针线细节不够清楚。字幕、剪点与声音已定。

**先证实假设**：实际打开三份对应文件，定位穿孔和收线时刻；探测它们的真实宽高；同条件播放比较。若母版已经丢了细节，就停止只改最终导出，回到造成损失的那一步。若旧导出实际没有缩到480高，也不能拿这项设置当已证实原因。

**若比较确认损失首次出现在该缩小导出**，本例作者选择保留1080高的本地候选：从清楚的画面母版重新出文件，在这条合成路径把OUTPUT_MAX_HEIGHT改为0，编码采用OUTPUT_CRF=18、OUTPUT_PRESET=veryfast。保持原字幕、画面次序与声音决定，使用单独候选工作目录和输出，留下原版作比较。关闭这个缩放只是不再缩小，不承诺候选立刻清楚；仍需实际检查。

**完整复查**：同条件比较原片、母版、旧导出和新候选的穿孔、收线、打结全过程。针应确实穿出，线应真正收紧，结应完成；不能为了看起来更清晰改成静态示意图或删掉步骤。核字幕没有因缩放改变而压住针线，声音仍完整且同步，再测候选宽高。

若候选细节可读，记录文件与实际观察后供作者采用；若仍不好，分别排查源细节、裁切放大和编码，不直接宣称参数已修复。若平台要求另交较小文件，单独制作并比较这一版的可读性，不把这里取消缩放当成所有交付规格。
body.en:
This is a fictional paper case with no files, probes or viewing findings. A creator edits a bookbinding tutorial. Essential coverage shows a needle emerging through a paper hole, thread tightening and a completed knot. Assume both source and edited picture master are 1920×1080 and their hole and thread details are readable. An old export used OUTPUT_MAX_HEIGHT=480, and the creator finds the needlework unclear. Subtitles, cuts and sound are approved.

**Verify the assumptions:** Open the corresponding files, locate piercing and tightening, probe actual dimensions and compare playback under the same conditions. If the master already loses detail, return to that stage. If the old export was not actually reduced to 480 pixels high, the setting is not an established cause.

**If comparison confirms the first loss at that downscale**, this creator chooses a local candidate retaining 1080-pixel height. Render from the clear picture master with OUTPUT_MAX_HEIGHT=0, OUTPUT_CRF=18 and OUTPUT_PRESET=veryfast in this composition path. Keep accepted subtitles, picture order and sound decisions; use a separate candidate workspace and output, retaining the old version. Removing the downscale does not establish readability; inspect the result.

**Complete review:** Compare source, master, old export and candidate through piercing, tightening and knot completion. The needle must emerge, thread tighten and knot finish. Do not substitute a still or delete a step to appear sharper. Ensure subtitles do not obstruct the needlework after sizing changes, sound remains complete and synchronized, and probe candidate dimensions.

If detail is readable, record the file and observations for the creator’s adoption. Otherwise investigate source detail, enlarged crops and encoding separately rather than claiming the settings fixed it. A platform’s smaller-file requirement calls for a separate delivery and readability comparison; removing the cap here is not a universal delivery specification.

heading.zh: 修画质时保住已经定下的内容
heading.en: Preserve accepted content while revising picture quality

body.zh:
向AI交代哪些是已定内容：台词、字幕文本、剪点、动作顺序、配乐与完整混音。要求先定位首次损失，说明拟改的输入和输出设置，再出画面候选；不要因为你说“高清一点”便重写旁白、换声线或重剪故事。

已有完整混音时，按[保留已定声音](/video-recap/keep-audio-when-changing-video)采用与新画面兼容的处理办法，不能从新默认流程悄悄生成另一版声音。交付时提供实际文件、探测值、查看过的关键段及尚未确认的问题。渲染成功只证明文件生成，不是观看已经满意。
body.en:
Tell the AI which content is accepted: speech, subtitle text, cuts, action order, music and complete mix. Request diagnosis of the first loss and proposed input/output changes before rendering a picture candidate. “Make it clearer” does not authorize rewriting narration, changing a voice or recutting the story.

For an existing complete mix, follow [keeping approved audio](/video-recap/keep-audio-when-changing-video) with a treatment compatible with the new picture rather than silently producing new sound. Deliver actual files, probe values, inspected passages and unresolved questions. Render success establishes file creation, not satisfactory viewing.

q.zh: 把720p导出成4K会恢复细节吗？
q.en: Does exporting 720p as 4K restore detail?

a.zh: 尺寸变大不等于原有细节回来。先检查可用原始文件与实际主体像素；本文所引路径不做超分辨率，不能把放大结果当真实恢复。
a.en: Larger dimensions do not restore missing detail. Check available originals and the pixels occupied by the subject. The cited path does not perform super-resolution.

q.zh: 本地清楚，上传YouTube后模糊怎么办？
q.en: What if only YouTube playback looks blurry?

a.zh: 先区分上传处理与本地导出。YouTube说明视频初期会先有低清版本，较高清晰度在处理完成后可用；检查处理状态与实际播放选项，再比较。参见[YouTube低清播放说明](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/71674?hl=zh-Hans)，不要给所有平台套固定等待分钟数。
a.en: Separate platform processing from the local export. YouTube says initial processing provides lower quality, with higher qualities available after processing. Check status and playback options before comparing. See [YouTube’s quality guidance](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/71674?hl=en); do not assign one fixed waiting time to every platform.

text.zh: 使用 /video-recap（Codex中用 $video-recap）核对我提供的原片、剪后母版、导出文件及输出设置，先给首次画质损失的证据与修改方案。本轮保留已定台词、字幕文本、镜序与混音；只讨论时不运行剪辑、配音或合成。批准制作候选后再按真实支持路径执行。
text.en: Use /video-recap ($video-recap in Codex) to review the supplied source, edited master, export and output settings. First identify evidence of the earliest detail loss and propose a revision. Preserve accepted speech, subtitle text, shot order and mix. For discussion only, run no editing, voice production or assembly. Execute a candidate through a supported path after its production is requested.

title.zh: 游戏按钮点了没反应怎么办：输入、条件与结果分别查
title.en: How to Fix a Game Button That Does Nothing

seo_title.zh: 游戏按钮点了没反应怎么办：输入、条件与结果分别查
