seo_title.en: How to Fix a Game Button That Does Nothing

description.zh: 按钮亮了不等于行动生效。分清输入未到达、规则拒绝和结果未显示，附完整原创定位路径与交给AI的修订说明。
description.en: A highlighted button does not prove an action happened. Separate missing input, rule rejection and hidden results with an original diagnostic path.

answer.zh: 先在实际候选中复现一次，分别确认真实输入有没有到达这项行动、当前条件是否允许提交，以及已提交结果有没有显示给玩家。按钮变色或截图存在都不能代替状态变化证据。合法输入没提交，交构建者修接入；规则有依据地拒绝，就说明当前原因；状态已改变但画面没更新，修对应表现，不重新结算一遍。
answer.en: Reproduce the issue in the actual candidate. Check whether real input reaches the action, current conditions allow submission, and committed results appear to the player. Highlighting and screenshots do not prove a state change. Repair missing input wiring, explain a justified refusal, or update presentation without applying the action again.

heading.zh: 先记一次完整的点击前后
heading.en: Record one complete attempt

body.zh:
记当前候选、实际运行环境和输入方式，再记录点击前的位置、持物、许可与任务状态。只选一项已经知道预期效果的动作，正常操作一次，看玩家画面与可观察状态怎样变化。

若按钮只闪一下，仍不能判断行动是否进入规则。若状态已经改变而没有提示，也不能判断为完全没执行。优先使用项目已有状态或事件记录；只有确实看不出结果时，再请构建者补最小观察手段，不要求每个游戏建立一套新调试系统。

桌面鼠标点通，不自动证明目标手机触摸也通。按产品简报里已批准的目标平台与输入测试；其他运行环境可以提供定位证据，但未覆盖的目标输入要明确留下。
body.en:
Record the candidate, actual runtime and input method, then the location, held items, permissions and task state before the attempt. Choose one action with an established expected effect, use its normal input once and observe picture and state changes.

A brief highlight does not establish that the rule received an action. A changed state without a message does not mean nothing executed. Use existing state or event observations first; request a minimal observation only when results cannot otherwise be determined.

A desktop mouse success does not establish phone touch input. Test the platform and input approved in the product brief. Other runtimes may help diagnosis while leaving target-specific coverage explicitly unresolved.

heading.zh: 分清哪一层没有发生
heading.en: Distinguish three different failures

body.zh:
| 观察到的事实 | 修改方向 |
|---|---|
| 点击后未形成目标行动，状态和事件均未变 | 请构建者核对这项控件实际连接的动作与目标输入；视觉按下效果不等于动作已接入。 |
| 行动到达，但条件检查拒绝，状态未变 | 对照已定许可、持物、位置或任务状态；条件确实不满足时展示当前原因，条件读取错时修规则读取。 |
| 规则已经提交结果，画面或文字仍旧 | 更新读取这项已提交结果的表现；不要为刷新画面再扣资源、再移动物件。 |

真正缺少观察时，结论是待定位，不是凭按钮颜色猜原因。若还在等待一个实际执行过程，按真实阶段显示进行中；不要一点击便提前写成功。

本页处理已显示动作在运行时没有按预期响应。玩家不知道下一步、合法推进路已消失，见[卡关排查](/novel-to-game/fix-a-story-game-that-cannot-progress)；是否应该显示灰色选项，见[锁定选项](/novel-to-game/design-locked-options-in-a-story-game)。
body.en:
| Observed fact | Repair direction |
|---|---|
| Input creates no intended action; state and events remain unchanged | Ask the builder to inspect the control’s actual action connection and target input. A pressed appearance does not establish wiring. |
| Action arrives but a condition rejects it; state remains unchanged | Compare approved permission, items, location and task state. Explain a valid refusal or repair an incorrect condition read. |
| Rules commit the result but picture or text stays old | Update presentation from the committed result without charging resources or moving objects again. |

With insufficient observation, keep the cause unresolved rather than guessing from color. If real execution is still underway, show its actual stage instead of announcing success on the initial click.

This page addresses an already-displayed action failing to respond correctly at runtime. For unclear next steps or missing legal routes, see [progression diagnosis](/novel-to-game/fix-a-story-game-that-cannot-progress). For displaying unavailable actions, see [locked choices](/novel-to-game/design-locked-options-in-a-story-game).

heading.zh: 原创完整路径：贴海报按钮只有按下效果
heading.en: Original complete path: a poster button only changes appearance

body.zh:
这是虚构定位案例，没有真实候选或测试结论。游戏让玩家布置社区演出大厅。初态：玩家在大厅，场地方已经允许在指定空墙贴这一张海报，玩家持有海报与一份胶带，海报尚未贴。已定“贴海报”行动检查位置、许可、持物与墙面空位；成功消耗这份胶带，把同一张海报从玩家手中移到墙上，标记本项布置完成。本例行动即时完成，不设等待动画或时间成本。

**假设问题定位**：玩家点击“贴海报”，按钮变色后恢复，墙面仍空，海报与胶带仍在手，本项未完成。继续查看这个候选实际接入情况，发现按钮只有视觉按下效果，未连接已实现的贴海报行动。这个发现是本纸面案例选定的故障，不是看到变色就能推断的通用原因。

**修订范围与完整复核方案**：

1. 保留大厅、许可、胶带成本和同一张海报。构建者把实际按钮输入连接到已有行动，点击时按当前状态检查，再由原规则提交；不另造一条“按钮专用”结算。
2. 从上述初态实际点击一次。成功时胶带从1变0，海报离手并出现在指定墙面，本项完成。玩家同时能读到“海报已贴好”，不是只有内部变量变化。
3. 在这份已完成状态再次点旧按钮，不能再消耗胶带、复制海报或重发完成事件；反馈说明这一张已经贴好。它不代表其他布置项目全部完成。
4. 回到同一初态，只把本次贴墙许可设为未取得，再执行同一输入。原规则应拒绝，胶带与海报保留、墙面仍空、本项未完成；显示“先向场地方申请”。这一条验证接入没有绕过原权限。
5. 按已定重开规则恢复本例初态：海报与一份胶带重新在手、墙面为空、许可有效、本项未完成。再走成功路径，确认重开恢复的也是当前设计，不沿用已完成画面。

实际修复后记录真实候选、输入和结果；纸面方案不能写成已测试通过。若定位发现规则已提交，只是墙图没更新，第1步应改为修表现读取，第2步仍核同一组结果，不能再次调用贴海报去“刷新”。
body.en:
This fictional case has no candidate or test findings. A game asks the player to prepare a community performance hall. Initially the player is there, the venue has approved one poster on a designated empty wall, the player holds that poster and one tape unit, and nothing is posted. The approved action checks location, permission, items and wall availability. Success consumes the tape, transfers the same poster to the wall and completes this task. Execution is immediate in this example, without a waiting animation or time cost.

**Assumed diagnosis:** Clicking “Put up poster” briefly changes the button appearance. Wall, items and task remain unchanged. Inspecting the fictional candidate’s integration reveals only a pressed visual treatment, with no connection to the implemented poster action. This is the case’s chosen fault, not a cause inferred merely from highlighting.

**Repair scope and complete review plan:**

1. Retain the hall, permission, tape cost and one poster. Connect actual control input to the existing action, checking current state before the original rules commit. Do not create a separate button-only settlement.
2. Use real input once from the initial state. Tape becomes zero, the poster leaves the player and appears on its wall, and this task completes. Show “Poster put up” as readable feedback.
3. Repeat the old input after completion. It must not consume more tape, duplicate the poster or repeat the completion event. Explain that this poster is already up without claiming all preparation tasks are done.
4. Restore the same initial state except remove posting permission. The same input must be refused: tape and poster remain, wall stays empty and task remains incomplete. Show “Ask the venue for permission first.” This checks that input integration did not bypass authority.
5. Restart under this example’s approved rule: restore the poster, one tape unit, empty wall, valid permission and incomplete task. Follow the success path again, with current state rather than the previous completion picture.

After repair, record real candidate, inputs and results; this plan does not establish a pass. If diagnosis instead finds a committed state with a stale wall image, repair presentation reading in step 1. Keep the same outcome checks without invoking the action again to refresh the picture.

heading.zh: 把“没反应”写成AI能定位的反馈
heading.en: Give the AI a reproducible report

body.zh:
不要只说“按钮坏了，全部重做”。给出当前候选、运行环境、复现初态、一次输入、预期变化和实际变化；能提供的现有状态或事件记录随报告附上。再注明已定故事与规则不能顺带修改。

本例可写：“大厅中的贴海报按钮有按下效果，但海报仍在手、胶带仍为1、墙仍空、布置未完成。请定位输入是否连接既有贴海报行动、条件是否误拒或已提交结果是否未显示。只修定位到的接入/读取节点，保许可和成本；修后重放此路径、缺许可反例及重开。当前只是问题描述，不能先填写PASS。”

这个描述允许真实定位结果改变修法，不指定引擎类名、监听函数或供应商API。需要改行动效果或许可规则时，先说明它是设计变更，再处理版本与存档兼容；不要把规则改宽当按钮修好了。
body.en:
Provide the candidate, runtime, reproducible initial state, one input, expected change and actual change, plus available observations. Specify which story and rule decisions must remain.

For this case: “The hall’s poster button presses visually, but the player retains the poster and one tape unit, the wall stays empty and the task remains incomplete. Locate missing action wiring, incorrect rejection or hidden committed results. Repair only the identified integration/read node, preserving permission and cost. Replay this path, the missing-permission counterexample and restart. This report is not evidence of a PASS.”

The report allows findings to determine the repair without prescribing engine classes, handler names or vendor APIs. Changing effects or permissions is a design change requiring version/save consideration, not proof that a button was repaired.

heading.zh: 修后证明真实输入改变了游戏
heading.en: Verify real input and its effect after repair

body.zh:
从干净启动，经真实输入到本例设计结果，再重开。用当前候选的实际运行路径看状态与玩家反馈是否一致，不以鼠标悬停、静态截图或按钮出现代替输入证据。

game-build 负责提供可运行候选和最小可观察状态；正式候选的 game-qa 按既有权威验证入口完成实际路径并记录结果。文本白盒里的行动能走通，只证明那层规则，不能宣称目标手机、触摸、引擎输入和整段游玩都已通过。

若还有缺口，写清输入方式、运行环境与未完成项。一次修订针对定位到的问题，避免同时重写故事、换美术和改全部按钮。
body.en:
Follow clean start, real input, the designed result and restart in the current candidate. Compare state with player feedback. Hovering, screenshots and a visible button do not substitute for input evidence.

game-build supplies the runnable candidate and minimal observations. For a production candidate, game-qa uses its existing authoritative verification entry and records the actual path. A working text whitebox proves its modeled rules rather than phone touch, engine input or the whole playing experience.

Record remaining input/runtime gaps. Keep the revision on the diagnosed fault rather than also rewriting story, replacing art and changing every control.

q.zh: 按钮变色了，为什么还不能算点击成功？
q.en: Why is highlighting insufficient evidence?

a.zh: 变色只显示一种视觉响应；还要看目标行动是否到达、是否合法提交及结果是否可读。三层可能分别出问题。
a.en: It demonstrates a visual response. Establish action arrival, a valid submission and a readable result; the three can fail separately.

q.zh: 把条件检查关掉，按钮能用就算修好了吗？
q.en: Is removing condition checks a valid repair?

a.zh: 不算原规则的修复。许可、持物或成本属于设计，合法输入应生效，非法输入应按原规则拒绝。若确实想改规则，作为设计变更明确决定。
a.en: It changes the design. Legal input should work while illegal input remains rejected under the approved rules. Decide any intended rule change explicitly.

text.zh: 在已安装 Novel to Game 的宿主中，请用 $game-build 定位当前候选中这个按钮的输入、条件读取与表现更新。提供复现初态和预期/实际结果，只修命中的节点，保已有规则与故事；准备原故障路径、相邻拒绝路径和重开观察。正式候选再由 $game-qa 使用既有验证入口记录真实结果，不预填通过。
text.en: In a host with Novel to Game installed, use $game-build to locate this candidate’s input, condition reading and presentation update. Supply a reproducible state and expected/actual results. Repair only the identified node while preserving rules and story. Prepare the original path, neighboring refusal and restart observations. For production, $game-qa records real results through the existing verification entry without a prefilled pass.

label.zh: 行动、前置条件与权威提交
真实输入与目标运行环境
故障重放与相邻反例
输入接收与实际结果的反馈

title.zh: 剪完视频后音画不同步怎么办：先找错位发生在哪一层
title.en: How to Fix Audio and Video Out of Sync After Editing

seo_title.zh: 剪完视频后音画不同步怎么办｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Fix Audio and Video Out of Sync After Editing

description.zh: 从原片、剪后画面、声音底轨与最终导出定位不同步，附完整原创错位记录与修订方案。明确流复制、时长相容和实际同步的区别。
description.en: Trace desynchronization through source footage, edited picture, sound beds and export. Includes a complete original repair plan and actual tool limits.

answer.zh: 先在实际原片和新成片里找同一次清楚的动作与声音，确定错位从哪版开始，再检查原片区间怎样映射到剪后时间。只错一段就修该段来源或放置；整段同幅度错位才考虑平移，越往后越偏则先查版本、变速和实际时钟。保留音轨的流复制不能自动对齐嘴型或动作，总时长相同也不够。修后正常速度重播关键点和整片。
answer.en: Find the same clear action and sound in the actual source and finished edit, identify the first failing version, then check the source-to-output mapping. Repair a local source range or placement locally; consider a shift only for a consistent offset, and inspect versions, retiming and actual clocks for growing drift. Packet copy does not align mouths or actions, and equal duration is insufficient. Replay checkpoints and the whole new render at normal speed.

heading.zh: 先定位：原片就错，还是剪完才错
heading.en: Find the first version that goes out of sync

body.zh:
选一个画面和声音确实属于同一事件的时刻，例如近处门合上与对应的合门声，或镜头里说话者清楚的起音。不要拿另加的配乐重拍、远处声音传播或有意先行的画外声当作必须重合的锚点。先确认这版作品希望它怎样对应。

按原片、锁定剪后画面所对应的声音、混音候选、实际导出依次比较。记录文件版本、事件、画面时刻、声音时刻和原片来源；没有播放观察的值写未知。预览异常时再比较同一导出在另一个播放器的表现，避免只凭编辑器卡顿改动已经正确的文件。

原片也错时，要先处理素材或录音的对应关系。原片正确、剪后才错时，优先看选段和声音放置。画面与声音已经正确、只有字幕提前或延后时，转到[字幕同步检查](/video-recap/subtitle-timing-evidence)；AI生成的嘴部表演本身错了，见[AI视频口型排查](/drama-skills/ai-video-lip-sync)。

这是已有内容的定位工作，不需要先重写解说文案或重录所有声音。
body.en:
Choose a moment where picture and sound really belong to the same event: a nearby door closing with its closing sound, or a clear utterance by the visible speaker. Added music accents, sound arriving from a distance and deliberate offscreen sound leads are not automatically coincidence anchors. Establish the edit’s intended relationship first.

Compare the source, the sound belonging to the locked edit, the mix candidate and the actual export. Record the file version, event, picture time, sound time and source location. Leave unobserved values unknown. If preview is suspect, compare the same export in another player before changing a file that may already be correct.

If the source is wrong too, address its footage or recording relationship first. If only the edit fails, inspect selected ranges and sound placement. For correct picture and sound with mistimed text, use [subtitle synchronization checks](/video-recap/subtitle-timing-evidence). For incorrect generated mouth performance, use [AI-video lip-sync diagnosis](/drama-skills/ai-video-lip-sync).

This is diagnosis of existing material. Rewriting the narration or recording every line again need not be the first step.

heading.zh: 比较几个位置，再决定修哪里
heading.en: Compare several positions before choosing a repair

body.zh:
| 观察到的形状 | 优先检查与修订范围 |
|---|---|
| 同一段的多个对应事件都晚相近幅度 | 核对是否整段放晚、误用了旧时间。证据相符且完整声音能保留时，再修这段位置；只看一个动作还不够。 |
| 开始接近，后面逐渐偏开 | 核对是否混用了不同版本、只有一层变速，或导入/渲染改变实际时钟。先找到差异，不靠一次平移修全片。 |
| 只在一处重剪之后突然错位 | 查该剪点前后的原片起止和剪后位置，以及是否还在用旧底轨。后面已有正确的段落不要一起移动。 |
| 某一路正确，另一路错 | 分别检查原对白、旁白、动作声和音乐的来源与放置；不能从一路错推出全部混音都晚。 |

这些是编辑诊断，不是自动识别结果。一次门声可能被遮盖或来自别处，不能只看波形峰值就认定它与画面动作同源。补看同一段的完整句子、下一动作和剪点后另一事件，直到修订范围有依据。
body.en:
| Pattern | Check and repair |
|---|---|
| Several matching events in one passage are late by a similar amount | Check late placement or old timings. Change that passage’s position only when the evidence agrees and the complete sound remains available. One action is insufficient. |
| The start is close, but the gap grows | Check mixed versions, retiming of only one layer, and changed import or render clocks. Locate the difference before applying a global shift. |
| Sync changes suddenly after one recut | Inspect source boundaries and output positions around that cut, including an old bed still being used. Leave later correct passages in place. |
| One sound layer fits and another does not | Check dialogue, narration, effects and music independently; one late layer does not prove the whole mix is late. |

These are editorial diagnoses, not automatic detection results. A door sound can be obscured or belong elsewhere; a waveform peak alone does not prove a shared source event. Check the complete line, the next action and another event after the cut until the repair scope has support.

heading.zh: 完整原创范例：画面选了新入点，原声还用了旧入点
heading.en: Complete example: new picture In point, old source-audio In point

body.zh:
下面是虚构木工作坊视频的纸面记录，没有真实音视频测试。示例选定25fps恒定帧率、零起点且符合来源工具要求的素材；实际项目必须先核真实媒体。原片中，门在4.0秒合上并有对应声响，人物在5.0—6.2秒说完“钥匙留在桌上”。

剪后画面共10秒：先取原片1—7秒，放到成片0—6秒；再接另一段已选的4秒画面。出问题的候选把第一段原声误取成原片0—6秒，仍放在成片0—6秒。第二段声音、独立连续音乐与已采用旁白的位置正确。

| 项目 | 本例记录与决定 |
|---|---|
| 第一段正确画面 | 原片1—7秒映射到成片0—6秒；门应在成片3.0秒合上，台词应在4.0—5.2秒发生。 |
| 候选第一段声音 | 误取原片0—6秒；门声在成片4.0秒，台词从5.0秒开始，原片6.0—6.2秒的句尾还被漏掉。 |
| 正确修订 | 回原片完整取1—7秒声音，放回成片0—6秒，既修事件位置，也补回句尾；不是把已裁短的候选声音前移就结束。 |
| 后续已定内容 | 第二段仍从成片6秒开始；保留它的正确声音、整条连续音乐和完整已采用旁白，不把这些一起前移1秒。 |
| 待实际验证 | 新候选中门动作与门声的对应，完整句尾，6秒剪点交接、第二段及全片；纸面运算不能预填试听通过。 |

在这个25fps例子里，正确源范围是半开帧区间25—175；原片第100帧的门动作映射到成片第75帧，即3.0秒。48kHz输出上，这个时刻是零起点的样本位置144000。数字用于解释本例；实际帧率或时钟不同就从实际映射求值，不能照抄。

Video Recap 的原声/音乐底轨方法允许按明确原片帧区间和输出位置重新准备声音。此例只更换第一段来源区间，完整底轨计划仍要包括第二段和全部明确空白；音乐已有正确连续轨时，按已选轨保留。重新准备受影响的底轨与新混音放置记录，再使用现有完整声音合成路径出新候选。原文、WAV和声线未改时，不为移动或修原声而重跑TTS。

总时长10秒在错误候选里也成立，第一段却既错位又丢句尾。恢复正确来源后，正常速度核对门、整句、剪点和第二段，最后完整播放10秒成片；这个检查计划尚未实际执行。
body.en:
This fictional woodworking video is a paper example, not a media test. Its sources are chosen as zero-origin 25fps CFR footage meeting the source tool’s requirements; verify actual media in a real project. A door closes with its sound at source time 4.0 seconds. From 5.0 to 6.2 seconds, the speaker completes “Leave the key on the table.”

The finished picture lasts ten seconds: source time 1–7 maps to output 0–6, followed by another selected four-second shot. The failing candidate mistakenly uses source audio 0–6 at output 0–6. The second passage’s sound, continuous separate music and adopted narration placements are correct.

| Item | Example record and decision |
|---|---|
| Correct first picture | Source 1–7 maps to output 0–6; the door closes at output 3.0, and the line belongs at 4.0–5.2. |
| Candidate first audio | Source 0–6 was used; the door sound falls at output 4.0 and speech begins at 5.0. The source line’s final 0.2 seconds is also missing. |
| Repair | Recover the complete source audio 1–7 and place it at output 0–6. This repairs event position and the lost ending. Moving the already shortened candidate alone is insufficient. |
| Adopted later material | Keep the second passage at output 6, with its correct sound, the continuous music and complete adopted narration. Do not shift these one second too. |
| Actual review still needed | Door correspondence, complete speech ending, the six-second cut, the second passage and the whole render; paper arithmetic is not listening approval. |

At 25fps, the correct half-open source frame range is 25–175. Source frame 100, the door event, maps to output frame 75, or 3.0 seconds. On a 48kHz output clock, that is sample 144000. These values explain this example. Derive positions from the actual map for different rates or clocks.

Video Recap’s source/score producer prepares sound from explicitly selected source-frame ranges and output placements. Here only the first source range changes, but the complete bed plan must still contain the second passage and every explicit silent interval. Retain the chosen continuous music stem when it remains correct. Rebuild the affected bed and new mix-placement record, then use the existing full-sound assembly path for a new candidate. Unchanged text, WAVs and voice selection need no new TTS merely to move sound or repair a source range.

The bad candidate also lasts ten seconds, yet its first passage is mistimed and missing a word ending. After restoring the right source, review the door, whole sentence, cut and second passage at normal speed, then play the complete ten-second file. This review plan has not been executed.

heading.zh: 选对工具：保留音轨不等于自动同步
heading.en: Choose the path: preserving audio does not automatically synchronize it

body.zh:
| 方法 | 能做什么与边界 |
|---|---|
| 画面与已定混音配对 | `pair_media.py`复制两路已选压缩流，核实际首尾与包时钟；不做偏移、变速、裁切或听感对齐。适合内部事件仍对应的新画面。 |
| 按原片区间重建声音底轨 | `source_score.py`消费明确的源帧范围与输出位置，准备原声和连续音乐；不自己猜对白、不自动修漂移，也不输出最终视频。 |
| 已采用旁白与底轨合成 | 完整声音采用路径消费明确的放置与增益，保完整声音。新`output_start_sample`才决定这个路径的旁白位置，旧生成窗口不自动成为新剪后位置。 |

当前源底轨实现核恒定帧率和实际包时钟，不接受把可变帧率、变速或任意秒数偏移字段塞进去冒充支持。输入不适合时先回上游准备合适素材或在编辑器中完成明确修订，再核实际对应；不要随便补一个未支持的参数。

[Adobe的同步说明](https://helpx.adobe.com/premiere/desktop/add-audio-effects/basic-audio-editing/synchronize-clips-in-the-timeline-panel.html)把同步点分为入点、出点、共同时间码、标记等。使用编辑器同步功能也先确定哪一个点属于同一事件，再看整段，不把开始对齐当作所有后续都正确。

[YouTube上传排障](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/58134?hl=en)也单列音画不同步并提醒检查两轨时长。本地编辑仍要逐事件核对；时长一致是需要看的条件，不能替代内容对应。
body.en:
| Path | Capability and boundary |
|---|---|
| Pair picture with adopted mix | `pair_media.py` copies selected compressed streams and checks endpoints and packet clocks. It does not shift, retime, trim or perceptually align them. Internal events must still correspond. |
| Rebuild a source/score bed | `source_score.py` consumes explicit source-frame ranges and output placements, preparing source sound and continuous music. It does not infer dialogue, automatically repair drift or publish a final video. |
| Assemble adopted narration and bed | The full-sound path consumes chosen placements and gains while retaining complete sound. New `output_start_sample` values govern narration placement on this path; old generation windows are not automatically the new edit’s positions. |

The current source-bed implementation checks CFR and actual packet clocks. It does not accept VFR, retiming or invented seconds-offset fields as supported operations. Prepare suitable inputs upstream or make an explicit editor revision, then check real correspondence rather than invent an unsupported option.

[Adobe’s synchronization guide](https://helpx.adobe.com/premiere/desktop/add-audio-effects/basic-audio-editing/synchronize-clips-in-the-timeline-panel.html) offers points such as In, Out, common timecode and markers. Identify which point represents the same event, then review the passage; a correct start does not prove all later events match.

[YouTube upload troubleshooting](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/58134?hl=en) separately addresses out-of-sync audio and video and advises checking track durations. In a local edit, also check individual events: equal duration does not establish content correspondence.

heading.zh: 修后检查新导出，不拿旧试听代替
heading.en: Review the new export

body.zh:
回到这次实际导出，先播改动前、改动处和改动后的清楚事件，再连播整段与整片。除了动作与声音，还要听完整句尾、剪点处是否重说或漏说、音乐是否仍按已定方式接续，检查字幕绑定的是当前声音版本。

文件或流验证只说明检查到的机械关系。流复制证明保住了选定音轨；底轨回执说明用了哪些源区间；放置记录说明声音放在哪里。哪一次动作听起来同步，仍需播放这版成片。未检查的位置继续标待检查。

如果只是正常的声音先行、延后或跨镜头对白，保留已接受的叙事安排。需要让所有声音贴切点整齐排列，并不是音画同步的目标。
body.en:
Play the actual new export at clear events before, within and after the change, then replay the passage and whole piece. Listen for complete line endings, repeated or missing speech at cuts and the adopted music continuity. Check that subtitles bind to the current sound version.

File and stream validation prove their tested mechanical relationships. Packet copy identifies retained audio; a bed receipt identifies source ranges; placement records identify positions. Perceived correspondence still requires playback of this render. Keep unreviewed positions pending.

Retain intentional sound leads, trails and dialogue crossing a picture cut. Synchronization does not require every sound to end neatly at a picture edit.

q.zh: 声音整体往前挪一点就能修好吗？
q.en: Can I fix sync by moving all audio earlier?

a.zh: 只有已核对事件支持同幅度偏移、完整声音仍在且移动不损坏其他正确段落时，才按该范围修位置。持续漂移、错源片段或被裁掉句尾需要另外处理；本例回源重取声音才同时修好了位置和完整性。
a.en: Only when checked events support a consistent offset, complete sound is available and the move preserves other correct passages. Drift, wrong source ranges and lost endings need different repairs. This example recovers the source to repair position and completeness together.

q.zh: 字幕对上了，音画就一定同步吗？
q.en: Do aligned subtitles prove audio-video sync?

a.zh: 不一定。字幕可以跟着一条已经放错的声音显示。分别核字幕与声音、声音与对应动作的关系，再在新成片里播放；不要靠移动字幕掩盖声音层错位。
a.en: No. Captions can follow an incorrectly placed sound perfectly. Check caption-to-speech and sound-to-action correspondence separately in the new render; moving text does not repair misplaced audio.

text.zh: 在已安装 Video Recap 的宿主中，用 $video-recap 只分析这版成片的音画错位。我提供原片/剪后画面/混音/导出版本、真实源到输出映射及已播放的对应事件记录。定位第一个出现问题的阶段和最小有依据的修订范围，未知时间保持未知；保已定文字、完整WAV、声线和未受影响的声音，列回源范围及新放置需核的项目。本轮不重录、不渲染，不宣称已听审。
text.en: In a host with Video Recap installed, use $video-recap only to diagnose this edit’s sound-picture mismatch. Use the supplied source, picture, mix and export versions, actual source-to-output map and observed event records. Find the first failing stage and smallest supported repair scope; leave unknown times unknown. Keep selected text, complete WAVs, voice and unaffected sound. List source ranges and new placements to verify. Do not rerecord, render or claim listening approval in this request.

label.zh: 原片帧范围与输出声音底轨
label.en: Source frame ranges and output sound beds

label.zh: 完整采用声音与明确放置
label.en: Complete adopted sound and explicit placements

label.zh: 重剪后采用声音的阶段衔接
流复制与感知同步的区别

title.zh: 视频导出后字幕不见了怎么办：区分画面、字幕文件与播放层
title.en: Why Subtitles Disappear After Video Export and How to Fix It

seo_title.zh: 视频导出后字幕不见了怎么办｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Fix Subtitles Missing After Video Export

description.zh: 先打开实际交付文件，区分画面硬字幕、独立SRT与可切换轨，再查烧录开关、完整字幕清单及媒体绑定。附两句字幕的完整返修方案。
description.en: Check the actual delivery, caption layer, burn-in setting and complete cue list. Includes a two-line repair plan that preserves adopted sound.

answer.zh: 先确认打开的是本次实际交付，再判断字幕是画面像素、独立文件还是播放器可切换的轨。只导出SRT不会让文字自动出现在MP4画面上；要随视频一直显示，就选烧录并检查新导出。只缺几句时再查完整清单、时间与当前绑定，保留原文字和声音。
answer.en: Open the actual delivery and distinguish burned pixels, a separate file and a selectable track. An SRT alone does not place text in MP4 pixels. For always-visible captions, burn them and review the new export. For missing lines, check the full cue list, timing and current binding.

heading.zh: 先检查发出去的文件，再辨认字幕层
heading.en: Check the delivered file and caption layer

body.zh:
编辑器预览有字，不证明导出的那份也有。记录当前路径和缺字时刻，确认没有误发无包装母版、旧预览或只有画面的候选。

| 字幕在哪一层 | 要核对什么 |
|---|---|
| 已烧进画面 | 实际帧上有字，关闭播放器字幕仍可见；改字需重新处理画面。 |
| 独立SRT等文件 | 是否一同交付，播放器或平台是否加载当前文件。 |
| 容器内可切换轨 | 导出格式是否支持，目标播放器能否选择并显示。 |
| 仅编辑器预览 | 本层是否启用并参与本次导出。 |

[Adobe导出说明](https://helpx.adobe.com/uk/premiere/desktop/render-and-export/export-files/overview-of-export-settings.html)将独立文件、烧录与嵌入轨分开，格式支持也有边界。具体编辑器按自己的选项核对。这里的Video Recap路径提供SRT与ASS烧录，不自动导出任意可切换格式。

同时辨认原片已有的硬字幕，避免把它当成本次生成的字。本地有字、上传后才没有时，另查实际上传文件、平台字幕加载与播放选择，不因此重录正确旁白。
body.en:
A captioned editor preview does not establish captions in the exported delivery. Record the current path and missing time. Check that an unbranded master, old preview or picture-only candidate was not sent.

| Layer | Check |
|---|---|
| Burned picture | Text on actual frames remains with player captions off. Changes require picture processing. |
| Separate SRT or similar file | Deliver it too and check loading of the current file. |
| Selectable container track | Check export-format support and target-player selection. |
| Editor preview | Confirm this enabled layer participates in export. |

[Adobe’s export reference](https://helpx.adobe.com/uk/premiere/desktop/render-and-export/export-files/overview-of-export-settings.html) distinguishes sidecars, burn-in and embedded tracks, with format limits. Check your editor’s options. The Video Recap path here supplies SRT and ASS burn-in, not every selectable format.

Distinguish source-burned captions from new text. If local playback shows captions but uploaded playback does not, check the actual upload, platform loading and playback selection before rerecording correct speech.

heading.zh: 检查skill实际用了哪条字幕路径
heading.en: Inspect the caption path actually used

body.zh:
所引`video-assemble`始终生成SRT；烧录开启时另生成ASS并绘制到画面。`--no-burn-subtitles`关闭新烧录，仍可能留下SRT。有字幕文件只是相应产物存在，是否实际可见还要看本次导出与运行错误。

在`adopted-packet-copy`模式中，当前`subtitle_track.json`完整替换全部生成字幕。空`cues`会有意移除所有新生成字幕；只写补充的一句也不会保留其余旧清单。源画面硬字仍是像素。

显式轨按输出时间填写，绑定当前画面和实际采用音轨。配对后的音频序号是0；当前CLI轨省略`edit_plan`。包数、采样率和时钟用当前媒体事实，不能让声明自行证明正确。过期或无可见帧的轨会报错，先处理失败。

合法清单也可能漏掉一句。对照定稿和实际播放查覆盖；字已存在但太小或遮挡，转去[字幕排版](/video-recap/subtitle-layout-and-line-breaks)，字跟不上声音则看[SRT时序](/video-recap/subtitle-timing-evidence)。
body.en:
The pinned `video-assemble` always generates SRT. With burn-in on it also generates ASS and draws it on the picture. `--no-burn-subtitles` disables new burn-in while SRT may remain. Check the actual export and errors rather than file existence alone.

In `adopted-packet-copy`, a present `subtitle_track.json` replaces all generated captions. Empty `cues` deliberately removes them. One supplemental cue does not preserve the old list. Source-burned pixels remain.

Author the track on the output clock, binding current picture and adopted audio. Paired output uses audio ordinal 0; current CLI tracks omit `edit_plan`. Obtain packet count, sample rate and clock from current media. Stale tracks and cues with no visible frame fail.

A valid list can still omit a line. Compare approved wording and playback for coverage. For existing but small or obstructed text, see [layout](/video-recap/subtitle-layout-and-line-breaks); for text missing speech timing, see [SRT diagnosis](/video-recap/subtitle-timing-evidence).

heading.zh: 完整返修例：有SRT，发出的视频却没字
heading.en: Complete repair: an SRT exists but the sent picture has no text

body.zh:
下面是原创八秒收纳示范的纸面方案，没有真实渲染结果。画面先合上盒盖，再把蓝标签贴到右上角；两句已采用声音为1—3秒、5—7秒。作者要求接收人只拿视频也能看字幕。

假定核查确认：旧候选误用了`--no-burn-subtitles`，创作者播放器加载了独立SRT，发送的MP4没有新烧录文字。声音和完整清单正确，返修只改字幕交付。

| 输出时间 | 全部需显示的文字 |
|---|---|
| 1—3秒 | 先把盒盖合上。 |
| 5—7秒 | 蓝色标签贴在右上角。 |

完整修订单：

> 沿用八秒画面与已采用完整声音，保留两句字幕和各自时段。本版选择烧录新字幕，关闭此前误选的不烧录设置。用当前文件核对绑定，保留全部提示；在合盖和贴标签画面测可读位置，避开手与标签，再出独立候选。关闭播放器字幕后看新文件，两句仍须可见。连播八秒，核声音、动作次序和文字出入沿用定稿。

实际项目先测真实时段。走显式轨时，核当前零起点媒体、选定AAC音轨和完整时钟，再填绑定；两句都进当前整轨，不提交一句补丁。烧录处理画面，`adopted-packet-copy`仅冻结选定AAC声音，仍须检查新导出的音轨和听感。

如果作者要求可关闭字幕，就保留该交付选择，附字幕文件和目标加载说明，不擅自改成永久烧录。
body.en:
This original eight-second storage demonstration is a paper plan, with no rendered result. Close the box, then place a blue label at its upper-right corner. The adopted lines occupy 1–3 and 5–7 seconds. The recipient must see text from the video alone.

Assume checking establishes that the old candidate mistakenly used `--no-burn-subtitles`. The creator’s player loaded an SRT, but the sent MP4 had no new burned text. Sound and the complete cue list are correct; change caption delivery only.

| Output time | Complete wording |
|---|---|
| 1–3 seconds | Close the box first. |
| 5–7 seconds | Put the blue label at the upper-right corner. |

Complete repair request:

> Retain the eight-second picture and adopted complete sound, both captions and their intervals. Choose burn-in and disable the mistakenly selected no-burn setting. Check bindings against the current file and carry every cue. Measure readable placement on the closing and labeling frames, clear of the hands and label, then render a separate candidate. With player captions off, both lines must remain visible. Play eight seconds and compare sound, action order and caption boundaries with the approved version.

Measure actual timings in a real project. For the explicit track, verify current zero-origin media, selected AAC and the complete clock before filling bindings. Include both cues in the replacement. Burn-in processes picture; `adopted-packet-copy` freezes only selected AAC. Check new audio and listening too.

For a switchable-caption requirement, preserve that choice and provide the sidecar with loading instructions. Do not replace it with permanent burn-in without an author decision.

heading.zh: 生成、烧录与交付分别检查
heading.en: Review generation, burn-in and delivery

body.zh:
先核完整清单，再看本地新导出的实际帧，最后在接收人要使用的环境打开同一交付。看两句首尾、长字幕、亮暗背景与换镜，确认文件版本、重复加载和动作遮挡。

一帧只证明这一刻有字；导出结束也不证明接收人开的是它。记录实际看过的文件和时刻，再检查剩余区间。
body.en:
Check the full list, the new export’s frames and the same delivery in the recipient’s intended environment. Review cue starts/ends, long text, light/dark backgrounds and cuts, including version, double loading and covered action.

One frame establishes text at that moment; an export-complete message does not establish which file the recipient opened. Record reviewed files and times and check the rest.

q.zh: 有SRT就说明字幕在视频里吗？
q.en: Does an SRT mean captions are in the video?

a.zh: 不说明。独立文字与时码需要播放器或平台加载；成为画面则要实际烧录。按交付要求选择，再检查最终文件。
a.en: No. Separate text and timing need loading; text in the picture needs actual burn-in. Choose for the delivery and inspect the final file.

q.zh: 只少一句，显式轨只写这一句行吗？
q.en: Can an explicit track contain only the missing line?

a.zh: 当前合同完整替换所有生成字幕，须带上每句仍需显示的内容。一条合法提示不会自动恢复其余字幕，原画面硬字是另一层。
a.en: The current contract replaces all generated captions. Carry every line that should remain. One valid cue does not restore the others; source-burned text is another layer.

text.zh: 请 video-recap 只排查这个已说明的问题。附当前文件、具体时间、已选交付方式和实际观察，先定位首次出错的一层，再提出局部修订单。保留未受影响的画面、文字与声音；需要的探测、渲染和播放分别列清，没有实际执行的项目留待检查。
text.en: Ask video-recap to diagnose this specified problem with current files, times, delivery choice and observations. Locate the first failing stage and propose a local repair, preserving unaffected picture, text and sound. Distinguish probing, rendering and playback; leave unperformed checks pending.

label.zh: 字幕输出与烧录开关
完整清单与当前媒体绑定
字幕包装与交付检查
实际SRT与ASS烧录路径

title.zh: 视频人声爆音怎么办：先查原录音，再查混音和导出
title.en: How to Fix Distorted Video Audio: Source, Mix and Export

seo_title.zh: 视频人声爆音和失真怎么修｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Fix Distorted Video Audio: Clipping and Mix Headroom

description.zh: 对比原录音、单段配音、混音和当前成片，定位首次失真。附浮点叠轨与固定总增益演算，分清恢复输入、降低增益和最终测听。
description.en: Locate distortion in the source, mix or delivery. Includes float-mix and master-gain calculations, followed by encoded-output measurement and listening.

answer.zh: 先单听原录音和配音，再听叠轨与导出，定位失真首次出现的一层。干净声音叠加后过载，就回未受损输入调整轨道或总增益；原录音已失真，降低播放音量只让它更小声。保留版本，查实际限幅路径，再测听本次编码输出。
answer.en: Compare isolated source/voice, mix and export to locate the first distortion. For overload introduced by combining clean inputs, return to them and revise track or master gain. Lowering an already distorted source only makes it quieter. Retain versions, check actual limiting and measure/listen to the new encoded output.

heading.zh: 找到首次失真的那一层
heading.en: Locate the first distorted stage

body.zh:
“爆音”可能指人声刺裂、一声啪、齿音或设备大音量失真。先记时间和听到什么，不把所有杂声都归为叠轨过载。

| 同条件对照 | 先检查 |
|---|---|
| 原录音或独立配音已失真 | 回原始候选、录制或该段生成；降低成片音量不恢复已损坏细节。 |
| 单听干净，叠起来异常 | 是否重复输入、轨道/总增益、峰值余量和后续处理。 |
| 中间混音正常，成片异常 | 实际混音输入、编码后测量、播放器与设备。 |
| 只在某设备大声播放时出现 | 同一文件换设备与较低播放音量对照。 |

[Adobe电平监看](https://helpx.adobe.com/ca/premiere/desktop/add-audio-effects/adjust-volume-and-levels/monitor-volume-levels.html)建议播放时查看Audio Meters并调整过高或过低电平；[对白修复](https://helpx.adobe.com/uk/premiere/desktop/add-audio-effects/adjust-volume-and-levels/repair-dialogue.html)将噪声、低频、嗡声、齿音和混响分开处理。本页重点是叠轨和余量。

[配音音量不均](/video-recap/fix-uneven-ai-voiceover-volume)和[音乐遮盖人声](/video-recap/background-music-overpowers-voice)不必然已经失真，按实际问题选修法。
body.en:
Distortion may mean cracked speech, a click, sibilance or a device failing at high playback volume. Record time and sound before diagnosing every noise as mix overload.

| Comparison | First check |
|---|---|
| Source or isolated voice already distorted | Original candidate, recording or segment generation. Lowering final volume does not restore damaged detail. |
| Clean separately, abnormal together | Duplicate inputs, track/master gain, headroom and later processing. |
| Mix clean, export abnormal | Actual mix input, encoded measurements, player and device. |
| One device at high volume only | Same-file comparison on another device and at lower volume. |

[Adobe’s meter guide](https://helpx.adobe.com/ca/premiere/desktop/add-audio-effects/adjust-volume-and-levels/monitor-volume-levels.html) recommends watching playback levels and adjusting excessive or low levels. Its [repair guide](https://helpx.adobe.com/uk/premiere/desktop/add-audio-effects/adjust-volume-and-levels/repair-dialogue.html) separates noise, rumble, hum, sibilance and reverb. This page focuses on track addition and headroom.

[Uneven voice segments](/video-recap/fix-uneven-ai-voiceover-volume) and [music masking speech](/video-recap/background-music-overpowers-voice) do not alone establish distortion. Match the repair to the observed problem.

heading.zh: 这条混音路径是否真的限幅
heading.en: Does this mix path actually limit peaks?

body.zh:
普通`narration`和`source-mix`按配置做最终响度/限幅，检查本次设置与输出。已采用AAC复制不做这些处理，原音轨失真也会保留。

显式完整声音路径把准备底轨与配音声轨相加得到浮点premaster，再乘固定`master_gain_db`后编码，跳过旧ducking、loudnorm与limiter。改旧环境变量不会给它补一个限幅器。

`source_score.py`浮点底轨保留超出`[-1,1]`的数值并记样本峰值。超过常见满幅参照不等于浮点文件已削顶；继续查总增益、编码与播放余量。有限值、文件生成和复制通过，分别有自己的检查范围。
body.en:
Ordinary `narration` and `source-mix` apply configured final loudness/limiting; inspect current settings and output. Adopted AAC copy performs neither and retains any existing distortion.

The explicit full-sound path adds the prepared bed and voice bus into a float premaster, applies fixed `master_gain_db` and encodes. It bypasses old ducking, loudnorm and limiting. Ambient settings do not add a limiter to it.

Float beds from `source_score.py` preserve values outside `[-1,1]` and record sample peaks. Exceeding that common reference does not establish a clipped float file. Check master gain and encoding/playback headroom. Finite samples, file generation and packet-copy checks have their own scopes.

heading.zh: 完整演算：两路相加，给候选留余量
heading.en: Worked example: leave headroom when tracks combine

body.zh:
这是八秒手作解说的纸面演算，没有真实音频。画面、旁白“边缘已经剪齐，下一步涂胶”、音乐和放置已选定。假定实际对照确认独立声音干净，异常首次出现在混合后。

左声道某一同时刻，准备底轨贡献0.55，配音声轨0.75。配音已做本路径的声道转换与逐段增益，不能把输入mono数值直接当左声道贡献。相加为1.30，固定总增益0 dB仍是1.30。

本候选选择总幅度乘0.5，等价`master_gain_db`约−6.0206 dB。该样本两路变为0.275和0.375，合为0.65，比例与时段不变。这只演算一个样本；其他时刻、右声道与编码后真峰还要测。

完整返修单：

> 回到未受损的已采用底轨和完整配音，保留画面、台词、音色、放置与两路比例。本候选采用约−6.0206 dB固定总增益，写入新的完整混音采用记录，在新目录输出。比较原问题处、前后与完整八秒；测当前编码文件的响度和真峰，再听语音可辨性、音色与字幕时段。

新采用记录选择总增益，显式路径仍消费完整底轨和配音。降低旧AAC不会恢复此前已削顶的细节；不要随后未经检查又自动推回旧电平。若异常来自原录音或尖锐齿音，这个叠轨假设不成立，回该层处理。
body.en:
This paper calculation concerns an eight-second craft recap, with no actual audio. Picture, narration (“The edge is trimmed; apply the glue next”), music and placement are selected. Assume actual comparison establishes clean isolated inputs and the first abnormality after mixing.

At one simultaneous left-channel sample, prepared bed contributes 0.55 and voice bus 0.75. Voice already includes channel conversion and segment gain; a mono input value is not automatically its left-channel contribution. Addition gives 1.30, unchanged by a 0 dB master.

The candidate adopts a 0.5 master multiplier, approximately −6.0206 dB in `master_gain_db`. Contributions become 0.275 and 0.375, totaling 0.65, retaining balance and timing. This covers one sample; measure other times, the right channel and encoded true peak.

Complete repair request:

> Return to the undamaged adopted bed and complete voice. Keep picture, wording, voice, placement and relative balance. Adopt approximately −6.0206 dB as fixed master gain in a new complete mix adoption and render into a new directory. Compare the problem spot, neighbors and eight seconds. Measure encoded loudness and true peak, then listen for intelligibility, voice quality and approved caption timing.

The new adoption chooses master gain while the explicit path consumes complete inputs. Turning down old AAC does not recover earlier clipped detail. Do not automatically boost back without checking. If the defect originates in the source or sibilance, repair that stage instead.

heading.zh: 保住完整声音，测听新编码输出
heading.en: Keep complete sound and review the new encoded output

body.zh:
原录音或独立TTS已经刺裂，先找未受损原声、重录或仅重生成该段。需要去噪、修复或瞬态处理时，用实际支持它的工具，保留候选作比较；底轨生成器不自动补回波形。

作品有意选择的失真效果、动作声和喊叫可保留，核必要话语仍可懂。重复输入先移除错误那一路。重做声音后检查新时长、接点与字幕，不为峰值好看裁尾字。

测编码后当前文件的实际LUFS与真峰，再听问题处、响亮字词、配乐进入和全片。分段RMS、浮点样本峰值和编码真峰不是同一量。短剧声音方法指出，两遍loudnorm未必命中目标，按项目交付要求检查实际结果。

在接收人常用条件下比较候选，记录修了哪一层、实际测听和仍待查区间，供作者采用。
body.en:
For damaged recording or isolated TTS, find an undamaged source, rerecord or regenerate only that segment. Use a tool supporting repair, denoising or transient processing where needed and retain candidates. The bed producer does not recover waveform detail automatically.

Preserve intended distortion, action sounds and shouting while checking necessary intelligibility. Remove an unintended duplicate input. For replaced sound, check duration, joins and captions; keep complete endings.

Measure actual LUFS and true peak of the current encoded file, then listen at defects, strong words, music entries and in full. Segment RMS, float sample peak and encoded true peak differ. The drama sound method notes that two-pass loudnorm may miss its target; judge actual results against project delivery requirements.

Compare under recipient playback conditions and report repaired stage, measurements/listening and remaining checks for author adoption.

q.zh: 调小播放器音量就修好了吗？
q.en: Does lowering player volume fix distortion?

a.zh: 可能缓解播放设备过载，但文件已损坏的细节不会恢复。先对比同一文件和独立原声，区分文件与播放问题。
a.en: It may reduce device overload but does not restore damaged file detail. Compare the same file and isolated source to distinguish the stages.

q.zh: 浮点峰值超过1就证明声音坏了吗？
q.en: Does a float peak above 1 prove damaged sound?

a.zh: 不证明。所引浮点路径保留超出常见满幅参照的值。继续核总增益、后续编码、实际真峰和听感，不直接判成最终削顶。
a.en: No. The cited float path preserves values beyond the common reference. Check master gain, encoding, actual true peak and listening before diagnosing final clipping.

text.zh: 请 video-recap 只排查这个已说明的问题。附当前文件、具体时间、已选交付方式和实际观察，先定位首次出错的一层，再提出局部修订单。保留未受影响的画面、文字与声音；需要的探测、渲染和播放分别列清，没有实际执行的项目留待检查。
text.en: Ask video-recap to diagnose this specified problem with current files, times, delivery choice and observations. Locate the first failing stage and propose a local repair, preserving unaffected picture, text and sound. Distinguish probing, rendering and playback; leave unperformed checks pending.

label.zh: 浮点底轨与样本峰值
叠轨与固定总增益
处理与复制边界
真实叠轨和总幅度运算
编码后响度与真峰

title.zh: 小说人物起名怎么起：符合设定，也让读者分得清
title.en: How to Choose Character Names That Fit Your Novel

seo_title.zh: 小说人物起名怎么起：设定、区分与称呼｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: How to Choose Character Names for a Novel

description.zh: 从时代、地域和人物关系出发选名字，检查相似姓名与别称，附三人同场的完整改名示例和AI起名简报。
description.en: Choose names from setting and relationships, test confusing names and aliases, and use a complete three-person revision plus an AI naming brief.

answer.zh: 先定人物所处时代、地域、文化和常用称呼，再给重要角色几个候选。把候选放进同一段对白，检查是否容易分清；别称先建立与本名的对应。名字有寓意可以，但不必替性格下结论。选定后核正文、设定和后续提纲，保留角色原有事实。
answer.en: Start with period, place, culture and forms of address. Test a few candidates in a shared scene for clarity, establish aliases and check the selected names across manuscript, notes and future outline. Meaning is optional; naming alone need not announce personality.

heading.zh: 先给名字一个所在的世界
heading.en: Begin with the world the name belongs to

body.zh:
Oh Story的人物卡将姓名放在身份、目标和关系旁，起名要求贴合时代、地域与文化。先写一份短简报：故事发生在哪里、人物属于哪一代、家人和同事怎样称呼他、是否已有本名或别称。

真实历史或文化背景需要核相应资料，不让生成器编出“古人都这样取名”或未经核验的词源。[Reedsy的作者教程](https://reedsy.com/blog/how-to-come-up-with-a-character-name/)也讨论名字与故事背景、称呼和朗读测试的关系。这里用它提示常见检查，具体人物仍按自己的设定选择。

同人或既有世界观先保留原作已采用的本名、译名；新人物沿相应地域的命名方式。跨文化角色可以有不同名字风格，只要各自来处成立。人物有迁居、改名或笔名时，先确定缘由和谁知道，不为统一风格抹掉这项经历。
body.en:
Oh Story’s character cards put names beside identity, goals and relationships, with naming matched to period, place and culture. Write a short brief covering the setting, generation, how relatives and coworkers address the person, and any established name or alias.

For real historical or cultural settings, verify relevant material rather than accepting an invented naming convention or etymology. [Reedsy’s author guide](https://reedsy.com/blog/how-to-come-up-with-a-character-name/) discusses setting, forms of address and read-aloud testing. Use these as checks; choose for your own story.

In fanfiction or an established world, retain adopted original names and translations; name new people for their region. Different cultural backgrounds can produce different naming styles when their origins make sense. Establish a migration, renaming or pen-name history and who knows it instead of erasing it for uniformity.

heading.zh: 把候选放进多人场景再选
heading.en: Test candidates in a shared scene

body.zh:
名字单看好听，放在一页里却可能难认。把本章同场的名字、常用称呼列在一起，再写几句实际对白。

| 检查 | 怎样试 |
|---|---|
| 外形与读音相近 | 连读本场姓名，看看是否需要回头确认是谁。只改真正造成混淆的候选。 |
| 称呼对应 | 首次出现别称时建立与已认识人物的关系；不要忽然把同一人叫成三个陌生名字。 |
| 人物关系 | 同姓可以表示家族，也可能只是同姓；正文按已定关系交代。 |
| 文字负担 | 试读生僻字、长名和缩写，按读者与文风判断是否需要辅助。 |
| 寓意与揭示 | 名字可以寄托愿望或反讽，不让解释提前泄露本章尚未知的身份。 |

不要求整本书每人不同姓、不同首字。家庭成员的相似名字、身份谜题里的别名也可以保留；在实际混淆处补关系或归属。名字只能辅助认人，角色的目标、行动和声音仍要有区别。
body.en:
A name can look appealing alone and become confusing on a crowded page. List the people in the current scene with their usual forms of address, then try actual dialogue.

| Check | Test |
|---|---|
| Similar appearance or sound | Read the scene’s names aloud. Revise candidates that cause genuine confusion. |
| Aliases | Connect a new form of address to the known person instead of introducing three apparently new people. |
| Relationships | A shared surname may reflect family or coincidence; explain according to established facts. |
| Reading load | Test unusual spelling, long names and abbreviations against audience and narrative voice. |
| Meaning and disclosure | A name may carry a hope or irony without exposing an identity still unknown here. |

Different surnames or initials for every character are optional. Related names and mystery aliases can remain; clarify actual confusion through relationships or attribution. Names help recognition, while goals, actions and voices distinguish people.

heading.zh: 完整例子：只换容易混淆的名字，保留同一场戏
heading.en: Complete example: rename confusing characters and keep the scene

body.zh:
原创设定为当代虚构城市的小改衣店。学徒林宁改裙子，同事林凝取衣袋，顾客林琳要求保留裙长。三人无亲属关系；本稿没有把相似名字设计成线索。作者发现顺读时常要倒回确认，选择保留主角林宁，将同事改为宋禾、顾客改为赵芬。名字是本例创作选择，不声称代表某年代的统计习惯。

**改前：**

> 林宁把蓝裙铺在柜台上。“裙长也要收吗？”
>
> “不改裙长，只改腰。”林琳说。
>
> 林凝拿来衣袋。“这只够大吗？”
>
> 林琳看了一眼。“够了。别把两处都改了。”

**改后：**

> 林宁把蓝裙铺在柜台上。“裙长也要收吗？”
>
> “不改裙长，只改腰。”赵芬说。
>
> 宋禾拿来衣袋。“这只够大吗？”
>
> 赵芬看了一眼。“够了。别把两处都改了。”

学徒问、顾客限定改动、同事拿袋、顾客回应的次序没变，衣服也没有因此已经改好。这里先完成姓名取舍；若再润色，另定范围。后文让熟客被叫作“赵姐”时，可以先由林宁招呼“赵姐，还是只改腰，对吧”，借当前交流把称呼接上。叙述继续用赵芬，不为避重反复换叫法。
body.en:
This original scene takes place in a small alterations shop in an invented contemporary Chinese city. Apprentice Lin Ning handles a skirt, coworker Lin Ning brings a garment bag, and customer Lin Lin requests its original length. The Chinese draft uses 林宁, 林凝 and 林琳. They are unrelated and the similarity is no clue. After finding the scene hard to follow, the author keeps 林宁 and renames the coworker 宋禾 (Song He) and customer 赵芬 (Zhao Fen). These are creative choices, not a claim about demographic naming patterns.

**Before:**

> Lin Ning spread the blue skirt on the counter. “Shorten it too?”
>
> “Keep the length. Just take in the waist,” Lin Lin said.
>
> Lin Ning brought a garment bag. “Is this big enough?”
>
> Lin Lin looked at it. “Yes. Don’t alter both.”

**After:**

> Lin Ning spread the blue skirt on the counter. “Shorten it too?”
>
> “Keep the length. Just take in the waist,” Zhao Fen said.
>
> Song He brought a garment bag. “Is this big enough?”
>
> Zhao Fen looked at it. “Yes. Don’t alter both.”

The question, customer’s limit, coworker’s bag and reply retain their order. The skirt has not been altered yet. This pass chooses names; define a separate scope for prose polishing. If Lin later uses “Zhao-jie,” connect it in a greeting to the established customer. Keep a stable narrative name rather than changing labels merely to avoid repetition.

heading.zh: 给AI的起名简报与改名检查
heading.en: Give AI a naming brief and check the replacement

body.zh:
可以给story-long-write一段明确要求：

> 只讨论这三人的名字。背景为当代虚构城市改衣店，三人无亲属关系；保留主角林宁，同事负责衣袋，顾客只要求改腰、不改裙长。请给同事和顾客少量候选，说明是否与已用名字容易混淆，试写同一段对白供我选。保留动作、人物关系、台词事实与本场停点，不新增身份秘密或词源。

候选和本页对照是作者工作用的简表，不是skill原生角色文件。选定后，核设定、已写正文、摘要、后续提纲和别称对应，逐处确认是不是同一人。不要把同字片段全局替换进另一个人、店名或引用里；已建立的家族称呼和刻意隐瞒仍按情节保留。

若正文已经清楚，临时名字也能先支持写作。关键是采用后保持一致；名字不合适可以修订，不必在第一章前选到无法再改。
body.en:
Give story-long-write a bounded request:

> Discuss only these three names in a contemporary alterations shop in an invented city. The people are unrelated. Keep Lin Ning; the coworker brings a bag and the customer wants waist alteration without shortening. Offer a few candidates for the other two, explain possible confusion with existing names and try the same dialogue for my choice. Preserve actions, relationships, dialogue facts and stopping point. Add no secret identity or invented etymology.

Candidates and comparisons are author working notes, not the skill’s native character file. Once selected, check character notes, manuscript, summaries, future outline and aliases, confirming each occurrence belongs to this person. A broad text replacement can also change another person, a shop name or a quotation. Preserve established family address and deliberate concealment according to plot.

A temporary name can support drafting when the scene is clear. Keep the adopted choice consistent and revise when useful; you need not find an irrevocable name before chapter one.

q.zh: 名字必须有深刻寓意吗？
q.en: Must every name have a deep meaning?

a.zh: 不用。先满足设定和辨识需要。寓意、家人愿望和反讽可以有，但是否解释看本场作用，不让名字替代人物行动。
a.en: No. Fit and recognition come first. Meaning, family hopes or irony are optional; explain them when they serve the scene rather than replacing behavior.

q.zh: 每个人的姓和首字都要不同吗？
q.en: Does everyone need a different surname or initial?

a.zh: 不必。相似名字可以服务亲属、文化或线索，实际读不清时才调整或补归属；别为区分名字改掉已定关系。
a.en: No. Similarities can serve family, culture or clues. Revise or clarify genuine confusion without changing established relationships.

text.zh: 请story-long-write只讨论指定角色的名字，附背景、已有本名别称与同场人物。生成少量候选并放进短对白，待作者选择；不改人物事实或继续写章节。
text.en: Ask story-long-write to discuss only the named characters, with setting, established aliases and current cast. Try a few candidates in short dialogue for author choice, preserving facts without continuing chapters.

label.zh: 姓名与时代、地域、文化
姓名、主语与指代
表达选择与事实保留

title.zh: 视觉小说怎么做对白历史：找回已读台词，接着当前选择
title.en: How to Design Dialogue History in a Visual Novel

seo_title.zh: 视觉小说对白历史怎么做：回看与返回选择｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Design Dialogue History in a Visual Novel

description.zh: 设计玩家主动打开的对白回看，保留说话者和已走分支，明确是否允许回滚，附完整维修场景与AI设计简报。
description.en: Design an on-demand dialogue backlog with speakers, the actual route and an explicit rollback policy, using a complete repair-shop example and AI brief.

answer.zh: 先确定玩家只回看已读台词，还是能回到过去重选。只读历史按当前路径收录已经显示的对白，保留说话者和顺序；打开、滚动、关闭都不重新结算选择。返回时接着原来的当前句或选项。未选分支、尚未揭示的秘密与后台状态不混进历史。
answer.en: First decide whether players can only reread or also return to an earlier choice. A read-only backlog retains displayed lines, speakers and order from the current route. Opening, scrolling and closing it must not settle choices again. Resume at the current line or choice without exposing unseen branches, secrets or internal state.

heading.zh: 先说清“回看”和“重选”各做什么
heading.en: Declare what rereading and reselection do

body.zh:
玩家误点跳过一句、忘了谁提出要求，常需要看前面的对白。历史页先解决这件事；想改变已做选择，则涉及另一套回滚规则。

game-build 的可执行模型合同把自由重选、固定历史只回看和不可逆节点作为需要明确的设计决定。本例选择**只读历史**。如果你的游戏允许回滚，入口要说明会回到哪一处、哪些已提交结果会撤销；不要让点击旧台词悄悄改掉当前进度。

[Ren’Py 的对白历史文档](https://www.renpy.org/doc/html/history.html)说明已显示的台词可以储存后再显示；历史条目中的回滚标识可用于另一项回滚动作。这里借它说明两种操作可以分开，不宣称本页方案已在 Ren’Py 或 skill 中自动实现。

“对白历史”也不同于全剧情图鉴。通关解锁的其他路线可以另设档案；当前游玩时回看，先尊重此路径已经公开的信息。
body.en:
Players may skip a line accidentally or forget who made a request. A backlog helps recover that dialogue. Changing an earlier choice requires a separate rollback policy.

game-build’s playable-model contract requires an explicit decision about free reselection, fixed history for rereading, or irreversible nodes. This example chooses **read-only history**. If your game permits rollback, explain the destination and which committed results will be undone; clicking an old line must not silently alter progress.

[Ren’Py’s dialogue-history documentation](https://www.renpy.org/doc/html/history.html) describes storing displayed lines for redisplay and a history identifier usable by a separate rollback action. These operations can be distinct; this page does not claim automatic implementation in Ren’Py or the skill.

A backlog also differs from a complete story gallery. Other routes may unlock in a separate archive after play. During the current run, history should respect information already revealed on that route.

heading.zh: 保留原台词、说话者与这次实际走过的路
heading.en: Keep the lines, speakers and route actually played

body.zh:
先决定收录对白、旁白以及玩家已提交的发言哪些内容，采用后保持一致。本例收录三者；未选选项不作为“玩家说过的话”。台词内容按当时显示的版本保存，后来的线索不能偷偷重写早先一句。

| 需要回看的内容 | 显示办法 |
|---|---|
| 谁提出什么要求 | 保留原说话者及台词，不把两人的话合成一句摘要。 |
| 玩家实际选了什么 | 收录已提交发言或行动说明，按发生顺序排列。 |
| 当时身份还未揭晓 | 沿用当时的可见称呼，不提前换成真实姓名。 |
| 行动是否已经完成 | 显示当时实际反馈；提出维修不等于物件已经修好。 |

game-world-design 的叙事方法区分世界事实、人物相信和玩家知道。后台可能已有凶手身份、未来回应或其他分支对白，历史不能因此把它们显示出来。

game-art-direction 把完整历史放在玩家主动打开的页面。主界面仍保留当前选择必需的依据；不能把费用、危险或对方的关键要求藏进历史，让玩家靠翻旧页才能理解眼前按钮。
body.en:
Decide which dialogue, narration and committed player statements to retain, then apply that policy consistently. This example retains all three. Unchosen options are not things the player said. Preserve what was displayed at the time; a later clue must not rewrite an earlier line silently.

| What players need | Presentation |
|---|---|
| Who requested what | Keep the original speaker and line instead of merging two speakers into a summary. |
| What the player chose | Record committed speech or action descriptions in their actual order. |
| An unrevealed identity | Retain the name visible then, without substituting a future real name. |
| Whether an action finished | Keep the actual feedback; requesting repair does not make the object repaired. |

game-world-design distinguishes world facts, character beliefs and player knowledge. Hidden culprit identities, future responses and other-route dialogue must not appear just because the backend contains them.

game-art-direction places complete history on an on-demand page. Keep evidence needed for the current choice nearby: fees, danger or a crucial request should not require searching old pages before understanding a button.

heading.zh: 完整纸面路径：回看维修要求，再决定是否付费
heading.en: Complete paper path: reread the repair request before paying

body.zh:
原创文字游戏中，林禾带台灯到维修铺，有3枚代币。台灯仍在柜台，没有维修或扣费；旧开关要保留。作者选择以下对白和规则，作为实现前的纸面示范。

> 林禾：“灯线坏了。只换线，旧开关留着。”
>
> 技师：“我先检查，不拆开关。”
>
> 玩家选择“请他检查灯线”。检查完成，技师指着破损处。
>
> 技师：“确实要换线，2枚代币。开关没坏，照你的要求留着。”
>
> 当前界面提供“确认换线，支付2枚代币”和“暂不修，取回台灯”。

玩家忘了开关约定，主动打开“对白历史”。页内按上面的顺序显示林禾、技师、已选择的检查行动与实际反馈。未选“自己拿灯离开”的另一条路线没有发生，不出现在历史；确认换线后的未来回应也不出现。

玩家滚回第一句，读到“旧开关留着”，再关闭历史。仍回到原来的两个选择；台灯留在柜台、代币仍为3、维修尚未开始。滚动和关闭没有把“请他检查”再执行一次。

玩家这次确认换线，规则提交一次2枚代币的费用，余额1。稍后，技师递回修好的灯，旧开关仍在；游戏显示对应结果。再次打开历史，才看到刚发生的确认与交付。再回看检查台词不会重复扣费或让台灯倒退到未修状态。

这条路径恢复了一个具体约定，又接回当前行动。纸面推演用于写清预期，不证明已有可运行界面；实际项目需验证入口、滚动、返回与费用记录。
body.en:
In an original text game, Lin He brings a lamp to a repair shop with three tokens. The lamp remains on the counter, unrepaired and unpaid for; its old switch must stay. The author selects these lines and rules as a paper example before implementation.

> LIN: “The cable broke. Replace only that. Keep the old switch.”
>
> TECHNICIAN: “I’ll check first, without removing the switch.”
>
> The player chooses “Ask him to inspect the cable.” After inspection, he points to the damage.
>
> TECHNICIAN: “It needs a new cable: two tokens. The switch works; I’ll keep it as you asked.”
>
> Current choices: “Confirm cable replacement; pay two tokens” and “Decline repair and take the lamp.”

Having forgotten the agreement, the player opens Dialogue History. It shows Lin, the technician, the selected inspection and its actual feedback in that order. An unchosen leave-with-the-lamp route never occurred and is absent, as is the future response to authorizing repair.

The player scrolls to “Keep the old switch,” then closes history. The same two choices remain. The lamp is still on the counter, the balance is three and repair has not begun. Scrolling and closing did not repeat inspection.

Now the player confirms replacement. The rules charge two tokens once, leaving one. Later, the technician returns the repaired lamp with its old switch and the game shows this result. Only then does history include confirmation and delivery. Rereading inspection neither charges again nor restores the unrepaired lamp.

This path recovers a concrete agreement and resumes the current action. Paper reasoning defines expectations, not proof of a running interface. The project still needs to verify opening, scrolling, returning and fee records.

heading.zh: 把回看要求交给实际设计与构建
heading.en: Give design and build a bounded history request

body.zh:
先在已有 GAME_DESIGN 中明确历史政策，再给 game-art-direction 当前场景和目标视口：

> 本项目只读回看，不允许从历史重选。请设计当前对白到历史、滚动阅读再返回当前选项的体验。保留说话者和已提交路线，历史可在清楚边界内滚动；当前维修费与保留开关的要求仍在决定旁。不要增加剧情、把回看做成回滚或输出未来分支。

这份请求使用 skill 的信息层级与历史回看方向；它不是现成历史组件。方向确定后，game-build 按已批准规则接入实际项目，入口与关闭只改变界面显示，不结算游戏行动。

核当前版本时走一次上例，再走“暂不修”相邻路径：历史是否只含那次实际发生的内容，关闭是否回到正确位置，费用与物件是否保持。存读档后的历史由项目存档政策决定，沿用[存档状态修复](/novel-to-game/fix-story-state-after-loading-a-save)的版本与路径检查，别靠另写一份剧情摘要猜出已走路线。
body.en:
Declare the history policy in the existing GAME_DESIGN, then give game-art-direction the current scene and target viewport:

> This project permits read-only history with no reselection from it. Design opening from current dialogue, scrolling and returning to the current choice. Preserve speakers and committed route. Give the history a clear scroll boundary, while keeping repair cost and switch retention beside the decision. Add no plot, rollback behavior or future branches.

This request uses the skill’s information hierarchy and history direction; it is not a ready-made component. game-build can implement the approved rules afterward, with opening and closing affecting presentation without settling actions.

Walk the example and a neighboring decline-repair route in the current build. Check route-specific content, return position, charges and possession. Persistence after loading follows the project’s save policy: use the version and path checks in [save-state repair](/novel-to-game/fix-story-state-after-loading-a-save), rather than guessing the route from a freshly generated summary.

q.zh: 点旧台词就必须回到过去吗？
q.en: Must clicking an old line return to the past?

a.zh: 不必。只读历史可以仅供阅读。允许回滚时，要另定目的地、撤销范围和不可逆节点，并向玩家说明行为。
a.en: No. History can be read-only. Rollback needs a declared destination, undo scope and irreversible boundaries that players can understand.

q.zh: 历史可以显示还没选的路线吗？
q.en: Can history show an unchosen route?

a.zh: 当前对白回看只收录当前路径已经显示的内容。其他路线若作为通关档案解锁，另设清楚入口和条件，避免游玩中泄露后续。
a.en: The current backlog retains displayed content from the actual route. A separate unlocked gallery may show other routes under clear conditions without leaking them during play.

text.zh: 提供已有GAME_DESIGN、PRODUCT_BRIEF、历史政策和目标视口，请game-art-direction设计对白回看入口、阅读边界与返回当前选择的体验。构建另按批准规则实现，不把方向稿当成可运行组件。
text.en: Provide GAME_DESIGN, PRODUCT_BRIEF, history policy and target viewport to game-art-direction for the backlog entry, reading boundary and return experience. Build the approved behavior separately; direction is not a running component.

label.zh: 按需历史与当前决策信息
label.en: On-demand history and current decision information

label.zh: 只读回看、回滚与提交边界
label.en: Read-only history, rollback and committed state

label.zh: 已走分支与玩家已知信息
实际路径与相邻反例检查

title.zh: 手机游戏按钮太小、容易误触怎么改：先看实际点按区域
title.en: How to Fix Small Game Buttons and Accidental Taps on Mobile

seo_title.zh: 手机游戏按钮太小容易误触怎么改｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Fix Small Game Buttons and Accidental Taps on Mobile

description.zh: 检查实际点击范围、相邻按钮间距和选择文字，用完整送药场景说明如何扩大按钮而不改费用、动作或结果。
description.en: Check actual touch targets, spacing and choice text, with a complete delivery example that enlarges controls while preserving actions, costs and results.

answer.zh: 先在目标手机界面检查实际可点区域，别只看图标大小。扩大整个按钮的点击范围，留出相邻间距，让行动和必要代价完整可读；空间不够先删重复说明或拆相邻节拍。保持原动作绑定，重要确认说明将执行什么，再用真实设备检查误触和重复提交。
answer.en: Inspect the actual touch target on the target mobile interface, not just the icon. Enlarge the active button, separate neighboring targets and keep the action and necessary cost legible. Remove repeated copy or split beats when space is tight. Preserve action bindings, describe important confirmations and test accidental taps and repeated submission on real devices.

heading.zh: 先区分按钮难点中，还是点中了却没有结果
heading.en: Distinguish missed taps from an action with no result

body.zh:
记录玩家打算点哪项、实际哪里有反应。字很大但只有文字本身可点，仍可能难用；图标周围有大边框，但边框不接收点按，也没有增加有效区域。

若玩家确实点中了，状态却不变，另查[按钮没有反应](/novel-to-game/fix-a-game-button-that-does-nothing)的输入、动作和结果链。本页处理目标太小、挤在一起和文字读不完整的问题，修尺寸后也要确认仍连着原动作。

可用区域受到屏幕尺寸、浏览器栏、设备安全区域和横竖屏影响。给设计者当前实际界面与目标输入方式，不用一张桌面海报证明手机可点。鼠标能点中也不能证明手指容易点中。
body.en:
Record the intended choice and where activation actually happens. Large text can still be difficult when only the letters are clickable. A decorative border adds no usable area if taps there do nothing.

If the intended button activates but state does not change, inspect the input, action and result chain in [buttons with no response](/novel-to-game/fix-a-game-button-that-does-nothing). Here the problem is small targets, crowding or unreadable choices; resizing should still preserve their original action.

Available space depends on viewport, browser bars, safe areas and orientation. Supply the actual interface and target input method. A desktop poster cannot prove mobile usability, and accurate mouse clicking cannot prove easy finger tapping.

heading.zh: 扩大可点区域，保住行动与必要代价
heading.en: Enlarge the target while preserving action and cost

body.zh:
[W3C 对 WCAG 2.2 目标尺寸最低要求的说明](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/target-size-minimum)给出24×24 CSS像素及间距、等效控件、行内文字、用户代理和必要呈现等例外。这里衡量实际目标，不是图标或设备物理像素。下例选择48像素最小高度作自己的设计起点，不把48写成统一合规门槛；满足一条尺寸条件也不证明整个游戏无障碍。

实际修订可以先做这几件事：

| 界面问题 | 修改方向 |
|---|---|
| 只有短文字能点 | 把内边距纳入同一按钮的实际目标，边缘也触发同一动作。 |
| 两个选择贴在一起 | 分开有效区域并留间距，不让扩大的点击层覆盖邻项。 |
| 长标签被省略 | 保留行动与本项代价，允许完整换行，不把“支付2枚”藏到截断处。 |
| 多段解释挤走选项 | 留当前决定必需信息，删除重复或拆拍，不靠缩小字体解决。 |

game-art-direction 的方法要求目标视口能读到当前正文、选择和必要反馈，选项突出玩家动词与本项代价。按钮变大后，主场景仍应保持可读；历史等主动打开的页面可以另有清楚滚动边界。配色可辅助区分，文字和形状也要说明行动，不让玩家只能凭红绿判断。
body.en:
[W3C’s explanation of WCAG 2.2 minimum target size](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/target-size-minimum) gives 24×24 CSS pixels with spacing, equivalent-control, inline, user-agent and essential-presentation exceptions. Measure the actual target, not its icon or physical display pixels. The example below selects a 48-pixel minimum height as its own starting choice, not a universal compliance threshold. Meeting one sizing condition does not establish whole-game accessibility.

| Interface problem | Revision |
|---|---|
| Only letters activate | Include padding in the same active button; its edges perform the same action. |
| Adjacent choices touch | Separate active areas and add spacing; enlarged layers must not cover a neighbor. |
| Long labels truncate | Preserve action and local cost with complete wrapping, not a hidden payment suffix. |
| Repeated explanations crowd out choices | Keep decision-critical information, cut repetition or split beats instead of shrinking fonts. |

game-art-direction requires readable current text, choices and necessary feedback in the target viewport, emphasizing verbs and each option’s cost. Larger buttons still need a readable play panel. On-demand history can have a separate, clear scroll boundary. Color can help, while words and shapes must also identify actions instead of relying only on red versus green.

heading.zh: 完整纸面例子：选摆渡车，确认费用，再看到到达
heading.en: Complete paper example: choose the shuttle, confirm cost and arrive

body.zh:
原创送药游戏里，玩家在山口，药箱在手，有4枚钱；本段没有倒计时。作者已定两种行动：坐摆渡车到诊所消耗2枚钱和1回合；步行同样到诊所，消耗0枚钱和2回合。两条路线都能送达，本例不另造迟到失败条件。

旧界面把“坐车”和“步行”两个文字链接并排放在插画角落，只有文字可点，费用写在更下面的说明里。改版把两个真实按钮竖排在当前选择区，分别写“坐摆渡车到诊所”和“步行到诊所”，旁边各保留本项费用与回合数。

给布局的起点是390×844 CSS像素竖屏、按钮最小高48、相邻间距12；高度随完整文字增加，有效区域与所见按钮一致。这些是作者选的规格，尚需在目标设备和实际长文本里试，不能由纸面数字宣称已经同屏通过。

> 当前：山口。你提着药箱，持有4枚钱。
>
> 选择：坐摆渡车到诊所（2枚钱，1回合）；步行到诊所（0枚钱，2回合）。
>
> 玩家点中摆渡车按钮的内边距。本例先显示确认：“花2枚钱坐摆渡车到诊所？药箱会随你带上。”下面是“确认坐车”和“返回选择”。
>
> 玩家先返回。仍在山口，4枚钱、药箱和回合数都未变化。
>
> 再选摆渡车并确认。规则提交一次行程：钱剩2枚，用去1回合，地点到诊所，药箱仍在手。界面显示“你带药箱抵达诊所”，接出交药行动。

这次修改解决的是难点按和费用分离；确认页是本例针对付费行动选的设计。它没有把步行改成失败，也没有因为点开确认就扣钱。再连点确认不能结算第二次；不需每次无代价推进都增加确认。
body.en:
In an original medicine-delivery game, the player holds a medicine case at a mountain pass with four coins. This section has no countdown. The author has defined two actions: a shuttle reaches the clinic for two coins and one turn; walking also reaches it for no coins and two turns. Both can deliver. The example invents no lateness failure.

The old interface places adjacent “Ride” and “Walk” text links in an illustration corner, with only letters active and costs farther below. The revision stacks two actual buttons in the choice area: “Take the shuttle to the clinic” and “Walk to the clinic,” each beside its own coin and turn cost.

The layout starts from a 390×844 CSS-pixel portrait viewport, 48-pixel minimum button height and 12-pixel gap. Height grows for complete text; active and visible button areas match. These are author-selected specifications to test with target devices and real long labels, not proof of fitting on screen.

> Current state: Mountain pass; medicine case held; four coins.
>
> Choices: Shuttle to clinic (two coins, one turn); walk to clinic (no coins, two turns).
>
> The player taps inside the shuttle button’s padding. This design opens confirmation: “Spend two coins to take the shuttle to the clinic? You will bring the medicine case.” Controls: “Confirm ride” and “Return to choices.”
>
> The player returns first. Location, four coins, the case and turns remain unchanged.
>
> They choose the shuttle again and confirm. The rules commit one journey: two coins remain, one turn passes, location becomes the clinic and the case stays held. Feedback reads “You arrive at the clinic with the medicine case,” followed by a handover action.

The revision addresses difficult tapping and detached cost information. Confirmation is this example’s decision for a paid action. Walking does not become a failure, and merely opening confirmation does not charge. Repeated confirmation must not settle twice; every cost-free advance need not gain a confirmation screen.

heading.zh: 给 AI 实际画面与规则，再用手机走完
heading.en: Give AI the actual interface and rules, then walk it on a phone

body.zh:
已有 GAME_DESIGN 与 PRODUCT_BRIEF 后，可给 game-art-direction 这样一份有界要求：

> 目标是手机竖屏触控，附当前送药选择界面和两条已批准行动。请只修点按区域、间距、文字换行与当前信息布局。费用、回合数、药箱归属和两条到达结果保持；提出摆渡车确认页，开页和返回都不结算。别缩小字体塞内容，也不要增加新路线或失败规则。

美术方向确定后，由 game-build 修实际控件和原动作绑定。QA方法关注玩家可观察结果；在目标手机分别点中心与边缘、走返回和确认，再走步行相邻路径，核实际触发、费用、回合、地点和物件。检查快速重复点按是否只提交一次，以及结果出现后下一项是否还能读到、点到。

放大文字、切换已支持的横竖屏和换成最长实际选项后，再看是否遮挡或截断。超出项目支持范围的设备如实记录。文章布局或桌面自动检查不能代替该游戏的真实触控、可读性和操作反馈；本页示例尚未实现为游戏。
body.en:
With GAME_DESIGN and PRODUCT_BRIEF in place, give game-art-direction a bounded request:

> Target portrait mobile touch input. Here are the current delivery-choice interface and two approved actions. Revise only active areas, spacing, wrapping and current information layout. Keep costs, turns, case possession and both arrival outcomes. Propose shuttle confirmation with no settlement on opening or returning. Do not shrink fonts to cram content or add routes or failure rules.

After direction is settled, game-build can revise actual controls and their existing bindings. QA methods focus on visible results. On the target phone, tap centers and edges, return from confirmation, confirm, and walk the neighboring route. Check actions, charges, turns, location and possession. Rapid repeated taps should commit once; the next action must remain readable and usable after the result.

Increase text size, use supported orientations and try the longest real choices to find overlap or truncation. Record devices beyond the supported scope accurately. Article layout and desktop automation do not establish the game’s touch usability, legibility or feedback. This page’s example has not been implemented as a game.

q.zh: 按钮都改成48像素就够了吗？
q.en: Is making every button 48 pixels enough?

a.zh: 48是本文示例选择。还要检查实际有效区域、间距、完整文字、动作绑定与目标设备；WCAG最低目标尺寸及其例外是另一项具体标准，不能由单个数字证明整体验收。
a.en: Forty-eight is the example’s choice. Check active area, spacing, full text, binding and target devices. WCAG minimum size and its exceptions are a specific criterion; one number cannot establish the whole experience.

q.zh: 所有选择都要再确认一次吗？
q.en: Does every choice need confirmation?

a.zh: 不用。按代价、可逆性和误操作影响决定。确认写清实际行动；打开或返回不提前结算，提交后只发生一次结果。
a.en: No. Decide by cost, reversibility and consequences of mistakes. Describe the actual action, leave state unchanged on opening or returning, and settle a submitted result once.

text.zh: 附已有产品简报、游戏设计、目标手机视口与当前界面，请game-art-direction只修点按区域、文字可读性和选择布局。保原动作与代价，方向采用后再由构建实现并按目标设备检查。
text.en: Provide the product brief, game design, target mobile viewport and current interface. Ask game-art-direction to revise targets, legibility and choice layout while preserving actions and costs, then build and verify the adopted direction on target devices.

label.zh: 目标视口、信息层级与非颜色反馈
label.en: Target viewport, hierarchy and non-color feedback

label.zh: 界面回调与唯一状态提交
实际输入、溢出与结果路径
label.en: Actual input, overflow and outcome paths

title.zh: 视频导出文件太大怎么办：减小体积，保住关键画面和声音
title.en: How to Reduce Video Export File Size Without Losing Key Content

seo_title.zh: 视频导出文件太大怎么办：压缩与清晰度｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Reduce Video Export File Size and Keep Key Details

description.zh: 核对文件体积、时长与编码，使用真实skill的重编码设置试候选，附纸盒教程完整压缩方案与可读性复查。
description.en: Check bytes, duration and encoding, try the skill’s actual re-encoding controls, and review a complete paper-box tutorial plan for legibility and sound.

answer.zh: 先确认交付上限的单位、当前文件大小和实际时长，再从清晰母版调整编码质量与速度设置。CRF只有在重新编码时生效，也不保证精确文件体积。逐版实测大小，正常速度看细字与动作、听完整声音；必要时再试缩小画面，不为上传删掉关键过程或重做已定配音。
answer.en: Confirm the delivery limit’s units, current bytes and duration, then adjust encoding quality and speed from a clear master. CRF applies only when re-encoding and cannot guarantee an exact size. Measure each candidate, review text and motion at normal speed, and hear the complete audio. Try downscaling when needed without deleting key steps or regenerating approved narration.

heading.zh: 先确认“大”在哪里，以及要交多大的文件
heading.en: Measure the file and the required delivery size

body.zh:
本地文件传不上去，先核限制说的是大小、时长、格式还是尺寸；已经上传但播放模糊，回到[模糊导出排查](/video-recap/fix-blurry-video-export)。不能只看文件写着1080p，就断定它必须很大或一定清晰。

记录当前文件字节数、实际时长、视频编码、宽高和采用的音轨。MB与MiB不同；本例自行选定上限40MiB，即41,943,040字节，不代表任何平台的当前规则。

文件体积与总平均码率、时长有关，声音与容器也占空间。两分钟文件若上限40MiB，总平均码率约为2.80Mbps，这是理解容量的估算，不能全部当成视频预算，也不是CRF输入值。复杂运动、细纹理和噪点会影响质量编码的结果，复制同一个CRF到另一素材不保证同样体积。
body.en:
When a file will not upload, establish whether the restriction concerns bytes, duration, format or dimensions. For uploaded playback that becomes blurry, use [blurred-export diagnosis](/video-recap/fix-blurry-video-export). A 1080p filename establishes neither size nor clarity.

Record bytes, actual duration, codec, dimensions and the adopted audio track. MB and MiB differ. This example selects a 40MiB limit—41,943,040 bytes—not a current platform rule.

Size relates to total average bitrate and duration, including audio and container overhead. A two-minute file capped at 40MiB allows roughly 2.80Mbps overall. That estimate is neither the full video budget nor a CRF value. Motion, texture and noise affect quality-based encoding, so another source at the same CRF need not have the same size.

heading.zh: 先核当前路径是否真的重新编码
heading.en: Check that the chosen path actually re-encodes

body.zh:
所引固定版本的 video-assemble 使用x264。实际参数是OUTPUT_CRF、OUTPUT_PRESET、OUTPUT_MAX_HEIGHT与FORCE_VIDEO_REENCODE，作用依次如下：

| 设置 | 在这条路径里的作用 |
|---|---|
| CRF | 默认18；调大通常降低体积并增加质量损失，不能指定精确MB。 |
| 预设 | 默认veryfast；调整编码速度与压缩取舍，不改变片长。 |
| 高度 | 默认0不加缩放；大于0只限制高度并保持比例，不提高低清细节。 |
| 重编码 | 需要重新压制时可显式开启；视频流复制分支不会应用新CRF。 |

[FFmpeg 的libx264文档](https://ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg-codecs.html#libx264_002c-libx264rgb)把CRF说明为质量模式，把preset列作编码预设。这里的变量来自仓库实现，不是所有编辑器都接受的通用参数。

烧录字幕、画面处理或缩放也会使这条路径进入编码。字幕已烧进母版时，不再额外烧一遍；只缩减文件不应默认重写旁白、改剪点、换配乐或更改帧率。若声音已采用，先明确保留方式；新编码设置不能自动冻结混音。
body.en:
The cited video-assemble version uses x264 with OUTPUT_CRF, OUTPUT_PRESET, OUTPUT_MAX_HEIGHT and FORCE_VIDEO_REENCODE. In that order:

| Setting | What it changes |
|---|---|
| CRF | Defaults to 18. Increasing it generally reduces size and increases loss; it specifies no exact MB. |
| Preset | Defaults to veryfast. It trades encoding speed against compression without changing duration. |
| Height | Defaults to 0 with no added scaling. Positive values cap height proportionally, without restoring low-resolution detail. |
| Encode | Explicitly enables re-encoding when required. Stream copying does not apply a new CRF. |

[FFmpeg’s libx264 documentation](https://ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg-codecs.html#libx264_002c-libx264rgb) describes CRF as a quality mode and preset as an encoding preset. The environment variables belong to this repository, not every editor.

Burning subtitles, visual processing and scaling can also trigger encoding. Do not burn an extra copy over captions already in the master. Reducing bytes need not rewrite narration, change cuts, replace music or alter frame rate. Declare how adopted audio stays intact; new encoding settings do not automatically freeze a mix.

heading.zh: 压缩示例：纸盒教程变小，底扣仍能看清
heading.en: Compression example: a smaller tutorial with a readable bottom tab

body.zh:
原创纸盒折叠教程长120秒，清晰母版1920×1080，假设当前导出90MiB。它完整显示展开折线、合拢盒壁、扣住底扣和放入物件后的结果，字幕已经烧进画面；AAC完整音轨已采用，不增加旁白或音乐。本例交付上限是作者选的40MiB，没有真实文件或压缩结果。

先实际确认母版、字节数、时长与音轨；若并非以上条件，按实际输入改方案。选择新工作目录和输出，保留旧版本。要复用输入视频里的已采用AAC流，须先满足`adopted-packet-copy`的编码与区间条件，明确音频流序号；不满足时先解决声音方案，不静默改成新混音。

**第一候选**：保持1080高与完整120秒，选择OUTPUT_CRF=23、OUTPUT_PRESET=medium、OUTPUT_MAX_HEIGHT=0、FORCE_VIDEO_REENCODE=1。这些是本例试用值，非保证。已烧录字幕保持在母版中，选择不再烧录新字幕；AAC采用复制，不重复响度处理。

实际生成后测字节数，再正常速度检查三个环节：折线是否仍可辨，底扣是否确实扣上，物件放进去后是否稳住。听讲解、折纸声和结尾，检查字幕字形与动作区域。若小于上限却看不清底扣，这版仍不采用。

**若候选仍超过上限但细节可读**，可从同一清晰母版另试一项变化，例如较慢preset，保留其他决定；另测大小，不承诺慢预设必然省多少。若需要试720高度，做单独候选并重看小字与底扣，不能从宽高推定可读。每次都从同一母版开始，不用上一轮小文件反复压小。

只有实际文件满足上限、内容可读且声音正确，才记录它为可采用候选。若仍不满足，保留未完成事实，按作者允许范围调整输出方案；没有哪项CRF能保证所有两分钟素材都恰好40MiB。
body.en:
An original paper-box tutorial lasts 120 seconds with a clear 1920×1080 master and a hypothetical 90MiB export. It shows unfolding creases, closing walls, fastening the bottom tab and placing an object inside. Captions are already burned in; the complete AAC soundtrack is adopted, with no new narration or music. The author selects a 40MiB delivery limit. No real file or compression result exists here.

First confirm master, bytes, duration and track. Revise the plan if actual inputs differ. Use a new working directory and output while keeping the old version. Copying the adopted AAC from the input video requires the `adopted-packet-copy` codec and interval conditions plus an explicit audio ordinal. Resolve incompatible audio separately instead of silently producing a new mix.

**First candidate:** Keep 1080 height and all 120 seconds; try OUTPUT_CRF=23, OUTPUT_PRESET=medium, OUTPUT_MAX_HEIGHT=0 and FORCE_VIDEO_REENCODE=1. These are trial values, not guarantees. Retain the master’s burned captions without burning another set. Copy the adopted AAC without repeating loudness processing.

After rendering, measure bytes and review at normal speed: readable creases, actual tab fastening and an object held by the completed box. Hear explanation, paper sounds and ending; inspect caption shapes and the action area. Reject an unreadable tab even if the file meets the limit.

**If still oversized but readable,** try one further change from the same clear master, such as a slower preset, preserving other decisions. Measure rather than promising a fixed saving. A separate 720-height candidate needs fresh checks of text and tab detail; dimensions alone cannot establish legibility. Start each trial from the master instead of repeatedly compressing the previous small file.

Record an adoptable candidate only when actual bytes meet the cap, content remains readable and sound is correct. Otherwise keep the incomplete result visible and adjust within the author’s permitted scope. No CRF guarantees every two-minute source becomes exactly 40MiB.

heading.zh: 给 AI 一个有边界的压缩请求
heading.en: Give AI a bounded compression request

body.zh:
可向负责合成的执行者提供：

> 输入清晰母版与已采用AAC音轨，保持片长、剪点、字幕内容、动作顺序和声音。上限40MiB是本次交付决定。先确认视频是否重新编码，提出一项参数试法，输出独立候选并报告实际字节数。复查底扣、字幕和完整声音；不重生成TTS，不删关键动作凑大小，不把渲染成功写成观看通过。

这是作者的操作简报，不是skill自动寻找最佳参数的功能。video-assemble的实际配置与记录可支撑候选制作，大小和可读性仍要核实际文件。只换扩展名不会重新压缩；移动文件头帮助播放起步，也不等于减少到指定体积。

原声来自另一份已采用文件时，另按[画面与已定声音配对](/video-recap/keep-audio-when-changing-video)处理，不把当前画面的声音当成指定音轨。
body.en:
Give the assembly operator this brief:

> Use the clear master and adopted AAC. Keep duration, cuts, caption content, action order and sound. This delivery limit is 40MiB. Confirm whether video will re-encode, propose one parameter trial and return an independent candidate with actual bytes. Review the bottom tab, captions and full audio. Do not regenerate TTS, delete essential steps to fit or equate rendering with viewing approval.

This is an author’s brief, not an automatic parameter optimizer. video-assemble’s settings and records support candidate production; verify actual bytes and legibility. Renaming an extension does not recompress, and relocating the file header for playback startup does not establish a target size.

For an adopted soundtrack from another file, follow [pairing picture with retained audio](/video-recap/keep-audio-when-changing-video) instead of assuming the current picture’s sound is the requested track.

q.zh: CRF设成23一定能压到指定大小吗？
q.en: Does CRF 23 guarantee the requested size?

a.zh: 不能。它控制这条x264路径的质量取舍，体积仍受素材与时长影响。必须重新编码后测实际字节数，再核细节是否可读。
a.en: No. It controls the quality tradeoff in this x264 path; source and duration still affect size. Re-encode, measure actual bytes and check legibility.

q.zh: 不加旁白，声音就不会变吗？
q.en: Does no new narration mean audio stays unchanged?

a.zh: 不一定。处理混音与已采用AAC复制是不同方式。先明确音轨与保留条件，再看实际处理和完整声音。
a.en: No. A processed mix differs from copying an adopted AAC stream. Declare the track and preservation conditions, then inspect processing and hear it fully.

text.zh: 把母版、交付大小、必须保住的细节和已采用声音交给负责video-assemble的执行者。先核实际编码路径，再试独立候选并测大小与内容；这项合成技能不自动决定压缩满意度。
text.en: Give the video-assemble operator the master, delivery cap, critical details and adopted audio. Check the actual encoding path, then measure and review an independent candidate; assembly does not decide compression satisfaction automatically.

label.zh: 实际CRF、preset与高度设置
label.en: Actual CRF, preset and height controls

label.zh: 视频重编码、复制与输出音频
label.en: Video re-encoding, copying and output audio

label.zh: 采用AAC的复制条件

title.zh: AI小说封面文字写错怎么办：修书名和笔名，保住画面
title.en: How to Fix Incorrect Text on an AI Book Cover

seo_title.zh: AI小说封面文字写错怎么办｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Fix Incorrect Text on an AI Book Cover | ZenStory

description.zh: 书名或笔名被AI写错，先区分错字、裁剪和字号问题。附准确文字修改简报、参考图保留要求与另行排字方案。
description.en: Separate wrong lettering from cropping or small type. Use exact text, declare what an edit should retain, and compare a separate lettering workflow.

answer.zh: 先把作者确认的书名和笔名逐字列出，核原图错在哪里，再决定用现有封面作编辑目标，还是用无字底图另行排字。把应保留的人物、构图和色调说清，生成新候选后检查全图与最终上传版。只把正确字写进提示词，不等于已经改对。
answer.en: List the author’s exact title and byline, inspect the original error, and choose between editing the existing cover and lettering a text-free background separately. Declare the character, composition and palette to retain, then inspect the whole new candidate and final export. Correct text in a prompt does not prove a correct image.

heading.zh: 先分清是错字，还是字没有显示完整
heading.en: Identify wrong letters, cropping or illegible type

body.zh:
拿准确文字与实际原图并排逐字比，不凭对书名的印象扫一眼。把多字、缺字、同音字和笔画异常分别记下来，书名与笔名都检查。

| 问题 | 先处理什么 |
|---|---|
| 原图把“处”写成“外” | 重新提供准确文字，修生成字样或另行排字。 |
| 原图完整，导出少了半个字 | 先查[裁剪发生在哪一步](/oh-story/fix-cropped-book-cover-text)。 |
| 放大正确，缩小认不清 | 处理[缩略图可读性](/oh-story/make-a-book-cover-readable-as-a-thumbnail)，不改书名内容。 |

花体笔画难辨时，先换更清楚的字形候选，不让装饰效果把书名变成需要猜的图案。不要为迁就生成错误，擅自替作者换笔名。
body.en:
Compare the actual original against exact wording character by character. Record additions, omissions, substitutions and malformed strokes; inspect both title and byline.

| Problem | First response |
|---|---|
| Wrong character in the original | Supply exact wording and revise the generated lettering or set type separately. |
| Complete original; clipped export | Locate [the cropping step](/oh-story/fix-cropped-book-cover-text). |
| Correct at full size; unreadable small | Address [thumbnail legibility](/oh-story/make-a-book-cover-readable-as-a-thumbnail) without renaming the book. |

When ornamental strokes obscure letters, try a clearer treatment. The title should not become a guessing game. Do not change the author’s pen name to accommodate a generation error.

heading.zh: 选择改现有图，还是另行排字
heading.en: Choose an image edit or separate lettering

body.zh:
`story-cover` 默认做含书名和署名的完整封面。固定版本也支持参考图，并要求先查看图片、说明是编辑目标还是风格参考、列出保留内容。修改已有封面时，把这一版明确作为编辑目标，另存结果，不能只传图再说“改正确”。

文字、人物和背景已经合成在一张图片里时，不存在可直接拖动的独立文字层。图像编辑可以作为候选办法，但可能改变附近笔画、人物或底纹，需要检查全图。

作者选择无字底图加后期排字时，要明确这是替代流程。先把旧字清除或使用真正无字的底图，再在排版工具中输入准确书名、笔名并导出完整封面；不能把新字盖在旧错字上，就认定问题消失。
body.en:
`story-cover` normally produces a cover with title and byline.
