The pinned workflow also accepts a reference, requires viewing it, distinguishes an editing target from a style reference and calls for preservation requirements. Mark an existing cover as the editing target and save another result, rather than supplying an image with “make it correct.”

A flattened cover has no automatically movable type layer. Image editing is a candidate route, but adjacent strokes, character art or texture may change; inspect the whole result.

If the author chooses a text-free background and separate typesetting, declare that alternative. Use a genuinely text-free base or remove old lettering, then enter the exact title and byline in a layout tool and export a complete cover. New type laid over visible old errors does not solve the problem.

heading.zh: 修改示例：《夜班寄存处》的两处错字
heading.en: Correction example: two errors on a luggage-office mystery cover

body.zh:
原创悬疑《夜班寄存处》，笔名“江澄”，讲夜班寄存员追查一件无人认领行李的来历。假设作者已有满意封面：一名寄存员、深蓝寄存柜和一件暗红行李；但书名成了“夜班寄存外”，笔名成了“江橙”。以下是修改方案，没有实际图片或生成结果。

作者先确认准确字符串：书名`夜班寄存处`，笔名`江澄`。本轮选现有封面作编辑目标，保住一个人物、柜子布局、行李颜色、冷光方向与原有画幅；不增加警察、尸体或新的剧情暗示。可给出完整简报：

> Use the supplied cover as the editing target. Correct the title to exactly '夜班寄存处' and the byline to exactly '江澄'. Keep the single luggage-office attendant, deep-blue lockers, dark-red suitcase, cool light direction and existing portrait composition. Keep the title at the top and byline at the bottom, with readable contrast and room inside the final crop. Add no slogan, watermark or extra text. Save a new candidate without replacing the original.

实际生成后先逐字核两处，再确认人物人数、行李、背景与光线。若字改对但行李变成了刀，仍不采用；把这项偏差列入下一次修改。若反复改字影响画面，作者可改选无字底图另排准确文字，再检查旧字残留、笔名和上传预览。
body.en:
The original mystery is titled `夜班寄存处`, with pen name `江澄`, about a night-shift attendant tracing unclaimed luggage. Assume an approved composition has one attendant, deep-blue lockers and a dark-red suitcase, but the image shows `夜班寄存外` and `江橙`. This is a proposed correction, with no actual image or generation result.

Confirm the exact Chinese strings first. Select the cover as an editing target and retain the person count, locker layout, suitcase colour, cool light direction and aspect ratio. Add no police, corpse or new plot implication. Use this complete brief:

> Use the supplied cover as the editing target. Correct the title to exactly '夜班寄存处' and the byline to exactly '江澄'. Keep the single luggage-office attendant, deep-blue lockers, dark-red suitcase, cool light direction and existing portrait composition. Keep the title at the top and byline at the bottom, with readable contrast and room inside the final crop. Add no slogan, watermark or extra text. Save a new candidate without replacing the original.

After generation, check both strings and the whole composition. Correct letters do not justify adopting a suitcase changed into a knife. Record that deviation for revision. If repeated text edits disturb the art, the author may choose a text-free background and separate accurate lettering, checking old-text remnants, byline and upload preview afterward.

heading.zh: 最后检查的是哪份文件
heading.en: Inspect the file that will actually be used

body.zh:
保留原图、对应提示词和参考图说明；新候选与上传版各自标清。按“准确文字—人物与关键物件—画幅与裁边—缩略辨识—实际预览”顺序检查当前文件。

字体描边、阴影或发光不是越多越好。若笔画粘连，先减装饰、拉开文字与背景的明暗；书名正确但不可读，也要继续修。不要把提示词中已经写对的字、旧版本截图或一次出图成功当作最终文字检查。
body.en:
Keep the original, prompt and reference note, identifying the new candidate and upload export separately. Inspect exact wording, character and key objects, canvas and crop, thumbnail recognition, then the current publishing preview.

More outline, shadow or glow need not help. If strokes merge, reduce decoration and separate lettering from the background. Correct yet unreadable text still needs revision. A correct prompt, an old screenshot or successful generation is no substitute for checking the final lettering.

q.zh: 提示词里写了准确书名，为什么还要核对？
q.en: Why check the image when the prompt has the correct title?

a.zh: 生成图片与文本指令是不同结果。成图仍可能缺笔、多字或替换字符，导出也可能裁字，所以要核实际使用的版本。
a.en: The image is separate from its instruction. It can still omit strokes, add letters or substitute characters, and export may crop them. Inspect the version actually used.

q.zh: 能不能直接移动图里的书名？
q.en: Can I just move the title in the image?

a.zh: 只有已有独立文字层时才能直接移动那一层。扁平图片需编辑像素或重新排字，不能假定原书名仍是可编辑文本。
a.en: Only a separate type layer can be moved directly. A flattened image needs pixel editing or new lettering; its title is not automatically editable text.

text.zh: 实际生成或修改封面时，使用 /story-cover（Codex 用 $story-cover），给出准确书名、笔名、用途、保存目录与本页的具体简报。有参考图先说明它的用途和保留项，另存候选，再核文字、画面与上传版。技能会调用图像工具并保存文件，不能用提示词代替成图检查。
text.en: For actual cover generation or revision, use /story-cover, or $story-cover in Codex, with exact title, byline, intended use, save directory and this page’s concrete brief. Declare reference purpose and preservation requirements, save a separate candidate, then inspect lettering, picture and upload export. The skill calls an image tool and saves files; a prompt cannot replace checking the result.

label.zh: 文字、参考图、版本保存与质量检查
label.en: Lettering, references, version saving and review

label.zh: 题材、构图、色彩与字体选项
label.en: Genre, composition, palette and lettering options

title.zh: 小说封面缩小后看不清怎么办：书名、主体与明暗层次
title.en: How to Make a Book Cover Readable as a Thumbnail

seo_title.zh: 小说封面缩略图看不清怎么办｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Make a Book Cover Readable as a Thumbnail | ZenStory

description.zh: 大图好看，小图却读不出书名？从实际缩略尺寸检查文字、主体和背景，附旧书店封面的完整简化方案。
description.en: Check title, subject and background at the actual small display size. Follow a complete bookshop-cover revision plan without claiming a fixed font rule.

answer.zh: 先用真实展示大小看准备上传的那版，分别判断书名能否读出、主体能否辨认、文字和背景是否互相淹没。保留一个核心视觉焦点，清理书名周围细节，调整字形与明暗；另存候选后检查大图、小图和裁剪。字号或安全区写进提示词，不代表实际成图已经可读。
answer.en: Inspect the upload version at its real display size. Check whether the title reads, the subject is recognisable and text separates from background. Keep a clear focal point, simplify around the title, and adjust letterforms and contrast. Review full size, small size and crop in a separate candidate; requested type size or margins do not prove legibility.

heading.zh: 不要只放大看封面
heading.en: Test the size readers will see

body.zh:
把最终上传文件缩到作品列表、手机卡片或分享图的实际显示大小，再用正常阅读距离看。不同界面大小不同，不设全平台统一的字号下限；也不把放大后的清晰当缩略图合格。

先看书名是否能准确读出，再看核心人物或物件是否可辨。笔名要完整且满足这次交付要求，但不应挤占书名和主体。如果上传版已缺字，先处理[裁剪问题](/oh-story/fix-cropped-book-cover-text)。

| 小图现象 | 优先试什么 |
|---|---|
| 书名像一块发光斑 | 减少发光与复杂笔画，重试清楚字形和对比。 |
| 人物、道具全挤在一起 | 留主焦点，减少重复题材装饰。 |
| 主体清楚，文字没入背景 | 清理文字区纹理，调整字色、背景明暗或位置。 |

这张表用于定位候选改法，仍须看修改后的实际小图。
body.en:
Reduce the final upload file to the actual book-list, phone-card or sharing display size and inspect it at normal reading distance. Interfaces differ, so there is no universal minimum type size here. Sharp enlarged lettering does not establish thumbnail readability.

Read the title accurately, then identify the main person or object. Keep the byline complete and suitable for delivery without displacing title and subject. For missing letters in an export, address [cropping first](/oh-story/fix-cropped-book-cover-text).

| Small-image symptom | First trial |
|---|---|
| Title becomes a glowing blob | Reduce glow and intricate strokes; try clearer lettering and contrast. |
| People and props merge | Keep a focal point and remove redundant genre decoration. |
| Clear subject, lost title | Simplify texture behind type; revise colour, brightness or placement. |

These are candidate fixes, followed by inspecting the actual small result.

heading.zh: 先决定读者第一眼看什么
heading.en: Choose the first thing readers should recognise

body.zh:
先从故事提炼一项主要承诺。封面可以有前中远景，但不必把每个重要角色、地点和伏笔都画出来。`story-cover` 的方法分文字、风格和画面层，并比较特写、全身或场景构图；先选适合本书的层级，再用风格库作候选。

书名字体、位置和颜色要单列，笔名也要明确。清晰不等于每个字都巨大：减少周围竞争、保住字的轮廓与间距，往往比再加一层光效更有效。顶部或底部只是初始安排，最终看实际画面与裁边。

适当简化背景不代表删掉题材。留下最能传递本书气质的主体与一项场景证据，别把悬疑改成空白商业海报，只为让字容易看见。
body.en:
Extract one main story promise. Foreground, midground and background need not include every important character, place and clue. `story-cover` separates text, style and picture and compares close-up, full-body and scene compositions. Choose the hierarchy for this book before treating style-library options as candidates.

Specify title lettering, placement and colour separately, along with the byline. Clarity does not mean every letter must be enormous: reducing competition and preserving strokes and spacing can help more than another glow. Top and bottom positions are starting choices, checked against actual art and crop.

Simplification should retain genre. Keep the focal subject and a useful setting cue rather than turning a mystery into a blank commercial poster merely to expose its text.

heading.zh: 简化示例：《雨天留灯》的旧书店封面
heading.en: Simplification example: a bookshop cover for 雨天留灯

body.zh:
原创《雨天留灯》，笔名“顾禾”，是旧书店重新开门的都市日常故事。假设初案把三位人物、货架、雨伞、猫和发光书名都塞在一起。作者在本例选择3:4构图和120×160显示预览，发现书名难读；这只是示例尺寸和假设观察，没有真实封面或测试结果。

新候选保留“雨天开门，店灯亮起”这一视觉焦点，去掉不是这张封面必要的猫、伞和另外两人，以一名主角与门灯传递日常温度。书架只在店内作简洁背景，书名放较干净的深色上方，笔名独立放下方。可用完整简报：

> Author-selected 3:4 portrait illustrated cover for a warm contemporary bookshop story. One protagonist opens the old bookshop door on a rainy evening; a warm doorway lamp is the main accent. Keep interior shelves simple and subordinate. Use muted blue-grey rain and warm cream light. Title exactly '雨天留灯' in clear cream lettering in a quiet upper area; byline exactly '顾禾' in smaller readable lettering below, with a restrained divider. Keep both inside the final retained canvas. No other people, cat, umbrella, slogan or watermark. Save a separate candidate.

作者并未删改小说里的配角，只选择封面呈现的重点。实际出图后在大图核准确文字和人数，再在本例120×160看书名与门灯能否分别识别，并检查准备上传那版。若人物或书名仍混成一片，继续调整这一项；不凭“高清”“专业”几个词宣布通过。
body.en:
The original contemporary story `雨天留灯`, by `顾禾`, concerns reopening an old bookshop. Assume a first concept crowds three people, shelves, umbrellas, a cat and glowing type. The author selects a 3:4 composition and 120×160 preview and hypothetically finds the title unreadable. This is an example size and observation, with no actual cover or test result.

Keep the rainy opening and lit doorway as the focal idea. Remove the cat, umbrellas and other two people from this cover, using one protagonist and a lamp for everyday warmth. Shelves become a simple interior background, with title on a quiet dark upper area and a distinct lower byline. Use this complete brief:

> Author-selected 3:4 portrait illustrated cover for a warm contemporary bookshop story. One protagonist opens the old bookshop door on a rainy evening; a warm doorway lamp is the main accent. Keep interior shelves simple and subordinate. Use muted blue-grey rain and warm cream light. Title exactly '雨天留灯' in clear cream lettering in a quiet upper area; byline exactly '顾禾' in smaller readable lettering below, with a restrained divider. Keep both inside the final retained canvas. No other people, cat, umbrella, slogan or watermark. Save a separate candidate.

This changes cover emphasis without removing characters from the novel. Inspect full-size letters and person count, then title and lamp separately at this example’s 120×160, followed by the intended upload file. If they still merge, adjust that issue. “High resolution” and “professional” do not establish a pass.

heading.zh: 比较候选时固定同一展示条件
heading.en: Compare candidates under the same conditions

body.zh:
用同一显示尺寸、同一背景和同一文件版本比较候选。记录“书名某两字粘连”“人物脸与背景同暗”“缩小后门灯与署名混在一起”等具体问题，避免只说更高级。

先实际核文字，再问一个未看简介的试读者“你读到什么书名，像什么题材”。这只是帮助发现表达偏差的反馈，不是点击率保证；作者仍决定哪种气质符合本书。检查完整上传版后，再看实际发布预览。
body.en:
Compare candidates at the same display size, background and version. Record specific issues such as merged letters, a face lost in shadow or a lamp competing with the byline, rather than “more premium.”

Check the lettering, then ask a reader who has not seen the synopsis which title and genre they perceive. This can reveal communication problems, without guaranteeing clicks. The author chooses the tone that fits the book. Check the complete upload export and actual publishing preview.

q.zh: 是不是把书名放得越大越好？
q.en: Should the title always be as large as possible?

a.zh: 不是。书名要可读，也要保住主体和画幅；过大可能挡脸或被裁。一起调整文字区、字形、背景与实际大小。
a.en: No. It needs to read while preserving subject and canvas. Oversized type can cover faces or get cropped. Adjust placement, letterforms, background and actual display size together.

q.zh: 有没有通用的缩略图测试尺寸？
q.en: Is there one universal thumbnail test size?

a.zh: 没有。按实际用途查看。本文120×160只是一组示例决定，不能代替平台或界面的真实显示大小。
a.en: No. Use the intended display. This example’s 120×160 is an illustrative choice, not a platform or interface requirement.

title.zh: 小说封面和题材不符怎么办：从简介确定视觉重点
title.en: How to Make a Book Cover Match the Story’s Genre

seo_title.zh: 小说封面和题材不符怎么办｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Make a Book Cover Match Its Story | ZenStory

description.zh: 封面精美却让人误认题材？从简介、主要行动和情绪确定视觉承诺，附空间站悬疑的完整封面简报。
description.en: Use the synopsis, main action and tone to diagnose a misleading cover. Follow a complete space-station mystery brief without relying on title keywords alone.

answer.zh: 先比较书名、简介与封面分别给出的期待，确定本书主要卖点和气质，再选人物、场景、物件、配色与光线。标题关键词只是题材判断起点，混合题材和含糊书名需要简介补足。修改封面承诺，不为迁就模板换掉故事，也不把结局全画出来。
answer.en: Compare expectations from title, synopsis and cover. Establish the main promise and tone, then choose character, setting, objects, palette and light. Title keywords are a starting point; mixed genres and ambiguous titles need synopsis context. Revise the visual promise without changing the story to fit a template or illustrating its whole ending.

heading.zh: 先说清封面让读者误认了什么
heading.en: Identify the expectation the cover creates

body.zh:
把简介压成一句“谁在什么处境下，反复要做什么”，另写读者主要期待：恋爱关系、追查真相、修炼成长或温暖日常。再看封面是否传达了同一体验。

| 偏差 | 检查重点 |
|---|---|
| 写日常，却画末日大战 | 主体行动和环境规模是否夸大了故事。 |
| 写追查，却只有甜蜜拥抱 | 两人关系是否抢走主要悬疑承诺。 |
| 背景时代不对 | 服装、建筑、工具是否与设定一致。 |

漂亮只是一个维度。读者以为会看到另一种故事，正文再好也难兑现那张封面的期待。处理偏差时先锁定本书内容，再改视觉选择。
body.en:
Condense the synopsis to who repeatedly does what in which circumstances. Separately state the main reading expectation: romance, investigation, progression or warm daily life. Compare the cover’s implied experience.

| Mismatch | Check |
|---|---|
| Daily life shown as an apocalypse battle | Is action or setting scale overstated? |
| Investigation shown only as an embrace | Has romance displaced the main mystery promise? |
| Wrong historical setting | Do clothing, buildings and tools fit the story? |

Beauty is one dimension. A cover promising a different story creates expectations the manuscript may not meet. Preserve the book’s content before revising its visual choices.

heading.zh: 书名关键词不够时，把简介补进去
heading.en: Add synopsis context when title keywords are insufficient

body.zh:
固定版本`story-cover`用书名关键词、必要时简介来判题材，并有多类命中的优先级和无命中时的都市默认。它们是工作流的起点，不能替作者判断实际故事。

混合题材先说主次：“以空间站调查为主，关系线为辅”；再给核心设定、主角的主要行动与整体气质。风格库里的人物、背景、配色和光源供选，不必把每项都用上，也不把粉色或黑色当题材的唯一身份证。

有多个构图候选时，比较的是哪版最清楚传递本书，而不是哪版最像某个热门封面。不要加入正文没有的武器、情侣关系或超自然能力来凑题材符号。
body.en:
The pinned `story-cover` workflow checks title keywords, using the synopsis when needed, with priorities for multiple matches and an urban default when none match. Those are workflow starting points, not a substitute for the author’s actual story.

Declare the hierarchy in a mixed genre: for example, space-station investigation first, relationship subplot second. Supply the core setting, protagonist’s main action and tone. Select among the library’s people, backgrounds, palettes and light sources rather than using all of them or treating pink and black as unique genre identifiers.

Compare which composition communicates this book, rather than resembling another popular cover. Add no weapon, romance or supernatural ability absent from the manuscript merely to supply a symbol.

heading.zh: 题材修正示例：《下班以后》不是写字楼日常
heading.en: Genre correction example: 下班以后 takes place on a space station

body.zh:
原创《下班以后》，笔名“程舟”：空间站维修员在轮班交接发现空气循环记录被改，沿记录追查并寻找责任人，核心体验是科幻环境里的悬疑。书名本身含糊。假设初案画西装青年、写字楼和金色都市字体，读者可能以为是普通职场故事。

作者决定保书名和笔名，封面主视觉改为维修员、空间站走廊与一份被改动的记录；不揭是谁改的，也不增加机甲大战。画面最多突出一个维修员、一处维护设施和一项记录异常，记录不承担必须读清的小字信息。完整简报可写：

> Illustrated portrait cover for a science-fiction mystery, not an office romance. Title exactly '下班以后'; byline exactly '程舟'. A station maintenance worker examines a visibly altered record beside an air-circulation service panel in a confined station corridor. Keep the record markings abstract, with no readable diagnostic text. Use deep blue and grey with one cold white work light and a restrained red alteration mark. No business suit, city skyline, romantic couple, combat mech or revealed culprit. Keep clear title and byline areas within the final retained canvas.

实际生成后核人物衣着、环境和记录是否符合简报，再在小图看空间站与追查的感觉是否还成立。找试读者反馈“像写字楼恋爱”时，先查画面证据，不只把“科幻”二字再重复十遍。这个示例提供方案，不声称已生成或证明读者反应。
body.en:
The original `下班以后`, by `程舟`, follows a space-station maintenance worker who discovers altered air-circulation records at a shift handover and investigates responsibility. Its main experience is mystery in a science-fiction setting. The title is ambiguous. Assume an initial cover shows a business suit, office tower and gold urban lettering, implying conventional workplace fiction.

Keep title and byline. Replace that visual emphasis with the worker, station corridor and altered record, without revealing the culprit or adding mech warfare. Feature one worker, a maintenance fixture and a record anomaly; the record does not require readable tiny text. Use this complete brief:

> Illustrated portrait cover for a science-fiction mystery, not an office romance. Title exactly '下班以后'; byline exactly '程舟'. A station maintenance worker examines a visibly altered record beside an air-circulation service panel in a confined station corridor. Keep the record markings abstract, with no readable diagnostic text. Use deep blue and grey with one cold white work light and a restrained red alteration mark. No business suit, city skyline, romantic couple, combat mech or revealed culprit. Keep clear title and byline areas within the final retained canvas.

Inspect clothing, setting and record against the brief, then whether station and investigation cues survive at small size. If a reader perceives office romance, check the pictured evidence rather than repeating “science fiction” ten more times. This example supplies a plan, without claiming generation or demonstrated reader feedback.

heading.zh: 和正文核对，再比较风格
heading.en: Compare with the manuscript before choosing style

body.zh:
把候选与简介、主角设定和故事主要场景核对：人物身份、工具、时代、关系、能力都不越界。已有画面要保留时，说明参考图是编辑目标和本轮可改范围，另存版本。

然后核书名、笔名、画幅、缩略图和实际预览。若还在试概念，就交代候选方向与待检点；不把“看起来更科幻”当作全书题材已被正确表达。提示词写法见[封面提示词教程](/oh-story/novel-cover-prompts)，参考图的具体用途见[参考图简报](/oh-story/use-reference-images-for-a-book-cover)。
body.en:
Check the candidate against synopsis, protagonist and main settings: identity, tools, era, relationship and abilities must fit. If retaining existing art, identify the reference as an editing target and declare what this revision may change, saving another version.

Then review title, byline, dimensions, thumbnail and actual preview. A concept trial should identify direction and remaining checks; “looks more futuristic” does not establish a correctly communicated genre. See [cover prompts](/oh-story/novel-cover-prompts) and [reference-image briefs](/oh-story/use-reference-images-for-a-book-cover) for the next steps.

q.zh: 混合题材一定要把所有元素放上封面吗？
q.en: Should every mixed-genre element appear on the cover?

a.zh: 不用。先明确主体验，再选少量能证明它的主体和场景；次要关系或伏笔可留给正文，不用堆满。
a.en: No. Establish the main experience and choose a few subjects or setting cues that support it. Subplots and clues can remain in the manuscript.

q.zh: 题材风格库是不是固定配色规则？
q.en: Is the style library a mandatory palette rule?

a.zh: 它提供候选方向。作者的故事气质与实际辨识更重要，最终要看成图是否兑现本书，而非只符合色卡。
a.en: It offers candidate directions. Story tone and actual recognition matter more; judge the result against the book rather than only a palette.

title.zh: 小说封面参考图怎么用：说明用途和必须保留的内容
title.en: How to Use a Reference Image for a Book Cover

seo_title.zh: 小说封面参考图怎么用｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Use a Reference Image for a Book Cover | ZenStory

description.zh: 给AI参考封面前，先说明是修改原图还是参考风格。附修理铺封面的完整简报，保住人物、构图和准确文字。
description.en: Declare whether an image is an editing target or style reference. Use a complete repair-shop cover brief with preserved identity, composition and exact text.

answer.zh: 先查看作者提供且可使用的参考图，说明它是要修改的那张图，还是只参考风格。把要借的特征、必须保留的事实、允许改动的部分和准确文字分别写清。生成独立候选后逐项比对；传入参考图不保证人物、构图或字样自动保持一致。
answer.en: Inspect a usable author-provided reference and declare whether it is the image to edit or a style reference. Separate borrowed features, preserved facts, permitted changes and exact wording. Compare a separate candidate against those requirements; supplying a reference does not automatically preserve identity, composition or lettering.

heading.zh: 先说明你要借什么
heading.en: Declare what the reference is for

body.zh:
“参考这张”容易混在一起：可能要保人物，可能只喜欢配色，也可能要修改已采用的封面。先看实际图，再具体说明。

| 用途 | 简报要说清什么 |
|---|---|
| 编辑目标 | 就修改这张，列保留项与允许改动范围。 |
| 风格参考 | 借配色、光线或笔触，不默认复制人物和题字。 |
| 构图参考 | 借人物与文字的位置关系，另给本书设定和准确文字。 |

后两项是作者对参考用途的描述，不是另一个原生模式名称。固定版本`story-cover`要求区分编辑目标与风格参考，并列出必须保持的内容。只写“差不多”，无法知道哪些相似是你要的。
body.en:
“Use this as reference” can mean retaining a character, borrowing a palette or revising an adopted cover. Inspect the actual picture and specify the intent.

| Purpose | Declare |
|---|---|
| Editing target | Edit this image, with preservation requirements and allowed changes. |
| Style reference | Borrow palette, light or brushwork without assuming its people and lettering transfer. |
| Composition reference | Borrow subject–type placement while supplying this book’s setting and exact text. |

The latter two describe author intent, not extra native mode names. The pinned `story-cover` workflow distinguishes an editing target from a style reference and requires what must stay. “Something similar” leaves the desired similarities unclear.

heading.zh: 参考图不能代替书名、笔名和简介
heading.en: Supply the book information separately

body.zh:
`story-cover` 支持可选参考图；实际调用前先查看本地图像，确认你提供的内容。此处使用作者自有或有权用于本次制作的素材。给执行者明确文件、准确书名、笔名、目标用途、保存目录和简介，不让它从别人的参考封面上抄书名。

工作流有一个`REF_IMAGE`入口，不等于多张图片会自动按角色、风格或构图分别绑定。需要多种要求时写进一份清楚的简报，执行者根据当前工具实际支持决定如何制作；不要虚构“角色锁定”开关。

没有参考图也可直接描述构图。现有封面只有扁平图片时，先确认修改方式；不得把画面中的字当已经存在的独立排版层。
body.en:
`story-cover` accepts an optional reference. View a local image before use so its actual content is known. Use material the author owns or can use for this production. Provide the file, exact title, byline, intended use, save directory and synopsis rather than copying a title from someone else’s cover.

The workflow has one `REF_IMAGE` input; this does not establish automatic multi-image binding by character, style or composition. Describe combined requirements in a clear brief and let the operator use capabilities actually available. Invent no “character lock” toggle.

A reference is optional; composition can be described directly. With only a flattened cover, establish the edit route instead of treating pictured lettering as a separate type layer.

heading.zh: 参考图示例：修理铺封面只改光线与文字
heading.en: Reference example: revise light and lettering on a repair-shop cover

body.zh:
原创《街角修理铺》，笔名“周青”，讲年轻修理师维持小店生意。假设作者有一张自己的封面：一名短发、戴圆框眼镜、穿棕色围裙的修理师在木工作台前，左侧窗户、后方工具架；喜欢人物与布局，但希望把橙色傍晚改成阴天冷光，书名和笔名更清楚。这是方案练习，没有实际图片。

先实际查看提供的图，确认上述事实再做编辑。选择它作为编辑目标，不只是色调参考。简报可以是：

> Edit the supplied cover for '街角修理铺', by '周青'. Preserve one short-haired repairer with round glasses and a brown apron, the wooden workbench, window on the left and tool rack behind. Keep the existing portrait framing and character pose. Change the orange evening light to soft overcast daylight from that same window. Render the title exactly '街角修理铺' in a clear upper area and the byline exactly '周青' below. Add no second person, weapon, slogan or watermark. Save a separate candidate and preserve the original.

实际候选与原图并排：先数人、核头发眼镜围裙，再看窗户方向、工作台和工具架布局，核光源仍来自同一窗；最后逐字检查两组文字、裁边和缩略大小。若光线变了但眼镜消失，或窗换到右边，记录偏差再修，不能因“整体像”就略过。

若作者其实只想借原图的暖色笔触做新书封面，就改说“风格参考”，提供新书人物与场景；那是另一份任务，不能同时要求保原角色又默认换成参考图以外的人。
body.en:
The original `街角修理铺`, by `周青`, follows a young repairer running a small shop. Assume the author owns a cover with one short-haired repairer, round glasses and brown apron at a wooden bench, a left-hand window and rear tool rack. They like identity and layout but want soft overcast light instead of orange evening light, plus clearer wording. This is a planning exercise without an actual image.

View the supplied picture and confirm those facts before editing. Select it as the editing target, not merely a colour reference. Use this brief:

> Edit the supplied cover for '街角修理铺', by '周青'. Preserve one short-haired repairer with round glasses and a brown apron, the wooden workbench, window on the left and tool rack behind. Keep the existing portrait framing and character pose. Change the orange evening light to soft overcast daylight from that same window. Render the title exactly '街角修理铺' in a clear upper area and the byline exactly '周青' below. Add no second person, weapon, slogan or watermark. Save a separate candidate and preserve the original.

Compare candidate and original: person count, hair, glasses, apron, window direction, bench and rack positions, with the same window remaining the light source. Then check exact text, crop and small display. Missing glasses or a window moved right remains a deviation despite broadly similar style.

If the author only wants warm brushwork for a new book, declare a style reference and supply the new people and setting. That is a different task; do not simultaneously request the old identity and silently replace it.

heading.zh: 保存参考用途，方便下一轮修改
heading.en: Keep the reference’s purpose with the version

body.zh:
固定工作流另存版本，并保存提示词和参考图说明。作者可以在简报中列“保留、修改、检查”三项，复核时逐项对照。参考图本身、当前候选与实际上传版不要混用，旧版通过不代表新版相同。

如果书名已正确而小图认不清，接[缩略图教程](/oh-story/make-a-book-cover-readable-as-a-thumbnail)；文字写错则接[准确字样修订](/oh-story/fix-ai-book-cover-text)。当一轮同时改了人物、色调和构图，很难判断哪项解决问题；优先围绕当前缺口修改，再检查全图。
body.en:
The pinned workflow saves another version with prompt and reference notes. A brief can list preserve, change and check requirements for comparison. Keep reference, current candidate and upload export distinct; approval of the old version does not transfer to the new one.

For correct but unreadable small lettering, use [thumbnail review](/oh-story/make-a-book-cover-readable-as-a-thumbnail); for wrong wording, use [text correction](/oh-story/fix-ai-book-cover-text). Changing identity, palette and composition at once obscures which fix helped. Address the current issue, then inspect the entire result.

q.zh: 给参考图就能保证人物不变吗？
q.en: Does a reference guarantee the character stays identical?

a.zh: 不能。说明需要保留的外观、人数和姿态，实际候选仍逐项比对；相似风格不等于同一人物。
a.en: No. Declare appearance, count and pose to retain, then compare the actual candidate. Similar style does not establish the same identity.

q.zh: 构图参考是不是一个专门的开关？
q.en: Is composition reference a dedicated switch?

a.zh: 本文说的是简报用途。当前引用工作流没有为每种用途提供独立开关，执行者须按实际图像工具支持处理。
a.en: Here it describes brief intent. The cited workflow does not supply a dedicated switch for every purpose; use the image tool’s actual capabilities.

Declare reference purpose and preservation requirements, save a separate candidate, then inspect lettering, picture and upload export. The skill calls an image tool and saves files; a prompt cannot replace checking the result.

title.zh: 小说章节太长怎么删：先去重复，保住选择与结果
title.en: How to Shorten an Overlong Novel Chapter Without Losing Its Story

seo_title.zh: 小说章节太长怎么删｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Shorten an Overlong Novel Chapter | ZenStory

description.zh: 章节超过目标，先核统计与必要情节点，再删重复解释和无作用过程。附完整删前删后场景及真实skill的一次压缩流程。
description.en: Check length and required beats, then remove redundant explanation and process. Compare a complete scene before and after with the skill’s one-pass workflow.

answer.zh: 先确认本章目标范围、当前统计和必须完成的内容，再找重复信息、重复解释与没有独立作用的过程。优先删冗余，保留关键判断、选择、对白、后果和承接。真实长篇流程会对超长稿安排一次净删压缩并复检；仍过长时由作者决定长度或结构，不反复改短到剧情断裂。
answer.en: Confirm the target range, consistent count and required content. Find redundant information, explanation and process before cutting, preserving judgement, choice, dialogue, consequences and handoff. The long-form workflow calls for one removal-only compression pass and recheck; if still overlong, the author decides length or structure instead of repeatedly shrinking away the story.

heading.zh: 先确认超了多少，也确认这一章要完成什么
heading.en: Confirm length and the chapter’s job

body.zh:
用同一种统计口径记当前长度与作者要求的范围，不混用字节、字符和不同工具的字数。先排除重复粘贴，再把必要情节点与实际正文逐项对照。不能只按“删百分之二十”处理一整章。

| 需要保住 | 为什么不能只留结论 |
|---|---|
| 判断依据 | 否则人物像凭空知道答案。 |
| 关键选择与对白 | 读者要看见人物如何承担这一步。 |
| 结果、代价和承接 | 后文依赖它们，删掉就换了剧情。 |

若目标范围本身与已定内容不合，先列取舍；不要把关键段删掉后再用一条新秘密补吸引力。字数不足是另一种问题，可看[缺失情节点的核对](/oh-story/ai-novel-word-count)。
body.en:
Use one counting method for current length and the author’s range; do not mix bytes, characters and different tools’ word counts. Check for pasted duplication, then match required beats to the draft. A blanket “cut twenty percent” cannot assess the whole chapter.

| Preserve | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| Basis for judgement | Otherwise the character knows an answer without evidence. |
| Choice and important dialogue | Readers need to experience the decision. |
| Result, cost and handoff | Later scenes depend on these facts. |

If the range conflicts with the planned content, present the tradeoff. Do not delete the key scene and invent a secret to restore interest. For the opposite problem, use [missing-beat diagnosis](/oh-story/ai-novel-word-count).

heading.zh: 按功能删，不把所有慢写都当冗余
heading.en: Cut by function rather than equating slowness with waste

body.zh:
先标出同一事实重复说明、动作后又总结一遍情绪、开头重述上一章已知内容等位置。删除测试要同时看信息、语气、关系、节奏和阅读体验。作者有意的反复或停顿仍可保留，不能只因句子没有新剧情就删。

所引writing-craft按作用分配详略：关键变化可展开，普通过场可压缩，同类并列项也不必平均写满。但它是技法候选，服从本书文风；日常陪伴、气氛和关系体验本身也可能是这一章的交付。

当前长篇流程对超字采用一次净删、零新语义的压缩。不要借删短之机改说话者、换决定、提前揭答案或另加心理。需要重新分章、删情节点或改变结尾时，先把结构选择交作者，另定范围。
body.en:
Mark repeated facts, emotional summaries repeating an action and unnecessary retelling of the previous chapter. A deletion test includes information, tone, relationships, rhythm and experience. Intentional repetition or pauses can stay; a sentence need not advance plot to serve the book.

The cited writing-craft reference allocates detail by function: develop important changes, compress ordinary transitions and avoid equal treatment of every parallel item. These are options subordinate to the book’s style. Companionship, atmosphere and relational experience can themselves be the chapter’s purpose.

The current long-form workflow uses a removal-only pass with no new meaning for excess length. Do not change speakers or decisions, reveal answers earlier or invent thoughts while cutting. Splitting chapters, dropping beats or changing the ending requires a separate author decision and scope.

heading.zh: 删减示例：核单场景保住依据与发车决定
heading.en: Cut example: keep the checking evidence and dispatch decision

body.zh:
以下为原创发货场景。许葵负责核单，既定内容是同事告知已装车，她向司机核对编号，核单后签名允许发车。这里只展示一段删减，不用短例冒充整章字数已达标。

**删前：**

> 许葵翻开发货清单，找到那只蓝箱。蓝箱列在清单上，她已经在清单上找到了它。
>
> 同事指向门边：“司机已经装车了，你去问他。”
>
> 许葵看了看同事，又看了看门边。她知道现在必须去门边，去问那个司机。她走到门边，向司机核对箱号。
>
> “是这只。”司机拿出交接单。许葵核了编号，在清单上签下名字：“那就发车。”
>
> 于是，许葵终于完成核对。这次核对让她明白，每一份清单都需要认真核对。

**本例选择删去重复确认、重复去向和末尾泛化总结；不增加新句：**

> 许葵翻开发货清单，找到那只蓝箱。
>
> 同事指向门边：“司机已经装车了，你去问他。”
>
> 她走到门边，向司机核对箱号。
>
> “是这只。”司机拿出交接单。许葵核了编号，在清单上签下名字：“那就发车。”

删后仍有清单、同事告知、去问司机、交接单、核编号和签名许可。没有把“核对后允许发车”删成“她签了字”，也没凭空加实物开箱检查。句间主语仍清楚，场景停在发车许可，不宣称货物已经到达。

若本书把“看同事、看门边”的停顿写成有意义的犹疑，就检查它在前后文的作用，而非套用本例必删。本例选的是核单过程，不替所有慢动作裁决。
body.en:
This original dispatch scene has Xu Kui check paperwork. Established beats: a colleague says loading is complete; she asks the driver about the number, checks it and signs permission to leave. This is a passage example, not a claim about an entire chapter meeting its target.

**Before:**

> Xu Kui opened the dispatch list and found the blue crate. It was listed there; she had already found it on the list.
>
> Her colleague pointed to the door. “The driver has loaded it. Ask him.”
>
> Xu Kui looked at her colleague, then the door. She knew she now had to go to the door and ask that driver. She went to the door and checked the crate number with him.
>
> “That one.” The driver produced the handover sheet. Xu Kui checked the number and signed the list. “You can leave.”
>
> Finally, Xu Kui had completed the check. This check taught her that every list needed careful checking.

**This version removes repeated confirmation, destination and generic closing commentary, adding no sentences:**

> Xu Kui opened the dispatch list and found the blue crate.
>
> Her colleague pointed to the door. “The driver has loaded it. Ask him.”
>
> She went to the door and checked the crate number with him.
>
> “That one.” The driver produced the handover sheet. Xu Kui checked the number and signed the list. “You can leave.”

The list, colleague’s statement, driver enquiry, handover sheet, number check and permission remain. Checking before permission has not become merely signing, and no physical inspection is invented. The subject stays clear. Permission to depart is not arrival at the destination.

If the original book uses the look between colleague and door as meaningful hesitation, assess its context rather than copying this deletion. This example emphasises checking, without banning slow actions elsewhere.

heading.zh: 删完一轮，重新读完整章节
heading.en: After one pass, read the whole chapter again

body.zh:
给执行者的任务可写：

> 只检查并删去本章已确认的重复信息和无作用解释。保持全部既定情节点、人物选择、关键原话、知情范围和章尾结果，零新语义，不重写成另一个故事。先标候选删除处及理由，按确认范围删一轮，报告实际长度；复读整章和前后承接。若仍超过范围，说明差额与不能再删的内容，提出接受长度或调整细纲/目标的选择。

`story-long-write`的单章检查会给超长稿一次压缩所需的删除范围，修改后复检；它并不自动替作者判断每句剧情价值。净删不代表直接截断文件末尾，也不保证一轮一定达标。

最后查主语、时间、证据、对白回应和结果是否还连得上。不要看到字数减少就省掉情节点检查；已经完成必要内容而仍过长时，保留这个事实，由作者决定下一步。
body.en:
Give the operator this task:

> Identify and remove only confirmed redundant information and purposeless explanation. Preserve established beats, decisions, key lines, knowledge boundaries and ending, with no new meaning. Mark candidate deletions and reasons first, cut within the agreed scope once and report actual length. Reread the whole chapter and its handoffs. If still outside range, report the gap and content that cannot safely go, offering acceptance or an outline/target revision.

`story-long-write` chapter checking supplies a deletion range for an overlong draft, followed by rechecking the changed file. It does not decide every sentence’s story value automatically. A removal-only pass is not truncating the file’s ending and need not meet the range in one attempt.

Review subject, time, evidence, replies and result. A lower count does not replace checking required beats. If necessary content remains overlong, preserve that finding for the author’s next decision.

q.zh: 可以直接让AI删到某个数字吗？
q.en: Can I just ask AI to cut to a number?

a.zh: 先给具体范围和保留项，判断冗余。若达到数字必须改变情节点或结果，就需要结构取舍，不能只截尾或反复删短。
a.en: Supply the range and preservation requirements, then assess redundancy. If reaching the number requires changing beats or results, make a structural decision rather than truncating or repeatedly shrinking.

q.zh: 删短之后一定会更好读吗？
q.en: Is a shorter chapter always more readable?

a.zh: 不是。必要的判断、交流和情绪体验被删掉，可能更难读。比较完整场景作用和前后承接，再看实际长度。
a.en: No. Removing judgement, communication or emotional experience can make it harder to read. Compare the scene’s function and handoffs before its count.

text.zh: 用 /story-long-write（Codex 用 $story-long-write）检查并按明确范围修这章，提供目标长度、正文、细纲和必须保留的事实。超长先定位冗余，按本书文风净删一轮再复检，不用删情节点或新增解释凑数字。
text.en: Use /story-long-write, or $story-long-write in Codex, to inspect and revise the specified chapter with its length range, draft, outline and preserved facts. Diagnose redundancy, remove once in the book’s style and recheck without dropping beats or adding explanation to hit a number.

label.en: One removal-only pass and recheck for excess length

label.en: Selective detail, parallel items and scene development

title.zh: 小说人物关系图怎么整理：目标、边界与变化
title.en: How to Build a Useful Character Relationship Map for a Novel

seo_title.zh: 小说人物关系图怎么整理｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Build a Novel Character Relationship Map | ZenStory

description.zh: 不只画亲友线：把双方目标、条件和知情写在关系旁，附四人旧书集市关系图、完整场景与写后更新示例。
description.en: Map goals, conditions and knowledge as well as social ties. Follow a four-person book-fair map, complete scene and concrete relationship updates.

answer.zh: 先只列本段剧情需要的重要人物，再给每条关系写双方想要什么、能提供什么、有什么条件和目前谁知道。亲友、同事或敌人只是起点；用具体事件确认变化，标清未完成计划。关系图是作者的规划工具，不替代正文，也不自动让所有人物互通信息。
answer.en: Start with important people needed for this stretch of story. Label what each side wants, offers and conditions, plus current knowledge. Family, colleagues or enemies are starting labels; events establish changes, while pending plans stay distinct. A relationship map supports planning without replacing prose or automatically sharing information.

heading.zh: 关系图要帮你决定下一场怎么写
heading.en: Use the map to choose the next scene

body.zh:
把所有人物都连起来，容易只剩一张拥挤通讯录。先问本段哪些关系会影响人物选择，再画这些线。共同目标不等于意见全相同，敌对也不等于每次见面都争吵。

所引character-relations区分冲突、联盟、亲密和权威，并强调人物自身目标与关系变化。依据style-resolution，作者与本书的选择优先；不用为了“有考验”给每条线强加背叛。

[人物设定集](/oh-story/story-bible-template)保存身份与当前事实；[群像写法](/oh-story/ensemble-cast)处理多人的叙事作用。本页聚焦一张能读出条件和下一步的关系图，不给每个人重写履历。
body.en:
Connecting everyone can produce a crowded address book. Map the relationships affecting choices in this stretch. A shared goal need not mean identical views, and rivals need not argue at every encounter.

The cited character-relations reference distinguishes conflict, alliance, intimacy and authority, emphasising personal goals and relational change. style-resolution gives the author and book priority; a relationship need not acquire a betrayal merely to satisfy a generic test rule.

A [story bible](/oh-story/story-bible-template) stores identity and current facts; [ensemble writing](/oh-story/ensemble-cast) addresses narrative roles. This page focuses on a map of conditions and next steps rather than another biography for everyone.

heading.zh: 人物连线旁边写什么
heading.en: Label the relationships with usable information

body.zh:
一条线可用这份手工模板：

> **两人及截至位置**：[A、B，截至哪章或哪场]  
> **双方目标与可提供内容**：[各自想要什么，不合并成一方的目标]  
> **已有约定与边界**：[已经说定什么、仍未答应什么]  
> **知情与误判**：[各自真正知道的内容及来源]  
> **下一步与变化证据**：[等待什么，发生后凭哪段正文更新]

箭头可标单向请求或承诺，双向线可标已确认合作。含义写在图例里；虚线或“待确认”只是这张手工图的约定，不是skill固定字段。不要把作者计划下一场会和解，提前记成双方已经和解。

不必给每条线打好感分。故事真正需要数值时再定体系；一次帮忙可能改变信任或事项进度，也可能只是履行已有约定。
body.en:
A hand-made relationship label can record:

> **People and story cutoff:** [A and B, through which chapter or scene]  
> **Goals and offers:** [what each wants and can provide]  
> **Agreements and boundaries:** [confirmed terms and unanswered requests]  
> **Knowledge and mistakes:** [what each actually knows and its source]  
> **Next step and evidence:** [what remains pending and which passage confirms change]

An arrow can mark a one-way request or promise, while a two-way line marks confirmed cooperation. Define the legend. Dashed lines or “pending” are manual conventions, not native skill fields. A planned reconciliation is not an accomplished one.

Every line need not have an affection score. Define numbers only if the story needs them. One helpful act can affect trust or task progress, or simply fulfil an existing agreement.

heading.zh: 完整示例：四人合办旧书集市
heading.en: Complete example: four people organise a used-book fair

body.zh:
原创旧书集市故事中，周南负责按时开门；叶桑提供藏书借展，并已说明不出售；唐禾负责海报，想用扉页但未获同意；陆音借出运输小车，周南已答应周五晚归还。四人不必互相都有新关系。写本场前，画三条起作用的线：

> 周南 ↔ 叶桑：合办；借展书不出售，现场标识待确认。  
> 唐禾 → 叶桑：想用扉页做海报，等待答复。  
> 周南 → 陆音：承诺周五晚还车，具体时刻待定。

本例箭头表示请求或承诺，双向表示已确认合作。接着把要确认的三件事写成连续场景：

> 周南把两张标签放到桌上：“借展和待售分两边，照这两种贴，行吗？”
>
> 叶桑将“借展”放在三本旧书旁：“这三本只摆给人看。扉页也别拍进去。”
>
> 唐禾放下准备扫描的手机：“那我画普通书脊，不用这些书上的字。”
>
> “这个可以。”叶桑把三本书收在一起。周南在清单上划出借展区，唐禾在海报草稿上写下“普通书脊”。
>
> 陆音翻开日历：“周五三点装，晚上八点车还我。周六我要用。”
>
> 周南把两个时刻记进运输计划：“照这个来。我送还以后告诉你。”

写后更新：周南与叶桑的借展标识已确认；唐禾的扉页请求被拒，普通书脊方案被接受并记入草稿；周南与陆音的还车时刻已确认。书还没展出、海报还没画完、车还没实际归还，不能把计划勾成已完成。三点八点与书脊方案是本例具体安排，不是通用情节要求。
body.en:
In this original used-book-fair story, Zhou Nan wants to open on time. Ye Sang lends collection books and has said they are not for sale. Tang He designs the poster and wants to use a flyleaf without approval. Lu Yin lends a transport cart, which Zhou Nan has promised to return Friday evening. Not every pair needs another relationship. Map three active lines before the scene:

> Zhou Nan ↔ Ye Sang: confirmed cooperation; display-only books, signage pending.  
> Tang He → Ye Sang: flyleaf request awaiting an answer.  
> Zhou Nan → Lu Yin: Friday-evening return promised, exact time pending.

Here arrows indicate requests or promises; the two-way line indicates cooperation. Write the three decisions as one continuous scene:

> Zhou Nan put two labels on the table. “Separate loan displays from stock for sale. Can we use these?”
>
> Ye Sang placed “Display only” beside three old books. “These are for looking at. Don’t photograph their flyleaves either.”
>
> Tang He put down the phone ready for scanning. “Then I’ll draw ordinary book spines without words from these books.”
>
> “That’s fine.” Ye Sang gathered the three books. Zhou Nan marked a display-only area on the list; Tang He wrote “ordinary book spines” on the poster draft.
>
> Lu Yin opened the calendar. “Load at three on Friday. Return the cart by eight that evening. I need it Saturday.”
>
> Zhou Nan recorded both times in the transport plan. “Agreed. I’ll tell you when I’ve returned it.”

Update the confirmed signage, rejected flyleaf request and accepted spine proposal, plus agreed cart-return time. Exhibition, finished poster and actual return remain pending. Three and eight o’clock and the spine design are concrete example choices rather than universal plot requirements.

heading.zh: 写完再更新，不把未来当成现在
heading.en: Update after the event without turning plans into facts

body.zh:
标明截至章或场，留下变化对应的正文位置。人物有了新条件就改那条线，未受影响的关系仍保留。秘密只记录在实际知道它的人旁边；作者看过全图，不代表人物也看过。

关系图可以用纸、表格或画图工具制作，形式服从你找信息的习惯。手工模板不是Oh Story的固定文件协议，也不替代工作区已有的状态管理。给AI的简报可写：

> 只整理截至本场的人物关系，不续写正文。列出双方目标、已确认约定、待答请求和各自知情来源，用简图与短表呈现。已有事实保留，未发生的计划另标；不要给每条关系补背叛或自动加好感。指出下一场真正需要确认的事项。

当图越来越复杂，按当前剧情筛出相关人物，再回总图核跨线影响。精简视图是少显示，不是删除已发生的故事事实。
body.en:
Record the chapter or scene cutoff and the passage confirming a change. Update the affected line while retaining other relationships. Place secrets only beside characters who actually know them; the author’s view of the full map does not give it to the cast.

Use paper, a table or a drawing tool according to how you find information. This manual template is not an Oh Story file protocol or a replacement for workspace state management. Give AI this brief:

> Organise relationships through this scene without drafting prose. Show both sides’ goals, confirmed agreements, pending requests and knowledge sources in a simple map and short table. Keep established facts and label future plans separately. Add no automatic betrayal or affection increase. Identify what the next scene genuinely needs to resolve.

For a crowded map, filter to people relevant to the current plot, then check cross-line effects against the full view. Showing less does not delete story facts.

q.zh: 是不是每两个人都要连线？
q.en: Should every pair be connected?

a.zh: 不用。只画影响当前故事的关系，其他事实可留人物卡；不为画满网络新增事件。
a.en: No. Map relationships affecting the current story; keep other facts on character cards without inventing events to fill the network.

q.zh: 关系图能代替人物设定集吗？
q.en: Can the map replace a story bible?

a.zh: 不能。它帮助看关系条件和变化，身份、经历、能力与权威事实仍放在既定位置，并互相核对。
a.en: No. It exposes relationship conditions and changes; identity, history, abilities and authoritative facts remain in their established places.

text.zh: 用 /story-long-write（Codex 用 $story-long-write）只整理或规划这段人物关系，附本书设定、截至位置和实际事件。要求简图、双向目标、边界与待办，不自动建全书或续写正文，也不把手工图例当原生状态格式。
text.en: Use /story-long-write, or $story-long-write in Codex, only to organise or plan these relationships, supplying settings, story cutoff and actual events. Request a map, goals on both sides, boundaries and pending decisions without starting the book or drafting prose; manual labels are not native state fields.

label.zh: 关系类型、人物目标与关系线
label.en: Relationship types, personal goals and relationship arcs

label.zh: 本书选择与事实边界优先
label.en: Book choices and factual boundaries take priority

title.zh: 先婚后爱小说怎么写：从共同生活写到主动选择
title.en: How to Write Marriage Before Love in a Novel

seo_title.zh: 先婚后爱小说怎么写｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Write Marriage Before Love in a Novel | ZenStory

description.zh: 已婚不等于相爱。把共同生活、各自目标和边界写成具体选择，附家宴分工到主动约会的完整场景与修订方法。
description.en: Marriage is a starting situation. Develop separate goals, boundaries and chosen closeness through a complete dinner negotiation and invitation scene.

answer.zh: 先明确两人为何结婚、各自仍要完成什么、共同生活有哪些已说定的安排，再用事件让双方提出需求、回应边界并主动靠近。婚姻身份不能替代信任、同意或爱情；关系变化要有可见的选择与行动，不只靠旁人宣布“已经是一家人”。
answer.en: Establish why they married, their separate goals and agreed living arrangements. Let events prompt requests, responses to boundaries and chosen closeness. Marriage does not supply trust, consent or love by itself; demonstrate change through choices and actions rather than someone declaring them a family.

heading.zh: 先写结婚后的实际处境
heading.en: Start with the life they now share

body.zh:
先婚后爱与假恋爱不同：这里的婚姻已成立，感情发展才是未完成项。开篇只交代当前事件需要的背景，剩余原因可在关系推进时补；不用先写一整页协议条款。

| 先确认 | 写进故事的方式 |
|---|---|
| 双方各自的目标 | 工作、家人或生活计划确实占用时间。 |
| 共同安排 | 谁知道什么、谁答应了什么，避免单方替对方表态。 |
| 尚未亲近的原因 | 陌生、价值分歧或旧经历，落在本场反应里。 |

豪门总裁卡把身份与资源差异放入人物行动；女频写作方法强调人物自身目标和选择。采用这些方法不要求男主是总裁，也不要求女主放弃事业。两人生活条件相近，同样可以写这一关系顺序。
body.en:
Unlike fake dating, this premise starts with an existing marriage and an unfinished relationship. Introduce the background required for the immediate event, revealing other reasons as the relationship develops rather than opening with a page of clauses.

| Establish | Show it through |
|---|---|
| Separate goals | Work, family or personal plans that actually take time. |
| Shared arrangements | Who knows and agreed to what, without one speaking for both. |
| Distance | Unfamiliarity, conflicting values or history affecting this scene. |

The cited CEO-romance card places status and resources inside action; the female-audience method emphasises personal goals and agency. These methods do not require a CEO hero or a heroine abandoning work. Similar living conditions can support the same relationship sequence.

heading.zh: 让体贴改变一件具体的事
heading.en: Make care change something concrete

body.zh:
“他其实很爱她”只是作者判断。让他先问、听到答案、承担自己能承担的部分，再写她如何看待这次行动。她也要有主动提出需求、拒绝或邀请的机会；不把被照顾等同于欠感情债。

误会可以来自不同预期，但人物已听清并认可的条件不能下一章自动忘掉。资源更多的一方提供帮助时，要确认对方的意愿与决定权；买下工作室、替她辞职等大动作并不天然是体贴。

共同生活中的一个有效变化可以很小：答应自己回应父母，就真的回应；说晚饭各自解决，就不临时责怪对方没有等。风格与进展速度由本书决定，不套固定章数。
body.en:
“He secretly loves her” is an author judgment. Have him ask, hear the answer and handle his own part; then show how she regards that action. Give her opportunities to request, refuse or invite as well. Receiving care does not create a debt of affection.

Different expectations can cause misunderstanding, but acknowledged terms cannot vanish next chapter. When one has greater resources, help still needs the other’s wishes and decision-making. Buying her studio or resigning on her behalf is not inherently considerate.

A useful change can be small: someone promising to answer their parents actually does so; separate dinner plans do not later become grounds for blame. Let the book choose its pace without a fixed chapter formula.

heading.zh: 完整示例：家宴安排后的主动邀请
heading.en: Complete example: a family dinner and a chosen invitation

body.zh:
原创故事中，林遥与周屿均为成年人，已结婚两个月，但还不熟悉。她的插画稿今晚到期；他希望参加父母的家宴。两人此前没有约定她必须出席。本例只写这次安排与下一次邀请，不把一次体贴当成相爱证明。

> 周屿把家宴时间发给她：“七点。你来得及吗？”
>
> 林遥看了眼还没画完的封底：“今晚要交稿。你可以去，我不想把工作带到饭桌上。”
>
> “我妈可能会问。”
>
> 她停下笔：“那你告诉她，这是我自己接的工作，今晚做完。我没有答应过一定到。”
>
> 周屿拨通电话，没有把手机递给她：“妈，林遥今晚赶稿，我一个人来。下次约之前，我先问她时间。”电话里追问了两句，他仍按这个安排答复。
>
> 门关上后，林遥继续画完封底。提交回执亮起来时，已过九点。周屿回来，将自己的外套挂好：“交了？”
>
> “交了。”她合上电脑，“周六我想去河边那家旧书店。你愿意一起吗？”
>
> 周屿看了日历：“上午有事，三点以后可以。”
>
> “那三点半门口见。”
>
> 他把约定记进日历。林遥也设了提醒，才起身倒水。

这里他回应了自己家人的期待，她完成了自己的工作并主动邀请；双方确认时间。读者能看见一次可信的小变化。家人是否完全赞同、周六是否赴约、两人何时相爱都还未完成，后文要继续兑现。
body.en:
In this original story, adult spouses Lin Yao and Zhou Yu have been married for two months but remain unfamiliar. Her illustration is due tonight; he wants to attend his parents’ dinner. They have no prior agreement requiring her attendance. This scene resolves the arrangement and a later invitation without treating one considerate act as proof of love.

> Zhou sent her the dinner time. “Seven. Can you make it?”
>
> Lin looked at the unfinished back cover. “The artwork is due tonight. You can go. I don’t want to take work to the table.”
>
> “My mother may ask.”
>
> She put down her pen. “Tell her I took this job and will finish it tonight. I never promised to attend.”
>
> Zhou called without handing her the phone. “Mum, Lin has a deadline. I’m coming alone. Next time I’ll ask her availability before we arrange it.” After two further questions, he gave the same answer.
>
> Once the door closed, Lin finished the back cover. The submission receipt appeared after nine. Zhou returned and hung up his coat. “Sent?”
>
> “Sent.” She closed the computer. “I want to visit the riverside secondhand bookshop Saturday. Would you like to come?”
>
> Zhou checked his calendar. “Busy in the morning. Free after three.”
>
> “Three-thirty outside, then.”
>
> He recorded the arrangement. Lin set a reminder before getting up for water.

He handles his family’s expectations; she completes her work and initiates an invitation. Both agree on a time. This is a credible small change, not proof that the parents fully approve, Saturday’s visit has happened or the couple are in love. Later scenes must fulfil those pending developments.

heading.zh: 修订时核对双方是否都能行动
heading.en: Revise for agency on both sides

body.zh:
给每场标出：谁提出要求、对方真正回答了什么、谁采取行动、关系因此改变到哪一步。若一方只负责感动或误会，就补其目标与选择；不必为制造波折强加背叛。

给AI的简报可写：

> 两人已婚但未相爱。只规划或修订指定场景，保留各自工作、已有约定与当前知情。让请求、答复和实际处理连续发生，双方都有主动选择。按本书文风写出本场信任变化，未发生的约会另标，不自动宣布相爱。

真实 `story-long-write` 可处理这段规划或修订。先给作者范围，避免因为调用长篇skill就默认启动整本书。
body.en:
Mark who asks, what the reply actually says, who acts and how far the relationship changes. If one person merely feels moved or misunderstands, restore a personal goal and choice. Do not manufacture betrayal to supply conflict.

Brief AI like this:

> They are married but not in love. Plan or revise only this scene, preserving separate work, agreements and current knowledge. Develop requests, answers and actual handling continuously, with choices on both sides. Follow the book’s style and show this scene’s trust change. Keep the future date pending rather than declaring love.

The actual `story-long-write` skill can handle the specified planning or revision. State the author’s scope instead of automatically starting a full book.

q.zh: 一定要写协议婚姻吗？
q.en: Does it have to be a contractual marriage?

a.zh: 不必。先婚后爱描述的是关系顺序。结婚原因按故事设定，关键是感情发展有双方的选择与行动。
a.en: No. It describes the relationship sequence. Choose the marriage premise for the story, then develop affection through both people’s choices and actions.

q.zh: 共同生活里没有大事件，会不会太平淡？
q.en: Do shared-life scenes need major events?

a.zh: 不一定。安排、分工和边界只要影响当下选择，就能推进关系；篇幅与变化大小要配合本书承诺。
a.en: Not always. Arrangements, shared work and boundaries can advance the relationship when they affect a current choice. Match space and scale to the book’s promise.

text.zh: 用 /story-long-write（Codex 用 $story-long-write）处理这场先婚后爱互动，给双方目标、已有约定、知情和本书文风；限定为本场规划或修订，保留双向选择与未发生事项。
text.en: Use /story-long-write, or $story-long-write in Codex, for this interaction. Supply both goals, agreements, knowledge and book style; limit the task to this scene, preserving mutual choice and pending events.

title.zh: 经营文小说怎么写：把一笔生意写成故事
title.en: How to Write Business-Management Fiction

seo_title.zh: 经营文小说怎么写｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Write Business-Management Fiction | ZenStory

description.zh: 从顾客需求、资源限制写到接单、交付和回款。附小文具店完整订单场景，区分卖得多与真正能继续经营。
description.en: Build a story from customer need through stock, terms, delivery and payment. Follow a complete stationery-shop order and its next capacity decision.

answer.zh: 围绕一笔生意写清谁需要什么、主角有什么资源、双方怎么谈条件、如何交付和收到什么回报。经营成长不只是一串营业额；每次改善都要改变能力、关系或下一轮责任。数字服务人物选择，不能代替订单真正完成的过程。
answer.en: Build one transaction around the customer’s need, available resources, agreed terms, delivery and return. Growth is more than a series of sales totals: each improvement changes capacity, relationships or next-round responsibilities. Numbers support choices without replacing the completed transaction.

heading.zh: 先找当前能完成的一笔生意
heading.en: Start with an achievable transaction

body.zh:
主角经营什么不是全部看点。顾客为什么现在需要它、为什么愿意试这家店、店里有什么做不到，才构成当前故事。都市种田卡的低资源起步、投入与生活改善可用于经营文；不必把每次成功升级成商业争霸。

先写一张作者用订单卡：顾客用途、数量与时限；可用库存与人手；双方已同意的条件；收钱与交付位置；可能影响下一单的结果。这是写作模板，不是skill原生文件格式。

食品、修理、服务等行业需要各自资料。本文用虚构文具店练习叙事，不把一句“有秘方”当作所有店铺都能成功的依据。
body.en:
What the protagonist sells is only part of the appeal. Why the customer needs it now, why they try this shop and what the shop cannot do supply the immediate story. The urban-farming card’s limited-resource start, investment and everyday improvement can support business fiction without escalating every success into commercial conquest.

Make a manual order card: purpose, quantity and deadline; stock and staff; agreed terms; payment and delivery; consequences for another order. This is an author template, not a native skill file format.

Different industries need their own research. This page uses a fictional stationery shop to practise narrative rather than making a secret recipe explain every business success.

heading.zh: 把钱与做得到的事一起写
heading.en: Track capacity alongside money

body.zh:
| 核对项 | 对剧情的作用 |
|---|---|
| 库存与工时 | 决定能否接单，而非答应后突然凭空到货。 |
| 条件与交付 | 买主同意何时拿、拿到什么；不是老板单方宣布完成。 |
| 收款与支出 | 区分订金、尾款、成本和仍要付的费用。 |
| 下一轮变化 | 有了什么资源，又新增什么限制或责任。 |

利润算式另见[营收、成本与现金](/oh-story/revenue-costs-and-cash-in-business-fiction)。这篇重点是接单和履约过程：即使算式正确，客人没有拿到货，也不能写成订单已完成。

周转困难可以让人谈延期、减量或拒单。帮忙的亲友要有自己的时间和报酬安排；竞争者也要对实际变化反应，不只在主角成功后喊一句不可能。
body.en:
| Check | Story function |
|---|---|
| Stock and time | Determine whether the order is feasible, without goods appearing after a promise. |
| Terms and delivery | The customer accepts when and what they receive; completion is not the owner’s declaration. |
| Receipts and spending | Separate deposits, final payment, costs and unpaid expenses. |
| Next round | Show gained resources and new limits or responsibilities. |

For calculations, see [revenue, costs and cash](/oh-story/revenue-costs-and-cash-in-business-fiction). This page focuses on taking and fulfilling orders. A correct calculation does not complete a transaction whose customer never receives the goods.

Shortfalls can require delay, reduction or refusal. Helpers have their own time and compensation; competitors respond to concrete changes rather than simply exclaiming that success is impossible.

heading.zh: 完整示例：二十本笔记本怎样交到顾客手里
heading.en: Complete example: delivering twenty notebooks

body.zh:
原创文具店故事：许宁接手的小店只有二十本空白本。社区读书会今晚需要练习本，不要求印字。以下价格与数量都是本例选择，不是经营建议。

> 客人指着样本：“二十本，封面能印名字吗？六点以前要。”
>
> 许宁翻开库存本：“二十本现货可以。店里没有印字设备，今晚加不上。空白封面，每本八元，你能接受吗？”
>
> 客人拿起一本试写：“可以。不印名字了。六点我来取。”
>
> 她记下订单，逐本检查页数，把两本压弯的封面整平，再分成两包。包装花了二十元，她把票据夹进账页，没有算进顾客的另加价里。
>
> 客人回来，解开一包数了十本，再数另一包：“齐了。”他付了一百六十元，将两包一起提走。
>
> 许宁在账上写：收款160，二十本进货成本100，包装20，差额40。房租与她的劳动还没扣，不能写成净赚40。
>
> 客人又问：“下周一百本也交给你？”
>
> 她看着空架：“我先确认进货时间，明天下午答复。现在不能保证。”她记下联系方式，才在待办里写“问供货”。

这笔订单真正完成；后来的百本询价仍待确认。店里有现金和一次履约记录，也出现库存补充问题。接下来可以写供应选择与能力扩张，而非跳到“从此生意越来越好”。
body.en:
Original story: Xu Ning’s inherited stationery shop holds only twenty blank notebooks. A neighbourhood reading group needs workbooks tonight and does not require printing. Prices and quantities are illustrative story choices.

> The customer pointed to the sample. “Twenty. Can you print names on the covers? Needed before six.”
>
> Xu opened the stock book. “Twenty available. No printing equipment here; I can’t add names tonight. Blank covers, eight each. Would that work?”
>
> He tested a page. “Yes. No names. I’ll collect at six.”
>
> She recorded the order, checked the pages and straightened two bent covers, then made two bundles. Packaging cost twenty; she clipped the receipt into the ledger without adding an unagreed charge.
>
> Returning, the customer opened one bundle and counted ten, then counted the other. “All here.” He paid one hundred and sixty and carried both away.
>
> Xu wrote: receipts 160, notebook acquisition cost 100, packaging 20, difference 40. Rent and her labour remained uncounted; this was not net profit of 40.
>
> “A hundred next week too?” the customer asked.
>
> She looked at the empty shelf. “I’ll check delivery dates and answer tomorrow afternoon. I can’t promise yet.” She recorded his contact before adding “ask supplier” to her task list.

The first order is complete; the hundred-book enquiry is pending. The shop has cash and a fulfilled order, alongside a stock problem. Continue with supply decisions and capacity rather than jumping to “business improved forever.”

heading.zh: 每轮增长之后，检查谁要做更多事
heading.en: After growth, ask who has more to do

body.zh:
给AI的范围可以很具体：

> 只写这一笔经营订单，保留顾客需求、现有库存、约定价格与时限。让双方谈条件、实际交付与收款发生在连续场景里。账目区分已付款和未扣费用；下一单询价不能自动当成已接。按本书文风写人物的期待与取舍，不添加万能技能或无限库存。

检查叙述是不是一直写“客人都夸好、收入翻倍”。保留一个能代表变化的订单过程，再适度概述同类重复，既不写流水账，也不跳掉关键选择。

规模扩大后，补货、人手、稳定交付和决定权会改变，新的章节从这些实际后果出发。生活改善与竞争线的比例服从作者，不机械要求每章涨收入。
body.en:
Give AI a concrete scope:

> Write only this order, preserving need, stock, agreed price and deadline. Develop negotiated terms, actual delivery and payment in continuous scenes. Distinguish receipts from uncounted costs; a new enquiry is not an accepted order. Follow the book’s style, showing expectations and choices without unlimited inventory orall-purpose abilities.

Check for repeated “customers praised it, revenue doubled.” Develop a representative transaction, then summarise routine repetition where appropriate. Avoid both a complete diary and skipping the essential choice.

Growth changes supply, staffing, reliable delivery and authority. Continue from those consequences. Let the author choose the balance of everyday improvement and competition without requiring revenue to rise every chapter.

q.zh: 经营文一定要从穷到富吗？
q.en: Must business fiction go from poverty to riches?

a.zh: 不必。守住小店、改变工作方式或经营关系都能成为目标。成长要符合本书承诺，不必每次扩张。
a.en: No. Keeping a shop, changing how work is done or developing business relationships can be the goal. Growth follows the book’s promise without compulsory expansion.

q.zh: 经营细节越多越好吗？
q.en: Are more business details always better?

a.zh: 留下影响选择与交付的细节。重复流程可概述，关键谈判、履约和结果需要让读者看见。
a.en: Keep details affecting choices and delivery. Summarise routine repetition while showing important negotiation, fulfilment and outcomes.

text.zh: 用 /story-long-write（Codex 用 $story-long-write）规划或修这一笔生意，附库存、时间、人手、顾客需求与已同意条件；保留实际交付回款、成本边界和未接下一单。
text.en: Use /story-long-write, or $story-long-write in Codex, to plan or revise this transaction with stock, time, staff, customer need and agreed terms. Preserve delivery, payment, cost limits and the pending next order.

title.zh: 网游小说怎么写：让玩法改变任务与队友关系
title.en: How to Write an Online-Game Novel

seo_title.zh: 网游小说怎么写｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Write an Online-Game Novel | ZenStory

description.zh: 别只罗列属性和装备。用可理解的任务规则、分工、操作和分配推动网游故事，附完整护送任务及队友选择示例。
description.en: Use understandable quest rules, roles, actions and reward choices rather than lists of stats. Follow a complete escort quest and its team consequences.

answer.zh: 先让读者理解当前任务的目标、限制、失败条件与完成证据，再写玩家在规则内如何配合、冒险和分配结果。属性与装备只在改变选择时出现；任务完成、奖励取得、队友信任是不同变化，需要分别兑现。
answer.en: Establish the current quest’s goal, limits, failure conditions and completion evidence. Develop cooperation, risk and reward decisions within those rules. Introduce stats and equipment when they change a choice; quest completion, obtaining rewards and teammate trust are separate changes to demonstrate.

heading.zh: 开头先给一个能看懂的任务
heading.en: Open with a readable task

body.zh:
网游小说以玩家进入游戏、任务和社交关系展开，不等于电竞职业联赛。先介绍眼前为什么要组队、要完成什么、每人能做什么；当前不用的职业树和装备表可以后放。

所引游戏体育卡将游戏规则、队伍分工与行动结果放在一局或一次任务里。这是当前可用的写作方法，卡片本身不提供真实游戏市场排名，也不保证某种设定更受欢迎。

虚构游戏可以自己定规则，但规则要在使用前建立。若写真实游戏版本，就另查其实际机制，不用“游戏通常这样”替具体资料。
body.en:
Online-game fiction develops through players, quests and social relationships; it differs from a professional esports league. Establish why this team forms, what it must accomplish and what each person can do. Unneeded class trees and equipment tables can wait.

The cited game-and-sports card puts rules, roles and results inside a match or task. It supplies writing options, not real market rankings or a guarantee that a premise will attract readers.

Invent a game’s rules before using them. For a real game version, research its actual mechanics rather than substituting what games supposedly usually do.

heading.zh: 只写当前改变操作的规则
heading.en: Use the rules that affect this action

body.zh:
| 作者先确认 | 本场需要看见 |
|---|---|
| 目标与失败 | 交给谁才算完成，什么会让任务失败。 |
| 队员条件 | 谁能操作、承担什么，是否已同意分工。 |
| 资源与奖励 | 可用次数、物品归属及分配方式。 |
| 场外限制 | 下线时间、现实安排怎样影响组队。 |

一件装备有新效果，就在合理获得后使用；不能为了救场忽然加未设定技能。操作描写要让读者知道位置、先后与结果，不一定逐秒播报。

任务难度不必只靠怪物血量增长。合作条件、道具用途和队友目标也可变化。游戏里的帮助是否影响关系，仍要由人物答复与下一次选择确认。
body.en:
| Establish | Show now |
|---|---|
| Goal and failure | Recipient defining completion and actions that fail the quest. |
| Roles | Who can act, their job and agreement to it. |
| Resources and reward | Available uses, ownership and allocation. |
| Outside limits | Logout time or real commitments affecting play. |

Use equipment effects after establishing and obtaining them; do not invent an undeclared rescue skill. Make position, sequence and result readable without compulsory second-by-second commentary.

Difficulty can change through cooperation, item uses and personal goals rather than monster health alone. Helpful play affects relationships only when responses and later choices establish that change.

heading.zh: 完整示例：守门的人怎样完成共同任务
heading.en: Complete example: the teammate holding the gate

body.zh:
以下为原创虚构游戏，三人任务是把档案箱交给门后的档案员。已定规则：压力板必须有人站着才开门，箱子交付后任务结束、门保持开启；抬箱需两人，途中不能放下。任务奖励一件组件，由队长选个人背包或小队仓库。苏澈是队长，另外两名玩家抬箱；本场没有临时增加技能。

> 苏澈踩上压力板，门升起来：“你们一起抬，进去后别停。我留这儿。”
>
> 小满看着箱子另一边：“你不进去，奖励算你的吗？”
>
> “看交付完成，不看谁先进门。”苏澈指了指任务说明，“别松手。”
>
> 小满与阿乔同时抬起箱子，沿门洞移过去。阿乔走得慢，小满也放缓，直到两人把箱子递到档案员手中。
>
> “已接收。”屏幕出现完成提示。苏澈离开压力板，门没有落下。他进门，看见奖励选择，把组件放进小队仓库。
>
> 阿乔打开仓库看了一眼：“下次缺人叫我。今晚还有一趟，要来吗？”
>
> 苏澈看时间：“明早考试，现在得下。周五晚我可以。”
>
> “那周五再约。”阿乔加上好友，没有立刻替他报名。苏澈退出游戏，去收拾考试用的笔。

压力板、双人抬箱和交付判定都被实际使用，奖励已选入仓库。阿乔回应合作并提出再约，但下一次任务还没发生。队长选择仓库是本例取舍，不意味着所有玩家或游戏都必须平均分配奖励。
body.en:
This original fictional game requires three players to deliver an archive box to an archivist beyond a gate. Established rules: a player must hold the pressure plate to open it; delivery ends the quest and leaves the gate open. Two players must carry the box without putting it down. The reward is one component allocated by the captain to personal inventory or team storage. Captain Su Che holds the plate; two others carry. No new skill appears.

> Su stepped onto the plate. The gate rose. “Carry together. Don’t stop inside. I’ll stay here.”
>
> Xiaoman faced the other side of the box. “Do you get the reward without going in?”
>
> “It checks delivery, not who enters first.” Su pointed at the quest description. “Keep holding.”
>
> Xiaoman and Aqiao lifted together and moved through the doorway. When Aqiao slowed, Xiaoman matched the pace, until they handed the box to the archivist.
>
> “Received.” The completion message appeared. Su left the plate; the gate stayed up. Entering, he saw the reward choice and placed the component in team storage.
>
> Aqiao checked the store. “Call me next time you need someone. Another run tonight?”
>
> Su checked the time. “Exam tomorrow. Need to log off. Friday evening works.”
>
> “Friday, then.” Aqiao added him as a friend without signing him up immediately. Su quit and packed his exam pens.

Plate, joint carrying and delivery conditions all affect actual play; the reward is allocated. Aqiao responds with an invitation, but the next quest remains pending. Team storage is this captain’s choice, not a requirement that every game or team split rewards equally.

heading.zh: 修订规则讲解与属性清单
heading.en: Revise explanation and stat lists

body.zh:
删掉属性框试读：行动仍清楚，就只在关键选择处留下相关数值；不清楚，就补必要规则，而不是贴整套说明书。物品稀有并不自动证明剧情重要，要看它改变谁的选择。

给AI的场景简报：

> 只写这次虚构网游任务。先列当前已定目标、完成与失败条件、队员能力、分工和奖励权限，再按本书文风写连续操作与回应。不临时加技能，不把任务完成等同于关系升级；保留现实下线限制和下一次任务未发生的状态。

真实skill是小说写作流程，不会替你运行游戏或证明操作可行。完成正文后，逐项对照规则与人物知情，再查看队友是否真的采取了所写行动。
body.en:
Remove the stat panel for a reread. If the action stays clear, retain only values affecting key decisions; if unclear, supply the necessary rule rather than a whole manual. Rarity alone does not give an item narrative importance—look for whose choice it changes.

Brief AI like this:

> Write only this fictional online-game quest. List established goal, completion and failure, abilities, roles and reward authority, then develop continuous play and responses in the book’s style. Invent no emergency skill and do not equate quest completion with relationship progress. Preserve logout limits and the unplayed next quest.

The actual skill is a novel-writing workflow; it does not run a game or prove an operation feasible. Check prose against rules and knowledge, then verify that teammates actually perform the described actions.

q.zh: 网游小说一定要加面板吗？
q.en: Does online-game fiction need stat panels?

a.zh: 不一定。数值影响决策时可用；任务、空间和行动能说清的部分，不必全部面板化。
a.en: No. Use values when they affect decisions. Tasks, space and action need not all become panels.

q.zh: 每次任务都要掉稀有装备吗？
q.en: Must every quest award rare equipment?

a.zh: 不用。合作、资格、用途与目标都可以变化。具体奖励按已定规则获得，不能每次靠更稀有道具替代故事。
a.en: No. Cooperation, access, item uses and goals can change. Award items under established rules rather than making rarity replace the story.

text.zh: 用 /story-long-write（Codex 用 $story-long-write）规划或修订这次网游任务，附已定规则、角色条件与下线安排；限定正文范围，实际兑现分工、交付和奖励，不运行游戏或添加救场技能。
text.en: Use /story-long-write, or $story-long-write in Codex, to plan or revise this quest with established rules, character conditions and logout plans. Limit prose scope; show roles, delivery and rewards without running a game or adding rescue skills.

label.zh: 规则、分工与游戏行动结果
让选择与结果在场景里发生
label.en: Develop choices and results in scenes

label.zh: 作者文风、事实与修改范围
label.en: Author style, facts and revision scope

title.zh: AI同时写多本小说怎么防串设定：先分书，再定本次任务
title.en: How to Keep Multiple AI Novel Projects Separate

seo_title.zh: AI写多本小说怎么防串设定｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Keep Multiple AI Novel Projects Separate | ZenStory

description.zh: 为每本书分开正文、设定和进度，切书时确认目录、章号与任务。附两本书切换示例，说明活跃书目不等于会话隔离。
description.en: Separate manuscripts, settings and progress. Follow a two-book switch with explicit paths and scope; an active-book selector is not session isolation.

answer.zh: 每本书保留自己的正文、设定、大纲和追踪。开始或切换任务时，明确书名、书目录、截至章与本次产物，再读取对应材料。不要仅凭聊天窗口标题或“继续”猜书。Oh Story的活跃书目用于默认定位，多会话共享工作区时仍需明确各自操作对象。
answer.en: Keep each book’s manuscript, settings, outline and tracking separate. At task start or switch, name the book, root, story cutoff and requested artifact, then load its materials. Do not infer the book from a chat title or “continue.” Oh Story’s active-book selector helps default discovery; shared-workspace sessions still need explicit targets.

heading.zh: 一份工具包可以用，多本书的事实要分开
heading.en: Share tools while keeping each book’s facts separate

body.zh:
Oh Story按书名目录组织长篇：每本各有`正文/`、`设定/`、`大纲/`与`追踪/`。书名可以自定，关键是实际写入与读取落在同一本书。只讨论或只规划时，不为凑目录创建正文与追踪。

| 分开保存 | 为什么要分开 |
|---|---|
| 正文与大纲 | 同为第八章，也属于不同故事。 |
| 人物、规则与知情 | 另一书的人物经历不能自动成为本书事实。 |
| 本书文风与进度 | 不能借邻近目录补缺失文风或当前状态。 |

安装目录里的skill是方法来源，不是放多本正文的资料夹。也不要把另一书的追踪文件复制来初始化新书；旧书已经发生的承诺、物件和伏笔会一起混进来。已有稿件导入可看[导入与续写](/oh-story/import-and-continue)。
body.en:
Oh Story organises long fiction under a book directory with its own `正文/`, `设定/`, `大纲/` and `追踪/`. Choose your names, but reads and writes must address the same book. Discussion or planning alone does not require generating manuscript and tracking directories.

| Keep separate | Reason |
|---|---|
| Draft and outline | Chapter eight can belong to two different stories. |
| Cast, rules and knowledge | Another book’s experience is not a fact here. |
| Style and progress | A neighbouring folder cannot supply missing book-local style or state. |

Installed skills provide methods rather than manuscript storage. Do not initialise a new book by copying another book’s tracking: its promises, objects and clues would come too. For existing manuscripts, see [import and continuation](/oh-story/import-and-continue).

heading.zh: 切书前核对活跃书目，也核对本次路径
heading.en: Check the selector and the actual task path

body.zh:
部署的定位代码会读取工作区根目录`.active-book`的首行，尝试按声明定位；没有采用声明时会尝试发现书目录。不同宿主对不存在路径的处理有差别，实际目录仍要核对，不能指望错误声明一定自动纠正。多书目录里“发现第一本”不等于作者选中了它，不应靠未设默认值来切书。

例如，工作区根是`我的书库/`，其中已有`灯塔往返/`与`周末修理台/`。选择后者时，根目录`.active-book`首行可写相对目录`周末修理台`；它是目录指示，不是章节号、多个书名清单或权限隔离。具体定位仍要核对当前宿主的部署与真实目录。

并行对话不能一边反复改共享默认值，一边假定各自永远绑定旧书。给每个任务固定书目录与材料；若需要互不影响的默认值，就在各自工作区使用各自选择。切换不是把旧对话里的全部故事事实自动清除。
body.en:
Deployed discovery code reads the first line of workspace-root `.active-book` and tries the declared target, with discovery when no declaration is adopted. Hosts differ in their treatment of nonexistent paths; check the actual directory rather than assuming an incorrect declaration is repaired automatically. Finding the first book is not an author choice; do not rely on an unset default for switching.

For example, `我的书库/` contains existing `灯塔往返/` and `周末修理台/` directories. To select the latter, the root selector can contain the relative directory `周末修理台` on its first line. This indicates a directory, not a chapter, list of books or access isolation. Check the host’s deployment and real path as well.

Parallel sessions cannot keep changing a shared default while assuming each retains its old binding. Fix each task’s root and materials; use separate workspaces when defaults must be independent. A switch does not automatically erase story facts from an earlier conversation.

heading.zh: 完整示例：从灯塔故事切到修理台故事
heading.en: Complete example: switching from lighthouse to repair shop

body.zh:
以下为原创工作区安排，不是已经运行过的写作项目。两本已有稿件：

| 本书 | 当前事实与本次停点 |
|---|---|
| 灯塔往返 | 已写八章；顾岚拿到靠岸许可，船货尚未交付。下一步暂不写。 |
| 周末修理台 | 已写三章；宁月拿到试用房间钥匙，阅读架尚未修好。本次只补第四章细纲。 |

先记录旧任务截至位置，保留旧书文件。核对当前工作区与`周末修理台/`确实存在，把本次对象指向这个目录，再读取它的设定、进度与相关大纲。不能因为旧聊天刚写过“许可已拿到”，就让宁月有港口许可。

给执行者的完整任务可以写：

> 本次只处理`我的书库/周末修理台/`。截至第三章，宁月拿到试用房间钥匙，阅读架还没修。请只补第四章细纲：让她核对房间使用安排，并与物主确认是否换底座。按这本书现有文风和设定规划，保留物主尚未批准换件；本轮不写正文、不改灯塔往返的任何文件。若当前打开的书不是它，先指出目录差异。

交付时核对：产物是这本书第四章细纲，正文仍截至第三章；换件是否获准是本次规划的后续事件，不能提前写进已发生追踪。灯塔书仍是八章与船货未交。这里解决的是操作对象与产物边界，不声称AI绝不会出错。
body.en:
This original workspace arrangement is an illustration, not an executed writing project. Two existing manuscripts have different cutoffs:

| Book | Current fact and scope |
|---|---|
| 灯塔往返 / Lighthouse Journeys | Eight chapters; Gu Lan obtained docking permission, cargo not delivered. No continuation now. |
| 周末修理台 / Weekend Repair Table | Three chapters; Ning Yue received a trial-room key, reading stand unrepaired. Plan chapter four only. |

Record the old task’s cutoff and keep its files. Check that the current workspace contains `周末修理台/`, target that root and load its settings, progress and relevant outline. A recent “permission obtained” in the old chat cannot give Ning a harbour permit.

Use this complete task:

> Work only in `我的书库/周末修理台/`. Through chapter three, Ning Yue has a trial-room key and the stand is unrepaired. Plan only chapter four: check room-use arrangements and ask the owner about replacing the base. Follow this book’s existing style and settings; preserve the owner’s currently ungranted approval. Draft no prose and change no files in Lighthouse Journeys. If the open book differs, identify the path mismatch first.

Check delivery: chapter-four outline belongs to this book, while prose still ends at three. Replacement approval is a planned event, not accomplished tracking. The lighthouse book remains at eight with cargo undelivered. This establishes target and scope without promising that AI cannot make mistakes.

heading.zh: 已经串书时，先找实际改了哪些内容
heading.en: If books were mixed, locate the actual changes

body.zh:
先保存当前差异，找出错误正文、设定或追踪涉及的范围，再对照该书可信前稿和实际章节。不是把文中另一书的姓名全部替换掉就修好：能力、时间、承诺和持物也可能被带入。

正文改回后，按当前书的已发生事件处理追踪与后续影响；Oh Story的追踪有自己的提交流程，不手改派生状态卡来掩盖错误。若另一书也被写入，同样单独核对，不删整本书来“清空上下文”。

切书后的首次任务可以先只读诊断，确认书名、截至章和下一步对象。需要正文时再明确章号与停点。批量章节的组织另见[分批写多章](/oh-story/batch-draft-novel-chapters-with-ai)，这页处理的是多本书之间的边界。
body.en:
Keep the current diff and locate affected prose, settings or tracking, then compare trusted drafts and actual chapters for this book. Replacing another book’s names is insufficient if abilities, time, promises and possessions came with them.

After correcting prose, handle tracking and downstream changes from this book’s actual events. Oh Story has a tracking commit workflow; do not edit a derived state card to hide contamination. Check the other book separately if it also changed rather than deleting a manuscript to clear context.

A first task after switching can be a read-only diagnosis of name, cutoff and next artifact. Request chapter and stopping point explicitly before drafting. See [batch chapter writing](/oh-story/batch-draft-novel-chapters-with-ai) for a different task: this page addresses boundaries between books.

q.zh: 开两个聊天窗口就能保证不串书吗？
q.en: Do two chat windows guarantee separation?

a.zh: 不能。还要看两边实际读取和写入的目录，以及是否共用默认书目。任务里固定书名、目录、截至位置和本次产物。
a.en: No. Check actual read/write directories and whether they share a selector. Fix name, root, cutoff and artifact in each task.

q.zh: 每本书都要重装skill吗？
q.en: Must every book reinstall the skills?

a.zh: 不必把故事内容放进skill目录。按所用工具的安装与项目部署组织方法，各书分开材料；换书仍核对真实路径。
a.en: Do not put manuscripts inside skill directories. Follow the tool’s installation and project deployment while keeping book materials separate and checking real paths at each switch.

text.zh: 用 /story-long-write（Codex 用 $story-long-write）只处理指定书与指定产物，给完整书目录、截至位置和材料。先核对操作对象；需要正文时另明确章号与停点，不因已有稿自动续写旧书。
text.en: Use /story-long-write, or $story-long-write in Codex, only for the named book and artifact with its root, cutoff and materials. Check the target first; specify chapter and stopping point for prose instead of automatically continuing the previous book.

label.zh: 各书项目文件与追踪组织
活跃书目与默认发现的实际实现
当前宿主的书目录定位
label.en: Book-root discovery in the host adapter

label.zh: 本书文风与事实边界

title.zh: 手机游戏文字太小怎么办：字号、换行与当前选择一起查
title.en: How to Fix Text That Is Too Small in a Mobile Game

seo_title.zh: 手机游戏文字太小怎么办｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Fix Small Text in a Mobile Game | ZenStory

description.zh: 检查真实游戏视口里的字体、字号、行距与遮挡，别靠缩字塞满屏幕。附借书场景的阅读调整与状态不变示例。
description.en: Check fonts, size, spacing and occlusion in the real game viewport. Follow a library scene redesign without changing choices or story state.

answer.zh: 先在实际手机视口读正文、选项和结果，区分字太小、字体缺字、对比不足与内容挤压。调整字号和换行时，保留当前决策需要的条件，不靠删规则或缩小所有文字凑同屏。文字设定改变显示，不应代选行动、重置状态或改变既定计时规则。
answer.en: Read prose, choices and feedback in the actual mobile viewport. Distinguish small type, missing glyphs, poor contrast and crowding. Adjust size and wrapping while preserving decision conditions; do not remove rules or shrink everything to force a fit. Display settings must not choose actions, reset history or change established timing rules.

heading.zh: 先确认哪一层看不清
heading.en: Identify the reading problem first

body.zh:
| 看到的现象 | 先查什么 |
|---|---|
| 字完整但很费力 | 实际字号、行距、阅读距离与目标视口。 |
| 汉字变方框或缺笔 | 目标语言字体覆盖与实际加载结果。 |
| 字够大但融进背景 | 字与承载面的对比、底图和遮挡。 |
| 放大后按钮被挤走 | 面板排版、长选项换行与信息安排。 |

游戏美术方法把字体覆盖、阅读顺序与行宽列入方向，验收面对实际交互画面。不要只拿概念海报的大标题判断游戏文字可读，也不要把[按钮点按区域](/novel-to-game/fix-small-game-buttons-on-mobile)当成字已经清楚。

同一字号在不同字体、设备和用户习惯下效果不同。具体取值是原型候选，需实际阅读与操作，不是一个数字适合所有玩家。
body.en:
| Symptom | Check first |
|---|---|
| Complete but hard to read | Actual size, spacing, viewing distance and viewport. |
| Boxes or missing strokes | Target-language font coverage and actual loading. |
| Large but lost in the background | Text surface, contrast, background and occlusion. |
| Enlargement pushes choices away | Panel layout, long-option wrapping and information order. |

The art method includes font coverage, reading order and line width, judging actual interaction screens. A concept poster’s large heading does not establish readable game prose, and a [large hit area](/novel-to-game/fix-small-game-buttons-on-mobile) does not prove legible text.

One size looks different across fonts, devices and reading habits. Values are prototype candidates to try through reading and operation, not a universal solution.

heading.zh: 放大文字时，不删掉选择依据
heading.en: Enlarge text without removing decision evidence

body.zh:
先分正文、当前条件、选项与反馈，确认谁在何时需要读什么。已经重复的解释可以压缩，当前独有的限制必须保留。长档案可在玩家主动打开的页面阅读；必要选项不能藏到无提示的屏外。

不要固定文本框高度再把字号压回去。若一屏承担多拍信息，调整排版或按语义拆开，保留就近复看和回到当前选择的入口。信息层级详见[界面内容太多](/novel-to-game/organize-a-story-game-interface)；这里重点是文字的实际阅读与显示调整。

文字偏好属于表现设置，不能借此提交等待、归还等剧情行动或重播已完成事件，也不向角色补未知内容。若游戏本来按实时计时，设置期间暂停还是继续按既定规则，不因文字修订偷偷改变它。本例设置不推进时钟，后面的路径按这个已定条件检查。
body.en:
Separate prose, current conditions, choices and feedback, asking who needs to read what and when. Condense repeated explanation while retaining unique current limits. An explicitly opened archive can contain longer reading; essential choices cannot disappear offscreen without guidance.

Do not keep a rigid box then shrink type again to fit it. If one screen carries several beats, change layout or split semantically while providing nearby review and return to the current choice. See [interface overload](/novel-to-game/organize-a-story-game-interface) for hierarchy; this page focuses on reading and display adjustments.

A text preference is presentation, not a submission of waiting or returning an item, a replay of completed events or a disclosure to characters. For an existing real-time clock, follow its established pause-or-continue rule rather than changing it during a text revision. The route below uses this example’s explicit no-time-advance setting rule.

heading.zh: 完整示例：看清借还记录，不自动把书归还
heading.en: Complete example: reading a loan record without returning the book

body.zh:
原创图书室游戏中，玩家在14:00整理柜子。红封册在柜里；蓝封册被唐禾借走，她答应十分钟后回来，但尚未归还。玩家可以先查借还记录，或选择等待。本例“阅读设置”和“查看记录”不推进时钟；等待才按已定规则进入后续事件。

当前手机稿把关键条件排成很小的密字，玩家容易把“蓝封册已借走”读漏。为本例尝试390×844视口、正文18px与1.6行高；这些只是作者候选值，不是skill默认值或已经通过测试的游戏。

> **当前说明**：红封册在柜里。蓝封册唐禾已借走；她答应十分钟后回来，现在尚未归还。  
> **选择**：查看借还记录；等待唐禾回来。  
> **按需入口**：阅读设置；已读历史。

把选项与当前说明放在明确的阅读区，长选项允许完整换行；完整历史放另页。然后按这条纸面路径检查：

| 步骤 | 应有结果 |
|---|---|
| 打开阅读设置并调大 | 返回仍是14:00；蓝封册仍由唐禾借出，没有自动等待或归还。 |
| 查看借还记录 | 展示本次已定借出条目，玩家实际看见；不触发唐禾回来。 |
| 返回当前选择 | 说明与两项选择仍可读，未替玩家提交“等待”。 |

接入真实界面后，在目标视口用实际字体读这条路径，检查字号变大时说明、选项与必要反馈是否仍可用；窄一些的支持视口与较长译文也要按实际范围核对。本文没有构建这个游戏，文章本身的手机排版不能证明示例游戏已经合格。
body.en:
In an original library game, the player sorts a cupboard at 14:00. The red volume is inside; Tang He borrowed the blue one and promised to return in ten minutes, but has not returned it. The player can check the loan record or wait. This example’s reading settings and record inspection do not advance time; waiting enters later events under established rules.

The phone draft packs conditions into tiny text, making “blue volume borrowed” easy to miss. Try a 390×844 viewport, 18px body text and 1.6 line height for this example. These are author candidates, not native defaults or a tested game.

> **Current prose:** The red volume is in the cupboard. Tang He has the blue one; she promised to return in ten minutes and has not returned it yet.  
> **Choices:** Check the loan record; wait for Tang He.  
> **On demand:** Reading settings; read history.

Give prose and choices a clear reading area, wrap long choices completely and place full history on another page. Check this paper route:

| Step | Expected result |
|---|---|
| Enlarge text in settings | Return at 14:00 with the blue volume still borrowed, without automatic waiting or return. |
| Inspect loan record | Show the established loan entry for the player to read without triggering Tang’s arrival. |
| Return to choices | Prose and both choices remain readable; waiting has not been submitted. |

After implementation, use actual fonts in the target viewport to read the route and check prose, choices and required feedback at the larger size. Check narrower supported views and longer translations within the project’s actual scope.
