This page does not build the game; the article’s mobile layout cannot prove that the example interface passes.

heading.zh: 把阅读修改交给构建，再走一次原路径
heading.en: Implement the reading change and replay the route

body.zh:
给执行者的简报：

> 只改正文、选项与反馈的阅读呈现。保留原文字事实、选项意义、时间规则、持物和当前状态。核目标视口的字体覆盖、字号、行距、换行与遮挡；调大文字后返回当前选择，不能提交行动或重置游戏。先重放原来读不清的路径，再看一条较长文字的相邻路径。报告实际检查视口与剩余问题，不用截图中的大标题代替正文阅读。

`game-art-direction`确定显示方向，`game-build`落实界面，`game-qa`按实际运行证据核对。这里没有要求重做整个游戏，也不靠增加大量日志证明可读。可读性涉及实际体验，自动检查没有报溢出不等于每个玩家都读得轻松。
body.en:
Brief the implementer:

> Change only reading presentation for prose, choices and feedback. Preserve textual facts, option meanings, time rules, possessions and current state. Check target fonts, size, spacing, wrapping and occlusion. Enlargement must return to the current choice without submitting an action or resetting the game. Replay the unreadable route, then an adjacent route with longer text. Report actual tested viewports and remaining issues; a large screenshot heading is not a prose-reading check.

`game-art-direction` sets presentation, `game-build` implements it and `game-qa` checks the actual runtime. This does not require rebuilding the game or extensive new logging. Readability includes experience; no automated overflow error does not mean effortless reading for every player.

q.zh: 把所有文字放大一倍就够了吗？
q.en: Is doubling every text size enough?

a.zh: 还要看字体、行距、对比、换行和选项是否被挤走。按实际视口读与点，不仅检查字号属性。
a.en: Check fonts, spacing, contrast, wrapping and displaced choices as well. Read and operate in the viewport rather than checking a size property alone.

q.zh: 可以删掉长条件让界面清爽吗？
q.en: Can I remove long conditions to clean the screen?

a.zh: 不能删当前判断必须知道的条件。先去重复、安排就近查看或拆节拍；改变规则属于另一个任务。
a.en: Keep conditions required for the decision. Remove repetition, provide nearby inspection or split beats; changing rules is a separate task.

text.zh: 用 $game-art-direction 只修订这部分阅读方向，附当前实际界面、目标视口与已定规则；给构建落实后，由真实运行阅读与操作确认，不把字号候选当成验收结果。
text.en: Use $game-art-direction to revise this reading direction with the current screen, target viewport and established rules. Implement it and verify actual reading and operation; a size candidate is not a passed result.

label.zh: 字体覆盖、行宽与阅读边界
label.en: Fonts, line width and reading boundaries

label.zh: 表现继承方向，状态独立提交
label.en: Implement presentation without independent state changes

label.zh: 目标视口、实际溢出与原路径复查
label.en: Target viewport, actual overflow and route replay

title.zh: 视频音效怎么加：把声音放到真正发生的那一刻
title.en: How to Add Sound Effects at the Right Moment in a Video

seo_title.zh: 视频音效怎么加｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Add Sound Effects at the Right Moment | ZenStory

description.zh: 先定位动作与原声，再把音效放到剪后局部时间。附敲门声的完整落点计算、剪辑单写法与原生混音边界。
description.en: Locate action and original audio, then place the cue in cut-local time. Follow a door-knock example with cue arithmetic and actual mixing boundaries.

answer.zh: 先确认画面事件和原声是否已有可用声音，再选音效、核文件发声起点与余音，把落点写到剪后片段的局部时间。实际混入后回看动作、回听对白和片尾；写下“加音效”不等于已经执行，整片响度也不能代替相对清晰度检查。
answer.en: Locate the event and any usable original sound first. Choose an effect, check its audible onset and tail, and cue it in cut-local time. After mixing, review action, dialogue and ending; an instruction is not execution, and overall loudness does not establish relative clarity.

heading.zh: 先判断需要哪一个声音
heading.en: Choose the sound’s job before adding it

body.zh:
一次敲门、钥匙落桌或提示音，可能交代动作完成、画外存在或状态变化。先看已定剧情要观众听到什么，再选声音；不为每个动作加通用冲击音。

原片已经有清楚的敲门声，就先听原声版本。重复叠同一个声音容易产生双响或错误距离感。需要补时，核音效的实际开头、长短与空间感，不能只看文件名。

[场景声音设计](/drama-skills/scene-sound-and-silence)解决注意与剧情作用；本文处理选定音效怎样在剪后真正落地。配乐、环境底声和对白仍各有职责。
body.en:
A knock, key on a table or chime can mark completion, offscreen presence or a state change. Decide what viewers need to hear before selecting the sound instead of adding a generic impact to every action.

If the source has a clear knock, listen to that version first. Duplicating it can create a double hit or incorrect distance. When adding one, inspect audible onset, duration and space rather than trusting the filename.

[Scene sound design](/drama-skills/scene-sound-and-silence) addresses attention and story purpose; this page implements a chosen cue in the edit. Music, ambience and dialogue retain their own roles.

heading.zh: 分开原片时间、片段时间和成片时间
heading.en: Separate source, cut-local and output time

body.zh:
| 要核对 | 意义 |
|---|---|
| 原片事件位置 | 动作在素材里什么时候发生。 |
| 本CUT入点 | 原片哪些时间已被剪掉。 |
| CUT局部落点 | 事件相对保留片段开头的时间。 |
| 前段实际时长 | 用已渲染片段累加成片位置，不只照计划长度。 |

`short-drama-edit`的`音效`行按本CUT的局部起止时间混入。实现会从音效文件开头取指定时长，再放到成片位置；这个字段不是音效源文件的入出点。文件开头若有静默，应先在外部修好音效源或调整方案，别凭空发明第三个偏移字段。

声音尾巴也需要空间。长混响被过短区间截掉，即使攻击点对齐，听感仍可能不合意。选择合适文件或准备适当版本，再更新真实路径和时间。
body.en:
| Check | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Source event | Where the action occurs in the source. |
| Cut in-point | Which source time was removed. |
| Local cue | Event time relative to the retained segment’s start. |
| Actual prior spans | Sum rendered segments rather than planned lengths alone. |

`short-drama-edit` mixes an `音效` cue at cut-local start/end times. Its implementation takes the specified duration from the sound file’s beginning before placing it in the film. The field is not an in/out range within the effect file. Prepare a source with suitable onset externally or revise the plan if it begins with silence; do not invent an extra offset field.

A tail needs room too. An over-short window can truncate reverberation despite correct onset. Choose or prepare an appropriate file, then update its real path and timing.

heading.zh: 完整示例：原片3.20秒的敲门声怎样放进成片
heading.en: Complete example: placing a knock at source time 3.20

body.zh:
以下为原创纸面剪辑练习，没有生产声音文件或实际混音。九秒场景中，来客敲修理室门，里面的人回答“来了，把架子放门边”。前一CUT渲染后实际3.00秒；本CUT用原片2.00—8.00秒，时长6.00秒。敲门接触在原片3.20秒，本CUT局部1.20秒，成片4.20秒；对白从本CUT局部2.00秒开始。

假定原声缺少可辨的敲门，已选单次敲门文件从零秒立即发声，所需声尾在0.60秒内结束。剪辑单片段可写：

> `## CUT-EP001-002 · 来客敲门`  
> `- 来源：MOTION-EP001-002 · 制作成果/videos/SHOT-EP001-002.mp4`  
> `- 入点：2.00`  
> `- 出点：8.00`  
> `- 时长：6.00`  
> `- 取舍：保留敲门接触、完整对白与末尾反应`  
> `- 声音：保留原声与完整对白，补一次敲门；回听不盖字。`  
> `- 音效：1.20-1.80 制作成果/音效/单次敲门.wav（增益：-8）`  
> `- 字幕：无`

这是格式与时间示例；正式使用须换成真实存在、已看听过的素材。-8dB只是本例待试听的增益，不是所有敲门声的推荐值。`声音`行交代意图，内置工具实际解析的是`音效`行；仅写意图不会让它自动补声音。

混入后沿这条路径核对：来客手指在成片4.20秒接触门面，敲门攻击点在同处；音效没有开头静默或第二次敲击，尾声不盖局部2.00秒开始的对白；全句与最后反应保留。若剪掉本CUT开头0.40秒，原入点变2.40秒，事件局部应重算为0.80秒，不能继续复制1.20。

实际帧边界可能影响段长，用真实渲染时长重新累加，再回听成片。纸面算式对，不证明音效内容、峰值或声画已经合格。
body.en:
This original paper edit produces no sound file or actual mix. In a nine-second scene, a visitor knocks and someone inside answers, “Coming. Leave the stand by the door.” The preceding rendered cut lasts exactly 3.00 seconds in this example. This cut retains source 2.00–8.00 for 6.00 seconds. Contact at source 3.20 becomes local 1.20 and output 4.20; dialogue begins at local 2.00.

Assume no distinct original knock and a selected single-hit file sounding immediately at zero, with its required tail ending within 0.60 seconds. Write this cut-list excerpt:

> `## CUT-EP001-002 · Visitor knocks`  
> `- 来源：MOTION-EP001-002 · 制作成果/videos/SHOT-EP001-002.mp4`  
> `- 入点：2.00`  
> `- 出点：8.00`  
> `- 时长：6.00`  
> `- 取舍：保留敲门接触、完整对白与末尾反应`  
> `- 声音：保留原声与完整对白，补一次敲门；回听不盖字。`  
> `- 音效：1.20-1.80 制作成果/音效/单次敲门.wav（增益：-8）`  
> `- 字幕：无`

Native field labels stay Chinese for the parser: source, in, out, duration, sound plan and sound-effect cue. Replace illustrative paths with real inspected media. The -8dB gain is an audition candidate, not a universal knock setting. The `声音` line describes intent; the tool parses `音效` for this operation. Intent alone does not add sound.

After mixing, follow the route: hand contact at output 4.20 matches the attack; no leading silence or second knock appears; the tail does not mask dialogue beginning at local 2.00; the whole sentence and final reaction remain. Removing another 0.40 seconds from this cut changes the source in-point to 2.40 and event-local time to 0.80. Do not retain the old 1.20 cue.

Frame boundaries can affect spans, so accumulate actual rendered durations and listen to the result. Correct paper arithmetic does not prove sound content, peaks or synchronisation.

heading.zh: 检查真正的混音结果，不只看render成功
heading.en: Inspect the mix rather than the render exit code alone

body.zh:
所引实现把音效混进成片原声，音效可写增益；它不因加了多个输入自动把原声除小，也不自动执行`声音`行的对白压低、静音或交叉淡入方案。需要这些处理时用外部工具实际完成，保存项目或处理记录，再验收输出。

内置对音效截尾有很短的淡出，不能替你判断长余音是否完整；声音叠加后仍可能过响或遮盖对白。整片响度是在音效混入后处理，也还要测输出并回听各声部。

给执行者的任务：

> 只补这一处敲门音效，保留已定镜序、动作结果、完整对白与其他声音。核当前素材接触时刻、CUT入出点和音效实际起声；更新音效行并实际混入。回听全句、接缝与片尾，记录输出和仍需处理的问题。若原声已够用，不叠第二个敲门。不要把声音说明当执行结果。

更多声画错位排查见[剪后音画同步](/video-recap/fix-audio-video-sync-after-editing)。
body.en:
The cited implementation mixes effects into the film’s original audio with optional effect gain. Adding inputs does not automatically divide the original audio level, and the `声音` plan does not execute dialogue ducking, muting or crossfades. Perform those externally when needed, keeping a project or processing record before checking output.

The tool’s short tail fade does not judge whether long decay survived; summing sounds can still become too loud or mask dialogue. Overall loudness processing follows effect mixing, with output measurement and listening still needed.

Brief the operator:

> Add only this knock, preserving shot order, action outcomes, whole dialogue and other audio. Check current contact time, cut in/out and the file’s audible onset; update the effect cue and actually mix it. Listen through the sentence, joins and ending, recording output and remaining issues. If original audio suffices, add no duplicate. A sound plan is not a result.

For broader timing faults, see [sync after editing](/video-recap/fix-audio-video-sync-after-editing).

q.zh: 为什么落点写对了还是晚响？
q.en: Why can a correct cue still sound late?

a.zh: 先听音效文件开头有没有静默，再核使用的是CUT局部时间还是原片时间，并用实际渲染段长检查成片位置。
a.en: Check silence at the file start, whether the cue uses cut-local rather than source time, and actual rendered spans for output position.

q.zh: 音效一加上就可以交付吗？
q.en: Is adding the effect enough to deliver?

a.zh: 还要看攻击点、余音、对白与叠加峰值。内置混入不自动执行全部声音方案，最终以实际成片回听和测量为准。
a.en: Check attack, tail, dialogue and summed peaks. Native mixing does not execute every sound-plan instruction; listen to and measure the final file.

text.zh: 用 $short-drama-edit 只补本CUT的指定音效，提供真实素材、剪辑单、已选音效与触发时刻；更新局部时间并实际渲染回听，保完整对白，额外混音另行执行记录。
text.en: Use $short-drama-edit for this cut’s specified effect with real media, cut list, chosen sound and trigger time. Update local cues, actually render and listen, preserving dialogue and recording any additional external mixing.

label.zh: 声音方案与内置混音的边界
label.en: Sound plans and native mixing boundaries

label.zh: 音效解析、时间放置与实际混入
label.en: Cue parsing, placement and actual mixing

label.zh: 真实字段的剪辑单格式样例

title.zh: AI写小说文风不一致怎么办：按本书要求逐项调整
title.en: How to Fix Inconsistent Prose Style in an AI Novel

seo_title.zh: AI写小说文风不一致怎么改｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Fix Inconsistent AI Novel Prose Style | ZenStory

description.zh: 把句长、视角、对白和情绪表达分开检查，用本书文风覆盖默认写法。附雨夜借伞改写，保留原事实与知情范围。
description.en: Resolve rhythm, viewpoint, dialogue and emotion separately. A rainy-night revision preserves story facts and knowledge while restoring the book’s voice.

answer.zh: 先找出不一致发生在哪个表达维度，再把当前要求与本书文风交给写作、润色和审稿环节。不要只说“像前面”，也不要为了统一句长改掉剧情。Oh Story按维度处理文风优先级，未声明的部分才采用参考方法的默认值。
answer.en: Identify the expression dimension that changed, then give drafting, polishing and review the current request and this book’s style. “Make it like before” is too vague. Do not alter plot to equalise sentences. Oh Story resolves style by dimension and uses reference defaults only where no applicable preference is declared.

heading.zh: 先说明哪里变了，而不是给整本书换标签
heading.en: Name the change before replacing the whole voice

body.zh:
同一本书突然从轻快对白变成长段旁白，问题可能在叙述者评论；从人物所见跳到反派心思，问题也可能是信息边界。先拿相邻章节各一小段比较，指出实际句子，不用“高级”“有质感”代替要求。

| 要检查的部分 | 可以说明的要求 |
|---|---|
| 句长与节奏 | 保留连贯中句，关键处短停顿；不把每句拆成一行。 |
| 视角 | 跟随本章人物所见所想，不替他知道旁人的秘密。 |
| 白话与对白 | 叙述平实，人物按各自习惯说话。 |
| 情绪与评论 | 可直写本视角的感受；不替每个动作补人生结论。 |

这些是本文示例里的作者选择，不是所有小说必须执行的风格。统一文风也不等于所有人物用同一口气，或打斗与闲聊具有相同节奏。
body.en:
A shift from brisk dialogue to long commentary may concern narrator presence. A jump from the viewpoint character’s observations into an antagonist’s thoughts may also violate information boundaries. Compare a short passage from each neighbouring chapter and name actual sentences instead of asking for “sophistication.”

| Dimension | An actionable request |
|---|---|
| Sentence rhythm | Keep connected medium-length sentences with short pauses at key moments, rather than one line per sentence. |
| Viewpoint | Follow what this chapter’s character sees and thinks without giving them another person’s secret. |
| Narration and dialogue | Use plain narration while preserving each speaker’s habits. |
| Emotion and commentary | Direct feeling is allowed within the viewpoint; do not attach a life lesson to every gesture. |

These are this example’s author choices, not universal rules. A coherent book does not require identical character voices or identical rhythms for a fight and a quiet conversation.

heading.zh: 本次要求、本书文风与默认方法怎么取舍
heading.en: Resolve current requests, book style and defaults

body.zh:
Oh Story的表达顺序是：当前请求、本书文风与设定、本书有效作者偏好，再到题材/流程/全局偏好、主对标文风和通用方法。每个维度取第一个明确且适用的要求，不把整份默认文件叠成一张禁令表。

长篇读取本书`设定/文风.md`全文；简短但可执行的一句也有效。不用另一书的文件补缺，也不把旧摘要当作全文。临时要求只用于这次任务，不自动写成长期偏好。

文风可以改变表达，不能改章节事件、知情范围、字数要求和修改范围。例如“本章写得幽默些”不能让人物提前发现真相。“转限知”可以暂不叙述他无从知道的事实，不能新增“他早就知道”来保住原句。
body.en:
Oh Story applies expression preferences in this order: the current request, book-local style and settings, active book-local author preferences, genre/workflow/global preferences, the main benchmark’s style, then general references. Each dimension takes the first explicit applicable instruction; defaults do not combine into a universal prohibition list.

For long fiction, read this book’s full `设定/文风.md`. One executable sentence can be enough. Do not fill gaps from another book or substitute an old summary for the full current text. A temporary request applies to this task and does not automatically become a lasting preference.

Style may change expression without changing events, knowledge, word-count requirements or revision scope. “Make this chapter funnier” cannot make someone discover a secret early. Limited viewpoint can withhold facts the character cannot know; it cannot invent “he already knew” to preserve an unsuitable sentence.

heading.zh: 完整示例：借伞仍然只是借伞
heading.en: Complete example: a borrowed umbrella remains a borrowed umbrella

body.zh:
原创设定：许宁在小店借梁川的伞，答应次日上午还；她不知道他第二天要搬走。本书采用许宁限知、平实中句，允许她直接表达担心。待改片段却写：“命运已替两人安排别离。梁川凝望她的背影，藏起迁居的秘密。”

问题不只是抒情太重：旁白替本章说出了未知的未来，还进入梁川的内心。可以改成：

> 许宁把伞撑开，伞骨卡了一下。梁川伸手扶正，等她握稳才松开。
>
> “明早还你。”她说。
>
> “放柜台就行。”
>
> 她回头看了一眼亮着灯的小店。雨越下越急，她担心明早赶不上开门，又问：“九点前有人吗？”
>
> “有人。”
>
> 她点点头，沿着屋檐走到街角。伞还在她手里，归还要等明天。

本例新增“九点前有人”的对话作为作者已经选定的局部改写方案，不把它当成原稿本来发生过的事；正式用到现有小说时，先确认是否允许补这句及其后文影响。梁川搬家的事实仍在作者设定中，只是本章不揭露；他回答有人，也不证明他本人会在店里。

交给AI的任务可以写：“只调整本章借伞段落，采用本书文风全文；保留借出、次日上午归还约定和许宁尚不知搬家。此次允许补她问开门时间的交流，不写第二天归还，不改其他章节，不更新长期文风。”
body.en:
Original setup: Xu Ning borrows Liang Chuan’s umbrella at a small shop and promises to return it the next morning. She does not know he moves away tomorrow. This book uses her limited viewpoint, plain connected sentences and direct worry. A faulty passage says, “Fate had arranged their separation. Liang watched her leave and concealed his move.”

The problem is more than heavy lyricism: commentary reveals an unknown future and enters Liang’s mind. A candidate revision is:

> Xu opened the umbrella; one rib caught. Liang straightened it and let go once she had a firm grip.
>
> “I’ll return it tomorrow morning,” she said.
>
> “Leave it on the counter.”
>
> She glanced back at the lit shop. Rain was getting harder. Worried she would miss opening time, she asked, “Will someone be here before nine?”
>
> “Yes.”
>
> She nodded and followed the awning to the corner. The umbrella remained with her; returning it belonged to tomorrow.

The opening-time exchange is an explicitly chosen new local revision in this example, not a claim that it existed in an earlier manuscript. When applying it to a book, approve the added exchange and check its later implications. Liang’s move remains an author-level fact withheld from this chapter. “Someone” does not establish that he personally will be there.

A task can say: “Revise only this chapter’s umbrella passage using the full book-local style. Preserve the loan, the next-morning return arrangement and Xu’s lack of knowledge about the move. This revision may add her opening-time question, but must not write the return, change other chapters or update lasting preferences.”

heading.zh: 改完要复核事实，也把文风带到下一环节
heading.en: Review facts and carry the same style into polishing

body.zh:
将本次生效要求与来源交给后续润色和审稿，不让下一环节又套回另一份默认文风。核对原稿和改稿：借伞是否发生、归还是否仍未发生、谁知道搬家、补写是否得到允许。

作者明确选定某种停顿或修辞，不代表所有同类句子都好；仍要查重复、冗余和越界。检测器报警也不自动等于必须删。需要保留已获准的原句时，按本书白名单规则登记具体句子与用途，不用“没有”等泛词关闭整类检查。

若只是一个段落出了问题，先修那个段落。没有必要把整本书统一改成短句，更不必把裁决说明插进小说正文。
body.en:
Pass the effective requirements and their sources to subsequent polishing and review so another default does not overwrite them. Compare draft and revision: did the loan happen, is return still pending, who knows about the move, and was added dialogue allowed?

An approved pause or metaphor does not make every similar sentence good. Check repetition, redundancy and information leaks. A detector finding does not automatically require deletion. When retaining an authorised original line, use the book-local whitelist rules for that specific phrase and purpose rather than exempting broad words to disable whole checks.

If only one passage drifted, repair that passage first. The entire novel need not become short sentences, and style-resolution commentary belongs outside the story prose.

q.zh: 每一章都要用同样句长吗？
q.en: Must every chapter use the same sentence lengths?

a.zh: 不用。根据行动、对话与安静段落调整节奏，保留作者选定的叙述声音和信息边界。
a.en: No. Vary rhythm for action, conversation and quiet passages while preserving the author’s chosen voice and information boundaries.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 检查指定段落的文风漂移，附本书文风全文、当前要求与原段。列出变化维度，保留已发生事实与知情范围，只改授权范围；把同一文风要求交给后续润色和审稿。
text.en: Use $story-long-write with the named passage, full book style and current request. Identify changed dimensions, preserve events and knowledge, and revise only the authorised scope. Carry the same style requirements into polishing and review.

label.zh: 按维度裁决、事实边界与本书白名单
label.en: Dimension-level style resolution, fact boundaries and book-local exemptions

label.zh: 本书材料与产物目录

title.zh: 游戏静音和音量设置怎么做：声音关了，关键信息仍要看得见
title.en: How to Design Mute and Volume Settings for a Story Game

seo_title.zh: 游戏静音和音量设置怎么做｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Story Game Mute and Volume Settings | ZenStory

description.zh: 区分音乐、语音与提示音，静音后保留规则、选择和结果。附闭馆提醒完整路线，核设置、恢复与重开行为。
description.en: Separate music, speech and cues while retaining rules, choices and results when muted. A museum-closing route checks settings, resuming and restart behaviour.

answer.zh: 先明确哪些声音可调、静音后用什么文字或视觉反馈表达关键信息，再实现设置。音量变化只改变播放表现，不替玩家提交动作。用真实候选走一条静音到结果再重开的路线，检查资源失败时也能继续。
answer.en: Specify adjustable sound layers and the text or visual feedback that carries essential information when muted, then implement settings. Volume changes affect playback rather than submitting player actions. In the actual candidate, follow a muted route through a result and restart, including a missing-resource fallback.

heading.zh: 先定声音职责，再决定要几个控件
heading.en: Assign sound roles before choosing controls

body.zh:
游戏美术方向的方法要求说明声音来源、动作反馈层级，以及静音时用什么视觉通道补足；语音不能成为规则、目标、选择或结果的唯一载体。不是每款小型游戏都需要三个滑块，按已经采用的声音与玩家需要设计。

| 声音层 | 可以确认的行为 |
|---|---|
| 背景音乐 | 调低或关闭后，场景和选择仍可读。 |
| 角色语音 | 台词对应同一份文字；没声音时不丢掉说话者与信息。 |
| 操作与警告音 | 用已提交结果的文字、图形或状态变化补足。 |

总静音是否记住上次音量、设置是否跨重开保留、重新打开声音是否从当前位置继续，都应由项目决定。本文的设置清单是对这些方法的编辑应用，不是skill自带的一套通用音量组件。
body.en:
The art-direction method specifies sound sources, feedback layers and visual channels that remain when muted. Voice cannot be the only carrier of rules, goals, choices or outcomes. A small game does not automatically need three sliders; choose controls for its adopted sound layers and player needs.

| Layer | Behaviour to decide |
|---|---|
| Background music | Reducing or disabling it leaves the scene and choices understandable. |
| Character speech | Matching text preserves the speaker and information without sound. |
| Input and warning cues | Text, graphics or state changes communicate the actual committed result. |

The project decides whether mute remembers the previous volume, preferences survive restart, and unmuting resumes at the current position. This settings worksheet applies native methods editorially; it is not a universal volume widget supplied by the skill.

heading.zh: 调音量不等于执行剧情，字幕也要跟实际事件走
heading.en: Changing volume is not a story action

body.zh:
构建阶段继承已批准设计，规则与事件由游戏状态提交，表现层负责让玩家听见或看见。拖动音量不应该开门、领取道具、重播一个已结算警告或自动选“离开”。

设置打开时游戏是否计时，按已有设计执行；实时游戏与回合式文游可以不同。也别为了静音才偷偷新增暂停能力。语音台词变化后，旧资产应重新核对；缺音或自动播放受限时，按已约定的文字fallback继续，不把“没有声音”误报成玩家没有收到剧情事件。

静音反馈只补已有信息：声音原本是模糊方向提示，文字也不应直接公布隐藏答案。关键是等价表达，而不是奖励玩家关声音来获得额外线索。
body.en:
Build inherits the approved design: game rules commit events while presentation makes them audible or visible. Dragging volume should not open a door, grant an item, repeat a settled warning or automatically choose “leave.”

Whether time advances while settings are open follows existing design; real-time and turn-based games may differ. Muting must not secretly introduce pausing. When dialogue changes, check the old voice asset. Missing audio or autoplay restrictions use the agreed text fallback rather than treating silence as proof that no story event occurred.

A visual fallback preserves existing information. If sound gives an indistinct direction, text must not reveal the hidden answer outright. Offer equivalent communication rather than extra clues for turning sound off.

heading.zh: 完整示例：听不到闭馆提醒，也能走出东厅
heading.en: Complete example: leaving the east gallery without hearing the warning

body.zh:
原创纸面游戏：当前20:59，21:00博物馆东厅关闭，值班员说“东厅关闭，请走南廊”。玩家还在东厅，尚未选择离开。规则已经规定设置期间不推进时间；总静音控制全部声音，跨重开保留个人设置。关闭事件显示同一句提醒与南廊出口指示，不代玩家走路。

| 实际路线 | 预期变化 |
|---|---|
| 在21:00提醒前打开设置，开启静音 | 只改变声音偏好，位置仍在东厅。 |
| 返回游戏，按原计时到21:00时发生提醒 | 没有声音，文字显示说话者与原句；出口指示出现一次。 |
| 玩家选择“从南廊离开” | 按原规则到南廊，离厅结果可见，不需要语音才能完成。 |
| 重新开始 | 剧情回初态，静音偏好按本例约定保留；旧闭馆事件不立即重现。 |

再做有区分力的检查：恢复声音不得把玩家送回东厅，也不得把刚才台词当新剧情重复提交；模拟本条音频缺失时，显示约定文字仍能完成相同离厅路线。提醒若未发生，不能为了展示设置页面先把未来台词写进历史。

上表不是已经运行的游戏证据。正式实现后，在目标运行时检查控件真的能改变播放、静音时关键信息可读，以及设置、返回、离厅和重开状态正确；实际计时与偏好保存可以选择其他规则，但应一致。
body.en:
Original paper game: the current time is 20:59 and the museum’s east gallery closes at 21:00. An attendant says, “The east gallery is closing. Use the south corridor.” The player remains inside and has not chosen to leave. This design explicitly stops time in settings, uses master mute for all sound and preserves that preference across restart. The closing event displays the same line and a south-corridor exit cue without moving the player.

| Route | Expected change |
|---|---|
| Open settings before the 21:00 warning and mute | Only the audio preference changes; the player remains in the gallery. |
| Resume; let the existing game clock reach 21:00 and trigger its warning | No sound plays. Text identifies the attendant and preserves the line; the exit cue appears once. |
| Choose “Leave through the south corridor” | The original rule moves the player into the corridor and displays the departure result without requiring voice. |
| Restart | Story state resets and this example’s mute preference remains; the old closing event does not immediately recur. |

Check a meaningful countercase: unmuting must neither return the player to the gallery nor submit the warning again as a new event. Simulate the missing voice file and complete the same route through its agreed text fallback. Before the warning occurs, a settings preview must not insert future dialogue into history.

The table is not evidence of a running game. After implementation, check actual playback controls, muted readability and state through settings, resuming, departure and restart on the target runtime. Timing and preference persistence may differ in another design, but must remain consistent.

heading.zh: 验收设置要看真实播放与路线，不只看滑块截图
heading.en: Verify playback and the route, beyond a slider screenshot

body.zh:
先重现原问题：声音关掉后，玩家究竟丢了哪条信息、哪一步不能做？按设计/美术/构建归属修，再走原路线与相邻反例。语音生产合同要求实际触发、字幕、静音、损坏文件与重开检查；测试方法要求真实输入和结果，不能用静态界面截图代替。

只验证项目已有的控件与采用的声音，不因本教程给所有游戏添加音乐、配音或更多设置。听感好不好可以继续调整，但“声音可关闭、信息仍可读、结果没被改写”应当能由实际候选证明。
body.en:
Reproduce the original loss: what information disappears when muted, and what action becomes impossible? Repair the responsible design, art or build layer, then replay the failing route and an adjacent countercase. The voice-production contract checks actual triggering, subtitles, mute, damaged files and restart; test design requires real input and outcomes rather than static settings screenshots.

Verify only adopted sounds and existing controls. This tutorial does not require adding music, voice or more settings to every game. Listening preferences can continue to evolve, while actual candidate evidence should establish that sound can be disabled, information remains readable and results are not rewritten.

q.zh: 静音后需要把所有声音都写成字幕吗？
q.en: Must every sound become a subtitle when muted?

a.zh: 不需要。保留规则、目标、选择与结果所需信息；环境氛围可用适当视觉补足，不能因静音增加未获知的事实。
a.en: No. Preserve information needed for rules, goals, choices and results. Appropriate visuals can support ambience without revealing otherwise unknown facts.

text.zh: 用 $game-build 实现已批准的声音设置，附声音层、静音fallback、计时与重开规则。设置只改变播放；保留关键文字和已提交结果。用实际运行路径检查静音、恢复、缺音与重开，不把纸面表格当游戏完成。
text.en: Use $game-build with approved sound layers, muted fallback, timing and restart rules. Settings affect playback while retaining essential text and committed results. Verify mute, unmute, missing audio and restart in the actual runtime.

label.zh: 声音层级与静音视觉通道
label.en: Sound hierarchy and muted visual channels

label.zh: 语音与字幕、缺音和重开检查
label.en: Speech, text, missing-audio and restart checks

label.zh: 实际路线与相邻反例

title.zh: AI视频人物被裁切怎么办：先查原图、动作范围和画幅
title.en: How to Fix Cropped Characters in AI Video

seo_title.zh: AI视频人物被裁切怎么修｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Fix Cropped Characters in AI Video | ZenStory

description.zh: 分清参考图裁切、人物运动出画和后期换画幅。附柜台取票完整提示词，保住头部、关键手部与已确认动作。
description.en: Separate reference cropping, movement out of frame and later aspect-ratio changes. A counter scene keeps the head, important hands and accepted action visible.

answer.zh: 先看裁切从哪一步开始：输入图已经缺头部或手部、人物动作越过画面边缘，还是完整生成片被后期裁成竖屏。回到对应材料修构图与动作范围，再检查整个动作。别只加“不裁切”，也别为了人物全身入画丢掉本镜关键道具。
answer.en: Locate where cropping begins: the input already lacks the head or hands, movement crosses the frame, or a complete generation is later cropped into portrait. Repair the responsible composition or action range, then inspect the whole action. “No cropping” alone is insufficient, and full-body framing must not hide the shot’s important object.

heading.zh: 先比较输入、原始视频与最终版本
heading.en: Compare the input, original clip and final version

body.zh:
| 裁切出现在哪里 | 先检查什么 |
|---|---|
| 参考图已经切掉头顶或手 | 实际送入的图片与本镜用途；文字计划不等于已修好的图片。 |
| 起点正常，弯腰或举手时出画 | 动作范围与摄影机的相对位置，是否有足够空间。 |
| 原视频完整，最终版才缺人物 | 后期画幅和裁切位置，先处理最终构图。 |

并非任何出画都是错误。人物离场、脸部特写和有意遮挡可以服务叙事；只有本镜必须看见的事实丢失，才按问题处理。例如递交凭据的镜头要看清持物变化，不需要为了保全鞋子退成读不清手部的大远景。
body.en:
| Where cropping appears | First check |
|---|---|
| Reference already loses head or hands | The actual submitted image and its shot role; a written plan is not a repaired image. |
| Start is correct but bending or raising an arm leaves frame | Subject movement relative to the camera and available space. |
| Original clip is complete but final output is cropped | The later aspect ratio and crop position. |

Leaving frame is not inherently wrong. Exits, facial close-ups and intentional occlusion can serve the story. Treat cropping as a defect when a required visible fact is lost. A receipt handover needs readable object possession; pulling into an extreme wide shot merely to retain shoes may hide the important hands.

heading.zh: 构图要覆盖完整动作，也要服从原分镜
heading.en: Cover the action while preserving the accepted shot

body.zh:
视频提示词方法要求从已确认起点到终点，运镜与分镜一致。固定机位应说明景别、高度、轴线侧、画内运动与保持时间；移动机位说明触发、路径及终点构图。同一区间不能既“完全固定”又要求摄影机一路跟随。

如果原分镜只留脸部特写，却要求从腰下取物再举到胸前，先修改分镜或采用获准的补镜，不能在提示词里默默换成远景。参考图的构图用途与终点事实也要分开：起始图不能拿人物已经取到票的状态冒充“准备取票”。

改后用实际参考图确认头部和关键手部位置。不要把未取得的图片称为冻结关键帧；用文字计划准备参考图时，明确还需真实图片才能按图生视频路径提交。
body.en:
Video-prompt methods realise accepted starts and ends while inheriting storyboard camera behaviour. A fixed shot specifies framing, height, axis side, movement within the frame and duration. A moving shot specifies trigger, path and endpoint. One interval cannot demand both a fully fixed camera and continuous camera following.

If an accepted facial close-up also requires taking something from below the waist, revise the storyboard or use an approved additional shot rather than silently changing to a wide view inside the prompt. Keep a reference’s composition role separate from end-state facts: an image of a person already holding the ticket cannot serve as the starting state before pickup.

Use the actual revised reference to check the head and important hands. An image not yet acquired is not a frozen keyframe. When planning an input in text, make clear that an actual image is still required for image-to-video submission.

heading.zh: 完整示例：取票时头部与持票手都留在画内
heading.en: Complete example: keeping the head and ticket hand visible

body.zh:
原创纸面镜头：书店柜台，杜晴从自己面前取回有蓝圆印的票据，最后在胸前拿稳。票据起初在柜台上，归属不变；本镜不表现交给别人。原方案是过紧的头肩构图，低头取票时手和纸都在画外。作者已同意改成六秒固定中景，保留取票动作和结尾持物。

创作者已明确选用文生视频，下面是构图与动作正文候选，没有实际生成视频：

> 竖屏书店柜台场景。成年短发女子杜晴穿灰色开衫，站在柜台后；白色票据带蓝色圆印，平放在她面前。柜台、她的双手以及头顶到腰部都在画内，头顶上方留出空间。摄影机在既定轴线左侧平视，六秒保持固定中景，为了看清她取票并拿稳的完整动作，不推近、不摇移。杜晴先低头看票据，右手伸向柜台，手指接触纸边后拿起；她直起身，将票据停在胸前，蓝圆印朝向画面，左手仍搭在柜台上。手、纸与头部在弯腰和直起时都保持可见，纸只有这一张，不转交。末尾她站稳，票据仍由右手持有。全镜只有轻微店内环境声，无对白、画外音和配乐；任何时刻都不生成非画内字幕、caption或对白文字叠加。票据无需生成可读文字。

构图中的留白没有通用百分比，六秒也是本例选择，不保证某模型一次成功。若换成图生视频，先取得同一起点的真实图：票据在柜台，不在胸前，并按所用模型的参考绑定方式提交；不要直接沿用文生的准备声明。
body.en:
Original paper shot: at a bookshop counter, Du Qing picks up her own receipt with a blue circular mark and holds it steadily at her chest. It begins on the counter and ownership does not change; no handover occurs. A tight head-and-shoulders plan hides the hand and paper during pickup. The author approves a six-second fixed medium shot preserving the action and final possession.

The creator explicitly chooses text-to-video. This is a composition and motion candidate, without an actual generated clip:

> Portrait bookshop-counter scene. Du Qing, an adult woman with short hair and a grey cardigan, stands behind the counter. One white receipt bearing a blue circular mark lies in front of her. Keep the counter, both hands and her head through waist visible, with space above the head. The camera is at eye level on the established left side of the axis and holds this medium framing for six seconds to show the whole pickup and steady hold, without pushing in or panning. She looks down, reaches with her right hand, contacts the paper edge and lifts it. She straightens and holds the receipt at chest height with its blue mark toward the image; her left hand remains on the counter. Head, hand and paper remain visible while bending and straightening. There is one receipt and no transfer. At the end she stands steadily and still holds it in her right hand. Use only quiet shop ambience, without dialogue, voice-over or music. Generate no non-diegetic subtitles, captions or dialogue overlays at any point. The receipt requires no readable text.

There is no universal headroom percentage, and six seconds is this example’s choice rather than a one-try model guarantee. For image-to-video, obtain an actual matching start image with the receipt on the counter, not already at the chest, and bind it according to the target model. Do not reuse a text-to-video preparation statement as proof of an image input.

heading.zh: 检查首、中、尾，再看最终画幅
heading.en: Check start, middle, end and the final frame format

body.zh:
正常速度看完整镜头，再暂停定位：手碰纸、纸离台、人物直起和最后持物时，关键内容是否都可见？头顶偶然被切掉与整个动作在画外，修法不必相同。核对下一镜仍是右手持同一张票，不因补构图变成左手或第二张纸。

最终成片若换画幅，重新检查这些时刻；原视频通过不证明裁切后的版本通过。只需补本镜影响的材料，不为一次构图错误重写全剧。提示词更清楚是改进方案，真实参考和生成结果才证明是否解决。
body.en:
Watch the complete shot at normal speed, then pause to locate contact, lift, straightening and final possession. Required content should be visible at each point. An occasional clipped head and an entire off-screen action may need different repairs. Check that the following shot still begins with the same receipt in the right hand, without a new hand or duplicate paper introduced by reframing.

If the final edit changes aspect ratio, inspect these moments again. A passing source clip does not prove the cropped version passes. Update only affected shot materials rather than rewriting the series for one framing error. A clearer prompt proposes a repair; actual references and generated results establish whether it worked.

q.zh: 写全身入画就能解决所有裁切吗？
q.en: Does asking for a full-body shot solve every crop?

a.zh: 不能。按本镜需要选择景别，确保头部、关键动作和道具可读；也要检查真实参考、运动范围和后期裁切。
a.en: No. Choose framing for the shot’s needed head, action and objects, then check actual references, movement range and later cropping.

text.zh: 用 $short-drama-video-prompts 检查指定镜头的裁切，附已确认分镜、实际输入与原片。定位输入、运动或后期问题；保留动作和终点，需换景别时先同步分镜。分别说明文生与真实图生输入，检查完整动作与最终画幅。
text.en: Use $short-drama-video-prompts with the accepted shot, actual input and source clip. Locate reference, movement or edit cropping; retain action and endpoint, updating the storyboard before changing framing. Distinguish text-to-video from real image inputs and inspect the whole action and final aspect ratio.

label.zh: 固定与移动摄影机、构图与主体相对运动
label.en: Fixed and moving cameras, framing and relative subject movement

label.zh: 起止边界、真实参考及动作实现
label.en: Start/end boundaries, actual references and motion implementation

title.zh: AI写小说乱加人物怎么办：分清现场细节与改变剧情的新角色
title.en: How to Stop AI Fiction from Adding Unwanted Characters

seo_title.zh: AI写小说乱加人物怎么办｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Stop AI Fiction Adding Unwanted Characters | ZenStory

description.zh: 用本章人物、已知事实和停笔点限制新增角色，区分一次性路人与改变剧情的新人。附修理间案例与局部回退方法。
description.en: Define this chapter’s cast, facts and stopping point. Distinguish incidental people from plot-changing additions, with a workshop example and local repair.

answer.zh: 先说明本章哪些人物在场、哪些人物只能被提及，以及本次允许新增什么。新角色若改变权限、信息或既定结果，就不是补一句描写。核对细纲、人物卡和当前状态后，修掉未经授权的行动链；不要仅替换名字，留下新人带来的钥匙和答案。
answer.en: Specify who is present, who may only be mentioned and what additions this task permits. A new character who changes access, knowledge or the planned outcome is more than descriptive detail. Compare the outline, character cards and current state, then repair the unauthorised action chain rather than renaming its newcomer while keeping the invented key or answer.

heading.zh: 不是所有路人都要删，先看新增人物做了什么
heading.en: Classify what the newcomer changes

body.zh:
Oh Story的新增物规则分三类：微连接、一次性路人和现场细节可直接写；具名配角、关系与后续承诺等写了要报；改变主线、真相、既定决定或发生冲突的内容先问作者。判断不能只看有没有名字。

| 新增内容 | 需要核对的影响 |
|---|---|
| 街边路人经过 | 是否只是现场细节，还是替主角递交关键证据。 |
| 新配角留下联系方式 | 后续章是否需要知道此人、关系与承诺。 |
| 突然到场的专家解决难题 | 是否改变原定过程、权限或结果。 |

作者可以进一步限定本章不新增人物；这是当前任务的范围，优先执行。反过来，也不要把方法误读为全书永远不能出现新人。角色是否需要存在，最终服务作者选定的故事。
body.en:
Oh Story separates additions into three levels: incidental connections, one-off passersby and local detail can be written directly; named supporting characters, relationships and future obligations need declaration; changes to the main plot, truth, established decisions or conflicting commitments require the author’s decision first. A name alone does not determine the level.

| Addition | Check its effect |
|---|---|
| Someone passing in the street | Is this local texture, or do they deliver decisive evidence? |
| A new supporting character leaves contact details | Will later chapters need this person, relationship or promise? |
| An expert arrives and solves the problem | Does this change the approved process, access or outcome? |

An author may further restrict this chapter to its established cast. That current scope applies. The method does not mean a book can never introduce anyone new; characters serve the author’s chosen story.

heading.zh: 把在场、未到场和允许提及分开写
heading.en: Separate presence, absence and permissible mentions

body.zh:
写指定章时读取完整细纲和本章相关状态，明确人物卡、已发生事实和本章停点。只写“不要加人”仍可能让AI给旧人物添加一段突然到场的经历，或把未接到电话的人写成已经知情。

可以附一张本章范围卡：实际在场的人；其他人的位置与已知内容；允许的提及或联络；本次必须发生和不得提前发生的事件。它是本文的编辑卡，不替代本书细纲或追踪文件。材料不足先补事实，不靠新角色填空。
body.en:
For a specified chapter, load the full outline and relevant current state, with character cards, occurred facts and the stopping point. “Add nobody” can still leave AI inventing an existing character’s sudden arrival or treating an unanswered call as knowledge received.

An editorial scope card can identify people actually present, others’ locations and knowledge, allowed mentions or contact, and events that must happen or remain pending. It does not replace the book’s outline or tracking files. Missing facts need clarification rather than a new character to fill the gap.

heading.zh: 完整示例：删掉大师，也删掉他凭空给出的权限
heading.en: Complete example: remove the expert and the access he invented

body.zh:
原创本章：袁禾与石宁在修理间检查旧画框；物主龚叔不在场，尚未同意换底座。停点是二人确认需要询问物主，不进行更换。这次作者限定只写二人现场检查。

错误候选突然写“赵师傅推门进来，递出仓库钥匙，替龚叔答应换底座”。只把赵师傅改名为石宁，仍保留凭空得到的钥匙和许可，问题没有解决。可以回到获准的检查：

> 袁禾把画框平放在桌上，手指停在松动的底座旁。
>
> “这里也要换。”石宁说。
>
> “龚叔只让我们检查。”袁禾取出记录纸，“把裂口记下来，问他愿不愿意换。”
>
> 石宁拿起笔，画出裂口的位置。“还是先报两种方案？”
>
> “好。保留底座怎么修、换掉怎么做，分开给他看。”
>
> 两人写完记录，把画框留在桌上，没有拆下底座。

正文停在检查与方案记录：龚叔仍未答复，仓库钥匙没有被新增，底座未换。下一章是否联络、得到哪个选择，由作者后续安排；本例不把记录计划写成已经获得同意。

请求可以写：“只修这一检查段，删除赵师傅及他带来的钥匙、代理许可与更换结果；保留袁禾/石宁检查并决定询问物主，不改其他章节，不替龚叔作答。”
body.en:
Original chapter: Yuan He and Shi Ning inspect an old picture frame in the workshop. Owner Gong is absent and has not approved replacing its base. The scene stops with their decision to ask him; replacement does not occur. The author limits this passage to the two inspectors.

A faulty candidate invents Master Zhao entering with a storeroom key and approval on Gong’s behalf. Renaming Zhao as Shi preserves the invented access and permission, so it does not repair the problem. Return to the approved inspection:

> Yuan laid the frame flat on the table and stopped beside its loose base.
>
> “This needs replacing too,” Shi said.
>
> “Gong only asked us to inspect it.” Yuan took out the record sheet. “Mark the crack and ask whether he wants replacement.”
>
> Shi drew its position. “Should we offer two plans?”
>
> “Yes. Show repairing the existing base and replacing it separately.”
>
> They finished the record and left the frame on the table without removing its base.

The passage ends with inspection and options recorded. Gong has not replied, no storeroom key has appeared, and the base is unchanged. Contact and a later decision belong to the author’s next plan; a proposal is not permission received.

A request can say: “Repair only this inspection passage. Remove Zhao and the key, proxy approval and replacement outcome he introduced. Keep Yuan and Shi’s inspection and decision to ask the owner. Change no other chapters and do not answer for Gong.”

heading.zh: 查新人带来的后续事实，别只搜索人名
heading.en: Trace the addition’s effects rather than only its name

body.zh:
先比对实际改动，再查新增人物给出的信息、物件、权限、关系和承诺有没有进入后文。若只有当前草稿用了它，修相关段落即可；若已经影响后章，按受影响范围修复，并通过既有追踪流程保持事实一致。

“写了要报”不等于报告中提一下就自动成立，仍需核对是否冲突。可保留的配角正常建档，越界的主线决定回到作者；无须为删除一位新人把整本书改写。
body.en:
Compare actual changes, then trace information, objects, access, relationships and promises the addition supplied. If only the current draft uses them, repair that passage. If later chapters depend on them, revise the affected scope and reconcile facts through the existing tracking workflow.

Declaration does not automatically validate an addition; conflicts still need review. Keep and document a legitimate supporting character, return an unauthorised plot decision to the author, and avoid rewriting the whole book to remove one newcomer.

q.zh: 人物没有名字，就不算改变剧情吗？
q.en: Can an unnamed person change the plot?

a.zh: 也能。路人递出关键证据、代为答应或解决难题，同样可能改变事实与结果，按功能和后续影响判断。
a.en: Yes. A passerby who provides decisive evidence, consent or a solution can change facts and outcomes. Judge function and later effects.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 核对指定章的新增人物，附细纲、人物卡、实际在场与停点。区分现场细节、需申报的配角和需作者决定的主线变化；局部修掉越界人物及其产生的事实，不把删名当成完整修复。
text.en: Use $story-long-write with the chapter outline, character cards, actual cast and stopping point. Distinguish local detail, declarable supporting roles and author-level plot decisions. Repair both the unauthorised character and their effects.

label.zh: 本章状态筛选、新增物核对与处置
label.en: Chapter state selection, addition review and disposition

label.zh: 任务范围、人物材料与新增申报
label.en: Task scope, character materials and addition declarations

title.zh: AI视频动作反复重来怎么办：写清完成状态，再查可用片段
title.en: How to Fix Repeated Actions in AI Video

seo_title.zh: AI视频动作重复怎么修｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Fix Repeated Actions in AI Video | ZenStory

description.zh: 区分提示词反复动作、生成回弹与剪辑重复，写清接触、松手和完成后保持。附放杯子例与可用区间判断。
description.en: Distinguish intended repetition, generation rebound and repeated edits. A cup-placement example defines contact, release, final hold and usable footage.

answer.zh: 先判断重复发生在动作计划、原始生成片还是剪辑时间线。对只需完成一次的动作，写清起点、接触、到位、松手及完成后状态，再看实际视频是否达成。若已有完整可用区间，可以评估剪短；缺关键动作时回上游补素材，不能只靠“不要循环”。
answer.en: Locate repetition in the action plan, original generation or edit timeline. For an action intended once, define start, contact, placement, release and the state afterward, then inspect actual footage. A complete usable interval may be shortened; missing action needs new material rather than only “do not loop.”

heading.zh: 先看原片，分清三种重复
heading.en: Distinguish three sources of repetition

body.zh:
| 看到的重复 | 先找原因 |
|---|---|
| 人物本来就在试探或反复擦拭 | 可能符合剧本，不默认删掉。 |
| 原片放下杯子后又拿起，违背终点 | 检查动作顺序、完成状态与生成回弹。 |
| 原片正常，成片同一动作出现两遍 | 检查是否重复选入素材或重叠了同一表演。 |

记录实际发生的时间与动作。不要因为最后一帧看似正确，就忽略中途重来的过程。若重复有叙事职责，例如人物犹豫着递出又收回，就保留已确认的过程，而不是强制每镜只有一个动词。
body.en:
| Repetition | First check |
|---|---|
| A character deliberately tests or wipes repeatedly | It may be scripted behaviour rather than a defect. |
| The source places a cup then picks it up against the endpoint | Check ordered motion, completion and generation rebound. |
| Source is correct but the edit shows the action twice | Check duplicate material selection or repeated performance coverage. |

Record when and how it happens. A correct-looking last frame does not excuse a repeated middle. Preserve purposeful repetition, such as offering something and withdrawing it, rather than imposing one verb per shot.

heading.zh: 写清到位后做什么，而不是只说“自然地放下”
heading.en: Define what happens after completion

body.zh:
视频运动方法按起点、先后动作、接触与已确认终点写实现，动作数量本身不是质量指标。持续的支撑与持物关系应可见，不能让“最后放好”跳过松手，也不能为了拉满时长让人物重新做一遍。

完成后可以停留、观察或转入已经确认的反应。不要临时添加喝水、递杯、走出房间来填时间。若动作和必需对白确实装不下，请分镜调整时长或拆镜，不在视频提示词阶段删掉台词或改终点。
body.en:
The motion method implements a start, ordered actions, contact and accepted endpoint. Action count itself is not a quality metric. Support and possession must remain visible: “finally placed” cannot skip release, and filling duration cannot justify repeating the action.

After completion, the subject may remain, observe or perform an accepted reaction. Do not invent drinking, handing over the cup or leaving to fill time. If required action and dialogue cannot fit, request storyboard duration or shot changes instead of deleting words or changing the endpoint in the video prompt.

heading.zh: 完整示例：杯子落稳、手松开，之后不再拿起
heading.en: Complete example: place, release and remain

body.zh:
原创纸面镜头采用已明确选择的文生视频：何琳右手持蓝色陶瓷杯，桌上白杯垫空着。五秒固定中景，目标是杯子放到杯垫后松手；末尾杯子由杯垫支撑，右手停在桌边，没有对白或饮水动作。正文候选可以写：

> 室内木桌旁，成年女子何琳穿米色衬衫，右手持一只蓝色陶瓷杯，杯底在白色杯垫上方，左手停在桌边。固定平视中景覆盖双手、杯子和杯垫，保持五秒不运镜。她将杯子向下移到杯垫中央，杯底接触杯垫并放稳后，右手手指才松开；右手撤到桌边停住。此后杯子一直由杯垫支撑，手不再接触或拿起杯子，直到本镜结束。动作平稳，完成后的停留用于让观众看清已经放下。只有安静室内底声，无对白、画外音与配乐；全镜不生成非画内字幕、caption或对白文字叠加。

五秒是本例已选时长，不是任何模型的默认值。若换图生视频，真实起始帧应仍是手持杯、杯垫空着；不能拿已经放好杯子的图片当本镜起点。终点一致也要看中途是不是重新举杯，提示词本身不证明视频正确。

假设检查一条实际素材发现：1.20秒接触、1.80秒松手、1.80—3.00秒稳定，3.20秒又拿起。若0—3.00秒已完整覆盖必要动作与反应，可把三秒可用段作为剪短候选；这些秒数仅为教学假设，不是本页实测。若缺必需台词、反应或接镜条件，就不能这样截。
body.en:
Original paper shot uses explicitly chosen text-to-video: He Lin holds a blue ceramic cup in her right hand above an empty white coaster. A five-second fixed medium shot ends after she places and releases it. The coaster supports the cup and her right hand rests by the table; there is no speech or drinking. A candidate is:

> Indoors beside a wooden table, adult He Lin wears a cream shirt and holds one blue ceramic cup in her right hand, its base above an empty white coaster. Her left hand rests at the table edge. Hold an eye-level medium shot showing both hands, cup and coaster for five seconds without camera movement. She lowers the cup to the coaster’s centre. Once its base contacts the coaster and sits steadily, her right fingers release it; her hand withdraws to rest by the table. The coaster supports the cup thereafter. She does not touch or lift it again before the shot ends. Use steady motion and a final hold so viewers can read that placement is complete. Include only quiet room ambience, no dialogue, voice-over or music, and no non-diegetic subtitles, captions or dialogue overlays at any point.

Five seconds is this shot’s chosen duration, not a universal model default. For image-to-video, the actual start frame should still show the held cup and empty coaster, not the completed placement. Inspect the middle for another lift even if the endpoint looks right; a prompt does not prove correct footage.

Suppose an actual clip inspection finds contact at 1.20 seconds, release at 1.80, stability until 3.00 and another lift at 3.20. If 0–3.00 already contains the required action and reaction, propose that three-second usable interval. These numbers are teaching assumptions, not measurements made by this page. Missing dialogue, reaction or continuity would make that cut unsuitable.

heading.zh: 剪短还是重做，要看信息是否完整
heading.en: Choose trimming or regeneration by completeness

body.zh:
生成素材方法要求逐段记录实际时长、可用区间和缺陷，重复表演与动作回弹都是检查项。已完整承载信息可以评估缩短；关键动作缺失则列出缺口并请求补素材。剪短后要复核声音、下一镜起点和成片时长，不能只看裁掉了重复。

反馈上游时说清在哪一刻重新拿起、希望末尾保持什么。修后比较同一段实际画面，不把某一次模型失误当成所有模型必然循环的规律。纸面提示词、计划区间与真实产物分别核实。
body.en:
Generated-footage methods record actual duration, usable intervals and defects, including repeated performance and action rebound. Shortening is an option when information is complete; missing required action needs explicit gaps and additional material. After trimming, recheck sound, the next shot’s start and final duration rather than merely confirming repetition is gone.

Tell upstream when the second lift occurs and what should remain at the end. Compare the same portion of the new actual clip rather than treating one failure as a universal model rule. Verify the paper prompt, planned interval and real output separately.

q.zh: 动作只出现一次就一定更好吗？
q.en: Is performing an action once always better?

a.zh: 不是。剧本要求的反复与犹豫可以保留；要修的是违背已确认过程或终点的重复，不按动词数量判断。
a.en: No. Preserve scripted repetition and hesitation. Repair repetition that contradicts the accepted process or endpoint, rather than counting verbs.

text.zh: 用 $short-drama-video-prompts 检查重复动作，附已确认镜头及实际原片时间点。保留合法反复，写清一次动作的接触、到位、松手与终点保持；缺动作回上游补，完整片段的剪短交剪辑核对，不以提示词代替产物证明。
text.en: Use $short-drama-video-prompts with the accepted shot and source-clip timestamps. Preserve purposeful repetition; specify contact, placement, release and endpoint holding. Missing action needs upstream material, while trimming complete footage requires editing review.

label.zh: 有序动作、支撑关系与只读终点
label.en: Ordered action, support relationships and accepted endpoints

label.zh: 完成后留时间与超载修订
label.en: Time for completion and overload revision

label.zh: 重复表演、可用区间与补素材
label.en: Repeated performance, usable intervals and replacement footage

title.zh: AI续写总重复上一章怎么办：从已发生的结果接着写
title.en: How to Stop AI Continuation Repeating the Previous Chapter

seo_title.zh: AI续写重复上一章怎么办｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Stop AI Continuation Repeating a Chapter | ZenStory

description.zh: 分清重写与续写，确认上一章结尾、已完成事件和下一章细纲。附修钟铺交接例，保留必要承接而不重演旧行动。
description.en: Separate rewriting from continuation and confirm the previous ending, completed events and next outline. A clock-shop example keeps continuity without replay.

answer.zh: 先确认是在重写当前章，还是从已完成章继续。续写要接住上一章实际结果，再进入下一章已批准的新行动；不从聊天里一个“继续”猜起点。必要的回顾可以保留，但不能把已发生的谈话、交接和决定再写成第一次发生。
answer.en: Confirm whether the task rewrites the current chapter or continues after a completed one. Continuation starts from the actual prior result and moves into the next approved action; “continue” alone is not a reliable starting point. Useful recap may remain, but occurred conversations, handoffs and decisions must not happen again as first-time events.

heading.zh: 先区分重复情节、回顾与当前章重写
heading.en: Distinguish replay, recap and a requested rewrite

body.zh:
| 看到的情况 | 先确认什么 |
|---|---|
| 新章重新谈成昨天已经谈成的事 | 已完成事件是不是被当成仍待发生。 |
| 开头短句回想昨夜的选择 | 是否提供当前判断所需的承接，而非整场重演。 |
| 作者本来要求修改上一章 | 这是获准重写，不是续写出错。 |

不要按出现过的人名或物件机械删重。同一把钥匙可以在下一章使用，同一句话也可被人物有意引用；需要修的是没有新作用、或把事实退回未发生状态的重复。
body.en:
| Symptom | First question |
|---|---|
| A new chapter negotiates yesterday’s completed agreement again | Was a completed event treated as pending? |
| A short opening recalls last night’s choice | Does it support a current decision rather than replaying the scene? |
| The author requested revision of the previous chapter | This is an authorised rewrite rather than faulty continuation. |

Do not delete repeated names or objects mechanically. The same key can be used next chapter and a line can be deliberately quoted. Repair repetition that serves no new purpose or reverses occurred facts into pending events.

heading.zh: 把起点交接清楚，不用整章复述来证明记得
heading.en: Make the handoff explicit without retelling the chapter

body.zh:
Oh Story的续写流程逐章完成并提交追踪后再写下一章。写前核对已完成章、本章细纲与当前相关状态；上一章结尾由组装流程承接，存疑时定点读原文，不用来源不明的聊天记忆代替。

给AI的材料应说明：本次是续写第几章；已经发生什么；下一章要做什么；不能再次发生或提前发生什么。细纲把相同要求写了两遍，也只兑现一次。若实际正文与追踪不一致，先查缺失或错误的交接，不靠重复旧情节修补状态。

批写时按当前章顺序推进。不要把几章并发写好后才决定谁接谁，也不要为了凑字数让角色再完成一次昨天的任务。
body.en:
Oh Story completes each chapter and commits tracking before the next. Before writing, confirm the completed chapter, current outline and relevant state. The assembly workflow carries the prior ending; inspect the specific manuscript when continuity is uncertain rather than relying on unsourced chat memory.

Tell AI which chapter to continue, what has occurred, what the next chapter does, and what must neither recur nor happen early. An instruction duplicated in the outline is fulfilled once. If prose and tracking disagree, investigate the handoff instead of repeating plot to patch the state.

Advance sequentially during batch drafting. Do not draft chapters concurrently and decide their ordering afterward, or repeat yesterday’s task merely to meet word count.

heading.zh: 完整示例：钥匙已借到，下一章从用钥匙开始
heading.en: Complete example: the key is already borrowed

body.zh:
原创第五章结尾：陶安向店主借到了修钟间钥匙，约定次日上午九点与罗岑一起检查钟，不擅自拆件。第六章细纲是两人按约抵达、用钥匙开门、发现钟未走并记录现象；停在准备询问店主，尚未获得拆件许可。

重复候选让陶安再次找店主借钥匙，并让罗岑重新同意时间。可以把重复协商改成当前行动：

> 九点，陶安在修钟间门口等到罗岑。钥匙还是昨晚店主交给他的那一把。
>
> “没迟到。”罗岑看了一眼钟面，“可它怎么还指着六点？”
>
> 陶安开门，把钥匙留在自己口袋里。两人隔着玻璃看摆锤，没有动。
>
> “先记下来。”他说，“昨晚说的是检查，没答应拆。”
>
> 罗岑写下钟面与摆锤状态，合上本子。“一起问店主。”
>
> 陶安点头，把钟留在原处。

借钥匙和约时间不再发生第二次；物件由陶安继续持有，两人实际抵达并完成观察。钟为何停、是否允许拆件仍未知，不因新章必须推进就自动给出答案。

任务可以写：“续写第六章，接第五章已借到钥匙及九点约定，不重写借钥匙谈话。按本章细纲完成抵达、开门和观察，停在准备询问店主；不拆钟、不增诊断结论，保留本书文风。”上面是原创交接方案，不是已经运行的小说工程。
body.en:
Original chapter five ends with Tao An borrowing the clock-room key from its owner and arranging a nine-o’clock inspection with Luo Cen, without permission to dismantle anything. Chapter six covers arrival, unlocking, observing the stopped clock and recording it. It stops before asking the owner; dismantling remains unauthorised.

A faulty continuation borrows the key again and renegotiates Luo’s arrival. Replace replayed negotiation with current action:

> At nine, Tao met Luo outside the clock room. The key was still the one its owner had handed him last night.
>
> “On time,” Luo said, glancing at the dial. “But why does that still say six?”
>
> Tao unlocked the door and kept the key in his pocket. Through the glass, they watched the motionless pendulum.
>
> “Record it first,” he said. “We agreed to inspect it, not take it apart.”
>
> Luo noted the dial and pendulum, then closed the notebook. “Ask the owner together.”
>
> Tao nodded and left the clock where it was.

Borrowing and scheduling do not occur twice. Tao retains the key; both arrive and observe. The cause and permission to dismantle remain unknown, without an automatic answer simply because a new chapter must progress.

A task can say: “Continue chapter six from the borrowed key and nine-o’clock agreement at chapter five’s end. Do not replay borrowing. Follow the outline through arrival, unlocking and observation; stop before asking the owner, without dismantling or a new diagnosis. Preserve book-local style.” This is an original handoff example rather than a running novel project.

heading.zh: 删重后看新结果，也看是否丢了必要承接
heading.en: Check new results and the continuity retained

body.zh:
核对旧章实际结尾与新章开头：时间、位置、持物、知情和承诺是否接上？再核本章新行动有没有落地，而非只把旧事换词复述。必要的一句回顾可留，不能为“去重复”把钥匙来源或不拆件约定删掉。

若已写出的后章沿用了重复谈话带来的新条件，按受影响范围修后文并走既有修订流程。只改措辞与改变事件状态分开处理，不手改追踪视图来伪装正确承接。
body.en:
Compare the actual prior ending and new opening for time, location, possession, knowledge and promises. Then check that the current chapter’s action occurs rather than rephrasing earlier events. Keep necessary recap; removing repetition must not erase the key’s origin or the no-dismantling agreement.

If later chapters depend on new conditions introduced by the repeated negotiation, repair their affected scope through the existing revision workflow. Distinguish wording changes from changed event state rather than hand-editing tracking views to simulate continuity.

q.zh: 每章开头都不能回顾吗？
q.en: Is recap forbidden at chapter openings?

a.zh: 可以简短回顾当前行动需要的事实，或写人物对旧事的新理解；不要把已完成事件重演成第一次发生。
a.en: Briefly recall facts needed now or a character’s changed understanding. Do not replay completed events as though they were happening for the first time.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 检查续写重复，附已完成章结尾、本章细纲与当前状态。分开重写和续写，从已有结果进入新行动；保留有用回顾，删除越界重演，不用补字数替代进展。
text.en: Use $story-long-write with the completed ending, current outline and state. Separate revision from continuation, advance from existing results and preserve useful recap while removing replay.

label.zh: 逐章交接、状态来源与定点查旧信息
label.en: Sequential handoff, state sources and targeted history lookup

label.zh: 本章细纲与相同要求只兑现一次
label.en: Current outline and fulfilling duplicated requirements once

title.zh: 字幕和旁白内容不一样怎么办：先核实际声音，再修文字
title.en: How to Fix Subtitles That Do Not Match the Voiceover

seo_title.zh: 字幕和旁白内容不一致怎么修｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Fix Subtitles That Differ from Voiceover | ZenStory

description.zh: 对照批准稿、TTS实读文本、采用音频与字幕来源，分清内容和时间错误。附保留与删除句子被字幕写反的修复示例。
description.en: Compare approved text, TTS spoken text, adopted audio and subtitle sources. A keep/delete example separates content mismatch from timing errors.

answer.zh: 先听当前成片的实际声音，再核字幕这句话来自哪份文字。时间对齐而内容不同，移动字幕轨不能解决；内容相同而显示太早或太晚，则按时间问题处理。定稿、TTS实读记录、音频与最终字幕分别对照，避免拿旧稿或原声字幕匹配新的旁白。
answer.en: Listen to the actual final audio and identify the text source for the mismatched cue. Aligned timing with different words is not repaired by moving the subtitle track; matching words shown early or late require timing work. Compare the approved draft, TTS spoken-text record, audio and final captions rather than matching new narration to old copy or source-dialogue subtitles.

heading.zh: 先判断是字不一样，还是出现时间不一样
heading.en: Separate wording from timing

body.zh:
| 当前情况 | 先修什么 |
|---|---|
| 旁白说“保留”，字幕写“删除” | 核当前采用声音与字幕文字来源。 |
| 字词相同，但字幕提前出现 | 查本条起止或整轨偏移，不改成另一句话。 |
| 字幕显示原片人物台词，声音是解说 | 核字幕所属原声还是旁白，别混用。 |

专名、否定词和顺序词尤其要逐字比较。视频上有字并不证明它就是当前旁白字幕：花字、标牌与原片字幕各有职责。本文修的是要对应旁白的字幕内容，时间同步详见[字幕起止检查](/video-recap/subtitle-timing-evidence)。
body.en:
| Situation | First repair |
|---|---|
| Voice says “keep” but caption says “delete” | Check adopted audio and the subtitle text source. |
| Words match but appear early | Check cue boundaries or track offset without substituting another sentence. |
| Caption shows original dialogue while narration is heard | Check source-dialogue versus narration attribution. |

Compare names, negation and ordering words carefully. Visible text is not automatically a caption for the current voice: titles, signs and source subtitles have separate roles. This page repairs captions intended to represent narration; see [subtitle boundary checks](/video-recap/subtitle-timing-evidence) for timing.

heading.zh: 定稿、实读记录与声音各证明什么
heading.en: Identify what each text and audio record establishes

body.zh:
配音模块记录`authored_text`、`spoken_text`及是否自动缩稿。前者保留送入的作者稿，后者记录本段实际送去合成的文本；它们不替代回听供应商到底读了什么。默认超窗可能缩稿，选定稿保护`--preserve-approved-text`可阻止自动删字，超窗或必需段失败则不能当完成。

先确认成片真的采用了当前WAV，再检查字幕是否仍引用旧稿。仅文件名相同或元数据存在，不能证明已换入成片。若稿件需要改动，作者先选择最终说法，再只重生成受影响声音，并按新采用声音核字幕和接点。
body.en:
The voice module records `authored_text`, `spoken_text` and automatic shortening. The first retains the supplied author text; the second records words sent for synthesis. Neither replaces listening to what the provider actually spoke. Default over-window handling may shorten copy; `--preserve-approved-text` prevents automatic deletion and treats an overrun or required-segment failure as unfinished.

Confirm the current WAV is actually in the final edit before checking captions still based on old copy. A matching filename or present metadata does not establish adoption. If wording changes, the author selects the final version, then regenerates only affected audio and checks captions and joins against the adopted sound.

heading.zh: 完整示例：保留与删除被旧字幕写反
heading.en: Complete example: an old caption reverses keep and delete

body.zh:
原创剪辑教学片的一句批准旁白是：“这一段要保留，下一段可以删除。”本段TTS的`spoken_text`一致，分段与当前成片回听也一致；外部导入的旧字幕却写：“这一段可以删除，下一段要保留。”本例窗口18—22秒仅为教学安排，正式起止须核实际音频。

| 核对材料 | 本例结果 |
|---|---|
| 批准稿和实读记录 | 保留当前段，删除下一段。 |
| 实际分段和采用的声音 | 听到相同说法，没有换成旧音频。 |
| 显示字幕 | 使用了相反的旧文字，内容错误。 |

保留当前声音，把对应字幕改成批准句，再按这条声音复核起止。不要为了迁就旧字幕把正确旁白换错，也不要只拖动时间，让错误句子晚两秒出现。

若项目采用本仓库的独立字幕轨，应在完整当前轨里修这条，同时保留其他所有需要的字幕。该集成只用于已采用AAC声音、输出从零开始的`adopted-packet-copy`路径；提交轨替换全部生成字幕，不是把一条补丁自动合并。新混旁白的路线不能直接假定同样适用。

导出后听这句并看字幕首尾，再看前后接点与其他保留字幕。这里给出的是修复方案，没有生成TTS、字幕轨或成片；真实采用声音和真实轨道决定最终检查值。
body.en:
An original editing lesson’s approved narration says, “Keep this section; the next section can be deleted.” Its TTS `spoken_text` matches, and listening to the segment and current edit confirms it. An imported old cue instead says, “Delete this section; keep the next.” An 18–22-second window is a teaching arrangement, with actual boundaries still needing audio review.

| Material | Example result |
|---|---|
| Approved copy and spoken-text record | Keep the current section; delete the next. |
| Actual segment and adopted sound | The same words are heard; old audio was not substituted. |
| Displayed caption | Opposite old text causes a content error. |

Keep the current sound and replace the cue with the approved sentence, then verify its actual boundaries. Do not replace correct narration to accommodate old subtitles or merely move the incorrect sentence two seconds later.

For this repository’s independent track integration, edit the cue within the complete current track and retain every other caption needed. The integration applies to zero-start output media with adopted AAC audio in `adopted-packet-copy` mode. The track replaces all generated captions rather than automatically merging a one-cue patch. Do not assume the same integration applies to a newly mixed narration route.

After export, listen and inspect this cue’s first and last display, neighbouring joins and retained captions. This is a repair plan without generated TTS, track or video; actual adopted audio and the real track determine final check values.

heading.zh: 结构验证之后，仍要检查实际文字覆盖
heading.en: Verify actual words and coverage after structural checks

body.zh:
字幕轨加载器保留文字与起止，核当前画面、采用声流和时长；它不识别声音、改错字或证明语音与文字同步。完整轨少了一句话，也不能靠“文件合法”发现所有漏字幕。

因此分开核对：采用哪路音频、哪些旁白/原声需要字幕、每条的当前文字、实际显示与声音起止。时间或素材变动后重新准备受影响轨，失效输入不能继续冒充当前版本。只改一条文字时也要保留其他字幕，不把全轨替换误当局部更新。
body.en:
The track loader preserves text and boundaries while checking current picture, adopted audio stream and duration. It does not recognise speech, correct words or prove synchronization. A structurally valid full track can still omit a required sentence.

Check separately which audio is adopted, which narration or source lines need captions, each cue’s current words and actual sound/display boundaries. Changed time or media requires preparing the affected track again; stale input cannot represent the current version. Even a one-line wording repair must retain other required captions when replacing a full track.

q.zh: 把字幕识别一遍就一定正确吗？
q.en: Does another transcription guarantee correct captions?

a.zh: 不能。识别结果只是候选，仍需对照当前采用声音核人名、否定与顺序，并在导出中检查文字和起止。
a.en: No. Transcription is a candidate; compare names, negation and order against adopted audio, then verify wording and boundaries in the export.

text.zh: 让 video-assemble 阶段核对当前旁白与字幕来源，附批准稿、实读记录、采用声音和当前轨。先修文字或声音的实际错误，再核起止；使用独立轨时按支持路径完整替换并保留其他字幕，不把结构验证当回听。
text.en: At video-assemble, compare approved copy, spoken-text records, adopted audio and current captions. Repair the actual wording or audio fault before timing. Use full-track replacement only on its supported route and preserve other cues; validation does not replace listening.

label.zh: 作者稿、实读、批准保护与分段复用
label.en: Author text, spoken text, approval protection and segment reuse

label.zh: 实际记录的作者文本与合成文本字段
完整字幕轨、绑定与内容检查边界
label.en: Complete subtitle tracks, binding and content-check limits

title.zh: AI配音太快怎么办：分开检查朗读和合成提速
title.en: How to Fix AI Voiceover That Speaks Too Fast

seo_title.zh: AI配音太快怎么办｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Fix AI Voiceover That Speaks Too Fast | ZenStory

description.zh: 分清原始朗读、整体提速与局部赶时间。附保留否定句的声音选择案例，放慢后重新核对画面窗口、字幕与实际成片。
description.en: Check raw delivery, global speed and local fitting. A worked example preserves a negation and rechecks picture timing, captions and the final sound.

answer.zh: 先对比生成的分段声音与成片：原始声音就急，要调整朗读并重新生成；只有成片急，要查整体和局部提速。放慢后重新核对画面窗口与字幕，不能把最后几个字切掉。听起来清楚是选择标准，能塞进时长只是另一项检查。
answer.en: Compare the generated segment with the final video. If the source is rushed, revise delivery and regenerate. If only the final video is rushed, inspect global speed and local fitting. Recheck picture windows and captions after slowing it; do not cut off the last words. Intelligibility and duration are separate checks.

heading.zh: 先听分段声音，再听同一句的成片
heading.en: Listen to the source segment and the same line in the final video

body.zh:
选择一句含有人名、因果或否定的信息句，例如“他没有拿走钥匙”。不看字幕听一遍，再带字幕核对；如果只能靠字幕猜出“没有”，就不能用“时长已对齐”作为采用理由。

| 听到的问题 | 先检查什么 |
|---|---|
| 原始分段也急，词与词挤在一起 | 原稿信息密度、朗读方式与当前引擎支持的控制。 |
| 分段清楚，整条成片都急 | 合成时有没有再次整体提速。 |
| 只有某句在成片里急 | 该句是否为了放进较短画面窗口而局部提速。 |
| 声音清楚，但画面已切到下个动作 | 重新安排窗口；不是继续加速的充分理由。 |

不要只在编辑器里降预览播放速度。那能帮助定位，导出的成片仍可能使用原来的声音处理。保留原始分段，和新的候选成片比较同一句。
body.en:
Choose an information-bearing sentence with a name, cause or negation, such as “He did not take the key.” Listen without captions, then check with them. If the negation is only recoverable from captions, aligned duration is not enough to adopt the sound.

| What you hear | What to check first |
|---|---|
| The source is rushed too | Information density, delivery and controls supported by the selected engine. |
| The source is clear but the whole video is rushed | Additional global acceleration during assembly. |
| Only one final line is rushed | Local acceleration to fit a shorter picture window. |
| Speech is clear but picture moves to the next action | Revise the window; this alone does not justify more acceleration. |

Slowing preview playback can help diagnosis, but the export may still use the original processing. Keep the generated segment and compare the same line in a new candidate export.

heading.zh: 把生成语速和合成速度分别说明
heading.en: Specify generation delivery and assembly speed separately

body.zh:
原生方法把生成时的语速请求、整体变速和段内适配分开记录。旧的普通合成路径有整体速度默认值；已明确采用的配音则以独立确认的速度策略为准，环境里的默认速度不能覆盖它。

给执行者的要求可以是：“先保留这份已听过的声音；合成不再整体提速，也不为塞进窗口额外加速。若完整声音放不下，先告诉我需要调整哪段画面，不裁尾，不改已定文字。”明确采用的策略可用`global_atempo: 1.0`和`bounded_segment_fit: false`表达这两项选择；前者保持输入声音在合成时的速度，不能把已经急促的输入自动恢复成自然朗读。

如果原始声音就太快，再改生成环节。仓库按引擎分别处理：有的采用自身默认控制，有的把语速请求转成朗读提示。不要把“减速10%”承诺成所有引擎都精确执行的旋钮。先生成同一句候选、实际听过，再决定采用哪份。也不要靠大量感叹号或省略号碰运气，它们还可能改变语气和停顿。
body.en:
The native method records generation rate requests, global speed and segment fitting separately. The legacy assembly path has a global speed default. Explicitly adopted narration instead follows an independently selected tempo policy, which ambient defaults cannot override.

A useful request is: “Keep this audio I have listened to. Do not globally accelerate it or speed individual segments to squeeze them into windows. If complete speech does not fit, identify the picture interval that needs revision. Do not cut the tail or change approved words.” An adoption can express these choices as `global_atempo: 1.0` and `bounded_segment_fit: false`. The former keeps the input’s speed during assembly; it cannot repair an already rushed input.

If the source itself is too fast, revise generation. The repository handles engines differently: some use their own default controls, while some translate rate requests into delivery instructions. Do not promise that every engine implements an exact ten-percent reduction. Generate a candidate of the same line, listen, and choose. Extra exclamation marks or ellipses can also change tone and pauses; they are not a reliable universal speed dial.

heading.zh: 完整示例：让“没有拿走”听得清楚
heading.en: Complete example: make the negation audible

body.zh:
以下是纸面教学案例，没有在本文生成或测听音频。原创画面：林澈从柜台移开手，钥匙仍放在白盘里；旁白定稿为“他没有拿走钥匙，只把借用时间改到明早。”本例假设作者试听原始分段认为清楚，但成片里的“没有”太急，容易听成拿走。

排查记录显示这段输入长6秒，画面窗口有7秒（含原先设计的1秒段末留白），合成又做了整体`1.15`倍提速。仅按理想比例计算，6 ÷ 1.15约为5.22秒；这是解释速度变化的算式，不是实际导出测量，也不能由数字证明哪个词一定听不清。本例未记录局部再提速，不凭空加一个原因。

作者选择保留原始声音，把该段合成速度设为`1.0`，关闭额外段内适配，重新做候选。在纸面安排中，画面窗口保留7秒，让完整6秒声音后仍有原先设计的1秒留白；字幕按实际采用声音重新定位，不沿用5.22秒的估算时间。画面仍是手移开、钥匙未动，不为赶旁白新增取走动作。

如果实际素材只剩5秒窗口，就不能同时声称完整6秒声音保持原速又已经放下。先由作者决定能否延长或重排画面；如果画面不可改、文字可改，再提出保留“没有拿走”和次日借用安排的压缩候选，确认后重新配音。文字也不可改时，原生明确采用策略会阻止超窗，不暗中加速或切词。

最后要听新成片，确认否定句、人名和句尾仍清楚，声音对应钥匙未动的画面，字幕对应这份声音。本文给的是定位和选择步骤，不把纸面安排写成已通过的声音质量结果。
body.en:
This is a paper teaching example; no audio was generated or auditioned for this article. In the original picture, Lin Che withdraws his hand from a counter while the key remains on a white dish. The approved line is “He did not take the key. He only changed the borrowing time to tomorrow morning.” Assume the author finds the generated segment clear but hears a rushed negation in the final video.

The example’s records show a six-second input, a seven-second picture window including a previously designed one-second end pause, and additional global acceleration of `1.15` during assembly. Ideal division gives 6 ÷ 1.15, approximately 5.22 seconds. This explains the speed change; it is not a measured export or proof that any particular word becomes unclear. No additional segment acceleration was recorded, so do not invent it as a cause.

The author chooses the source sound, sets assembly speed to `1.0`, disables additional segment fitting, and makes a candidate. The paper arrangement retains the seven-second window, allowing the full six-second sound followed by its previously designed one-second pause. Captions are positioned against the actually adopted sound, rather than the estimated 5.22 seconds. The hand still withdraws and the key stays put; no taking action is added to hurry the line.

If real footage offers only five seconds, six seconds of complete speech cannot also fit at its original speed. The author first decides whether to extend or rearrange picture. If picture is fixed but words may change, propose a shorter candidate preserving the negation and tomorrow’s borrowing arrangement, then regenerate after approval. If words are fixed too, the native explicit adoption policy blocks the overlong segment instead of secretly accelerating or cutting words.

Listen to the new final video. Check the negation, name and ending, the unchanged key in picture, and captions against that selected sound. These are diagnosis and choice steps, not a claim that the paper arrangement has passed an audio-quality test.

heading.zh: 最后采用的是哪份声音，必须再听
heading.en: Listen to the sound you actually adopt

body.zh:
只调一个已定位的环节，再比较同一句，避免把声线、文字、语速、画面同时换掉后无法判断原因。保留定稿文字和所选声音对应关系；速度改变会影响字幕和原声重叠，核对句尾有没有压住必须听见的台词或动作声。

原生记录能说明哪些输入和速度策略进入合成，不能代替直接试听，也不能证明引擎身份、声线自然或已经获准发布。低于某个速度上限同样不保证易懂：名字密集、信息跳跃或句子太长，可能需要作者批准文字调整。

若你的问题是同一旁白超出画面，继续看[配音超时处理](/video-recap/fit-voiceover-to-a-picture-edit)；若提速后声调变怪，看[速度与音高检查](/video-recap/fix-pitch-changes-after-speeding-audio)。本页重点是声音已经急到影响理解时，如何定位并采用可听清的版本。
body.en:
Change one identified stage, then compare the same line. Changing voice, text, speed and picture together makes the cause harder to assess. Keep the approved words linked to the selected sound. Speed changes affect captions and original-audio overlap; check that endings do not cover dialogue or action sounds that must remain audible.

Native records show which inputs and tempo policy entered assembly. They do not replace listening or prove provider identity, natural delivery or release approval. A speed below a configured limit is not a guarantee of intelligibility. Dense names, information jumps or long sentences may require an author-approved text revision.

For speech that exceeds picture duration, see [fitting voiceover to picture](/video-recap/fit-voiceover-to-a-picture-edit). For an altered voice after acceleration, see [speed and pitch checks](/video-recap/fix-pitch-changes-after-speeding-audio). This page focuses on locating rushed speech and selecting a version listeners can understand.

q.zh: 调成1倍就一定自然吗？
q.en: Does 1× guarantee natural speech?

a.zh: 不保证。它只能避免合成时额外整体提速；原始声音已经急，仍需调整朗读、重新生成并试听。
a.en: No. It avoids additional global acceleration during assembly. A rushed input still needs revised delivery, regeneration and listening.

q.zh: 慢下来放不进画面怎么办？
q.en: What if slower speech no longer fits?

a.zh: 先确认画面能否调整；若文字可改，批准压缩后重新配音。画面和文字都锁定时，不暗中提速或截断完整句子。
a.en: First consider a picture revision. If words may change, approve a shorter version and regenerate. If both are locked, do not secretly speed up or truncate the sentence.

text.zh: 合成阶段将分段声音与速度策略落实到时间线；先定位生成、整体与局部三处，明确选择声音后再核成片。
text.en: Assembly places segment audio under a tempo policy. Locate generation, global speed and local fitting, select the sound, then check the final video.

label.zh: 生成环节按引擎区分语速控制
整体速度与累计提速预算
label.en: Global speed and cumulative tempo budget

label.zh: 整体提速与段内适配分别处理
label.en: Separate global acceleration and segment fitting

label.zh: 明确采用的速度策略与试听边界
label.en: Explicit adopted tempo policy and listening limits

title.zh: AI写小说视角乱跳怎么办：人称与知情范围分别改
title.en: How to Fix Viewpoint Drift in AI Fiction

seo_title.zh: AI写小说视角乱跳怎么办｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Fix Viewpoint Drift in AI Fiction | ZenStory

description.zh: 区分人称混用、进入他人内心和提前知道后文。附封口信改写：保留事件与作者设定，不靠虚构观察或记忆补救视角。
description.en: Separate pronoun drift, access to other minds and premature knowledge. A sealed-letter revision keeps events intact without inventing observations or memories.

answer.zh: 先明确本场由谁观察、采用什么人称、读者此刻能知道什么，再逐句查事实来源。改“我／他”只能修人称，不能消除进入别人内心或提前揭底。保留作者设定，把当前视角无从知道的信息暂不叙述；不为保住原句新增听说、回忆或偷看。
answer.en: Name the viewpoint character, narrative person and what readers may know now, then check each claim’s source. Replacing “I” with “he” fixes pronouns, not access to other minds or future facts. Keep the author’s facts while withholding information this viewpoint cannot access. Do not invent overhearing, memories or peeking to rescue a sentence.

heading.zh: 先分清人称错了，还是信息越界
heading.en: Separate narrative person from information access

body.zh:
同一场本来用陆遥第一人称，突然写“陆遥拿起信”，可能是人称不一致；写“林姝想着母亲一定会原谅她”，则进入了另一人的内心。把后一句改成“我看出她想着……”仍然没交代陆遥如何得知。

| 问题 | 修订方向 |
|---|---|
| 我、他和人物姓名混成不同叙述姿态 | 按本场选定人称调整；对白里的自称不能机械替换。 |
| 从观察中心跳进另一人的私密感受 | 找实际说话或可观察依据；没有来源就暂不叙述。 |
| 直接宣布尚未发生的结果 | 对照本章揭示与停点，不用未来事实替当前悬念作答。 |
| 作者本来采用全知或有意切换 | 检查是否符合已定安排，不一律改成限知。 |

人物可以猜测别人的动机，但句子要保留猜测的身份。动作能支持一种解释，也可能有其他解释；“她握紧信封”不自动证明信里是什么。
body.en:
If a scene uses Lu Yao’s first person and suddenly says “Lu picked up the letter,” the narrative person may have drifted. “Lin Shu thought her mother would forgive her” instead enters someone else’s mind. Replacing it with “I could tell she thought…” still leaves the knowledge source unexplained.

| Problem | Revision direction |
|---|---|
| Mixed I, he and names imply different narration | Restore this scene’s chosen person; do not mechanically replace self-reference inside dialogue. |
| Narration enters another person’s private feelings | Find actual speech or observable support; otherwise withhold the claim. |
| An unoccurred result is announced | Follow this chapter’s reveal boundary and stopping point. |
| Omniscience or a switch was intentional | Check the accepted arrangement instead of forcing limited viewpoint. |

Characters may infer motives, but preserve the status of an inference. An action can support several explanations. Gripping an envelope does not establish its contents.

heading.zh: 把本场选择说清楚，不重定整本书
heading.en: Specify this scene without redefining the whole book

body.zh:
Oh Story按表达维度采用当前要求、本书文风与有效作者偏好，参考文件的默认视角建议不能压过作者已经选定的第一人称。取本书文风全文，说明本次修哪一场；旧摘要和另一书的安排都不能代替它。

可以给AI这段请求：“只修第六章柜台场面，用陆遥第一人称限知。保留林姝放下封口信、陆遥查看封面地址和本章停在信未寄出；陆遥不知道信的正文、林姝昨夜经历或母亲将如何回应。不新增偷看、听说和提前告知，不改其他场景。”

如果本来要换到林姝，先按作者选择安排明确场景分隔，并核对读者此刻是否允许知道她的秘密。加一道分隔线只是标示切换，不能自动批准原定后面才揭示的信息。
body.en:
Oh Story resolves expression dimensions using the current request, book style and active author preferences. A reference’s default viewpoint advice cannot override chosen first person. Read the full book-local style and name the scene being repaired; neither an old summary nor another book’s arrangement replaces it.

A request could be: “Repair only chapter six’s counter scene in Lu Yao’s limited first person. Keep Lin putting down a sealed letter, Lu checking the address on its face, and the chapter ending before posting. Lu does not know its body, Lin’s previous night or her mother’s response. Add no peeking, overhearing or early disclosure; leave other scenes alone.”

If the author intends a switch to Lin, use a clear scene boundary and check whether readers may learn her secret now. A separator marks a switch; it does not approve information reserved for a later reveal.

heading.zh: 完整改写：封口信仍然没有被读过
heading.en: Complete revision: the sealed letter stays unread

body.zh:
原创作者设定：林姝写信向母亲道歉，但这场不揭示正文，也不写母亲回应。陆遥在柜台前接到她放下的封口信，只核对封面地址，尚未寄出。待改文字是：“林姝把信放在柜台。她终于敢向母亲道歉，昨夜的愧疚还没有散。陆遥拿起信，他替她难过。我知道她等的只是母亲一句原谅。”

这里既把第一人称写成了第三人称，又直接公布陆遥不知道的道歉、昨夜感受和期待。后两项也不能因为作者知道信是道歉信，就自动视为已定事实。改成：

> 林姝把封口信放在柜台，手还压着右下角。
>
> “地址看得清吗？”她问。
>
> 我等她挪开手，拿起信，只看了封面。
>
> “看得清。现在寄吗？”
>
> 她把信接回去：“再等一会儿。”
>
> 我松开手。信回到她手里，封口没有拆。柜台后的袋子还空着，我没有替她把信放进去。

这段对话与收回信的动作是本文作者选定的局部示范，不冒充既有小说事实。正式修现有稿时，若“收回、暂不寄”不在原细纲，先保留原本动作与停点，只修人称和越界叙述，不自行用本文结尾替换。示例的“尚未寄出”没有被改成已经送达、母亲原谅或双方和好。

“向母亲道歉”仍保留在作者设定里，本场不叙述它。陆遥只回答封面字能看清，不因此读到正文。林姝要再等，理由仍未知；不添“我以前就听她提过母亲”来合理化原来的全知句。
body.en:
Original author facts: Lin writes an apology to her mother, but this scene reveals neither the body nor the mother’s response. At a counter, Lu receives the sealed letter she puts down and only checks the address. It has not been posted. Faulty prose says: “Lin put the letter down. She finally dared apologize to her mother, still guilty from last night. Lu picked it up; he felt sorry for her. I knew she wanted only her mother’s forgiveness.”

The passage mixes first and third person and announces an apology, overnight feelings and expectations Lu cannot know. The last two are not established merely because the author knows the letter is an apology. A candidate revision is:

> Lin placed the sealed letter on the counter, keeping her hand on its lower-right corner.
>
> “Can you read the address?” she asked.
>
> I waited for her hand to move, picked it up, and looked only at the face.
>
> “Yes. Shall we post it now?”
>
> She took it back. “Give it a little longer.”
>
> I let go. The letter returned to her hand, still sealed. The bag behind the counter stayed empty; I did not put it inside for her.

The exchange and retrieval are this article’s chosen local demonstration, not facts from an existing novel. When repairing an existing manuscript, if retrieval and waiting are absent from its outline, keep its actions and stopping point while correcting person and unauthorized narration. Do not substitute this example’s ending. “Not posted yet” never becomes delivery, forgiveness or reconciliation.

The apology remains an author fact, withheld here. Lu confirms legible writing on the face without reading the body. Lin’s reason for waiting remains unknown. Do not invent a prior conversation about her mother to justify the faulty omniscient claim.

heading.zh: 改完读相邻两段，不自动改成另一种小说
heading.en: Read the adjacent passages after the local repair

body.zh:
检查修订段前后谁在说、谁在观察，已发生事件和持物是否一致。删去越界句后，保留让当前行动成立的可见信息，不把场景删成无从理解的谜语。

修人称时，核对对白、书信引用、回忆与叙述的边界；人物说“我”并不等于叙述者也换了。修知情时，追问“这句话来自所见、听到、已知，还是推测”，不能只搜索几个代词验收。

整本书的视角选择看[小说视角取舍](/oh-story/narrative-point-of-view)；多个表达维度都变了，看[AI小说文风不一致](/oh-story/fix-inconsistent-ai-novel-prose-style)。本页处理已经选好叙述姿态后，一场里的人称与信息漂移。
body.en:
Check who speaks and observes before and after the repair, along with occurred events and item custody. Removing unauthorized narration should retain the visible information needed to understand the action, rather than turning the scene into an unreadable riddle.

For person changes, distinguish dialogue, quoted letters, recollections and narration. A character saying “I” does not switch the narrator. For knowledge, ask whether each claim comes from observation, speech, established knowledge or inference. Searching pronouns alone cannot validate it.

For book-level choice, see [narrative viewpoint](/oh-story/narrative-point-of-view). If several expression dimensions changed, see [inconsistent AI prose style](/oh-story/fix-inconsistent-ai-novel-prose-style). This page repairs a scene’s person and knowledge after the narrative stance has already been chosen.

q.zh: 能把全部“她”换成“我”吗？
q.en: Can I replace every “she” with “I”?

a.zh: 不能。先分清叙述、对白与不同人物；机械替换会改说话者或事实，也不能修复无从知道的内心信息。
a.en: No. Distinguish narration, dialogue and different characters. Mechanical replacement can change speakers or facts and does not repair inaccessible thoughts.

q.zh: 全知视角也要只写一个人所见吗？
q.en: Must omniscience stay within one person’s observations?

a.zh: 不用。按作者已经选定的叙述安排检查；全知与切换同样要守本章揭示边界，不能因改稿临时提前揭底。
a.en: No. Follow the author’s chosen narration. Omniscience and switches still respect the chapter’s reveal boundary instead of advancing a secret during repair.

text.zh: 指定本场人称、观察中心与揭示边界，按本书文风修局部表达，保留事实和停点。
text.en: Specify this scene’s person, viewpoint and reveal boundary. Follow book-local style while preserving facts and the stopping point.

label.zh: 视角按作者选择与事实边界裁决
label.en: Resolve viewpoint with author choice and factual boundaries

label.zh: 不同叙述姿态与明确切换

title.zh: 双男主长篇怎么写：外部目标与关系一起推进
title.en: How to Write a Dual Male Lead Novel

seo_title.zh: 双男主长篇怎么写｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Write a Dual Male Lead Novel | ZenStory

description.zh: 先定两人的目标差异与外部任务，再写合作、误判和公开选择。附戏团名单纠错场面，关系变化有行动依据，不靠固定性格或每章撒糖。
description.en: Connect two distinct goals to an external plot. A theater-credit scene shows cooperation, public choices and costs without fixed roles or affection quotas.

answer.zh: 先让两人各自有想完成和不愿牺牲的事，再用同一外部任务逼出合作、取舍与关系变化。主线给相处一个必须发生的理由，关系又改变解决任务的方法。不要只给两人分配冷与热，也不要把一次维护直接写成所有矛盾已经解决。
answer.en: Give each lead a goal and something he will not sacrifice, then use a shared external task to produce cooperation, trade-offs and relationship change. The plot makes interaction necessary; the relationship changes how the task is handled. Opposite temperaments alone are insufficient, and one act of support does not settle every conflict.

heading.zh: 先写两个人要什么，再写他们为何同处
heading.en: Write two goals and a reason they must interact

body.zh:
Oh Story的长篇双男主题材卡把外部压力、不同目标与互相误读连在一起。关系不只是插在主线间隙的糖，主线也不能把两人的反应吞掉。
