原创戏团故事：余澈负责今晚入场安排，想按时开门，不愿向观众作无法兑现的承诺；沈弈负责演出名单，想改正导师被漏记的贡献，不愿把别人的劳动算到自己名下。他们需要交同一份最终名单，但余澈担心重做耽误入场，沈弈担心按错稿印出后更难纠正。

| 人物 | 本场真正的取舍 |
|---|---|
| 余澈 | 接受核实与通知成本，还是把争议留到散场以后。 |
| 沈弈 | 提交可核对记录，还是只要求对方相信自己；改正名字后仍要承担排版。 |

两人都不是来替对方完成全部工作的工具。性格差异可以从证据观、公开范围和处理时间压力的方法显现，不必固定成一个永远冷、另一个永远闹。
body.en:
Oh Story’s long-form dual-lead card connects external pressure, different goals and misreading. Affection need not be a decoration between plot beats, and the external plot must leave room for each man’s response.

Original theater story: Yu Che handles tonight’s admission. He wants doors opened on time and will not promise spectators something the team cannot deliver. Shen Yi handles credits. He wants his mentor’s omitted contribution corrected and will not accept someone else’s work under his name. They must deliver one final list. Yu fears redoing it will delay admission; Shen fears a wrong printed version will be harder to correct.

| Lead | This scene’s actual trade-off |
|---|---|
| Yu | Accept verification and notification costs, or defer the dispute until after the show. |
| Shen | Supply checkable records rather than demand belief; still handle layout after correction. |

Neither man exists to do all the other’s work. Differences can emerge through evidence, disclosure and handling time pressure, rather than fixed cold-versus-rowdy personalities.

heading.zh: 同一件事要改变任务，也改变关系
heading.en: Let one event change the task and the relationship

body.zh:
写大纲时，先说明一次事件之后任务到了哪里，两人因此怎样重新判断对方。关系变化可以是开始愿意合作、明确拒绝一种控制、撤回误判或在公开场合支持一个选择，不必每章都有告白。

| 阶段 | 外部事件与关系承接 |
|---|---|
| 前期 | 同交名单时暴露分歧；余澈原以为沈弈在抢功，核对记录后修正这个判断。 |
| 中期 | 两人合作补遗漏，却仍对能否公开私人材料有分歧；拒绝越界后改用获准记录，合作没有靠牺牲一人的底线维持。 |
| 后期 | 正式场合按核实贡献分署；余澈承担通知，沈弈承担改稿，彼此维护来自真实选择。 |

这是本例的长篇方向，不是已经写完的三段剧情。正式开写只交当前章的发生、禁止发生和停点，不让AI一次把后面的公开选择、亲密关系与结局全写完。

题材卡建议主线与关系都保持变化，但不把它变成每章配额。按本书细纲和文风安排缓冲、独处和日常；过去发生的帮助要被后来回应，而不是用新增危机强行凑两个“变化”。
body.en:
When outlining, state where an event leaves the task and how the leads reassess each other. Change can mean willingness to cooperate, rejecting control, withdrawing a mistaken judgment or publicly supporting a choice. A confession every chapter is unnecessary.

| Phase | Plot and relationship |
|---|---|
| Early | Joint credit delivery exposes disagreement. Yu initially reads Shen as claiming credit; checking the record revises that judgment. |
| Middle | Cooperation corrects omissions but disagreement remains over private material. Refusing unauthorized disclosure leads them to permitted records instead of preserving cooperation by sacrificing a boundary. |
| Late | Verified contributions receive the proper credits in a formal setting. Yu handles notification and Shen revision; mutual support follows actual choices. |

This is the example’s long-form direction, not three completed stretches of story. Drafting receives only the current chapter’s required events, prohibitions and stopping point, rather than writing later public support, intimacy and the ending at once.

The card recommends movement in plot and relationship without becoming a per-chapter quota. Use this book’s outline and style for recovery, solitude and everyday scenes. Earlier help should receive later responses, rather than inventing crises to fill two change boxes.

heading.zh: 完整场面：先核名单，再承担更正
heading.en: Complete scene: check credits and take responsibility for correction

body.zh:
原创本章设定：开门前还有二十分钟，名单尚未印发，桌上旧稿仍是内部文件。导师确有贡献，沈弈带来的是本项目先前已经确认的记录；本场允许观众知道这些记录，但不揭示中期的私人材料。导演有权批准入场安排，两名主角不能自行宣布无限延后。

> 余澈把名单推到沈弈面前：“这一版能交吗？”
>
> 沈弈没签。他在自己名字旁画了一条线，把那页排练记录压在名单边上。
>
> “这一段是谁改的，你看日期。”
>
> 余澈对照两份记录，指尖停在导师签名下：“是我看错了。我去叫导演确认。”
>
> 沈弈把笔拿起来：“确认后我改版。别说已经印了，它还在这儿。”
>
> 导演看完记录，划去错列的署名，补上导师贡献，并批准入场推迟十分钟。
>
> 余澈拿起手机，把更正后的入场时间发给门口同事：“通知我来。名单是我们这边没核全，别让观众去找他。”
>
> 门口同事回复：“收到，按新时间通知。”
>
> 沈弈看了他一眼，把更正稿放回键盘旁：“那我把这版交清楚。改完一起核，不要替我说已经好了。”
>
> “好。”余澈在旧稿上写了“作废”，收进文件夹。沈弈开始改排版。

这场已经完成记录核对、导演更正，门口同事收到新时间；同事通知观众、排版、印发和演出仍未完成。两人从互相疑虑走到具体分工，但沈弈仍要求不替他宣布完成，余澈也没有得到包办他工作的许可。

关系推进不靠旁白宣布“从此信任”。余澈承认误判并承担通知，沈弈接受这项分工但保留自己的边界。下一章继承新时间、更正署名和未完成的排版，不把旧错误复活，也不把此处直接接成全部和解或恋爱确认。
body.en:
Original chapter setup: doors are due to open in twenty minutes. Credits have not been printed or distributed; the old draft is internal. The mentor really contributed, and Shen brings records already confirmed in this fictional project. Readers may see these records here, but not the middle arc’s private material. The director approves admission changes; neither lead can announce an unlimited delay.

> Yu pushed the list toward Shen. “Can this version go?”
>
> Shen did not sign. He marked the entry beside his own name and placed a rehearsal record against the list.
>
> “Check the date. Who revised this passage?”
>
> Yu compared the records. His finger stopped beneath the mentor’s signature. “I read it wrong. I’ll ask the director to confirm.”
>
> Shen picked up the pen. “After confirmation, I revise the layout. Don’t say it’s printed. It’s still here.”
>
> The director checked the record, removed the mistaken credit, added the mentor’s contribution, and approved opening ten minutes later.
>
> Yu sent the revised admission time to the colleague at the entrance. “I’ll handle the notice. We failed to check the list. Don’t send spectators to him.”
>
> The entrance colleague replied, “Received. I’ll notify people using the new time.”
>
> Shen glanced at him and set the corrected draft by the keyboard. “Then I deliver this version properly. We check together when it’s revised. Don’t say it’s finished for me.”
>
> “Agreed.” Yu marked the old draft “void” and filed it away. Shen began the layout revision.

Verification and the director’s correction are complete, and the entrance colleague has received the new time. Audience notification, layout, printing and the performance are not complete. The men move from suspicion to concrete cooperation, but Shen still refuses completion claims made for him; Yu has no permission to manage all his work.

The relationship advances without narration declaring permanent trust. Yu admits his mistaken reading and takes the notification cost. Shen accepts that division while keeping a boundary. The next chapter inherits the new time, corrected credit and unfinished layout. Do not revive the old error or jump to complete reconciliation or confirmed romance.

heading.zh: 检查两人是否都还有选择
heading.en: Check that both leads retain choices

body.zh:
试着删去其中一人：另一人是否仍能完成相同故事，只少了几句暧昧？如果是，补独立目标、筹码或必须由他决定的事，不用增加一次牺牲来证明重要。

交换两人的关键台词，看它们是否还完全成立。若余澈的入场承诺、沈弈的贡献边界都消失，只剩“嘴硬但心软”，人物需要具体理由，而不是更多口头禅。保护也应保留对方决定，不把替他发言、抢他的工作当成默认甜点。

长篇推进看本页；若要安排一场“嘴上立场与行动痕迹不同”的关系戏，继续看[双男主潜台词示例](/oh-story/dual-male-lead-subtext)。关系性质与亲密节奏按作者设定，不由题材卡自动决定。
body.en:
Remove one lead hypothetically. If the same story still works with only a few affectionate lines missing, add an independent goal, leverage or a decision that is his to make. More sacrifice is not the only way to establish importance.

Swap key lines. If Yu’s admission commitments and Shen’s contribution boundary disappear into generic gruff kindness, restore concrete reasons instead of more catchphrases. Protection should preserve the other man’s decisions; speaking or working for him is not automatically affectionate.

This page covers long-form progression. For a scene whose spoken position differs from observable action, see [dual-lead subtext](/oh-story/dual-male-lead-subtext). Relationship nature and intimacy follow the author’s settings rather than being automatically determined by a genre card.

q.zh: 必须一个冷一个热吗？
q.en: Must one lead be cold and the other warm?

a.zh: 不必。用目标、证据观、公开范围和压力下的选择区分他们；相似性格也能在同一件事上作不同决定。
a.en: No. Distinguish goals, evidence, disclosure and choices under pressure. Similar temperaments can make different decisions about one event.

q.zh: 每章都要撒糖吗？
q.en: Does every chapter need an affectionate beat?

a.zh: 不设配额。让相处与主线有因果联系，日常、分歧和恢复都可以有作用；关键选择后来要得到真实回应。
a.en: There is no quota. Connect interaction causally to the plot. Everyday scenes, disagreement and recovery can matter; later responses should remember key choices.

text.zh: 用长篇双男主题材卡核对外部压力、目标差异与关系变化，遵守本书文风和当前章边界。
text.en: Use the long-form dual-lead card to connect external pressure, differing goals and relationship movement under book style and chapter boundaries.

label.zh: 长篇双男主的外部压力与关系推进
label.en: External pressure and relationship progression for long-form dual leads

label.zh: 作者文风与事实揭示边界
label.en: Author style and factual reveal boundaries

title.zh: AI小说封面像真人照片怎么办：先明确插画画法
title.en: How to Make an AI Book Cover Look Illustrated

seo_title.zh: AI小说封面像真人照片怎么办｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Make an AI Book Cover Look Illustrated | ZenStory

description.zh: 把绘画媒介与题材、人物、排版分开说明，清理棚拍与写实摄影要求。附修伞人完整封面简报，保留人物、书名和笔名，再比较实际候选。
description.en: Separate painted style from genre, character and type. A complete umbrella-maker brief preserves the subject, title and byline while changing the medium.

answer.zh: 先确认作者要的是哪种插画，再检查提示词和参考图是否仍要求棚拍、摄影皮肤或写实镜头效果。把绘画方式写清楚，同时保留人物身份、题材、构图、书名和笔名。改变画法不等于换人物；收到候选后看实际图，不凭一个“插画”标签宣布成功。
answer.en: Choose the intended illustration style, then check whether prompts and references still ask for studio photography, photographic skin or lens effects. Specify the painted medium while preserving identity, genre, composition, title and byline. A medium change is not a new character; inspect the actual candidate rather than trusting an “illustration” label.

heading.zh: 题材相同，也可能画法不同
heading.en: The same story can use different visual media

body.zh:
都市日常、悬疑或仙侠是故事方向，数字绘画、线稿插画和摄影则是表现方式。封面内容符合题材，仍可能因为画法不合作者选择而需要修订。照片本身不是错误；本页处理作者已经选定插画、输出却像照片的情况。

Oh Story的封面方法把文字、风格与画面分层，并明确用绘画表达替换摄影感。先说出可观察的选择，例如较大的色块、可见笔触、简化材质边缘与清楚轮廓，不只写“二次元一点”“不要像真人”。

不必同时改头身比例、人物年龄和整个场景。先确认哪项才是作者要换的画法；夸张比例、柔和水彩或细腻厚涂是不同候选，不要把它们一股脑塞进同一次要求。
body.en:
Contemporary life, mystery and fantasy describe story direction. Digital painting, line illustration and photography describe visual medium. A cover can fit the genre yet need revision because its medium differs from the author’s choice. Photography itself is not an error; this page concerns an intended illustration that came out photographic.

Oh Story separates text, style and image content and explicitly uses painted expression in place of photographic cues. Name visible choices such as broad color masses, brush texture, simplified material edges and clear contours, rather than only asking for “more anime.”

Do not automatically change proportions, age and the entire location together. Exaggeration, soft watercolor and detailed opaque painting are different candidates, not a bundle of requirements to combine blindly.

heading.zh: 清理互相打架的风格和参考用途
heading.en: Remove conflicting directions and clarify reference roles

body.zh:
检查有没有一边要求`digital painting style`，一边又要求棚拍人像、照片级皮肤毛孔或真实镜头散景。把不符合本次画法的要求撤掉，换成选定的绘画表现；照明方向可以保留，不必因去摄影感就把人物压成没有明暗的平面。

参考图也要说明用途。如果它只供面部、衣着和构图参考，就不要同时让执行者完整复制其中的摄影材质。若它是要编辑的基底，先查看作者选定的那版，再点名应保留的身份、人数、持物、标题和裁切。

原生封面流程分别保存候选，不覆盖已选版本。只改色调却继续保留全部摄影要求，通常还没有落实这次媒介选择；反过来，把人物换成年轻模特，也不是保住身份的风格修订。
body.en:
Check whether `digital painting style` competes with studio portraiture, photographic pores or lens bokeh. Withdraw directions that oppose the selected medium and replace them with its visible treatment. Lighting direction can remain; removing photography does not require flattening every light and shadow.

Specify reference use too. A face, clothing or composition reference need not also dictate photographic materials. If an image is the editing base, inspect the author’s selected version and name identity, count, held objects, title and crop to preserve.

The native cover workflow saves distinct candidates. Changing only color while retaining all photographic instructions does not implement the medium choice. Replacing the person with a younger model is also not an identity-preserving style revision.

heading.zh: 完整简报：《街角修伞人》保留什么，改变什么
heading.en: Complete brief: keep the umbrella-maker story, change its medium

body.zh:
原创小说《街角修伞人》，笔名“夏树”，讲一位中年修伞人重新开门做小生意的都市日常。作者选定2:3竖版、数字绘画、有笔触而不过度卡通的方向。原先的纸面方案已经有深蓝工作衫、一把闭合的红伞、店门和暖灯，但写了“studio portrait, photorealistic skin”。这里没有真实封面，示例展示如何修简报。

保留这位人物的中年外观、短深色头发、工作衫和原来的站姿；不是因为改插画就给他换脸、减龄或加盔甲。背景仍是同一家街角小店。可以交付完整新候选：

> Author-selected 2:3 portrait digital-painted cover for a warm contemporary story about a middle-aged umbrella repairer reopening his corner shop. One middle-aged man with short dark hair and a worn navy work shirt stands just inside the doorway, holding one closed red umbrella upright in his right hand; his left hand rests on the door handle. Preserve the selected character identity, middle-aged appearance, clothing, pose and umbrella count when using the author’s chosen image as a reference. Use broad painted color masses, visible brush texture and simplified fabric edges with believable anatomy. A warm doorway lamp lights him from above; keep the shop interior quieter than the figure and umbrella. Title exactly '街角修伞人' in clear cream lettering in a quiet upper area; byline exactly '夏树' in smaller readable lettering below. Keep both inside the retained canvas. The requested medium is digital painting, with no photographic skin rendering, studio backdrop, added people, slogan or watermark. Save a separate candidate.

若实际基底里的手或门把位置与本示例不同，就按作者选定基底改写保持项，不能把这段模板的姿态当成原图事实。没有真实参考图时，按文本建立候选；有图时先确认它控制身份、构图还是整图编辑。

出图后分别看画法、人物与文字：笔触和材质是否落实，年龄与红伞是否保留，书名笔名是否准确；再核准备上传那版的裁剪和实际小图表现。本例没有生成图片，也没有把简报里的要求当成已通过的成图结果。
body.en:
The original contemporary novel `街角修伞人`, by `夏树`, follows a middle-aged umbrella repairer reopening his small business. The author selects 2:3 portrait digital painting with brush texture rather than heavy cartoon exaggeration. A paper concept already includes a navy work shirt, one closed red umbrella, a shop entrance and warm light, but asks for “studio portrait, photorealistic skin.” No real cover exists here; the example revises the brief.

Keep the man’s middle-aged appearance, short dark hair, work shirt and selected stance. Changing medium does not authorize a new face, de-aging or armor. The corner shop remains the same. A complete candidate request is:

> Author-selected 2:3 portrait digital-painted cover for a warm contemporary story about a middle-aged umbrella repairer reopening his corner shop. One middle-aged man with short dark hair and a worn navy work shirt stands just inside the doorway, holding one closed red umbrella upright in his right hand; his left hand rests on the door handle. Preserve the selected character identity, middle-aged appearance, clothing, pose and umbrella count when using the author’s chosen image as a reference. Use broad painted color masses, visible brush texture and simplified fabric edges with believable anatomy. A warm doorway lamp lights him from above; keep the shop interior quieter than the figure and umbrella. Title exactly '街角修伞人' in clear cream lettering in a quiet upper area; byline exactly '夏树' in smaller readable lettering below. Keep both inside the retained canvas. The requested medium is digital painting, with no photographic skin rendering, studio backdrop, added people, slogan or watermark. Save a separate candidate.

If a real base image places hands or the handle differently, revise the preserve set to match the author’s actual selection instead of calling the template’s pose an observed fact. With no real reference, establish a candidate from text. With a reference, determine whether it controls identity, composition or editing of the whole image.

Inspect medium, person and type separately: painted materials, retained age and umbrella, exact title and byline, then upload-candidate crop and small-display appearance. No image was generated for this example, and brief requirements are not a verified image result.

heading.zh: 看实际候选，不用换一串风格词代替检查
heading.en: Inspect the candidate instead of replacing a string of style words

body.zh:
比较时保持同一书名、笔名和故事方向，才能判断这次画法是否更贴合作者选择。若只脸部仍像照片，就点名那一处表现与须保留的身份；若整图方向错误，再考虑重新做完整候选。

文字错误看[封面文字修订](/oh-story/fix-ai-book-cover-text)，缩小后难辨看[封面缩略图检查](/oh-story/make-a-book-cover-readable-as-a-thumbnail)。画法修订不能代替这两项检查，也不能用“高清”证明封面可读。
body.en:
Keep the same title, byline and story direction when comparing the chosen medium. If only the face remains photographic, name that region and its identity requirements. If the whole visual direction is wrong, consider a complete new candidate.

For incorrect lettering, see [cover-text revision](/oh-story/fix-ai-book-cover-text). For small-display problems, see [thumbnail checks](/oh-story/make-a-book-cover-readable-as-a-thumbnail). Medium revision does not replace either check, and high resolution alone does not prove legibility.

q.zh: 插画封面一定要卡通吗？
q.en: Must an illustrated cover be cartoonish?

a.zh: 不用。画法可以细腻，也可以简化；先选可观察的笔触、轮廓和材质表现，保留本书人物和气质。
a.en: No. Painting can be detailed or simplified. Choose visible treatment of brushwork, contours and materials while preserving the story’s character and tone.

q.zh: 加一句digital painting就够吗？
q.en: Is adding digital painting enough?

a.zh: 它是明确媒介的起点，不是保证。还要清理冲突的摄影要求、说明参考用途，并看实际候选是否符合选择。
a.en: It specifies a medium, not a guarantee. Remove conflicting photography instructions, define reference roles and inspect the actual candidate.

text.zh: 按文字、风格和画面分层明确绘画媒介，保住书名、笔名和主体，另存候选并实际检查。
text.en: Separate text, style and image content to specify the painted medium. Preserve title, byline and subject, save a candidate and inspect it.

label.zh: 封面分层、绘画表达与候选检查
label.en: Layered cover brief, painted expression and candidate inspection

label.zh: 绘画媒介、主体和背景层次
label.en: Painted medium, subject and background layers

title.zh: AI视频人物视线不对怎么办：先明确看谁、看哪里
title.en: How to Fix Wrong Eyelines in AI Video

seo_title.zh: AI视频人物视线不对怎么办｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Fix Wrong Eyelines in AI Video | ZenStory

description.zh: 分清人物朝向、眼睛落点和机位，把看人、看证据写成有触发的过程。附柜台蓝圈示例，保住身体、持物和终点，不让“向左看”替代对象。
description.en: Separate body direction, gaze target and camera position. A counter-scene brief moves attention from a person to a blue circle while preserving other states.

answer.zh: 先确认人物实际要看的人或物在本机位哪里，再分别写身体朝向、初始目光、触发与最后落点。不要只说“向左看”，也不要用运镜掩盖人物看错对象。起始帧已错时先修起点，起点正确而视频漂移时再修动作过程；得到片段后逐段核对实际目光。
answer.en: Locate the intended person or object in the selected camera view. Specify body direction, starting gaze, trigger and final target separately instead of only “look left.” If the starting frame is wrong, repair it first; if motion drifts from a correct start, revise the action. Check the actual generated segment rather than hiding an incorrect gaze with camera movement.

heading.zh: 先找对象，不先指定左右
heading.en: Locate the object before assigning left or right

body.zh:
同一个人站在柜台另一端，换机位后可能落在画面不同位置。人物身体朝右、脸偏向右、眼睛看向桌面，也不是同一项状态。先对着当前构图找目标：对方的脸、桌上蓝圈还是门外声音所在的门缝。

| 要说明的事 | 写得具体一点 |
|---|---|
| 看谁或什么 | 看钱叔的脸，或桌面纸张上已定的蓝圈。 |
| 在哪里 | 本镜钱叔在画面右侧；蓝圈在两人之间较低的桌面。 |
| 开始看哪里 | 安宁先看钱叔，不从已经低头读纸的状态开始。 |
| 谁触发变化 | 钱叔指向蓝圈后，她才把注意移到纸上。 |

正反打还要检查两镜方向与实际身高关系；不是把所有人都设成同一个平视角。具体机位改变后重新核对，别把上一机位的“左”直接复制到下一镜。
body.en:
The person across a counter can occupy a different screen position after a camera change. A right-facing body, a right-turned face and eyes looking down at paper are different states. Locate the target in this view: the other person’s face, a blue circle on the table, or a door gap where a sound came from.

| Decision | A concrete description |
|---|---|
| Target | Qian’s face, or the accepted blue circle on the paper. |
| Location | Qian is screen right; the circle is lower on the counter between them. |
| Starting gaze | An looks at Qian before looking down at the paper. |
| Trigger | Qian indicates the circle before she shifts attention. |

For shot/reverse-shot, match directions and actual height relationships rather than making everyone eye-level. Recheck after a camera change instead of copying the previous view’s “left.”

heading.zh: 先核起始帧，再修视线过程
heading.en: Check the starting frame before revising the motion

body.zh:
原生视频方法把已确认起点、终点、时长和对白作为只读边界。真实起始帧已经让人物看向镜头，却要求视频从看着对方开始，两项互相冲突；先返回分镜/关键帧，不能随便挑一个当准。

起点正确时，把目光变化接到已定触发，写清先看见指示，再把视线移到目标，头部怎样辅助，最后停在哪里。身体、手与道具未参与变化时保持原状态，别因“转头”让人物顺便转身、拿走纸或换位置。

只有真实起始图已输入，才可省掉它已经说明的静态外观。没有图片、只有分镜文字时，复制正文仍需人物、造型、场景、构图和光线，不把“同上”当作已经有参考帧。
body.en:
The native video method treats accepted starts, ends, duration and dialogue as read-only boundaries. A real start frame looking into camera conflicts with a required start looking at the partner. Resolve the storyboard/keyframe rather than arbitrarily choosing one.

With a correct start, connect gaze movement to the accepted trigger: receive the indication, move attention to the target, describe supporting head movement, and settle. Preserve body, hands and objects that do not participate. Turning the head must not also turn the body, take the paper or relocate the person.

Static appearance may be omitted only when a real start image is actually supplied. With text alone, the copyable prompt still needs person, look, setting, composition and light. “As above” is not a reference frame.

heading.zh: 完整示例：从钱叔的脸看到桌上蓝圈
heading.en: Complete example: from Qian’s face to the circle on the counter

body.zh:
纸面已定场面：安宁在画面左侧，钱叔在右侧且比她高；两人在同一柜台前，纸张平放于他们之间，蓝圈是已选画面标记，不包含可读文字。安宁先看钱叔的脸，钱叔指蓝圈后她低头看圈；她还不知道这个圈表示什么。本镜不递纸、不站起、不发现作伪者。作者选六秒固定双人中景，实际任务须匹配目标能力；这里没有起始图片，采用完整文生视频简报。

> 竖版生活化真人短剧。社区书店柜台内景，暖色顶灯，摄影机固定在入口一侧，双人中景同时保留两人的脸、双手和柜台上的纸。安宁是成年女性，短深色头发、深蓝工作衫，位于画面左侧，身体朝向右侧的钱叔。钱叔是成年男性，短灰发、浅灰外套，位于画面右侧，身体朝向安宁，站得比她高。纸张平放在两人之间，蓝圈位于安宁能看见的一面，无可读文字。安宁起点看着钱叔的脸，双手在自己一侧桌沿。钱叔左手食指原在纸边，右手留在自己一侧桌面。
> 六秒过程：钱叔左手食指从纸边移到蓝圈旁并停住，纸张位置不变；安宁接收到这项指示后，先把目光从钱叔的脸移到蓝圈，再略低头保持注视。她的身体仍朝钱叔，双手仍在原桌沿，钱叔保持位置。结束时她看着蓝圈，尚未作出解释；纸仍平放，手指仍指在圈旁，两人未换位。固定机位，无对白，不新增取纸、起身或看向镜头的动作。

这是本例选定的动作与视觉事实，不是已有图片的观察说明，也不是已生成视频。若使用真实图生视频起点，先核它是不是同一站位、同一纸面与初始目光，再减去已经由图明确承载的外观；不要因为参考只给脸，就把柜台和手的状态也全删掉。

检查候选时看三处：起点是否仍看钱叔、变化是否发生在指示之后、最后是否落到圈而非镜头。看圈只能证明注意对象变化，不证明她已经读到内容、理解秘密或知道谁作伪。下一镜按这个终点接，不回到未发生的拿纸状态。
body.en:
Accepted paper scene: An Ning is screen left and Qian is screen right and taller. A sheet lies flat between them on one counter. Its blue circle is a selected visual mark with no readable words. An initially looks at Qian’s face, then down at the circle after he indicates it. She does not know its meaning. No paper handoff, standing up or culprit discovery occurs. The author selects a fixed six-second two-shot; a real task must fit target capabilities. No start image exists here, so use a complete text-to-video brief.

> A vertical, restrained live-action community-bookshop scene under warm ceiling light. The camera stays on the entrance side in a medium two-shot retaining both faces, hands and the paper on the counter. An Ning is an adult woman with short dark hair and a navy work shirt, screen left with her body facing Qian. Qian is an adult man with short grey hair and a pale-grey jacket, screen right facing her and visibly taller. The sheet lies flat between them, with its blue circle on the face visible to An and no readable words. An initially looks at Qian’s face, both hands resting on her own counter edge. Qian’s left index finger starts beside the sheet; his right hand stays on his own side of the counter.
> Across six seconds, Qian moves his left index finger from the sheet edge to beside the blue circle and stops, leaving the sheet in place. After receiving this indication, An moves her gaze from his face to the circle, then slightly lowers her head and settles her attention there. Her body still faces Qian and both hands remain on the original edge. Qian keeps his position. At the end she looks at the circle without explaining it; the sheet is flat, the finger remains beside the circle and neither person has changed places. Fixed camera, no dialogue, and no added paper pickup, standing or gaze into camera.

These are selected example actions and visual facts, not an observation of an existing image or a generated video. For a real image-to-video start, verify the same placement, sheet and starting gaze before subtracting static details the image supplies. A face-only reference does not justify omitting the counter and hand states.

Check the candidate’s start, indication-triggered change and final gaze toward the circle rather than camera. Looking at it establishes changed attention, not reading, understanding a secret or discovering a culprit. Continue the next shot from this end instead of an unoccurred paper pickup.

heading.zh: 只修已定位的偏差，再看实际片段
heading.en: Repair the located deviation and inspect the segment

body.zh:
如果结尾目光不对，先查目标是否清楚、是否被手或画面裁切挡住，再修目标和落点；如果人物看人时方向不对，查当前机位与站位，不靠加“自然、专注”来补空间。

需要改已定机位、人物位置或事件时回到分镜，不在运动提示词里悄悄替换。只改眼神却同时改脸、服装、持物或关系解释的候选应重新处理。

复杂跨镜对话继续看[正反打连续性](/drama-skills/shot-reverse-shot-continuity)，表演无变化看[人物表情与反应](/drama-skills/character-performance-prompts)。本页先把这次注意到底落在哪个对象上写清楚。
body.en:
For an incorrect final gaze, check target clarity and obstruction by hands or crop, then revise its location and endpoint. For wrong person-to-person direction, check this camera and blocking. “Natural” or “focused” cannot substitute for space.

Changes to accepted camera, placement or events belong in the storyboard rather than being silently substituted in motion text. A gaze repair that also alters face, clothes, custody or relationship meaning needs correction.

For a multi-shot conversation, see [shot/reverse-shot continuity](/drama-skills/shot-reverse-shot-continuity). For unchanging performance, see [character reactions](/drama-skills/character-performance-prompts). This page first identifies the exact object of attention.

q.zh: 人物朝右就等于眼睛看右吗？
q.en: Does a right-facing body imply rightward gaze?

a.zh: 不等于。身体朝向、头部与目光落点分别说明，尤其看桌面证据时可能身体不动，只转移注意。
a.en: No. Specify body, head and gaze separately. Looking at evidence on a table may shift attention while the body stays put.

q.zh: 参考图已经看错，提示词能直接纠正起点吗？
q.en: Can motion text silently correct a wrong reference start?

a.zh: 先解决起点冲突。原生方法要求分镜和关键帧起点一致；运动描述不能随便把其中一项忽略。
a.en: Resolve the conflicting start first. The native method requires storyboard and keyframe starts to agree; motion text cannot simply ignore one.

text.zh: 按已定起点和终点写目光目标、触发与过程，保住身体和持物状态；机位变化再核屏幕方向。
text.en: Write gaze target, trigger and process within accepted starts and ends. Preserve body and custody and recheck screen direction after camera changes.

label.zh: 目光起点、有序变化与只读终点
label.en: Starting gaze, ordered motion and read-only endpoint

label.zh: 视线方向与实际身高的机位配对
label.en: Eyeline directions and camera pairing for actual heights

title.zh: AI写小说角色提前知道秘密怎么办：查清信息从哪里来
title.en: How to Stop AI Fiction Characters Knowing Secrets Too Soon

seo_title.zh: AI写小说角色提前知道秘密怎么办｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: When AI Characters Know Secrets Too Soon | ZenStory

description.zh: 区分作者事实、读者所知、角色听见和角色猜测。附面试保密与志愿轮班的完整返修，只改失去信息依据的对白和反应。
description.en: Separate author facts, reader knowledge and character evidence. A complete interview-and-rota repair preserves privacy and the actual shift agreement.

answer.zh: 先找角色第一次把秘密当确定事实说出或使用的句子，再查他实际看见、听见或被告知了什么。作者设定、读者看过和另一个角色知道，都不自动传给此人。只改失去依据的对白、判断与依赖反应；若作者要让他此刻知道，就明确选择真实的获知过程，并检查后文。
answer.en: Find the first line where a character states or uses the secret as a fact, then trace what they actually saw, heard or were told. Author notes, reader knowledge and another character’s knowledge do not automatically reach them. Repair unsupported dialogue, judgments and dependent reactions. An intended disclosure needs an actual acquisition path and later continuity checks.

heading.zh: 事实存在，不等于每个人都知道
heading.en: An existing fact is not everyone’s knowledge

body.zh:
同一件事可以同时处在几种不同位置：作者已经定了，读者已经看过，主角刚告诉室友，同事却还不知道。先分开这些位置，再判断某句对白是否越界。

Oh Story的细纲方法单列谁知道什么、读者知道什么、主角误判什么；人物当前快照也保存已知信息，时间线则分客观事实与读者认知。这些记录要对照正文，不能仅凭作者笔记就让所有人物接着说。

| 要分清的内容 | 面试例 |
|---|---|
| 作者事实 | 秦禾约了周六九点的本城培训项目面试，尚未参加。 |
| 读者与韩宁所知 | 前章实际写过秦禾私下告诉室友韩宁，韩宁答应保密。 |
| 唐遇所知 | 公开群里只说秦禾周六愿意帮借书站轮班，未定时段。 |
| 尚无依据 | 唐遇知道面试、地点或结果；韩宁知道后来的排班回应。 |

全知叙述可以给读者更多信息，仍不替人物完成听见或被告知。把叙述中的“她有面试”删掉，也不能修好唐遇口中的“你九点面试”。
body.en:
One fact can occupy different positions: the author has established it, readers have seen it, the protagonist has told a roommate, and a colleague still knows nothing. Separate those positions before judging a line.

Oh Story’s chapter outline distinguishes character knowledge, reader knowledge and protagonist misjudgment. Character snapshots store known information; the timeline separates objective facts from reader understanding. Compare these records with prose rather than letting everyone speak from author notes.

| Distinction | Interview example |
|---|---|
| Author fact | Qin He has a local training-program interview at nine on Saturday. It has not happened. |
| Readers and Han Ning | The previous chapter shows Qin privately telling her roommate, who agrees to keep it private. |
| Tang Yu | A public group message says Qin can help at the lending station on Saturday, without a time. |
| Unsupported | Tang knows the interview, location or result; Han knows the later rota response. |

An omniscient narrator may inform readers without informing characters. Removing “she has an interview” from narration does not repair Tang’s “your nine o’clock interview.”

heading.zh: 从第一句越界对白向前查来源
heading.en: Trace evidence before the first unsupported line

body.zh:
先引用问题句和前文相关段落，再问：他是否在场？消息是否实际发给他？他拿到了什么内容？看到反常，只能支持哪种推断？

“知道你上午不来”与“知道你去面试”不同；“别人说你有面试”与“已核实面试”也不同。角色可以猜错、试探或撒谎，但要按作者采用的写法表现这些性质，别把AI无意漏出的答案事后改口成“他很聪明”。

返修有两条路径：保留尚不知情，就改成他当前能问的问题；确实采用提前获知，就补作者选定的消息传递，并同步有关章节。不要为了保住旧句随口加“原来韩宁早就告诉了他”，这会改变韩宁的保密行为和关系后果。
body.en:
Quote the problem line and relevant earlier passages. Was this person present? Was a message actually sent to them? What did it contain? What inference does an observed anomaly support?

Knowing someone is unavailable in the morning differs from knowing they have an interview. Hearing an interview claim differs from verifying it. A character may guess wrongly, probe or lie, but preserve the author’s intended status rather than retroactively calling an accidental leak intelligence.

Two repair paths are available: retain ignorance and ask a question supported by current knowledge, or adopt earlier disclosure with an author-chosen communication and synchronized chapters. “Han already told him” is not a harmless patch when it changes her promise of privacy and its relationship consequences.

heading.zh: 完整返修：答应下午帮忙，不公开上午面试
heading.en: Complete repair: agree to an afternoon shift without exposing the interview

body.zh:
沿用前章已定事实：秦禾的面试只告诉韩宁；唐遇负责登记借书站志愿轮班，只看过那条未定时段的公开消息。本场作者选择秦禾保留上午私人安排，答应周六14:00—16:00帮忙，唐遇接受这个时段；本章不写面试结果。

错稿让唐遇直接说：“九点面试完就过来，你不是想进培训项目吗？”随后秦禾答“先别告诉别人”。唐遇尚无信息来源，后一句也建立了并未获准发生的透露。只删“面试”两个字，仍留着“先保密”的回应，会留下同一问题。完整候选：

> 唐遇把预排表放在秦禾面前，周六上午那格还空着。
>
> “你在群里说周六能帮忙。上午能来吗？”
>
> 秦禾看着空格，没有把面试接进话里。韩宁答应保密的那句话还记着，她也没有打算在这里解释。
>
> “上午有自己的安排。我能接下午两点到四点。”
>
> “两小时？”唐遇将笔尖移到下午，“那上午我再找人。”
>
> “好。下午这段我来。”
>
> 他写下14:00—16:00，转过预排表让她看。秦禾点头，上午那格仍然空着。

唐遇实际知道了上午不接班、下午愿意帮两小时；他没有得到面试信息，也还没找好上午的人。韩宁不在这场，不能自动知道两人的排班回应。面试和志愿到场都仍是未来事项，不把写进预排表当作已经参加。

这个片段允许秦禾的内心提到韩宁，因为她亲历了那次私下交流；它没有让唐遇听到这段叙述。若本书不用内心叙述，可保留她的有限回答与对方回应，同一信息边界仍成立。
body.en:
Keep the prior facts: Qin told only Han about the interview. Tang records volunteer shifts at the lending station and has seen only the public message without a time. For this scene, the author selects Qin keeping her morning private, offering Saturday 14:00–16:00, and Tang accepting that slot. No interview result appears.

The faulty draft has Tang say, “Come after your nine o’clock interview—you wanted that training place, didn’t you?” Qin replies, “Don’t tell anyone yet.” Tang has no source, and the reply establishes an unapproved disclosure. Removing only the word interview while keeping a secrecy reply leaves the problem. A complete candidate:

> Tang put the provisional rota in front of Qin. Saturday morning was still blank.
>
> “You said in the group you could help Saturday. Can you do the morning?”
>
> Qin looked at the blank without bringing the interview into the conversation. She remembered Han’s promise of privacy and did not intend to explain here.
>
> “I have my own plans in the morning. I can cover two until four.”
>
> “Two hours?” Tang moved the pen to the afternoon. “I’ll find someone else for the morning.”
>
> “All right. I’ll do that afternoon slot.”
>
> He wrote 14:00–16:00 and turned the provisional rota for her to see. Qin nodded. The morning remained blank.

Tang now knows Qin declines the morning and offers two afternoon hours. He has no interview information and has not yet found morning cover. Han is absent and does not automatically know their agreement. The interview and attendance remain future events; an entry is not completed participation.

Qin may remember Han because she experienced the private conversation. Tang does not hear that narration. If the book avoids inner narration, her limited answer and his response can preserve the same boundary.

heading.zh: 只返修受影响的句子，再核后续依赖
heading.en: Repair the affected passage and its later dependencies

body.zh:
可以交给`/story-long-write`（Codex用`$story-long-write`）：

> 只改唐遇约秦禾轮班这一段。依据前章私下交流与公开群消息，保留秦禾上午私人安排、下午14:00—16:00帮忙及唐遇接受。唐遇不知道面试，韩宁未获知本场回应。撤掉直接说面试、保密回应及依赖它的反应，不新增泄密、偷听或转发。保留本书文风；本章不写面试结果、上午找到代班人或实际到场。其他段落不改，先指出后文是否依赖唐遇已经知情。

写后复读实际获知的内容。若后文让唐遇询问面试结果，检查此前是否另有已经写出的披露；有就保留那条来源，没有就列为待修。Oh Story项目按章节流程提交实际变化，完整快照保留位置、资源、关系等未变部分；不手改派生视图来掩盖正文。

全书一致性取证另看[AI小说前后矛盾检查](/oh-story/ai-fiction-consistency-check)，删除旧获知场景后的级联改稿另看[修改前文后检查后文](/oh-story/sync-later-chapters-after-a-revision)。
body.en:
Give `/story-long-write`, or `$story-long-write` in Codex, this request:

> Revise only Tang’s shift conversation with Qin, using the previous private exchange and public message. Keep her private morning plans, offered 14:00–16:00 and his acceptance. Tang does not know the interview; Han has not learned this exchange. Remove the interview claim, secrecy reply and dependent reactions. Add no disclosure, overhearing or forwarded message. Preserve book style. Do not write an interview result, found morning cover or actual attendance. Leave other passages unchanged and first identify later reliance on Tang already knowing.

Review what each person actually learns. If Tang later asks about the result, check for an independently written disclosure before that question. Retain a valid source; otherwise flag the passage. Oh Story’s chapter workflow submits actual changes while complete snapshots retain unaffected location, resources and relationships. Editing a generated view cannot hide faulty prose.

Use the [continuity audit](/oh-story/ai-fiction-consistency-check) for manuscript-wide evidence, or [later-chapter synchronization](/oh-story/sync-later-chapters-after-a-revision) after removing an earlier acquisition scene.

q.zh: 全知旁白能说秘密，角色就能接着说吗？
q.en: Can a character use a secret revealed by omniscient narration?

a.zh: 不能自动如此。读者收到叙述信息，不代表角色在场听见。角色使用它仍要有正文中的获知或符合设定的判断依据。
a.en: Not automatically. Readers receiving narrated information does not mean a character heard it. Their use still needs an acquisition or inference supported by the story.

q.zh: 角色猜中了秘密，也算错误吗？
q.en: Is a correct guess always a continuity error?

a.zh: 不一定。作者可以让角色根据线索猜测，猜中也仍是猜测。检查线索是否已给到他、语言有没有把推断当确认，以及听者的回应是否实际泄露了更多。
a.en: No. A supported inference can be correct and still remain a guess. Check available clues, whether language turns inference into confirmation, and whether the reply actually discloses more.

text.zh: 用 /story-long-write（Codex用 $story-long-write）返修这段角色提前知道秘密的对白。附前文真实获知来源和本场目标；保留有效进展，只改越界对白与依赖反应，不补偷听、转发或旧透露来圆稿。列出相关后文依赖，保留未变事实和本书文风。
text.en: Use /story-long-write, or $story-long-write in Codex, to repair premature knowledge in this conversation. Supply actual earlier acquisition and this scene’s goal. Keep valid progress; revise unsupported lines and reactions without invented overhearing, forwarding or prior disclosure. Identify later dependencies and preserve unaffected facts and style.

label.zh: 细纲中的人物、读者与误判信息
label.en: Character, reader and mistaken knowledge in chapter outlines

label.zh: 角色已知与客观事实、读者认知分开
label.en: Separate character knowledge, facts and reader understanding

label.zh: 后文知情依赖与完整当前快照
label.en: Later knowledge dependencies and complete current snapshots

label.zh: 文风不能改信息边界或新增获知
label.en: Style does not change information bounds or invent acquisition

title.zh: AI写小说总加新危机怎么办：让成功真正落地
title.en: How to Stop AI Fiction Adding a Crisis After Every Success

seo_title.zh: AI写小说总加新危机怎么办｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Stop AI Fiction Adding Crises After Success | ZenStory

description.zh: 区分已有代价与AI临时补出的新危机，保住本章约定的交付和收益。附修窗帘的完整改稿，成功后也能用低压片段承接。
description.en: Separate established costs from an invented crisis. Preserve the chapter’s agreed result and reward, with a complete curtain-repair scene and quiet aftermath.

answer.zh: 先核本章原定结果：成功该兑现到哪里，已有代价是什么，下一轮压力何时开始。AI若只是为“增加冲突”在成功后临时夺走收益，撤掉未经采用的新事件及其依赖反应，保留验收、接收与当下变化。已有损耗和作者确实采用的后果仍照写；低压收益不必另配一次危机。
answer.en: Check the intended result, established costs and when the next pressure begins. If AI adds a crisis merely to create conflict and removes an agreed reward, remove the unadopted event and dependent reactions while preserving acceptance, receipt and present change. Keep costs and consequences the author actually selected. A quiet reward needs no compulsory crisis.

heading.zh: 先查这是已有后果，还是临时加戏
heading.en: Check an established consequence versus an added event

body.zh:
成功之后仍有伤势、费用或关系问题，可以是前文已经写下的事实。临时冒出未定的裂口、债主或失踪者，却让刚完成的事立刻作废，则需要对照作者本章安排，不因“有冲突”自动保留。

| 内容 | 怎样处理 |
|---|---|
| 已定的行动消耗 | 保留实际用掉的时间与材料，不让下一场复位。 |
| 已定的成功代价 | 按前文条件写后果，不以轻松语气抹掉。 |
| 作者采用的新压力 | 给出来源和承接，按所选章节发生。 |
| AI临时补出的危机 | 查是否越过本章结果与停点，未采用时撤掉依赖句。 |

Oh Story的推进方法允许兑现后先得到小而可见的收益，也明确低压、过渡或纯奖励章不强制附加代价。它没有要求每次胜利马上变成另一场失败。
body.en:
An injury, expense or relationship problem after success may already be established. A newly invented tear, creditor or missing person that cancels the completed task needs comparison with the author’s chapter plan; conflict alone does not justify keeping it.

| Content | Treatment |
|---|---|
| Established expenditure | Keep spent time and material; do not reset them next scene. |
| Chosen cost of success | Follow its prior conditions rather than erase it with a lighter tone. |
| Adopted new pressure | Establish its source and place it in the selected chapter. |
| AI-added crisis | Check the chapter result and stopping point; remove dependent lines if unadopted. |

Oh Story permits a small visible gain after a payoff and explicitly does not force costs onto quiet, transitional or reward chapters. A win need not immediately become another failure.

heading.zh: 把结果、范围与停笔点一起交给AI
heading.en: Specify the result, revision scope and stopping point

body.zh:
不要只说“写轻松一点”，让AI另选剧情。给原稿和当前安排，明确哪些已发生、哪些待后场、这次改哪一段。

> 用 $story-long-write 只改这段交付之后未经采用的新危机及依赖反应。保留作者已定的客户验收、付款与收走窗帘；保留已经耗去的工时、材料及尚未处理的两件修补单。本文段落在整理下一件工作前停，不新增返修、退款、欠债、失踪或新秘密。按本书文风写现场交流，先标出会改的句子，再交完整候选。

这是本例的局部请求，不是永久禁用返修或退款的写作规则。若真实稿里客户本来就不满意，先处理原来的结果；不能为了低压收益伪造验收。
body.en:
Do not ask only for a lighter tone and leave AI to choose new plot. Supply the passage and current plan: what happened, what follows later, and which portion to change.

> Use $story-long-write to revise only the unadopted crisis after this handover and its dependent reactions. Preserve the author-selected inspection, payment and customer taking the curtain. Keep spent labour and material and two repair orders still waiting. Stop before work on the next item. Add no repeat repair, refund, debt, disappearance or secret. Use the book’s voice for the exchange; identify affected lines, then deliver a complete candidate.

This is the example’s local request rather than a permanent ban on refunds or repeat repairs. If an actual manuscript established dissatisfaction, address that result instead of inventing acceptance for a quiet reward.

heading.zh: 完整改稿：客户收走窗帘，收益留到手里
heading.en: Complete revision: the customer takes the curtain and the reward remains

body.zh:
原创生活故事：江岑在街边经营缝补摊，已修好唐禾窗帘磨损的下缘。两人事先约定只修下缘，不换旧布或恢复褪色，工费二十元；唐禾今晚来取。江岑还有两件待修，投入的工时与材料已花掉。本章作者选择验收、付款、收走与短暂整理，不写返修。

AI稿在付款后又添“新裂口出现，唐禾立即要求退费”，未经作者采用，改变了已定结果。删掉新裂口，却留下江岑退钱和重新拆线，也没有修好。下面完整接住原定交付：

> 唐禾把窗帘展开，先看下缘，又翻到背面。江岑等她把那段放平，没有急着收起来。
>
> “边上好了。旧颜色还是这样。”唐禾说。
>
> “只补磨损这段，布没换。”
>
> 她又看一遍，点头：“就是按说好的做。二十？”
>
> 江岑说是。唐禾把钱递过来，她数过，放进抽屉，将窗帘叠好。唐禾双手接稳，带着它离开摊前。
>
> 抽屉里那张二十还在。江岑收起这单剩下的线头，把已交付的名字从当天清单上划掉，再把另外两张修补单排到明天。
>
> 她端起放凉的茶喝了一口。桌面腾出一块，下一件布包仍没有拆开。

本轮收益是客户实际验收、付款并收走这一件，清单实际变为已交付；不等于店铺从此稳定盈利或所有客户满意。另两件还没修，不用新裂口才能继续写。既有工时与材料消耗保留，短暂安静让读者感到这次成功已经到手。
body.en:
Original everyday-life story: Jiang Cen runs a street-side mending stall and has repaired Tang He's worn curtain hem. They agreed to repair only that edge, retain the old fabric and fading, and charge twenty yuan. Tang collects tonight. Two jobs remain; labour and material have already been spent. The author selects inspection, payment, collection and brief tidying, without a repeat repair here.

AI adds a new tear after payment and an immediate refund demand. The author has not adopted that change. Removing the tear while leaving a refund and reopened stitching is an incomplete repair. A complete candidate follows the chosen handover:

> Tang spread the curtain, inspected the hem and turned it over. Jiang waited for her to lay the edge flat rather than hurry to fold it.
>
> “The edge is fixed. The old colour is still the same.”
>
> “Only the worn part was mended. I didn't replace the fabric.”
>
> Tang looked again and nodded. “As agreed. Twenty?”
>
> Jiang confirmed. Tang handed over the money. Jiang counted it into the drawer, folded the curtain and let Tang take a firm two-handed grip. Tang left with it.
>
> The twenty remained in the drawer. Jiang gathered the leftover thread, crossed the delivered name off today's list and put the other two repair slips in tomorrow's order.
>
> She drank the cooled tea. A patch of table was clear; the next cloth bundle remained unopened.

The result is this customer's actual inspection, payment and collection, with the item marked delivered. It is not permanent profitability or universal satisfaction. Two jobs remain undone, offering continuation without a new tear. Spent labour and material remain; a quiet moment lets readers feel the success has reached its recipient.

heading.zh: 改完连读，别留下“危机没了，反应还在”
heading.en: Reread for reactions whose cause was removed

body.zh:
检查新增事件是否连同退款、惊慌、责备和重新开工一起撤掉；再核原来的交付是否仍完整。只改一句“没有裂开”，后面仍继续拆线，会留下同一矛盾。

如果下一章需要压力，从已经未完成的工作、既有关系或作者采用的新安排接续，先写它的来源。低压片段也可以交付收入、恢复、陪伴或关系确认。整段章节力度另见[网文节奏](/oh-story/web-serial-pacing)，不必把这次局部返修扩大为全卷重排。
body.en:
Remove the unadopted event together with dependent refunds, panic, blame and reopened work, then verify that the original handover is complete. Saying there is no tear while later reopening the seam leaves the contradiction.

If pressure begins next chapter, continue unfinished work, an existing relationship or an adopted new arrangement with its source established. Quiet passages can deliver income, recovery, companionship or relationship confirmation. See [web-fiction pacing](/oh-story/web-serial-pacing) for chapter-level intensity; this local repair need not reorder a whole volume.

q.zh: 成功后完全没有代价，会不会显得太轻松？
q.en: Does success without a new cost feel too easy?

a.zh: 要看本书承诺与已定结果。先前付出的工时、选择和限制可以保留；本轮成功后不必再扣一次。若作者采用代价，建立来源与后果，不为公式额外制造。
a.en: Judge the book’s promise and intended result. Keep prior labour, choices and limits without charging again after success. An adopted cost needs a source and consequence rather than a formula.

q.zh: 可以用安静片段结束这一章吗？
q.en: Can this chapter end quietly?

a.zh: 可以，只要本轮该交付的事已发生，安静也有当下体验或余波。可用收起工具、看到收益或回应关系收尾；不必临时新增秘密或事故。
a.en: Yes, when the promised result has happened and the quiet carries experience or aftermath. Tools put away, a received gain or a relationship response can close it without an invented secret or accident.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 对照本章结果和停点，只删未经采用的成功后危机及依赖反应，保留已有代价、实际收益和未完事项。先列受影响句，再写完整候选。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to compare the passage with this chapter’s result and stopping point. Remove only an unadopted post-success crisis and dependent reactions. Keep established costs, received gains and unfinished work. Identify affected lines, then provide a complete candidate.

label.zh: 兑现后低压收益与可选代价
label.en: Quiet gains after payoff and optional costs

label.zh: 当前要求、本书选择与事实边界
label.en: Current requests, book choices and facts

label.zh: 把已定交付演成场景

title.zh: 影视解说怎么避免提前剧透：让揭晓服务本条主线
title.en: When to Reveal a Twist in a Video Recap

seo_title.zh: 影视解说怎么安排剧透与揭晓｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: When to Reveal a Video Recap Twist | ZenStory

description.zh: 先定观众问题，再安排已知信息、原声与结论。附同一原创短片的悬念开头和结果先行开头，避免隐瞒必要前提或虚构动机。
description.en: Choose a viewer question before revealing answers. Compare two openings from one original short film without hiding prerequisites or inventing motives.

answer.zh: 先决定这条解说让观众追问原因，还是观察已知结果怎样发生。跟随人物发现时，旁白的结论要到证据出现后再落地；结果先行时，可以提前交代已证实的结果，但要换成正文仍会回答的问题。两种结构都要保留理解行动所需的前提、关键原声和真实后果。
answer.en: Choose whether viewers should discover an answer or examine how an established result happened. With a discovery structure, wait for supporting evidence before stating the conclusion. With a result-first structure, reveal the verified outcome and pose a different question the edit actually answers. Both need the prerequisites, crucial speech and real consequences.

heading.zh: 先定观众要追问什么
heading.en: Choose the question viewers follow

body.zh:
video-script 的剪辑工作法先确定观众承诺、主视角、戏剧问题与隐瞒揭示，再选择片段。不要先写“他竟然是凶手”，然后才找素材填满后面的时间。

同一个真实结果可以服务不同结构：

| 主线选择 | 开头与揭晓的职责 |
|---|---|
| 跟随发现 | 给出可感知的疑问，保留人物实际找到证据的过程；结论在证据落地时出现。 |
| 结果先行 | 先交代有证据的结果，再追问怎样发生、为什么这样处理或付出了什么。 |

若作者已定结构，局部返修就沿该主线调整一句旁白或一个剪点。不要每次修改都重新换一种故事。这里讨论解说的揭晓顺序；短视频标题的承诺和包装另见相关指南。
body.en:
The video-script playbook chooses the viewer promise, viewpoint, dramatic question and reveal before selecting clips. Do not write “He was the killer” and then search for footage to fill the remaining time.

| Structure | Opening and reveal |
|---|---|
| Follow discovery | Establish a perceptible question and preserve the character’s actual evidence-finding. State the conclusion when evidence lands. |
| Start with the result | Name a supported result, then ask how it happened, why it was handled that way, or what it cost. |

For a directed edit, revise the sentence or boundary within the established main line. A local revision does not require a new story structure. This page addresses reveal order inside the recap; promotional promises and titles have their own related guide.

heading.zh: 把画面事实、人物知情与解释分开
heading.en: Separate evidence, knowledge and interpretation

body.zh:
写稿时给关键结论做一张短卡：在哪个片段看见或听见，主视角何时接触它，旁白什么时候说，哪些解释仍无证据。素材里后来才出现的承认，不会使开头的人物自动知情。

不能为了悬念删除理解选择所需的前提。例如人物因事先约定而不愿交出物件，先让观众知道必要约定，仍可以晚一些揭示谁违反了它。隐藏答案与删掉因果是两件不同的剪辑决定。

也不要把“暂不说原因”写成更强的错误指控。画面只有取走物件，解说就不能先叫它偷盗；人物未解释，不等于解释只能是恶意。必要原话应完整保留，旁白避开它，下一句再承接已发生的变化。
body.en:
For each important claim, note where it is seen or heard, when the viewpoint character encounters it, when narration states it, and which interpretations remain unsupported. A later admission does not give the opening character prior knowledge.

Suspense cannot remove prerequisites. If an earlier agreement explains reluctance to hand over an object, establish the necessary agreement while delaying the answer about who broke it. Withholding an answer and deleting causality are separate editing choices.

Nor should a delayed explanation become a stronger accusation. Taking an object is not sufficient evidence to narrate theft; missing explanation does not establish malicious intent. Preserve crucial speech in full, let narration yield, then connect the change that actually occurred.

heading.zh: 完整示例：同一张展览照片，两种开头
heading.en: Complete example: two openings from one exhibition film

body.zh:
以下是原创纸面短片方案，没有拍摄素材、真实时码或试听结果。社区展览中，姜禾发现母亲的照片从展板上消失。她与陆安早有约定，改展品先商量。陆安站在柜前，先说“等一下再开”。后来他拿出本次换背板的取件单，并说：“我拿去换背板了，没问你。”随后取回的照片实际装回展板，姜禾要求以后先说，他答应，并在展品登记里写下“本次背板已换，下次先联系姜禾”。

取件单可支持本次装裱处理，陆安的原话支持他未先商量；装回的动作才交付照片回位。素材没有说明他全部内心，也没有证明以后都不会再犯。本例不额外给出损坏原因或迫不得已的辩解。

**版本一：跟随姜禾发现。** 开头不先揭示取件单。

> 画面：空出的照片位置，姜禾停下。旁白：“这张照片的改动，他们约定先商量。今天她却看见空位。”
>
> 原声：姜禾问“照片呢？”陆安说“等一下再开”。保留她等答复的反应，不用旁白宣布他在掩盖什么。
>
> 画面与原声：陆安取出本次取件单，说“我拿去换背板了，没问你”。这句完整说完，观众和姜禾才得到本次处理的解释。
>
> 画面：照片实际装回原位。旁白：“照片回来了。改动前的商量，被他省掉了。”
>
> 原声：姜禾说“下次先告诉我”，陆安答应；保留他登记这次变化与下次联系要求的动作，结束在登记落笔。

疑问从照片去向转向两人怎样处理未商量的改动。没有把“不先揭晓”变成“他偷走照片”的虚假承诺。

**版本二：先给结果，再问关系怎样改变。** 可以先用装回照片的片段，但回到此前发现空位时，要让时间跳转可辨。

> 开头画面：陆安把照片装回展板。旁白：“他给照片换了背板，却没有先问姜禾。照片回位以后，他们还得处理这次未商量的改动。”这条片子接着回答她怎样提出要求、他怎样回应。
>
> 明确回到此前：空位与“照片呢？”接上陆安的答复。保留早有约定的依据、取件单和完整承认，不把两次装回剪成两个不同事件。
>
> 回到当前结果：姜禾提出下次先联系，陆安答应并实际登记。照片已装回，不重复播放成新的修复或宣布关系从此无事。

第二版失去了“照片在哪里”的未知，得到的是观众已知他做了什么、等待姜禾怎样回应。若原片没有约定或登记动作，就删去对应解释、收束到实际可见的结果；不能为了这个结构补拍成已经存在的源证据。
body.en:
This is an original paper film with no footage, measured timing or listening test. At a community exhibition Jiang He finds her mother’s photograph missing from its board. She and Lu An had agreed to discuss exhibit changes first. Standing by a cabinet, he says to wait before opening it. Later he produces the collection slip for a replacement backing and says, “I took it to have the backing changed. I didn’t ask you.” The returned photograph is actually mounted on the board. Jiang asks him to tell her first next time. He agrees and writes in the exhibit record: “Backing changed this time; contact Jiang before the next change.”

The slip supports this mounting work, his words support the lack of prior discussion, and the remounting delivers the return. None establishes his entire inner motive or permanent future reliability. This candidate adds no cause of damage or necessity excuse.

**Version one: follow Jiang’s discovery.** Do not reveal the slip in the opening.

> Picture: the empty position; Jiang stops. Narration: “They had agreed to discuss changes to this photograph first. Today she finds its place empty.”
>
> Original speech: Jiang asks where it is; Lu asks her to wait before opening the cabinet. Keep her reaction while awaiting an answer without announcing what he is hiding.
>
> Picture and speech: Lu produces this collection slip and says, “I took it to have the backing changed. I didn’t ask you.” Let the full line land. Jiang and viewers now receive the explanation for this instance.
>
> Picture: the photograph is actually remounted. Narration: “The photograph is back. He skipped the discussion before making the change.”
>
> Original speech: Jiang asks him to tell her first next time. He agrees. Keep his entry recording this change and the future contact requirement; end on the completed entry.

The question shifts from the photograph’s whereabouts to their response to an unconsulted change. Delaying the answer does not promise a theft revelation.

**Version two: show the result, then examine the relationship.** Open with remounting if the return to the earlier discovery is clear.

> Opening picture: Lu remounts the photograph. Narration: “He changed its backing without asking Jiang first. Returning the photograph still leaves them to address that unconsulted change.” The edit answers what she asks for and how he responds.
>
> Clearly return to earlier events: the empty position, her question and his response. Keep the established agreement, collection slip and complete admission. Do not turn two uses of the remounting footage into two separate events.
>
> Return to the present result: Jiang requests prior contact, Lu agrees and actually records it. The photograph is already back; do not replay it as another repair or declare their relationship permanently settled.

This version removes uncertainty about location and builds anticipation around Jiang’s response to a known action. If actual footage lacks the agreement or record entry, remove those explanations and end on the available result. This paper structure does not make invented shots into existing source evidence.

heading.zh: 旁白已经说早了，先改哪一句
heading.en: Repair a premature conclusion

body.zh:
先定位哪句话让观众提前知道答案，再查它是不是当前主线所需。跟随发现版可以把结论后移到证据落地处，开头改成可兑现的问题；结果先行版则保留有依据的结果，重写后面仍值得看的问题。

移动一句旁白后检查相邻原声与反应。不能让新位置盖住承认，也不能删掉人物真正收到信息的瞬间。字幕跟随当前实际声音；若文字先于声音揭晓，也会改变观众经历。

实际制作按剪后时间重新安放旁白，正常速度播放开头、揭晓接点与收尾。让未读过脚本的人说出自己在等什么，以及答案在何处出现；这能帮助判断结构，纸面方案本身不证明观众一定被吸引。
body.en:
Locate the sentence that answers early and check whether this structure needs it. In a discovery edit, move the conclusion to its evidence and open with a question the footage answers. In a result-first edit, keep the supported result and rewrite the remaining question.

Check adjacent speech and reactions after moving narration. Do not cover the admission or remove the character’s actual moment of learning. Subtitles follow the current audible wording; an earlier written revelation also changes the experience.

During production, place narration on the edited timeline and play the opening, reveal boundary and ending at normal speed. Ask a first-time viewer what they were waiting for and where the answer appeared. Such observation helps assess the structure; a paper plan alone does not establish engagement.

q.zh: 解说一定要等到最后才揭晓吗？
q.en: Must a recap save every answer for the end?

a.zh: 不用。揭晓位置服从这条主线。结果先行可有效，但开头结果要有依据，后续问题仍需兑现；不要为延迟答案删去必要前提。
a.en: No. A supported result-first opening can work if the remaining question is answered. Do not remove prerequisites just to delay an answer.

q.zh: 原片已经有反转，可以先在旁白里说吗？
q.en: Can narration reveal a twist before the source scene?

a.zh: 可以作为明确结构选择，但会改变观众经历。先比较你要观众跟随发现还是观察后果，保留证据与人物知情顺序，不把未来事实变成人物早已知道。
a.en: It can be an explicit structural choice. Decide whether viewers should discover the answer or examine consequences, while preserving evidence and the character’s actual knowledge sequence.

text.zh: 用 $video-script 调整本条解说的揭晓顺序。提供当前主线、实际素材里的证据与原声、说早的具体句子、应保留的剪辑决定。要求标出观众何时知道、人物何时知道、结论依据和修改后的原声接力；返修只动指定段落，写稿方案不冒充已剪成片。
text.en: Use $video-script with the current main line, actual evidence and speech, the premature sentence and decisions to retain. Ask for viewer and character knowledge timing, claim support and the revised sound handoff. Limit revisions to the specified section and distinguish a writing plan from a rendered edit.

label.zh: 观众问题、隐瞒揭示与证据边界

title.zh: AI写小说对白像问答怎么办：主动说，也真正回应
title.en: How to Fix Mechanical Question-and-Answer Dialogue in Fiction

seo_title.zh: AI小说对白像问答怎么改｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Fix Mechanical Question-and-Answer Dialogue | ZenStory

description.zh: 从双方目标、主动表达与接话反应修机械问答，附借展板的改前改后全文。保留必要问题，不靠每句加动作或突然争吵制造自然感。
description.en: Revise mechanical dialogue through goals, initiative and responses. A complete board-loan example keeps necessary questions without adding constant gestures.

answer.zh: 先查每个人来这场交流想得到什么，哪些信息不必等人发问才会主动说，再看对方是否真正回应了请求、顾虑或态度。保留有作用的问题，把只替读者填资料的轮流报答案改成现场交流。动作和心理只在有内容时加入，不给每句台词固定配一个表情。
answer.en: Identify what each speaker wants, what they would volunteer without being asked, and how the other responds to the request or concern. Keep useful questions while replacing alternating fact delivery with an exchange. Add action or thought where it contributes, rather than attaching a gesture to every line.

heading.zh: 先分清：必要问答，还是轮流填资料
heading.en: Distinguish useful questions from alternating fact delivery

body.zh:
问句多不自动等于对白差。人物确实在确认情况、问路或访谈时，直接问答可以清楚；本书也可以选择简短、规整的说话方式。问题出在两个人只为读者报资料：一方没有自己的表达意图，另一方答完便等下一题，态度与当前行动没有变化。

Oh Story 的对白方法对机械问答建议“一方主动说，另一方给反应”，情绪交流还要回应上一句的状态。本页把它用作改稿判断，不把全部对话改成长独白，也不让每句都升级冲突。

先圈三处：人物本会主动说的信息；对方真实关心的条件；答复之后仍欠的一步行动。若前文已说明地点与身份，后面不必再问“你是谁、这是哪里”替读者复习。
body.en:
Many questions do not automatically make bad dialogue. People confirming details, asking directions or conducting an interview can speak directly; a book may deliberately choose a concise, orderly voice. The problem is alternating information for readers while neither speaker has an independent intention or responds beyond supplying the next answer.

Oh Story suggests initiative from one speaker and a response from the other for mechanical question chains. Emotional exchanges should also respond to the preceding emotional state. Use this as a revision lens rather than making every exchange a monologue or escalating every line into conflict.

Mark information someone would volunteer, conditions the other genuinely cares about, and action still needed after the answer. Established identity and location do not require another round of “Who are you?” and “Where is this?” merely to refresh readers.

heading.zh: 让两个人都在做自己的事
heading.en: Give both speakers an intention

body.zh:
先用白话写双方目的，不用给每句贴术语：借用者想拿到合用的展板，展览负责人要保住仍在用的地图板，并知道何时归还。前者会主动说用途与归还计划；后者会说明可借对象与条件，未必照着问题顺序回答。

| 原稿的问题 | 改稿选择 |
|---|---|
| 信息只能等问句逐项出现 | 把来意与必要条件连成自然的一句或几句。 |
| 对方只是回答资料 | 让他提出自己的顾虑、可行条件或下一步。 |
| 有回答却没回应态度 | 接住担心、解释或退让；也可以暂不接受。 |
| 答完就宣布事情办成 | 写实际交接或接受；未来约定保持未来。 |

反应可以是继续说话、调整请求、暂缓决定，也可以是动作、表情或本视角心理。只有确实改变交流或体验的细节才留下；不能把“主动说”机械换成“每句后面都捏手指”。
body.en:
State both purposes plainly. The borrower wants a usable display board; the exhibition coordinator must retain the map board still in use and know the return deadline. The borrower can volunteer purpose and timing. The coordinator can state the available object and conditions without following a questionnaire’s order.

| Draft problem | Revision choice |
|---|---|
| Facts wait for individual questions | Connect purpose and necessary conditions in natural speech. |
| The other speaker only supplies data | Give them a concern, workable condition or next step. |
| An answer ignores the preceding attitude | Respond to worry, explanation or concession; acceptance can remain pending. |
| Finished answers become finished action | Show actual acceptance or transfer; future agreements remain future. |

A response may be speech, a revised request, a delayed decision, an action or viewpoint thought. Keep detail that changes the exchange or experience rather than replacing every question with another finger gesture.

heading.zh: 改前改后：借一块展板，不用问完一份表
heading.en: Before and after: borrowing a display board

body.zh:
原创设定：魏南负责小剧场周六上午的海报展示，来向展览负责人陶禾借一块展板。展览周五撤场；东墙的空折叠板可借，地图板还要用。陶禾有权安排这一块空板的借用，要求最晚周六晚上归还。本例作者已选择双方同意并实际交接，归还尚未发生。下面比较同一组事实；弱版停在资料问完，改版把既定交接演出来。

**机械问答片段：**

> “你来做什么？”
>
> “借展板。”
>
> “什么时候用？”
>
> “周六上午，剧场放海报。”
>
> “什么时候还？”
>
> “周六晚上。”
>
> 魏南又问：“哪块可以借？”
>
> “东墙的空板。地图板还要用，展览周五撤场。”
>
> “好。”

这些信息并非都没用，问题是双方只有提问或回答，没有现场的请求与回应。保留用途、对象和期限，可以改成：

> 魏南进来时看向东墙：“周六上午剧场要放海报，想借一块展板。结束后我搬回来，最晚周六晚上。”
>
> 陶禾把地图板旁的凳子挪开：“地图这块还得留着。展览周五撤场，东墙那块空折叠板能借。”
>
> “就是那块。”魏南走近，确认是空板，“我按你这边的期限还。”
>
> “先把借用写上。”陶禾打开记录，写明空折叠板和周六晚的归还期限，把笔递给他。
>
> 魏南签了名字。两人合起空板，陶禾松手，让他接稳；地图板仍留在原处。
>
> “到时找你？”魏南问。
>
> “还到这里，按记录交接。”
>
> 魏南拿着空板离开，陶禾把记录放回。归还期限写在他的名字旁，还不是一条已归还的记录。

问题仍然存在，但出现在真正需要确认的时候。陶禾不是问话工具，她决定可借对象与条件；魏南主动给用途与时间，也实际签收。动作承担确认、记录与交接，不与每句一对一配齐。场面普通顺利，无需突然加入敌人或争吵。

本例的岗位、借用权限与交接方式都是虚构作品的教学选择，不是现实场馆规定。若你的原稿只到提出请求、对方还没同意，就保留待答，不能为了让对白流畅擅自完成借用。
body.en:
Original setup: Wei Nan handles a theatre’s poster display on Saturday morning and asks exhibition coordinator Tao He for a board. The exhibition closes Friday. The empty folding board on the east wall is available; the map board remains in use. Tao can arrange this particular loan and requires return by Saturday evening. The author has chosen agreement and actual transfer, with return still future. Both versions use these facts; the weak fragment stops after collecting information, while the revision dramatizes the planned handoff.

**Mechanical fragment:**

> “Why are you here?”
>
> “To borrow a board.”
>
> “When do you need it?”
>
> “Saturday morning, for theatre posters.”
>
> “When will you return it?”
>
> “Saturday evening.”
>
> Wei then asked, “Which one is available?”
>
> “The empty board on the east wall. We still need the map board. The exhibition closes Friday.”
>
> “Okay.”

The information matters, but speakers merely ask or answer. Keep purpose, object and deadline while restoring the request and response:

> Wei looked toward the east wall as he entered. “The theatre needs a board for posters Saturday morning. I’ll bring it back after the display, by Saturday evening at the latest.”
>
> Tao moved the stool beside the map. “This map stays. The exhibition closes Friday; you can borrow the empty folding board over there.”
>
> “That’s the one.” Wei approached and checked that it was empty. “I’ll keep your deadline.”
>
> “Record the loan first.” Tao opened the register, entered the empty folding board and Saturday-evening deadline, then passed him the pen.
>
> Wei signed. They folded the board together. Tao released it once he had a steady hold; the map board stayed in place.
>
> “Should I find you when I return?” Wei asked.
>
> “Bring it here and hand it over against the record.”
>
> Wei left carrying the empty board. Tao put the register away. The deadline beside his name was still a future return, not a completed one.

Questions remain where confirmation is needed. Tao decides availability and conditions rather than serving as a questionnaire. Wei volunteers purpose and timing, then signs and receives the object. Actions perform checking, recording and transfer without one gesture for every line. Ordinary cooperation needs no sudden enemy or argument.

Roles, authority and handoff procedure are fictional teaching choices, not real venue policy. If a draft only reaches a request without acceptance, retain that pending response rather than completing the loan merely to smooth dialogue.

heading.zh: 给AI改稿时，先固定事实与停点
heading.en: Give AI the facts and stopping point

body.zh:
可以这样提出本次修改：“保留双方目的、可借对象、期限与本场停点，把轮流问答改成更自然的主动表达和回应。必要问句保留；不加新冲突，不给每句配动作，不提前执行未来约定。只改指定段落。”

改完先对照事实：物件归谁、条件是否被接受、动作到哪一步；再朗读台词，看第二个人是否回应了上一句，而不是换一种说法播报下一条资料。

长短服从本书文风。简短问答可以快，长一点的主动说明也可以自然；不能只用问号数量或固定对白占比评价。若问题主要是重复确认，看对白精简指南；若是多人的归属不清，看名字与代词指南。
body.en:
A scoped request can say: “Keep both purposes, the available object, deadline and scene stopping point. Replace alternating questions with natural initiative and responses. Retain useful questions; add no new conflict or gesture after every line, and do not perform future agreements early. Revise only this passage.”

Compare ownership, accepted conditions and completed action first. Then read dialogue aloud to hear whether the second speaker responds to the preceding line instead of broadcasting another fact.

Length follows book voice. Brief questions can be brisk; longer volunteered explanations can be natural. Question-mark counts or fixed dialogue ratios cannot decide quality. Use dialogue-trimming guidance for repeated confirmations and name/pronoun guidance for unclear attribution.

q.zh: 一问一答是不是都要删？
q.en: Must all question-and-answer exchanges be removed?

a.zh: 不用。确认、访谈与简短沟通可以直接问答。要修的是人物没有主动意图、互不回应、只为读者轮流报信息的部分。
a.en: No. Confirmation, interviews and brief exchanges can be direct. Revise passages where speakers have no initiative or response beyond delivering information for readers.

q.zh: 每句后面加动作会更自然吗？
q.en: Does adding an action after every line make it natural?

a.zh: 未必。动作要有当前作用；没有作用的捏手、转头会形成新模板。主动表达、接住顾虑与实际回应，也可以只通过台词完成。
a.en: Not necessarily. Repeated gestures create another template. Initiative and responses to concerns can also happen entirely through speech.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 修改对白像问答的指定段落。附当前全文、本书文风、双方目的、已知信息、物件状态和本场停点。要求先指出机械轮流报信息的位置，再改主动表达与回应；事实、权限和后续剧情不变，不固定增加动作或制造争吵。
text.en: Use $story-long-write for the specified dialogue passage with current text, book voice, both purposes, known information, object state and stopping point. Identify mechanical fact delivery, then revise initiative and responses while preserving facts, authority and later plot. Do not add fixed gestures or forced arguments.

label.zh: 机械问答、主动表达与情绪承接
label.en: Mechanical questions, initiative and emotional response

label.zh: 把交流与交接演成连续场景
本书文风、事实与改稿范围
label.en: Book voice, facts and revision scope

title.zh: AI视频乱加旁白或台词怎么办：把允许的发声写完整
title.en: How to Stop Unwanted Voiceover and Dialogue in AI Video

seo_title.zh: AI视频乱加旁白和台词怎么改｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Stop Unwanted Voiceover in AI Video | ZenStory

description.zh: 按说话人、声源、语言、原句和底声写完整声音时间线。附有对白与无对白两份原创提示词，保住既定音效，不把去旁白误做全片静音。
description.en: Write a complete sound timeline with speakers, exact lines and ambience. Two original prompts preserve approved sound while excluding unwanted voices.

answer.zh: 先核对剧本允许哪些发声，再把这些事件按顺序写进一条完整声音时间线。每句标明说话人、声源性质、实际语言和逐字原句；句间与句后回到已定环境声或静默。作者已经确认不需要的旁白、新台词、语气词或重复发声，再在末尾集中说明，不把整条音轨静音当成保留对白的修法。
answer.en: Check which sounds the script permits, then place those events in one complete timeline. Give each line its speaker, source, spoken language and exact text; between and after lines, return to established ambience or silence. Consolidate the creator’s confirmed exclusions at the end. Muting the entire track is not a way to preserve required dialogue.

heading.zh: 先找多出的声音出现在哪一层
heading.en: Locate the added voice

body.zh:
先对原生成素材回听，再对剪辑后的成片回听。不要只看字幕：字幕没写出的语气词可能仍在音频里，自动转写也可能把正确原句识别错。

| 听到的问题 | 先查哪里 |
|---|---|
| 原素材已有旁白或新台词 | 生成提示词的完整声音时间线与本场已定声音。 |
| 角色先加“嗯、啊”才读原句 | 发声是否要求从原文首字开始；这些非语言或语气发声是否本就允许。 |
| 同一句说两次 | 单镜原句是否被重复抄进多个段落；相邻镜是否都从句首开始。 |
| 原素材正确，成片才多声音 | 剪辑、旁白轨、重复音频片段与声音落点。 |

本页解决擅自新增的人声。语种错了另查语种与原句指南；正确声音配到错误嘴部，另查口型指南。不要因问题发生在成片，就一律重生成正确原素材。
body.en:
Listen to generated source footage before the edited output. Subtitles alone cannot reveal a filler audible in the track, and automatic transcription may misrecognize correct speech.

| Audible problem | First check |
|---|---|
| Source contains added narration or dialogue | Its complete sound timeline and the scene’s established sounds. |
| A filler precedes the approved line | Whether speech begins with the first original word and whether fillers were permitted. |
| One line occurs twice | Repeated text in the prompt or adjacent shots both starting from its beginning. |
| Source is correct; output adds speech | Edit tracks, narration, duplicated segments and placement. |

This page addresses unapproved voices. Spoken-language errors and wrong-mouth animation have separate guides. Do not regenerate correct source merely because an error appears in the final edit.

heading.zh: 写允许的声音，再写已确认的排除项
heading.en: Write permitted sounds and confirmed exclusions

body.zh:
Drama Skills 的 motion-recipe 对同轨声音要求：列全本镜对白、旁白、画外声、必要非语言发声和音效，逐字原句只在单镜可复制正文中出现一次，事件外回到已定底声或静默。视觉段按时点引用声音事件，不再抄一遍原句。

每项人声至少回答：谁、从哪里、用什么语言、说哪一句、何时开始与结束。叹气、笑声、吸气与重叠说话只有本场确实选择时才加入；不是所有片段都要禁止它们。

同一镜前面写“无对白”，后面又安排人物说话，是相互矛盾的目标。只说“不要旁白”也没有交代应保住哪些对白或音效。末尾总结本镜实际层次，把作者已经确认不要的新增声音合并说明一次，不扩大成一套通用禁令。
body.en:
For sound generated with picture, Drama Skills’ motion recipe lists all dialogue, narration, off-screen speech, needed nonverbal events and effects. Exact lines appear once in the copyable shot text. Outside those events, retain declared ambience or silence; the visual section refers to sound events without repeating their words.

Each voice event needs speaker, source, language, exact line, and beginning/end. Include sighs, laughter, breaths or overlap when the scene chooses them rather than prohibiting them universally.

“No dialogue” followed by a speaking action contradicts itself. “No voiceover” alone also fails to identify required speech and effects. Summarize the actual layers at the end and consolidate only the creator’s confirmed exclusions.

heading.zh: 完整示例一：保留店员的原句，不让模型加解说
heading.en: Complete example one: keep the clerk’s line

body.zh:
原创纸面场景：打印店柜台，店员孟茹把一册样册交给顾言。她的画内普通话对白是“这本先给你核对。”顾言本镜不说话。已定声音只有连续低风扇声、这句对白，以及接册时的轻微纸张摩擦；作者已确认不要旁白、新台词、额外语气词、重复句或配乐。时长尚待按实际发声、交接与收尾核定，没有生成或回听结果。

下面是可按角色和场景事实接入的指令候选，没有假称已存在参考图或录音：

> 固定双人中景，孟茹在柜台后，顾言在柜台前，一册样册由孟茹持有。开头两人保持当前位置，连续低风扇声已经存在。
>
> 孟茹把样册放到柜台交接位置，顾言先等待。她完成放置后进行声音事件A：孟茹画内对白，实际说话语言为普通话，逐字说“这本先给你核对。”发声从这句首字开始，到末字结束。顾言在事件A期间听，不发声，嘴唇闭合；视觉段不重复这一句。
>
> 事件A结束后，顾言才接起样册，孟茹松手。保留接册所产生的轻微纸张摩擦声，风扇底声继续。结尾样册在顾言手中，孟茹双手已空，两人都不再发声。声音层只有本句画内对白、风扇底声和所述纸声；不加入旁白、新台词、额外语气词、重复句或配乐。

原句不是旁白，不用改成旁白来避开口型。末尾也不能再加一个“他终于拿到样册”的解说。交接完成不表示顾言已经核对内容；影片只到接册这一拍。

英文提示词正文也可以保留普通话原句；下面的译文仅供英文读者理解，不能当第二条要发声的台词加入生成指令。
body.en:
Original paper scene: printing-shop clerk Meng Ru hands one sample booklet to Gu Yan across a counter. Meng’s visible dialogue is the Mandarin line shown below. Gu does not speak. Established sound consists only of a continuous low fan, that line and slight paper friction during receipt. The creator excludes narration, new lines, extra fillers, repeats and music. Duration still needs actual speech, handoff and ending checks; no footage or listening result exists.

This candidate can be adapted to established character and location facts. It claims no existing reference image or recording:

> Fixed two-person medium shot. Meng Ru is behind the counter, Gu Yan in front, and Meng holds one sample booklet. Start in these positions with the established low fan ambience.
>
> Meng places the booklet at the counter’s handoff position while Gu waits. After placing it, sound event A begins: Meng Ru, visible dialogue, spoken Mandarin, verbatim “这本先给你核对。” Speech begins with its first word and ends with its last. Gu listens without vocalizing, lips closed. The visual segment does not repeat that line.
>
> After event A finishes, Gu takes the booklet and Meng releases it. Keep slight paper friction from the handoff and continuous fan ambience. End with the booklet in Gu’s hands and Meng’s hands empty; neither vocalizes again. Sound layers are this visible line, fan ambience and the stated paper sound. Add no narration, new lines, extra fillers, repeats or music.

The line means “This copy is for you to check first.” This explanatory translation is outside the generation instruction and is not a second spoken line. An English prompt body can retain the Mandarin original.

The line is dialogue, not narration; relabeling it to avoid mouth animation changes the scene. Do not append narration announcing successful receipt. Receiving the booklet does not mean Gu has checked its contents.

heading.zh: 完整示例二：另一已定无对白版本，仍保留环境与纸声
heading.en: Complete example two: a separately chosen no-dialogue version

body.zh:
如果作者另选的剧本版本本就没有台词，同一交接也可以只有环境与动作声音。这是制作前明确采用的另一版本，不是修掉额外旁白时顺便删除原本要求的店员对白：

> 固定双人中景，起点仍是孟茹在柜台后持一册样册、顾言在柜台前等待。全镜只有连续低风扇底声和接册时的轻微纸张摩擦声。两人全程不发声，嘴唇闭合。
>
> 孟茹把样册放到交接位置，顾言随后接起，孟茹松手。纸声只跟这次实际接册发生；动作前后风扇底声继续，不补声音空缺。结尾样册在顾言手中、孟茹双手空着，保留这一状态。全镜无对白、旁白、画外说话、额外人声或配乐，保留已定风扇声与纸声。

“无对白”与“全片静音”不同。本例没有叹气或笑声；若你的剧本需要它们，明确由谁在哪一拍发出，不照抄本例的排除项。提示词语言、实际说话语言与字幕文字分别决定。
body.en:
If the creator separately adopts a script without dialogue, the same transfer can use ambience and action sound alone. Choose that version before production rather than deleting required speech while repairing added narration:

> Fixed two-person medium shot. Meng holds one sample booklet behind the counter; Gu waits in front. Throughout, retain only the continuous low fan and slight paper friction during receipt. Neither person vocalizes; both keep lips closed.
>
> Meng places the booklet at the handoff position. Gu then takes it and Meng releases it. Paper sound follows this actual handoff; before and after it, fan ambience continues without filling the gap with another sound. End with the booklet in Gu’s hands and Meng’s hands empty, holding that state. No dialogue, narration, off-screen speech, other voices or music; retain the declared fan and paper sounds.

No dialogue is different from a muted film. This version has no sigh or laughter. Where a script needs those events, state who produces them and when instead of copying this exclusion set. Prompt language, actual spoken language and subtitle text are separate decisions.

heading.zh: 生成后回听，修改提示词不等于已经删掉声音
heading.en: Listen after generation and repair the right layer

body.zh:
从头到尾回听这句有没有多出的开头、尾句、重复或换人，再看接册时有没有让顾言跟说。对照的是实际音频，不是字幕里看起来正确的原句。记录错误发生在原素材还是后期，再只改对应段落或声音轨。

若多余旁白和正确对白已经混在同一条音轨，直接静音会一起删掉它们。要采用重出、独立配音或后期处理，先确认实际工具能执行所需方案，处理后回听输出。套件剪辑工具的声音说明不会自动把文字要求变成静音、声音桥或替换音轨。

模型可能仍产生额外发声，文字约束不是成功证明。无新增声音之外，还要保留完整原句、正确说话者、必要音效与本场结尾；修复不能以丢失原要求为代价。
body.en:
Listen from beginning to end for added prefixes, endings, repeats or changed speakers; then inspect whether Gu speaks along during receipt. Compare actual audio rather than correct-looking subtitles. Locate the error in source or post-production and change the affected segment or track.

If unwanted narration shares a track with required dialogue, muting removes both. For regeneration, separate dubbing or post-production, confirm that the actual tool can perform the chosen treatment, then listen to its output. The suite’s edit sound notes do not automatically execute muting, bridges or track replacement.

Wording does not prove successful exclusion. Preserve the full required line, correct speaker, needed effects and intended ending as well as removing additions.

q.zh: 写“不要旁白”就够了吗？
q.en: Is “no voiceover” enough?

a.zh: 还要说明允许的对白、音效、底声与事件间状态。否则它没有交代应保住什么。按本场已定声音写完整时间线，生成后回听。
a.en: Also specify permitted dialogue, effects, ambience and intervals. State what to retain in a complete timeline, then listen to the result.

q.zh: 能不能把原视频静音解决？
q.en: Can muting the source solve it?

a.zh: 只有作者确实选择不要原声音轨、并另有已确认的声音方案时才这样处理。若仍要保留同轨对白或音效，全部静音会删掉所需内容。
a.en: Only when the creator chooses to discard the source track and has an adopted replacement. Whole-track muting also removes dialogue or effects that must remain.

text.zh: 用 $short-drama-video-prompts 修本镜擅自新增发声的声音段。附本场剧本、逐字台词、说话人、声源、语种、已定底声/音效与实际多出的声音位置。要求原句单镜出现一次、事件外回归底声、只合并已确认排除项，视觉与终点保持；不得声称改提示词已经修好成片。
text.en: Use $short-drama-video-prompts with the scene script, exact lines, speakers, source types, languages, ambience/effects and observed additions. Ask for one occurrence of each line, established sound between events and only confirmed exclusions. Preserve visuals and ending; a prompt revision is not a repaired film.

label.en: Complete sound timeline and exact lines
