title.zh: 视频透明动态字幕和Logo图层怎么叠加
title.en: How to Overlay Animated Transparent Graphics on Video

seo_title.zh: 视频透明动态图层怎么叠加
seo_title.en: How to Overlay Animated Transparent Graphics on Video

description.zh: 把已渲染的全画布透明动画序列叠到锁定母版，保留采用的混音。附交接表、边界残影与遮挡修订方法。
description.en: Overlay a rendered full-canvas transparent animation on a locked master while retaining the adopted mix. Includes handoff and boundary review sheets.

answer.zh: 先锁定母版的画面、剪点和已采用完整混音；这份混音须已在母版 AAC `a:0`。透明动画从输出第 0 帧开始，用连续零起点、无缺漏或额外文件的 `frame_%06d.png` RGBA 全画布序列覆盖完整 `[0, total_frames)`；没有图形的时段也交付全透明帧。每次计划检查和实际合成都使用新的未存在输出目录，只有实际渲染并通过验证的新文件才成为候选。随后检查动画边界、人物与证据遮挡、首尾帧和全片声音连续性；修订透明序列后再生成另一份候选。
answer.en: Lock the master picture, cuts, and complete adopted mix first; that mix must already be AAC `a:0` in the master. The transparent animation starts at output frame zero and covers the complete `[0, total_frames)` clock as contiguous, zero-based, full-canvas RGBA `frame_%06d.png` files with no missing or extra entries. Visually empty spans still receive fully transparent frames. Use a fresh nonexistent output directory for each planning check and real composition. Only a real render that passes verification becomes a candidate. Then inspect motion boundaries, obstruction of people or evidence, first and last frames, and whole-program audio continuity; revise the transparent sequence and produce another candidate when needed.

heading.zh: 先列齐五项交接，再开始叠加
heading.en: Complete five handoff items first

body.zh:
- [ ] 指定锁定母版：MP4 家族容器中的 H.264、零起点恒定帧率、`yuv420p`，并带明确 BT.709 / TV 有限范围色彩信息。
- [ ] 确认完整已采用混音已经位于母版 AAC `a:0`；这条路径只复制该声音流。若采用声音还在另一条流，先在上游配对或重封装成新的锁定母版。
- [ ] 指定已渲染透明动画：从 `frame_000000.png` 开始的连续 `frame_%06d.png`，每张都是与母版完全同尺寸的 RGBA 全画布图片，目录没有缺帧或额外文件。
- [ ] 覆盖完整帧钟：序列从输出第 0 帧覆盖到实际探测母版总帧数的半开区间 `[0, total_frames)`；没有图形的时段使用全透明帧，仍留在连续序列内。
- [ ] 保留母版并建立新候选与复核清单：每次检查或渲染选用新的未存在输出目录，记录需要观看和试听的边界。

Video Recap 的这一合成路径消费调用方已经完成的 RGBA 动画序列。它负责把现成像素叠到锁定母版；字体选择、文案写作、Logo 绘制和动画设计留在上一步。交接双方由此能区分“图层内容已经定稿”和“实际合成候选已经通过检查”。
body.en:
- [ ] Name the locked master: an MP4-family H.264 file with a zero-origin constant frame rate, `yuv420p`, and explicit BT.709 / TV limited-range color metadata.
- [ ] Confirm that the complete adopted mix is already AAC `a:0` in that master; this path copies only that stream. If the adopted sound is another stream, pair or remux it upstream into a new locked master first.
- [ ] Name the rendered animation: contiguous `frame_%06d.png` files beginning with `frame_000000.png`, each an RGBA full-canvas image matching the master exactly, with no missing or extra entries.
- [ ] Cover the full clock: the sequence runs from output frame zero through the half-open `[0, total_frames)` range measured from the master. Spans with no visible graphic still contain fully transparent frames inside the continuous sequence.
- [ ] Retain the master and create a new-candidate review sheet. Give every check or render a fresh nonexistent output directory and list the boundaries that require viewing and listening.

This Video Recap composition path consumes caller-finished RGBA animation frames and overlays those existing pixels on a locked master. Font choice, copywriting, logo drawing, and motion design remain upstream. The handoff therefore separates “the layer content is approved” from “the real composited candidate has passed review.”

heading.zh: 原创两列制作表：锁定输入、输出和检查点
heading.en: Author-designed two-column production worksheet

body.zh:
这张表是本文根据来源边界设计的制作工作表，用来组织交接与人工复核，不是来源工具的私有计划格式。

| 制作项 | 本轮要填写的内容 |
|---|---|
| 锁定母版 | 唯一版本标识；MP4/H.264、零起点恒定帧率、`yuv420p`、明确 BT.709 / TV 有限范围；实际画布与总帧数。 |
| 已采用声音 | 完整混音已在母版 AAC `a:0`；若原来位于另一流，记录上游生成的新锁定母版。 |
| 透明动画 | 交付者；`frame_000000.png` 起连续编号；RGBA 全画布；完整 `[0, total_frames)` 覆盖；空白时段为全透明帧。 |
| 创作意图 | 每段动态图层帮助观众看懂什么；哪些人物、动作、证据和画面文字必须始终露出。 |
| 边界帧 | 每次进入前一帧、进入帧、稳定段、退出前一帧、退出帧，以及全片首尾帧。 |
| 输出与声音检查 | 计划检查目录、实际渲染目录和候选名称分别记录；试听改动前、边界处、改动后和全片。 |

先固定版本关系，再安排观看。亮背景、暗背景、人物近景、动作靠近画面边缘和信息密集镜头都进入抽检。代表帧快速发现透明度与遮挡问题，完整播放负责发现短暂闪烁、残影和声音中断。
body.en:
This is an author-designed production worksheet derived from the cited boundaries. It organizes handoff and human review; it is not the tool’s private plan format.

| Production item | What to record for this pass |
|---|---|
| Locked master | Unique version identifier; MP4/H.264, zero-origin CFR, `yuv420p`, explicit BT.709 / TV limited range; actual canvas and total frames. |
| Adopted sound | Complete mix already present as master AAC `a:0`; if it began on another stream, record the new locked master prepared upstream. |
| Transparent animation | Delivering party; contiguous numbering from `frame_000000.png`; full-canvas RGBA; complete `[0, total_frames)` coverage; fully transparent frames through visually empty spans. |
| Creator intent | What each animated element helps the viewer understand; people, actions, evidence, and on-picture text that must remain visible. |
| Boundary frames | Frame before entry, entry frame, stable passage, frame before exit, exit frame, plus the program’s first and last frames. |
| Output and audio review | Record separate planning-check directory, real-render directory, and candidate name; listen before, across, and after the change, then through the whole program. |

Fix version relationships before playback. Sample bright scenes, dark scenes, close-ups, action near the canvas edge, and information-dense shots. Representative frames expose transparency and obstruction quickly; complete playback exposes brief flashes, ghosts, and audio interruptions.

heading.zh: 原创纸面案例：给潮间带观察短片叠动态识别层
heading.en: Original paper example: an animated guide layer for a tide-pool film

body.zh:
下面的“潮池一分钟”是本文设计的纸面案例。它没有创建素材、渲染视频、运行合成或进行试听，所有观察项都等待真实候选生成后确认。

创作者已经锁定一条横屏短片：画面依次展示海葵收缩、寄居蟹换壳和潮水漫过岩面，旁白、现场水声与轻音乐已经采用。另一位设计者交付完整全画布透明动画序列：片头栏目 Logo 轻微显现；物种出现时，一条细线从安全边缘移动到目标附近；标签随后淡出。图层的意图是帮助观众快速定位生物，同时保留触手、蟹钳、壳口和水线这些观察证据。

| 时间段与意图 | 合成后的检查决定 |
|---|---|
| 片头 Logo 进入 | 看进入前一帧、第一张可见帧和稳定帧；透明背景保持画面可见，Logo 不碰海面地平线。 |
| 海葵指示线移动 | 逐帧看线头是否越过触手；若遮住收缩动作，回序列缩短线段或改变已设计运动路径。 |
| 寄居蟹标签停留 | 播放整段，确认标签没有盖住壳口和蟹钳，也没有在明暗岩石交替时闪烁。 |
| 标签退出 | 看退出前后连续帧；若最后一张有内容的帧后仍残留半透明边缘，修序列的退出帧，再做新候选。 |
| 全片声音 | 听 Logo 进入前后、两个物种交接和片尾，再完整播放；旁白、水声和音乐应延续已采用版本。 |

这份案例把修改点留在正确的生产阶段：透明像素、运动边界和遮挡回到动画序列修；母版剪点与采用混音保持锁定。每次修订都生成另一个候选，便于与锁定母版及上一候选对照。
body.en:
Tide Pool in One Minute is an original paper example designed for this article. It creates no assets, renders no video, runs no composition, and performs no listening. Every observation remains pending until a real candidate exists.

The creator has locked a landscape short showing an anemone contracting, a hermit crab changing shells, and tidewater crossing the rock. Narration, location sound, and light music are adopted. A designer delivers a complete full-canvas transparent animation sequence: a program logo eases in at the opening; a fine line moves from a safe edge toward each species; its label then fades away. The layer helps viewers locate the animals while keeping the tentacles, claw, shell opening, and waterline visible as evidence.

| Passage and intent | Review decision after composition |
|---|---|
| Opening logo entry | Inspect the frame before entry, first visible frame, and stable frame. The transparent field preserves the shot, and the logo clears the sea horizon. |
| Moving anemone pointer | Step through the movement and check whether the line crosses the tentacles. If it blocks the contraction, shorten the line or revise its designed motion in the sequence. |
| Hermit-crab label hold | Play the passage and confirm that the label clears the shell opening and claw and remains stable across alternating light and dark rocks. |
| Label exit | Inspect consecutive frames around the exit. If a translucent edge remains after the final intended frame, correct the sequence's exit frames and make a new candidate. |
| Whole-program sound | Listen before and after the logo entry, across both species transitions, and at the ending, then play the full program. Narration, water sound, and music should continue from the adopted version. |

The example returns each correction to its proper stage. Transparent pixels, motion boundaries, and obstruction go back to the animation sequence; the master cuts and adopted mix stay locked. Each revision becomes another candidate for comparison with the master and prior candidate.

heading.zh: 按失败形状修正确环节
heading.en: Correct the stage indicated by the failure

body.zh:
| 失败形状 | 修订动作 |
|---|---|
| 动画第一帧突然跳出 | 回看进入前一帧与第一张可见帧，修透明序列的进入边界；母版保持不动。 |
| 退出后留下一圈半透明残影 | 找到最后一张带内容的图层帧，修尾部透明像素与退出帧，再生成新候选。 |
| 标签只在某个动作瞬间挡住主体 | 标出对应母版帧和被挡证据，局部移动、缩短或隐藏该段图层；其余已通过区间不重做。 |
| 图层整体拉伸、错位或边缘被裁 | 停止使用该输入，按母版实际画布和帧钟重新交接完整序列。 |
| 候选的旁白、原声或音乐发生中断或换版 | 淘汰该候选，重新从锁定母版与其已采用声音建立合成；随后重听边界和全片。 |
| 技术检查通过，观看仍发现闪烁或遮挡 | 以实际播放观察为准修图层。文件验证证明媒体关系，创作验收来自这版候选的观看与试听。 |

修订记录至少写明候选版本、问题所在帧或段落、被遮住的内容、回到哪一份透明序列修改，以及新候选仍需复看的位置。记录具体观察能防止下一轮只写“效果不对”，也能保护已经通过的区间。
body.en:
| Failure shape | Correction |
|---|---|
| The animation pops on at its first frame | Review the preceding frame and first visible frame, then repair the sequence entry while leaving the master unchanged. |
| A translucent rim remains after exit | Locate the final occupied layer frame, correct trailing alpha pixels and exit frames, and produce a new candidate. |
| A label blocks the subject during one action | Mark the corresponding master frames and obscured evidence. Move, shorten, or hide the layer locally while retaining approved passages. |
| The whole layer is stretched, displaced, or cropped | Reject that input and hand off a complete sequence against the master's actual canvas and frame clock. |
| Narration, source sound, or music breaks or changes version | Reject the candidate and compose again from the locked master carrying its adopted sound, then repeat boundary and full-program listening. |
| Mechanical checks pass while playback reveals flicker or obstruction | Repair from actual playback observations. File validation establishes media relationships; creative approval comes from viewing and listening to this candidate. |

A revision record names the candidate, affected frames or passage, obscured content, transparent-sequence revision, and review points that remain. Concrete observations replace vague notes such as “the effect feels wrong” and protect passages that have already passed.

heading.zh: 把合成作为可选执行步骤交给 Video Recap
heading.en: Hand optional execution to Video Recap

body.zh:
| 可选执行条件 | 当前固定版本的要求 |
|---|---|
| 锁定母版 | MP4 家族 H.264；零起点恒定帧率；`yuv420p`；明确 BT.709 / TV 有限范围；画布、帧率和总帧数与实际探测一致。 |
| 已采用完整混音 | 已位于母版 AAC `a:0`，并与画面时钟相容；合成只复制这一流。采用声音位于别处时，先在上游配对或重封装成新母版。 |
| 透明动画 | `frame_%06d.png` 从零连续编号；每张 PNG 都是正确尺寸的 RGBA 全画布；完整覆盖 `[0, total_frames)`，无缺失或额外文件，空白时段用全透明帧。 |
| 输出纪律 | 每次计划检查和实际渲染都用新的未存在目录。计划检查只写运行报告，不生成候选，也不更新当前指针；失败渲染保留报告和已有日志，同时移除暂存与最终媒体。 |

满足这些条件后，可以把真实输入位置、创作意图和复核表交给 `$video-recap`。实际合成只重编码叠加后的 H.264 画面，因此透明区域下的解码画面按可见容差复核，不承诺逐像素一致；母版 AAC `a:0` 保持复制。只有实际渲染完成并通过机械验证的新文件才进入候选复核，随后仍要正常速度观看和完整试听。

母版还在改剪点、动画序列尚未完成、画布或帧钟不符时，先回上游准备输入。本任务只处理完整动态透明前景与锁定母版的合成。
body.en:
| Optional execution condition | Requirement at the cited revision |
|---|---|
| Locked master | MP4-family H.264; zero-origin CFR; `yuv420p`; explicit BT.709 / TV limited range; declared canvas, frame rate, and total frames matching the measured file. |
| Complete adopted mix | Already present as master AAC `a:0` and compatible with the picture clock; composition copies only this stream. When adopted sound lives elsewhere, pair or remux it upstream into a new master first. |
| Transparent animation | Zero-based contiguous `frame_%06d.png` names; every PNG is full-canvas RGBA at the exact dimensions; complete `[0, total_frames)` coverage with no missing or extra files and fully transparent frames through empty spans. |
| Output discipline | Use a fresh nonexistent directory for every planning check and real render. A planning check writes only its run report, produces no candidate, and updates no current pointer. A failed render retains the report and available logs while removing staged and final media. |

Once these conditions hold, hand real input locations, creator intent, and the review sheet to `$video-recap`. Composition re-encodes only the overlaid H.264 picture, so visually preserved regions require tolerance-based review rather than a pixel-identity promise; master AAC `a:0` is copied. Only a real render that completes mechanical verification enters candidate review, followed by normal-speed viewing and complete listening.

When cuts are still changing, the animation remains incomplete, or canvas and frame clock differ, prepare those inputs upstream. This task covers only composition of a complete animated transparent foreground onto a locked master.

q.zh: 透明动画在样帧里正常，为什么还要完整播放？
q.en: Why play the whole video when sampled frames look correct?

a.zh: 样帧能查画布、透明度和代表性遮挡；完整播放才能发现短暂闪烁、进入或退出残影、移动中途遮住动作，以及声音在边界处中断。两种检查覆盖不同问题。
a.en: Sampled frames check canvas, transparency, and representative obstruction. Full playback reveals brief flicker, entry or exit ghosts, obstruction during movement, and audio breaks at boundaries. The checks cover different failures.

q.zh: 可以直接覆盖锁定母版吗？
q.en: Can the composition overwrite the locked master?

a.zh: 保留锁定母版并输出新候选。这样可以对照画面、声音和边界，也能在图层修订后继续生成候选，而不丢失已采用版本。
a.en: Retain the locked master and write a new candidate. This preserves picture, sound, and boundary comparisons and supports another candidate after a layer revision without losing the adopted version.

text.zh: 用 `$video-recap` 把我已完成的全画布 RGBA 动态透明序列叠到这份锁定母版。母版是 MP4/H.264、零起点恒定帧率、`yuv420p`、明确 BT.709 / TV 有限范围，完整已采用混音已在 AAC `a:0`；请只复制这条声音流。序列从 `frame_000000.png` 连续覆盖完整 `[0, total_frames)`，没有缺帧或额外文件，空白时段使用全透明帧。计划检查和实际渲染分别使用新的未存在输出目录；只有实际渲染并验证通过的新文件才作为候选。保留母版，列出动画边界、遮挡、首尾帧与全片声音复核点。
text.en: Use `$video-recap` to overlay my completed full-canvas RGBA animation sequence on this locked master. The master is MP4/H.264, zero-origin CFR, `yuv420p`, with explicit BT.709 / TV limited range, and its complete adopted mix is already AAC `a:0`; copy only that audio stream. The sequence runs contiguously from `frame_000000.png` through the complete `[0, total_frames)` range with no missing or extra files and fully transparent frames in empty spans. Use separate fresh nonexistent output directories for the planning check and real render. Treat only a real render that passes verification as a candidate. Retain the master and list motion-boundary, obstruction, first/last-frame, and whole-program audio review points.

title.zh: 短剧关键场景怎么比较不同拍法：先选导演命题，再做正式分镜
title.en: How to Compare Directing Approaches for a Key Scene

seo_title.zh: 短剧关键场景怎么比较不同拍法
seo_title.en: How to Compare Directing Approaches for a Key Scene

description.zh: 在正式分镜前比较两到三种真正不同的导演命题，从知情时机、视点、表演中心、空间声音与结尾取舍中选定一种。
description.en: Compare directing propositions through knowledge timing, viewpoint, performance ownership, space, sound, endings, and explicit tradeoffs.

answer.zh: 关键场景先写清共同的剧本事实和必须到达的结尾，再提出两到三种会改变观众体验的导演命题。逐案比较观众何时知道什么、主要跟随谁、表演空间归谁、核心画面、空间与声音策略、结尾落点和代价。选择一种后，只把它的观众立场、揭示顺序、空间关系与声音策略交给正式分镜；候选阶段不写固定宫格、镜头数量或景别比例。
answer.en: Before formal shots, lock the shared script facts and required ending, then propose two or three approaches that would genuinely change the viewer's experience. Compare when the audience learns each fact, whose side it occupies, who owns the performance, the strongest image, spatial and sound strategy, ending, and tradeoffs. Select one proposition and project only its viewpoint, information timing, space, and sound strategy into the storyboard. Do not turn the audition into a fixed grid, shot count, or shot-size ratio.

heading.zh: 先锁定共同事实，再提出候选拍法
heading.en: Lock shared facts before proposing alternatives

body.zh:
- [ ] 写明场景 ID、当前剧本版本、地点和在场人物。
- [ ] 写明开场状态：人物位置、持物、已知信息、持续声音和空间阻挡。
- [ ] 写明不可改的触发、人物行动、反应与结尾状态。
- [ ] 写明本场为什么值得比较：观看位置、知情时机或表演所有权的变化会怎样改变体验。
- [ ] 只提出两到三种真正不同的导演命题，每种至少改变知情时机、视点、表演中心、空间或声音中的一项。

普通连接场景可以直接进入分镜。关系反转、身份揭示、高潮、结尾、复杂多人调度或悬念延迟更可能受益于这一步。判断依据是不同导演命题会不会改变观众怎样经历场景。“重要场景”标签本身不触发额外表格。
body.en:
- [ ] Record the scene ID, current script revision, location, and people present.
- [ ] Record the opening state: positions, held objects, current knowledge, continuing sound, and spatial obstacles.
- [ ] Lock the trigger, character action, reaction, and ending state that every approach must preserve.
- [ ] State why this scene merits comparison: how would a change in viewpoint, knowledge timing, or performance ownership alter the experience?
- [ ] Propose only two or three genuinely different directing propositions. Each must change at least one of knowledge timing, viewpoint, performance ownership, space, or sound.

An ordinary connective scene can proceed directly to storyboarding. Relationship reversals, reveals, climaxes, endings, complex group blocking, and delayed suspense are stronger candidates. The deciding question is whether different propositions change how the audience experiences the scene. An “important” label carries no weight on its own.

heading.zh: 用一张两列备忘录比较每个命题
heading.en: Compare each proposition with a two-column memo

body.zh:
下面是本文设计的作者工作表，用于选择导演命题；`short-drama-storyboard` 的原生文件不要求使用这套格式。每个候选各填一遍，保留反对理由。

| 比较项 | 本方案的明确选择 |
|---|---|
| 观众知情时机 | 观众在触发前、人物接收时或人物行动后知道关键事实；写明被延迟的信息。 |
| 观看位置 | 观众主要与谁对齐；转折前后是否换边；哪些人物只能被观察。 |
| 表演所有权 | 谁获得停顿、反应和决定的空间；谁暂时退为声音、遮挡或旁观。 |
| 最强画面 | 哪个可见状态最集中地承载转折；它发生前需要保留什么。 |
| 空间与声音 | 入口、距离、阻挡、通道和画外声怎样参与权力变化。 |
| 结尾落点 | 最后留下哪位人物、哪件物、哪种距离或哪段声音。 |
| 得到与失去 | 方案强化什么，又会损失哪些反应、空间信息或悬念。 |
| 制作相容性 | 当前地点、参与资产与制作形态能否承载这项选择；未知项明确留待确认。 |

两个候选若拥有相同的知情时机、对齐对象、表演中心、最强画面和结尾落点，只换了景别名称，它们仍是同一个导演命题。
body.en:
The worksheet below is an author-designed selection aid; native `short-drama-storyboard` files do not require this structure. Complete it once per candidate and retain the reasons against each option.

| Comparison field | Explicit choice in this proposition |
|---|---|
| Audience knowledge timing | State whether the audience learns the key fact before the trigger, as a character receives it, or after the character acts; name the delayed information. |
| Viewpoint | Name the primary alignment, whether the audience changes sides around the turn, and which people remain observed from outside. |
| Performance ownership | Name who receives room for the pause, reaction, and decision, and who recedes into sound, obstruction, or observation. |
| Strongest image | Describe the visible state that carries the turn and what must be withheld until it arrives. |
| Space and sound | Explain how entrances, distance, obstacles, passage ownership, and offscreen sound participate in the power change. |
| Ending | State which person, object, distance, or sound remains at the landing. |
| Gain and loss | Name what the approach strengthens and which reactions, spatial facts, or suspense it gives up. |
| Production fit | Check whether the current location, participating assets, and production form support the choice; mark unknowns for confirmation. |

Two candidates remain the same directing proposition when they share knowledge timing, alignment, performance ownership, strongest image, and ending and merely rename shot sizes.

heading.zh: 原创纸面案例：观测站交接控制权
heading.en: Original paper example: a control handoff at an observatory

body.zh:
下面的“山顶观测站”是本文原创的纸面场景，没有拍摄、生成或观众测试结果。夜间校准开始时，站长赵峤坐在主控台前，访问卡挂在胸前；见习员梅槿站在他右后方的日志台旁；追踪警报间歇响起，屏幕上的目标标记持续向右偏移。两人都知道系统必须在下一轮自动校准前恢复手动追踪。梅槿尚不知道赵峤为什么没有修正。

共同触发是赵峤第一次伸手时错过修正旋钮，第二次碰到旋钮却向错误方向微调，偏移扩大。共同动作是梅槿看懂第二次错误微调后说“让我接手”，赵峤停止操作，连人带椅向左滚出控制位，仍坐在左侧，并将访问卡平放在键盘旁。梅槿穿过刚打开的通道，站到主控台前，拿起访问卡解锁手动控制，把卡放回键盘旁，再把旋钮回调到目标标记停止漂移的位置。共同结尾是赵峤连同椅子留在控制位左外侧并保持坐姿，梅槿站在主控台前，访问卡回到键盘旁，警报停止而设备仍处于手动追踪。

| 命题 | 比较备忘 |
|---|---|
| A：把表演交给赵峤 | 观众与梅槿同时从第二次错误微调发现异常；随后看赵峤停顿并放弃操作，屏幕才确认偏移已经扩大。最强画面是访问卡离开赵峤胸前并落到键盘旁。室内警报持续到梅槿完成回调。得到赵峤主动让位的重量，较晚才看清技术风险。 |
| B：让观众先知道 | 观众先看见目标标记右移和错误微调，再观察梅槿何时意识到问题。表演中心转给梅槿的判断与开口。最强画面是赵峤连人带椅滚向左侧后，她穿过打开的通道并站到主控台前。得到清楚的因果和悬念，赵峤的内在处理空间减少。 |
| C：用空间与声音完成换位 | 观众起初留在狭窄通道一侧，赵峤的椅子挡住梅槿去主控台的路线；他连人带椅滚到左侧并保持坐姿，通道随之打开。警报先占据声场，卡片落桌声与警报停止成为两个落点。得到明确的空间权力变化，屏幕细节和两人的细微反应较少。 |

三个方案保留同一开场、触发、动作因果和结尾状态。它们真正不同的部分是观众先知道什么、跟谁判断、谁拥有停顿，以及权力变化由卡片、屏幕还是通道承载。
body.en:
The Mountaintop Observatory is an original paper scene created for this article. It has no filmed, generated, or audience-tested result. At the start of a night calibration, station chief Zhao Qiao sits at the main console with an access card on his chest. Trainee Mei Jin stands behind and to his right beside the log desk. A tracking alarm sounds intermittently while the target marker on the display continues drifting right. Both know that manual tracking must be restored before the next automatic calibration cycle. Mei does not yet know why Zhao has failed to correct it.

The shared trigger is Zhao missing the correction dial on his first reach, then touching it and turning the wrong way on his second attempt, increasing the drift. The shared action is Mei recognizing the second incorrect adjustment and saying, “Let me take over.” Zhao stops operating the console, rolls himself and the chair left out of the control position, remains seated on the left, and lays the access card beside the keyboard. Mei crosses through the newly opened passage, stands at the console, picks up the card to unlock manual control, returns it beside the keyboard, and turns the dial back until the target marker stops drifting. At the shared ending, Zhao and the chair remain to the left outside the control position with Zhao seated, Mei stands at the console, the card has returned beside the keyboard, the alarm has stopped, and the instrument remains under manual tracking.

| Proposition | Comparison memo |
|---|---|
| A: give Zhao the performance | The audience and Mei discover the problem from Zhao's second incorrect adjustment. They then watch his pause and surrender before the display confirms that the drift has increased. The strongest image is the access card leaving his chest and landing beside the keyboard. The alarm continues until Mei completes the correction. The approach gives weight to Zhao's voluntary withdrawal while delaying the technical risk. |
| B: let the audience know first | The audience sees the marker drift and the incorrect adjustment before watching Mei recognize them. Performance ownership shifts to her judgment and decision to speak. The strongest image is Zhao rolling himself and the chair left, opening the passage for Mei to cross and stand at the console. The approach clarifies causality and suspense while reducing Zhao's private processing time. |
| C: make space and sound carry the handoff | The audience begins from one side of the narrow passage, with Zhao's chair blocking Mei's route to the console. He rolls himself and the chair left, remains seated there, and opens the passage. The alarm dominates first; the card landing and the alarm stopping become separate sound landings. The approach makes spatial authority explicit while giving less room to display detail and subtle reactions. |

All three preserve the same opening, trigger, causal actions, and ending state. They differ in what the audience learns first, whose judgment it follows, who owns the pause, and whether the card, display, or passage carries the power change.

heading.zh: 选择一种命题，只投影选择结果
heading.en: Select one proposition and project only the decision

body.zh:
假设创作者选择方案 A。交给正式分镜的内容是：观众与梅槿从第二次错误微调同步发现异常；赵峤随后拥有停顿与放弃操作的表演空间；屏幕确认偏移扩大延迟到他决定退出之后；赵峤连人带椅滚到控制位左外侧并保持坐姿；梅槿穿过通道、站到主控台前，拿卡解锁后放回键盘旁再回调旋钮；警报持续到回调完成。

这份选择没有指定镜头数量、宫格、景别比例或逐镜编号。`short-drama-storyboard` 接手后，仍需根据当前剧本、视觉事实、地点、资产、制作形态和连续性边界设计正式 shots。未选的方案 B、C 留在比较记录中，作为舍弃理由的证据，不进入正式分镜，也不与方案 A 混成折中版。
body.en:
Assume the creator selects proposition A. The storyboard handoff says: the audience and Mei discover the problem from Zhao's second incorrect adjustment; Zhao then owns the pause and surrender; display confirmation of the increased drift waits until he chooses to withdraw; Zhao rolls himself and the chair left and remains seated outside the control position; Mei crosses the opened passage, stands at the console, uses the card, returns it beside the keyboard, and corrects the dial; the alarm continues until the correction is complete.

This selection specifies no shot count, grid, shot-size ratio, or shot IDs. `short-drama-storyboard` still designs the formal shots from the current script, visual facts, location, assets, production form, and continuity boundaries. Propositions B and C remain in the comparison record as evidence for the rejected tradeoffs. They do not enter the formal storyboard or blend into a compromise version of A.

heading.zh: 删掉伪方案，补齐真实取舍
heading.en: Remove false alternatives and expose real tradeoffs

body.zh:
| 发现的问题 | 修订动作 |
|---|---|
| 三个方案只换远景、近景和特写名称 | 重写其中两案，改变观众知情时机、对齐对象、表演所有权、空间或声音命题。 |
| 每案都列完整镜头表 | 退回导演命题层，只保留观看位置、信息时机、最强画面、结尾与取舍。 |
| 候选改变了剧本触发或结局 | 恢复共同事实；若剧情确实需要变更，先交回剧本 owner。 |
| 每案都宣称“更有冲击力” | 写出具体得到与失去的反应、空间信息、悬念或制作负担。 |
| 选择后仍把所有亮点塞进正式分镜 | 只投影选中命题，保留其他方案的反对理由，避免互相抵消。 |
| 普通过场也制作多套方案 | 直接进入分镜，把比较留给观看位置或信息时机会显著改变体验的场景。 |

这一步完成时，交付物是一项可解释的创作者选择和一份取舍记录。正式镜头设计、时长、连续性与冻结关键帧继续由分镜阶段负责。
body.en:
| Problem found | Revision |
|---|---|
| Three options only rename wide, medium, and close shots | Rewrite two options so they change knowledge timing, alignment, performance ownership, space, or sound. |
| Every option contains a complete shot list | Return to the proposition level and keep only viewpoint, information timing, strongest image, ending, and tradeoffs. |
| A candidate changes the scripted trigger or outcome | Restore the shared facts. If the story genuinely needs revision, return it to the script owner first. |
| Every option claims to be “more impactful” | Name the specific reaction, spatial information, suspense, or production burden gained and lost. |
| The selected version absorbs every attractive detail | Project only the chosen proposition and retain objections to the others so the strategies do not cancel one another. |
| Ordinary transitions receive several alternatives | Proceed directly to storyboarding and reserve comparison for scenes where viewpoint or information timing substantially changes the experience. |

Completion produces an explainable creator choice and a record of tradeoffs. Formal shot design, duration, continuity, and frozen keyframes remain responsibilities of the storyboard stage.

q.zh: 每个关键场景都要做三种拍法吗？
q.en: Does every key scene need three directing approaches?

a.zh: 只在观看位置、知情时机或表演所有权存在多个成立选择时比较两到三种命题。普通场景直接进入分镜；单一成立方案也不需要凑数。
a.en: Compare two or three propositions only when several valid choices of viewpoint, knowledge timing, or performance ownership exist. Ordinary scenes can go directly to storyboarding, and a scene with one viable proposition needs no filler alternatives.

q.zh: 方案选定后可以把其他方案的优点一起加入吗？
q.en: Can I combine the best parts of the rejected approaches?

a.zh: 先检查这些选择是否相容。提前揭示信息会取消延迟揭示，让两个人同时拥有表演中心也会削弱主次。相容的小项可以吸收，知情时机、对齐对象、空间和声音策略仍需形成一个统一命题。
a.en: Check whether those choices are compatible. Early disclosure cancels delayed disclosure, and simultaneous performance ownership can weaken the hierarchy. Compatible details may transfer, while knowledge timing, alignment, space, and sound still need to form one coherent proposition.

text.zh: 用 `$short-drama-storyboard` 在正式分镜前比较这个关键场景的两到三种导演命题。固定当前剧本事实、开场状态与结尾；逐案写观众知情时机、观看位置、表演所有权、最强画面、空间与声音策略、结尾和取舍。保留反对理由，等我选择后，只把选中命题投影进正式 `分镜.md`；不要预设宫格、镜头数量或景别比例。
text.en: Use `$short-drama-storyboard` to compare two or three directing propositions for this key scene before formal shots. Lock the current script facts, opening state, and ending. For each proposition, record audience knowledge timing, viewpoint, performance ownership, strongest image, spatial and sound strategy, ending, and tradeoffs. Retain objections. After I select one, project only that proposition into the formal `分镜.md`; do not impose a grid, shot count, or shot-size ratio.

label.zh: 关键场景导演命题比较与选择投影
label.en: Directing-proposition comparison and selected projection for key scenes

label.zh: 短剧正式分镜公开工作流

title.zh: AI视频单镜动作太多怎么办：保留故事动作，调整镜头边界
title.en: How to Fix Too Many Actions in One AI Video Shot

seo_title.zh: AI视频一个镜头动作太多怎么办
seo_title.en: How to Fix Too Many Actions in One AI Video Shot

description.zh: 生成前按镜头目的和已接受时长检查触发、关键动作、必要反应与落点，删除装饰和依赖；仍不可行就请求拆镜、延长或重排。
description.en: Before generation, protect the trigger, decisive action, reaction, and landing; remove decoration, then request a split, extension, or reblock if needed.

answer.zh: 在生成前修一个动作过载的 AI 视频镜头，先写明镜头目的、已接受时长、起点和终点，再找出不可删的“触发→决定性动作→必要反应→落点”。删除只让画面忙碌的手势、环境活动和额外物件操作，并把互为条件的动作恢复为可见顺序。若完整对白、必要动作和已接受结尾仍无法在边界内清楚完成，向分镜 owner 请求拆镜、延长或重排调度；不要静默删对白、改结尾或用固定动词数量判断容量。
answer.en: To repair an overloaded AI-video shot before generation, record its purpose, accepted duration, start, and end, then identify the indispensable trigger, decisive action, necessary reaction, and landing. Remove gestures, environmental activity, and prop business that only make the frame busy, and restore visible order between dependent actions. If the accepted dialogue, necessary action, and ending still cannot complete clearly within the boundary, ask the storyboard owner to split, extend, or reblock the shot. Do not silently cut dialogue, change the ending, or judge capacity by a fixed verb count.

heading.zh: 先做生成前动作负载清单
heading.en: Start with a pre-generation action-load checklist

body.zh:
- [ ] 写明镜头目的：观众在这段结束时必须看懂哪一次变化。
- [ ] 抄入已接受时长、完整对白和已接受结尾，不自行改写。
- [ ] 写全起点：演员、物件、双手、位置、距离、阻挡、已有声音与已知信息。
- [ ] 圈出不可删的触发、决定性动作、必要反应和落点。
- [ ] 标出装饰动作、额外环境活动、重复反应和没有故事后果的物件操作。
- [ ] 标出依赖关系：接近后才能触碰，触碰后才能施力，释放后另一只手才能接住。
- [ ] 检查对白、顺序动作、停顿和结尾反应是否共同适配当前边界。

动作负载由具体镜头的距离、接触复杂度、对白、表演和相机等待共同决定。四个动词可能是一条清楚的连续动作，两个动词也可能包含一次穿越房间和复杂交接。判断对象是故事变化能否在已接受时长内清楚发生。
body.en:
- [ ] State the shot purpose: what change must the audience understand by the end?
- [ ] Copy the accepted duration, complete dialogue, and accepted ending without rewriting them.
- [ ] Record the full start: actors, objects, hands, positions, distance, obstacles, existing sound, and current knowledge.
- [ ] Mark the indispensable trigger, decisive action, necessary reaction, and landing.
- [ ] Mark decorative gestures, extra environmental activity, repeated reactions, and prop business with no story consequence.
- [ ] Mark dependencies: approach before contact, contact before force, release before another hand receives an object.
- [ ] Check dialogue, sequential actions, pauses, and the ending reaction against the same boundary.

Action load depends on the specific shot's distance, contact complexity, dialogue, performance, and camera waits. Four verbs may describe one clear continuous action, while two may conceal a room crossing and a complex handoff. The practical question is whether the story change can occur clearly within the accepted duration.

heading.zh: 用两列表保住动作脊柱
heading.en: Protect the action spine with a two-column worksheet

body.zh:
这张表是本文设计的作者工作表，用于生成前审读；`short-drama-video-prompts` 的原生文档不要求使用这套结构。

| 审读项 | 当前镜头要写的内容 |
|---|---|
| 目的与边界 | 镜头职责、已接受时长、完整对白、起点和已接受结尾。 |
| 不可删触发 | 哪个已在剧本或分镜中的可见或可听事件启动变化。 |
| 决定性动作 | 哪个演员对哪个对象朝哪个方向行动，并造成故事状态变化。 |
| 必要反应 | 谁接收到变化；当前景别能读到的目光、停手、距离或声音变化。 |
| 落点 | 演员、物件、位置、系统状态和声音怎样停在可供下一镜接续的状态。 |
| 可删装饰 | 只增加忙碌感、重复信息或制造新依赖的手势、走动和物件操作。 |
| 顺序依赖 | 哪些动作必须先后发生；哪些动作可与对白或持续环境声自然重叠。 |
| 边界请求 | 精简后仍不可行时，请分镜 owner 拆镜、延长或重新调度的具体理由。 |

先删装饰，再合并自然连续且不丢因果节点的动作，并选择一个主要注意中心。完整对白和已接受结尾继续保留。
body.en:
This author-designed worksheet supports pre-generation review; native `short-drama-video-prompts` documents do not require this structure.

| Review field | What to record for the current shot |
|---|---|
| Purpose and boundary | Shot duty, accepted duration, complete dialogue, start, and accepted ending. |
| Indispensable trigger | The visible or audible event already established by the script or storyboard that starts the change. |
| Decisive action | Which actor acts on which object, in what direction, and how that action changes story state. |
| Necessary reaction | Who receives the change and which gaze, stopped action, distance, or vocal shift is readable at the current framing. |
| Landing | How actors, objects, positions, system state, and sound settle into a state the next shot can inherit. |
| Removable decoration | Gestures, travel, and prop business that add bustle, repeat information, or create new dependencies. |
| Sequential dependencies | Actions that must occur in order and actions that can naturally overlap dialogue or continuing ambience. |
| Boundary request | The specific reason to ask the storyboard owner for a split, extension, or reblock when simplification remains infeasible. |

Remove decoration first. Then combine naturally continuous actions without deleting causal nodes and choose one primary focus of attention. Preserve complete dialogue and the accepted ending.

heading.zh: 原创纸面案例：陶艺教室的窑炉警报
heading.en: Original paper example: a kiln alarm in a ceramics classroom

body.zh:
下面的“窑炉警报”是本文原创的纸面案例，没有提交生成，也没有测得模型时长或成片结果。项目为这个虚构镜头接受了 8 秒边界、台词“别开门，先断电”和明确结尾：苏苇扳下隔离开关后松手并把手停在身侧，纪岑留在工作台后，两人都不触碰窑门，警示灯熄灭且蜂鸣停止。这项时长只表示本例的作者边界；任何模型容量和成功结果仍需另行验证。

起点完整状态：学员苏苇站在窑炉右侧，右手距门闩一掌但尚未接触；墙上隔离开关就在他右肩外侧，当前朝上；窑门关闭，红色警示灯亮，蜂鸣器间歇响；老师纪岑站在房间左侧工作台后，双手没有持物；一只上釉陶碗留在工作台中央，隔热手套挂在窑炉左侧墙钩。苏苇以为警报表示可以开门检查，纪岑知道应先断电。

过载版本要求纪岑放下刷子、擦净碗沿、绕过工作台、取下手套、走到窑炉前、拉住苏苇、说完整台词、打开柜门取记录夹、指向温度表；同时苏苇触碰门闩、停手、后退、扳下开关、看老师，最后两人站在窑炉两侧；这项站位属于未获接受的装饰性结尾。这个版本新增了不存在于起点的刷子，安排了多次跨区移动，让取手套和记录夹形成额外依赖，并让制止、对白、断电和结尾反应争夺同一边界。

| 保留或删除 | 修订后的因果 |
|---|---|
| 触发：警示灯与蜂鸣器 | 保留。苏苇把右手继续移向门闩。 |
| 决定性动作：老师阻止开门 | 保留。纪岑留在工作台后说完整台词；无需跨房间拉住苏苇。 |
| 必要反应：学员接收指令 | 保留。苏苇在接触门闩前停手，右手转向肩侧的隔离开关。 |
| 状态变化：先断电 | 保留。苏苇扳下开关；指示灯熄灭，窑门始终关闭。 |
| 落点 | 保留。苏苇的手离开开关并停在身侧，纪岑隔着工作台看向他；两人都不触碰窑门，蜂鸣停止。 |
| 擦碗、取手套、拿记录夹、走到窑炉、指温度表 | 删除。它们不完成“阻止开门并先断电”的镜头目的，还会引入移动、持物与接触依赖。 |

修订后，每个位置和状态都有来源：苏苇从门闩旁转向同侧开关，纪岑保持在工作台后，陶碗和手套保持原位，窑门从头到尾关闭。警示灯和蜂鸣停止来自苏苇扳下已建立的隔离开关。这个纸面因果检查支持继续写提示词，实际生成能力仍待候选验证。
body.en:
The Kiln Alarm is an original paper example created for this article. It has not been submitted for generation and provides no measured model duration or rendered result. For this fictional shot, the project has accepted an eight-second boundary, the line “Don't open it. Cut the power first,” and an explicit ending: Su releases the lowered isolator and holds his hand at his side; Ji remains behind the worktable; neither touches the kiln door; the warning lamp is dark and the buzzer has stopped. Eight seconds is an authored boundary for this example; model capacity and generation success still require separate evidence.

Complete starting state: student Su Wei stands to the right of the kiln, his right hand one palm-width from the door latch without touching it. The wall isolator is just beyond his right shoulder and currently points up. The kiln door is closed, a red warning lamp is lit, and a buzzer sounds intermittently. Instructor Ji Cen stands behind the worktable on the left with empty hands. A glazed bowl remains at the center of the table, and heat-resistant gloves hang from a wall hook to the kiln's left. Su believes the alarm means he should open the door to inspect it; Ji knows the power must be isolated first.

The overloaded version asks Ji to put down a brush, wipe the bowl rim, circle the worktable, take the gloves, walk to the kiln, grab Su, deliver the complete line, open a cabinet for a logbook, and point at the temperature display. At the same time, Su touches the latch, stops, steps back, lowers the isolator, and looks at Ji before they finish on opposite sides of the kiln, an unaccepted decorative ending. This version invents a brush absent from the start, adds repeated cross-room travel, creates dependencies around the gloves and logbook, and makes the intervention, dialogue, power isolation, and ending reaction compete inside one boundary.

| Keep or remove | Revised causality |
|---|---|
| Trigger: warning lamp and buzzer | Keep. Su continues moving his right hand toward the latch. |
| Decisive action: the instructor stops the opening | Keep. Ji stays behind the table and delivers the complete line; she does not cross the room to grab Su. |
| Necessary reaction: the student receives the instruction | Keep. Su stops before touching the latch and redirects his right hand to the isolator beside his shoulder. |
| State change: isolate power first | Keep. Su lowers the switch; the warning lamp goes dark and the kiln door remains closed. |
| Landing | Keep. Su releases the switch and holds his hand at his side while Ji watches him from behind the table. Neither touches the kiln door, and the buzzer has stopped. |
| Wiping the bowl, taking gloves, fetching a logbook, crossing to the kiln, and pointing at the display | Remove. They do not accomplish the purpose of stopping the opening and isolating power, and they add travel, holding, and contact dependencies. |

Every revised position and state has a source. Su redirects from the nearby latch to the same-side isolator. Ji remains behind the worktable. The bowl and gloves stay where they began. The kiln door remains closed throughout. The warning lamp and buzzer stop because Su lowers the established isolator. This paper causality check supports continuing into prompt writing; it does not claim that any model has generated the shot successfully.

heading.zh: 精简后仍不可行，就请求上游改边界
heading.en: Request an upstream boundary change when simplification is insufficient

body.zh:
某些动作承担真实剧情职责，无法靠删装饰解决。例如已接受场景要求一个角色从房间另一端赶到控制台、完成带锁物件的开启与交接、说完不可删对白，并给对方留下可读反应；起点距离和接触顺序决定这些事件必须串行。此时，视频提示词阶段应写清证据、影响、必要修订和 owner。

| 修订请求字段 | 要写的内容 |
|---|---|
| Evidence | 已接受时长、完整对白、起点距离、阻挡、必要接触顺序和已接受结尾。 |
| Impact | 哪个关键动作、反应或落点无法在当前边界内清楚完成；不得只写“动作太多”。 |
| Required fix | 请求拆成两个有作者边界的镜头、延长当前镜头，或把人物和物件重排到可执行起点。 |
| Preserved facts | 明确保留的对白、触发、人物选择、物件归属和结尾状态。 |
| Owner | 视频提示词可删除装饰；分镜 owner 决定拆镜、延长或重排；剧本 owner 决定任何对白或剧情更改。 |

拆镜时选择一个可见状态闭合点，让第一镜的终点成为第二镜可信的起点。延长时仍保留动作与反应的因果顺序。重排时修改起点位置和物件关系，并同步回分镜；提示词阶段不暗中移动人物。
body.en:
Some actions carry genuine story duties and cannot be solved by deleting decoration. An accepted scene may require a person to cross from the far side of a room, unlock and hand over an object, deliver protected dialogue, and leave the receiver a readable reaction. Starting distance and contact order make those events sequential. The video-prompt stage should then state evidence, impact, required revision, and ownership.

| Revision-request field | What to record |
|---|---|
| Evidence | Accepted duration, complete dialogue, starting distance, obstacles, necessary contact order, and accepted ending. |
| Impact | Name the key action, reaction, or landing that cannot complete clearly inside the current boundary; “too many actions” is insufficient. |
| Required fix | Ask for two authored shots, a longer current shot, or reblocked people and objects at an executable start. |
| Preserved facts | Name the dialogue, trigger, character choice, object ownership, and ending state that remain fixed. |
| Owner | Video prompts may remove decoration; the storyboard owner decides a split, extension, or reblock; the script owner decides any dialogue or story change. |

For a split, choose a visible state closure so the first shot's ending becomes a credible start for the second. For an extension, preserve the causal order of action and reaction. For a reblock, update the starting positions and object relationships in the storyboard; the prompt stage does not move people silently.

heading.zh: 按过载来源选择最小修法
heading.en: Choose the smallest repair for the source of overload

body.zh:
| 过载来源 | 最小修法 |
|---|---|
| 多个角色各自完成大动作，镜头目的只有一次变化 | 指定一个主要注意中心，其他人只保留理解变化所需的反应。 |
| 装饰性手势和环境活动不断加入 | 删除没有故事后果的活动，让触发、决定性动作和落点清楚。 |
| 两只手或同一身体被安排互斥任务 | 写明释放、换手、接触和施力顺序；仍冲突就改调度边界。 |
| 角色要跨越距离并完成多次物件操作 | 根据起点、障碍和接触链判断；请求重排、延长或拆镜。 |
| 对白、动作和末尾反应都必须串行 | 保留完整对白和结尾，删除装饰；容量仍不足就请求新边界。 |
| 结尾只写“最终到达” | 补出谁完成最后动作、物件落在哪里、谁反应，以及声音和身体怎样停住。 |
| 通过加入“同时”压缩前后依赖 | 只让可自然叠加的说话、缓慢目光或持续环境声并行；因果动作恢复先后。 |

这项方法用于生成前的内容与边界审读。已经生成的视频若出现动作变形、漏做或重复，需要根据实际成片证据进入相应的重写、重抽、剪辑或补拍判断。
body.en:
| Source of overload | Smallest repair |
|---|---|
| Several characters perform large independent actions while the shot carries one change | Choose one primary focus and retain only reactions needed to understand the change. |
| Decorative gestures and environmental activity keep accumulating | Remove activity with no story consequence so the trigger, decisive action, and landing remain clear. |
| The same hands or body receive incompatible tasks | State the release, hand change, contact, and force order; revise the blocking boundary if the conflict remains. |
| A person must cross distance and perform several object operations | Judge from the start, obstacles, and contact chain; request a reblock, extension, or split. |
| Dialogue, action, and ending reaction must all occur sequentially | Preserve complete dialogue and the ending, remove decoration, and request a new boundary if capacity remains insufficient. |
| The ending merely says “finally arrives” | State who completes the last action, where the object lands, who reacts, and how sound and bodies settle. |
| “At the same time” compresses dependent events | Overlap only naturally compatible speech, slow gaze, or continuing ambience; restore causal order elsewhere. |

This method reviews content and boundaries before generation. When a generated video already contains deformation, omissions, or repetition, route the observed result through the appropriate rewrite, reroll, edit, or reshoot decision.

q.zh: 一个 AI 视频镜头最多能写几个动作？
q.en: How many actions can one AI-video shot contain?

a.zh: 没有通用动词上限。距离、接触顺序、对白、停顿、表演强度、相机等待和结尾反应共同决定负载。用当前镜头的起点、目的、已接受时长和结尾做审读。
a.en: There is no universal verb limit. Distance, contact order, dialogue, pauses, performance intensity, camera waits, and the ending reaction jointly determine load. Review the current shot from its start, purpose, accepted duration, and ending.

q.zh: 动作太多时，可以先删对白吗？
q.en: Can I cut dialogue first when the shot is overloaded?

a.zh: 视频提示词阶段保留已接受的完整对白。先删无故事功能的动作并调整注意中心；仍不可行时，请分镜 owner 拆镜、延长或重排。对白确需改写时交回剧本 owner。
a.en: The video-prompt stage preserves accepted dialogue in full. Remove actions with no story function and simplify attention first. If the boundary remains infeasible, ask the storyboard owner to split, extend, or reblock it. Return any dialogue rewrite to the script owner.

text.zh: 用 `$short-drama-video-prompts` 在生成前检查这个镜头的动作负载。读取镜头目的、已接受时长、完整对白、起点和结尾；列出不可删的触发、决定性动作、必要反应与落点，删除装饰动作和多余依赖，并保留明确的接触顺序。若仍无法清楚完成，请给分镜 owner 写拆镜、延长或重排请求，保留已接受对白与结尾。不要使用固定动词数或通用时间容量。
text.en: Use `$short-drama-video-prompts` to review this shot's action load before generation. Read its purpose, accepted duration, complete dialogue, start, and ending. Identify the indispensable trigger, decisive action, necessary reaction, and landing; remove decorative action and unnecessary dependencies; and preserve explicit contact order. If the shot still cannot complete clearly, write a split, extension, or reblock request to the storyboard owner while preserving accepted dialogue and the ending. Do not use a fixed verb count or universal timing capacity.

label.zh: 动作负载、可演动作链与超载修订
label.en: Action load, performable action chains, and overload revision

label.zh: 短剧视频提示词公开工作流

title.zh: 小说危险可预见，过程怎么越写越紧
title.en: How to Build Tension from a Foreseeable Consequence

seo_title.zh: 小说危险可预见，过程怎么越写越紧
seo_title.en: How to Build Tension from a Foreseeable Consequence

description.zh: 先让读者看懂坏结果会怎样发生，再让每次避险失败改变可选办法。附斜坡档案车原创场景、前后对照与因果审读表。
description.en: Show how harm could happen, then let each failed prevention attempt remove an option. Includes an original archive-trolley scene and causal audit.

answer.zh: 先写出一个读者能沿物理或人际因果预见的坏结果，再让人物采取合理的避险动作。每次动作都要产生可见结果：拦住一部分问题、暴露原先没处理的原因，或让一种办法失效。下一步必须由这个结果逼出来。这样，读者等待的重点是人物还能怎样改变后果，紧张感来自选择持续收窄，不靠反复写“危险”“紧张”，也不需要期限或隐藏答案。
answer.en: First establish a bad consequence readers can forecast through physical or human causality. Then give the character a reasonable prevention attempt. Each attempt must create a visible result: contain part of the problem, expose an untreated cause, or remove one tactic. That result forces the next move. Readers keep watching to see how much of the consequence can still change as the character's options narrow, without repeated danger adjectives, a deadline, or a concealed answer.

heading.zh: 先确认读者能预见什么坏结果
heading.en: Define the bad consequence readers can forecast

body.zh:
这类紧张感先给读者一条可追踪的因果路：什么已经开始变化，会经过哪里，碰到谁或什么，人物目前能做什么。读者可以比人物早看见风险，也可以与人物同时看见；关键是坏结果已经具备具体路径。

- [ ] 观察到的变化可以直接写出，例如车轮移动、支点松开、关系中的承诺被公开撤回。
- [ ] 坏结果写到对象和作用，例如推车会撞到下坡端的人，而非只写“会出事”。
- [ ] 人物拥有有限且合理的初始办法，例如制动、扶正、示警或改变路线。
- [ ] 每次尝试的结果能改变下一步，成功一部分也要保留其代价。

引用的 Oh Story 简要笔记把一组“发现、观测、打捞、失败、坠落”的连续过程称为倒计时结构，并强调读者已经知道危险方向会形成期待。本文只迁移其中的因果洞见：已知坏方向与包含失败的连续过程，会让读者追踪后果怎样逼近。本文进一步设计了多次避险尝试的改稿方法。下面的审读法、字段和档案车案例均为本文作者设计；`story-long-analyze` 没有要求这张表，也不会自动替作者完成修改。
body.en:
This kind of tension begins with a traceable causal route: what has started changing, where it can travel, whom or what it can affect, and what the character can currently do. Readers may see the risk before the character or at the same moment. In either case, the bad outcome has a concrete path.

- [ ] State an observable change, such as a moving wheel, a loosened support, or a publicly withdrawn commitment.
- [ ] Name the affected person or object and the action upon it; replace “something bad will happen” with a specific consequence.
- [ ] Give the character a limited, reasonable first tactic, such as braking, supporting, warning, or redirecting.
- [ ] Make every attempt alter the next move, including partial success and its cost.

The cited Oh Story note calls a discover-observe-retrieve-fail-fall sequence a countdown structure and says that an already understood direction of danger creates expectation. This article carries forward only the causal insight: a known bad direction plus an unfolding process containing failure makes readers track how the consequence approaches. Repeated prevention attempts are this article’s further revision design. The audit, fields, and trolley scene below are author-designed. `story-long-analyze` does not require this worksheet or automatically revise the passage.

heading.zh: 逐次检查观察、预判、选择、后果与承接
heading.en: Audit observation, forecast, choice, consequence, and handoff

body.zh:
每轮只检查一段因果。先圈出原文已经写出的可见事实，再记录读者据此能预见的结果。人物的选择要符合当时位置、持物、知识和身体条件；选择执行后，写清它实际改变了什么。最后一句承接新的受限局面。

| 审读项 | 写进原文或边注的内容 |
|---|---|
| 观察到的事 | 可见动作、位置变化、失灵部件或人际动作，避免情绪形容词代替事实。 |
| 读者预判 | 沿已写因果最可能发生的坏结果，写明受影响的人或物。 |
| 人物可选办法 | 当下确实做得到的两三种动作，以及人物为何先选其中一个。 |
| 本次实际后果 | 尝试成功了哪部分、失败在哪里、消耗了什么位置或工具。 |
| 下一步承接 | 因为本次结果，哪种办法消失，剩下哪种动作必须立刻接上。 |

这五项是本文的手工审读顺序。它们可以在一个场景里重复多轮，也可以只用于两次关键失败。skill 的原生字段、阶段流程和落盘产物仍按公开工作流执行，与这张作者审读表分开。
body.en:
Audit one causal passage at a time. Circle the visible fact already present, then record the consequence readers can forecast from it. A character's choice must fit current position, held objects, knowledge, and physical ability. After the attempt, state exactly what changed. The final sentence hands the scene into its newly constrained situation.

| Audit item | What to place in the passage or margin |
|---|---|
| Observed event | A visible action, positional change, failed control, or human act instead of danger adjectives. |
| Reader forecast | The most likely bad result along the established causal route, including the affected person or object. |
| Character option | Two or three actions genuinely available now and the reason one is attempted first. |
| Actual consequence | What the attempt contained, where it failed, and which position or tool it consumed. |
| Forced next link | The tactic that disappeared and the remaining action that must follow from this result. |

These five items form an author-designed manual reading order. They may repeat several times within a scene or cover only two decisive failures. They are not native skill fields, a mandatory five-stage process, or a required pipeline artifact.

heading.zh: 修改前：危险形容词反复出现，因果没有前进
heading.en: Before: danger adjectives repeat while causality stalls

body.zh:
下面是本文为改稿演示写的原创反例：

> 斜坡上的档案车危险地晃了一下。廖芩十分紧张，觉得事情很危险。车子越来越快，段禾还在下面，情况更加危急。她拼命去拦，危险却没有消失，她只能更紧张地想办法。

这段宣布了危险程度，却没有给出车头朝向、段禾的位置、制动件、侧栏或人物为什么没拦住。读者无法形成稳定预判，也看不出第一次动作怎样迫使第二次动作。修改时保留“车在斜坡上、段禾在下方、廖芩试图阻止”三个事实，删除其余危险形容词，补齐空间、控制件与每次动作的结果。
body.en:
The following original counterexample was written for this revision demonstration:

> The archive trolley swayed dangerously on the slope. Liao Qin grew very tense and felt that the situation was dangerous. The trolley moved faster while Duan He remained below, making everything even more critical. She desperately tried to stop it, but the danger remained, so she had to think even more anxiously.

The paragraph announces intensity without establishing the cart's orientation, Duan's position, the brake, the side rail, or why the first intervention fails. Readers cannot form a stable forecast or see how one action forces the next. Keep only three facts: the cart is on a slope, Duan is below it, and Liao tries to intervene. Then replace the danger adjectives with geography, controls, and consequences.

heading.zh: 修改后：原创场景“斜坡档案车”
heading.en: After: original scene, The Sloped Archive Trolley

body.zh:
以下“斜坡档案车”是本文原创虚构教学场景，没有改编现实作品，也没有经过读者实验。档案库的窄通道从西侧整理台向东侧防火门缓缓下斜。北墙有连续扶手和一块齐膝高的橡胶防撞垫；南墙的底图柜拉开了一只抽屉，占去半条通道。装着平放海报盒的四轮档案车停在整理台下方，车头朝东，前轮可以自由转向，左后轮有一块灰色制动踏板。左侧护栏的插销只进了一半。段禾蹲在下坡端整理抽屉，背对档案车；廖芩站在车尾上坡侧。

> 左侧护栏响了一声，半截插销从孔里退出来。最上层海报盒朝缺口滑了两指宽，档案车的左后轮也开始顺坡转动。
>
> “段禾，合抽屉，贴南墙！”廖芩边喊边用左手把海报盒推回去，右手去压护栏。车架受力后轻微扭斜，插销顶在孔沿，没能落进去。她的左手被盒子占住，车却已经离开整理台一臂远。
>
> 她放开护栏，脚踩左后轮的灰色踏板。踏板到底又弹了回来，轮子没有锁住。车尾擦过她的小腿，她松开海报盒，退到北墙扶手旁；车速让她失去了站到车头正面硬挡的选择。
>
> 段禾听见第一声示警便转过身。廖芩踩下制动踏板时，他正用肩抵住抽屉；车进入窄段时，他已把底图抽屉送回柜内，身体侧进防火门南侧的凹位。通道重新让出一条完整车宽，廖芩也不再需要同时拦车和把人从车前拉开。
>
> 她抓住车尾横杆，没有向后硬拽，而是沿北墙跑了两步，把车尾往南带。自由转向的前轮随之偏向北墙，车头斜着撞上橡胶垫。左侧护栏被扶手刮开，最上层海报盒却沿转过的车身滑向仍闭合的右栏，盒角撞出一道折痕；档案车横停下来，没有进入段禾刚才蹲着的位置。
>
> 廖芩仍扶着横杆。盒角的折痕压得很深，里面的海报是否受损，要等车身固定后再开盒检查。

第一轮同时示警和扶盒，保住海报盒，却没有锁上侧栏，还让车离开整理台；第二轮确认制动失灵，人物失去正面拦车的安全位置。示警让段禾关闭抽屉并退出路径，通道变宽，廖芩才获得“引导车头撞向防撞垫”这一条可执行办法。场景解决了撞人的即时后果，同时保留盒内是否受损的后续问题；紧张落点来自因果变化，无需给所有损失下最终结论。
body.en:
The Sloped Archive Trolley is an original fictional teaching scene created for this article. It is not adapted from a published work and has no reader-test result. A narrow archive aisle slopes gently east from a sorting table toward a fire door. The north wall carries a continuous handrail and a knee-high rubber bumper. One map-cabinet drawer stands open from the south wall, taking half the passage. A four-wheel trolley loaded with flat poster boxes sits below the sorting table, facing east, with freely swiveling front casters and a gray brake pedal on the left rear wheel. The left retaining rail's pin is only halfway seated. Duan He crouches downhill at the drawer with his back to the trolley; Liao Qin stands uphill behind its rear bar.

> The left retaining rail clicked. Its half-seated pin backed out of the socket. The top poster box slid two finger-widths toward the opening, and the trolley's left rear wheel began turning downhill.
>
> “Duan, close the drawer. South wall!” Liao shouted while pushing the box back with her left hand and pressing the rail with her right. The loaded frame twisted slightly, leaving the pin against the rim instead of inside the socket. Her left hand remained occupied by the box while the trolley moved an arm's length away from the sorting table.
>
> She released the rail and stamped the gray pedal on the left rear wheel. It bottomed out and sprang back. The wheel did not lock. The rear bar brushed her shin. She released the box and stepped beside the north handrail; its speed removed the option of stepping in front and stopping it head-on.
>
> Duan turned at the first warning. As Liao pressed the brake pedal, his shoulder was already against the drawer. By the time the trolley entered the narrow section, he had driven the map drawer shut and slipped into the recess south of the fire door. A full cart-width opened again. Liao no longer had to stop the trolley while also pulling him out of its path.
>
> She gripped the rear bar. Instead of hauling backward, she ran two steps along the north wall and drew the rear south. The free front casters turned toward the north wall, sending the trolley's front corner into the rubber bumper. The handrail caught the left retaining rail and pulled it open. As the trolley turned, the top poster box slid toward the still-closed right rail and struck it hard enough to crease one corner. The trolley stopped crosswise without entering the place where Duan had been crouching.
>
> Liao kept hold of the bar. The crease cut deeply across the box corner. Whether the poster inside was damaged would have to wait until the trolley was secured and the box opened.

The first response warns Duan and retains the poster box but fails to secure the side rail and lets the trolley leave the table. The second confirms brake failure and removes a safe head-on stop. Liao's warning lets Duan close the drawer and leave the path, widening the aisle and creating one executable tactic: guide the front into the bumper. The scene resolves the immediate collision risk while preserving the question of damage inside the box. Tension lands through changed causality without requiring final certainty about every loss.

heading.zh: 把审读项连回具体原文
heading.en: Link every audit row to exact authored text

body.zh:
| 原文锚点 | 因果审读与修改动作 |
|---|---|
| “最上层海报盒朝缺口滑了两指宽” | 读者可预见盒子会从未锁侧栏滑出。若前文没有护栏缺口，补“插销只进了一半”；若盒子不会移动，删除这句预判来源。 |
| “插销顶在孔沿，没能落进去” | 第一次尝试失败有物理原因。保留车架扭斜；删去只写“怎么也扣不上”的空泛阻力。 |
| “踏板到底又弹了回来” | 制动失效可见，并直接删除正面拦车这一选择。若踏板此前从未出现，在场景开头补它的位置。 |
| “他已把底图抽屉送回柜内” | 示警产生实际变化：人退出路径，通道恢复车宽。若他只喊叫不移动，后续转向空间就缺少来源。 |
| “把车尾往南带……前轮随之偏向北墙” | 恢复动作利用已建立的自由转向轮和北墙防撞垫。若缺任一条件，补前置事实或改用已有设施。 |
| “盒角撞出一道折痕” | 即时人身危险结束，物件损失仍待检查。保留已看见的折痕，删除未经开盒便宣布海报完好的结论。 |

每行都能回答“这句话允许读者预见什么”或“这句话取消了哪个办法”。无法回答且只重复紧张程度的句子，优先删除。提供必要空间、接触、控制或选择结果的句子保留；缺少前置条件时，在第一次使用前补一笔。
body.en:
| Exact text anchor | Causal audit and revision action |
|---|---|
| “The top poster box slid two finger-widths toward the opening” | Readers can forecast a box leaving the unsecured side. Add the half-seated pin earlier if the opening lacks a cause; delete this forecast source if the box cannot move. |
| “the pin against the rim instead of inside the socket” | The first failure has a physical cause. Keep the frame twist; remove a vague statement that the latch simply refuses to work. |
| “It bottomed out and sprang back” | Brake failure is visible and removes the head-on-stop option. Establish the pedal's location earlier if it has not appeared. |
| “he had driven the map drawer shut” | The warning changes the scene: the person leaves the route and a full width returns. If Duan only shouts, the later turning space has no cause. |
| “drew the rear south…front casters turned toward the north wall” | The recovery uses established free casters and the north-wall bumper. Add either condition before use or replace the tactic with an existing facility. |
| “The crease cut deeply across the box corner” | Immediate bodily risk ends while object damage remains unconfirmed. Keep the visible crease; delete any claim that the unopened poster is unharmed. |

Every line should answer either “What can readers forecast from this?” or “Which tactic does this remove?” Delete sentences that answer neither question and only repeat intensity. Keep the lines that establish space, contact, controls, or changed choices. Add missing conditions before their first use.

heading.zh: 用最小修订清掉假紧张
heading.en: Use the smallest revision to remove false tension

body.zh:
| 发现的问题 | 直接修订 |
|---|---|
| 只写危险升级，坏结果没有对象 | 补一条可追踪路线：什么在动、将碰到谁或什么、接触后会怎样。 |
| 人物反复扑上去，每次结果相同 | 合并重复动作；让保留的失败取消一个办法或改变人物位置。 |
| 救场工具在最后一句才出现 | 提前把工具放进地理或人物注意范围；无法前置就删除该工具，改用已建立条件。 |
| 人物忽略显而易见的安全动作 | 写明该动作为什么做不到，或让人物先尝试它并承受可见结果。 |
| 每次失败都额外添加新事故 | 先利用同一因果链中的位置、接触和控制失效；删除只为加码却不改变选择的事故。 |
| 恢复动作突然保证毫发无损 | 把结论限制在已发生的结果；未检查的损坏留待后续行动确认。 |

完成审读后，从最后一次失败倒查到最初观察：恢复动作使用的条件是否提前存在；每次失败是否改变选项；人物是否知道自己正在依据什么行动。再顺读一遍，删除不承担因果、选择或体验功能的危险形容词。
body.en:
| Problem found | Direct revision |
|---|---|
| Danger increases without an affected object | Add one traceable route: what moves, whom or what it will meet, and what contact will do. |
| The character lunges repeatedly with the same result | Merge repeated actions; let each retained failure remove a tactic or change position. |
| A rescue tool appears in the final sentence | Establish it within the geography or attention earlier. If it cannot be planted, remove it and use an existing condition. |
| The character ignores an obvious safety action | State why it is unavailable, or let the character try it first and receive a visible result. |
| Every failure adds a separate accident | Use position, contact, and control failure within the same causal chain; delete incidents that add intensity without changing choice. |
| Recovery suddenly guarantees no damage | Limit the conclusion to observed results and leave uninspected damage for a later action. |

After the audit, work backward from the final intervention to the first observation. Confirm that every recovery condition existed earlier, every failure changed the option set, and every action follows from what the character knows. Then read forward once and delete danger adjectives that carry no causal, choice, or experiential function.

q.zh: 读者提前知道危险结果，会不会没有悬念？
q.en: Does a foreseeable consequence remove suspense?

a.zh: 读者已经知道坏方向，仍会追踪人物能否改变碰撞对象、损失程度或自身位置。每次尝试都改变剩余办法时，过程本身持续提供新结果。
a.en: Readers can understand the bad direction and still track whether the character changes the target, degree of loss, or personal position. Each attempt supplies a new result when it alters the remaining tactics.

q.zh: 结尾必须明确证明所有人和物都安全吗？
q.en: Must the ending prove that every person and object is safe?

a.zh: 场景先结算当前因果。可以明确人物已经退出碰撞路线，同时把尚未开盒检查的物件损伤留到下一步。已观察结果与待确认结果要分开写。
a.en: Settle the current causal chain first. A person can be clearly out of the collision path while damage inside an unopened box remains for the next action. Separate observed results from pending confirmation.

text.zh: 用 `$story-long-analyze` 分析我提供的小说正文，用章节或定位词支持观察：分清客观事件顺序、文本披露顺序、读者所知和人物所知，指出读者从哪里开始预见坏结果，以及每次避险动作怎样改变后续选项。证据不足的判断标为待核实。我会依据这些观察，再用本文的手工因果表修改场景。
text.en: Use `$story-long-analyze` to examine the novel text I provide. Support observations with chapter or text locators: separate event order, disclosure order, reader knowledge, and character knowledge. Identify where readers can first forecast the bad consequence and how each prevention attempt changes later options. Mark unsupported judgments for verification. I will use these observations to revise the scene with this article’s manual causal audit.

title.zh: 手机 HDR 视频导出后颜色发灰怎么办
title.en: How to Prepare HDR Video for SDR Editing

seo_title.zh: 手机HDR视频发灰：转SDR前怎么处理
seo_title.en: Prepare HDR Video for SDR Editing

description.zh: 先分清HDR像素、错误色彩标签和未知素材，再做外部色调映射或仅修标签。附探测命令、夜市短片案例与SDR交接表。
description.en: Separate HDR pixels, wrong color tags, and unknown footage before conversion. Includes probe commands, a night-market case, and an SDR handoff record.

answer.zh: 先保留手机原片，用来源记录与 ffprobe 读到的色彩声明建立证据，不凭画面发灰猜 HDR 类型。已确认像素是 HDR 时，在具备色彩管理的外部工具中按已确认的输入传递特性线性化、做 HDR 到 SDR 色调映射，再编码为明确的 BT.709 SDR 新候选。已独立确认像素本来就是正确 SDR、只有标签错误时，才只修正属性声明。来源与声明缺失或互相冲突时标为未知，先补证据，不猜标签也不做转换。最后在 SDR 播放链路实际观看中间调、高光、肤色、黑白电平和连续镜头，通过后再交给普通 Video Recap 编辑。
answer.en: Retain the phone original and build evidence from provenance plus the color declarations reported by ffprobe; a washed-out appearance alone does not identify the HDR type. For confirmed HDR pixels, use an external color-managed tool to linearize from the confirmed input transfer, tone-map HDR to SDR, and encode a new candidate with explicit BT.709 SDR properties. If independent evidence proves the pixels are already correct SDR and only the tags are wrong, correct properties only. If provenance and declarations are missing or contradictory, mark the source unknown and gather evidence rather than guessing tags or converting. Finally, view the candidate through an SDR playback path and check midtones, highlights, skin, black/white levels, and shot continuity before handing it to ordinary Video Recap editing.

heading.zh: 保留原片，先把素材分到三条路
heading.en: Preserve the original and choose one of three paths

body.zh:
把手机原片设为只读来源，所有检查与转换写到新的候选路径。先记录拍摄设备与模式、原始传输方式、是否经过聊天软件或剪辑器、可用的相机或导出设置截图，以及一份可信参考播放。ffprobe 汇报的是文件和码流中的声明；这些字段能暴露缺失或矛盾，却不能单独证明像素实际采用哪种传递特性。画面看起来灰、暗或过曝也不能独立定性。

| 证据结论 | 本轮动作 |
|---|---|
| 来源记录与声明共同确认是 HDR 像素 | 走外部 HDR→SDR 色调映射，原片不动，新建 SDR 候选。 |
| 独立来源或可靠参考确认像素已经是正确 SDR，只有声明错误 | 仅纠正属性声明，随后重新探测并实际播放；不再对像素做色调映射。 |
| 来源缺失，或来源、声明、参考互相冲突 | 标为未知；停止猜测传递特性、色域和范围，先找回原始文件或可信记录。 |

第二条路要求独立证据，例如产生该文件的受控 SDR 导出记录，或与可信 SDR 参考逐项核对的来源链。单凭“改标签后看起来顺眼”不够。第三条路保护原片，防止二次误处理。

若第二条路已经由受控 SDR 导出记录证明像素为 BT.709、有限范围，只是属性错误，可为**新的重编码候选**使用这一滤镜参数：

> setparams=color_primaries=bt709:color_trc=bt709:colorspace=bt709:range=limited

它只标记属性，不做像素变换；但只要作为 -vf 运行，画面就会经历解码、过滤与重新编码，必须另选视频编码器，可能产生有损代际变化，不能声称是流复制或无损容器头修复。保留原片，记录编码设置，再探测并实际观看候选。
body.en:
Treat the phone original as a read-only source and write every inspection or conversion to a new candidate path. Record the capture device and mode, original transfer route, any messaging or editing step, available camera/export setting captures, and a trustworthy reference playback. ffprobe reports declarations carried by the file and bitstream. Those fields can expose absence or contradiction, but they do not by themselves prove the transfer actually used by the pixels. A gray, dark, or blown-out appearance also cannot establish the source type.

| Evidence conclusion | Action for this pass |
|---|---|
| Provenance and declarations jointly confirm HDR pixels | Perform external HDR-to-SDR tone mapping, retain the original, and create a new SDR candidate. |
| Independent provenance or a reliable reference proves correct SDR pixels with wrong declarations only | Correct properties only, then probe and play the result; do not tone-map the pixels. |
| Provenance is absent, or provenance, declarations, and reference conflict | Mark unknown; stop guessing transfer, gamut, or range and recover the original or a trustworthy record. |

The second path requires independent evidence, such as a controlled SDR export record for that file or a traceable comparison with a trusted SDR reference. “It looks better after retagging” is insufficient. The third path protects the original from another unsupported transformation.

If controlled SDR export records prove the second branch contains BT.709 limited-range pixels with wrong properties only, this filter-only value may be used for a **new re-encoded candidate**:

> setparams=color_primaries=bt709:color_trc=bt709:colorspace=bt709:range=limited

It marks properties without transforming pixels. However, when used through -vf, the picture is decoded, filtered, and re-encoded with a separately selected video encoder. That may introduce a lossy generation and must not be described as stream copy or lossless container-header repair. Retain the original, record encoder settings, then probe and actually view the candidate.

heading.zh: 用探测命令记录声明与工具可用性
heading.en: Record declarations and tool availability

body.zh:
先把输入文件路径写进记录，再运行只读探测：

> ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=codec_name,pix_fmt,color_range,color_space,color_transfer,color_primaries -of json INPUT.mov

把原始 JSON 保存为“探测观察”，不要改写成“像素真相”。再记录当前构建和滤镜：

> ffmpeg -hide_banner -version  
> ffmpeg -hide_banner -filters | grep -E '(^|[[:space:]])(zscale|tonemap|setparams)[[:space:]]'

FFmpeg 文档中，zscale 依赖构建时启用 libzimg；tonemap 期望浮点、线性光输入；setparams 只标记帧的色彩属性，不转换像素。转换顺序因此是：用已确认的输入传递与色彩信息完成线性化，在浮点线性光域做色调映射，再转换到明确的 BT.709 SDR 输出并编码。每个输入参数都来自当前素材的已确认记录，不能把手机品牌或“HDR”字样自动替换成某套色域、传递曲线或范围。

本文不提供把未知输入硬塞进固定参数的通用命令。本地写作环境的 FFmpeg 9.0.1 没有 zscale / libzimg，所以本文没有执行 HDR 转换，也没有验证任何转换输出。实际执行前先检查滤镜；缺少所需能力时，改用明确支持该输入与 SDR 输出的色彩管理工具，或团队批准的构建。
body.en:
Write the input path into the record, then run a read-only probe:

> ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=codec_name,pix_fmt,color_range,color_space,color_transfer,color_primaries -of json INPUT.mov

Preserve the raw JSON as a probe observation; do not rewrite it as pixel truth. Record the build and filters:

> ffmpeg -hide_banner -version  
> ffmpeg -hide_banner -filters | grep -E '(^|[[:space:]])(zscale|tonemap|setparams)[[:space:]]'

In the FFmpeg documentation, zscale depends on a build enabled with libzimg, tonemap expects floating-point linear-light input, and setparams marks frame color properties without changing pixels. The processing order is therefore: linearize with the confirmed input transfer and color information, tone-map in floating-point linear light, then convert to an explicit BT.709 SDR output and encode. Every input property must come from confirmed evidence for the current source; a phone brand or an “HDR” label does not supply a transfer curve, gamut, or range.

This article avoids a universal command that forces unknown material through fixed parameters. The local writing environment used FFmpeg 9.0.1 without zscale / libzimg, so no HDR conversion or converted output was tested here. Check filter availability before execution. If required capabilities are absent, use a color-managed application that explicitly supports the confirmed input and SDR destination, or an approved build.

heading.zh: 已确认 HDR 时，照这份参数映射做候选
heading.en: For confirmed HDR, map evidence to this exact filter plan

body.zh:
下面是一份**仅供文档说明、依赖具体构建、未执行**的假设方案。它只适用于独立记录已经确认以下全部事实的素材：BT.2020 原色、BT.2020 非恒定亮度矩阵、PQ 传递、有限范围，实际信号峰值为 1000 cd/m²。本例为 zscale 选择 npl=100 这一标称峰值亮度参数。另一个独立的源码事实是：固定版 FFmpeg 的信号峰值辅助实现定义 REFERENCE_WHITE=100，并用 MaxCLL 或母版显示最大亮度除以该常量来确定归一化信号峰值。参数 npl 与归一化常量分别记录；本例采用相同数值，再据 1000/100 得到 peak=10。选择这套候选前提仍是本文的限定设计，不是从手机型号自动得出的通用输入。

| 已确认事实或作者选择 | 对应滤镜项与含义 |
|---|---|
| BT.2020 原色 | setparams 的 color_primaries=bt2020 标记已知输入；zscale 的 primariesin=2020 显式读取该输入。 |
| BT.2020-NCL 矩阵 | colorspace=bt2020nc 与 matrixin=2020_ncl 对应同一已确认矩阵。 |
| PQ 传递 | setparams 用 color_trc=smpte2084 标记已知 PQ。后续 zscale 没有猜写 transferin；按文档默认从输入属性取得传递特性，再以 transfer=linear 线性化。 |
| 有限范围 | range=limited 与 rangein=limited 来自独立来源记录，不由画面外观推测。 |
| 实际信号峰值 1000 cd/m²；本例 npl=100；实现常量 REFERENCE_WHITE=100 | npl=100 是本例选择的 zscale 标称峰值亮度参数；REFERENCE_WHITE=100 是该固定实现的独立归一化常量；tonemap 的 peak=10 来自本例 1000/100，单位为归一化信号比例。它们分别说明处理设置、实现常量与信号峰值。 |
| 作者选择 Mobius 做首个视觉候选 | tonemap=mobius 是待实际观看比较的创作选择，不是元数据推导结果，也不宣称是通用默认。 |
| 输出目标为 BT.709、有限范围、yuv420p | 最后一次 zscale 转到 709 原色/传递/矩阵与有限范围，format 转成 yuv420p，末尾 setparams 明确标记输出属性。 |

下面整行是传给 -vf 的**滤镜参数本身**，不是完整 ffmpeg 命令：

> setparams=color_primaries=bt2020:color_trc=smpte2084:colorspace=bt2020nc:range=limited,zscale=primariesin=2020:matrixin=2020_ncl:rangein=limited:transfer=linear:npl=100,format=pix_fmts=gbrpf32le,tonemap=tonemap=mobius:peak=10,zscale=primaries=709:transfer=709:matrix=709:range=limited,format=pix_fmts=yuv420p,setparams=color_primaries=bt709:color_trc=bt709:colorspace=bt709:range=limited

实际命令还必须在别处选择真正的视频编码器与新候选路径；使用 -vf 会解码、过滤并重新编码，不能搭配 -c:v copy。本文不拼装音频、容器或完整编码命令，因为这些取决于真实交接。先在目标机器确认 zscale 可用，再把以上整行作为 -vf 的一个参数用于新候选。输出后保存 ffprobe 观察，并在 SDR 播放链路逐项观看。此处没有运行结果；本地 FFmpeg 9.0.1 缺少 zscale/libzimg。输入色彩事实缺失或互相冲突时，回到素材类型“未知”分支。若色彩事实已确认是 HDR、只有实际峰值或其他转换参数待核实，则保留“已确认 HDR”状态，另记“数值转换方案待定”；先取得可信的峰值证据或明确审核的调色决策，再制定当前素材的方案，暂不照抄这张滤镜图。
body.en:
The following is a **docs-only, build-dependent, unexecuted** hypothetical plan. It applies only when independent records have confirmed every input fact: BT.2020 primaries, BT.2020 non-constant-luminance matrix, PQ transfer, limited range, and an actual signal peak of 1000 cd/m². This example selects npl=100 for zscale’s nominal peak luminance parameter. Separately, the pinned FFmpeg signal-peak helper defines REFERENCE_WHITE=100 and divides MaxCLL or mastering-display maximum luminance by that constant. Record the npl parameter and normalization constant separately: this example uses the same numeric value and derives peak=10 from 1000/100. Selecting this candidate premise remains a bounded article design, not a universal input inferred from a phone model.

| Confirmed fact or author choice | Corresponding filter item and meaning |
|---|---|
| BT.2020 primaries | color_primaries=bt2020 in setparams marks the known input; primariesin=2020 tells zscale how to read it. |
| BT.2020-NCL matrix | colorspace=bt2020nc and matrixin=2020_ncl express the same confirmed matrix. |
| PQ transfer | setparams marks known PQ with color_trc=smpte2084. The following zscale does not guess a transferin literal; its documented default reads the input transfer property before transfer=linear requests linearization. |
| Limited range | range=limited and rangein=limited come from independent source records, not appearance. |
| Actual signal peak 1000 cd/m²; example npl=100; implementation constant REFERENCE_WHITE=100 | npl=100 is the example’s zscale nominal peak luminance parameter. REFERENCE_WHITE=100 is a separate constant in the pinned implementation. tonemap peak=10 is this example’s normalized 1000/100 signal ratio. Record these as a processing setting, an implementation constant, and a signal peak respectively. |
| Mobius selected by the author for the first visual candidate | tonemap=mobius is a creative choice awaiting actual viewing, not a metadata-derived result or claimed universal default. |
| BT.709 limited-range yuv420p output target | The final zscale requests 709 primaries/transfer/matrix and limited range, format selects yuv420p, and the final setparams marks the output properties. |

The next single line is the exact **filter-only value** passed as the argument after -vf; it is not a complete ffmpeg command:

> setparams=color_primaries=bt2020:color_trc=smpte2084:colorspace=bt2020nc:range=limited,zscale=primariesin=2020:matrixin=2020_ncl:rangein=limited:transfer=linear:npl=100,format=pix_fmts=gbrpf32le,tonemap=tonemap=mobius:peak=10,zscale=primaries=709:transfer=709:matrix=709:range=limited,format=pix_fmts=yuv420p,setparams=color_primaries=bt709:color_trc=bt709:colorspace=bt709:range=limited

The real command must separately choose a real video encoder and a fresh candidate path. Using -vf decodes, filters, and re-encodes the picture; it cannot use -c:v copy. This article does not invent audio, container, or complete encoding options because those depend on the real handoff. Confirm zscale on the target machine, then pass the complete line above as one -vf argument for a new candidate. Save output ffprobe observations and perform the SDR playback review. No result exists here; local FFmpeg 9.0.1 lacks zscale/libzimg. If source color facts are absent or contradictory, return to the source-type unknown branch. If HDR color facts are confirmed but peak or another conversion parameter remains unverified, retain “confirmed HDR” and separately mark “numeric conversion plan pending.” Obtain trustworthy peak evidence or an explicitly reviewed grading decision before preparing that source’s plan; do not copy this graph meanwhile.

heading.zh: 原创纸面案例：雨后夜市短片的三路判断
heading.en: Original paper case: a rainy night-market clip

body.zh:
下面的“雨棚下三十秒”是本文虚构的教学案例。没有真实媒体、转换、播放测试或成功结果；文件名与观察均为假设。

创作者要把手机拍摄的夜市片段放进普通 SDR 视频回顾。镜头从湿路面的灯笼倒影摇到摊主递出热饮，背景有白色价牌、红色雨棚和蒸汽。创作者说第一次导出后“整段发灰，灯笼又像被剪平”，但只保留聊天软件转存文件 market-share.mov。这个外观描述先记为症状，不据此宣布 HDR。

| 假设证据状态 | 决定与下一步 |
|---|---|
| 手机原片与拍摄记录找回，来源模式和文件声明一致确认 HDR | 保留原片；按已确认输入制作 SDR 候选。实际观看时检查摊主脸部和蒸汽的中间调、灯笼与价牌高光、湿路黑位，以及摇镜头前后亮度是否突跳。 |
| 受控 SDR 导出日志证明转存文件的像素已是正确 SDR，但文件被错误标记 | 复制到新候选，仅纠正已被证明错误的属性；复查声明并在 SDR 链路完整播放。没有独立日志就不能选这一路。 |
| 只剩转存文件，探测字段缺失或互相矛盾，原片与记录都找不到 | 状态写“未知”；不猜输入曲线，不用标签修复碰碰运气，也不执行 HDR 色调映射。请求原始相机文件或可信导出记录。 |

“修改前”决定是根据发灰外观直接换标签，把像素问题与声明问题混在一起。“修改后”决定是保存证据并进入三路之一。即使第一路生成候选，也只能写“等待 SDR 播放复核”；实际检查通过后才可交接。
body.en:
Thirty Seconds Under the Awning is a fictional teaching case written for this article. There is no real media, conversion, playback test, or successful result; filenames and observations are hypothetical.

A creator wants to place a phone-shot night-market passage into an ordinary SDR recap. The camera moves from lantern reflections on wet pavement to a vendor handing over a hot drink; a white price board, red awning, and steam sit behind. The creator says the first export “looks gray and the lanterns seem flattened,” but only a messaging-app copy named market-share.mov remains. Record that appearance as a symptom without declaring the clip HDR.

| Hypothetical evidence state | Decision and next step |
|---|---|
| The phone original and capture record are recovered, and mode plus declarations consistently confirm HDR | Preserve the original and create an SDR candidate from the confirmed input. During real viewing, inspect face and steam midtones, lantern and price-board highlights, wet-pavement blacks, and brightness continuity through the pan. |
| A controlled SDR export log proves the transferred file contains correct SDR pixels but was mislabeled | Copy to a new candidate and correct only the proven-wrong properties. Probe again and play the entire candidate through an SDR path. This branch is unavailable without independent evidence. |
| Only the transferred copy remains, fields are absent or contradictory, and neither original nor record can be recovered | Record “unknown.” Do not guess the input curve, try random tag repair, or perform HDR tone mapping. Request the camera original or a trustworthy export record. |

The before decision changes tags from appearance alone, conflating pixel conversion with declaration repair. The after decision preserves evidence and enters exactly one branch. Even if the first branch produces a candidate, its status remains “awaiting SDR playback review.” It becomes a handoff file only after actual checks pass.

heading.zh: 真实 SDR 播放决定候选是否能交接
heading.en: Real SDR playback decides the handoff

body.zh:
机械检查与观看检查分开记录。探测确认候选能读、输出声明完整、尺寸与时钟符合计划；实际播放确认内容是否可用。至少普通速度完整播放一次。

| 复核项 | 实际要看什么 |
|---|---|
| 中间调 | 人脸、墙面、蒸汽或阴影内主体是否被整体压暗或抬灰；与相邻 SDR 镜头是否连贯。 |
| 高光 | 灯具、窗户、白牌和反光是否出现突兀硬边、大片无层次区域或镜头间跳变；不承诺保存 HDR 全部峰值。 |
| 肤色与中性色 | 不凭“更鲜艳”验收；看肤色是否稳定，中性物是否无意外色偏。 |
| 黑白电平 | 黑位是否被压死或抬起，白位是否持续顶住；结合实际 SDR 范围与播放链路判断。 |
| 镜头序列 | 逐个过剪点和曝光变化，避免单镜头顺眼却造成全片亮度脉冲。 |
| 声音与时钟 | 听完整声音，核对时长、同步与已采用内容；色彩转换不授权顺带改剪辑或混音。 |

发现问题时回到当前候选的转换设置，另存下一候选。保留失败候选与记录，避免覆盖原片或把未经观看的最新文件误当成通过版本。
body.en:
Record mechanical and viewing checks separately. Probing confirms that the candidate is readable, declarations are complete, and canvas and clock match the plan. Playback confirms whether content is usable. Play the complete program at normal speed at least once.

| Review item | What to inspect in the actual candidate |
|---|---|
| Midtones | Faces, walls, steam, and shadow subjects are not globally crushed or lifted; adjacent SDR shots remain coherent. |
| Highlights | Lamps, windows, white signs, and reflections avoid abrupt edges, broad featureless areas, and shot-to-shot jumps; retaining every HDR peak is not promised. |
| Skin and neutrals | Do not approve from “more colorful.” Check stable skin and unintended casts on neutral objects. |
| Black and white levels | Blacks are neither crushed nor raised and whites do not ride the ceiling continuously, judged through the actual SDR range and playback path. |
| Shot sequence | Cross every cut and exposure change so a pleasant isolated shot does not create brightness pulsing. |
| Sound and clock | Listen throughout and confirm duration, sync, and adopted content. Color conversion does not authorize incidental editorial or mix changes. |

When review finds a problem, return to the current candidate's conversion settings and save another candidate. Keep failed candidates and records so the original is never overwritten and the newest unviewed file is not mistaken for an approved version.

heading.zh: 复制这份已验证 SDR 交接记录
heading.en: Copy this verified-SDR handoff record

body.zh:
> **来源与原片：** 设备/模式/传输链；只读原片路径或哈希；可信参考。  
> **探测观察：** 输入 ffprobe 原始 JSON 路径；声明缺失或矛盾项。  
> **决定与证据：** 已确认 HDR 像素 / 已确认 SDR 像素但标签错误 / 未知；独立证据。  
> **构建与滤镜：** 工具版本；zscale、tonemap、setparams 或等价能力的实际可用性。  
> **转换记录：** 已确认输入；线性化、色调映射、BT.709 SDR 输出步骤与参数；或仅修标签的证据。  
> **候选路径：** 新文件路径或哈希；原片保持不动。  
> **输出探测：** 编解码、像素格式、范围、色彩空间、传递与原色声明。  
> **实际观看：** SDR 播放链；中间调、高光、肤色、中性色、黑白电平、镜头序列、声音与同步。  
> **下游交接：** 只有实际检查通过时，记录“已验证 SDR 候选”并交给普通视频回顾编辑；否则写待修或未知。

固定版 Video Recap 的普通装配路径可能复制视频，也可能为了字幕、遮挡、叠加或尺寸而编码 H.264 yuv420p；它没有本文所需的 HDR 色调映射链。透明前景合成路径更明确要求输入已经是带 BT.709 / TV 有限范围声明的 H.264 yuv420p 母版。因此先在外部完成并验证 SDR 候选，再把新文件作为普通编辑输入。原片、未知文件和未观看候选不进入这一步。
body.en:
> **Provenance and original:** Device/mode/transfer chain; read-only original path or hash; trustworthy reference.  
> **Probe observations:** Input ffprobe raw JSON path; missing or contradictory declarations.  
> **Decision and evidence:** Confirmed HDR pixels / confirmed SDR pixels with wrong tags / unknown; independent evidence.  
> **Build and filters:** Tool version; actual availability of zscale, tonemap, setparams, or equivalent capabilities.  
> **Conversion record:** Confirmed input; linearization, tone mapping, BT.709 SDR output stages and parameters; or evidence for property-only correction.  
> **Candidate path:** New file path or hash; original retained unchanged.  
> **Output probe:** Codec, pixel format, range, color space, transfer, and primaries declarations.  
> **Actual viewing:** SDR playback path; midtones, highlights, skin, neutrals, black/white levels, shot sequence, sound, and sync.  
> **Downstream handoff:** Only after actual checks pass, record “verified SDR candidate” and hand it to ordinary video-recap editing; otherwise mark revision pending or unknown.

At the pinned revision, ordinary Video Recap assembly may copy picture or encode H.264 yuv420p for subtitles, masking, overlays, or sizing. It does not implement this HDR tone-mapping chain. The transparent-foreground path specifically requires an already H.264 yuv420p master with explicit BT.709 / TV limited-range declarations. Complete and verify the external SDR candidate first, then use that new file as ordinary editing input. Originals, unknown files, and unviewed candidates do not enter this step.

q.zh: ffprobe 显示 BT.2020 或 PQ，就能证明像素一定是 HDR 吗？
q.en: Do BT.2020 or PQ fields in ffprobe prove the pixels are HDR?

a.zh: 不能单独证明。它们是文件或码流声明，要与原始拍摄、导出或可信参考证据一起判断。声明可能缺失、错误或在转存中改变。
a.en: Not by themselves. They are file or bitstream declarations and must be evaluated with original capture, export, or trustworthy reference evidence. Declarations can be missing, wrong, or altered during transfer.

q.zh: 把 setparams 改成 BT.709 能修好所有发灰视频吗？
q.en: Can setparams fix every washed-out video by marking BT.709?

a.zh: 不能。setparams 标记属性，不改变像素。只有独立证据确认像素本来就是正确 SDR、问题仅在错误声明时，才走属性修正；确认 HDR 像素需要真实转换。
a.en: No. setparams marks properties without changing pixels. Property correction is appropriate only when independent evidence proves correct SDR pixels with wrong declarations; confirmed HDR pixels require a real conversion.

text.zh: 用 $video-recap 从这份已验证的 SDR 文件继续制作普通视频回顾。输入路径是我在交接记录中标为“已验证 SDR 候选”的新文件；请保留原始手机文件和转换记录，不把 HDR 转换当作该 skill 的原生能力。先读取实际素材并规划剪辑、旁白、字幕与成片，再生成新输出；报告使用的 SDR 候选版本和仍需人工观看、试听的项目。
text.en: Use $video-recap to continue ordinary recap editing from this verified SDR file. The input path is the new file marked “verified SDR candidate” in my handoff record. Retain the phone original and conversion record, and do not treat HDR conversion as a native capability of this skill. Inspect the actual media first, plan the edit, narration, captions, and final video, then create a new output. Report the SDR candidate version used and the viewing or listening checks that remain.
