title.zh: AI绘画提示词怎么写：主体、构图与可复制模板
title.en: How to Write an AI Image Prompt: A Copyable Template

seo_title.zh: AI绘画提示词：主体、构图与模板
seo_title.en: AI Image Prompt Template: Subject and Composition

description.zh: 从画面用途、可见主体、构图留白、光线材质与文字处理出发，把模糊想法改成可复制提示词，并按实际结果逐项检查。
description.en: Turn a vague idea into a copyable AI image prompt by defining purpose, visible facts, composition, light, materials, text, and result checks.

answer.zh: 先写图片用途，再写可见主体、状态、道具与地点关系；随后确定取景、主体占比、视角、留白、背景、光向、颜色和材质。文字要给出准确内容与位置，或留给后期。最后只列相关排除项。生成后检查主体、空间和文字处理，针对一个具体偏差改写。
answer.en: State the picture job, then describe the visible subject, state, prop, and location relationship. Set framing, subject size, viewpoint, reserved space, background, light, color, material, and text treatment. Add only relevant exclusions. After generation, inspect recognition, spatial relationships, and text, then revise one concrete mismatch at a time.

heading.zh: 先决定这张图要完成什么任务
heading.en: Decide the picture's job first

body.zh:
同一个点子可以写成角色、地点、道具或带人物的场景概念图。第一张图先选一个任务：人物图重在轮廓和可认特征；地点图重在入口、区域与尺度；道具图重在形制、功能面和材质；场景图重在人物、地点、道具的可见关系。

本文使用一个原创纸面示例：为虚构故事准备横向开场概念图。夜班植物管理员岑遥站在旧商场屋顶温室里，手持待归还的铜制种子盒。这里没有实际生成、测试或验收结果。

先填手工卡片；无关的行直接删除。

| 要填写 | 当前示例的答案 |
|---|---|
| 图片用途 | 横向开场概念图，讨论人物、温室和种子盒的同框关系 |
| 主体与状态 | 岑遥，短卷发，深绿围裙，双手托住关闭的铜盒 |
| 地点关系 | 人物中央偏左，右侧是通往楼梯的玻璃门 |
| 关键道具 | 手掌宽的扁长铜盒，圆角，盖面三道平行凹槽 |
| 所需留白 | 右上留出雾灰玻璃区域，供后期放标题 |
body.en:
One idea can become a character, location, prop, or scene concept. Choose one job for the first image. A character concept emphasizes silhouette and recognition; a location emphasizes entrances, zones, and scale; a prop emphasizes form, function, and material; a scene emphasizes visible relationships among person, place, and object.

This article uses an original paper-only example: a horizontal opening concept for a fictional story. Night plant keeper Cen Yao stands in an old shopping-center rooftop greenhouse, holding a brass seed case that must be returned. No image was generated, tested, or approved.

Fill this manual card and delete irrelevant rows.

| Field | Answer in this example |
|---|---|
| Picture job | Horizontal opening concept showing character, greenhouse, and seed case together |
| Subject and state | Cen Yao, short curly hair, dark-green apron, holding a closed brass case in both hands |
| Location relationship | Subject left of center, glass stair door on the right |
| Key prop | Palm-width, low rectangular brass case with rounded corners and three lid grooves |
| Required space | Mist-gray glass area in the upper right for a title added later |

heading.zh: 把感觉词改成能看见的事实
heading.en: Translate mood labels into visible facts

body.zh:
“神秘女孩在老温室里”给了主题，却没有画法。继续问：凭什么认出主体？人物、地点和道具怎样摆放？哪些光线、表面与颜色承担情绪？答案要能在成图中指出。

| 模糊想法 | 可见改写 |
|---|---|
| 神秘女孩 | 二十多岁的夜班管理员，短卷发，深绿围裙，低头看铜盒 |
| 老温室 | 水汽玻璃顶、锈红钢梁、浅木种植台，右侧玻璃门通向楼梯 |
| 紧张感 | 双手托盒但未打开；门后冷白灯与人物侧面的暖黄灯相对 |
| 重要道具 | 扁长圆角铜盒，手掌宽，盖面三道凹槽，边缘有使用痕迹 |

少量稳定细节已经够用。短卷发、围裙色、盒子轮廓与凹槽支撑识别；未确定的徽章、品牌或文字不临时发明。
body.en:
“A mysterious woman in an old greenhouse” gives a theme but little visual direction. Ask what identifies the subject, how person/place/prop relate, and which light, surfaces, and colors carry the mood. Each answer should be visible in the result.

| Vague idea | Visible repair |
|---|---|
| Mysterious woman | Night keeper in her twenties, short curly hair, dark-green apron, looking at the case |
| Old greenhouse | Condensed glass roof, rust-red ribs, pale wooden benches, glass stair door on the right |
| Tension | Both hands support the unopened case; cold stair light opposes warm light on her profile |
| Important prop | Palm-width rounded brass case, three lid grooves, handled edges |

A few stable details are enough. Hair, apron color, case silhouette, and grooves support recognition. Do not invent an unsettled badge, brand, or wording.

heading.zh: 补齐构图、光线、材质和文字处理
heading.en: Set composition, light, material, and text treatment

body.zh:
构图服务用途。本例可写：“横向中远景，人物中央偏左，占画面高度约二分之一；右侧玻璃门完整可见，右上保留安静区域。”

光线与材质写成关系：暖黄工作灯照到脸侧、围裙和铜盒上缘；门后冷白灯勾出门框；铜盒是边缘微亮的旧黄铜，玻璃有水汽，木台偏哑光。

标题尚未确定，因此留给后期：右上保留无人物、无枝叶遮挡、亮暗均匀的玻璃区域，不要求图内生成可读标题。必须出现的门牌或包装文字，则先确认准确内容和位置，再逐字写明。

排除项只保护当前任务：盒盖打开、盒内发光、第二个人物、植物遮门，以及留白中的标牌或水印。
body.en:
Composition serves the job. For this example: “horizontal medium-wide view; subject left of center at roughly half the image height; glass stair door fully visible on the right; quiet space in the upper right.”

Describe light and material as relationships: a warm lamp reaches her profile, apron, and case edge; cold stair light traces the door frame; the case is aged muted brass with handled edges; glass is condensed and benches are matte wood.

The title is unsettled, so reserve evenly toned glass in the upper right, free of people and crossing leaves, for later lettering. Do not request readable title text. When a sign or package must carry words, confirm exact wording and location first.

Use exclusions that protect this task: open lid, glowing contents, second person, plants blocking the door, and signs or watermarks in the title area.

heading.zh: 复制这份已填写提示词
heading.en: Copy the completed prompt

body.zh:
完整纸面提示词如下：

> 横向开场场景概念图。旧商场屋顶温室的夜班植物管理员岑遥，二十多岁，短卷发，穿深绿工作围裙，站在画面中央偏左，双手托着一只关闭的扁长铜制种子盒，低头看向盒盖。盒子约手掌宽，圆角，盖面有三道平行凹槽，旧黄铜表面偏暗，边缘有细微磨亮。横向中远景，人物约占画面高度二分之一；锈红钢梁、带水汽的玻璃顶棚与浅木种植台建立屋顶温室，右侧通往楼梯的玻璃门完整可见。暖黄工作灯照到人物侧脸、围裙和盒子上缘，门后冷白灯勾出门框。右上方保留亮暗均匀的雾灰玻璃区域，供后期添加标题，区域内没有人物、枝叶、标牌或水印。盒盖保持关闭，盒内不发光；画面只有岑遥一人，高大植物不遮挡楼梯门。

换题材时保留决策顺序并替换事实：用途 → 主体与状态 → 道具或地点关系 → 构图留白 → 光线材质 → 文字处理 → 少量排除。无关项直接删除。
body.en:
Complete paper prompt:

> Horizontal opening-scene concept. Cen Yao, the night plant keeper of an old shopping-center rooftop greenhouse, is in her twenties with short curly hair and a dark-green work apron. She stands left of center, holding a closed, low rectangular brass seed case in both hands and looking down at its lid. The case is palm-width with rounded corners and three parallel grooves on the lid; its aged brass is muted, with lightly polished handling edges. Use a horizontal medium-wide view with the subject at about half the image height. Rust-red steel ribs, a condensed glass roof, and pale wooden planting benches establish the rooftop greenhouse; keep the glass stair door fully visible on the right. A warm work lamp reaches her profile, apron, and the upper edge of the case, while cold white stair light traces the door frame. Reserve an evenly toned mist-gray glass area in the upper right for a title added later, with no person, crossing leaves, sign, or watermark in that area. Keep the case closed and unlit inside. Show Cen Yao alone, and keep tall plants from blocking the stair door.

For a new subject, retain the decision order and replace the facts: job → subject and state → prop or location relationship → composition and reserved space → light and material → text treatment → relevant exclusions. Delete parts that do not serve the picture.

heading.zh: 生成后按用途检查实际结果
heading.en: Inspect the actual result against its job

body.zh:
拿到实际图片后，把成图与用途和卡片并排查看。先改影响最大的偏差；人物正确而门被遮挡时，就强化门的完整可见与植物高度边界。以下是尚未执行的检查计划：

- [ ] 人物、温室、铜盒的主次清楚。
- [ ] 短卷发、深绿围裙、关闭盒盖和三道凹槽可辨。
- [ ] 人物中央偏左，门在右侧完整可见，右上可放标题。
- [ ] 暖灯与冷灯能解释人物、盒缘和门框的亮暗。
- [ ] 铜盒像双手可托的旧黄铜盒，尺度合理。
- [ ] 没有新增人物、发光内容物、遮门植物、意外标牌或水印。
- [ ] 放大检查手与盒子的接触、盒盖关系、门框和种植台交叠。

多个目标同时偏离时，先修主体与关键关系，再修构图和留白，最后调整次要表面。每轮保存实际图片和对应提示词，才能比较改动。
body.en:
When an actual image exists, compare it with the job and card. Fix the highest-impact mismatch first. If the person is correct but plants hide the door, strengthen door visibility and the plant-height boundary. This checklist has not been executed:

- [ ] Person, greenhouse, and case have a clear hierarchy.
- [ ] Hair, apron, closed lid, and three grooves are recognizable.
- [ ] Subject is left of center, door is visible on the right, and title space remains clear.
- [ ] Warm and cold light explain values on the person, case edge, and door frame.
- [ ] The case reads as handled aged brass at a believable two-hand scale.
- [ ] No extra person, glowing contents, door-blocking plant, accidental sign, or watermark appears.
- [ ] At close view, inspect hand contact, lid closure, door geometry, and bench overlaps.

When several targets miss, repair subject and relationships first, then composition and title space, then secondary surfaces. Retain each actual image with its prompt so revisions can be compared.

heading.zh: 在短剧项目里交给正确阶段
heading.en: Hand it to the right stage in a short-drama project

body.zh:
已有配置好的短剧项目时，`short-drama-image-prompts` 会读取已确认的人物、地点、道具、视觉方向和提示词语言，写出可复制文本；它不生成图片。请求中给出项目路径、已接受事实和图片用途。

需要实际生成时，另行转到 `short-drama-produce`：先展示精确任务预览，再由创作者确认外部调用。通用手工提示词也可复制到创作者选择的工具，并按同一简报检查结果。
body.en:
In a configured short-drama project, `short-drama-image-prompts` reads accepted character, location, prop, visual-direction, and prompt-language facts and writes copyable text; it does not generate images. Give it the project path, accepted facts, and picture job.

For project generation, transfer the accepted prompt to `short-drama-produce`, which previews the exact task before creator confirmation of an external call. A manual prompt can also be copied into the creator's chosen tool and inspected against the same brief.

q.zh: AI 绘画提示词越长越好吗？
q.en: Is a longer AI image prompt always better?

a.zh: 长度服从用途。保留主体识别、空间关系和关键误读所需内容；同义形容词、无关背景和通用故障词会稀释重点。
a.en: Length follows the job. Keep details needed for recognition, spatial relationships, and likely misreadings. Synonymous adjectives, unrelated backstory, and generic defect lists dilute the hierarchy.

q.zh: 图片里的文字应该直接写进提示词吗？
q.en: Should text inside the image be written directly into the prompt?

a.zh: 需要可读时，先确认准确文字、承载面和位置，再逐字写明并检查成图。文案未定时预留干净区域，后期添加。
a.en: For readable text, confirm exact wording, surface, and location, then inspect the result. When wording is unsettled, reserve a clean area and add it later.

text.zh: 在已配置的短剧项目 /ABS/my-drama 中，用 $short-drama-image-prompts 为已经确认的[人物、地点或道具]写一条[图片用途]提示词。只使用项目里已接受的资产事实与提示词语言，写清主体状态、构图留白、地点或道具关系、光线材质、文字处理和本图相关的排除项。交付可复制正文并停在提示词阶段，不生成图片。若我要在项目内实际生成，再把已接受提示词交给 short-drama-produce，先展示精确任务预览，等我确认后执行。
text.en: In the configured short-drama project /ABS/my-drama, use $short-drama-image-prompts to write one [picture job] prompt for the accepted [character, location, or prop]. Use only accepted project asset facts and the project's prompt language. State subject condition, composition and reserved space, location or prop relationships, light and materials, text treatment, and exclusions relevant to this picture. Deliver copyable text and stop at the prompt stage; do not generate an image. If I later request project production, hand the accepted prompt to short-drama-produce, show the exact task preview, and wait for my confirmation before execution.

label.zh: 短剧资产图片提示词的用途、写法与生产边界
label.en: Purpose, writing method, and production boundary for short-drama asset image prompts

label.zh: 从资产事实到可复制图片提示词的通用配方
label.en: General recipe from asset facts to copyable image prompts

title.zh: AI分镜图怎么生成：从镜头起点到可用首帧
title.en: How to Generate an AI Storyboard Frame from a Shot Start

seo_title.zh: AI分镜图怎么生成：镜头起点到首帧
seo_title.en: Generate an AI Storyboard Frame from a Shot Start

description.zh: 把已确认镜头起点冻结成一张静态分镜提示词，选择参考图、预览单图任务、检查真实候选图，并在人工接受后交给下游。
description.en: Freeze an accepted shot start into a static prompt, choose references, preview one image job, inspect the candidate, and accept it for downstream use.

answer.zh: 先从已确认分镜中只取镜头起点：人物位置、身体朝向、视线、双手、持物与当下可见状态。把随后才发生的动作、表情变化、运镜和终点信息移出首帧。再写清景别、机位、画面层次、空间锚点、光线与文字处理，并选择确实要控制身份、造型、地点或构图的真实参考图；没有参考图也可以明确按文字生成。生成前只预览一张图片任务，创作者确认后才调用外部服务。拿到真实候选图后对照镜头起点检查，只有人工接受的实际图片才作为下游首帧。
answer.en: Take only the start boundary from an accepted shot: positions, body facing, gaze, hands, held props, and visible state. Remove actions, expression changes, camera movement, and end facts that occur later. Add framing, camera side, depth, spatial anchors, light, and text treatment. Select real references only for the identity, look, location, or composition they should control, or explicitly proceed without references. Preview one image job and run it only after creator confirmation. Inspect the returned candidate against the shot start; only a human-accepted actual image becomes the downstream first frame.

heading.zh: 先把已确认镜头冻结在起点
heading.en: Freeze the accepted shot at its start

body.zh:
从已确认镜头中分开起点与动作：首帧只保留同一瞬间能存在的事实；伸手、转身、揭示、运镜和光线变化留给运动描述。分镜阶段只写冻结关键帧文字。

本文使用原创纸面案例，没有实际生成或测试：社区剧场的道具管理员顾晴在仓库里发现一只木制狐狸面具。镜头稍后会让她翻转面具，看到背面的编号；首帧停在翻转之前。

| 已确认镜头信息 | 首帧怎样处理 |
|---|---|
| 镜头职责：观众先注意到异常面具 | 让面具成为清楚的视觉重点 |
| 起点：顾晴在工作台左侧，左臂夹着清单，右手空置并放在台面 | 全部保留 |
| 起点：身体朝向工作台，头和视线转向面具 | 写清身体与头部朝向，视线落点具体 |
| 动作：右手拿起面具并翻到背面 | 移出首帧 |
| 终点：背面编号进入画面 | 移出首帧，正面首帧看不到编号 |

一条错误的压缩写法是：“顾晴拿起狐狸面具翻到背面，惊讶地发现编号。”它把多个时刻塞进一张静态图，也提前交付了镜头结果。改写时逐项核对位置、朝向、视线、手和道具状态。
body.en:
An AI storyboard image begins with an accepted shot. State the shot duty, then separate start from action. The first frame contains only facts a still camera could capture at once; reaching, turning, revealing, camera moves, and changing light belong to motion. The storyboard stage writes this frozen-keyframe text but does not create media.

This article uses an original paper-only case with no generated or tested result. Community-theater prop keeper Gu Qing notices an unusual wooden fox mask in storage. The shot will later have her turn the mask over and see a number on its back; the first frame stops before the turn.

| Accepted shot information | First-frame treatment |
|---|---|
| Duty: make the audience notice the unusual mask | Give the mask a clear focal role |
| Start: Gu Qing stands left of the bench, checklist under her left arm, empty right hand resting on the surface | Keep all facts |
| Start: body faces the bench; head and gaze turn toward the mask | State body/head facing and exact gaze target |
| Action: right hand lifts and turns the mask | Remove from first frame |
| End: the number on the back enters view | Remove; the front-facing start cannot show it |

A compressed prompt such as “Gu Qing picks up the fox mask, turns it over, and reacts to the number” combines several moments and reveals the result early. Repair it by checking position, facing, gaze, hands, and prop state one by one.

heading.zh: 只选择这张首帧真正需要的参考
heading.en: Choose only references this first frame needs

body.zh:
参考图按职责选择。身份图控制稳定识别特征，造型图控制本场服装，地点图控制仓库布局，构图图只借取占比、机位一侧或留白。逐张说明允许影响和不能带入的内容，避免参考姿势改写手位、陌生人物进入画面。

本例可以选两张已核对的真实参考：顾晴的身份与当集造型图，控制人物识别和灰蓝工作外套；道具仓库地点图，控制门、工作台和层架的相对位置，不控制人物姿势或狐狸面具设计。若这些文件尚未准备好，先补齐并核对真实参考，或由创作者明确选择无参考的文字生成路线；描述、计划或尚未生成的图片不能当作已经存在的参考。
body.en:
Choose references by role rather than quantity. An identity image can control face, hair, and stable recognition; a look image controls the current costume; a location image controls storage geography; a composition reference contributes only scale, camera side, or negative space. For every real image, say what it may and may not influence. A pose in an identity reference should not rewrite first-frame hand positions, and strangers in a location reference should not enter the frame.

This example could use two inspected files: Gu Qing identity/current-look material for recognition and her gray-blue work jacket, plus a prop-storage location image for the relative placement of door, bench, and shelving. The location does not control her pose or the fox-mask design. If those files are unavailable, obtain and inspect the real references first, or have the creator explicitly choose text-only generation without references. A description, plan, or future image is not an existing reference.

heading.zh: 写一段只属于起点的可复制提示词
heading.en: Write one copyable prompt for the start only

body.zh:
起点明确后，补齐景别、机位所在一侧、人物占比、前中后景、光源方向和可见文字。姿态要符合景别：中景能读到上身、手位与面具，却不依赖细微眼皮变化。文字政策也服从起点；面具背面的编号此刻不可见，清单背面朝镜头且保持无可读内容。

完整纸面提示词：

> 竖屏中景，社区剧场道具仓库。机位位于工作台轴线右侧、平视，顾晴站在画面左半，身体朝向工作台，头转向画面右下的木制狐狸面具，视线准确落在面具上。她穿灰蓝工作外套，左臂夹住一张清单，纸张背面朝镜头且无可读文字；右手空置，手掌放在台面上，距离面具约一掌。狐狸面具正面朝上，位于画面右下三分区，浅褐木纹，耳尖各有一道暗红涂色，背面编号完全不可见。前景是工作台边缘，中景只有顾晴与面具，背景层架整齐放着素色道具箱，仓库门在画面右后方。左上方暖白顶灯照亮顾晴的手和面具，层架区域略暗。画面只有顾晴一人；面具保持放在台面上，右手没有抓握动作，没有翻转过程，没有新增标签、水印或可读编号。

复制到通用生图工具时，可附上已选参考图及其职责。配置好的短剧项目则从当前镜头的冻结关键帧文字准备图片任务；两条路径都先保持首帧边界一致。
body.en:
Once the start is settled, add shot size, camera side, subject scale, depth layers, light direction, and visible-text treatment. The pose must fit the framing: a medium shot can show upper body, hands, and mask without depending on an eyelid detail. Text also follows the start boundary. The number on the back of the mask is hidden, while the checklist presents its blank back to camera.

Complete paper prompt:

> Vertical medium shot inside a community-theater prop store. The camera is on the right side of the workbench axis at eye level. Gu Qing stands in the left half of frame, body facing the bench, head turned toward the wooden fox mask at lower right, gaze landing precisely on it. She wears a gray-blue work jacket and holds a checklist under her left arm; the blank back of the paper faces camera with no readable text. Her right hand is empty and rests on the bench one palm-width from the mask. The fox mask lies front-up in the lower-right third, with pale brown wood grain and one dark-red painted mark on each ear tip; the number on its back is fully hidden. The bench edge fills the foreground; Gu Qing and the mask occupy the middle ground; background shelving holds orderly plain prop boxes, with the storage door at rear right. A warm-white ceiling light from upper left reaches her hand and the mask while the shelves remain dimmer. Show Gu Qing alone. Keep the mask on the bench and her hand open, with no lifting or turning action, added label, watermark, or readable number.

In a general image tool, copy the prompt and attach only the selected references with their roles. In a configured short-drama project, prepare an image task from the current shot’s frozen-keyframe text. Both routes preserve the same start boundary.

heading.zh: 先预览一张图的任务，再确认外部调用
heading.en: Preview one image job before confirming an external call

body.zh:
通用工具路径由创作者自己粘贴提示词、挂载选定参考并查看工具将要执行的设置。短剧套件路径用 `short-drama-produce` 从已确认镜头的冻结关键帧正文准备一张图片任务。预览至少要让创作者看清：来源镜头、完整提示词、生成数量、选定参考及各自职责、输出位置和是否覆盖已有文件。

套件的任务准备预览不向供应商提交生成请求。创作者看到当前预览并明确确认后，才执行这一张图；提示词、参考、数量或输出目标改变时，再展示新的预览，并取得创作者对新任务的明确确认。这样可以确认本轮花费与画面边界，同时避免把整集图片一起塞进第一次试画。
body.en:
In a general tool, the creator pastes the prompt, attaches selected references, and reviews that tool’s pending settings. In the short-drama suite, `short-drama-produce` prepares one image job from the accepted shot’s frozen-keyframe text. The preview should expose the source shot, full prompt, image count, selected references and roles, output destination, and overwrite behavior.

The suite’s job-preparation preview does not submit a generation request to a provider. Run this one image only after the creator sees the current preview and explicitly confirms it. If the prompt, references, count, or output target changes, present a new preview and obtain fresh explicit creator confirmation for the changed job. This keeps the cost and frame boundary visible and avoids placing a whole episode into the first trial.

heading.zh: 检查真实候选图，人工接受后再交给下游
heading.en: Inspect the real candidate, then accept it for downstream use

body.zh:
外部调用返回的是候选图，需要与镜头起点并排检查。本例计划尚未执行：

- [ ] 顾晴在左、面具在右下、仓库门在右后方，空间方向符合镜头。
- [ ] 身体朝向工作台，头与视线落向面具；左臂夹清单，右手空置并停在面具旁。
- [ ] 面具正面朝上，背面编号没有提前出现，也没有拿起或翻转动作。
- [ ] 中景能同时读清人物、手位和面具，背景层架没有抢走视觉重点。
- [ ] 暖白灯方向与已确认场景一致，木纹和暗红耳尖可辨。
- [ ] 清单没有意外文字，画面没有新增人物、标签或水印。
- [ ] 若使用参考图，人物身份、服装和仓库地理受到正确控制，参考中的姿势与陌生物件没有被带入。

候选图偏离时按来源修正：手位或道具状态错了就改提示词；身份或地点漂移就检查参考职责；镜头起点改变则先接受新边界。创作者选定一张真实图片后，再把该文件记录为这个镜头的起始帧输入，交给后续视频提示词或首帧驱动流程。未接受的候选图继续留在候选状态。
body.en:
An image returned by an external call is a candidate. Technical completion, a saved file, or a pleasing surface does not automatically make it the accepted first frame. Compare the real image with the shot start. This example’s inspection plan has not been executed:

- [ ] Gu Qing is left, mask lower right, and storage door rear right, matching shot geography.
- [ ] Body faces the bench; head and gaze target the mask; checklist stays under the left arm; empty right hand rests beside the mask.
- [ ] The mask remains front-up, with no visible back number and no lifting or turning action.
- [ ] Medium framing reads character, hands, and mask together while shelving remains secondary.
- [ ] Warm-white light follows the accepted scene direction; wood grain and dark-red ear-tip marks remain visible.
- [ ] The checklist gains no accidental writing, and no extra person, label, or watermark appears.
- [ ] When references are used, they control the intended identity, look, and geography without importing poses or strangers.

Route a mismatch to its owner. Repair the keyframe prompt for wrong hands or prop state; revise reference roles for identity or geography drift; return to storyboard acceptance if the shot start itself changes. After the creator selects a real image, record that actual file as this shot’s first-frame input for downstream video prompting or first-frame-driven production. Unaccepted candidates remain candidates.

q.zh: 首帧需要同时写镜头结尾吗？
q.en: Should the first-frame prompt include the shot ending?

a.zh: 首帧只投影镜头起点。结尾首次出现的动作、手位、道具状态或文字留在运动与终点说明。下游确实需要尾帧时，再为已确认终点准备独立图片交接。
a.en: The first frame projects only the shot start. Actions, hand positions, prop states, or text that first appear at the end stay in motion and end descriptions. If downstream production truly needs an end frame, prepare a separate image handoff for the accepted end.

q.zh: 生成成功后能直接把图片当首帧吗？
q.en: Can a successfully generated image immediately become the first frame?

a.zh: 先对照镜头起点检查人物、空间、双手、持物、光线、文字和参考图职责。创作者接受具体图片后，再把实际文件交给下游。
a.en: First compare the actual image with the accepted start: character, geography, hands, props, light, text, and reference roles. Hand the real file downstream only after the creator accepts that specific image.

text.zh: 在已配置的短剧项目 /ABS/my-drama 中，用 $short-drama-produce 为当前已确认的[镜头编号]冻结关键帧准备一张起始画面。读取该镜头现有的可复制首帧正文，只使用已经选定且当前可读的参考图及其职责。先展示这一张图的完整任务预览，包括提示词、数量、参考、输出位置和覆盖行为，然后停下等待我对本次预览的明确确认。确认后执行并返回实际文件路径；把结果标为候选，不自动接受，也不自动绑定到分镜或启动视频生产。
text.en: In the configured short-drama project /ABS/my-drama, use $short-drama-produce to prepare one start image from the accepted frozen-keyframe text for [shot ID]. Use only the selected, currently readable references and their stated roles. Show the complete preview for this one image, including prompt, count, references, output destination, and overwrite behavior, then stop for my explicit confirmation of that preview. After confirmation, run it and return the actual file path. Keep the result as a candidate; do not accept it, bind it into the storyboard, or start video production automatically.

label.zh: 分镜冻结关键帧、参考图与起始帧交接
label.en: Storyboard frozen keyframes, references, and first-frame handoff

label.zh: 镜头起点投影与静态画面检查方法
单图任务预览、确认、执行与候选结果边界
label.en: Single-image preview, confirmation, execution, and candidate-result boundary

title.zh: 可灵提示词模板：首帧、动作与运镜
title.en: Kling Prompt Template: Frame, Motion, and Camera

seo_title.zh: 可灵提示词模板：首帧、动作与运镜
seo_title.en: Kling Image-to-Video Prompt Template

description.zh: 从实际首帧提取起点，用可复制模板写清动作、运镜和终点；附原创开伞案例、手工输入路线选择与真实视频检查表。
description.en: Use a real start frame, a copyable motion template, and an original umbrella example; choose manual inputs and inspect the resulting clip.

answer.zh: 可灵图生视频提示词先填写“主体与起点、连续动作、次级反应、运镜、可见终点、连续性要求”。起点以实际上传图片为准，动作要交代双手、接触和物件变化。先用下面的模板写一条镜头，再按所选输入路线手工提交；拿到视频后逐项检查，不把提示词写完当作结果通过。
answer.en: Fill in subject and start, a continuous action, secondary response, camera, visible ending, and continuity requirements. Match the actual uploaded image and explain hands, contact, and object changes. Write one shot with the template below, submit through the selected manual input route, then inspect the returned clip; a finished prompt is not an accepted result.

heading.zh: 用动作、运镜和终点填写模板
heading.en: Fill the template with action, camera, and ending

body.zh:
首帧已经说明外观，提示词把字数留给变化。一个可复用的手工模板是：

> 从首帧开始，[主体]保持[起始身体、手位与持物]。[动作触发]后，[完成一个连续主动作，写清接触与物件状态变化]。[环境中与动作有关的次级反应]。镜头[机位或运动方式]，始终让[视觉重点]清楚可见。结尾停在[可见终点：人物位置、手位、物件状态与视线]。保持[首帧中必须连续的主体、服装、地点和构图关系]；画面不新增[最可能破坏本镜的对象或文字]。

动词要能连成一条线。先写谁动、接触什么、物件怎样改变，再写镜头；避免同时要求人物快走、回头、开伞、挥手和更换地点。运镜只选一个主要目的，例如缓慢后拉是为了让打开的伞和出口同时进入可读范围。终点要能截成下一张静态图，不能只写“很有感觉地结束”。
body.en:
The start image already supplies appearance, so spend prompt space on change. Reusable manual template:

> Begin from the start frame. [Subject] keeps [starting body, hands, and held object]. After [trigger], [complete one continuous main action, including contact and object-state change]. [Relevant secondary environmental response]. The camera [position or movement], keeping [visual priority] readable. End with [visible final position, hands, object state, and gaze]. Preserve [subject, clothing, location, and composition relationships required from the start frame]; add no [likely task-breaking object or text].

Make the verbs one continuous line: who moves, what is contacted, and how the object changes, followed by camera behavior. Avoid combining fast walking, looking back, opening an umbrella, waving, and changing location. Give the camera one purpose. A slow pullback, for example, can keep the opened umbrella and exit readable together. The ending should be drawable as a still rather than merely “ending with emotion.”

heading.zh: 先检查真实首帧，再写运动
heading.en: Inspect the real start image before writing motion

body.zh:
图生视频的起点来自实际上传图片。放大查看主体是谁、身体朝向哪里、双手与物件怎样接触、画面有没有文字、镜头能否容纳下一步动作。提示词不应偷偷修复首帧里已经错误的站位或道具状态；起点不合用时，先换图或修图。

Kling 的图生视频入门指南把输入图片作为场景基础，提示词重点放在主体运动，也可补充背景运动，并建议使用简单、符合图片起点的动作。若提示词要求画面突然变成另一地点或完全不同的姿态，生成过程可能出现明显转场。

本文采用原创纸面案例，没有实际生成或测试：案例的首帧设想是一名穿姜黄色雨衣的成年女子站在河边步道，右手握着一把合拢的红伞，伞尖朝下；身体侧对河面，左手扶栏杆，雨后石路有薄水光。镜头任务是让她撑开伞并转向步道出口。
body.en:
Image-to-video starts from the actual uploaded picture. Zoom in and inspect subject identity, body facing, hand-to-object contact, visible text, and whether the framing has room for the next action. A motion prompt should not silently repair a wrong stance or prop state already present in the image; replace or edit an unsuitable start first.

Kling’s image-to-video guide treats the input image as the scene basis, focuses the prompt on subject movement, optionally adds background movement, and recommends simple motion compatible with the image. Asking for a different place or radically different pose can create a visible cut or transition.

This article uses an original paper plan with no actual generation or test. The imagined start image shows an adult woman in a mustard raincoat on a riverside walkway. Her right hand holds a closed red umbrella pointed down, her body is side-on to the river, and her left hand rests on the railing. The shot will have her open the umbrella and turn toward the walkway exit.

heading.zh: 选择真实首帧，按需再绑定 Element
heading.en: Use the real start frame, then bind an Element if needed

body.zh: VIDEO 3.0 官方指南说明的输入关系是：先上传真实首帧，再按需从 “Bind Subject to Enhance Consistency” 入口绑定另行创建的 Element。它是首帧的补充，普通参考图片未经创建流程不能当作已创建主体。本文先选仅首帧路线；已准备相容主体且账号页面支持绑定时，才选择“首帧加主体”的路线。
body.en: The VIDEO 3.0 guide describes uploading a real start frame, then optionally binding a separately created Element through “Bind Subject to Enhance Consistency.” This supplements the frame; ordinary reference images are not automatically created Elements. Start with the frame-only route here. Choose the frame-plus-subject route only with a compatible prepared subject and an account interface that exposes binding.

heading.zh: 原创案例：从压缩错误改成可复制提示词
heading.en: Original case: repair a compressed prompt

body.zh:
错误写法：“女子走过河边，撑开红伞，回头微笑，镜头环绕她，最后到了街口。”它堆入多个动作，也没有说明开伞过程。保留一个动作：她原地开伞，再转向出口。

> 从真实首帧开始，穿姜黄色雨衣的成年女子保持身体侧对河面，左手扶着金属栏杆，右手握住合拢红伞的直柄，伞尖朝下。她先松开左手离开栏杆，右手把合拢的伞转到伞尖朝上的位置；左手沿伞杆把滑套推向伞顶，右手稳定伞柄，红伞在身体右侧完整撑开；伞面抖落少量水珠，河边细枝受微风轻摆。她把撑开的伞举到头顶，同时身体向步道出口转过四分之一圈，在原地转动双脚，不向出口迈步。镜头平视缓慢后拉，只扩大到能同时看清人物全身、完整伞面和出口方向，不绕到人物背后。结尾停在她面向出口、右手举伞、左手自然垂在身侧的状态，视线沿步道向前。保持姜黄色雨衣、红伞、河边栏杆、湿石路和阴天光线连续；不新增行人、车辆、字幕、标牌或第二把伞。

这段文字不声称已经得到合格视频。它是一次可复制的纸面计划。若实际首帧中她用左手持伞，或出口在另一侧，就先按真实图片改手位与转身方向。
body.en:
Weak version: “A woman walks by the river, opens a red umbrella, looks back and smiles as the camera circles her, finally reaching the street.” It stacks actions and never explains how the umbrella opens. Keep one action: open it in place, then turn toward the exit.

> Begin from the real start frame. The adult woman in a mustard raincoat keeps her body side-on to the river, left hand on the metal railing, and right hand around the straight handle of the closed red umbrella, its tip pointing down. She releases the railing and uses her right hand to turn the closed umbrella tip upward; her left hand slides the runner along the shaft toward the tip while the right hand steadies the handle, and opens the red canopy fully at her right side. A few droplets shake from the canopy and thin riverside branches move lightly in the breeze. She raises the open umbrella overhead and turns her body one quarter toward the walkway exit by pivoting her feet in place, without stepping toward the exit. At eye level, the camera slowly pulls back only far enough to show her full body, the complete canopy, and the exit direction together; it does not travel behind her. End with her facing the exit, right hand holding the umbrella overhead, left arm resting at her side, and gaze following the walkway. Preserve the mustard raincoat, red umbrella, riverside railing, wet stone path, and overcast light. Add no pedestrian, vehicle, subtitle, sign, or second umbrella.

This text is a copyable paper plan, not a claim of a successful clip. If the actual frame shows the umbrella in her left hand or the exit on the opposite side, revise hand use and turning direction to match the image.

heading.zh: 在可灵页面逐项核对再提交
heading.en: Check each input in Kling before submitting

body.zh:
在账号页面选择所需的 VIDEO 3 图生视频输入路线。上传已检查的真实首帧，确认预览显示的是本轮图片，再粘贴运动提示词。若选择了上一节的补充主体路线，先完成对应的主体准备和绑定，再核对当前输入。

提交前逐项核对：

| 核对项 | 本例答案 |
|---|---|
| 起点图片 | 女子、合拢红伞、栏杆和出口方向可见且正确 |
| 主动作 | 先把伞尖转向上方，再开伞，原地转向出口 |
| 运镜 | 平视缓慢后拉，服务于人物、伞面和出口同框 |
| 终点 | 右手举伞，身体面向出口，未离开起点区域 |
| 排除项 | 不新增行人、车辆、文字或第二把伞 |

以实际页面显示的输入与设置完成手工提交。
body.en:
Choose the required VIDEO 3 image-to-video input route in the account interface. Upload the inspected real frame, confirm that its preview shows this run’s image, and paste the motion prompt. If you chose the supplemental-subject route above, finish its preparation and binding before checking the current inputs.

Pre-submit check:

| Check | Answer for this case |
|---|---|
| Start image | Woman, closed red umbrella, railing, and exit direction are visible and correct |
| Main action | Turn the umbrella tip upward, open it, and pivot toward the exit |
| Camera | Eye-level slow pullback to hold person, canopy, and exit together |
| Ending | Right hand holds umbrella overhead; body faces exit without leaving the starting area |
| Exclusions | No pedestrian, vehicle, text, or second umbrella |

Complete the manual submission using the actual inputs and settings shown in the interface.

heading.zh: 用真实视频检查动作与连续性
heading.en: Inspect Motion and Continuity in the Actual Clip

body.zh:
按镜头任务检查返回视频。以下计划尚未执行：

- [ ] 第一帧与上传图片一致，没有先跳到开伞后的姿态。
- [ ] 左手离开栏杆，右手先把伞尖转向上方，再由左手推动滑套，右手持续稳定伞柄，双手没有交换职责。
- [ ] 伞从合拢连续变为撑开，没有出现第二把伞或伞面突变。
- [ ] 人物原地转向出口，双脚只在原地转动，没有向出口迈步。
- [ ] 镜头只缓慢后拉，人物、完整伞面和出口始终可读。
- [ ] 河岸、栏杆、湿石路、雨衣与阴天光线保持连续。
- [ ] 终点可冻结为“右手举伞、面向出口、左臂下垂、视线向前”。

首帧跳变时核对上传图与动作起点；伞或双手失真时缩短动作链并写清接触；运镜抢戏时删掉多余运动。每轮只改一个主要问题。
body.en:
Inspect the returned video against the shot job. This plan has not been executed:

- [ ] The first frame matches the upload instead of jumping to an already-open umbrella.
- [ ] The left hand leaves the railing; the right hand turns the tip upward before the left pushes the runner while the right keeps the handle; hand roles do not swap.
- [ ] The umbrella changes continuously from closed to open without a second umbrella or canopy mutation.
- [ ] The subject turns in place toward the exit; her feet pivot in place without stepping toward it.
- [ ] The camera performs only the slow pullback, keeping person, canopy, and exit readable.
- [ ] Riverbank, railing, wet path, raincoat, and overcast light remain continuous.
- [ ] The ending can freeze as right hand overhead, body toward exit, left arm down, gaze forward.

For an opening jump, compare upload and written start. For hand or umbrella failure, shorten the chain and clarify contact. If camera movement overwhelms the action, remove it. Change one major issue per revision.

q.zh: 一条提示词可以放几个动作？
q.en: How many actions should one prompt contain?

a.zh: 先写一条能从起点连续走到终点的主动作链。开伞需要放开栏杆、调整伞向、推动滑套和举伞，这些接触步骤可以连写；走到街口、回头和挥手若没有镜头职责，就移到另一镜。
a.en: Start with one continuous chain from start to ending. Opening the umbrella needs release, reorientation, runner contact, and lifting; those steps belong together. Walking to the street, looking back, or waving belongs in another shot unless this shot requires it.

q.zh: 提示词需要重复首帧全部外观吗？
q.en: Should the prompt repeat every visible detail from the start frame?

a.zh: 保留会影响动作连续性的身份、服装、持物、空间和光线即可，把主要篇幅留给接触、动作、运镜和终点。上传前仍要检查真实图片。
a.en: Repeat the identity, clothing, held objects, geography, and light needed for continuity, then spend most words on contact, action, camera, and ending. Inspect the real image before upload.

text.zh: 用 $short-drama-video-prompts 为这个已确认镜头写一条可复制的可灵 VIDEO 3 图生视频提示词。实际首帧是 /ABS/start-frame.png；先按图片核对人物朝向、双手、持物、地点和构图。目标动作是[一条连续动作链]，运镜是[一个主要运镜]，终点是[可冻结状态]。按已选手工输入计划写正文，只写提示词，不生成媒体；我会在可灵页面核对输入并手工提交，再检查真实结果。
text.en: Use $short-drama-video-prompts to write one copyable Kling VIDEO 3 image-to-video prompt for this accepted shot. The actual start frame is /ABS/start-frame.png; first inspect body facing, hands, held object, location, and composition. The main action is [one continuous chain], the camera is [one primary move], and the ending is [a freezeable state]. Follow the selected manual input plan and write the prompt only; generate no media. I will check inputs and submit manually in Kling, then inspect the actual result.

label.zh: 短剧图生视频提示词的真实图片、动作与起终点边界
label.en: Real-image, motion, and boundary rules for short-drama video prompts

label.zh: Kling AI 图生视频提示入门
Kling VIDEO 3.0 模型用户指南

title.zh: 网文扫榜怎么做：从榜单样本到可验证的开书方向
title.en: How to Scan Web-Fiction Charts: From Ranking Samples to a Testable Book Direction

seo_title.zh: 网文扫榜怎么做：从榜单样本到选题验证
seo_title.en: How to Scan Web-Fiction Charts for a Testable Book Idea

description.zh: 扫榜不是照抄排名靠前的书。按来源顺序收样本，单本当线索、重复模式写成观察，再推读者画像和一个带风险与验证动作的开书方向。附原创手抄样本表示例。
description.en: Read chart samples for repeated patterns: single titles are leads, repeats are observations. Turn them into a reader profile and a testable book direction.

answer.zh: 网文扫榜是读平台榜单和推荐样本，找出题材、主角人设、开篇切入点这些反复出现的模式。先定平台和方向，再按“采集脚本、自己提供的榜单、内置知识”的顺序取样本，用内置知识时要标明只是候选假设。单本排名只是线索，多本、跨榜单重复的模式才写成观察；“读者为什么追”先当假设，并写出下一步怎么验证。最后把观察和你的素材、篇幅、目标平台放在一起，得到 2–3 个带可行性、失败风险和验证动作的候选方向，写哪个由你决定。
answer.en: Chart scanning (扫榜) means reading ranking and recommendation samples to find patterns that keep recurring: genre, protagonist setup, opening angle. Fix the platform and direction first, then gather samples in this order: a platform collector, rankings you supply, and built-in knowledge only as a last resort that is labeled a candidate hypothesis. A single title’s rank is a lead; only patterns repeated across several titles and charts count as observations. Treat “why readers follow it” as a hypothesis and name the next check. Finally, set the observations against your material, planned length and target platform to get two or three candidate directions, each with a feasibility rating, failure risks and a validation step. Which one to write is your call.

heading.zh: 扫榜先收哪些样本：来源顺序与记录字段
heading.en: What to Collect: Source Priority and Fields to Record

body.zh:
先定两件事：看哪个平台，有没有已经关注的方向。有方向就围绕它深挖，没有就先看全榜概览，想比较平台就各扫一份。

| 优先级 | 样本来源 | 用法与限制 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 平台采集脚本 | 需联网；起点默认不用 Chrome，番茄、晋江、七猫、刺猬猫要先用 `/browser-cdp` 启动 Chrome；页面改版或被验证页拦住会采不到 |
| 2 | 作者提供的榜单 | 粘贴文字、截图或给链接，整理成统一格式后一样汇总 |
| 3 | 内置知识 | 只在无法联网、也没有数据时用；报告注明这是历史趋势，未经实时榜单校验只能当候选假设，并列出要复扫的榜单 |

新书榜看新题材、新风向的早期信号，阅读榜、月票榜、畅销榜、金榜这类看已经形成的流量和付费认可，两类搭配着取。每本至少记榜单名、日期、名次、书名、题材、状态、字数、热度（注明在读、收藏还是月票）和简介开头的标签。每次扫榜单独存一份带日期的记录，不往旧记录里追加；哪张榜没取到，结论里写明不含它。
body.en:
First settle two things: which platform, and whether you already have a direction in mind. With a direction, dig into it; without one, start with an overview of the whole chart; to compare platforms, scan each one separately.

| Priority | Sample source | Use and limits |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Platform collector scripts | Need network access. Qidian works without Chrome by default; Fanqie, Jinjiang, Qimao and Ciweimao need Chrome launched with `/browser-cdp` first. A redesigned page or a verification wall can stop collection |
| 2 | Rankings the author supplies | Paste text, screenshots or links; they are put into one format and aggregated the same way |
| 3 | Built-in knowledge | Only when there is no network and no data. The report says this is historical trend data, usable only as a candidate hypothesis until checked against live charts, and lists the charts to rescan |

New-book charts give early signals of new genres and shifts; reading, monthly-ticket, best-seller and “gold” charts show traffic and paid support that already exist. Take both kinds. For each title, record at least the chart name, date, position, title, genre, status, word count, heat with its unit (readers, favorites or monthly tickets) and the tags at the start of the blurb. Save each scan as its own dated record rather than appending to an old one. If a chart could not be collected, say the conclusion leaves it out.

heading.zh: 单本排名只是线索，重复出现才算信号
heading.en: A Single Rank Is a Lead; Repetition Is the Signal

body.zh:
榜单只能证明某本书在那里，证明不了需求有多强。story-long-scan 的规则是：单本上榜只记为个例；同类样本跨榜单、跨作者重复出现，才标成趋势候选。

- **数量够不够**：同一方向不到 15 本（刺猬猫这类小平台不到 10 本），汇总会标「少」，即数据稀疏，后面的可行性不能给「高」。
- **分布广不广**：只在一张榜、一位作者身上出现的组合先当线索；新书榜和阅读类榜单都有，比只在一张榜上更有说服力。
- **口径同不同**：番茄看流量和完读率，起点看订阅和追读，晋江看收藏和积分。不同平台、不同榜单的数字不横比。

找到的新东西再分级：新题材极少，要有跨榜单、跨作者的重复样本才标趋势；新金手指多是翻新，适合低成本试，但要换题材外壳和情绪触发方式；新噱头最常见，同质化风险高，没有差异化机制就降低优先级。
body.en:
A chart proves only that a book is there, not how strong demand is. The rule in story-long-scan: one title on a chart is an isolated case; only when similar samples repeat across charts and authors does a pattern become a trend candidate.

- **Enough samples?** If a direction has fewer than 15 titles (fewer than 10 on a small platform such as Ciweimao), the aggregate marks it “few”, meaning sparse data, and feasibility cannot later be rated high.
- **Spread wide enough?** A combination seen on one chart or from one author is a lead. Appearing on both new-book and reading-type charts is more persuasive than one chart.
- **Same unit?** Fanqie measures traffic and completion, Qidian subscriptions and ongoing readership, Jinjiang favorites and points. Do not compare numbers across platforms or across charts.

Then grade anything new. New genres are rare and count as a trend only with repeated samples across charts and authors. New golden fingers (protagonist advantages) are mostly refreshes; they suit low-cost tests but need a different genre shell and emotional trigger. New gimmicks are the most common and carry a high risk of sameness; without a differentiating mechanism, lower their priority.

heading.zh: 把结论分成观察、线索、假设和下一步验证
heading.en: Sort Every Conclusion: Observation, Lead, Hypothesis, Next Check

body.zh:
从汇总里依次看题材分布与本数、字数区间、书名常见词、标签热词和代表作简介里的开篇卖点，再对候选方向抽几条原始条目，找新的人设、开篇切入点和桥段。有上一次的汇总才写上升、稳定或下降，没有就只写现状。看完后，每条结论放进一栏：

| 栏目 | 写什么 | 要求 |
|---|---|---|
| 观察 | 多个样本都支持的重复模式 | 写清几本、来自哪些榜 |
| 线索 | 只有一本或只在一张榜出现的新组合 | 记下，下次扫榜再看 |
| 假设 | 读者为什么追、你的版本能否成立 | 标“待验证”，不写成“会火” |
| 下一步验证 | 确认或推翻假设的具体动作 | 补样本、拆代表作、试写开头 |

参考同类简介时只提取功能位：问题、利益点、爽点预告、安全感、悬念，不复刻具体剧情和表达。
body.en:
In the aggregate, look in turn at genre distribution and counts, word-count ranges, common title words, hot tags and the opening hooks in representative blurbs. Then pull a few raw entries for a candidate direction to spot new character setups, opening angles and set pieces. Write “rising”, “steady” or “falling” only if you have an earlier scan to compare; otherwise describe the present. Then put each conclusion in one column:

| Column | What goes in | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| Observation | A repeated pattern that several samples support | Say how many titles and which charts |
| Lead | A new combination seen in one title or on one chart | Note it; check again next scan |
| Hypothesis | Why readers follow it; whether your version can work | Mark it “to verify”, never “will be a hit” |
| Next check | A concrete action that confirms or refutes it | More samples, a breakdown of a representative book, a trial opening |

When studying blurbs in the same lane, take only the functional slots: the problem, the benefit, a preview of the payoff, reassurance and suspense. Do not copy specific plot or wording.

heading.zh: 从样本推读者画像：有依据才写，没依据写未知
heading.en: Reader Profile: Write What the Samples Support, Mark the Rest Unknown

body.zh:
画像按九个维度写：平台、标签、阅读量、性别、年龄、地域、学历、阶层、社会角色。标签决定读者预期，看到“系统文”就期待升级节奏；阶层决定什么样的逆袭有共鸣；社会角色决定什么样的日常有代入感。

找共鸣素材用 70/20/10：七成是读者有过的经历，如代际记忆、校园、童年；两成是正在面对的压力，如工作、感情、经济；一成是当下热点。每一维都写依据来自哪几条样本，样本说不出的维度写“未知”，不凭印象补。
body.en:
The profile uses nine dimensions: platform, tags, reading volume, gender, age, region, education, class and social role. Tags set expectations: a “system” tag promises a levelling rhythm. Class decides which kind of comeback resonates; social role decides which daily life feels like the reader’s own.

For resonant material, use 70/20/10: 70% experiences readers have had, such as generational memories, school and childhood; 20% pressures they face now, such as work, relationships and money; 10% current hot topics. For every dimension, note which samples support it. Where the samples say nothing, write “unknown” instead of filling in an impression.

heading.zh: 原创示例：从手抄样本表到一个待验证方向
heading.en: Original Example: From a Hand-Copied Sample Table to a Direction Worth Testing

body.zh:
以下全部虚构：编号代替书名，不对应任何真实作品、名次或平台数据；表格是假想作者的手写简表，不是 skill 的输出。

作者帮家里的县城家电维修店跑过几年上门，想写都市日常长篇，目标平台已定。没有采集环境，就从新书榜和阅读榜手抄这个方向的 8 条，表头记下榜单名和日期，下表只留和判断有关的列。

| 编号 | 来源 | 简介标签 | 开篇切入点 | 回报方式 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A1 | 新书榜 | 经营、日常 | 失业回乡，接手快关门的修车铺 | 修好一单，解锁一位熟客 |
| A2 | 新书榜 | 经营、系统 | 接手外婆的早餐摊，开张当天欠着房租 | 顾客好评换奖励 |
| A3 | 新书榜 | 日常、手艺 | 被裁员后接手老街钟表铺 | 修好旧表，委托人介绍新客 |
| A4 | 阅读榜 | 种田、美食 | 回村承包鱼塘 | 签到奖励 |
| A5 | 阅读榜 | 经营、系统 | 接手师傅留下的配钥匙摊 | 每开一把锁得一次奖励 |
| A6 | 阅读榜 | 都市、系统 | 退伍回乡开农家乐 | 任务奖励 |
| A7 | 新书榜 | 经营、悬疑 | 接手舅舅的旧货店，第一单收到来历不明的箱子 | 旧物牵出旧案 |
| A8 | 阅读榜 | 日常、群像 | 在城中村接手五金店 | 没有金手指，靠邻里人情 |

| 栏目 | 内容 | 依据 |
|---|---|---|
| 观察 | 开篇多是接手一家现成的店或摊，两张榜都有 | A1、A2、A3、A5、A7、A8 |
| 观察 | 回报来得快，完成一单或一项任务就有奖励或熟客 | A1、A2、A3、A5、A6 |
| 线索 | 失业、裁员、欠租的开局压力 | 只在新书榜：A1–A3 |
| 线索 | 经营加悬疑；不靠金手指、只靠人情 | 各一本：A7、A8 |
| 假设 | 读者追的是“一单一结”的确定回报和慢慢变大的熟人网 | 待拆文验证 |

画像只写样本撑得住的：标签以经营、日常为主，读者预期每单有结果；回乡、老街、城中村可接七成怀旧素材；两成当前压力只有新书榜三条，先当假设；热点、性别、年龄、学历没有依据，留空或写“未知”。

候选方向：**县城维修铺，上门修一台旧电器，就卷进一户人家的一件难事。**

- 题材组合：都市日常加经营；按“85% 熟悉 + 15% 惊喜”，沿用接手小店的开局，新意放在上门
- 回报方式：每修好一单，换来一位回头客或一条新的上门线索
- 差异化：样本里店是舞台，这里冲突发生在客户家；配件、旧机型和上门规矩来自作者亲历
- 可行性：中。同方向只有 8 条，会标「少」；没有上次扫榜可比，趋势只写现状；素材够撑开篇，撑不撑长线未验证
- 失败风险：接手小店的开局太多，首章只写接手会被淹没；不用系统时回报可能偏慢，明确不靠金手指的样本只有 A8；上门单元容易重复成“修好、道谢”
- 验证动作（计划，尚未执行）：下次扫榜把同方向补到 15 条以上，留意无系统样本和扑街、烂尾的反例；拆 A5、A8 的前三章（一本有系统、一本没有）检验“一单一结”；列上门单元清单，看后面的单元是否还在换冲突，而不只是换电器

这张卡只是候选：作者可以加轻量系统、改走悬疑或放弃；样本补够之前，按 skill 的规则它不能评「高」。
body.en:
Everything here is invented. Codes such as A1 replace titles and match no real book, position or platform data. The table is an imaginary author’s hand-made sheet, not the skill’s output.

The author spent a few years doing house calls for the family’s appliance-repair shop in a county town and wants to write a long novel of everyday urban life for a platform already chosen. With no collector set up, the author copies 8 entries in this direction by hand from the new-book and reading charts, noting chart names and dates in the header. The table keeps only the columns this judgment needs.

| No. | Chart | Blurb tags | Opening angle | Reward pattern |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A1 | New-book | business, daily life | Jobless and back home, takes over a failing car-repair shop | Each fixed job unlocks a regular customer |
| A2 | New-book | business, system | Takes over grandmother’s breakfast stall, behind on rent on opening day | Good reviews earn rewards |
| A3 | New-book | daily life, craft | Laid off, takes over a watch-repair shop on an old street | Each repaired watch brings a referral |
| A4 | Reading | farming, food | Goes back to the village to lease a fish pond | Daily check-in rewards |
| A5 | Reading | business, system | Takes over a key-cutting stall left by a mentor | Each opened lock earns a reward |
| A6 | Reading | urban, system | Leaves the army and opens a farm guesthouse | Quest rewards |
| A7 | New-book | business, mystery | Takes over an uncle’s junk shop; the first deal brings a box of unknown origin | Old objects lead to old cases |
| A8 | Reading | daily life, ensemble | Takes over a hardware shop in an urban village | No golden finger, only neighbors’ goodwill |

| Column | Content | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| Observation | Most openings take over an existing shop or stall, on both charts | A1, A2, A3, A5, A7, A8 |
| Observation | Rewards come fast: finishing a job or task brings a reward or a regular | A1, A2, A3, A5, A6 |
| Lead | Opening pressure from job loss, layoffs or overdue rent | New-book chart only: A1–A3 |
| Lead | Business plus mystery; goodwill instead of a golden finger | One title each: A7, A8 |
| Hypothesis | Readers follow for the reliable “one job, one payoff” return and a growing circle of familiar faces | To verify by breaking down books |

The profile covers only what the samples support. Tags lean to business and daily life, so readers expect each job to resolve. Hometowns, old streets and urban villages can feed the 70% of nostalgic material. The 20% of current pressure rests on three new-book entries only, so it stays a hypothesis. Hot topics, gender, age and education have no basis and stay blank or “unknown”.

Candidate direction: **a county-town repair shop where every house call to fix an old appliance pulls the repairer into one household’s trouble.**

- Genre mix: urban daily life plus business. Following “85% familiar, 15% surprise”, keep the familiar takeover opening and put the novelty in the house calls
- Reward: each repaired job brings a returning customer or a lead to the next house call
- Difference: in the samples the shop is the stage; here the conflict happens in the customer’s home, and the parts, old models and house-call etiquette come from the author’s own work
- Feasibility: medium. Only 8 samples in this direction, so the aggregate would mark it “few”; with no earlier scan, the trend can only describe the present; the material covers the opening, but whether it can carry a long book is untested
- Failure risks: takeover openings are crowded, so a first chapter that only covers the takeover will sink; without a system, rewards may feel slow, and A8 is the only sample that clearly has no golden finger; house-call units can repeat as “fixed it, got thanked”
- Validation (planned, not yet done): on the next scan, bring this direction to 15 or more samples and look for system-free titles and counterexamples that flopped or were abandoned; break down the first three chapters of A5 and A8 (one with a system, one without) to test the “one job, one payoff” hypothesis; list house-call units and check whether later ones still change the conflict rather than just the appliance

This card is only a candidate: the author may add a light system, lean toward mystery or drop it. Until the sample is large enough, the skill’s rules do not allow a high rating.

heading.zh: 扫榜结果怎样进入选题，又不替你做决定
heading.en: How the Scan Feeds a Topic Decision Without Making It for You

body.zh:
扫榜报告写给作者，讲市场结论和能写的方向，同时存进本次扫榜目录的 `选题决策.md`；只扫榜、暂不选题，结论也已落盘。

要选题时，skill 先问目标平台、已有素材、擅长题材或写作约束、计划篇幅，每个推荐选题再走四步：

1. **能爆的原因先当假设**：只从重复样本推，标“待拆文验证”。
2. **市场验证**：同方向几本、趋势如何、有没有扑街或烂尾的反例。
3. **差异化定位**：你的优势对上市场缺口，说清你的版本和榜上作品有什么不同。
4. **可行性、失败风险和验证动作**：样本不足不给「高」，只用内置知识时一律给「中」。常见验证是先写[黄金三章](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/novel-opening)看追读，不行就换。

推荐只给 2–3 个，素材撑不住的方向不列。[拆文](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/learn-from-fiction)之后回填“能爆的原因”；开书时 story-long-write 可读这份文件作起点，项目在同一文件夹或同级时会自动找到并请你确认。选哪个、怎么改、要不要全部放弃，由你决定。
body.en:
The scan report is written for the author, covering market conclusions and directions you could write, and is saved to `选题决策.md` (the topic-decision file) in this scan’s folder. A scan that stops short of choosing a topic still leaves its findings on disk.

When you want topics, the skill first asks for your target platform, existing material, strengths or writing constraints, and planned length. Each recommended topic then goes through four steps:

1. **Why it could take off, as a hypothesis**: inferred only from repeated samples and marked “to verify by breakdown”.
2. **Market check**: how many titles share the direction, the trend, and any counterexamples that flopped or were abandoned.
3. **Differentiation**: match your strengths to a gap in the market and say how your version differs from what is on the chart.
4. **Feasibility, failure risk and validation**: no “high” without enough samples, and “medium” for every direction when only built-in knowledge was used. A common check is to write the [first three chapters](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/novel-opening), see whether readers keep following, and switch if they do not.

It recommends two or three and leaves out directions your material cannot support. After a [book breakdown](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/learn-from-fiction), the “why it could take off” line gets filled in. When you start the book, story-long-write can read this file as its starting point; if the project sits in the same folder or next to it, it finds the file and asks you to confirm. Which one to write, how to change it and whether to drop them all is your decision.

q.zh: 没有采集脚本或 Chrome，还能扫榜吗？
q.en: Can I scan charts without a collector or Chrome?

a.zh: 能。把目标榜单的文字、截图或链接交给 skill，它会整理成统一格式再汇总；也可以像上面的示例一样手抄。两者都没有时才用内置知识，报告会标明只是候选假设，所有方向的可行性一律给「中」。
a.en: Yes. Give the skill the chart text, screenshots or links and it puts them into one format and aggregates them; you can also copy entries by hand, as in the example. Only with neither does it fall back to built-in knowledge, which the report labels a candidate hypothesis, with every direction rated medium.

q.zh: 扫榜要看多少本才够？
q.en: How many titles are enough?

a.zh: skill 的门槛是同方向 15 本，刺猬猫这类小平台 10 本；不到就标「少」，可行性最高给「中」。够数只说明样本不稀疏，还要看趋势、反例和你的素材撑不撑得住。
a.en: The skill’s threshold is 15 titles per direction, or 10 on a small platform such as Ciweimao. Below that the aggregate marks it “few” and feasibility tops out at medium. Reaching the number only means the sample is not sparse; the trend, counterexamples and your own material still decide.

q.zh: 扫榜和拆书有什么区别？
q.en: How is chart scanning different from breaking down a book?

a.zh: 扫榜横着看很多本，找重复模式和候选方向；拆书竖着读一本，从原文取证据和可迁移的机制。扫榜推出的“能爆的原因”只是假设，要靠拆代表作回填，做法见[小说拆书怎么拆](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/learn-from-fiction)。
a.en: Scanning looks across many titles for repeated patterns and candidate directions; a breakdown reads one book closely for textual evidence and transferable mechanics. The “why it could take off” that a scan produces is a hypothesis, filled in by breaking down representative books; see [how to break down a novel](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/learn-from-fiction).

text.zh: 用 $story-long-scan 扫我选定平台上的这个方向：优先用可用的采集脚本，没有就用我提供的榜单，内置知识只作标明的降级来源。单本只记线索，结论分成观察、假设和下一步验证，写清样本数和来源榜单；同方向不足 15 本（小平台 10 本）可行性最高给「中」。再按我的素材、篇幅和目标平台给 2–3 个候选方向，各附失败风险和验证动作；由我选择，不写正文。
text.en: Use $story-long-scan to scan this direction on the platform I chose. Use an available collector first, otherwise the rankings I supply, and built-in knowledge only as a labeled fallback. Treat a single title as a lead; split conclusions into observations, hypotheses and next checks, with sample counts and source charts. With fewer than 15 titles in a direction (10 on a small platform), cap feasibility at medium. Then suggest two or three candidate directions that fit my material, planned length and target platform, each with failure risks and a validation step. I choose; do not write prose.

title.zh: 短篇小说选题怎么找：用榜单样本对上自己的长处
title.en: How to Find a Short-Story Topic: Match Ranking Samples to Your Strengths

seo_title.zh: 短篇小说选题怎么找：扫榜样本与选题匹配
seo_title.en: Choosing a Short-Story Topic from Ranking Samples

description.zh: 把盐言式短篇榜单抄成样本文件，读出情绪与题材信号，再和自己的素材交叉成候选方向；附原创扫榜范例和第一次验证。
description.en: Copy a short-fiction chart into samples, read its emotion and genre signals, and match them to your own material. Original scan and first check included.

answer.zh: 短篇选题先看样本，再对照自己。用 `$story-short-scan` 时，点众、黑岩可以用脚本采集（需要 Chrome，黑岩还要登录作者后台）；知乎盐言、番茄短篇、七猫短篇没有脚本，要你提供榜单截图或文字，整理成固定格式后再聚合；都拿不到时只能用历史参考，结论只算候选假设。从聚合表读出反复出现的情绪、题材、开头和篇幅，再和你的素材、能力交叉，得到 2–3 个写明目标情绪、开头钩子、传播引擎、可行性和验证动作的候选。样本少时可行性最高只到“中”；写哪个由你决定，结果不预测成绩，过了复扫日期只当参考。
answer.en: Look at the samples first, then at yourself. With `$story-short-scan`, Dianzhong and Heiyan can be collected by script (Chrome is required, and Heiyan also needs you logged in to its author back end). Zhihu Yanyan, Fanqie short fiction and Qimao short fiction have no collector, so you supply ranking screenshots or text, which are put into a fixed format and aggregated. If neither is possible, only historical reference material remains and every conclusion is a candidate hypothesis. From the aggregate, read the recurring emotions, genres, openings and lengths, then cross them with your material and abilities to get two or three candidates, each stating target emotion, opening hook, sharing engine, feasibility and a validation step. With thin samples, feasibility tops out at medium. You decide what to write; the result predicts no performance, and after its re-scan date it is reference only.

heading.zh: 样本从哪来：三种来源各有边界
heading.en: Where Samples Come From, and the Limits of Each Source

body.zh:
`$story-short-scan` 先问看哪个平台、有没有想写的方向：有方向就深扫，没有就做全榜概览，想比较就做平台对比。数据来源按环境选：

| 来源 | 适用与限制 |
|---|---|
| 脚本采集 | 点众、黑岩，需先用 `/browser-cdp` 启动 Chrome。黑岩还要你在浏览器里登录作者后台；它的书库列表没有热度字段，只能按列表顺序取代表作，可信度低一档。采集失败就跳过，报告注明结论不含它 |
| 作者提供 | 知乎盐言、番茄短篇、七猫短篇等没有脚本的平台：发截图、复制的文字或链接，链接抓不到就改发截图或文字 |
| 内置知识 | 无法联网、你也没有榜单时才用。参考来自历史样本，报告须声明只是候选假设，并列出要复扫的平台页面 |

写盐言式短篇，多半要自己抄样本。这里的[扫榜](https://zenstory.ai/glossary/saobang)是找一批样本里反复出现的模式，不是盯着某一本的名次。
body.en:
`$story-short-scan` first asks which platform you want and whether you already have a direction. With a direction it scans that direction in depth; without one it surveys the whole list; for a comparison it compares platforms. The data source depends on the environment:

| Source | Use and limits |
|---|---|
| Script collection | Dianzhong and Heiyan, after Chrome is started with `/browser-cdp`. Heiyan also needs you to log in to its author back end in that browser; its library list has no popularity field, so representative titles follow list order and confidence drops a level. A failed platform is skipped and the report says its conclusions exclude it |
| Author-supplied | Platforms without a collector, such as Zhihu Yanyan, Fanqie short fiction and Qimao short fiction: send screenshots, copied text or a link, and switch to screenshots or text if the link cannot be fetched |
| Built-in knowledge | Only when there is no web access and you have no ranking. The reference comes from historical samples, so the report must call it a candidate hypothesis and list the platform pages to re-scan |

For Yanyan-style short fiction you will usually copy the samples yourself. [Chart scanning](https://zenstory.ai/glossary/saobang) here means finding patterns that repeat across a set of samples, not fixating on one title's rank.

heading.zh: 没有采集脚本时，怎样把榜单抄成样本
heading.en: No Collector? Copy the Ranking into a Sample File

body.zh:
提供榜单时尽量带上书名、作者、题材/标签、字数、热度（赞同、收藏、在读都行）和简介；只有故事名也能分析，但可信度低一档。skill 会整理成[手动榜单格式](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/79b2970096d91d2771915dc3f9270e807c6c97c3/skills/story-short-scan/references/manual-rank-input.md)：

> `# 知乎盐言 · 热门榜`
> `### #1 {书名}`
> `*{作者} · {题材} · {状态} · {字数}字 · {热度数字}收藏*`
> `**标签：** {标签1}、{标签2}`
> `> {简介}`

热度写成“数字 + 口径”（参考文件的例子是 `2.3万收藏`），聚合才认得；缺的字段直接省略，不要补编。

文件存进本次新建的 `扫榜/{YYYYMMDD}/` 目录，再聚合成 `扫榜聚合.md`：按平台、题材列出本数、占比、热度与字数中位、高频标签，同题材少于 10 本标“少”。后续分析只读这张聚合表，需要时再按题材或标签词抽几条原始条目。
body.en:
When you supply a ranking, include title, author, genre or tags, word count, popularity (upvotes, saves or current readers all work) and blurb where you can. A bare list of titles can still be analysed, at one level lower confidence. The skill puts your material into the [manual ranking format](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/79b2970096d91d2771915dc3f9270e807c6c97c3/skills/story-short-scan/references/manual-rank-input.md):

> `# 知乎盐言 · 热门榜`
> `### #1 {title}`
> `*{author} · {genre} · {status} · {count}字 · {number}收藏*`
> `**标签：** {tag 1}、{tag 2}`
> `> {blurb}`

Keep the Chinese markers (字 = characters, 收藏 = saves, 标签 = tags), because the aggregation script reads them. Write popularity as number plus metric (the reference file's example is `2.3万收藏`, 23,000 saves) so aggregation recognises it, and omit a missing field instead of inventing it.

Save the file in a new `扫榜/{YYYYMMDD}/` folder for this scan, then aggregate it into `扫榜聚合.md`: for each platform and genre it lists count, share, median popularity and length, and frequent tags, and marks any genre with fewer than 10 titles as “少” (thin). Later analysis reads only this aggregate and pulls a few raw entries by genre or tag when it needs them.

heading.zh: 从样本里读什么：先读情绪，再读题材
heading.en: What to Read in the Samples: Emotion Before Genre

body.zh:
这个 skill 把短篇市场当作情绪市场：读者在短时间内完成一次情绪体验，作品靠完读和分享、收藏、点赞传播。所以扫榜除了题材名，还记高频情绪、触发场景、爆发点和让人想转发的地方。

从聚合表看七项：情绪类型分布、反复出现的设定和场景、篇幅、开头模式、结尾是 HE/BE 还是开放式、书名常见词、主角类型，开头和结尾靠抽样看。盐言这类平台还可以看高赞故事的结构、非头部作者上榜时的题材与开篇、读者愿意为哪些题材付费、热门标签的变化。

三条判断贯穿始终：情绪拉扯力比题材新鲜更重要；开头三句是留存高风险区，要建立冲突、身份差或情绪钩子；反转是常见的传播引擎，不用反转就要靠强共鸣、强话题或强余韵补上。结论写成给作者看的报告，写明样本量、来源和建议复扫日期，不写脚本名和采集状态。
body.en:
The skill treats short fiction as an emotion market: readers finish one emotional experience in a short sitting, and a story spreads through completion and through shares, saves and likes. So besides genre names, the scan records frequent emotions, triggering situations, emotional peaks and the moments readers want to pass on.

From the aggregate it reads seven things: emotion types, recurring setups and situations, length, opening patterns, ending type (happy, sad or open), common title words and protagonist types, with openings and endings checked by sampling. On a Yanyan-style platform it can also look at the structure of highly upvoted stories, the genres and openings of less established authors who reach the list, which genres readers pay for, and how popular tags shift.

Three judgments run throughout. Emotional pull matters more than genre novelty. The first three sentences are the highest retention risk and must set up conflict, a status gap or an emotional hook. Reversal is a common sharing engine; without one, strong resonance, a strong talking point or a strong aftertaste has to make up for it. The conclusion is a report for the author that states sample size, sources and a suggested re-scan date, and leaves out script names and collection status.

heading.zh: 选题匹配：样本强信号 × 你撑得住的素材
heading.en: Topic Matching: Strong Signals × Material You Can Sustain

body.zh:
写完结论，skill 先重读结论文件和聚合表，不靠对话记忆，再结合你给的项目条件做匹配。优先候选是交叉点：当前样本里的强信号，加上你的素材和能力撑得住。反转、打脸结构清晰、验证成本低，算低复杂度；悬疑、虐恋需要伏笔、反转和情绪控制的证据，算高复杂度。

每个方向按[选题匹配模板](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/79b2970096d91d2771915dc3f9270e807c6c97c3/skills/story-short-scan/references/topic-match.md)写八项：目标情绪、题材与设定、开头钩子、传播引擎、复杂度、可行性、篇幅/平台、开写前的低成本验证动作；一般 2–3 个，可行性高的在前。可行性有硬上限：聚合表标“少”、样本不到 10 篇或只有你给的故事名列表，都不能给“高”；只用内置知识时一律给“中”。

结果写进 `短篇扫榜结论.md`，文件头记扫榜日期、复扫日期（通常是扫榜后 2–4 周）和数据来源，重扫时整节替换。`/story-short-write` 定目标情绪时会读它，所以把小说项目建在扫榜文件夹里或与它同级，否则把这份文件复制到项目根。
body.en:
After the conclusion is written, the skill rereads the conclusion file and the aggregate rather than relying on chat memory, then matches them against the project conditions you give. Priority goes to the intersection: a strong signal in the current samples that your material and abilities can support. Reversal and comeuppance stories have clear structures and are cheap to validate, so they count as low complexity; suspense and heartbreak need evidence of foreshadowing, reversal and emotional control, so they count as high complexity.

Each direction follows the [topic-matching template](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/79b2970096d91d2771915dc3f9270e807c6c97c3/skills/story-short-scan/references/topic-match.md) with eight fields: target emotion, genre and setup, opening hook, sharing engine, complexity, feasibility, length and platform, and a low-cost validation step before drafting. Two or three directions are typical, most feasible first. Feasibility has hard caps: if the aggregate marks the group “少”, the sample has fewer than 10 titles, or it is only a list of titles you supplied, feasibility cannot be “high”; built-in-knowledge mode is always “medium”.

The result goes into `短篇扫榜结论.md`, whose header records the scan date, the re-scan date (usually two to four weeks later) and the data source; a re-run replaces whole sections. `/story-short-write` reads this file when it sets the target emotion, so create your story project inside the scan folder or beside it, or else copy the file to the project root.

heading.zh: 原创范例：前房产中介的一次手动扫榜
heading.en: Original Example: A Former Housing Agent Scans a Ranking by Hand

body.zh:
以下作者、样本条目、书名和数字均为本文虚构，不代表任何平台的真实榜单。

**作者条件**：做过五年二手房中介，熟悉带看、定金和挂牌记录；家庭对话写得快，不擅长多线诡计；想写一万字左右的盐言式短篇，还没有方向。

**样本**：她从热门榜两张截图里抄出 14 条，都有题材和标签，多数带简介；9 条看得见收藏数，5 条被截断，热度就空着。其中一条：

> `### #6 弟弟婚房写了谁的名`
> `*青檐 · 家庭 · 已完结 · 11000字 · 4200收藏*`
> `**标签：** 家庭、反转`
> `> 爸妈说房子写弟弟的名字是为了好贷款，我在抽屉里翻到另一份协议。`

聚合后她手工归并成下表（她的笔记，不是脚本原样输出）：

| 方向 | 条数 | 反复出现的东西 |
|---|---|---|
| 家庭算计后反转 | 5 | 房和钱，亲戚的说法与凭证对不上 |
| 虐恋意难平 | 4 | 迟到的真相 |
| 职业细节悬疑 | 3 | 行业规矩里的破绽 |
| 沙雕脑洞 | 2 | 一条荒诞规则 |

每组都少于 10 本、标“少”，没有方向能拿“高”。

**选题匹配**按模板填出两个方向（示意）。方向 1，中介视角的卖房反转：目标情绪从愤怒到解气，留一点温情；开头钩子是舅舅要她压价急卖外婆的老房，系统里却显示外婆本人三个月前挂过这套房；传播引擎是旧记录被重新解释；复杂度低；可行性中（同方向 5 篇，素材撑得住）；验证动作是先写导语和前三句。方向 2，带看时发现房内异常的职业悬疑：复杂度高，可行性低，样本只有 3 篇，又压在她的弱项上。虐恋组没有她的素材，未列入。

**她的选择**：方向 2 更新鲜，她还是选了方向 1。这是她的决定，匹配只提供排序和理由。

**第一次验证**：她写下前三句——“舅舅让我把外婆的房子挂出去，比市价低两成，越快越好。我登进系统，这套房三个月前已经挂过一次。挂牌人是外婆，备注栏只写了一句话。”冲突、她的双重身份和钩子都在三句内出现。她抽出同方向 5 条原始条目读简介，4 条从饭桌争吵写起，于是保留从挂牌记录切入。写导语时她发现，结尾的解气只靠外婆当众训话，便改成“我”以经纪人身份拒接这单、要求外婆本人到场确认，舅舅的计划因此卡住。

已经发生的只有这些：正文还没写，读者反应无从得知；复扫定在三周后，到时再看这个方向是否还在样本里。
body.en:
The author, sample entries, titles and numbers below are invented for this article and do not represent any platform's actual ranking.

**The author's conditions:** five years as a second-hand housing agent, familiar with viewings, deposits and listing records; quick at family dialogue, weak at puzzles with several interlocking clue lines; wants to write a Yanyan-style short story of about 10,000 characters and has no direction yet.

**The samples:** from two screenshots of a popular list she copies 14 entries. All have genre and tags and most have a blurb; nine show a save count, five are cropped, so their popularity stays empty. One entry:

> `### #6 弟弟婚房写了谁的名`
> `*青檐 · 家庭 · 已完结 · 11000字 · 4200收藏*`
> `**标签：** 家庭、反转`
> `> 爸妈说房子写弟弟的名字是为了好贷款，我在抽屉里翻到另一份协议。`

(Title: “Whose Name Is on My Brother's Wedding Flat”; genre: family; tags: family, reversal. Blurb: my parents say the flat is in my brother's name to make the mortgage easier, then I find a different agreement in a drawer.)

After aggregation she groups the result by hand. The table is her note, not the script's output:

| Direction | Count | What recurs |
|---|---|---|
| Family scheming, then reversal | 5 | Property and money; relatives' claims don't match the records |
| Heartbreak, lingering regret | 4 | A truth that arrives too late |
| Professional-detail suspense | 3 | A flaw hidden in trade rules |
| Absurd comedy | 2 | One ridiculous rule |

Every group has fewer than 10 titles and is marked “少”, so no direction can be rated “high”.

**Topic matching** fills in two directions using the template (illustrative). Direction 1, a property-sale reversal seen through an agent's eyes: the target emotion moves from anger to satisfaction with some warmth left over; the opening hook is her uncle asking her to underprice and rush-sell her grandmother's old flat while the system shows the grandmother herself listed it three months ago; the sharing engine is an old record reinterpreted; complexity low; feasibility medium (five samples in this direction, and her material can sustain it); validation is to write the blurb and the first three sentences. Direction 2, professional suspense about something wrong inside a flat during a viewing: complexity high, feasibility low, with only three samples and the weight falling on her weakness. The heartbreak group touches none of her material and is left out.

**Her choice:** Direction 2 is fresher, but she takes Direction 1. That is her decision; the matching only supplied an order and reasons.

**First validation:** she writes three sentences: “My uncle wanted Grandma's flat listed twenty percent under market, the sooner the better. I logged into the system: the flat had already been listed once, three months ago. The seller was Grandma, and the notes field held a single sentence.” Conflict, her double role and the hook all arrive within three sentences. She pulls the five raw entries in this direction and reads their blurbs; four start with a quarrel at a family dinner, so she keeps the listing-record entry point. Drafting her own blurb, she notices the satisfying ending relies only on Grandma scolding the uncle in public, so she changes it: acting as the agent, the narrator refuses the listing until Grandma confirms in person, and the uncle's plan stalls.

That is all that has happened. The story is unwritten and reader response is unknown; the re-scan is planned for three weeks later, when she will check whether this direction still shows up in the samples.

heading.zh: 结果能决定什么，常见误用怎么改
heading.en: What the Result Decides, and Common Misuses

body.zh:
这份结果能帮你排除方向、给候选排序、写明每个方向的依据和验证动作，并定下复扫日期。它不替你选题，也不预测阅读、收藏、签约或收入；没采到的平台，报告只说明原因并注明结论不含它。

| 误用 | 改法 |
|---|---|
| 把内置参考里的平台对照和题材公式当作当前行情 | 当候选假设，等真实样本校验 |
| 只抄书名，却期待“高”可行性 | 补标签、热度和简介，或接受低一档 |
| 截图看不清热度，就估一个数 | 省略这个字段 |
| 过了复扫日期还按旧结论开写 | 重扫，旧结论只当参考 |
| 把“值得写的方向”当成必写清单 | 按自己的素材取舍，也可以一个都不选 |

找到方向后，可以用 `/story-short-analyze` 拆一篇你手里有原文的同方向作品，或直接用 `/story-short-write` 开写；故事需要更长的展开，就转去 `/story-long-scan`。把方向写成完整短篇，见[一个点子怎么写成短篇小说](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/short-story-from-idea)。
body.en:
The result helps you rule out directions, rank candidates, record the basis and validation step for each one, and set a re-scan date. It does not choose for you and does not predict reads, saves, signing or income. For a platform it could not collect, the report gives the reason and says the conclusions exclude it.

| Misuse | Fix |
|---|---|
| Treating the built-in platform comparison and genre formulas as today's market | Treat them as hypotheses until real samples check them |
| Copying titles only, yet expecting “high” feasibility | Add tags, popularity and blurbs, or accept one level lower |
| Guessing a cropped popularity number | Omit the field |
| Drafting from an old conclusion after the re-scan date | Re-scan; keep the old result as reference |
| Treating “directions worth writing” as a to-do list | Choose by your material, or choose none |

Once you have a direction, use `/story-short-analyze` to dissect a same-direction story whose text you have, or start drafting with `/story-short-write`. If the story needs a longer arc, move to `/story-long-scan`. To turn the direction into a full piece, see [turning an idea into a short story](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/short-story-from-idea).

q.zh: 完全拿不到榜单，还能用这个 skill 选题吗？
q.en: Can I use the skill with no ranking at all?

a.zh: 能，但只能走内置知识：skill 加载跨平台历史参考，在报告里声明分析基于历史趋势数据、未经实时榜单校验前只是候选假设，列出要复扫的平台页面，所有方向的可行性都写“中”。哪怕只抄到十几条带标签和热度的样本，也比纯历史参考更接近当下，只是可信度仍然偏低。
a.en: Yes, but only through built-in knowledge. The skill loads its historical cross-platform reference, states in the report that the analysis rests on historical trend data and remains a candidate hypothesis until checked against a live ranking, lists the platform pages to re-scan, and rates every direction “medium”. Even a dozen or so copied entries with tags and popularity sit closer to the present, though confidence stays low.

q.zh: 样本要多少才算够？
q.en: How many samples are enough?

a.zh: 聚合时同一题材少于 10 本会标“少”。方向标“少”、样本不到 10 篇，或样本只是你给的书名列表，可行性都不能给“高”。少样本仍能帮你排除方向、比较简介和开头，但不能写成趋势。
a.en: During aggregation, a genre with fewer than 10 titles is marked “少” (thin). If a direction is marked thin, the sample has fewer than 10 titles, or the samples are only a list of titles you supplied, feasibility cannot be “high”. A thin sample can still rule out directions and let you compare blurbs and openings, but it cannot be reported as a trend.

q.zh: 扫完多久要再扫一次？
q.en: How soon should I scan again?

a.zh: 复扫日期通常定在扫榜后 2–4 周，过了这天结论只当参考。重扫时新建日期目录，和上一次的聚合表对比，结论文件里的“扫榜结论”和“选题匹配”整节替换。
a.en: The re-scan date is usually two to four weeks after the scan; after that, the conclusion is reference only. A re-scan uses a new dated folder, compares against the previous aggregate, and replaces the “scan conclusion” and “topic matching” sections of the conclusion file in full.

text.zh: 用 `$story-short-scan` 为我的盐言式短篇做一次手动扫榜和选题匹配。这个平台没有采集脚本：我会贴上从榜单截图转写的条目（书名、题材/标签、字数、看得见的热度口径和简介），请整理成手动榜单格式，缺的字段省略，不要补编，聚合后写扫榜结论。我的条件：[职业或生活素材]、[擅长与不擅长]、[目标篇幅]。给 2–3 个方向，每个写目标情绪、开头钩子、传播引擎、复杂度、可行性和开写前的验证动作，并标明样本数、可信度和复扫日期。不要替我决定写哪个，也不要预测阅读、签约或收入。
text.en: Use `$story-short-scan` to run a manual chart scan and topic match for my Yanyan-style short story. This platform has no collector: I will paste entries transcribed from ranking screenshots (title, genre/tags, word count, any visible popularity metric and blurb). Put them in the manual ranking format, omit missing fields rather than inventing them, aggregate, and write the scan conclusion. My conditions: [work or life material], [strengths and weaknesses], [target length]. Give two or three directions, each with target emotion, opening hook, sharing engine, complexity, feasibility and a validation step before drafting, and state the sample size, confidence and re-scan date. Do not decide which one I write, and do not predict reads, signing or income.
